book.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

verses.original: בְּ/רֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֵ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: br'shyt br' 'lhym 't hshmym v't h'rts
verses.translation: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֨הוּ֙ וָ/בֹ֔הוּ וְ/חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְ/ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vh'rts hyth thv vbhv vchshkh 'l pny thvm vrvch 'lhym mrchpt 'l pny hmym
verses.translation: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְהִ֣י א֑וֹר וַֽ/יְהִי אֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yhy 'vr vyhy 'vr
verses.translation: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָ/א֖וֹר כִּי ט֑וֹב וַ/יַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָ/א֖וֹר וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 't h'vr khy tvb vybdl 'lhym byn h'vr vbyn hchshkh
verses.translation: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים לָ/אוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְ/לַ/חֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽ/יְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽ/יְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhym l'vr yvm vlchshkh qr' lylh vyhy 'rb vyhy bqr yvm 'chd
verses.translation: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/מָּ֑יִם וִ/יהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָ/מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yhy rqy' btvkh hmym vyhy mbdyl byn mym lmym
verses.translation: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת הָ/רָקִיעַ֒ וַ/יַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִ/תַּ֣חַת לָ/רָקִ֔יעַ וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵ/עַ֣ל לָ/רָקִ֑יעַ וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym 't hrqy' vybdl byn hmym 'shr mtcht lrqy' vbyn hmym 'shr m'l lrqy' vyhy khn
verses.translation: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָֽ/רָקִ֖יעַ שָׁמָ֑יִם וַֽ/יְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽ/יְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שֵׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhym lrqy' shmym vyhy 'rb vyhy bqr yvm shny
verses.translation: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִקָּו֨וּ הַ/מַּ֜יִם מִ/תַּ֤חַת הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ אֶל מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְ/תֵרָאֶ֖ה הַ/יַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yqvv hmym mtcht hshmym 'l mqvm 'chd vtr'h hybshh vyhy khn
verses.translation: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים לַ/יַּבָּשָׁה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וּ/לְ/מִקְוֵ֥ה הַ/מַּ֖יִם קָרָ֣א יַמִּ֑ים וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhym lybshh 'rts vlmqvh hmym qr' ymym vyr' 'lhym khy tvb
verses.translation: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תַּֽדְשֵׁ֤א הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ דֶּ֔שֶׁא עֵ֚שֶׂב מַזְרִ֣יעַ זֶ֔רַע עֵ֣ץ פְּרִ֞י עֹ֤שֶׂה פְּרִי֙ לְ/מִינ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְע/וֹ ב֖/וֹ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym tdsh' h'rts dsh' 'shb mzry' zr' 'ts pry 'shh pry lmynv 'shr zr'v bv 'l h'rts vyhy khn
verses.translation: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

verses.original: וַ/תּוֹצֵ֨א הָ/אָ֜רֶץ דֶּ֠שֶׁא עֵ֣שֶׂב מַזְרִ֤יעַ זֶ֨רַע֙ לְ/מִינֵ֔/הוּ וְ/עֵ֧ץ עֹֽשֶׂה פְּרִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְע/וֹ ב֖/וֹ לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vtvts' h'rts dsh' 'shb mzry' zr' lmynhv v'ts 'shh pry 'shr zr'v bv lmynhv vyr' 'lhym khy tvb
verses.translation: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽ/יְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שְׁלִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vyhy 'rb vyhy bqr yvm shlyshy
verses.translation: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְהִ֤י מְאֹרֹת֙ בִּ/רְקִ֣יעַ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם לְ/הַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַ/יּ֖וֹם וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וְ/הָי֤וּ לְ/אֹתֹת֙ וּ/לְ/מ֣וֹעֲדִ֔ים וּ/לְ/יָמִ֖ים וְ/שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yhy m'rt brqy' hshmym lhbdyl byn hyvm vbyn hlylh vhyv l'tt vlmv'dym vlymym vshnym
verses.translation: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

verses.original: וְ/הָי֤וּ לִ/מְאוֹרֹת֙ בִּ/רְקִ֣יעַ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם לְ/הָאִ֖יר עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vhyv lm'vrt brqy' hshmym lh'yr 'l h'rts vyhy khn
verses.translation: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/מְּאֹרֹ֖ת הַ/גְּדֹלִ֑ים אֶת הַ/מָּא֤וֹר הַ/גָּדֹל֙ לְ/מֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/אֶת הַ/מָּא֤וֹר הַ/קָּטֹן֙ לְ/מֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וְ/אֵ֖ת הַ/כּוֹכָבִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym 't shny hm'rt hgdlym 't hm'vr hgdl lmmshlt hyvm v't hm'vr hqtn lmmshlt hlylh v't hkhvkhbym
verses.translation: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛/ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּ/רְקִ֣יעַ הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם לְ/הָאִ֖יר עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vytn 'tm 'lhym brqy' hshmym lh'yr 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

verses.original: וְ/לִ/מְשֹׁל֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם וּ/בַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וּֽ/לֲ/הַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הָ/א֖וֹר וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vlmshl byvm vblylh vlhbdyl byn h'vr vbyn hchshkh vyr' 'lhym khy tvb
verses.translation: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽ/יְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם רְבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vyhy 'rb vyhy bqr yvm rby'y
verses.translation: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יִשְׁרְצ֣וּ הַ/מַּ֔יִם שֶׁ֖רֶץ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֑ה וְ/עוֹף֙ יְעוֹפֵ֣ף עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ עַל פְּנֵ֖י רְקִ֥יעַ הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yshrtsv hmym shrts npsh chyh v'vf y'vpf 'l h'rts 'l pny rqy' hshmym
verses.translation: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת הַ/תַּנִּינִ֖ם הַ/גְּדֹלִ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽ/חַיָּ֣ה הָֽ/רֹמֶ֡שֶׂת אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁרְצ֨וּ הַ/מַּ֜יִם לְ/מִֽינֵ/הֶ֗ם וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל ע֤וֹף כָּנָף֙ לְ/מִינֵ֔/הוּ וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vybr' 'lhym 't htnynm hgdlym v't khl npsh hchyh hrmsht 'shr shrtsv hmym lmynhm v't khl 'vf khnf lmynhv vyr' 'lhym khy tvb
verses.translation: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֧רֶךְ אֹתָ֛/ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר פְּר֣וּ וּ/רְב֗וּ וּ/מִלְא֤וּ אֶת הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ בַּ/יַּמִּ֔ים וְ/הָ/ע֖וֹף יִ֥רֶב בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vybrkh 'tm 'lhym l'mr prv vrbv vml'v 't hmym bymym vh'vf yrb b'rts
verses.translation: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽ/יְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם חֲמִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vyhy 'rb vyhy bqr yvm chmyshy
verses.translation: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תּוֹצֵ֨א הָ/אָ֜רֶץ נֶ֤פֶשׁ חַיָּה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ בְּהֵמָ֥ה וָ/רֶ֛מֶשׂ וְ/חַֽיְתוֹ אֶ֖רֶץ לְ/מִינָ֑/הּ וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym tvts' h'rts npsh chyh lmynh bhmh vrmsh vchytv 'rts lmynh vyhy khn
verses.translation: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֩ אֶת חַיַּ֨ת הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לְ/מִינָ֗/הּ וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֖ה לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym 't chyt h'rts lmynh v't hbhmh lmynh v't khl rmsh h'dmh lmynhv vyr' 'lhym khy tvb
verses.translation: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֛ם בְּ/צַלְמֵ֖/נוּ כִּ/דְמוּתֵ֑/נוּ וְ/יִרְדּוּ֩ בִ/דְגַ֨ת הַ/יָּ֜ם וּ/בְ/ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ וּ/בְ/כָל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/בְ/כָל הָ/רֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽ/רֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym n'shh 'dm btslmnv khdmvtnv vyrdv bdgt hym vb'vf hshmym vbbhmh vbkhl h'rts vbkhl hrmsh hrmsh 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶת הָֽ/אָדָם֙ בְּ/צַלְמ֔/וֹ בְּ/צֶ֥לֶם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּרָ֣א אֹת֑/וֹ זָכָ֥ר וּ/נְקֵבָ֖ה בָּרָ֥א אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vybr' 'lhym 't h'dm btslmv btslm 'lhym br' 'tv zkhr vnqbh br' 'tm
verses.translation: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָ/ם֮ אֱלֹהִים֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לָ/הֶ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים פְּר֥וּ וּ/רְב֛וּ וּ/מִלְא֥וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/כִבְשֻׁ֑/הָ וּ/רְד֞וּ בִּ/דְגַ֤ת הַ/יָּם֙ וּ/בְ/ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וּ/בְ/כָל חַיָּ֖ה הָֽ/רֹמֶ֥שֶׂת עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vybrkh 'tm 'lhym vy'mr lhm 'lhym prv vrbv vml'v 't h'rts vkhbshh vrdv bdgt hym vb'vf hshmym vbkhl chyh hrmsht 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶת כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב זֹרֵ֣עַ זֶ֗רַע אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/עֵ֛ץ אֲשֶׁר בּ֥/וֹ פְרִי עֵ֖ץ זֹרֵ֣עַ זָ֑רַע לָ/כֶ֥ם יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym hnh ntty lkhm 't khl 'shb zr' zr' 'shr 'l pny khl h'rts v't khl h'ts 'shr bv pry 'ts zr' zr' lkhm yhyh l'khlh
verses.translation: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

verses.original: וּֽ/לְ/כָל חַיַּ֣ת הָ֠/אָרֶץ וּ/לְ/כָל ע֨וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ל רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר בּ/וֹ֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה אֶת כָּל יֶ֥רֶק עֵ֖שֶׂב לְ/אָכְלָ֑ה וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vlkhl chyt h'rts vlkhl 'vf hshmym vlkhl rvmsh 'l h'rts 'shr bv npsh chyh 't khl yrq 'shb l'khlh vyhy khn
verses.translation: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּה ט֖וֹב מְאֹ֑ד וַֽ/יְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽ/יְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם הַ/שִּׁשִּֽׁי
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 't khl 'shr 'shh vhnh tvb m'd vyhy 'rb vyhy bqr yvm hshshy
verses.translation: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

verses.original: וַ/יְכֻלּ֛וּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֥יִם וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/כָל צְבָאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykhlv hshmym vh'rts vkhl tsb'm
verses.translation: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִ/כָּל מְלַאכְתּ֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vykhl 'lhym byvm hshby'y ml'khtv 'shr 'shh vyshbt byvm hshby'y mkhl ml'khtv 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַ/יְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑/וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤/וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִ/כָּל מְלַאכְתּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vybrkh 'lhym 't yvm hshby'y vyqdsh 'tv khy bv shbt mkhl ml'khtv 'shr br' 'lhym l'shvt
verses.translation: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/הִבָּֽרְאָ֑/ם בְּ/י֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְ/שָׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'lh tvldvt hshmym vh'rts bhbr'm byvm 'shvt yhvh 'lhym 'rts vshmym
verses.translation: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל שִׂ֣יחַ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/כָל עֵ֥שֶׂב הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֶת הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl shych hshdh trm yhyh b'rts vkhl 'shb hshdh trm ytsmch khy l' hmtyr yhvh 'lhym 'l h'rts v'dm 'yn l'bd 't h'dmh
verses.translation: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת כָּל פְּנֵֽי הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'd y'lh mn h'rts vhshqh 't khl pny h'dmh
verses.translation: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת הָֽ/אָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה וַ/יִּפַּ֥ח בְּ/אַפָּ֖י/ו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַֽ/יְהִ֥י הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם לְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה
verses.translit: vyytsr yhvh 'lhym 't h'dm 'pr mn h'dmh vypch b'pyv nshmt chyym vyhy h'dm lnpsh chyh
verses.translation: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

verses.original: וַ/יִּטַּ֞ע יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים גַּן בְ/עֵ֖דֶן מִ/קֶּ֑דֶם וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם שָׁ֔ם אֶת הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר
verses.translit: vyt' yhvh 'lhym gn b'dn mqdm vyshm shm 't h'dm 'shr ytsr
verses.translation: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצְמַ֞ח יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה כָּל עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְ/מַרְאֶ֖ה וְ/ט֣וֹב לְ/מַאֲכָ֑ל וְ/עֵ֤ץ הַֽ/חַיִּים֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/גָּ֔ן וְ/עֵ֕ץ הַ/דַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָ/רָֽע
verses.translit: vytsmch yhvh 'lhym mn h'dmh khl 'ts nchmd lmr'h vtvb lm'khl v'ts hchyym btvkh hgn v'ts hd't tvb vr'
verses.translation: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

verses.original: וְ/נָהָרּ֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵ/עֵ֔דֶן לְ/הַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת הַ/גָּ֑ן וּ/מִ/שָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְ/הָיָ֖ה לְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vnhr yts' m'dn lhshqvt 't hgn vmshm yprd vhyh l'rb'h r'shym
verses.translation: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥ם הָֽ/אֶחָ֖ד פִּישׁ֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַ/סֹּבֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ/חֲוִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם הַ/זָּהָֽב
verses.translit: shm h'chd pyshvn hv' hsbb 't khl 'rts hchvylh 'shr shm hzhb
verses.translation: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

verses.original: וּֽ/זֲהַ֛ב הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/הִ֖וא ט֑וֹב שָׁ֥ם הַ/בְּדֹ֖לַח וְ/אֶ֥בֶן הַ/שֹּֽׁהַם
verses.translit: vzhb h'rts hhv' tvb shm hbdlch v'bn hshhm
verses.translation: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

verses.original: וְ/שֵֽׁם הַ/נָּהָ֥ר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י גִּיח֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַ/סּוֹבֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ כּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: vshm hnhr hshny gychvn hv' hsvbb 't khl 'rts khvsh
verses.translation: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֨ם הַ/נָּהָ֤ר הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֙ חִדֶּ֔קֶל ה֥וּא הַֽ/הֹלֵ֖ךְ קִדְמַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/הַ/נָּהָ֥ר הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֖י ה֥וּא פְרָֽת
verses.translit: vshm hnhr hshlyshy chdql hv' hhlkh qdmt 'shvr vhnhr hrby'y hv' prt
verses.translation: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת הָֽ/אָדָ֑ם וַ/יַּנִּחֵ֣/הוּ בְ/גַן עֵ֔דֶן לְ/עָבְדָ֖/הּ וּ/לְ/שָׁמְרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyqch yhvh 'lhym 't h'dm vynchhv bgn 'dn l'bdh vlshmrh
verses.translation: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַו֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מִ/כֹּ֥ל עֵֽץ הַ/גָּ֖ן אָכֹ֥ל תֹּאכֵֽל
verses.translit: vytsv yhvh 'lhym 'l h'dm l'mr mkhl 'ts hgn 'khl t'khl
verses.translation: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עֵ֗ץ הַ/דַּ֨עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָ/רָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּ/י֛וֹם אֲכָלְ/ךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: vm'ts hd't tvb vr' l' t'khl mmnv khy byvm 'khlkh mmnv mvt tmvt
verses.translation: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ לּ֥/וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּ/נֶגְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym l' tvb hyvt h'dm lbdv ''shh lv 'zr khngdv
verses.translation: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִן הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֗ה כָּל חַיַּ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יָּבֵא֙ אֶל הָ֣/אָדָ֔ם לִ/רְא֖וֹת מַה יִּקְרָא ל֑/וֹ וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקְרָא ל֧/וֹ הָֽ/אָדָ֛ם נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytsr yhvh 'lhym mn h'dmh khl chyt hshdh v't khl 'vf hshmym vyb' 'l h'dm lr'vt mh yqr' lv vkhl 'shr yqr' lv h'dm npsh chyh hv' shmv
verses.translation: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א הָֽ/אָדָ֜ם שֵׁמ֗וֹת לְ/כָל הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ וּ/לְ/ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וּ/לְ/אָדָ֕ם לֹֽא מָצָ֥א עֵ֖זֶר כְּ/נֶגְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqr' h'dm shmvt lkhl hbhmh vl'vf hshmym vlkhl chyt hshdh vl'dm l' mts' 'zr khngdv
verses.translation: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּפֵּל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים תַּרְדֵּמָ֛ה עַל הָ/אָדָ֖ם וַ/יִּישָׁ֑ן וַ/יִּקַּ֗ח אַחַת֙ מִ/צַּלְעֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּסְגֹּ֥ר בָּשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vypl yhvh 'lhym trdmh 'l h'dm vyyshn vyqch 'cht mtsl'tyv vysgr bshr tchtnh
verses.translation: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶֽת הַ/צֵּלָ֛ע אֲשֶׁר לָקַ֥ח מִן הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יְבִאֶ֖/הָ אֶל הָֽ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vybn yhvh 'lhym 't htsl' 'shr lqch mn h'dm l'shh vyb'h 'l h'dm
verses.translation: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ הָֽ/אָדָם֒ זֹ֣את הַ/פַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽ/עֲצָמַ֔/י וּ/בָשָׂ֖ר מִ/בְּשָׂרִ֑/י לְ/זֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵ/אִ֖ישׁ לֻֽקֳחָה זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr h'dm z't hp'm 'tsm m'tsmy vbshr mbshry lz't yqr' 'shh khy m'ysh lqchh z't
verses.translation: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ יַֽעֲזָב אִ֔ישׁ אֶת אָבִ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת אִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/דָבַ֣ק בְּ/אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וְ/הָי֖וּ לְ/בָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'l khn y'zb 'ysh 't 'byv v't 'mv vdbq b'shtv vhyv lbshr 'chd
verses.translation: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם וְ/אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֖א יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ
verses.translit: vyhyv shnyhm 'rvmym h'dm v'shtv vl' ytbshshv
verses.translation: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נָּחָשׁ֙ הָיָ֣ה עָר֔וּם מִ/כֹּל֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הָ֣/אִשָּׁ֔ה אַ֚ף כִּֽי אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל עֵ֥ץ הַ/גָּֽן
verses.translit: vhnchsh hyh 'rvm mkhl chyt hshdh 'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhym vy'mr 'l h'shh 'f khy 'mr 'lhym l' t'khlv mkhl 'ts hgn
verses.translation: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל הַ/נָּחָ֑שׁ מִ/פְּרִ֥י עֵֽץ הַ/גָּ֖ן נֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh 'l hnchsh mpry 'ts hgn n'khl
verses.translation: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/פְּרִ֣י הָ/עֵץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/תוֹךְ הַ/גָּן֒ אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/לֹ֥א תִגְּע֖וּ בּ֑/וֹ פֶּן תְּמֻתֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vmpry h'ts 'shr btvkh hgn 'mr 'lhym l' t'khlv mmnv vl' tg'v bv pn tmtvn
verses.translation: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/נָּחָ֖שׁ אֶל הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֑ה לֹֽא מ֖וֹת תְּמֻתֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vy'mr hnchsh 'l h'shh l' mvt tmtvn
verses.translation: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

verses.original: כִּ֚י יֹדֵ֣עַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֗י בְּ/יוֹם֙ אֲכָלְ/כֶ֣ם מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/נִפְקְח֖וּ עֵֽינֵי/כֶ֑ם וִ/הְיִיתֶם֙ כֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים יֹדְעֵ֖י ט֥וֹב וָ/רָֽע
verses.translit: khy yd' 'lhym khy byvm 'khlkhm mmnv vnpqchv 'ynykhm vhyytm kh'lhym yd'y tvb vr'
verses.translation: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣רֶא הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֡ה כִּ֣י טוֹב֩ הָ/עֵ֨ץ לְ/מַאֲכָ֜ל וְ/כִ֧י תַֽאֲוָה ה֣וּא לָ/עֵינַ֗יִם וְ/נֶחְמָ֤ד הָ/עֵץ֙ לְ/הַשְׂכִּ֔יל וַ/תִּקַּ֥ח מִ/פִּרְי֖/וֹ וַ/תֹּאכַ֑ל וַ/תִּתֵּ֧ן גַּם לְ/אִישָׁ֛/הּ עִמָּ֖/הּ וַ/יֹּאכַֽל
verses.translit: vtr' h'shh khy tvb h'ts lm'khl vkhy t'vh hv' l'ynym vnchmd h'ts lhshkhyl vtqch mpryv vt'khl vttn gm l'yshh 'mh vy'khl
verses.translation: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

verses.original: וַ/תִּפָּקַ֨חְנָה֙ עֵינֵ֣י שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י עֵֽירֻמִּ֖ם הֵ֑ם וַֽ/יִּתְפְּרוּ֙ עֲלֵ֣ה תְאֵנָ֔ה וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם חֲגֹרֹֽת
verses.translit: vtpqchnh 'yny shnyhm vyd'v khy 'yrmm hm vytprv 'lh t'nh vy'shv lhm chgrt
verses.translation: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶת ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּ/גָּ֖ן לְ/ר֣וּחַ הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/יִּתְחַבֵּ֨א הָֽ/אָדָ֜ם וְ/אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ עֵ֥ץ הַ/גָּֽן
verses.translit: vyshm'v 't qvl yhvh 'lhym mthlkh bgn lrvch hyvm vytchb' h'dm v'shtv mpny yhvh 'lhym btvkh 'ts hgn
verses.translation: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל הָֽ/אָדָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ אַיֶּֽ/כָּה
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvh 'lhym 'l h'dm vy'mr lv 'ykhh
verses.translation: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת קֹלְ/ךָ֥ שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בַּ/גָּ֑ן וָ/אִירָ֛א כִּֽי עֵירֹ֥ם אָנֹ֖כִי וָ/אֵחָבֵֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr 't qlkh shm'ty bgn v'yr' khy 'yrm 'nkhy v'chb'
verses.translation: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֚י הִגִּ֣יד לְ/ךָ֔ כִּ֥י עֵירֹ֖ם אָ֑תָּה הֲ/מִן הָ/עֵ֗ץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר צִוִּיתִ֛י/ךָ לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י אֲכָל מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ אָכָֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr my hgyd lkh khy 'yrm 'th hmn h'ts 'shr tsvytykh lblty 'khl mmnv 'khlt
verses.translation: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הָֽ/אָדָ֑ם הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה עִמָּדִ֔/י הִ֛וא נָֽתְנָה לִּ֥/י מִן הָ/עֵ֖ץ וָ/אֹכֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr h'dm h'shh 'shr ntth 'mdy hv' ntnh ly mn h'ts v'khl
verses.translation: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה מַה זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑ית וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה הַ/נָּחָ֥שׁ הִשִּׁיאַ֖/נִי וָ/אֹכֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym l'shh mh z't 'shyt vt'mr h'shh hnchsh hshy'ny v'khl
verses.translation: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֶֽל הַ/נָּחָשׁ֮ כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּאת֒ אָר֤וּר אַתָּה֙ מִ/כָּל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה וּ/מִ/כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה עַל גְּחֹנְ/ךָ֣ תֵלֵ֔ךְ וְ/עָפָ֥ר תֹּאכַ֖ל כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym 'l hnchsh khy 'shyt z't 'rvr 'th mkhl hbhmh vmkhl chyt hshdh 'l gchnkh tlkh v'pr t'khl khl ymy chyykh
verses.translation: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

verses.original: וְ/אֵיבָ֣ה אָשִׁ֗ית בֵּֽינְ/ךָ֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וּ/בֵ֥ין זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ וּ/בֵ֣ין זַרְעָ֑/הּ ה֚וּא יְשׁוּפְ/ךָ֣ רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תְּשׁוּפֶ֥/נּוּ עָקֵֽב
verses.translit: v'ybh 'shyt bynkh vbyn h'shh vbyn zr'kh vbyn zr'h hv' yshvpkh r'sh v'th tshvpnv 'qb
verses.translation: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

verses.original: אֶֽל הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הַרְבָּ֤ה אַרְבֶּה֙ עִצְּבוֹנֵ֣/ךְ וְ/הֵֽרֹנֵ֔/ךְ בְּ/עֶ֖צֶב תֵּֽלְדִ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְ/אֶל אִישֵׁ/ךְ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָתֵ֔/ךְ וְ/ה֖וּא יִמְשָׁל בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l h'shh 'mr hrbh 'rbh 'tsbvnkh vhrnkh b'tsb tldy bnym v'l 'yshkh tshvqtkh vhv' ymshl bkh
verses.translation: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אָדָ֣ם אָמַ֗ר כִּֽי שָׁמַעְתָּ֮ לְ/ק֣וֹל אִשְׁתֶּ/ךָ֒ וַ/תֹּ֨אכַל֙ מִן הָ/עֵ֔ץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּיתִ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אֲרוּרָ֤ה הָֽ/אֲדָמָה֙ בַּֽ/עֲבוּרֶ֔/ךָ בְּ/עִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔/נָּה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vl'dm 'mr khy shm't lqvl 'shtkh vt'khl mn h'ts 'shr tsvytykh l'mr l' t'khl mmnv 'rvrh h'dmh b'bvrkh b'tsbvn t'khlnh khl ymy chyykh
verses.translation: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

verses.original: וְ/ק֥וֹץ וְ/דַרְדַּ֖ר תַּצְמִ֣יחַֽ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֖ אֶת עֵ֥שֶׂב הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vqvts vdrdr ttsmych lkh v'khlt 't 'shb hshdh
verses.translation: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

verses.original: בְּ/זֵעַ֤ת אַפֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ תֹּ֣אכַל לֶ֔חֶם עַ֤ד שֽׁוּבְ/ךָ֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖/נָּה לֻקָּ֑חְתָּ כִּֽי עָפָ֣ר אַ֔תָּה וְ/אֶל עָפָ֖ר תָּשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: bz't 'pykh t'khl lchm 'd shvbkh 'l h'dmh khy mmnh lqcht khy 'pr 'th v'l 'pr tshvb
verses.translation: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art , and unto dust shalt thou return.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א הָֽ/אָדָ֛ם שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ חַוָּ֑ה כִּ֛י הִ֥וא הָֽיְתָ֖ה אֵ֥ם כָּל חָֽי
verses.translit: vyqr' h'dm shm 'shtv chvh khy hv' hyth 'm khl chy
verses.translation: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַשׂ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְ/אָדָ֧ם וּ/לְ/אִשְׁתּ֛/וֹ כָּתְנ֥וֹת ע֖וֹר וַ/יַּלְבִּשֵֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh 'lhym l'dm vl'shtv khtnvt 'vr vylbshm
verses.translation: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים הֵ֤ן הָֽ/אָדָם֙ הָיָה֙ כְּ/אַחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ לָ/דַ֖עַת ט֣וֹב וָ/רָ֑ע וְ/עַתָּ֣ה פֶּן יִשְׁלַ֣ח יָד֗/וֹ וְ/לָקַח֙ גַּ֚ם מֵ/עֵ֣ץ הַֽ/חַיִּ֔ים וְ/אָכַ֖ל וָ/חַ֥י לְ/עֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym hn h'dm hyh kh'chd mmnv ld't tvb vr' v'th pn yshlch ydv vlqch gm m'ts hchyym v'khl vchy l'lm
verses.translation: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֛/הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִ/גַּן עֵ֑דֶן לַֽ/עֲבֹד֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֻקַּ֖ח מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshlchhv yhvh 'lhym mgn 'dn l'bd 't h'dmh 'shr lqch mshm
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

verses.original: וַ/יְגָ֖רֶשׁ אֶת הָֽ/אָדָ֑ם וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּן֩ מִ/קֶּ֨דֶם לְ/גַן עֵ֜דֶן אֶת הַ/כְּרֻבִ֗ים וְ/אֵ֨ת לַ֤הַט הַ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ הַ/מִּתְהַפֶּ֔כֶת לִ/שְׁמֹ֕ר אֶת דֶּ֖רֶךְ עֵ֥ץ הַֽ/חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vygrsh 't h'dm vyshkhn mqdm lgn 'dn 't hkhrbym v't lht hchrb hmthpkht lshmr 't drkh 'ts hchyym
verses.translation: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣/אָדָ֔ם יָדַ֖ע אֶת חַוָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וַ/תַּ֨הַר֙ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד אֶת קַ֔יִן וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר קָנִ֥יתִי אִ֖ישׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vh'dm yd' 't chvh 'shtv vthr vtld 't qyn vt'mr qnyty 'ysh 't yhvh
verses.translation: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣סֶף לָ/לֶ֔דֶת אֶת אָחִ֖י/ו אֶת הָ֑בֶל וַֽ/יְהִי הֶ֨בֶל֙ רֹ֣עֵה צֹ֔אן וְ/קַ֕יִן הָיָ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ד אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vtsf lldt 't 'chyv 't hbl vyhy hbl r'h ts'n vqyn hyh 'bd 'dmh
verses.translation: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֖י מִ/קֵּ֣ץ יָמִ֑ים וַ/יָּבֵ֨א קַ֜יִן מִ/פְּרִ֧י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy mqts ymym vyb' qyn mpry h'dmh mnchh lyhvh
verses.translation: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הֶ֨בֶל הֵבִ֥יא גַם ה֛וּא מִ/בְּכֹר֥וֹת צֹאנ֖/וֹ וּ/מֵֽ/חֶלְבֵ/הֶ֑ן וַ/יִּ֣שַׁע יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הֶ֖בֶל וְ/אֶל מִנְחָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhbl hby' gm hv' mbkhrvt ts'nv vmchlbhn vysh' yhvh 'l hbl v'l mnchtv
verses.translation: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

verses.original: וְ/אֶל קַ֥יִן וְ/אֶל מִנְחָת֖/וֹ לֹ֣א שָׁעָ֑ה וַ/יִּ֤חַר לְ/קַ֨יִן֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'l qyn v'l mnchtv l' sh'h vychr lqyn m'd vyplv pnyv
verses.translation: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל קָ֑יִן לָ֚/מָּה חָ֣רָה לָ֔/ךְ וְ/לָ֖/מָּה נָפְל֥וּ פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l qyn lmh chrh lkh vlmh nplv pnykh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֤וֹא אִם תֵּיטִיב֙ שְׂאֵ֔ת וְ/אִם֙ לֹ֣א תֵיטִ֔יב לַ/פֶּ֖תַח חַטָּ֣את רֹבֵ֑ץ וְ/אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָת֔/וֹ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּמְשָׁל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hlv' 'm tytyb sh't v'm l' tytyb lptch cht't rbts v'lykh tshvqtv v'th tmshl bv
verses.translation: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑י/ו וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בִּ/הְיוֹתָ֣/ם בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וַ/יָּ֥קָם קַ֛יִן אֶל הֶ֥בֶל אָחִ֖י/ו וַ/יַּהַרְגֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr qyn 'l hbl 'chyv vyhy bhyvtm bshdh vyqm qyn 'l hbl 'chyv vyhrghv
verses.translation: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל קַ֔יִן אֵ֖י הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי הֲ/שֹׁמֵ֥ר אָחִ֖/י אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l qyn 'y hbl 'chykh vy'mr l' yd'ty hshmr 'chy 'nkhy
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ ק֚וֹל דְּמֵ֣י אָחִ֔י/ךָ צֹעֲקִ֥ים אֵלַ֖/י מִן הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mh 'shyt qvl dmy 'chykh ts'qym 'ly mn h'dmh
verses.translation: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה אָר֣וּר אָ֑תָּה מִן הָֽ/אֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּצְתָ֣ה אֶת פִּ֔י/הָ לָ/קַ֛חַת אֶת דְּמֵ֥י אָחִ֖י/ךָ מִ/יָּדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th 'rvr 'th mn h'dmh 'shr ptsth 't pyh lqcht 't dmy 'chykh mydkh
verses.translation: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹֽא תֹסֵ֥ף תֵּת כֹּחָ֖/הּ לָ֑/ךְ נָ֥ע וָ/נָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה בָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy t'bd 't h'dmh l' tsf tt khchh lkh n' vnd thyh b'rts
verses.translation: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל עֲוֺנִ֖/י מִ/נְּשֹֽׂא
verses.translit: vy'mr qyn 'l yhvh gdvl 'vny mnsh'
verses.translation: And Cain said unto the LORD , My punishment is greater than I can bear.

verses.original: הֵן֩ גֵּרַ֨שְׁתָּ אֹתִ֜/י הַ/יּ֗וֹם מֵ/עַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה וּ/מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ אֶסָּתֵ֑ר וְ/הָיִ֜יתִי נָ֤ע וָ/נָד֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הָיָ֥ה כָל מֹצְאִ֖/י יַֽהַרְגֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hn grsht 'ty hyvm m'l pny h'dmh vmpnykh 'str vhyyty n' vnd b'rts vhyh khl mts'y yhrgny
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ יְהוָ֗ה לָ/כֵן֙ כָּל הֹרֵ֣ג קַ֔יִן שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקָּ֑ם וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם יְהוָ֤ה לְ/קַ֨יִן֙ א֔וֹת לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י הַכּוֹת אֹת֖/וֹ כָּל מֹצְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yhvh lkhn khl hrg qyn shb'tym yqm vyshm yhvh lqyn 'vt lblty hkhvt 'tv khl mts'v
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥צֵא קַ֖יִן מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ נ֖וֹד קִדְמַת עֵֽדֶן
verses.translit: vyts' qyn mlpny yhvh vyshb b'rts nvd qdmt 'dn
verses.translation: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD , and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤דַע קַ֨יִן֙ אֶת אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַ/תַּ֖הַר וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד אֶת חֲנ֑וֹךְ וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בֹּ֣נֶה עִ֔יר וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הָ/עִ֔יר כְּ/שֵׁ֖ם בְּנ֥/וֹ חֲנֽוֹךְ
verses.translit: vyd' qyn 't 'shtv vthr vtld 't chnvkh vyhy bnh 'yr vyqr' shm h'yr khshm bnv chnvkh
verses.translation: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּלֵ֤ד לַֽ/חֲנוֹךְ֙ אֶת עִירָ֔ד וְ/עִירָ֕ד יָלַ֖ד אֶת מְחֽוּיָאֵ֑ל וּ/מְחִיּיָאֵ֗ל יָלַד֙ אֶת מְת֣וּשָׁאֵ֔ל וּ/מְתוּשָׁאֵ֖ל יָלַ֥ד אֶת לָֽמֶךְ
verses.translit: vyvld lchnvkh 't 'yrd v'yrd yld 't mchvy'l vmchyy'l yld 't mtvsh'l vmtvsh'l yld 't lmkh
verses.translation: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל֥/וֹ לֶ֖מֶךְ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם הָֽ/אַחַת֙ עָדָ֔ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית צִלָּֽה
verses.translit: vyqch lv lmkh shty nshym shm h'cht 'dh vshm hshnyt tslh
verses.translation: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד עָדָ֖ה אֶת יָבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י יֹשֵׁ֥ב אֹ֖הֶל וּ/מִקְנֶֽה
verses.translit: vtld 'dh 't ybl hv' hyh 'by yshb 'hl vmqnh
verses.translation: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖י/ו יוּבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י כָּל תֹּפֵ֥שׂ כִּנּ֖וֹר וְ/עוּגָֽב
verses.translit: vshm 'chyv yvbl hv' hyh 'by khl tpsh khnvr v'vgb
verses.translation: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

verses.original: וְ/צִלָּ֣ה גַם הִ֗וא יָֽלְדָה֙ אֶת תּ֣וּבַל קַ֔יִן לֹטֵ֕שׁ כָּל חֹרֵ֥שׁ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת וּ/בַרְזֶ֑ל וַֽ/אֲח֥וֹת תּֽוּבַל קַ֖יִן נַֽעֲמָֽה
verses.translit: vtslh gm hv' yldh 't tvbl qyn ltsh khl chrsh nchsht vbrzl v'chvt tvbl qyn n'mh
verses.translation: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לֶ֜מֶךְ לְ/נָשָׁ֗י/ו עָדָ֤ה וְ/צִלָּה֙ שְׁמַ֣עַן קוֹלִ֔/י נְשֵׁ֣י לֶ֔מֶךְ הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִ֑/י כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ הָרַ֨גְתִּי֙ לְ/פִצְעִ֔/י וְ/יֶ֖לֶד לְ/חַבֻּרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lmkh lnshyv 'dh vtslh shm'n qvly nshy lmkh h'znh 'mrty khy 'ysh hrgty lpts'y vyld lchbrty
verses.translation: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

verses.original: כִּ֥י שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקַּם קָ֑יִן וְ/לֶ֖מֶךְ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: khy shb'tym yqm qyn vlmkh shb'ym vshb'h
verses.translation: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨דַע אָדָ֥ם עוֹד֙ אֶת אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ שֵׁ֑ת כִּ֣י שָֽׁת לִ֤/י אֱלֹהִים֙ זֶ֣רַע אַחֵ֔ר תַּ֣חַת הֶ֔בֶל כִּ֥י הֲרָג֖/וֹ קָֽיִן
verses.translit: vyd' 'dm 'vd 't 'shtv vtld bn vtqr' 't shmv sht khy sht ly 'lhym zr' 'chr tcht hbl khy hrgv qyn
verses.translation: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֤ת גַּם הוּא֙ יֻלַּד בֵּ֔ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ אָ֣ז הוּחַ֔ל לִ/קְרֹ֖א בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlsht gm hv' yld bn vyqr' 't shmv 'nvsh 'z hvchl lqr' bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD .

verses.original: זֶ֣ה סֵ֔פֶר תּוֹלְדֹ֖ת אָדָ֑ם בְּ/י֗וֹם בְּרֹ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אָדָ֔ם בִּ/דְמ֥וּת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zh spr tvldt 'dm byvm br' 'lhym 'dm bdmvt 'lhym 'shh 'tv
verses.translation: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

verses.original: זָכָ֥ר וּ/נְקֵבָ֖ה בְּרָאָ֑/ם וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָ֗/ם וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמָ/ם֙ אָדָ֔ם בְּ/י֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: zkhr vnqbh br'm vybrkh 'tm vyqr' 't shmm 'dm byvm hbr'm
verses.translation: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י אָדָ֗ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּ/מְאַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בִּ/דְמוּת֖/וֹ כְּ/צַלְמ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ שֵֽׁת
verses.translit: vychy 'dm shlshym vm't shnh vyvld bdmvtv khtslmv vyqr' 't shmv sht
verses.translation: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֣וּ יְמֵי אָדָ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת שֵׁ֔ת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhyv ymy 'dm 'chry hvlydv 't sht shmnh m't shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֞וּ כָּל יְמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁר חַ֔י תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy 'dm 'shr chy tsh' m'vt shnh vshlshym shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי שֵׁ֕ת חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּ/מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת אֱנֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vychy sht chmsh shnym vm't shnh vyvld 't 'nvsh
verses.translation: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי שֵׁ֗ת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת אֱנ֔וֹשׁ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy sht 'chry hvlydv 't 'nvsh shb' shnym vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵי שֵׁ֔ת שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/תְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy sht shtym 'shrh shnh vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֥י אֱנ֖וֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת קֵינָֽן
verses.translit: vychy 'nvsh tsh'ym shnh vyvld 't qynn
verses.translation: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י אֱנ֗וֹשׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת קֵינָ֔ן חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy 'nvsh 'chry hvlydv 't qynn chmsh 'shrh shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י אֱנ֔וֹשׁ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וּ/תְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy 'nvsh chmsh shnym vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֥י קֵינָ֖ן שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת מַֽהֲלַלְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vychy qynn shb'ym shnh vyvld 't mhll'l
verses.translation: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י קֵינָ֗ן אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy qynn 'chry hvlydv 't mhll'l 'rb'ym shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י קֵינָ֔ן עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים וּ/תְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy qynn 'shr shnym vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת יָֽרֶד
verses.translit: vychy mhll'l chmsh shnym vshshym shnh vyvld 't yrd
verses.translation: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֗ל אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת יֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy mhll'l 'chry hvlydv 't yrd shlshym shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י מַהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֤שׁ וְ/תִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy mhll'l chmsh vtsh'ym shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי יֶ֕רֶד שְׁתַּ֧יִם וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת חֲנֽוֹךְ
verses.translit: vychy yrd shtym vshshym shnh vm't shnh vyvld 't chnvkh
verses.translation: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי יֶ֗רֶד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת חֲנ֔וֹךְ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy yrd 'chry hvlydv 't chnvkh shmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵי יֶ֔רֶד שְׁתַּ֤יִם וְ/שִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/תְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy yrd shtym vshshym shnh vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י חֲנ֔וֹךְ חָמֵ֥שׁ וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת מְתוּשָֽׁלַח
verses.translit: vychy chnvkh chmsh vshshym shnh vyvld 't mtvshlch
verses.translation: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְהַלֵּ֨ךְ חֲנ֜וֹךְ אֶת הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vythlkh chnvkh 't h'lhym 'chry hvlydv 't mtvshlch shlsh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י כָּל יְמֵ֣י חֲנ֑וֹךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְ/שִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khl ymy chnvkh chmsh vshshym shnh vshlsh m'vt shnh
verses.translation: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ חֲנ֖וֹךְ אֶת הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/אֵינֶ֕/נּוּ כִּֽי לָקַ֥ח אֹת֖/וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vythlkh chnvkh 't h'lhym v'ynnv khy lqch 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שֶׁ֧בַע וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת לָֽמֶךְ
verses.translit: vychy mtvshlch shb' vshmnym shnh vm't shnh vyvld 't lmkh
verses.translation: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֗לַח אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת לֶ֔מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֤יִם וּ/שְׁמוֹנִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy mtvshlch 'chry hvlydv 't lmkh shtym vshmvnym shnh vshb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח תֵּ֤שַׁע וְ/שִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/תְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy mtvshlch tsh' vshshym shnh vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי לֶ֕מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֧יִם וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vychy lmkh shtym vshmnym shnh vm't shnh vyvld bn
verses.translation: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א אֶת שְׁמ֛/וֹ נֹ֖חַ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֶ֞֠ה יְנַחֲמֵ֤/נוּ מִֽ/מַּעֲשֵׂ֨/נוּ֙ וּ/מֵ/עִצְּב֣וֹן יָדֵ֔י/נוּ מִן הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽרְרָ֖/הּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' 't shmv nch l'mr zh ynchmnv mm'shnv vm'tsbvn ydynv mn h'dmh 'shr 'rrh yhvh
verses.translation: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי לֶ֗מֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת נֹ֔חַ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְ/תִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy lmkh 'chry hvlydv 't nch chmsh vtsh'ym shnh vchmsh m't shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כָּל יְמֵי לֶ֔מֶךְ שֶׁ֤בַע וְ/שִׁבְעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhy khl ymy lmkh shb' vshb'ym shnh vshb' m'vt shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי נֹ֕חַ בֶּן חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֣וֹלֶד נֹ֔חַ אֶת שֵׁ֖ם אֶת חָ֥ם וְ/אֶת יָֽפֶת
verses.translit: vyhy nch bn chmsh m'vt shnh vyvld nch 't shm 't chm v't ypt
verses.translation: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּֽי הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם לָ/רֹ֖ב עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וּ/בָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy khy hchl h'dm lrb 'l pny h'dmh vbnvt yldv lhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ בְנֵי הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם כִּ֥י טֹבֹ֖ת הֵ֑נָּה וַ/יִּקְח֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyr'v bny h'lhym 't bnvt h'dm khy tbt hnh vyqchv lhm nshym mkhl 'shr bchrv
verses.translation: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא יָד֨וֹן רוּחִ֤/י בָֽ/אָדָם֙ לְ/עֹלָ֔ם בְּ/שַׁ/גַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר וְ/הָי֣וּ יָמָ֔י/ו מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh l' ydvn rvchy b'dm l'lm bshgm hv' bshr vhyv ymyv m'h v'shrym shnh
verses.translation: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

verses.original: הַ/נְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָ/אָרֶץ֮ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵם֒ וְ/גַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֜אוּ בְּנֵ֤י הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם וְ/יָלְד֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵ/עוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/שֵּֽׁם
verses.translit: hnplym hyv b'rts bymym hhm vgm 'chry khn 'shr yb'v bny h'lhym 'l bnvt h'dm vyldv lhm hmh hgbrym 'shr m'vlm 'nshy hshm
verses.translation: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָ/אָדָ֖ם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כָל יֵ֨צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔/וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh khy rbh r't h'dm b'rts vkhl ytsr mchshbt lbv rq r' khl hyvm
verses.translation: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vynchm yhvh khy 'shh 't h'dm b'rts vyt'tsb 'l lbv
verses.translation: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת הָ/אָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָ֨אתִי֙ מֵ/עַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽ/אָדָם֙ עַד בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְ/עַד ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'mchh 't h'dm 'shr br'ty m'l pny h'dmh m'dm 'd bhmh 'd rmsh v'd 'vf hshmym khy nchmty khy 'shytm
verses.translation: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֕חַ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnch mts' chn b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD .

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים הָיָ֖ה בְּ/דֹֽרֹתָ֑י/ו אֶת הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ נֹֽחַ
verses.translit: 'lh tvldt nch nch 'ysh tsdyq tmym hyh bdrtyv 't h'lhym hthlkh nch
verses.translation: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד נֹ֖חַ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים אֶת שֵׁ֖ם אֶת חָ֥ם וְ/אֶת יָֽפֶת
verses.translit: vyvld nch shlshh bnym 't shm 't chm v't ypt
verses.translation: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֥א הָ/אָ֖רֶץ חָמָֽס
verses.translit: vtshcht h'rts lpny h'lhym vtml' h'rts chms
verses.translation: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי הִשְׁחִ֧ית כָּל בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 't h'rts vhnh nshchth khy hshchyt khl bshr 't drkhv 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְ/נֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כָּל בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְ/פָנַ֔/י כִּֽי מָלְאָ֥ה הָ/אָ֛רֶץ חָמָ֖ס מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הִנְ/נִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖/ם אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym lnch qts khl bshr b' lpny khy ml'h h'rts chms mpnyhm vhnny mshchytm 't h'rts
verses.translation: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ תֵּבַ֣ת עֲצֵי גֹ֔פֶר קִנִּ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת הַ/תֵּבָ֑ה וְ/כָֽפַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛/הּ מִ/בַּ֥יִת וּ/מִ/ח֖וּץ בַּ/כֹּֽפֶר
verses.translit: 'shh lkh tbt 'tsy gpr qnym t'shh 't htbh vkhprt 'th mbyt vmchvts bkhpr
verses.translation: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֹתָ֑/הּ שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔/הּ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vzh 'shr t'shh 'th shlsh m'vt 'mh 'rkh htbh chmshym 'mh rchbh vshlshym 'mh qvmth
verses.translation: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

verses.translit: tshr t'shh ltbh v'l 'mh tkhlnh mlm'lh vptch htbh btsdh tshym tchtym shnym vshlshym t'shh
verses.translation: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י הִנְ/נִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶת הַ/מַּבּ֥וּל מַ֨יִם֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לְ/שַׁחֵ֣ת כָּל בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁר בּ/וֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ חַיִּ֔ים מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ יִגְוָֽע
verses.translit: v'ny hnny mby' 't hmbvl mym 'l h'rts lshcht khl bshr 'shr bv rvch chyym mtcht hshmym khl 'shr b'rts ygv'
verses.translation: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֥י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י אִתָּ֑/ךְ וּ/בָאתָ֙ אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה אַתָּ֕ה וּ/בָנֶ֛י/ךָ וְ/אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֥ וּ/נְשֵֽׁי בָנֶ֖י/ךָ אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhqmty 't bryty 'tkh vb't 'l htbh 'th vbnykh v'shtkh vnshy bnykh 'tkh
verses.translation: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/כָּל הָ֠/חַי מִֽ/כָּל בָּשָׂ֞ר שְׁנַ֧יִם מִ/כֹּ֛ל תָּבִ֥יא אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֖ה לְ/הַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑/ךְ זָכָ֥ר וּ/נְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vmkhl hchy mkhl bshr shnym mkhl tby' 'l htbh lhchyt 'tkh zkhr vnqbh yhyv
verses.translation: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

verses.original: מֵ/הָ/ע֣וֹף לְ/מִינֵ֗/הוּ וּ/מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ מִ/כֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֖ה לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִ/כֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/הַֽחֲיֽוֹת
verses.translit: mh'vf lmynhv vmn hbhmh lmynh mkhl rmsh h'dmh lmynhv shnym mkhl yb'v 'lykh lhchyvt
verses.translation: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה קַח לְ/ךָ֗ מִ/כָּל מַֽאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל וְ/אָסַפְתָּ֖ אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ וְ/לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: v'th qch lkh mkhl m'khl 'shr y'khl v'spt 'lykh vhyh lkh vlhm l'khlh
verses.translation: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'sh nch khkhl 'shr tsvh 'tv 'lhym khn 'shh
verses.translation: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לְ/נֹ֔חַ בֹּֽא אַתָּ֥ה וְ/כָל בֵּיתְ/ךָ֖ אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֑ה כִּֽי אֹתְ/ךָ֥ רָאִ֛יתִי צַדִּ֥יק לְ/פָנַ֖/י בַּ/דּ֥וֹר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lnch b' 'th vkhl bytkh 'l htbh khy 'tkh r'yty tsdyq lpny bdvr hzh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

verses.original: מִ/כֹּ֣ל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֣ה הַ/טְּהוֹרָ֗ה תִּֽקַּח לְ/ךָ֛ שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וּ/מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א טְהֹרָ֥ה הִ֛וא שְׁנַ֖יִם אִ֥ישׁ וְ/אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mkhl hbhmh hthvrh tqch lkh shb'h shb'h 'ysh v'shtv vmn hbhmh 'shr l' thrh hv' shnym 'ysh v'shtv
verses.translation: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מֵ/ע֧וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּ/נְקֵבָ֑ה לְ/חַיּ֥וֹת זֶ֖רַע עַל פְּנֵ֥י כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: gm m'vf hshmym shb'h shb'h zkhr vnqbh lchyvt zr' 'l pny khl h'rts
verses.translation: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

verses.original: כִּי֩ לְ/יָמִ֨ים ע֜וֹד שִׁבְעָ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מַמְטִ֣יר עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וּ/מָחִ֗יתִי אֶֽת כָּל הַ/יְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy lymym 'vd shb'h 'nkhy mmtyr 'l h'rts 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh vmchyty 't khl hyqvm 'shr 'shyty m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖/הוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh nch khkhl 'shr tsvhv yhvh
verses.translation: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֕חַ בֶּן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וְ/הַ/מַּבּ֣וּל הָיָ֔ה מַ֖יִם עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vnch bn shsh m'vt shnh vhmbvl hyh mym 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣בֹא נֹ֗חַ וּ֠/בָנָי/ו וְ/אִשְׁתּ֧/וֹ וּ/נְשֵֽׁי בָנָ֛י/ו אִתּ֖/וֹ אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֑ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י מֵ֥י הַ/מַּבּֽוּל
verses.translit: vyb' nch vbnyv v'shtv vnshy bnyv 'tv 'l htbh mpny my hmbvl
verses.translation: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

verses.original: מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ הַ/טְּהוֹרָ֔ה וּ/מִן הַ֨/בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵינֶ֖נָּ/ה טְהֹרָ֑ה וּ/מִ֨ן הָ/ע֔וֹף וְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר רֹמֵ֖שׂ עַל הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: mn hbhmh hthvrh vmn hbhmh 'shr 'ynnh thrh vmn h'vf vkhl 'shr rmsh 'l h'dmh
verses.translation: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

verses.original: שְׁנַ֨יִם שְׁנַ֜יִם בָּ֧אוּ אֶל נֹ֛חַ אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּ/נְקֵבָ֑ה כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת נֹֽחַ
verses.translit: shnym shnym b'v 'l nch 'l htbh zkhr vnqbh kh'shr tsvh 'lhym 't nch
verses.translation: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֖י לְ/שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וּ/מֵ֣י הַ/מַּבּ֔וּל הָי֖וּ עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy lshb't hymym vmy hmbvl hyv 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שֵׁשׁ מֵא֤וֹת שָׁנָה֙ לְ/חַיֵּי נֹ֔חַ בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י בְּ/שִׁבְעָֽה עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה נִבְקְעוּ֙ כָּֽל מַעְיְנֹת֙ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וַ/אֲרֻבֹּ֥ת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם נִפְתָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: bshnt shsh m'vt shnh lchyy nch bchdsh hshny bshb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh byvm hzh nbq'v khl m'ynt thvm rbh v'rbt hshmym nptchv
verses.translation: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֥י הַ/גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyhy hgshm 'l h'rts 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh
verses.translation: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.original: בְּ/עֶ֨צֶם הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ בָּ֣א נֹ֔חַ וְ/שֵׁם וְ/חָ֥ם וָ/יֶ֖פֶת בְּנֵי נֹ֑חַ וְ/אֵ֣שֶׁת נֹ֗חַ וּ/שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת נְשֵֽׁי בָנָ֛י/ו אִתָּ֖/ם אֶל הַ/תֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: b'tsm hyvm hzh b' nch vshm vchm vypt bny nch v'sht nch vshlsht nshy bnyv 'tm 'l htbh
verses.translation: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

verses.original: הֵ֜מָּה וְ/כָל הַֽ/חַיָּ֣ה לְ/מִינָ֗/הּ וְ/כָל הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/מִינָ֔/הּ וְ/כָל הָ/רֶ֛מֶשׂ הָ/רֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ וְ/כָל הָ/ע֣וֹף לְ/מִינֵ֔/הוּ כֹּ֖ל צִפּ֥וֹר כָּל כָּנָֽף
verses.translit: hmh vkhl hchyh lmynh vkhl hbhmh lmynh vkhl hrmsh hrmsh 'l h'rts lmynhv vkhl h'vf lmynhv khl tspvr khl khnf
verses.translation: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל נֹ֖חַ אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֑ה שְׁנַ֤יִם שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ מִ/כָּל הַ/בָּשָׂ֔ר אֲשֶׁר בּ֖/וֹ ר֥וּחַ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l nch 'l htbh shnym shnym mkhl hbshr 'shr bv rvch chyym
verses.translation: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בָּאִ֗ים זָכָ֨ר וּ/נְקֵבָ֤ה מִ/כָּל בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֔אוּ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יִּסְגֹּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּֽעֲדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhb'ym zkhr vnqbh mkhl bshr b'v kh'shr tsvh 'tv 'lhym vysgr yhvh b'dv
verses.translation: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֧י הַ/מַּבּ֛וּל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים י֖וֹם עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּרְבּ֣וּ הַ/מַּ֗יִם וַ/יִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה וַ/תָּ֖רָם מֵ/עַ֥ל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy hmbvl 'rb'ym yvm 'l h'rts vyrbv hmym vysh'v 't htbh vtrm m'l h'rts
verses.translation: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַ/מַּ֛יִם וַ/יִּרְבּ֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/תֵּ֥לֶךְ הַ/תֵּבָ֖ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vygbrv hmym vyrbv m'd 'l h'rts vtlkh htbh 'l pny hmym
verses.translation: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּ֗יִם גָּֽבְר֛וּ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹ֖ד עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יְכֻסּ֗וּ כָּל הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ הַ/גְּבֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhmym gbrv m'd m'd 'l h'rts vykhsv khl hhrym hgbhym 'shr tcht khl hshmym
verses.translation: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.

verses.original: חֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ מִ/לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה גָּבְר֖וּ הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יְכֻסּ֖וּ הֶ/הָרִֽים
verses.translit: chmsh 'shrh 'mh mlm'lh gbrv hmym vykhsv hhrym
verses.translation: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְוַ֞ע כָּל בָּשָׂ֣ר הָ/רֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ בָּ/ע֤וֹף וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ וּ/בַ֣/חַיָּ֔ה וּ/בְ/כָל הַ/שֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַ/שֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כֹ֖ל הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vygv' khl bshr hrmsh 'l h'rts b'vf vbbhmh vbchyh vbkhl hshrts hshrts 'l h'rts vkhl h'dm
verses.translation: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

verses.original: כֹּ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁמַת ר֨וּחַ חַיִּ֜ים בְּ/אַפָּ֗י/ו מִ/כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֶּ/חָֽרָבָ֖ה מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: khl 'shr nshmt rvch chyym b'pyv mkhl 'shr bchrbh mtv
verses.translation: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land , died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֜מַח אֶֽת כָּל הַ/יְק֣וּם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֗ה מֵ/אָדָ֤ם עַד בְּהֵמָה֙ עַד רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ וְ/עַד ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יִּמָּח֖וּ מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִשָּׁ֧אֶר אַךְ נֹ֛חַ וַֽ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/תֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: vymch 't khl hyqvm 'shr 'l pny h'dmh m'dm 'd bhmh 'd rmsh v'd 'vf hshmym vymchv mn h'rts vysh'r 'kh nch v'shr 'tv btbh
verses.translation: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive , and they that were with him in the ark.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַ/מַּ֖יִם עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vygbrv hmym 'l h'rts chmshym vm't yvm
verses.translation: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת נֹ֔חַ וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל הַֽ/חַיָּה֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/תֵּבָ֑ה וַ/יַּעֲבֵ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים ר֨וּחַ֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יָּשֹׁ֖כּוּ הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyzkhr 'lhym 't nch v't khl hchyh v't khl hbhmh 'shr 'tv btbh vy'br 'lhym rvch 'l h'rts vyshkhv hmym
verses.translation: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

verses.original: וַ/יִּסָּֽכְרוּ֙ מַעְיְנֹ֣ת תְּה֔וֹם וַֽ/אֲרֻבֹּ֖ת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/יִּכָּלֵ֥א הַ/גֶּ֖שֶׁם מִן הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyskhrv m'ynt thvm v'rbt hshmym vykhl' hgshm mn hshmym
verses.translation: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֧בוּ הַ/מַּ֛יִם מֵ/עַ֥ל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הָל֣וֹךְ וָ/שׁ֑וֹב וַ/יַּחְסְר֣וּ הַ/מַּ֔יִם מִ/קְצֵ֕ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshbv hmym m'l h'rts hlvkh vshvb vychsrv hmym mqtsh chmshym vm't yvm
verses.translation: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֤נַח הַ/תֵּבָה֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י בְּ/שִׁבְעָה עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י אֲרָרָֽט
verses.translit: vtnch htbh bchdsh hshby'y bshb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh 'l hry 'rrt
verses.translation: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּ֗יִם הָיוּ֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְ/חָס֔וֹר עַ֖ד הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/עֲשִׂירִ֑י בָּֽ/עֲשִׂירִי֙ בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ נִרְא֖וּ רָאשֵׁ֥י הֶֽ/הָרִֽים
verses.translit: vhmym hyv hlvkh vchsvr 'd hchdsh h'shyry b'shyry b'chd lchdsh nr'v r'shy hhrym
verses.translation: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month , on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֑וֹם וַ/יִּפְתַּ֣ח נֹ֔חַ אֶת חַלּ֥וֹן הַ/תֵּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'rb'ym yvm vyptch nch 't chlvn htbh 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת הָֽ/עֹרֵ֑ב וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א יָצוֹא֙ וָ/שׁ֔וֹב עַד יְבֹ֥שֶׁת הַ/מַּ֖יִם מֵ/עַ֥ל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyshlch 't h'rb vyts' ytsv' vshvb 'd ybsht hmym m'l h'rts
verses.translation: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הַ/יּוֹנָ֖ה מֵ/אִתּ֑/וֹ לִ/רְאוֹת֙ הֲ/קַ֣לּוּ הַ/מַּ֔יִם מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch 't hyvnh m'tv lr'vt hqlv hmym m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא מָצְאָה֩ הַ/יּוֹנָ֨ה מָנ֜וֹחַ לְ/כַף רַגְלָ֗/הּ וַ/תָּ֤שָׁב אֵלָי/ו֙ אֶל הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה כִּי מַ֖יִם עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָד/וֹ֙ וַ/יִּקָּחֶ֔/הָ וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛/הּ אֵלָ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/תֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: vl' mts'h hyvnh mnvch lkhf rglh vtshb 'lyv 'l htbh khy mym 'l pny khl h'rts vyshlch ydv vyqchh vyb' 'th 'lyv 'l htbh
verses.translation: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֛סֶף שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הַ/יּוֹנָ֖ה מִן הַ/תֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: vychl 'vd shb't ymym 'chrym vysf shlch 't hyvnh mn htbh
verses.translation: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֨א אֵלָ֤י/ו הַ/יּוֹנָה֙ לְ/עֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה עֲלֵה זַ֖יִת טָרָ֣ף בְּ/פִ֑י/הָ וַ/יֵּ֣דַע נֹ֔חַ כִּי קַ֥לּוּ הַ/מַּ֖יִם מֵ/עַ֥ל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vtb' 'lyv hyvnh l't 'rb vhnh 'lh zyt trf bpyh vyd' nch khy qlv hmym m'l h'rts
verses.translation: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַ/יְשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת הַ/יּוֹנָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא יָסְפָ֥ה שׁוּב אֵלָ֖י/ו עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyychl 'vd shb't ymym 'chrym vyshlch 't hyvnh vl' ysph shvb 'lyv 'vd
verses.translation: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/יְהִי בְּ/אַחַ֨ת וְ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֜וֹת שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ חָֽרְב֥וּ הַ/מַּ֖יִם מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּ֤סַר נֹ֨חַ֙ אֶת מִכְסֵ֣ה הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֕רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה חָֽרְב֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הָֽ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy b'cht vshsh m'vt shnh br'shvn b'chd lchdsh chrbv hmym m'l h'rts vysr nch 't mkhsh htbh vyr' vhnh chrbv pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month , the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י בְּ/שִׁבְעָ֧ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים י֖וֹם לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ יָבְשָׁ֖ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vbchdsh hshny bshb'h v'shrym yvm lchdsh ybshh h'rts
verses.translation: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל נֹ֥חַ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhym 'l nch l'mr
verses.translation: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

verses.original: צֵ֖א מִן הַ/תֵּבָ֑ה אַתָּ֕ה וְ/אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֛ וּ/בָנֶ֥י/ךָ וּ/נְשֵֽׁי בָנֶ֖י/ךָ אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ts' mn htbh 'th v'shtkh vbnykh vnshy bnykh 'tkh
verses.translation: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/חַיָּ֨ה אֲשֶֽׁר אִתְּ/ךָ֜ מִ/כָּל בָּשָׂ֗ר בָּ/ע֧וֹף וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֛ה וּ/בְ/כָל הָ/רֶ֛מֶשׂ הָ/רֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הוצא הַיְצֵ֣א אִתָּ֑/ךְ וְ/שָֽׁרְצ֣וּ בָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/פָר֥וּ וְ/רָב֖וּ עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khl hchyh 'shr 'tkh mkhl bshr b'vf vbbhmh vbkhl hrmsh hrmsh 'l h'rts hvts' hyts' 'tkh vshrtsv b'rts vprv vrbv 'l h'rts
verses.translation: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖צֵא נֹ֑חַ וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו וְ/אִשְׁתּ֥/וֹ וּ/נְשֵֽׁי בָנָ֖י/ו אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyts' nch vbnyv v'shtv vnshy bnyv 'tv
verses.translation: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:

verses.original: כָּל הַֽ/חַיָּ֗ה כָּל הָ/רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ וְ/כָל הָ/ע֔וֹף כֹּ֖ל רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם יָצְא֖וּ מִן הַ/תֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: khl hchyh khl hrmsh vkhl h'vf khl rvmsh 'l h'rts lmshpchtyhm yts'v mn htbh
verses.translation: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥בֶן נֹ֛חַ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח מִ/כֹּ֣ל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֣ה הַ/טְּהוֹרָ֗ה וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ הָ/ע֣וֹף הַ/טָּהֹ֔ר וַ/יַּ֥עַל עֹלֹ֖ת בַּ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vybn nch mzbch lyhvh vyqch mkhl hbhmh hthvrh vmkhl h'vf hthr vy'l 'lt bmzbch
verses.translation: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD ; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣רַח יְהוָה֮ אֶת רֵ֣יחַ הַ/נִּיחֹחַ֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל לִבּ֗/וֹ לֹֽא אֹ֠סִף לְ/קַלֵּ֨ל ע֤וֹד אֶת הָֽ/אֲדָמָה֙ בַּ/עֲב֣וּר הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם כִּ֠י יֵ֣צֶר לֵ֧ב הָ/אָדָ֛ם רַ֖ע מִ/נְּעֻרָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹֽא אֹסִ֥ף ע֛וֹד לְ/הַכּ֥וֹת אֶת כָּל חַ֖י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: vyrch yhvh 't rych hnychch vy'mr yhvh 'l lbv l' 'sf lqll 'vd 't h'dmh b'bvr h'dm khy ytsr lb h'dm r' mn'ryv vl' 'sf 'vd lhkhvt 't khl chy kh'shr 'shyty
verses.translation: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

verses.original: עֹ֖ד כָּל יְמֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ זֶ֡רַע וְ֠/קָצִיר וְ/קֹ֨ר וָ/חֹ֜ם וְ/קַ֧יִץ וָ/חֹ֛רֶף וְ/י֥וֹם וָ/לַ֖יְלָה לֹ֥א יִשְׁבֹּֽתוּ
verses.translit: 'd khl ymy h'rts zr' vqtsyr vqr vchm vqyts vchrf vyvm vlylh l' yshbtv
verses.translation: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת נֹ֖חַ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר לָ/הֶ֛ם פְּר֥וּ וּ/רְב֖וּ וּ/מִלְא֥וּ אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vybrkh 'lhym 't nch v't bnyv vy'mr lhm prv vrbv vml'v 't h'rts
verses.translation: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹרַאֲ/כֶ֤ם וְ/חִתְּ/כֶם֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַ֚ל כָּל חַיַּ֣ת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּרְמֹ֧שׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֛ה וּֽ/בְ/כָל דְּגֵ֥י הַ/יָּ֖ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֥ם נִתָּֽנוּ
verses.translit: vmvr'khm vchtkhm yhyh 'l khl chyt h'rts v'l khl 'vf hshmym bkhl 'shr trmsh h'dmh vbkhl dgy hym bydkhm ntnv
verses.translation: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

verses.original: כָּל רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּא חַ֔י לָ/כֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה לְ/אָכְלָ֑ה כְּ/יֶ֣רֶק עֵ֔שֶׂב נָתַ֥תִּי לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת כֹּֽל
verses.translit: khl rmsh 'shr hv' chy lkhm yhyh l'khlh khyrq 'shb ntty lkhm 't khl
verses.translation: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

verses.original: אַךְ בָּשָׂ֕ר בְּ/נַפְשׁ֥/וֹ דָמ֖/וֹ לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'kh bshr bnpshv dmv l' t'khlv
verses.translation: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

verses.original: וְ/אַ֨ךְ אֶת דִּמְ/כֶ֤ם לְ/נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי/כֶם֙ אֶדְרֹ֔שׁ מִ/יַּ֥ד כָּל חַיָּ֖ה אֶדְרְשֶׁ֑/נּוּ וּ/מִ/יַּ֣ד הָֽ/אָדָ֗ם מִ/יַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔י/ו אֶדְרֹ֖שׁ אֶת נֶ֥פֶשׁ הָֽ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: v'kh 't dmkhm lnpshtykhm 'drsh myd khl chyh 'drshnv vmyd h'dm myd 'ysh 'chyv 'drsh 't npsh h'dm
verses.translation: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.

verses.original: שֹׁפֵךְ֙ דַּ֣ם הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם בָּֽ/אָדָ֖ם דָּמ֣/וֹ יִשָּׁפֵ֑ךְ כִּ֚י בְּ/צֶ֣לֶם אֱלֹהִ֔ים עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: shpkh dm h'dm b'dm dmv yshpkh khy btslm 'lhym 'shh 't h'dm
verses.translation: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם פְּר֣וּ וּ/רְב֑וּ שִׁרְצ֥וּ בָ/אָ֖רֶץ וּ/רְבוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'tm prv vrbv shrtsv b'rts vrbv bh
verses.translation: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל נֹ֔חַ וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֥י/ו אִתּ֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l nch v'l bnyv 'tv l'mr
verses.translation: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֕י הִנְנִ֥/י מֵקִ֛ים אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/כֶ֖ם אַֽחֲרֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'ny hnny mqym 't bryty 'tkhm v't zr'khm 'chrykhm
