verses.translation: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל נֶ֤פֶשׁ הַֽ/חַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם בָּ/ע֧וֹף בַּ/בְּהֵמָ֛ה וּֽ/בְ/כָל חַיַּ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם מִ/כֹּל֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v't khl npsh hchyh 'shr 'tkhm b'vf bbhmh vbkhl chyt h'rts 'tkhm mkhl yts'y htbh lkhl chyt h'rts
verses.translation: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת בְּרִיתִ/י֙ אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֧ת כָּל בָּשָׂ֛ר ע֖וֹד מִ/מֵּ֣י הַ/מַּבּ֑וּל וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד מַבּ֖וּל לְ/שַׁחֵ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhqmty 't bryty 'tkhm vl' ykhrt khl bshr 'vd mmy hmbvl vl' yhyh 'vd mbvl lshcht h'rts
verses.translation: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים זֹ֤את אֽוֹת הַ/בְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֗ן בֵּינִ/י֙ וּ/בֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֵ֛ין כָּל נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם לְ/דֹרֹ֖ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym z't 'vt hbryt 'shr 'ny ntn byny vbynykhm vbyn khl npsh chyh 'shr 'tkhm ldrt 'vlm
verses.translation: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

verses.original: אֶת קַשְׁתִּ֕/י נָתַ֖תִּי בֶּֽ/עָנָ֑ן וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ לְ/א֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 't qshty ntty b'nn vhyth l'vt bryt byny vbyn h'rts
verses.translation: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֕ה בְּ/עַֽנְנִ֥/י עָנָ֖ן עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/נִרְאֲתָ֥ה הַ/קֶּ֖שֶׁת בֶּ/עָנָֽן
verses.translit: vhyh b'nny 'nn 'l h'rts vnr'th hqsht b'nn
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתִּ֣י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֵּינִ/י֙ וּ/בֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֵ֛ין כָּל נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה בְּ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר וְ/לֹֽא יִֽהְיֶ֨ה ע֤וֹד הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ לְ/מַבּ֔וּל לְ/שַׁחֵ֖ת כָּל בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vzkhrty 't bryty 'shr byny vbynykhm vbyn khl npsh chyh bkhl bshr vl' yhyh 'vd hmym lmbvl lshcht khl bshr
verses.translation: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה הַ/קֶּ֖שֶׁת בֶּֽ/עָנָ֑ן וּ/רְאִיתִ֗י/הָ לִ/זְכֹּר֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם בֵּ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/בֵין֙ כָּל נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה בְּ/כָל בָּשָׂ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyth hqsht b'nn vr'ytyh lzkhr bryt 'vlm byn 'lhym vbyn khl npsh chyh bkhl bshr 'shr 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל נֹ֑חַ זֹ֤את אֽוֹת הַ/בְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲקִמֹ֔תִי בֵּינִ֕/י וּ/בֵ֥ין כָּל בָּשָׂ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l nch z't 'vt hbryt 'shr hqmty byny vbyn khl bshr 'shr 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֣וּ בְנֵי נֹ֗חַ הַ/יֹּֽצְאִים֙ מִן הַ/תֵּבָ֔ה שֵׁ֖ם וְ/חָ֣ם וָ/יָ֑פֶת וְ/חָ֕ם ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י כְנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vyhyv bny nch hyts'ym mn htbh shm vchm vypt vchm hv' 'by khn'n
verses.translation: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי נֹ֑חַ וּ/מֵ/אֵ֖לֶּה נָֽפְצָ֥ה כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: shlshh 'lh bny nch vm'lh nptsh khl h'rts
verses.translation: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥חֶל נֹ֖חַ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וַ/יִּטַּ֖ע כָּֽרֶם
verses.translit: vychl nch 'ysh h'dmh vyt' khrm
verses.translation: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

verses.translit: vysht mn hyyn vyshkhr vytgl btvkh 'hlh
verses.translation: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗רְא חָ֚ם אֲבִ֣י כְנַ֔עַן אֵ֖ת עֶרְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יַּגֵּ֥ד לִ/שְׁנֵֽי אֶחָ֖י/ו בַּ/חֽוּץ
verses.translit: vyr' chm 'by khn'n 't 'rvt 'byv vygd lshny 'chyv bchvts
verses.translation: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ שֵׁ֨ם וָ/יֶ֜פֶת אֶת הַ/שִּׂמְלָ֗ה וַ/יָּשִׂ֨ימוּ֙ עַל שְׁכֶ֣ם שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֲחֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית וַ/יְכַסּ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עֶרְוַ֣ת אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם וּ/פְנֵי/הֶם֙ אֲחֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית וְ/עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ
verses.translit: vyqch shm vypt 't hshmlh vyshymv 'l shkhm shnyhm vylkhv 'chrnyt vykhsv 't 'rvt 'byhm vpnyhm 'chrnyt v'rvt 'byhm l' r'v
verses.translation: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥יקֶץ נֹ֖חַ מִ/יֵּינ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֕דַע אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָ֥שָׂה ל֖/וֹ בְּנ֥/וֹ הַ/קָּטָֽן
verses.translit: vyyqts nch myynv vyd' 't 'shr 'shh lv bnv hqtn
verses.translation: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אָר֣וּר כְּנָ֑עַן עֶ֥בֶד עֲבָדִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְ/אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rvr khn'n 'bd 'bdym yhyh l'chyv
verses.translation: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹ֣הֵי שֵׁ֑ם וִ/יהִ֥י כְנַ֖עַן עֶ֥בֶד לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy shm vyhy khn'n 'bd lmv
verses.translation: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

verses.original: יַ֤פְתְּ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/יֶ֔פֶת וְ/יִשְׁכֹּ֖ן בְּ/אָֽהֳלֵי שֵׁ֑ם וִ/יהִ֥י כְנַ֖עַן עֶ֥בֶד לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: ypt 'lhym lypt vyshkhn b'hly shm vyhy khn'n 'bd lmv
verses.translation: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי נֹ֖חַ אַחַ֣ר הַ/מַּבּ֑וּל שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַֽ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vychy nch 'chr hmbvl shlsh m'vt shnh vchmshym shnh
verses.translation: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל יְמֵי נֹ֔חַ תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv khl ymy nch tsh' m'vt shnh vchmshym shnh vymt
verses.translation: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת בְּנֵי נֹ֔חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֣ם וָ/יָ֑פֶת וַ/יִּוָּלְד֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם בָּנִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַ/מַּבּֽוּל
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt bny nch shm chm vypt vyvldv lhm bnym 'chr hmbvl
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּ/מָג֔וֹג וּ/מָדַ֖י וְ/יָוָ֣ן וְ/תֻבָ֑ל וּ/מֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְ/תִירָֽס
verses.translit: bny ypt gmr vmgvg vmdy vyvn vtbl vmshkh vtyrs
verses.translation: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְ/רִיפַ֖ת וְ/תֹגַרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vbny gmr 'shkhnz vrypt vtgrmh
verses.translation: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְ/תַרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּתִּ֖ים וְ/דֹדָנִֽים
verses.translit: vbny yvn 'lyshh vtrshysh khtym vddnym
verses.translation: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.original: מֵ֠/אֵלֶּה נִפְרְד֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ בְּ/אַרְצֹתָ֔/ם אִ֖ישׁ לִ/לְשֹׁנ֑/וֹ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/גוֹיֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: m'lh nprdv 'yy hgvym b'rtstm 'ysh llshnv lmshpchtm bgvyhm
verses.translation: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/פ֥וּט וּ/כְנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vbny chm khvsh vmtsrym vpvt vkhn'n
verses.translation: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַֽ/חֲוִילָ֔ה וְ/סַבְתָּ֥ה וְ/רַעְמָ֖ה וְ/סַבְתְּכָ֑א וּ/בְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖ה שְׁבָ֥א וּ/דְדָֽן
verses.translit: vbny khvsh sb' vchvylh vsbth vr'mh vsbtkh' vbny r'mh shb' vddn
verses.translation: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.original: וְ/כ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת נִמְרֹ֑ד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִֽ/הְי֥וֹת גִּבֹּ֖ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkhvsh yld 't nmrd hv' hchl lhyvt gbr b'rts
verses.translation: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

verses.original: הֽוּא הָיָ֥ה גִבֹּֽר צַ֖יִד לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל כֵּן֙ יֵֽאָמַ֔ר כְּ/נִמְרֹ֛ד גִּבּ֥וֹר צַ֖יִד לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hv' hyh gbr tsyd lpny yhvh 'l khn y'mr khnmrd gbvr tsyd lpny yhvh
verses.translation: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD : wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֨י רֵאשִׁ֤ית מַמְלַכְתּ/וֹ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אֶ֖רֶךְ וְ/אַכַּ֣ד וְ/כַלְנֵ֑ה בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר
verses.translit: vthy r'shyt mmlkhtv bbl v'rkh v'khd vkhlnh b'rts shn'r
verses.translation: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.original: מִן הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/הִ֖וא יָצָ֣א אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת נִ֣ינְוֵ֔ה וְ/אֶת רְחֹבֹ֥ת עִ֖יר וְ/אֶת כָּֽלַח
verses.translit: mn h'rts hhv' yts' 'shvr vybn 't nynvh v't rchbt 'yr v't khlch
verses.translation: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת רֶ֔סֶן בֵּ֥ין נִֽינְוֵ֖ה וּ/בֵ֣ין כָּ֑לַח הִ֖וא הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/גְּדֹלָֽה
verses.translit: v't rsn byn nynvh vbyn khlch hv' h'yr hgdlh
verses.translation: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

verses.original: וּ/מִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת לוּדִ֧ים וְ/אֶת עֲנָמִ֛ים וְ/אֶת לְהָבִ֖ים וְ/אֶת נַפְתֻּחִֽים
verses.translit: vmtsrym yld 't lvdym v't 'nmym v't lhbym v't nptchym
verses.translation: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְ/אֶת כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִ/שָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת כַּפְתֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: v't ptrsym v't khslchym 'shr yts'v mshm plshtym v't khptrym
verses.translation: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

verses.original: וּ/כְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת צִידֹ֥ן בְּכֹר֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת חֵֽת
verses.translit: vkhn'n yld 't tsydn bkhrv v't cht
verses.translation: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/יְבוּסִי֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י וְ/אֵ֖ת הַ/גִּרְגָּשִֽׁי
verses.translit: v't hybvsy v't h'mry v't hgrgshy
verses.translation: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַֽ/חִוִּ֥י וְ/אֶת הַֽ/עַרְקִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/סִּינִֽי
verses.translit: v't hchvy v't h'rqy v't hsyny
verses.translation: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אַרְוָדִ֥י וְ/אֶת הַ/צְּמָרִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַֽ/חֲמָתִ֑י וְ/אַחַ֣ר נָפֹ֔צוּ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִֽי
verses.translit: v't h'rvdy v't htsmry v't hchmty v'chr nptsv mshpchvt hkhn'ny
verses.translation: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִ/צִּידֹ֔ן בֹּאֲ/כָ֥ה גְרָ֖רָ/ה עַד עַזָּ֑ה בֹּאֲ/כָ֞ה סְדֹ֧מָ/ה וַ/עֲמֹרָ֛ה וְ/אַדְמָ֥ה וּ/צְבֹיִ֖ם עַד לָֽשַׁע
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl hkhn'ny mtsydn b'khh grrh 'd 'zh b'khh sdmh v'mrh v'dmh vtsbym 'd lsh'
verses.translation: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי חָ֔ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לִ/לְשֹֽׁנֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/אַרְצֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/גוֹיֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'lh bny chm lmshpchtm llshntm b'rtstm bgvyhm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֥ם יֻלַּ֖ד גַּם ה֑וּא אֲבִי֙ כָּל בְּנֵי עֵ֔בֶר אֲחִ֖י יֶ֥פֶת הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vlshm yld gm hv' 'by khl bny 'br 'chy ypt hgdvl
verses.translation: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י שֵׁ֖ם עֵילָ֣ם וְ/אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְ/ל֥וּד וַֽ/אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: bny shm 'ylm v'shvr v'rpkhshd vlvd v'rm
verses.translation: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י אֲרָ֑ם ע֥וּץ וְ/ח֖וּל וְ/גֶ֥תֶר וָ/מַֽשׁ
verses.translit: vbny 'rm 'vts vchvl vgtr vmsh
verses.translation: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת שָׁ֑לַח וְ/שֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת עֵֽבֶר
verses.translit: v'rpkhshd yld 't shlch vshlch yld 't 'br
verses.translation: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/עֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָֽ/אֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְ/יָמָי/ו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖י/ו יָקְטָֽן
verses.translit: vl'br yld shny bnym shm h'chd plg khy bymyv nplgh h'rts vshm 'chyv yqtn
verses.translation: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

verses.original: וְ/יָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְ/אֶת שָׁ֑לֶף וְ/אֶת חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְ/אֶת יָֽרַח
verses.translit: vyqtn yld 't 'lmvdd v't shlf v't chtsrmvt v't yrch
verses.translation: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְ/אֶת אוּזָ֖ל וְ/אֶת דִּקְלָֽה
verses.translit: v't hdvrm v't 'vzl v't dqlh
verses.translation: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עוֹבָ֥ל וְ/אֶת אֲבִֽימָאֵ֖ל וְ/אֶת שְׁבָֽא
verses.translit: v't 'vbl v't 'bym'l v't shb'
verses.translation: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אוֹפִ֥ר וְ/אֶת חֲוִילָ֖ה וְ/אֶת יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן
verses.translit: v't 'vpr v't chvylh v't yvbb khl 'lh bny yqtn
verses.translation: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֥י מוֹשָׁבָ֖/ם מִ/מֵּשָׁ֑א בֹּאֲ/כָ֥ה סְפָ֖רָ/ה הַ֥ר הַ/קֶּֽדֶם
verses.translit: vyhy mvshbm mmsh' b'khh sprh hr hqdm
verses.translation: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי שֵׁ֔ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לִ/לְשֹׁנֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/אַרְצֹתָ֖/ם לְ/גוֹיֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'lh bny shm lmshpchtm llshntm b'rtstm lgvyhm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֧ת בְּנֵי נֹ֛חַ לְ/תוֹלְדֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/גוֹיֵ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מֵ/אֵ֜לֶּה נִפְרְד֧וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ אַחַ֥ר הַ/מַּבּֽוּל
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bny nch ltvldtm bgvyhm vm'lh nprdv hgvym b'rts 'chr hmbvl
verses.translation: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֥י כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ שָׂפָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּ/דְבָרִ֖ים אֲחָדִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khl h'rts shph 'cht vdbrym 'chdym
verses.translation: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֖י בְּ/נָסְעָ֣/ם מִ/קֶּ֑דֶם וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֥וּ בִקְעָ֛ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֖ר וַ/יֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyhy bns'm mqdm vymts'v bq'h b'rts shn'r vyshbv shm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֗/הוּ הָ֚בָ/ה נִלְבְּנָ֣ה לְבֵנִ֔ים וְ/נִשְׂרְפָ֖ה לִ/שְׂרֵפָ֑ה וַ/תְּהִ֨י לָ/הֶ֤ם הַ/לְּבֵנָה֙ לְ/אָ֔בֶן וְ/הַ֣/חֵמָ֔ר הָיָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם לַ/חֹֽמֶר
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv hbh nlbnh lbnym vnshrph lshrph vthy lhm hlbnh l'bn vhchmr hyh lhm lchmr
verses.translation: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ הָ֣בָ/ה נִבְנֶה לָּ֣/נוּ עִ֗יר וּ/מִגְדָּל֙ וְ/רֹאשׁ֣/וֹ בַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/נַֽעֲשֶׂה לָּ֖/נוּ שֵׁ֑ם פֶּן נָפ֖וּץ עַל פְּנֵ֥י כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mrv hbh nbnh lnv 'yr vmgdl vr'shv bshmym vn'shh lnv shm pn npvts 'l pny khl h'rts
verses.translation: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣רֶד יְהוָ֔ה לִ/רְאֹ֥ת אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּגְדָּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh lr't 't h'yr v't hmgdl 'shr bnv bny h'dm
verses.translation: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה הֵ֣ן עַ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְ/שָׂפָ֤ה אַחַת֙ לְ/כֻלָּ֔/ם וְ/זֶ֖ה הַחִלָּ֣/ם לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת וְ/עַתָּה֙ לֹֽא יִבָּצֵ֣ר מֵ/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָזְמ֖וּ לַֽ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh hn 'm 'chd vshph 'cht lkhlm vzh hchlm l'shvt v'th l' ybtsr mhm khl 'shr yzmv l'shvt
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

verses.original: הָ֚בָ/ה נֵֽרְדָ֔ה וְ/נָבְלָ֥ה שָׁ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפַ֥ת רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: hbh nrdh vnblh shm shptm 'shr l' yshm'v 'ysh shpt r'hv
verses.translation: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨פֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֹתָ֛/ם מִ/שָּׁ֖ם עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַֽ/יַּחְדְּל֖וּ לִ/בְנֹ֥ת הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vypts yhvh 'tm mshm 'l pny khl h'rts vychdlv lbnt h'yr
verses.translation: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָ/הּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּי שָׁ֛ם בָּלַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה שְׂפַ֣ת כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/מִ/שָּׁם֙ הֱפִיצָ֣/ם יְהוָ֔ה עַל פְּנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'l khn qr' shmh bbl khy shm bll yhvh shpt khl h'rts vmshm hpytsm yhvh 'l pny khl h'rts
verses.translation: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת שֵׁ֔ם שֵׁ֚ם בֶּן מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֔ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֑ד שְׁנָתַ֖יִם אַחַ֥ר הַ/מַּבּֽוּל
verses.translit: 'lh tvldt shm shm bn m't shnh vyvld 't 'rpkhshd shntym 'chr hmbvl
verses.translation: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי שֵׁ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֔ד חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy shm 'chry hvlydv 't 'rpkhshd chmsh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֣ד חַ֔י חָמֵ֥שׁ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת שָֽׁלַח
verses.translit: v'rpkhshd chy chmsh vshlshym shnh vyvld 't shlch
verses.translation: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִ֣י אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֗ד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת שֶׁ֔לַח שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy 'rpkhshd 'chry hvlydv 't shlch shlsh shnym v'rb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וְ/שֶׁ֥לַח חַ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת עֵֽבֶר
verses.translit: vshlch chy shlshym shnh vyvld 't 'br
verses.translation: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי שֶׁ֗לַח אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת עֵ֔בֶר שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy shlch 'chry hvlydv 't 'br shlsh shnym v'rb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי עֵ֕בֶר אַרְבַּ֥ע וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת פָּֽלֶג
verses.translit: vychy 'br 'rb' vshlshym shnh vyvld 't plg
verses.translation: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי עֵ֗בֶר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת פֶּ֔לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy 'br 'chry hvlydv 't plg shlshym shnh v'rb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי פֶ֖לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת רְעֽוּ
verses.translit: vychy plg shlshym shnh vyvld 't r'v
verses.translation: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי פֶ֗לֶג אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת רְע֔וּ תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִ֖ים וּ/מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy plg 'chry hvlydv 't r'v tsh' shnym vm'tym shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י רְע֔וּ שְׁתַּ֥יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת שְׂרֽוּג
verses.translit: vychy r'v shtym vshlshym shnh vyvld 't shrvg
verses.translation: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י רְע֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת שְׂר֔וּג שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וּ/מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy r'v 'chry hvlydv 't shrvg shb' shnym vm'tym shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֥י שְׂר֖וּג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת נָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: vychy shrvg shlshym shnh vyvld 't nchvr
verses.translation: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י שְׂר֗וּג אַחֲרֵ֛י הוֹלִיד֥/וֹ אֶת נָח֖וֹר מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy shrvg 'chry hvlydv 't nchvr m'tym shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י נָח֔וֹר תֵּ֥שַׁע וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת תָּֽרַח
verses.translit: vychy nchvr tsh' v'shrym shnh vyvld 't trch
verses.translation: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֣י נָח֗וֹר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣/וֹ אֶת תֶּ֔רַח תְּשַֽׁע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy nchvr 'chry hvlydv 't trch tsh' 'shrh shnh vm't shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחִי תֶ֖רַח שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֨וֹלֶד֙ אֶת אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת נָח֖וֹר וְ/אֶת הָרָֽן
verses.translit: vychy trch shb'ym shnh vyvld 't 'brm 't nchvr v't hrn
verses.translation: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת תֶּ֔רַח תֶּ֚רַח הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת נָח֖וֹר וְ/אֶת הָרָ֑ן וְ/הָרָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת לֽוֹט
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt trch trch hvlyd 't 'brm 't nchvr v't hrn vhrn hvlyd 't lvt
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת הָרָ֔ן עַל פְּנֵ֖י תֶּ֣רַח אָבִ֑י/ו בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/א֥וּר כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: vymt hrn 'l pny trch 'byv b'rts mvldtv b'vr khshdym
verses.translation: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָ֧ם וְ/נָח֛וֹר לָ/הֶ֖ם נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת אַבְרָם֙ שָׂרָ֔י וְ/שֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת נָחוֹר֙ מִלְכָּ֔ה בַּת הָרָ֥ן אֲבִֽי מִלְכָּ֖ה וַֽ/אֲבִ֥י יִסְכָּֽה
verses.translit: vyqch 'brm vnchvr lhm nshym shm 'sht 'brm shry vshm 'sht nchvr mlkhh bt hrn 'by mlkhh v'by yskhh
verses.translation: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֥י שָׂרַ֖י עֲקָרָ֑ה אֵ֥ין לָ֖/הּ וָלָֽד
verses.translit: vthy shry 'qrh 'yn lh vld
verses.translation: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח תֶּ֜רַח אֶת אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֗/וֹ וְ/אֶת ל֤וֹט בֶּן הָרָן֙ בֶּן בְּנ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵת֙ שָׂרַ֣י כַּלָּת֔/וֹ אֵ֖שֶׁת אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּצְא֨וּ אִתָּ֜/ם מֵ/א֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָ/ה כְּנַ֔עַן וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ עַד חָרָ֖ן וַ/יֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyqch trch 't 'brm bnv v't lvt bn hrn bn bnv v't shry khltv 'sht 'brm bnv vyts'v 'tm m'vr khshdym llkht 'rtsh khn'n vyb'v 'd chrn vyshbv shm
verses.translation: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵי תֶ֔רַח חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּ/מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֥מָת תֶּ֖רַח בְּ/חָרָֽן
verses.translit: vyhyv ymy trch chmsh shnym vm'tym shnh vymt trch bchrn
verses.translation: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל אַבְרָ֔ם לֶךְ לְ/ךָ֛ מֵ/אַרְצְ/ךָ֥ וּ/מִ/מּֽוֹלַדְתְּ/ךָ֖ וּ/מִ/בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ךָ אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַרְאֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l 'brm lkh lkh m'rtskh vmmvldtkh vmbyt 'bykh 'l h'rts 'shr 'r'kh
verses.translation: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽעֶשְׂ/ךָ֙ לְ/ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל וַ/אֲבָ֣רֶכְ/ךָ֔ וַ/אֲגַדְּלָ֖ה שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ וֶ/הְיֵ֖ה בְּרָכָֽה
verses.translit: v''shkh lgvy gdvl v'brkhkh v'gdlh shmkh vhyh brkhh
verses.translation: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

verses.original: וַ/אֲבָֽרֲכָה֙ מְבָ֣רְכֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/מְקַלֶּלְ/ךָ֖ אָאֹ֑ר וְ/נִבְרְכ֣וּ בְ/ךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'brkhh mbrkhykh vmqllkh ''r vnbrkhv bkh khl mshpcht h'dmh
verses.translation: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ אַבְרָ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אִתּ֖/וֹ ל֑וֹט וְ/אַבְרָ֗ם בֶּן חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ וְ/שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּ/צֵאת֖/וֹ מֵ/חָרָֽן
verses.translit: vylkh 'brm kh'shr dbr 'lyv yhvh vylkh 'tv lvt v'brm bn chmsh shnym vshb'ym shnh bts'tv mchrn
verses.translation: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אַבְרָם֩ אֶת שָׂרַ֨י אִשְׁתּ֜/וֹ וְ/אֶת ל֣וֹט בֶּן אָחִ֗י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל רְכוּשָׁ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָכָ֔שׁוּ וְ/אֶת הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֣וּ בְ/חָרָ֑ן וַ/יֵּצְא֗וּ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָ/ה כְּנַ֔עַן וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָ/ה כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vyqch 'brm 't shry 'shtv v't lvt bn 'chyv v't khl rkhvshm 'shr rkhshv v't hnpsh 'shr 'shv bchrn vyts'v llkht 'rtsh khn'n vyb'v 'rtsh khn'n
verses.translation: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר אַבְרָם֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ עַ֚ד מְק֣וֹם שְׁכֶ֔ם עַ֖ד אֵל֣וֹן מוֹרֶ֑ה וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י אָ֥ז בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'br 'brm b'rts 'd mqvm shkhm 'd 'lvn mvrh vhkhn'ny 'z b'rts
verses.translation: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶל אַבְרָ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לְ/זַ֨רְעֲ/ךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את וַ/יִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַ/יהוָ֖ה הַ/נִּרְאֶ֥ה אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh 'l 'brm vy'mr lzr'kh 'tn 't h'rts hz't vybn shm mzbch lyhvh hnr'h 'lyv
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD , who appeared unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעְתֵּ֨ק מִ/שָּׁ֜ם הָ/הָ֗רָ/ה מִ/קֶּ֛דֶם לְ/בֵֽית אֵ֖ל וַ/יֵּ֣ט אָהֳלֹ֑/ה בֵּֽית אֵ֤ל מִ/יָּם֙ וְ/הָ/עַ֣י מִ/קֶּ֔דֶם וַ/יִּֽבֶן שָׁ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'tq mshm hhrh mqdm lbyt 'l vyt 'hlh byt 'l mym vh'y mqdm vybn shm mzbch lyhvh vyqr' bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD , and called upon the name of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֣ע אַבְרָ֔ם הָל֥וֹךְ וְ/נָס֖וֹעַ הַ/נֶּֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: vys' 'brm hlvkh vnsv' hngbh
verses.translation: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד אַבְרָ֤ם מִצְרַ֨יְמָ/ה֙ לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם כִּֽי כָבֵ֥ד הָ/רָעָ֖ב בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy r'b b'rts vyrd 'brm mtsrymh lgvr shm khy khbd hr'b b'rts
verses.translation: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יב לָ/ב֣וֹא מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ הִנֵּה נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִשָּׁ֥ה יְפַת מַרְאֶ֖ה אָֽתְּ
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr hqryb lbv' mtsrymh vy'mr 'l shry 'shtv hnh n' yd'ty khy 'shh ypt mr'h 't
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יִרְא֤וּ אֹתָ/ךְ֙ הַ/מִּצְרִ֔ים וְ/אָמְר֖וּ אִשְׁתּ֣/וֹ זֹ֑את וְ/הָרְג֥וּ אֹתִ֖/י וְ/אֹתָ֥/ךְ יְחַיּֽוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khy yr'v 'tkh hmtsrym v'mrv 'shtv z't vhrgv 'ty v'tkh ychyv
verses.translation: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

verses.original: אִמְרִי נָ֖א אֲחֹ֣תִ/י אָ֑תְּ לְמַ֨עַן֙ יִֽיטַב לִ֣/י בַ/עֲבוּרֵ֔/ךְ וְ/חָיְתָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י בִּ/גְלָלֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'mry n' 'chty 't lm'n yytb ly b'bvrkh vchyth npshy bgllkh
verses.translation: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כְּ/ב֥וֹא אַבְרָ֖ם מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/ה וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ הַ/מִּצְרִים֙ אֶת הָ֣/אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי יָפָ֥ה הִ֖וא מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyhy khbv' 'brm mtsrymh vyr'v hmtsrym 't h'shh khy yph hv' m'd
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ אֹתָ/הּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יְהַֽלְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖/הּ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/תֻּקַּ֥ח הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyr'v 'th shry pr'h vyhllv 'th 'l pr'h vtqch h'shh byt pr'h
verses.translation: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אַבְרָ֥ם הֵיטִ֖יב בַּ/עֲבוּרָ֑/הּ וַֽ/יְהִי ל֤/וֹ צֹאן וּ/בָקָר֙ וַ/חֲמֹרִ֔ים וַ/עֲבָדִים֙ וּ/שְׁפָחֹ֔ת וַ/אֲתֹנֹ֖ת וּ/גְמַלִּֽים
verses.translit: vl'brm hytyb b'bvrh vyhy lv ts'n vbqr vchmrym v'bdym vshpcht v'tnt vgmlym
verses.translation: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַגַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה אֶת פַּרְעֹ֛ה נְגָעִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים וְ/אֶת בֵּית֑/וֹ עַל דְּבַ֥ר שָׂרַ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָֽם
verses.translit: vyng' yhvh 't pr'h ng'ym gdlym v't bytv 'l dbr shry 'sht 'brm
verses.translation: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א פַרְעֹה֙ לְ/אַבְרָ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מַה זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לִּ֑/י לָ֚/מָּה לֹא הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֔/י כִּ֥י אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֖ הִֽוא
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h l'brm vy'mr mh z't 'shyt ly lmh l' hgdt ly khy 'shtkh hv'
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

verses.original: לָ/מָ֤ה אָמַ֨רְתָּ֙ אֲחֹ֣תִ/י הִ֔וא וָ/אֶקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛/הּ לִ֖/י לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֖ קַ֥ח וָ/לֵֽךְ
verses.translit: lmh 'mrt 'chty hv' v'qch 'th ly l'shh v'th hnh 'shtkh qch vlkh
verses.translation: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her , and go thy way.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ו עָלָ֛י/ו פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּח֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytsv 'lyv pr'h 'nshym vyshlchv 'tv v't 'shtv v't khl 'shr lv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַל֩ אַבְרָ֨ם מִ/מִּצְרַ֜יִם ה֠וּא וְ/אִשְׁתּ֧/וֹ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר ל֛/וֹ וְ/ל֥וֹט עִמּ֖/וֹ הַ/נֶּֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: vy'l 'brm mmtsrym hv' v'shtv vkhl 'shr lv vlvt 'mv hngbh
verses.translation: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְרָ֖ם כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד בַּ/מִּקְנֶ֕ה בַּ/כֶּ֖סֶף וּ/בַ/זָּהָֽב
verses.translit: v'brm khbd m'd bmqnh bkhsf vbzhb
verses.translation: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/מַסָּעָ֔י/ו מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב וְ/עַד בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל עַד הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר הָ֨יָה שָׁ֤ם אהל/ה אָֽהֳל/וֹ֙ בַּ/תְּחִלָּ֔ה בֵּ֥ין בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vylkh lms'yv mngb v'd byt 'l 'd hmqvm 'shr hyh shm 'hlh 'hlv btchlh byn byt 'l vbyn h'y
verses.translation: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;

verses.original: אֶל מְקוֹם֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר עָ֥שָׂה שָׁ֖ם בָּ/רִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שָׁ֛ם אַבְרָ֖ם בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'l mqvm hmzbch 'shr 'shh shm br'shnh vyqr' shm 'brm bshm yhvh
verses.translation: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/גַם לְ/ל֔וֹט הַ/הֹלֵ֖ךְ אֶת אַבְרָ֑ם הָיָ֥ה צֹאן וּ/בָקָ֖ר וְ/אֹהָלִֽים
verses.translit: vgm llvt hhlkh 't 'brm hyh ts'n vbqr v'hlym
verses.translation: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא נָשָׂ֥א אֹתָ֛/ם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי הָיָ֤ה רְכוּשָׁ/ם֙ רָ֔ב וְ/לֹ֥א יָֽכְל֖וּ לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: vl' nsh' 'tm h'rts lshbt ychdv khy hyh rkhvshm rb vl' ykhlv lshbt ychdv
verses.translation: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי רִ֗יב בֵּ֚ין רֹעֵ֣י מִקְנֵֽה אַבְרָ֔ם וּ/בֵ֖ין רֹעֵ֣י מִקְנֵה ל֑וֹט וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י אָ֖ז יֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy ryb byn r'y mqnh 'brm vbyn r'y mqnh lvt vhkhn'ny vhprzy 'z yshb b'rts
verses.translation: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל ל֗וֹט אַל נָ֨א תְהִ֤י מְרִיבָה֙ בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/בֵ֥ין רֹעַ֖/י וּ/בֵ֣ין רֹעֶ֑י/ךָ כִּֽי אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אַחִ֖ים אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'l lvt 'l n' thy mrybh byny vbynykh vbyn r'y vbyn r'ykh khy 'nshym 'chym 'nchnv
verses.translation: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֤א כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ הִפָּ֥רֶד נָ֖א מֵ/עָלָ֑/י אִם הַ/שְּׂמֹ֣אל וְ/אֵימִ֔נָה וְ/אִם הַ/יָּמִ֖ין וְ/אַשְׂמְאִֽילָה
verses.translit: hl' khl h'rts lpnykh hprd n' m'ly 'm hshm'l v'ymnh v'm hymyn v'shm'ylh
verses.translation: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂא ל֣וֹט אֶת עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת כָּל כִּכַּ֣ר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן כִּ֥י כֻלָּ֖/הּ מַשְׁקֶ֑ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י שַׁחֵ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה אֶת סְדֹם֙ וְ/אֶת עֲמֹרָ֔ה כְּ/גַן יְהוָה֙ כְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲ/כָ֖ה צֹֽעַר
verses.translit: vysh' lvt 't 'ynyv vyr' 't khl khkhr hyrdn khy khlh mshqh lpny shcht yhvh 't sdm v't 'mrh khgn yhvh kh'rts mtsrym b'khh ts'r
verses.translation: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD , like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְחַר ל֣/וֹ ל֗וֹט אֵ֚ת כָּל כִּכַּ֣ר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַ/יִּסַּ֥ע ל֖וֹט מִ/קֶּ֑דֶם וַ/יִּפָּ֣רְד֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/עַ֥ל אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vybchr lv lvt 't khl khkhr hyrdn vys' lvt mqdm vyprdv 'ysh m'l 'chyv
verses.translation: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

verses.original: אַבְרָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/ל֗וֹט יָשַׁב֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הַ/כִּכָּ֔ר וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֖ל עַד סְדֹֽם
verses.translit: 'brm yshb b'rts khn'n vlvt yshb b'ry hkhkhr vy'hl 'd sdm
verses.translation: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

verses.original: וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י סְדֹ֔ם רָעִ֖ים וְ/חַטָּאִ֑ים לַ/יהוָ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v'nshy sdm r'ym vcht'ym lyhvh m'd
verses.translation: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֞ה אָמַ֣ר אֶל אַבְרָ֗ם אַחֲרֵי֙ הִפָּֽרֶד ל֣וֹט מֵֽ/עִמּ֔/וֹ שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּ/רְאֵ֔ה מִן הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֣ה שָׁ֑ם צָפֹ֥נָ/ה וָ/נֶ֖גְבָּ/ה וָ/קֵ֥דְמָ/ה וָ/יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyhvh 'mr 'l 'brm 'chry hprd lvt m'mv sh' n' 'ynykh vr'h mn hmqvm 'shr 'th shm tspnh vngbh vqdmh vymh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

verses.original: כִּ֧י אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְ/ךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑/נָּה וּֽ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khy 't khl h'rts 'shr 'th r'h lkh 'tnnh vlzr'kh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֥י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ כַּ/עֲפַ֣ר הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם יוּכַ֣ל אִ֗ישׁ לִ/מְנוֹת֙ אֶת עֲפַ֣ר הָ/אָ֔רֶץ גַּֽם זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ יִמָּנֶֽה
verses.translit: vshmty 't zr'kh kh'pr h'rts 'shr 'm yvkhl 'ysh lmnvt 't 'pr h'rts gm zr'kh ymnh
verses.translation: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

verses.translit: qvm hthlkh b'rts l'rkhh vlrchbh khy lkh 'tnnh
verses.translation: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֣ל אַבְרָ֗ם וַ/יָּבֹ֛א וַ/יֵּ֛שֶׁב בְּ/אֵלֹנֵ֥י מַמְרֵ֖א אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/חֶבְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּֽבֶן שָׁ֥ם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'hl 'brm vyb' vyshb b'lny mmr' 'shr bchbrvn vybn shm mzbch lyhvh
verses.translation: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/ימֵי֙ אַמְרָפֶ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ שִׁנְעָ֔ר אַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר כְּדָרְלָעֹ֨מֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֔ם וְ/תִדְעָ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vyhy bymy 'mrpl mlkh shn'r 'ryvkh mlkh 'lsr khdrl'mr mlkh 'ylm vtd'l mlkh gvym
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

verses.original: עָשׂ֣וּ מִלְחָמָ֗ה אֶת בֶּ֨רַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֔ם וְ/אֶת בִּרְשַׁ֖ע מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֑ה שִׁנְאָ֣ב מֶ֣לֶךְ אַדְמָ֗ה וְ/שֶׁמְאֵ֨בֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ צביים צְבוֹיִ֔ים וּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִיא צֹֽעַר
verses.translit: 'shv mlchmh 't br' mlkh sdm v't brsh' mlkh 'mrh shn'b mlkh 'dmh vshm'br mlkh tsbyym tsbvyym vmlkh bl' hy' ts'r
verses.translation: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֨לֶּה֙ חָֽבְר֔וּ אֶל עֵ֖מֶק הַ/שִּׂדִּ֑ים ה֖וּא יָ֥ם הַ/מֶּֽלַח
verses.translit: khl 'lh chbrv 'l 'mq hshdym hv' ym hmlch
verses.translation: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עָבְד֖וּ אֶת כְּדָרְלָעֹ֑מֶר וּ/שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה מָרָֽדוּ
verses.translit: shtym 'shrh shnh 'bdv 't khdrl'mr vshlsh 'shrh shnh mrdv
verses.translation: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/אַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה בָּ֣א כְדָרְלָעֹ֗מֶר וְ/הַ/מְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּכּ֤וּ אֶת רְפָאִים֙ בְּ/עַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת קַרְנַ֔יִם וְ/אֶת הַ/זּוּזִ֖ים בְּ/הָ֑ם וְ/אֵת֙ הָֽ/אֵימִ֔ים בְּ/שָׁוֵ֖ה קִרְיָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vb'rb' 'shrh shnh b' khdrl'mr vhmlkhym 'shr 'tv vykhv 't rp'ym b'shtrt qrnym v't hzvzym bhm v't h'ymym bshvh qrytym
verses.translation: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/חֹרִ֖י בְּ/הַרְרָ֣/ם שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֚ד אֵ֣יל פָּארָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v't hchry bhrrm sh'yr 'd 'yl p'rn 'shr 'l hmdbr
verses.translation: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּשֻׁבוּ וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל עֵ֤ין מִשְׁפָּט֙ הִ֣וא קָדֵ֔שׁ וַ/יַּכּ֕וּ אֶֽת כָּל שְׂדֵ֖ה הָ/עֲמָלֵקִ֑י וְ/גַם֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חַֽצְצֹ֥ן תָּמָֽר
verses.translit: vyshbv vyb'v 'l 'yn mshpt hv' qdsh vykhv 't khl shdh h'mlqy vgm 't h'mry hyshb bchtstsn tmr
verses.translation: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א מֶֽלֶךְ סְדֹ֜ם וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֗ה וּ/מֶ֤לֶךְ אַדְמָה֙ וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ צביים צְבוֹיִ֔ם וּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִוא צֹ֑עַר וַ/יַּֽעַרְכ֤וּ אִתָּ/ם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּ/עֵ֖מֶק הַ/שִּׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: vyts' mlkh sdm vmlkh 'mrh vmlkh 'dmh vmlkh tsbyym tsbvym vmlkh bl' hv' ts'r vy'rkhv 'tm mlchmh b'mq hshdym
verses.translation: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

verses.original: אֵ֣ת כְּדָרְלָעֹ֜מֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֗ם וְ/תִדְעָל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/אַמְרָפֶל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁנְעָ֔ר וְ/אַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֥ה מְלָכִ֖ים אֶת הַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: 't khdrl'mr mlkh 'ylm vtd'l mlkh gvym v'mrpl mlkh shn'r v'ryvkh mlkh 'lsr 'rb'h mlkhym 't hchmshh
verses.translation: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

verses.original: וְ/עֵ֣מֶק הַ/שִׂדִּ֗ים בֶּֽאֱרֹ֤ת בֶּאֱרֹת֙ חֵמָ֔ר וַ/יָּנֻ֛סוּ מֶֽלֶךְ סְדֹ֥ם וַ/עֲמֹרָ֖ה וַ/יִּפְּלוּ שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים הֶ֥רָ/ה נָּֽסוּ
verses.translit: v'mq hshdym b'rt b'rt chmr vynsv mlkh sdm v'mrh vyplv shmh vhnsh'rym hrh nsv
verses.translation: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּקְחוּ אֶת כָּל רְכֻ֨שׁ סְדֹ֧ם וַ/עֲמֹרָ֛ה וְ/אֶת כָּל אָכְלָ֖/ם וַ/יֵּלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vyqchv 't khl rkhsh sdm v'mrh v't khl 'khlm vylkhv
verses.translation: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֨וּ אֶת ל֧וֹט וְ/אֶת רְכֻשׁ֛/וֹ בֶּן אֲחִ֥י אַבְרָ֖ם וַ/יֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְ/ה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב בִּ/סְדֹֽם
verses.translit: vyqchv 't lvt v't rkhshv bn 'chy 'brm vylkhv vhv' yshb bsdm
verses.translation: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ הַ/פָּלִ֔יט וַ/יַּגֵּ֖ד לְ/אַבְרָ֣ם הָ/עִבְרִ֑י וְ/הוּא֩ שֹׁכֵ֨ן בְּ/אֵֽלֹנֵ֜י מַמְרֵ֣א הָ/אֱמֹרִ֗י אֲחִ֤י אֶשְׁכֹּל֙ וַ/אֲחִ֣י עָנֵ֔ר וְ/הֵ֖ם בַּעֲלֵ֥י בְרִית אַבְרָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' hplyt vygd l'brm h'bry vhv' shkhn b'lny mmr' h'mry 'chy 'shkhl v'chy 'nr vhm b'ly bryt 'brm
verses.translation: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע אַבְרָ֔ם כִּ֥י נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אָחִ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֨רֶק אֶת חֲנִיכָ֜י/ו יְלִידֵ֣י בֵית֗/וֹ שְׁמֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֖ף עַד דָּֽן
verses.translit: vyshm' 'brm khy nshbh 'chyv vyrq 't chnykhyv ylydy bytv shmnh 'shr vshlsh m'vt vyrdf 'd dn
verses.translation: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants , born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּחָלֵ֨ק עֲלֵי/הֶ֧ם לַ֛יְלָה ה֥וּא וַ/עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יַּכֵּ֑/ם וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפֵ/ם֙ עַד חוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִ/שְּׂמֹ֖אל לְ/דַמָּֽשֶׂק
verses.translit: vychlq 'lyhm lylh hv' v'bdyv vykhm vyrdpm 'd chvbh 'shr mshm'l ldmshq
verses.translation: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֕שֶׁב אֵ֖ת כָּל הָ/רְכֻ֑שׁ וְ/גַם֩ אֶת ל֨וֹט אָחִ֤י/ו וּ/רְכֻשׁ/וֹ֙ הֵשִׁ֔יב וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים וְ/אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyshb 't khl hrkhsh vgm 't lvt 'chyv vrkhshv hshyb vgm 't hnshym v't h'm
verses.translation: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ סְדֹם֮ לִ/קְרָאת/וֹ֒ אַחֲרֵ֣י שׁוּב֗/וֹ מֵֽ/הַכּוֹת֙ אֶת כְּדָרלָעֹ֔מֶר וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּלָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ אֶל עֵ֣מֶק שָׁוֵ֔ה ה֖וּא עֵ֥מֶק הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyts' mlkh sdm lqr'tv 'chry shvbv mhkhvt 't khdrl'mr v't hmlkhym 'shr 'tv 'l 'mq shvh hv' 'mq hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְכִּי צֶ֨דֶק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שָׁלֵ֔ם הוֹצִ֖יא לֶ֣חֶם וָ/יָ֑יִן וְ/ה֥וּא כֹהֵ֖ן לְ/אֵ֥ל עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: vmlkhy tsdq mlkh shlm hvtsy' lchm vyyn vhv' khhn l'l 'lyvn
verses.translation: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵ֖/הוּ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר בָּר֤וּךְ אַבְרָם֙ לְ/אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vybrkhhv vy'mr brvkh 'brm l'l 'lyvn qnh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

verses.original: וּ/בָרוּךְ֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר מִגֵּ֥ן צָרֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֥/וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: vbrvkh 'l 'lyvn 'shr mgn tsrykh bydkh vytn lv m'shr mkhl
verses.translation: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ סְדֹ֖ם אֶל אַבְרָ֑ם תֶּן לִ֣/י הַ/נֶּ֔פֶשׁ וְ/הָ/רְכֻ֖שׁ קַֽח לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh sdm 'l 'brm tn ly hnpsh vhrkhsh qch lkh
verses.translation: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָ֖ם אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֑ם הֲרִימֹ֨תִי יָדִ֤/י אֶל יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'l mlkh sdm hrymty ydy 'l yhvh 'l 'lyvn qnh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD , the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

verses.original: אִם מִ/חוּט֙ וְ/עַ֣ד שְׂרֽוֹךְ נַ֔עַל וְ/אִם אֶקַּ֖ח מִ/כָּל אֲשֶׁר לָ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹ֣א תֹאמַ֔ר אֲנִ֖י הֶעֱשַׁ֥רְתִּי אֶת אַבְרָֽם
verses.translit: 'm mchvt v'd shrvkh n'l v'm 'qch mkhl 'shr lkh vl' t'mr 'ny h'shrty 't 'brm
verses.translation: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

verses.original: בִּלְעָדַ֗/י רַ֚ק אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽכְל֣וּ הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וְ/חֵ֨לֶק֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלְכ֖וּ אִתִּ֑/י עָנֵר֙ אֶשְׁכֹּ֣ל וּ/מַמְרֵ֔א הֵ֖ם יִקְח֥וּ חֶלְקָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bl'dy rq 'shr 'khlv hn'rym vchlq h'nshym 'shr hlkhv 'ty 'nr 'shkhl vmmr' hm yqchv chlqm
verses.translation: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

verses.original: אַחַ֣ר הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה הָיָ֤ה דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֶל אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽ/מַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אַל תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ מָגֵ֣ן לָ֔/ךְ שְׂכָרְ/ךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'chr hdbrym h'lh hyh dbr yhvh 'l 'brm bmchzh l'mr 'l tyr' 'brm 'nkhy mgn lkh shkhrkh hrbh m'd
verses.translation: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֗ם אֲדֹנָ֤/י יֱהוִה֙ מַה תִּתֶּן לִ֔/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עֲרִירִ֑י וּ/בֶן מֶ֣שֶׁק בֵּיתִ֔/י ה֖וּא דַּמֶּ֥שֶׂק אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'dny yhvh mh ttn ly v'nkhy hvlkh 'ryry vbn mshq byty hv' dmshq 'ly'zr
verses.translation: And Abram said, Lord GOD , what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֔ם הֵ֣ן לִ֔/י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖תָּה זָ֑רַע וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה בֶן בֵּיתִ֖/י יוֹרֵ֥שׁ אֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm hn ly l' ntth zr' vhnh bn byty yvrsh 'ty
verses.translation: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה דְבַר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א יִֽירָשְׁ/ךָ֖ זֶ֑ה כִּי אִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִ/מֵּעֶ֔י/ךָ ה֖וּא יִֽירָשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnh dbr yhvh 'lyv l'mr l' yyrshkh zh khy 'm 'shr yts' mm'ykh hv' yyrshkh
verses.translation: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵ֨א אֹת֜/וֹ הַ/ח֗וּצָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַבֶּט נָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יְמָ/ה וּ/סְפֹר֙ הַ/כּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים אִם תּוּכַ֖ל לִ/סְפֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ כֹּ֥ה יִהְיֶ֖ה זַרְעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyvts' 'tv hchvtsh vy'mr hbt n' hshmymh vspr hkhvkhbym 'm tvkhl lspr 'tm vy'mr lv khh yhyh zr'kh
verses.translation: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

verses.original: וְ/הֶאֱמִ֖ן בַּֽ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּחְשְׁבֶ֥/הָ לּ֖/וֹ צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: vh'mn byhvh vychshbh lv tsdqh
verses.translation: And he believed in the LORD ; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י/ו אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵאתִ֨י/ךָ֙ מֵ/א֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לָ֧/תֶת לְ/ךָ֛ אֶת הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'ny yhvh 'shr hvts'tykh m'vr khshdym ltt lkh 't h'rts hz't lrshth
verses.translation: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יֱהוִ֔ה בַּ/מָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁ/נָּה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny yhvh bmh 'd' khy 'yrshnh
verses.translation: And he said, Lord GOD , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו קְחָ֥/ה לִ/י֙ עֶגְלָ֣ה מְשֻׁלֶּ֔שֶׁת וְ/עֵ֥ז מְשֻׁלֶּ֖שֶׁת וְ/אַ֣יִל מְשֻׁלָּ֑שׁ וְ/תֹ֖ר וְ/גוֹזָֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv qchh ly 'glh mshlsht v'z mshlsht v'yl mshlsh vtr vgvzl
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל֣/וֹ אֶת כָּל אֵ֗לֶּה וַ/יְבַתֵּ֤ר אֹתָ/ם֙ בַּ/תָּ֔וֶךְ וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אִישׁ בִּתְר֖/וֹ לִ/קְרַ֣את רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/אֶת הַ/צִפֹּ֖ר לֹ֥א בָתָֽר
verses.translit: vyqch lv 't khl 'lh vybtr 'tm btvkh vytn 'ysh btrv lqr't r'hv v't htspr l' btr
verses.translation: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד הָ/עַ֖יִט עַל הַ/פְּגָרִ֑ים וַ/יַּשֵּׁ֥ב אֹתָ֖/ם אַבְרָֽם
verses.translit: vyrd h'yt 'l hpgrym vyshb 'tm 'brm
verses.translation: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לָ/ב֔וֹא וְ/תַרְדֵּמָ֖ה נָפְלָ֣ה עַל אַבְרָ֑ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אֵימָ֛ה חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה נֹפֶ֥לֶת עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy hshmsh lbv' vtrdmh nplh 'l 'brm vhnh 'ymh chshkhh gdlh nplt 'lyv
verses.translation: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/אַבְרָ֗ם יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי גֵ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֲ/ךָ֗ בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָ/הֶ֔ם וַ/עֲבָד֖וּ/ם וְ/עִנּ֣וּ אֹתָ֑/ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr l'brm yd' td' khy gr yhyh zr'kh b'rts l' lhm v'bdvm v'nv 'tm 'rb' m'vt shnh
verses.translation: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

verses.original: וְ/גַ֧ם אֶת הַ/גּ֛וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲבֹ֖דוּ דָּ֣ן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֥ן יֵצְא֖וּ בִּ/רְכֻ֥שׁ גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vgm 't hgvy 'shr y'bdv dn 'nkhy v'chry khn yts'v brkhsh gdvl
verses.translation: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֛ה תָּב֥וֹא אֶל אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/שָׁל֑וֹם תִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/שֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: v'th tbv' 'l 'btykh bshlvm tqbr bshybh tvbh
verses.translation: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

verses.original: וְ/ד֥וֹר רְבִיעִ֖י יָשׁ֣וּבוּ הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֧י לֹא שָׁלֵ֛ם עֲוֺ֥ן הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י עַד הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vdvr rby'y yshvbv hnh khy l' shlm 'vn h'mry 'd hnh
verses.translation: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ בָּ֔אָה וַ/עֲלָטָ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה תַנּ֤וּר עָשָׁן֙ וְ/לַפִּ֣יד אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֔ר בֵּ֖ין הַ/גְּזָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy hshmsh b'h v'lth hyh vhnh tnvr 'shn vlpyd 'sh 'shr 'br byn hgzrym h'lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא כָּרַ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֶת אַבְרָ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֗ נָתַ֨תִּי֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את מִ/נְּהַ֣ר מִצְרַ֔יִם עַד הַ/נָּהָ֥ר הַ/גָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר פְּרָֽת
verses.translit: byvm hhv' khrt yhvh 't 'brm bryt l'mr lzr'kh ntty 't h'rts hz't mnhr mtsrym 'd hnhr hgdl nhr prt
verses.translation: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

verses.original: אֶת הַ/קֵּינִי֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/קְּנִזִּ֔י וְ/אֵ֖ת הַ/קַּדְמֹנִֽי
verses.translit: 't hqyny v't hqnzy v't hqdmny
verses.translation: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/חִתִּ֥י וְ/אֶת הַ/פְּרִזִּ֖י וְ/אֶת הָ/רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: v't hchty v't hprzy v't hrp'ym
verses.translation: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ וְ/אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְ/אֶת הַ/גִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: v't h'mry v't hkhn'ny v't hgrgshy v't hybvsy
verses.translation: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂרַי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת אַבְרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָלְדָ֖ה ל֑/וֹ וְ/לָ֛/הּ שִׁפְחָ֥ה מִצְרִ֖ית וּ/שְׁמָ֥/הּ הָגָֽר
verses.translit: vshry 'sht 'brm l' yldh lv vlh shpchh mtsryt vshmh hgr
verses.translation: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר שָׂרַ֜י אֶל אַבְרָ֗ם הִנֵּה נָ֞א עֲצָרַ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ מִ/לֶּ֔דֶת בֹּא נָא֙ אֶל שִׁפְחָתִ֔/י אוּלַ֥י אִבָּנֶ֖ה מִמֶּ֑/נָּה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע אַבְרָ֖ם לְ/ק֥וֹל שָׂרָֽי
verses.translit: vt'mr shry 'l 'brm hnh n' 'tsrny yhvh mldt b' n' 'l shpchty 'vly 'bnh mmnh vyshm' 'brm lqvl shry
verses.translation: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֞ח שָׂרַ֣י אֵֽשֶׁת אַבְרָ֗ם אֶת הָגָ֤ר הַ/מִּצְרִית֙ שִׁפְחָתָ֔/הּ מִ/קֵּץ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים לְ/שֶׁ֥בֶת אַבְרָ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/תִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛/הּ לְ/אַבְרָ֥ם אִישָׁ֖/הּ ל֥/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vtqch shry 'sht 'brm 't hgr hmtsryt shpchth mqts 'shr shnym lshbt 'brm b'rts khn'n vttn 'th l'brm 'yshh lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֶל הָגָ֖ר וַ/תַּ֑הַר וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וַ/תֵּקַ֥ל גְּבִרְתָּ֖/הּ בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyb' 'l hgr vthr vtr' khy hrth vtql gbrth b'ynyh
verses.translation: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר שָׂרַ֣י אֶל אַבְרָם֮ חֲמָסִ֣/י עָלֶי/ךָ֒ אָנֹכִ֗י נָתַ֤תִּי שִׁפְחָתִ/י֙ בְּ/חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וָ/אֵקַ֖ל בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/הָ יִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינֶֽיׄ/ךָ
verses.translit: vt'mr shry 'l 'brm chmsy 'lykh 'nkhy ntty shpchty bchyqkh vtr' khy hrth v'ql b'ynyh yshpt yhvh byny vbynykh
verses.translation: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל שָׂרַ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה שִׁפְחָתֵ/ךְ֙ בְּ/יָדֵ֔/ךְ עֲשִׂי לָ֖/הּ הַ/טּ֣וֹב בְּ/עֵינָ֑יִ/ךְ וַ/תְּעַנֶּ֣/הָ שָׂרַ֔י וַ/תִּבְרַ֖ח מִ/פָּנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'l shry hnh shpchtkh bydkh 'shy lh htvb b'ynykh vt'nh shry vtbrch mpnyh
verses.translation: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּמְצָאָ֞/הּ מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה עַל עֵ֥ין הַ/מַּ֖יִם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר עַל הָ/עַ֖יִן בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ שֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vymts'h ml'kh yhvh 'l 'yn hmym bmdbr 'l h'yn bdrkh shvr
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר הָגָ֞ר שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרַ֛י אֵֽי מִ/זֶּ֥ה בָ֖את וְ/אָ֣נָה תֵלֵ֑כִי וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר מִ/פְּנֵי֙ שָׂרַ֣י גְּבִרְתִּ֔/י אָנֹכִ֖י בֹּרַֽחַת
verses.translit: vy'mr hgr shpcht shry 'y mzh b't v'nh tlkhy vt'mr mpny shry gbrty 'nkhy brcht
verses.translation: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה שׁ֖וּבִי אֶל גְּבִרְתֵּ֑/ךְ וְ/הִתְעַנִּ֖י תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lh ml'kh yhvh shvby 'l gbrtkh vht'ny tcht ydyh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה הַרְבָּ֥ה אַרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת זַרְעֵ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr lh ml'kh yhvh hrbh 'rbh 't zr'kh vl' yspr mrb
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה הִנָּ֥/ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְ/יֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְ/קָרָ֤את שְׁמ/וֹ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל כִּֽי שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה אֶל עָנְיֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr lh ml'kh yhvh hnkh hrh vyldt bn vqr't shmv yshm''l khy shm' yhvh 'l 'nykh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

verses.original: וְ/ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ פֶּ֣רֶא אָדָ֔ם יָד֣/וֹ בַ/כֹּ֔ל וְ/יַ֥ד כֹּ֖ל בּ֑/וֹ וְ/עַל פְּנֵ֥י כָל אֶחָ֖י/ו יִשְׁכֹּֽן
verses.translit: vhv' yhyh pr' 'dm ydv bkhl vyd khl bv v'l pny khl 'chyv yshkhn
verses.translation: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם יְהוָה֙ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/הָ אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל רֳאִ֑י כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה הֲ/גַ֥ם הֲלֹ֛ם רָאִ֖יתִי אַחֲרֵ֥י רֹאִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtqr' shm yhvh hdbr 'lyh 'th 'l r'y khy 'mrh hgm hlm r'yty 'chry r'y
verses.translation: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ קָרָ֣א לַ/בְּאֵ֔ר בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י הִנֵּ֥ה בֵין קָדֵ֖שׁ וּ/בֵ֥ין בָּֽרֶד
verses.translit: 'l khn qr' lb'r b'r lchy r'y hnh byn qdsh vbyn brd
verses.translation: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֧לֶד הָגָ֛ר לְ/אַבְרָ֖ם בֵּ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָ֧ם שֶׁם בְּנ֛/וֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָ֥ה הָגָ֖ר יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל
verses.translit: vtld hgr l'brm bn vyqr' 'brm shm bnv 'shr yldh hgr yshm''l
verses.translation: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְרָ֕ם בֶּן שְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים בְּ/לֶֽדֶת הָגָ֥ר אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל לְ/אַבְרָֽם
verses.translit: v'brm bn shmnym shnh vshsh shnym bldt hgr 't yshm''l l'brm
verses.translation: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אַבְרָ֔ם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/תֵ֣שַׁע שָׁנִ֑ים וַ/יֵּרָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל אַבְרָ֗ם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אֲנִי אֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֔י הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לְ/פָנַ֖/י וֶ/הְיֵ֥ה תָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy 'brm bn tsh'ym shnh vtsh' shnym vyr' yhvh 'l 'brm vy'mr 'lyv 'ny 'l shdy hthlkh lpny vhyh tmym
verses.translation: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

verses.original: וְ/אֶתְּנָ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖/י בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אַרְבֶּ֥ה אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ בִּ/מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v'tnh bryty byny vbynkh v'rbh 'vtkh bm'd m'd
verses.translation: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל אַבְרָ֖ם עַל פָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֛/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vypl 'brm 'l pnyv vydbr 'tv 'lhym l'mr
verses.translation: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

verses.original: אֲנִ֕י הִנֵּ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖/י אִתָּ֑/ךְ וְ/הָיִ֕יתָ לְ/אַ֖ב הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: 'ny hnh bryty 'tkh vhyyt l'b hmvn gvym
verses.translation: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד אֶת שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ אַבְרָ֑ם וְ/הָיָ֤ה שִׁמְ/ךָ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֛י אַב הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vl' yqr' 'vd 't shmkh 'brm vhyh shmkh 'brhm khy 'b hmvn gvym nttykh
verses.translation: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

verses.original: וְ/הִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ בִּ/מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לְ/גוֹיִ֑ם וּ/מְלָכִ֖ים מִמְּ/ךָ֥ יֵצֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: vhprty 'tkh bm'd m'd vnttykh lgvym vmlkhym mmkh yts'v
verses.translation: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֜/י בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֗/ךָ וּ/בֵ֨ין זַרְעֲ/ךָ֧ אַחֲרֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/דֹרֹתָ֖/ם לִ/בְרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֑ם לִ/הְי֤וֹת לְ/ךָ֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים וּֽ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ אַחֲרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhqmty 't bryty byny vbynkh vbyn zr'kh 'chrykh ldrtm lbryt 'vlm lhyvt lkh l'lhym vlzr'kh 'chrykh
verses.translation: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י לְ֠/ךָ וּ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֨ אַחֲרֶ֜י/ךָ אֵ֣ת אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֗י/ךָ אֵ֚ת כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לַ/אֲחֻזַּ֖ת עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vntty lkh vlzr'kh 'chrykh 't 'rts mgrykh 't khl 'rts khn'n l'chzt 'vlm vhyyty lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל אַבְרָהָ֔ם וְ/אַתָּ֖ה אֶת בְּרִיתִ֣/י תִשְׁמֹ֑ר אַתָּ֛ה וְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֥ אַֽחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/דֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l 'brhm v'th 't bryty tshmr 'th vzr'kh 'chrykh ldrtm
verses.translation: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

verses.original: זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֞/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֗וּ בֵּינִ/י֙ וּ/בֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֵ֥ין זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ הִמּ֥וֹל לָ/כֶ֖ם כָּל זָכָֽר
verses.translit: z't bryty 'shr tshmrv byny vbynykhm vbyn zr'kh 'chrykh hmvl lkhm khl zkhr
verses.translation: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

verses.original: וּ/נְמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלַתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָיָה֙ לְ/א֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vnmltm 't bshr 'rltkhm vhyh l'vt bryt byny vbynykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן שְׁמֹנַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִמּ֥וֹל לָ/כֶ֛ם כָּל זָכָ֖ר לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּ/מִקְנַת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מִ/כֹּ֣ל בֶּן נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִֽ/זַּרְעֲ/ךָ֖ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vbn shmnt ymym ymvl lkhm khl zkhr ldrtykhm ylyd byt vmqnt khsf mkhl bn nkhr 'shr l' mzr'kh hv'
verses.translation: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

verses.original: הִמּ֧וֹל יִמּ֛וֹל יְלִ֥יד בֵּֽיתְ/ךָ֖ וּ/מִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/הָיְתָ֧ה בְרִיתִ֛/י בִּ/בְשַׂרְ/כֶ֖ם לִ/בְרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hmvl ymvl ylyd bytkh vmqnt khspkh vhyth bryty bbshrkhm lbryt 'vlm
verses.translation: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

verses.original: וְ/עָרֵ֣ל זָכָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יִמּוֹל֙ אֶת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלָת֔/וֹ וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵ/עַמֶּ֑י/הָ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י הֵפַֽר
verses.translit: v'rl zkhr 'shr l' ymvl 't bshr 'rltv vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh 't bryty hpr
verses.translation: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל אַבְרָהָ֔ם שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֔ לֹא תִקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמָ֖/הּ שָׂרָ֑י כִּ֥י שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l 'brhm shry 'shtkh l' tqr' 't shmh shry khy shrh shmh
verses.translation: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be .

verses.original: וּ/בֵרַכְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/גַ֨ם נָתַ֧תִּי מִמֶּ֛/נָּה לְ/ךָ֖ בֵּ֑ן וּ/בֵֽרַכְתִּ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/הָֽיְתָ֣ה לְ/גוֹיִ֔ם מַלְכֵ֥י עַמִּ֖ים מִמֶּ֥/נָּה יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vbrkhty 'th vgm ntty mmnh lkh bn vbrkhtyh vhyth lgvym mlkhy 'mym mmnh yhyv
verses.translation: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֧ל אַבְרָהָ֛ם עַל פָּנָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּצְחָ֑ק וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר בְּ/לִבּ֗/וֹ הַ/לְּ/בֶ֤ן מֵאָֽה שָׁנָה֙ יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְ/אִ֨ם שָׂרָ֔ה הֲ/בַת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תֵּלֵֽד
verses.translit: vypl 'brhm 'l pnyv vytschq vy'mr blbv hlbn m'h shnh yvld v'm shrh hbt tsh'ym shnh tld
verses.translation: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים ל֥וּ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל יִחְיֶ֥ה לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'l h'lhym lv yshm''l ychyh lpnykh
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲבָל֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֗ יֹלֶ֤דֶת לְ/ךָ֙ בֵּ֔ן וְ/קָרָ֥אתָ אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ יִצְחָ֑ק וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֥/י אִתּ֛/וֹ לִ/בְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/זַרְע֥/וֹ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'bl shrh 'shtkh yldt lkh bn vqr't 't shmv ytschq vhqmty 't bryty 'tv lbryt 'vlm lzr'v 'chryv
verses.translation: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

verses.original: וּֽ/לְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֘אל שְׁמַעְתִּי/ךָ֒ הִנֵּ֣ה בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹת֗/וֹ וְ/הִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹת֖/וֹ בִּ/מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֤ר נְשִׂיאִם֙ יוֹלִ֔יד וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ו לְ/ג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vlyshm''l shm'tykh hnh brkhty 'tv vhpryty 'tv vhrbyty 'tv bm'd m'd shnym 'shr nshy'm yvlyd vnttyv lgvy gdvl
verses.translation: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י אָקִ֣ים אֶת יִצְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁר֩ תֵּלֵ֨ד לְ/ךָ֤ שָׂרָה֙ לַ/מּוֹעֵ֣ד הַ/זֶּ֔ה בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הָ/אַחֶֽרֶת
verses.translit: v't bryty 'qym 't ytschq 'shr tld lkh shrh lmv'd hzh bshnh h'chrt
verses.translation: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֖ל לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֣עַל אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵ/עַ֖ל אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: vykhl ldbr 'tv vy'l 'lhym m'l 'brhm
verses.translation: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֗/וֹ וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל יְלִידֵ֤י בֵית/וֹ֙ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל מִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפּ֔/וֹ כָּל זָכָ֕ר בְּ/אַנְשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֜מָל אֶת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלָתָ֗/ם בְּ/עֶ֨צֶם֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyqch 'brhm 't yshm''l bnv v't khl ylydy bytv v't khl mqnt khspv khl zkhr b'nshy byt 'brhm vyml 't bshr 'rltm b'tsm hyvm hzh kh'shr dbr 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

verses.original: וְ/אַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וָ/תֵ֖שַׁע שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/הִמֹּל֖/וֹ בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'brhm bn tsh'ym vtsh' shnh bhmlv bshr 'rltv
verses.translation: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֔/וֹ בֶּן שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/הִ֨מֹּל֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm''l bnv bn shlsh 'shrh shnh bhmlv 't bshr 'rltv
verses.translation: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.original: בְּ/עֶ֨צֶם֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה נִמּ֖וֹל אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b'tsm hyvm hzh nmvl 'brhm vyshm''l bnv
verses.translation: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

verses.original: וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵית/וֹ֙ יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּ/מִקְנַת כֶּ֖סֶף מֵ/אֵ֣ת בֶּן נֵכָ֑ר נִמֹּ֖לוּ אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl 'nshy bytv ylyd byt vmqnt khsf m't bn nkhr nmlv 'tv
verses.translation: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/אֵלֹנֵ֖י מַמְרֵ֑א וְ/ה֛וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב פֶּֽתַח הָ/אֹ֖הֶל כְּ/חֹ֥ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv yhvh b'lny mmr' vhv' yshb ptch h'hl khchm hyvm
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּ֔רְא וְ/הִנֵּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים נִצָּבִ֖ים עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֗רְא וַ/יָּ֤רָץ לִ/קְרָאתָ/ם֙ מִ/פֶּ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֔הֶל וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vysh' 'ynyv vyr' vhnh shlshh 'nshym ntsbym 'lyv vyr' vyrts lqr'tm mptch h'hl vyshtchv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗/י אִם נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ אַל נָ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר מֵ/עַ֥ל עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh 'l n' t'br m'l 'bdkh
verses.translation: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

verses.original: יֻקַּֽח נָ֣א מְעַט מַ֔יִם וְ/רַחֲצ֖וּ רַגְלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ תַּ֥חַת הָ/עֵֽץ
verses.translit: yqch n' m't mym vrchtsv rglykhm vhsh'nv tcht h'ts
verses.translation: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

verses.original: וְ/אֶקְחָ֨ה פַת לֶ֜חֶם וְ/סַעֲד֤וּ לִבְּ/כֶם֙ אַחַ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֥ן עֲבַרְתֶּ֖ם עַֽל עַבְדְּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: v'qchh pt lchm vs'dv lbkhm 'chr t'brv khy 'l khn 'brtm 'l 'bdkhm vy'mrv khn t'shh kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֧ר אַבְרָהָ֛ם הָ/אֹ֖הֱלָ/ה אֶל שָׂרָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מַהֲרִ֞י שְׁלֹ֤שׁ סְאִים֙ קֶ֣מַח סֹ֔לֶת ל֖וּשִׁי וַ/עֲשִׂ֥י עֻגֽוֹת
verses.translit: vymhr 'brhm h'hlh 'l shrh vy'mr mhry shlsh s'ym qmch slt lvshy v'shy 'gvt
verses.translation: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הַ/בָּקָ֖ר רָ֣ץ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח בֶּן בָּקָ֜ר רַ֤ךְ וָ/טוֹב֙ וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל הַ/נַּ֔עַר וַ/יְמַהֵ֖ר לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l hbqr rts 'brhm vyqch bn bqr rkh vtvb vytn 'l hn'r vymhr l'shvt 'tv
verses.translation: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח חֶמְאָ֜ה וְ/חָלָ֗ב וּ/בֶן הַ/בָּקָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הֽוּא עֹמֵ֧ד עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם תַּ֥חַת הָ/עֵ֖ץ וַ/יֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vyqch chm'h vchlb vbn hbqr 'shr 'shh vytn lpnyhm vhv' 'md 'lyhm tcht h'ts vy'khlv
verses.translation: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵׄלָׄ֔יׄ/וׄ אַיֵּ֖ה שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּ֥ה בָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'yh shrh 'shtkh vy'mr hnh b'hl
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וֹב אָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כָּ/עֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּה בֵ֖ן לְ/שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/שָׂרָ֥ה שֹׁמַ֛עַת פֶּ֥תַח הָ/אֹ֖הֶל וְ/ה֥וּא אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr shvb 'shvb 'lykh kh't chyh vhnh bn lshrh 'shtkh vshrh shm't ptch h'hl vhv' 'chryv
verses.translation: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְרָהָ֤ם וְ/שָׂרָה֙ זְקֵנִ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים בַּ/יָּמִ֑ים חָדַל֙ לִ/הְי֣וֹת לְ/שָׂרָ֔ה אֹ֖רַח כַּ/נָּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v'brhm vshrh zqnym b'ym bymym chdl lhyvt lshrh 'rch khnshym
verses.translation: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

verses.original: וַ/תִּצְחַ֥ק שָׂרָ֖ה בְּ/קִרְבָּ֣/הּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אַחֲרֵ֤י בְלֹתִ/י֙ הָֽיְתָה לִּ֣/י עֶדְנָ֔ה וַֽ/אדֹנִ֖/י זָקֵֽן
verses.translit: vttschq shrh bqrbh l'mr 'chry blty hyth ly 'dnh v'dny zqn
verses.translation: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל אַבְרָהָ֑ם לָ֣/מָּה זֶּה֩ צָחֲקָ֨ה שָׂרָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הַ/אַ֥ף אֻמְנָ֛ם אֵלֵ֖ד וַ/אֲנִ֥י זָקַֽנְתִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l 'brhm lmh zh tschqh shrh l'mr h'f 'mnm 'ld v'ny zqnty
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

verses.original: הֲ/יִפָּלֵ֥א מֵ/יְהוָ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר לַ/מּוֹעֵ֞ד אָשׁ֥וּב אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ כָּ/עֵ֥ת חַיָּ֖ה וּ/לְ/שָׂרָ֥ה בֵֽן
verses.translit: hypl' myhvh dbr lmv'd 'shvb 'lykh kh't chyh vlshrh bn
verses.translation: Is any thing too hard for the LORD ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

verses.original: וַ/תְּכַחֵ֨שׁ שָׂרָ֧ה לֵ/אמֹ֛ר לֹ֥א צָחַ֖קְתִּי כִּ֣י יָרֵ֑אָה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לֹ֖א כִּ֥י צָחָֽקְתְּ
verses.translit: vtkhchsh shrh l'mr l' tschqty khy yr'h vy'mr l' khy tschqt
verses.translation: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֤מוּ מִ/שָּׁם֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יַּשְׁקִ֖פוּ עַל פְּנֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם וְ/אַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הֹלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּ֖/ם לְ/שַׁלְּחָֽ/ם
