verses.translit: vyqmv mshm h'nshym vyshqpv 'l pny sdm v'brhm hlkh 'mm lshlchm
verses.translation: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהֹוָ֖ה אָמָ֑ר הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֤ה אֲנִי֙ מֵֽ/אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyhvh 'mr hmkhsh 'ny m'brhm 'shr 'ny 'shh
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

verses.original: וְ/אַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הָי֧וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֛ה לְ/ג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל וְ/עָצ֑וּם וְ/נִ֨בְרְכוּ ב֔/וֹ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'brhm hyv yhyh lgvy gdvl v'tsvm vnbrkhv bv khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְדַעְתִּ֗י/ו לְמַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֶת בָּנָ֤י/ו וְ/אֶת בֵּית/וֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת צְדָקָ֖ה וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט לְמַ֗עַן הָבִ֤יא יְהוָה֙ עַל אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֖ר עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy yd'tyv lm'n 'shr ytsvh 't bnyv v't bytv 'chryv vshmrv drkh yhvh l'shvt tsdqh vmshpt lm'n hby' yhvh 'l 'brhm 't 'shr dbr 'lyv
verses.translation: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD , to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה זַעֲקַ֛ת סְדֹ֥ם וַ/עֲמֹרָ֖ה כִּי רָ֑בָּה וְ/חַ֨טָּאתָ֔/ם כִּ֥י כָבְדָ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh z'qt sdm v'mrh khy rbh vcht'tm khy khbdh m'd
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

verses.original: אֵֽרֲדָה נָּ֣א וְ/אֶרְאֶ֔ה הַ/כְּ/צַעֲקָתָ֛/הּ הַ/בָּ֥אָה אֵלַ֖/י עָשׂ֣וּ כָּלָ֑ה וְ/אִם לֹ֖א אֵדָֽעָה
verses.translit: 'rdh n' v'r'h hkhts'qth hb'h 'ly 'shv khlh v'm l' 'd'h
verses.translation: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֤וּ מִ/שָּׁם֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ סְדֹ֑מָ/ה וְ/אַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם עוֹדֶ֥/נּוּ עֹמֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vypnv mshm h'nshym vylkhv sdmh v'brhm 'vdnv 'md lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֥שׁ אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַ/אַ֣ף תִּסְפֶּ֔ה צַדִּ֖יק עִם רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: vygsh 'brhm vy'mr h'f tsph tsdyq 'm rsh'
verses.translation: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

verses.original: אוּלַ֥י יֵ֛שׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֑יר הַ/אַ֤ף תִּסְפֶּה֙ וְ/לֹא תִשָּׂ֣א לַ/מָּק֔וֹם לְמַ֛עַן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַ/צַּדִּיקִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'vly ysh chmshym tsdyqm btvkh h'yr h'f tsph vl' tsh' lmqvm lm'n chmshym htsdyqm 'shr bqrbh
verses.translation: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

verses.original: חָלִ֨לָ/ה לְּ/ךָ֜ מֵ/עֲשֹׂ֣ת כַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה לְ/הָמִ֤ית צַדִּיק֙ עִם רָשָׁ֔ע וְ/הָיָ֥ה כַ/צַּדִּ֖יק כָּ/רָשָׁ֑ע חָלִ֣לָ/ה לָּ֔/ךְ הֲ/שֹׁפֵט֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: chllh lkh m'sht khdbr hzh lhmyt tsdyq 'm rsh' vhyh khtsdyq khrsh' chllh lkh hshpt khl h'rts l' y'shh mshpt
verses.translation: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אִם אֶמְצָ֥א בִ/סְדֹ֛ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/נָשָׂ֥אתִי לְ/כָל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם בַּ/עֲבוּרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'm 'mts' bsdm chmshym tsdyqm btvkh h'yr vnsh'ty lkhl hmqvm b'bvrm
verses.translation: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הִנֵּה נָ֤א הוֹאַ֨לְתִּי֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל אֲדֹנָ֔/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י עָפָ֥ר וָ/אֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vy'n 'brhm vy'mr hnh n' hv'lty ldbr 'l 'dny v'nkhy 'pr v'pr
verses.translation: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

verses.original: א֠וּלַי יַחְסְר֞וּ/ן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים הַ/צַּדִּיקִם֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה הֲ/תַשְׁחִ֥ית בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת כָּל הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית אִם אֶמְצָ֣א שָׁ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'vly ychsrvn chmshym htsdyqm chmshh htshchyt bchmshh 't khl h'yr vy'mr l' 'shchyt 'm 'mts' shm 'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨סֶף ע֜וֹד לְ/דַבֵּ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּ/ן שָׁ֖ם אַרְבָּעִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה בַּ/עֲב֖וּר הָ/אַרְבָּעִֽים
verses.translit: vysf 'vd ldbr 'lyv vy'mr 'vly ymts'vn shm 'rb'ym vy'mr l' ''shh b'bvr h'rb'ym
verses.translation: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty’s sake.

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר אַל נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽ/אדֹנָ/י֙ וַ/אֲדַבֵּ֔רָה אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּ/ן שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה אִם אֶמְצָ֥א שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l n' ychr l'dny v'dbrh 'vly ymts'vn shm shlshym vy'mr l' ''shh 'm 'mts' shm shlshym
verses.translation: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it , if I find thirty there.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּֽה נָ֤א הוֹאַ֨לְתִּי֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל אֲדֹנָ֔/י אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּ/ן שָׁ֖ם עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית בַּ/עֲב֖וּר הָֽ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh n' hv'lty ldbr 'l 'dny 'vly ymts'vn shm 'shrym vy'mr l' 'shchyt b'bvr h'shrym
verses.translation: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר אַל נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽ/אדֹנָ/י֙ וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אַךְ הַ/פַּ֔עַם אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּ/ן שָׁ֖ם עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית בַּ/עֲב֖וּר הָ/עֲשָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l n' ychr l'dny v'dbrh 'kh hp'm 'vly ymts'vn shm 'shrh vy'mr l' 'shchyt b'bvr h'shrh
verses.translation: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔ה לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר אֶל אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְ/אַבְרָהָ֖ם שָׁ֥ב לִ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh yhvh kh'shr khlh ldbr 'l 'brhm v'brhm shb lmqmv
verses.translation: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֤ים סְדֹ֨מָ/ה֙ בָּ/עֶ֔רֶב וְ/ל֖וֹט יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/שַֽׁעַר סְדֹ֑ם וַ/יַּרְא לוֹט֙ וַ/יָּ֣קָם לִ/קְרָאתָ֔/ם וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb'v shny hml'khym sdmh b'rb vlvt yshb bsh'r sdm vyr' lvt vyqm lqr'tm vyshtchv 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֶּ֣ה נָּא אֲדֹנַ֗/י ס֣וּרוּ נָ֠א אֶל בֵּ֨ית עַבְדְּ/כֶ֤ם וְ/לִ֨ינוּ֙ וְ/רַחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֖ם וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֣ם לְ/דַרְכְּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לֹּ֔א כִּ֥י בָ/רְח֖וֹב נָלִֽין
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh n' 'dny svrv n' 'l byt 'bdkhm vlynv vrchtsv rglykhm vhshkhmtm vhlkhtm ldrkhkhm vy'mrv l' khy brchvb nlyn
verses.translation: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְצַר בָּ֣/ם מְאֹ֔ד וַ/יָּסֻ֣רוּ אֵלָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ לָ/הֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וּ/מַצּ֥וֹת אָפָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vyptsr bm m'd vysrv 'lyv vyb'v 'l bytv vy'sh lhm mshth vmtsvt 'ph vy'khlv
verses.translation: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

verses.original: טֶרֶם֮ יִשְׁכָּבוּ֒ וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָ/עִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֤י סְדֹם֙ נָסַ֣בּוּ עַל הַ/בַּ֔יִת מִ/נַּ֖עַר וְ/עַד זָקֵ֑ן כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם מִ/קָּצֶֽה
verses.translit: trm yshkhbv v'nshy h'yr 'nshy sdm nsbv 'l hbyt mn'r v'd zqn khl h'm mqtsh
verses.translation: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְא֤וּ אֶל לוֹט֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔/וֹ אַיֵּ֧ה הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה הוֹצִיאֵ֣/ם אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/נֵדְעָ֖ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqr'v 'l lvt vy'mrv lv 'yh h'nshym 'shr b'v 'lykh hlylh hvtsy'm 'lynv vnd'h 'tm
verses.translation: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֧א אֲלֵ/הֶ֛ם ל֖וֹט הַ/פֶּ֑תְחָ/ה וְ/הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת סָגַ֥ר אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyts' 'lhm lvt hptchh vhdlt sgr 'chryv
verses.translation: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אַל נָ֥א אַחַ֖/י תָּרֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l n' 'chy tr'v
verses.translation: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֨א לִ֜/י שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יָדְעוּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אוֹצִֽיאָה נָּ֤א אֶתְ/הֶן֙ אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וַ/עֲשׂ֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ן כַּ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֑ם רַ֠ק לָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ/אֵל֙ אַל תַּעֲשׂ֣וּ דָבָ֔ר כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֥ן בָּ֖אוּ בְּ/צֵ֥ל קֹרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hnh n' ly shty bnvt 'shr l' yd'v 'ysh 'vtsy'h n' 'thn 'lykhm v'shv lhn khtvb b'ynykhm rq l'nshym h'l 'l t'shv dbr khy 'l khn b'v btsl qrty
verses.translation: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ גֶּשׁ הָ֗לְאָה וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ הָ/אֶחָ֤ד בָּֽא לָ/גוּר֙ וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט שָׁפ֔וֹט עַתָּ֕ה נָרַ֥ע לְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּפְצְר֨וּ בָ/אִ֤ישׁ בְּ/לוֹט֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽ/יִּגְּשׁ֖וּ לִ/שְׁבֹּ֥ר הַ/דָּֽלֶת
verses.translit: vy'mrv gsh hl'h vy'mrv h'chd b' lgvr vyshpt shpvt 'th nr' lkh mhm vyptsrv b'ysh blvt m'd vygshv lshbr hdlt
verses.translation: And they said, Stand back. And they said again , This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֤וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת יָדָ֔/ם וַ/יָּבִ֧יאוּ אֶת ל֛וֹט אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/בָּ֑יְתָ/ה וְ/אֶת הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת סָגָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyshlchv h'nshym 't ydm vyby'v 't lvt 'lyhm hbyth v't hdlt sgrv
verses.translation: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֞ים אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֣תַח הַ/בַּ֗יִת הִכּוּ֙ בַּ/סַּנְוֵרִ֔ים מִ/קָּטֹ֖ן וְ/עַד גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יִּלְא֖וּ לִ/מְצֹ֥א הַ/פָּֽתַח
verses.translit: v't h'nshym 'shr ptch hbyt hkhv bsnvrym mqtn v'd gdvl vyl'v lmts' hptch
verses.translation: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֶל ל֗וֹט עֹ֚ד מִֽי לְ/ךָ֣ פֹ֔ה חָתָן֙ וּ/בָנֶ֣י/ךָ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר לְ/ךָ֖ בָּ/עִ֑יר הוֹצֵ֖א מִן הַ/מָּקֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'nshym 'l lvt 'd my lkh ph chtn vbnykh vbntykh vkhl 'shr lkh b'yr hvts' mn hmqvm
verses.translation: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

verses.original: כִּֽי מַשְׁחִתִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּֽי גָֽדְלָ֤ה צַעֲקָתָ/ם֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֥/נוּ יְהוָ֖ה לְ/שַׁחֲתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy mshchtym 'nchnv 't hmqvm hzh khy gdlh ts'qtm 't pny yhvh vyshlchnv yhvh lshchth
verses.translation: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD ; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א ל֜וֹט וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל חֲתָנָ֣י/ו לֹקְחֵ֣י בְנֹתָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִן הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּֽי מַשְׁחִ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יְהִ֥י כִ/מְצַחֵ֖ק בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י חֲתָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyts' lvt vydbr 'l chtnyv lqchy bntyv vy'mr qvmv ts'v mn hmqvm hzh khy mshchyt yhvh 't h'yr vyhy khmtschq b'yny chtnyv
verses.translation: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

verses.original: וּ/כְמוֹ֙ הַ/שַּׁ֣חַר עָלָ֔ה וַ/יָּאִ֥יצוּ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֖ים בְּ/ל֣וֹט לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קוּם֩ קַ֨ח אֶֽת אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֜ וְ/אֶת שְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/נִּמְצָאֹ֔ת פֶּן תִּסָּפֶ֖ה בַּ/עֲוֺ֥ן הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vkhmv hshchr 'lh vy'ytsv hml'khym blvt l'mr qvm qch 't 'shtkh v't shty bntykh hnmts't pn tsph b'vn h'yr
verses.translation: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְמַהְמָ֓הּ וַ/יַּחֲזִ֨קוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּ/יָד֣/וֹ וּ/בְ/יַד אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ וּ/בְ/יַד֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתָ֔י/ו בְּ/חֶמְלַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּצִאֻ֥/הוּ וַ/יַּנִּחֻ֖/הוּ מִ/ח֥וּץ לָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vytmhmh vychzqv h'nshym bydv vbyd 'shtv vbyd shty bntyv bchmlt yhvh 'lyv vyts'hv vynchhv mchvts l'yr
verses.translation: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כְ/הוֹצִיאָ֨/ם אֹתָ֜/ם הַ/ח֗וּצָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט עַל נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ אַל תַּבִּ֣יט אַחֲרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּ/כָל הַ/כִּכָּ֑ר הָ/הָ֥רָ/ה הִמָּלֵ֖ט פֶּן תִּסָּפֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khhvtsy'm 'tm hchvtsh vy'mr hmlt 'l npshkh 'l tbyt 'chrykh v'l t'md bkhl hkhkhr hhrh hmlt pn tsph
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹט אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אַל נָ֖א אֲדֹנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lvt 'lhm 'l n' 'dny
verses.translation: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֠א מָצָ֨א עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ חֵן֮ בְּ/עֵינֶי/ךָ֒ וַ/תַּגְדֵּ֣ל חַסְדְּ/ךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ עִמָּדִ֔/י לְ/הַחֲי֖וֹת אֶת נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֗י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לְ/הִמָּלֵ֣ט הָ/הָ֔רָ/ה פֶּן תִּדְבָּקַ֥/נִי הָ/רָעָ֖ה וָ/מַֽתִּי
verses.translit: hnh n' mts' 'bdkh chn b'ynykh vtgdl chsdkh 'shr 'shyt 'mdy lhchyvt 't npshy v'nkhy l' 'vkhl lhmlt hhrh pn tdbqny hr'h vmty
verses.translation: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֠א הָ/עִ֨יר הַ/זֹּ֧את קְרֹבָ֛ה לָ/נ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּ/ה וְ/הִ֣יא מִצְעָ֑ר אִמָּלְטָ֨ה נָּ֜א שָׁ֗מָּ/ה הֲ/לֹ֥א מִצְעָ֛ר הִ֖וא וּ/תְחִ֥י נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: hnh n' h'yr hz't qrbh lnvs shmh vhy' mts'r 'mlth n' shmh hl' mts'r hv' vtchy npshy
verses.translation: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, ( is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו הִנֵּה֙ נָשָׂ֣אתִי פָנֶ֔י/ךָ גַּ֖ם לַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י הָפְכִּ֥/י אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv hnh nsh'ty pnykh gm ldbr hzh lblty hpkhy 't h'yr 'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

verses.original: מַהֵר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט שָׁ֔מָּ/ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת דָּבָ֔ר עַד בֹּאֲ/ךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּ/ה עַל כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם הָ/עִ֖יר צֽוֹעַר
verses.translit: mhr hmlt shmh khy l' 'vkhl l'shvt dbr 'd b'kh shmh 'l khn qr' shm h'yr tsv'r
verses.translation: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

verses.original: הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ יָצָ֣א עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/ל֖וֹט בָּ֥א צֹֽעֲרָ/ה
verses.translit: hshmsh yts' 'l h'rts vlvt b' ts'rh
verses.translation: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה הִמְטִ֧יר עַל סְדֹ֛ם וְ/עַל עֲמֹרָ֖ה גָּפְרִ֣ית וָ/אֵ֑שׁ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה מִן הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhvh hmtyr 'l sdm v'l 'mrh gpryt v'sh m't yhvh mn hshmym
verses.translation: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔ל וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל הַ/כִּכָּ֑ר וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הֶ/עָרִ֔ים וְ/צֶ֖מַח הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhpkh 't h'rym h'l v't khl hkhkhr v't khl yshby h'rym vtsmch h'dmh
verses.translation: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

verses.original: וַ/תַּבֵּ֥ט אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ מֵ/אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וַ/תְּהִ֖י נְצִ֥יב מֶֽלַח
verses.translit: vtbt 'shtv m'chryv vthy ntsyb mlch
verses.translation: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר אֶל הַ֨/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם אֶת פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'brhm bbqr 'l hmqvm 'shr 'md shm 't pny yhvh
verses.translation: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD :

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁקֵ֗ף עַל פְּנֵ֤י סְדֹם֙ וַ/עֲמֹרָ֔ה וְ/עַֽל כָּל פְּנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/כִּכָּ֑ר וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה עָלָה֙ קִיטֹ֣ר הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כְּ/קִיטֹ֖ר הַ/כִּבְשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vyshqf 'l pny sdm v'mrh v'l khl pny 'rts hkhkhr vyr' vhnh 'lh qytr h'rts khqytr hkhbshn
verses.translation: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/שַׁחֵ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת עָרֵ֣י הַ/כִּכָּ֔ר וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶת לוֹט֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/הֲפֵכָ֔ה בַּ/הֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁ֥ב בָּ/הֵ֖ן לֽוֹט
verses.translit: vyhy bshcht 'lhym 't 'ry hkhkhr vyzkhr 'lhym 't 'brhm vyshlch 't lvt mtvkh hhpkhh bhpkh 't h'rym 'shr yshb bhn lvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַל֩ ל֨וֹט מִ/צּ֜וֹעַר וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּ/הָ֗ר וּ/שְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת בְּ/צ֑וֹעַר וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בַּ/מְּעָרָ֔ה ה֖וּא וּ/שְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'l lvt mtsv'r vyshb bhr vshty bntyv 'mv khy yr' lshbt btsv'r vyshb bm'rh hv' vshty bntyv
verses.translation: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר הַ/בְּכִירָ֛ה אֶל הַ/צְּעִירָ֖ה אָבִ֣י/נוּ זָקֵ֑ן וְ/אִ֨ישׁ אֵ֤ין בָּ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לָ/ב֣וֹא עָלֵ֔י/נוּ כְּ/דֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vt'mr hbkhyrh 'l hts'yrh 'bynv zqn v'ysh 'yn b'rts lbv' 'lynv khdrkh khl h'rts
verses.translation: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

verses.original: לְכָ֨/ה נַשְׁקֶ֧ה אֶת אָבִ֛י/נוּ יַ֖יִן וְ/נִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה עִמּ֑/וֹ וּ/נְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵ/אָבִ֖י/נוּ זָֽרַע
verses.translit: lkhh nshqh 't 'bynv yyn vnshkhbh 'mv vnchyh m'bynv zr'
verses.translation: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.original: וַ/תַּשְׁקֶ֧יןָ אֶת אֲבִי/הֶ֛ן יַ֖יִן בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה ה֑וּא וַ/תָּבֹ֤א הַ/בְּכִירָה֙ וַ/תִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אֶת אָבִ֔י/הָ וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֥ע בְּ/שִׁכְבָ֖/הּ וּ/בְ/קׄוּמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtshqyn 't 'byhn yyn blylh hv' vtb' hbkhyrh vtshkhb 't 'byh vl' yd' bshkhbh vbqvmh
verses.translation: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/בְּכִירָה֙ אֶל הַ/צְּעִירָ֔ה הֵן שָׁכַ֥בְתִּי אֶ֖מֶשׁ אֶת אָבִ֑/י נַשְׁקֶ֨/נּוּ יַ֜יִן גַּם הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה וּ/בֹ֨אִי֙ שִׁכְבִ֣י עִמּ֔/וֹ וּ/נְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵ/אָבִ֖י/נוּ זָֽרַע
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vt'mr hbkhyrh 'l hts'yrh hn shkhbty 'msh 't 'by nshqnv yyn gm hlylh vb'y shkhby 'mv vnchyh m'bynv zr'
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.original: וַ/תַּשְׁקֶ֜יןָ גַּ֣ם בַּ/לַּ֧יְלָה הַ/ה֛וּא אֶת אֲבִי/הֶ֖ן יָ֑יִן וַ/תָּ֤קָם הַ/צְּעִירָה֙ וַ/תִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֥ע בְּ/שִׁכְבָ֖/הּ וּ/בְ/קֻמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtshqyn gm blylh hhv' 't 'byhn yyn vtqm hts'yrh vtshkhb 'mv vl' yd' bshkhbh vbqmh
verses.translation: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּהֲרֶ֛יןָ שְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֽוֹת ל֖וֹט מֵ/אֲבִי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vthryn shty bnvt lvt m'byhn
verses.translation: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤לֶד הַ/בְּכִירָה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ מוֹאָ֑ב ה֥וּא אֲבִֽי מוֹאָ֖ב עַד הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vtld hbkhyrh bn vtqr' shmv mv'b hv' 'by mv'b 'd hyvm
verses.translation: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/צְּעִירָ֤ה גַם הִוא֙ יָ֣לְדָה בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ בֶּן עַמִּ֑י ה֛וּא אֲבִ֥י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן עַד הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vhts'yrh gm hv' yldh bn vtqr' shmv bn 'my hv' 'by bny 'mvn 'd hyvm
verses.translation: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֨ע מִ/שָּׁ֤ם אַבְרָהָם֙ אַ֣רְצָ/ה הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב בֵּין קָדֵ֖שׁ וּ/בֵ֣ין שׁ֑וּר וַ/יָּ֖גָר בִּ/גְרָֽר
verses.translit: vys' mshm 'brhm 'rtsh hngb vyshb byn qdsh vbyn shvr vygr bgrr
verses.translation: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ אֲחֹ֣תִ/י הִ֑וא וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲבִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּרָ֔ר וַ/יִּקַּ֖ח אֶת שָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'l shrh 'shtv 'chty hv' vyshlch 'bymlkh mlkh grr vyqch 't shrh
verses.translation: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בַּ/חֲל֣וֹם הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ הִנְּ/ךָ֥ מֵת֙ עַל הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה אֲשֶׁר לָקַ֔חְתָּ וְ/הִ֖וא בְּעֻ֥לַת בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhym 'l 'bymlkh bchlvm hlylh vy'mr lv hnkh mt 'l h'shh 'shr lqcht vhv' b'lt b'l
verses.translation: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ לֹ֥א קָרַ֖ב אֵלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֕/י הֲ/ג֥וֹי גַּם צַדִּ֖יק תַּהֲרֹֽג
verses.translit: v'bymlkh l' qrb 'lyh vy'mr 'dny hgvy gm tsdyq thrg
verses.translation: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֨א ה֤וּא אָֽמַר לִ/י֙ אֲחֹ֣תִ/י הִ֔וא וְ/הִֽיא גַם הִ֥וא אָֽמְרָ֖ה אָחִ֣/י ה֑וּא בְּ/תָם לְבָבִ֛/י וּ/בְ/נִקְיֹ֥ן כַּפַּ֖/י עָשִׂ֥יתִי זֹֽאת
verses.translit: hl' hv' 'mr ly 'chty hv' vhy' gm hv' 'mrh 'chy hv' btm lbby vbnqyn khpy 'shyty z't
verses.translation: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלָ֨י/ו הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים בַּ/חֲלֹ֗ם גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ כִּ֤י בְ/תָם לְבָבְ/ךָ֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּ֔את וָ/אֶחְשֹׂ֧ךְ גַּם אָנֹכִ֛י אֽוֹתְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/חֲטוֹ לִ֑/י עַל כֵּ֥ן לֹא נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לִ/נְגֹּ֥עַ אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv h'lhym bchlm gm 'nkhy yd'ty khy btm lbbkh 'shyt z't v'chshkh gm 'nkhy 'vtkh mchtv ly 'l khn l' nttykh lng' 'lyh
verses.translation: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הָשֵׁ֤ב אֵֽשֶׁת הָ/אִישׁ֙ כִּֽי נָבִ֣יא ה֔וּא וְ/יִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל בַּֽעַדְ/ךָ֖ וֶֽ/חְיֵ֑ה וְ/אִם אֵֽינְ/ךָ֣ מֵשִׁ֗יב דַּ֚ע כִּי מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת אַתָּ֖ה וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'th hshb 'sht h'ysh khy nby' hv' vytpll b'dkh vchyh v'm 'ynkh mshyb d' khy mvt tmvt 'th vkhl 'shr lkh
verses.translation: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ לְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּֽירְא֥וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'bymlkh bbqr vyqr' lkhl 'bdyv vydbr 't khl hdbrym h'lh b'znyhm vyyr'v h'nshym m'd
verses.translation: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֗ם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜/וֹ מֶֽה עָשִׂ֤יתָ לָּ֨/נוּ֙ וּ/מֶֽה חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔/ךְ כִּֽי הֵבֵ֧אתָ עָלַ֛/י וְ/עַל מַמְלַכְתִּ֖/י חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה מַעֲשִׂים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יֵֽעָשׂ֔וּ עָשִׂ֖יתָ עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyqr' 'bymlkh l'brhm vy'mr lv mh 'shyt lnv vmh cht'ty lkh khy hb't 'ly v'l mmlkhty cht'h gdlh m'shym 'shr l' y'shv 'shyt 'mdy
verses.translation: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה רָאִ֔יתָ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh 'l 'brhm mh r'yt khy 'shyt 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי רַ֚ק אֵין יִרְאַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/הֲרָג֖וּ/נִי עַל דְּבַ֥ר אִשְׁתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm khy 'mrty rq 'yn yr't 'lhym bmqvm hzh vhrgvny 'l dbr 'shty
verses.translation: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אָמְנָ֗ה אֲחֹתִ֤/י בַת אָבִ/י֙ הִ֔וא אַ֖ךְ לֹ֣א בַת אִמִּ֑/י וַ/תְּהִי לִ֖/י לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vgm 'mnh 'chty bt 'by hv' 'kh l' bt 'my vthy ly l'shh
verses.translation: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְע֣וּ אֹתִ֗/י אֱלֹהִים֮ מִ/בֵּ֣ית אָבִ/י֒ וָ/אֹמַ֣ר לָ֔/הּ זֶ֣ה חַסְדֵּ֔/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשִׂ֖י עִמָּדִ֑/י אֶ֤ל כָּל הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּ/ה אִמְרִי לִ֖/י אָחִ֥/י הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr ht'v 'ty 'lhym mbyt 'by v'mr lh zh chsdkh 'shr t'shy 'mdy 'l khl hmqvm 'shr nbv' shmh 'mry ly 'chy hv'
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֗ר וַ/עֲבָדִים֙ וּ/שְׁפָחֹ֔ת וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן לְ/אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֣שֶׁב ל֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch 'bymlkh ts'n vbqr v'bdym vshpcht vytn l'brhm vyshb lv 't shrh 'shtv
verses.translation: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּ֥ה אַרְצִ֖/י לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ בַּ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ שֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh hnh 'rtsy lpnykh btvb b'ynykh shb
verses.translation: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שָׂרָ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֜תִּי אֶ֤לֶף כֶּ֨סֶף֙ לְ/אָחִ֔י/ךְ הִנֵּ֤ה הוּא לָ/ךְ֙ כְּס֣וּת עֵינַ֔יִם לְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑/ךְ וְ/אֵ֥ת כֹּ֖ל וְ/נֹכָֽחַת
verses.translit: vlshrh 'mr hnh ntty 'lf khsf l'chykh hnh hv' lkh khsvt 'ynym lkhl 'shr 'tkh v't khl vnkhcht
verses.translation: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יִּרְפָּ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת אֲבִימֶ֧לֶךְ וְ/אֶת אִשְׁתּ֛/וֹ וְ/אַמְהֹתָ֖י/ו וַ/יֵּלֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: vytpll 'brhm 'l h'lhym vyrp' 'lhym 't 'bymlkh v't 'shtv v'mhtyv vyldv
verses.translation: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children .

verses.original: כִּֽי עָצֹ֤ר עָצַר֙ יְהוָ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד כָּל רֶ֖חֶם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל דְּבַ֥ר שָׂרָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: khy 'tsr 'tsr yhvh b'd khl rchm lbyt 'bymlkh 'l dbr shrh 'sht 'brhm
verses.translation: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֛ה פָּקַ֥ד אֶת שָׂרָ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמָ֑ר וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוָ֛ה לְ/שָׂרָ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyhvh pqd 't shrh kh'shr 'mr vy'sh yhvh lshrh kh'shr dbr
verses.translation: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

verses.original: וַ/תַּהַר֩ וַ/תֵּ֨לֶד שָׂרָ֧ה לְ/אַבְרָהָ֛ם בֵּ֖ן לִ/זְקֻנָ֑י/ו לַ/מּוֹעֵ֕ד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֹת֖/וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vthr vtld shrh l'brhm bn lzqnyv lmv'd 'shr dbr 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶֽת שֶׁם בְּנ֧/וֹ הַ/נּֽוֹלַד ל֛/וֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּ֥/וֹ שָׂרָ֖ה יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: vyqr' 'brhm 't shm bnv hnvld lv 'shr yldh lv shrh ytschq
verses.translation: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤מָל אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔/וֹ בֶּן שְׁמֹנַ֖ת יָמִ֑ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyml 'brhm 't ytschq bnv bn shmnt ymym kh'shr tsvh 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְרָהָ֖ם בֶּן מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/הִוָּ֣לֶד ל֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֥ק בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'brhm bn m't shnh bhvld lv 't ytschq bnv
verses.translation: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר שָׂרָ֔ה צְחֹ֕ק עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖/י אֱלֹהִ֑ים כָּל הַ/שֹּׁמֵ֖עַ יִֽצְחַק לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr shrh tschq 'shh ly 'lhym khl hshm' ytschq ly
verses.translation: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֤י מִלֵּל֙ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֔ם הֵינִ֥יקָה בָנִ֖ים שָׂרָ֑ה כִּֽי יָלַ֥דְתִּי בֵ֖ן לִ/זְקֻנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vt'mr my mll l'brhm hynyqh bnym shrh khy yldty bn lzqnyv
verses.translation: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְדַּ֥ל הַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וַ/יִּגָּמַ֑ל וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ אַבְרָהָם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה גָד֔וֹל בְּ/י֖וֹם הִגָּמֵ֥ל אֶת יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: vygdl hyld vygml vy'sh 'brhm mshth gdvl byvm hgml 't ytschq
verses.translation: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא שָׂרָ֜ה אֶֽת בֶּן הָגָ֧ר הַ/מִּצְרִ֛ית אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָ֥ה לְ/אַבְרָהָ֖ם מְצַחֵֽק
verses.translit: vtr' shrh 't bn hgr hmtsryt 'shr yldh l'brhm mtschq
verses.translation: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֔ם גָּרֵ֛שׁ הָ/אָמָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/אֶת בְּנָ֑/הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִירַשׁ֙ בֶּן הָ/אָמָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את עִם בְּנִ֖/י עִם יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: vt'mr l'brhm grsh h'mh hz't v't bnh khy l' yyrsh bn h'mh hz't 'm bny 'm ytschq
verses.translation: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧רַע הַ/דָּבָ֛ר מְאֹ֖ד בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֥ת בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' hdbr m'd b'yny 'brhm 'l 'vdt bnv
verses.translation: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל אַבְרָהָ֗ם אַל יֵרַ֤ע בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עַל הַ/נַּ֣עַר וְ/עַל אֲמָתֶ֔/ךָ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קֹלָ֑/הּ כִּ֣י בְ/יִצְחָ֔ק יִקָּרֵ֥א לְ/ךָ֖ זָֽרַע
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l 'brhm 'l yr' b'ynykh 'l hn'r v'l 'mtkh khl 'shr t'mr 'lykh shrh shm' bqlh khy bytschq yqr' lkh zr'
verses.translation: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת בֶּן הָ/אָמָ֖ה לְ/ג֣וֹי אֲשִׂימֶ֑/נּוּ כִּ֥י זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vgm 't bn h'mh lgvy 'shymnv khy zr'kh hv'
verses.translation: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם אַבְרָהָ֣ם בַּ/בֹּ֡קֶר וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח לֶחֶם֩ וְ/חֵ֨מַת מַ֜יִם וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל הָ֠גָר שָׂ֧ם עַל שִׁכְמָ֛/הּ וְ/אֶת הַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֶ֑/הָ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶךְ וַ/תֵּ֔תַע בְּ/מִדְבַּ֖ר בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'brhm bbqr vyqch lchm vchmt mym vytn 'l hgr shm 'l shkhmh v't hyld vyshlchh vtlkh vtt' bmdbr b'r shb'
verses.translation: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְל֥וּ הַ/מַּ֖יִם מִן הַ/חֵ֑מֶת וַ/תַּשְׁלֵ֣ךְ אֶת הַ/יֶּ֔לֶד תַּ֖חַת אַחַ֥ד הַ/שִּׂיחִֽם
verses.translit: vykhlv hmym mn hchmt vtshlkh 't hyld tcht 'chd hshychm
verses.translation: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּלֶךְ֩ וַ/תֵּ֨שֶׁב לָ֜/הּ מִ/נֶּ֗גֶד הַרְחֵק֙ כִּ/מְטַחֲוֵ֣י קֶ֔שֶׁת כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֔ה אַל אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּ/מ֣וֹת הַ/יָּ֑לֶד וַ/תֵּ֣שֶׁב מִ/נֶּ֔גֶד וַ/תִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת קֹלָ֖/הּ וַ/תֵּֽבְךְּ
verses.translit: vtlkh vtshb lh mngd hrchq khmtchvy qsht khy 'mrh 'l 'r'h bmvt hyld vtshb mngd vtsh' 't qlh vtbkh
verses.translation: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice, and wept.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת ק֣וֹל הַ/נַּעַר֒ וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶל הָגָר֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖/הּ מַה לָּ֣/ךְ הָגָ֑ר אַל תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי שָׁמַ֧ע אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל ק֥וֹל הַ/נַּ֖עַר בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּא שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshm' 'lhym 't qvl hn'r vyqr' ml'kh 'lhym 'l hgr mn hshmym vy'mr lh mh lkh hgr 'l tyr'y khy shm' 'lhym 'l qvl hn'r b'shr hv' shm
verses.translation: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .

verses.original: ק֚וּמִי שְׂאִ֣י אֶת הַ/נַּ֔עַר וְ/הַחֲזִ֥יקִי אֶת יָדֵ֖/ךְ בּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי לְ/ג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִׂימֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: qvmy sh'y 't hn'r vhchzyqy 't ydkh bv khy lgvy gdvl 'shymnv
verses.translation: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְקַ֤ח אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת עֵינֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תֵּ֖רֶא בְּאֵ֣ר מָ֑יִם וַ/תֵּ֜לֶךְ וַ/תְּמַלֵּ֤א אֶת הַ/חֵ֨מֶת֙ מַ֔יִם וַ/תַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת הַ/נָּֽעַר
verses.translit: vypqch 'lhym 't 'ynyh vtr' b'r mym vtlkh vtml' 't hchmt mym vtshq 't hn'r
verses.translation: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הַ/נַּ֖עַר וַ/יִּגְדָּ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וַ/יְהִ֖י רֹבֶ֥ה קַשָּֽׁת
verses.translit: vyhy 'lhym 't hn'r vygdl vyshb bmdbr vyhy rbh qsht
verses.translation: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/מִדְבַּ֣ר פָּארָ֑ן וַ/תִּֽקַּֽח ל֥/וֹ אִמּ֛/וֹ אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshb bmdbr p'rn vtqch lv 'mv 'shh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔וא וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּ/פִיכֹל֙ שַׂר צְבָא֔/וֹ אֶל אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עִמְּ/ךָ֔ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyhy b't hhv' vy'mr 'bymlkh vpykhl shr tsb'v 'l 'brhm l'mr 'lhym 'mkh bkhl 'shr 'th 'shh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֨בְעָ/ה לִּ֤/י בֵֽ/אלֹהִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה אִם תִּשְׁקֹ֣ר לִ֔/י וּ/לְ/נִינִ֖/י וּ/לְ/נֶכְדִּ֑/י כַּ/חֶ֜סֶד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֤יתִי עִמְּ/ךָ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עִמָּדִ֔/י וְ/עִם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר גַּ֥רְתָּה בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'th hshb'h ly b'lhym hnh 'm tshqr ly vlnyny vlnkhdy khchsd 'shr 'shyty 'mkh t'shh 'mdy v'm h'rts 'shr grth bh
verses.translation: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אָנֹכִ֖י אִשָּׁבֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'nkhy 'shb'
verses.translation: And Abraham said, I will swear.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹכִ֥חַ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל אֹדוֹת֙ בְּאֵ֣ר הַ/מַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּזְל֖וּ עַבְדֵ֥י אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vhvkhch 'brhm 't 'bymlkh 'l 'dvt b'r hmym 'shr gzlv 'bdy 'bymlkh
verses.translation: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִ֥י עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/גַם אַתָּ֞ה לֹא הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֗/י וְ/גַ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בִּלְתִּ֥י הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh l' yd'ty my 'shh 't hdbr hzh vgm 'th l' hgdt ly vgm 'nkhy l' shm'ty blty hyvm
verses.translation: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it , but to day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֔ר וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן לַ/אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vyqch 'brhm ts'n vbqr vytn l'bymlkh vykhrtv shnyhm bryt
verses.translation: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֵּ֣ב אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶת שֶׁ֛בַע כִּבְשֹׂ֥ת הַ/צֹּ֖אן לְ/בַדְּ/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vytsb 'brhm 't shb' khbsht hts'n lbdhn
verses.translation: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה שֶׁ֤בַע כְּבָשֹׂת֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצַּ֖בְתָּ לְ/בַדָּֽ/נָה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh 'l 'brhm mh hnh shb' khbsht h'lh 'shr htsbt lbdnh
verses.translation: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֚י אֶת שֶׁ֣בַע כְּבָשֹׂ֔ת תִּקַּ֖ח מִ/יָּדִ֑/י בַּ/עֲבוּר֙ תִּֽהְיֶה לִּ֣/י לְ/עֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י חָפַ֖רְתִּי אֶת הַ/בְּאֵ֥ר הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr khy 't shb' khbsht tqch mydy b'bvr thyh ly l'dh khy chprty 't hb'r hz't
verses.translation: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א לַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ם נִשְׁבְּע֖וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l khn qr' lmqvm hhv' b'r shb' khy shm nshb'v shnyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרְת֥וּ בְרִ֖ית בִּ/בְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַ/יָּ֣קָם אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּ/פִיכֹל֙ שַׂר צְבָא֔/וֹ וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vykhrtv bryt bb'r shb' vyqm 'bymlkh vpykhl shr tsb'v vyshbv 'l 'rts plshtym
verses.translation: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יִּטַּ֥ע אֶ֖שֶׁל בִּ/בְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַ/יִּ֨קְרָא שָׁ֔ם בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵ֥ל עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vyt' 'shl bb'r shb' vyqr' shm bshm yhvh 'l 'vlm
verses.translation: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD , the everlasting God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧גָר אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vygr 'brhm b'rts plshtym ymym rbym
verses.translation: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים נִסָּ֖ה אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִ/י
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh vh'lhym nsh 't 'brhm vy'mr 'lyv 'brhm vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר קַח נָ֠א אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֨ אֶת יְחִֽידְ/ךָ֤ אֲשֶׁר אָהַ֨בְתָּ֙ אֶת יִצְחָ֔ק וְ/לֶךְ לְ/ךָ֔ אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/מֹּרִיָּ֑ה וְ/הַעֲלֵ֤/הוּ שָׁם֙ לְ/עֹלָ֔ה עַ֚ל אַחַ֣ד הֶֽ/הָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr qch n' 't bnkh 't ychydkh 'shr 'hbt 't ytschq vlkh lkh 'l 'rts hmryh vh'lhv shm l'lh 'l 'chd hhrym 'shr 'mr 'lykh
verses.translation: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם אַבְרָהָ֜ם בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַֽ/יַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ אֶת חֲמֹר֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת שְׁנֵ֤י נְעָרָי/ו֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑/וֹ וַ/יְבַקַּע֙ עֲצֵ֣י עֹלָ֔ה וַ/יָּ֣קָם וַ/יֵּ֔לֶךְ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר אָֽמַר ל֥/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'brhm bbqr vychbsh 't chmrv vyqch 't shny n'ryv 'tv v't ytschq bnv vybq' 'tsy 'lh vyqm vylkh 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mr lv h'lhym
verses.translation: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א אַבְרָהָ֧ם אֶת עֵינָ֛י/ו וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֶת הַ/מָּק֖וֹם מֵ/רָחֹֽק
verses.translit: byvm hshlyshy vysh' 'brhm 't 'ynyv vyr' 't hmqvm mrchq
verses.translation: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶל נְעָרָ֗י/ו שְׁבוּ לָ/כֶ֥ם פֹּה֙ עִֽם הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר וַ/אֲנִ֣י וְ/הַ/נַּ֔עַר נֵלְכָ֖ה עַד כֹּ֑ה וְ/נִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְ/נָשׁ֥וּבָה אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'l n'ryv shbv lkhm ph 'm hchmvr v'ny vhn'r nlkhh 'd khh vnshtchvh vnshvbh 'lykhm
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת עֲצֵ֣י הָ/עֹלָ֗ה וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם֙ עַל יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ אֶת הָ/אֵ֖שׁ וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מַּאֲכֶ֑לֶת וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: vyqch 'brhm 't 'tsy h'lh vyshm 'l ytschq bnv vyqch bydv 't h'sh v't hm'khlt vylkhv shnyhm ychdv
verses.translation: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יִצְחָ֜ק אֶל אַבְרָהָ֤ם אָבִי/ו֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֔/י וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֶּ֣נִּֽ/י בְנִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה הָ/אֵשׁ֙ וְ/הָ֣/עֵצִ֔ים וְ/אַיֵּ֥ה הַ/שֶּׂ֖ה לְ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr ytschq 'l 'brhm 'byv vy'mr 'by vy'mr hnny bny vy'mr hnh h'sh vh'tsym v'yh hshh l'lh
verses.translation: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֱלֹהִ֞ים יִרְאֶה לּ֥/וֹ הַ/שֶּׂ֛ה לְ/עֹלָ֖ה בְּנִ֑/י וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'lhym yr'h lv hshh l'lh bny vylkhv shnyhm ychdv
verses.translation: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ אֶֽל הַ/מָּקוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר ל֣/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִים֒ וַ/יִּ֨בֶן שָׁ֤ם אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽ/יַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת הָ/עֵצִ֑ים וַֽ/יַּעֲקֹד֙ אֶת יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם אֹת/וֹ֙ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ מִ/מַּ֖עַל לָ/עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mr lv h'lhym vybn shm 'brhm 't hmzbch vy'rkh 't h'tsym vy'qd 't ytschq bnv vyshm 'tv 'l hmzbch mm'l l'tsym
verses.translation: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֖ח אֶת הַֽ/מַּאֲכֶ֑לֶת לִ/שְׁחֹ֖ט אֶת בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'brhm 't ydv vyqch 't hm'khlt lshcht 't bnv
verses.translation: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֜י/ו מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֣ם אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִ/י
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lyv ml'kh yhvh mn hshmym vy'mr 'brhm 'brhm vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אַל תִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ אֶל הַ/נַּ֔עַר וְ/אַל תַּ֥עַשׂ ל֖/וֹ מְא֑וּמָּה כִּ֣י עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי יְרֵ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אַ֔תָּה וְ/לֹ֥א חָשַׂ֛כְתָּ אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֥ אֶת יְחִידְ/ךָ֖ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l tshlch ydkh 'l hn'r v'l t'sh lv m'vmh khy 'th yd'ty khy yr' 'lhym 'th vl' chshkht 't bnkh 't ychydkh mmny
verses.translation: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּרְא֙ וְ/הִנֵּה אַ֔יִל אַחַ֕ר נֶאֱחַ֥ז בַּ/סְּבַ֖ךְ בְּ/קַרְנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ אַבְרָהָם֙ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת הָ/אַ֔יִל וַ/יַּעֲלֵ֥/הוּ לְ/עֹלָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysh' 'brhm 't 'ynyv vyr' vhnh 'yl 'chr n'chz bsbkh bqrnyv vylkh 'brhm vyqch 't h'yl vy'lhv l'lh tcht bnv
verses.translation: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א אַבְרָהָ֛ם שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא יְהוָ֣ה יִרְאֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר הַ/יּ֔וֹם בְּ/הַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה יֵרָאֶֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' 'brhm shm hmqvm hhv' yhvh yr'h 'shr y'mr hyvm bhr yhvh yr'h
verses.translation: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל אַבְרָהָ֑ם שֵׁנִ֖ית מִן הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqr' ml'kh yhvh 'l 'brhm shnyt mn hshmym
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בִּ֥/י נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֗י יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א חָשַׂ֖כְתָּ אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֥ אֶת יְחִידֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr by nshb'ty n'm yhvh khy y'n 'shr 'shyt 't hdbr hzh vl' chshkht 't bnkh 't ychydkh
verses.translation: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD , for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

verses.original: כִּֽי בָרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֶכְ/ךָ֗ וְ/הַרְבָּ֨ה אַרְבֶּ֤ה אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/כַ/ח֕וֹל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יָּ֑ם וְ/יִרַ֣שׁ זַרְעֲ/ךָ֔ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy brkh 'brkhkh vhrbh 'rbh 't zr'kh khkhvkhby hshmym vkhchvl 'shr 'l shpt hym vyrsh zr'kh 't sh'r 'ybyv
verses.translation: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

verses.original: וְ/הִתְבָּרֲכ֣וּ בְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּ/קֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhtbrkhv bzr'kh khl gvyy h'rts 'qb 'shr shm't bqly
verses.translation: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶל נְעָרָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּקֻ֛מוּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו אֶל בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב אַבְרָהָ֖ם בִּ/בְאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: vyshb 'brhm 'l n'ryv vyqmv vylkhv ychdv 'l b'r shb' vyshb 'brhm bb'r shb'
verses.translation: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/יֻּגַּ֥ד לְ/אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִ֠נֵּה יָלְדָ֨ה מִלְכָּ֥ה גַם הִ֛וא בָּנִ֖ים לְ/נָח֥וֹר אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry hdbrym h'lh vygd l'brhm l'mr hnh yldh mlkhh gm hv' bnym lnchvr 'chykh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

verses.original: אֶת ע֥וּץ בְּכֹר֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת בּ֣וּז אָחִ֑י/ו וְ/אֶת קְמוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֥י אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: 't 'vts bkhrv v't bvz 'chyv v't qmv'l 'by 'rm
verses.translation: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כֶּ֣שֶׂד וְ/אֶת חֲז֔וֹ וְ/אֶת פִּלְדָּ֖שׁ וְ/אֶת יִדְלָ֑ף וְ/אֵ֖ת בְּתוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: v't khshd v't chzv v't pldsh v't ydlf v't btv'l
verses.translation: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

verses.original: וּ/בְתוּאֵ֖ל יָלַ֣ד אֶת רִבְקָ֑ה שְׁמֹנָ֥ה אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה מִלְכָּ֔ה לְ/נָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: vbtv'l yld 't rbqh shmnh 'lh yldh mlkhh lnchvr 'chy 'brhm
verses.translation: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

verses.original: וּ/פִֽילַגְשׁ֖/וֹ וּ/שְׁמָ֣/הּ רְאוּמָ֑ה וַ/תֵּ֤לֶד גַּם הִוא֙ אֶת טֶ֣בַח וְ/אֶת גַּ֔חַם וְ/אֶת תַּ֖חַשׁ וְ/אֶֽת מַעֲכָֽה
verses.translit: vpylgshv vshmh r'vmh vtld gm hv' 't tbch v't gchm v't tchsh v't m'khh
verses.translation: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְיוּ֙ חַיֵּ֣י שָׂרָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֛ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֖י חַיֵּ֥י שָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: vyhyv chyy shrh m'h shnh v'shrym shnh vshb' shnym shny chyy shrh
verses.translation: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֣מָת שָׂרָ֗ה בְּ/קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥וא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם לִ/סְפֹּ֥ד לְ/שָׂרָ֖ה וְ/לִ/בְכֹּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtmt shrh bqryt 'rb' hv' chbrvn b'rts khn'n vyb' 'brhm lspd lshrh vlbkhth
verses.translation: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י מֵת֑/וֹ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל בְּנֵי חֵ֖ת לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyqm 'brhm m'l pny mtv vydbr 'l bny cht l'mr
verses.translation: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

verses.original: גֵּר וְ/תוֹשָׁ֥ב אָנֹכִ֖י עִמָּ/כֶ֑ם תְּנ֨וּ לִ֤/י אֲחֻזַּת קֶ֨בֶר֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶקְבְּרָ֥ה מֵתִ֖/י מִ/לְּ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: gr vtvshb 'nkhy 'mkhm tnv ly 'chzt qbr 'mkhm v'qbrh mty mlpny
verses.translation: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי חֵ֛ת אֶת אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֥ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'nv bny cht 't 'brhm l'mr lv
verses.translation: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

verses.original: שְׁמָעֵ֣/נוּ אֲדֹנִ֗/י נְשִׂ֨יא אֱלֹהִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֔/נוּ בְּ/מִבְחַ֣ר קְבָרֵ֔י/נוּ קְבֹ֖ר אֶת מֵתֶ֑/ךָ אִ֣ישׁ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ אֶת קִבְר֛/וֹ לֹֽא יִכְלֶ֥ה מִמְּ/ךָ֖ מִ/קְּבֹ֥ר מֵתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shm'nv 'dny nshy' 'lhym 'th btvkhnv bmbchr qbrynv qbr 't mtkh 'ysh mmnv 't qbrv l' ykhlh mmkh mqbr mtkh
verses.translation: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧קָם אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לְ/עַם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לִ/בְנֵי חֵֽת
verses.translit: vyqm 'brhm vyshtchv l'm h'rts lbny cht
verses.translation: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתָּ֖/ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִם יֵ֣שׁ אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֗ם לִ/קְבֹּ֤ר אֶת מֵתִ/י֙ מִ/לְּ/פָנַ֔/י שְׁמָע֕וּ/נִי וּ/פִגְעוּ לִ֖/י בְּ/עֶפְר֥וֹן בֶּן צֹֽחַר
verses.translit: vydbr 'tm l'mr 'm ysh 't npshkhm lqbr 't mty mlpny shm'vny vpg'v ly b'prvn bn tschr
verses.translation: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

verses.original: וְ/יִתֶּן לִ֗/י אֶת מְעָרַ֤ת הַ/מַּכְפֵּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה שָׂדֵ֑/הוּ בְּ/כֶ֨סֶף מָלֵ֜א יִתְּנֶ֥/נָּה לִ֛/י בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶ֖ם לַ/אֲחֻזַּת קָֽבֶר
verses.translit: vytn ly 't m'rt hmkhplh 'shr lv 'shr bqtsh shdhv bkhsf ml' ytnnh ly btvkhkhm l'chzt qbr
verses.translation: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

verses.original: וְ/עֶפְר֥וֹן יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵי חֵ֑ת וַ/יַּעַן֩ עֶפְר֨וֹן הַ/חִתִּ֤י אֶת אַבְרָהָם֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י בְנֵי חֵ֔ת לְ/כֹ֛ל בָּאֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר עִיר֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'prvn yshb btvkh bny cht vy'n 'prvn hchty 't 'brhm b'zny bny cht lkhl b'y sh'r 'yrv l'mr
verses.translation: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

verses.original: לֹֽא אֲדֹנִ֣/י שְׁמָעֵ֔/נִי הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔/ךְ וְ/הַ/מְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בּ֖/וֹ לְ/ךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֑י/הָ לְ/עֵינֵ֧י בְנֵי עַמִּ֛/י נְתַתִּ֥י/הָ לָּ֖/ךְ קְבֹ֥ר מֵתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' 'dny shm'ny hshdh ntty lkh vhm'rh 'shr bv lkh nttyh l'yny bny 'my nttyh lkh qbr mtkh
verses.translation: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyshtchv 'brhm lpny 'm h'rts
verses.translation: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל עֶפְר֜וֹן בְּ/אָזְנֵ֤י עַם הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַ֛ךְ אִם אַתָּ֥ה ל֖וּ שְׁמָעֵ֑/נִי נָתַ֜תִּי כֶּ֤סֶף הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ קַ֣ח מִמֶּ֔/נִּי וְ/אֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת מֵתִ֖/י שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vydbr 'l 'prvn b'zny 'm h'rts l'mr 'kh 'm 'th lv shm'ny ntty khsf hshdh qch mmny v'qbrh 't mty shmh
verses.translation: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן עֶפְר֛וֹן אֶת אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֥ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'n 'prvn 't 'brhm l'mr lv
verses.translation: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֣/י שְׁמָעֵ֔/נִי אֶרֶץ֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵאֹ֧ת שֶֽׁקֶל כֶּ֛סֶף בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵֽינְ/ךָ֖ מַה הִ֑וא וְ/אֶת מֵתְ/ךָ֖ קְבֹֽר
verses.translit: 'dny shm'ny 'rts 'rb' m't shql khsf byny vbynkh mh hv' v't mtkh qbr
verses.translation: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע אַבְרָהָם֮ אֶל עֶפְרוֹן֒ וַ/יִּשְׁקֹ֤ל אַבְרָהָם֙ לְ/עֶפְרֹ֔ן אֶת הַ/כֶּ֕סֶף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י בְנֵי חֵ֑ת אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שֶׁ֣קֶל כֶּ֔סֶף עֹבֵ֖ר לַ/סֹּחֵֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' 'brhm 'l 'prvn vyshql 'brhm l'prn 't hkhsf 'shr dbr b'zny bny cht 'rb' m'vt shql khsf 'br lschr
verses.translation: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם שְׂדֵ֣ה עֶפְר֗וֹן אֲשֶׁר֙ בַּ/מַּכְפֵּלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י מַמְרֵ֑א הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וְ/הַ/מְּעָרָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר בּ֔/וֹ וְ/כָל הָ/עֵץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/כָל גְּבֻל֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyqm shdh 'prvn 'shr bmkhplh 'shr lpny mmr' hshdh vhm'rh 'shr bv vkhl h'ts 'shr bshdh 'shr bkhl gblv sbyb
verses.translation: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

verses.original: לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/מִקְנָ֖ה לְ/עֵינֵ֣י בְנֵי חֵ֑ת בְּ/כֹ֖ל בָּאֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר עִירֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'brhm lmqnh l'yny bny cht bkhl b'y sh'r 'yrv
verses.translation: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵן֩ קָבַ֨ר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ אֶל מְעָרַ֞ת שְׂדֵ֧ה הַ/מַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵ֖א הִ֣וא חֶבְר֑וֹן בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: v'chry khn qbr 'brhm 't shrh 'shtv 'l m'rt shdh hmkhplh 'l pny mmr' hv' chbrvn b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם הַ/שָּׂדֶ֜ה וְ/הַ/מְּעָרָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר בּ֛/וֹ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֖ם לַ/אֲחֻזַּת קָ֑בֶר מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵי חֵֽת
verses.translit: vyqm hshdh vhm'rh 'shr bv l'brhm l'chzt qbr m't bny cht
verses.translation: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְרָהָ֣ם זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּ/יָּמִ֑ים וַֽ/יהוָ֛ה בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֶת אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: v'brhm zqn b' bymym vyhvh brkh 't 'brhm bkhl
verses.translation: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶל עַבְדּ/וֹ֙ זְקַ֣ן בֵּית֔/וֹ הַ/מֹּשֵׁ֖ל בְּ/כָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ שִֽׂים נָ֥א יָדְ/ךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת יְרֵכִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'l 'bdv zqn bytv hmshl bkhl 'shr lv shym n' ydkh tcht yrkhy
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

verses.original: וְ/אַשְׁבִּ֣יעֲ/ךָ֔ בַּֽ/יהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֖י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִ/בְנִ֔/י מִ/בְּנוֹת֙ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shby'kh byhvh 'lhy hshmym v'lhy h'rts 'shr l' tqch 'shh lbny mbnvt hkhn'ny 'shr 'nkhy yvshb bqrbv
verses.translation: And I will make thee swear by the LORD , the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

verses.original: כִּ֧י אֶל אַרְצִ֛/י וְ/אֶל מוֹלַדְתִּ֖/י תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִ/בְנִ֥/י לְ/יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: khy 'l 'rtsy v'l mvldty tlkh vlqcht 'shh lbny lytschq
verses.translation: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ הָ/עֶ֔בֶד אוּלַי֙ לֹא תֹאבֶ֣ה הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה לָ/לֶ֥כֶת אַחֲרַ֖/י אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את הֶֽ/הָשֵׁ֤ב אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֔ אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָצָ֥אתָ מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv h'bd 'vly l' t'bh h'shh llkht 'chry 'l h'rts hz't hhshb 'shyb 't bnkh 'l h'rts 'shr yts't mshm
verses.translation: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו אַבְרָהָ֑ם הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֔ פֶּן תָּשִׁ֥יב אֶת בְּנִ֖/י שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'brhm hshmr lkh pn tshyb 't bny shmh
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לְקָחַ֜/נִי מִ/בֵּ֣ית אָבִ/י֮ וּ/מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מֽוֹלַדְתִּ/י֒ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּר לִ֜/י וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע לִ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/זַ֨רְעֲ/ךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את ה֗וּא יִשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכ/וֹ֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֛ה לִ/בְנִ֖/י מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy hshmym 'shr lqchny mbyt 'by vm'rts mvldty v'shr dbr ly v'shr nshb' ly l'mr lzr'kh 'tn 't h'rts hz't hv' yshlch ml'khv lpnykh vlqcht 'shh lbny mshm
verses.translation: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֨א תֹאבֶ֤ה הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת אַחֲרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/נִקִּ֕יתָ מִ/שְּׁבֻעָתִ֖/י זֹ֑את רַ֣ק אֶת בְּנִ֔/י לֹ֥א תָשֵׁ֖ב שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: v'm l' t'bh h'shh llkht 'chrykh vnqyt mshb'ty z't rq 't bny l' tshb shmh
verses.translation: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם הָ/עֶ֨בֶד֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ תַּ֛חַת יֶ֥רֶךְ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשָּׁ֣בַֽע ל֔/וֹ עַל הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshm h'bd 't ydv tcht yrkh 'brhm 'dnyv vyshb' lv 'l hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח הָ֠/עֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָ֨ה גְמַלִּ֜ים מִ/גְּמַלֵּ֤י אֲדֹנָי/ו֙ וַ/יֵּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כָל ט֥וּב אֲדֹנָ֖י/ו בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֗קָם וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל אֲרַ֥ם נַֽהֲרַ֖יִם אֶל עִ֥יר נָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyqch h'bd 'shrh gmlym mgmly 'dnyv vylkh vkhl tvb 'dnyv bydv vyqm vylkh 'l 'rm nhrym 'l 'yr nchvr
verses.translation: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

verses.original: וַ/יַּבְרֵ֧ךְ הַ/גְּמַלִּ֛ים מִ/ח֥וּץ לָ/עִ֖יר אֶל בְּאֵ֣ר הַ/מָּ֑יִם לְ/עֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב לְ/עֵ֖ת צֵ֥את הַ/שֹּׁאֲבֹֽת
verses.translit: vybrkh hgmlym mchvts l'yr 'l b'r hmym l't 'rb l't ts't hsh'bt
verses.translation: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֓ר יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י אַבְרָהָ֔ם הַקְרֵה נָ֥א לְ/פָנַ֖/י הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/עֲשֵׂה חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥/י אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm hqrh n' lpny hyvm v'shh chsd 'm 'dny 'brhm
verses.translation: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל עֵ֣ין הַ/מָּ֑יִם וּ/בְנוֹת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָ/עִ֔יר יֹצְאֹ֖ת לִ/שְׁאֹ֥ב מָֽיִם
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy ntsb 'l 'yn hmym vbnvt 'nshy h'yr yts't lsh'b mym
verses.translation: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹמַ֤ר אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ הַטִּי נָ֤א כַדֵּ/ךְ֙ וְ/אֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְ/אָמְרָ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְ/גַם גְּמַלֶּ֖י/ךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה אֹתָ֤/הּ הֹכַ֨חְתָּ֙ לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/יִצְחָ֔ק וּ/בָ֣/הּ אֵדַ֔ע כִּי עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֶ֖סֶד עִם אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyh hn'r 'shr 'mr 'lyh hty n' khdkh v'shth v'mrh shth vgm gmlykh 'shqh 'th hkhcht l'bdkh lytschq vbh 'd' khy 'shyt chsd 'm 'dny
verses.translation: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי ה֗וּא טֶרֶם֮ כִּלָּ֣ה לְ/דַבֵּר֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה רִבְקָ֣ה יֹצֵ֗את אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֻלְּדָה֙ לִ/בְתוּאֵ֣ל בֶּן מִלְכָּ֔ה אֵ֥שֶׁת נָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְ/כַדָּ֖/הּ עַל שִׁכְמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhy hv' trm khlh ldbr vhnh rbqh yts't 'shr yldh lbtv'l bn mlkhh 'sht nchvr 'chy 'brhm vkhdh 'l shkhmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֗ טֹבַ֤ת מַרְאֶה֙ מְאֹ֔ד בְּתוּלָ֕ה וְ/אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּ֣רֶד הָ/עַ֔יְנָ/ה וַ/תְּמַלֵּ֥א כַדָּ֖/הּ וַ/תָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vhn'r tbt mr'h m'd btvlh v'ysh l' yd'h vtrd h'ynh vtml' khdh vt'l
verses.translation: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥רָץ הָ/עֶ֖בֶד לִ/קְרָאתָ֑/הּ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הַגְמִיאִ֥י/נִי נָ֛א מְעַט מַ֖יִם מִ/כַּדֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyrts h'bd lqr'th vy'mr hgmy'yny n' m't mym mkhdkh
verses.translation: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁתֵ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֑/י וַ/תְּמַהֵ֗ר וַ/תֹּ֧רֶד כַּדָּ֛/הּ עַל יָדָ֖/הּ וַ/תַּשְׁקֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vt'mr shth 'dny vtmhr vtrd khdh 'l ydh vtshqhv
verses.translation: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

verses.original: וַ/תְּכַ֖ל לְ/הַשְׁקֹת֑/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֤ם לִ/גְמַלֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶשְׁאָ֔ב עַ֥ד אִם כִּלּ֖וּ לִ/שְׁתֹּֽת
verses.translit: vtkhl lhshqtv vt'mr gm lgmlykh 'sh'b 'd 'm khlv lshtt
verses.translation: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

verses.original: וַ/תְּמַהֵ֗ר וַ/תְּעַ֤ר כַּדָּ/הּ֙ אֶל הַ/שֹּׁ֔קֶת וַ/תָּ֥רָץ ע֛וֹד אֶֽל הַ/בְּאֵ֖ר לִ/שְׁאֹ֑ב וַ/תִּשְׁאַ֖ב לְ/כָל גְּמַלָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtmhr vt'r khdh 'l hshqt vtrts 'vd 'l hb'r lsh'b vtsh'b lkhl gmlyv
verses.translation: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אִ֥ישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵ֖ה לָ֑/הּ מַחֲרִ֕ישׁ לָ/דַ֗עַת הַֽ/הִצְלִ֧יחַ יְהוָ֛ה דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: vh'ysh msht'h lh mchrysh ld't hhtslych yhvh drkhv 'm l'
verses.translation: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלּ֤וּ הַ/גְּמַלִּים֙ לִ/שְׁתּ֔וֹת וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח הָ/אִישׁ֙ נֶ֣זֶם זָהָ֔ב בֶּ֖קַע מִשְׁקָל֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁנֵ֤י צְמִידִים֙ עַל יָדֶ֔י/הָ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מִשְׁקָלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr khlv hgmlym lshtvt vyqch h'ysh nzm zhb bq' mshqlv vshny tsmydym 'l ydyh 'shrh zhb mshqlm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ בַּת מִ֣י אַ֔תְּ הַגִּ֥ידִי נָ֖א לִ֑/י הֲ/יֵ֧שׁ בֵּית אָבִ֛י/ךְ מָק֥וֹם לָ֖/נוּ לָ/לִֽין
verses.translit: vy'mr bt my 't hgydy n' ly hysh byt 'bykh mqvm lnv llyn
verses.translation: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו בַּת בְּתוּאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי בֶּן מִלְכָּ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְ/נָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv bt btv'l 'nkhy bn mlkhh 'shr yldh lnchvr
verses.translation: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו גַּם תֶּ֥בֶן גַּם מִסְפּ֖וֹא רַ֣ב עִמָּ֑/נוּ גַּם מָק֖וֹם לָ/לֽוּן
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv gm tbn gm mspv' rb 'mnv gm mqvm llvn
verses.translation: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקֹּ֣ד הָ/אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqd h'ysh vyshtchv lyhvh
verses.translation: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא עָזַ֥ב חַסְדּ֛/וֹ וַ/אֲמִתּ֖/וֹ מֵ/עִ֣ם אֲדֹנִ֑/י אָנֹכִ֗י בַּ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ נָחַ֣/נִי יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אֲחֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm 'shr l' 'zb chsdv v'mtv m'm 'dny 'nkhy bdrkh nchny yhvh byt 'chy 'dny
verses.translation: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

verses.translit: vtrts hn'r vtgd lbyt 'mh khdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/רִבְקָ֥ה אָ֖ח וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ לָבָ֑ן וַ/יָּ֨רָץ לָבָ֧ן אֶל הָ/אִ֛ישׁ הַ/ח֖וּצָ/ה אֶל הָ/עָֽיִן
verses.translit: vlrbqh 'ch vshmv lbn vyrts lbn 'l h'ysh hchvtsh 'l h'yn
verses.translation: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִּ/רְאֹ֣ת אֶת הַ/נֶּ֗זֶם וְֽ/אֶת הַ/צְּמִדִים֮ עַל יְדֵ֣י אֲחֹת/וֹ֒ וּ/כְ/שָׁמְע֗/וֹ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֞י רִבְקָ֤ה אֲחֹת/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּֽה דִבֶּ֥ר אֵלַ֖/י הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל הָ/אִ֔ישׁ וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל הַ/גְּמַלִּ֖ים עַל הָ/עָֽיִן
verses.translit: vyhy khr't 't hnzm v't htsmdym 'l ydy 'chtv vkhshm'v 't dbry rbqh 'chtv l'mr khh dbr 'ly h'ysh vyb' 'l h'ysh vhnh 'md 'l hgmlym 'l h'yn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בּ֖וֹא בְּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה לָ֤/מָּה תַעֲמֹד֙ בַּ/ח֔וּץ וְ/אָנֹכִי֙ פִּנִּ֣יתִי הַ/בַּ֔יִת וּ/מָק֖וֹם לַ/גְּמַלִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr bv' brvkh yhvh lmh t'md bchvts v'nkhy pnyty hbyt vmqvm lgmlym
verses.translation: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD ; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הָ/אִישׁ֙ הַ/בַּ֔יְתָ/ה וַ/יְפַתַּ֖ח הַ/גְּמַלִּ֑ים וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן תֶּ֤בֶן וּ/מִסְפּוֹא֙ לַ/גְּמַלִּ֔ים וּ/מַ֨יִם֙ לִ/רְחֹ֣ץ רַגְלָ֔י/ו וְ/רַגְלֵ֥י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' h'ysh hbyth vyptch hgmlym vytn tbn vmspv' lgmlym vmym lrchts rglyv vrgly h'nshym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

verses.original: ו/יישם וַ/יּוּשַׂ֤ם לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לֶ/אֱכֹ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל עַ֥ד אִם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי דְּבָרָ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyyshm vyvshm lpnyv l'khl vy'mr l' 'khl 'd 'm dbrty dbry vy'mr dbr
verses.translation: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bd 'brhm 'nkhy
verses.translation: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.

verses.original: וַ/יהוָ֞ה בֵּרַ֧ךְ אֶת אֲדֹנִ֛/י מְאֹ֖ד וַ/יִּגְדָּ֑ל וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֞/וֹ צֹ֤אן וּ/בָקָר֙ וְ/כֶ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב וַ/עֲבָדִם֙ וּ/שְׁפָחֹ֔ת וּ/גְמַלִּ֖ים וַ/חֲמֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vyhvh brkh 't 'dny m'd vygdl vytn lv ts'n vbqr vkhsf vzhb v'bdm vshpcht vgmlym vchmrym
verses.translation: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֡לֶד שָׂרָה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת אֲדֹנִ֥/י בֵן֙ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י אַחֲרֵ֖י זִקְנָתָ֑/הּ וַ/יִּתֶּן לּ֖/וֹ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtld shrh 'sht 'dny bn l'dny 'chry zqnth vytn lv 't khl 'shr lv
verses.translation: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁבִּעֵ֥/נִי אֲדֹנִ֖/י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹא תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִ/בְנִ֔/י מִ/בְּנוֹת֙ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb'ny 'dny l'mr l' tqch 'shh lbny mbnvt hkhn'ny 'shr 'nkhy yshb b'rtsv
verses.translation: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

verses.original: אִם לֹ֧א אֶל בֵּית אָבִ֛/י תֵּלֵ֖ךְ וְ/אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑/י וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִ/בְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm l' 'l byt 'by tlkh v'l mshpchty vlqcht 'shh lbny
verses.translation: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אֶל אֲדֹנִ֑/י אֻלַ֛י לֹא תֵלֵ֥ךְ הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה אַחֲרָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mr 'l 'dny 'ly l' tlkh h'shh 'chry
verses.translation: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י יְהוָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו יִשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכ֤/וֹ אִתָּ/ךְ֙ וְ/הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֤ אִשָּׁה֙ לִ/בְנִ֔/י מִ/מִּשְׁפַּחְתִּ֖/י וּ/מִ/בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly yhvh 'shr hthlkhty lpnyv yshlch ml'khv 'tkh vhtslych drkhkh vlqcht 'shh lbny mmshpchty vmbyt 'by
verses.translation: And he said unto me, The LORD , before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

verses.original: אָ֤ז תִּנָּקֶה֙ מֵ/אָ֣לָתִ֔/י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑/י וְ/אִם לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ לָ֔/ךְ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ נָקִ֖י מֵ/אָלָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'z tnqh m'lty khy tbv' 'l mshpchty v'm l' ytnv lkh vhyyt nqy m'lty
verses.translation: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one , thou shalt be clear from my oath.

verses.original: וָ/אָבֹ֥א הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֶל הָ/עָ֑יִן וָ/אֹמַ֗ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אִם יֶשְׁ/ךָ נָּא֙ מַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י הֹלֵ֥ךְ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'b' hyvm 'l h'yn v'mr yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm 'm yshkh n' mtslych drkhy 'shr 'nkhy hlkh 'lyh
verses.translation: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל עֵ֣ין הַ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/הָיָ֤ה הָֽ/עַלְמָה֙ הַ/יֹּצֵ֣את לִ/שְׁאֹ֔ב וְ/אָמַרְתִּ֣י אֵלֶ֔י/הָ הַשְׁקִֽי/נִי נָ֥א מְעַט מַ֖יִם מִ/כַּדֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy ntsb 'l 'yn hmym vhyh h'lmh hyts't lsh'b v'mrty 'lyh hshqyny n' m't mym mkhdkh
verses.translation: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water , and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

verses.original: וְ/אָמְרָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ גַּם אַתָּ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְ/גַ֥ם לִ/גְמַלֶּ֖י/ךָ אֶשְׁאָ֑ב הִ֣וא הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הֹכִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לְ/בֶן אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mrh 'ly gm 'th shth vgm lgmlykh 'sh'b hv' h'shh 'shr hkhych yhvh lbn 'dny
verses.translation: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master’s son.

verses.original: אֲנִי֩ טֶ֨רֶם אֲכַלֶּ֜ה לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל לִבִּ֗/י וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה רִבְקָ֤ה יֹצֵאת֙ וְ/כַדָּ֣/הּ עַל שִׁכְמָ֔/הּ וַ/תֵּ֥רֶד הָ/עַ֖יְנָ/ה וַ/תִּשְׁאָ֑ב וָ/אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/הָ הַשְׁקִ֥י/נִי נָֽא
verses.translit: 'ny trm 'khlh ldbr 'l lby vhnh rbqh yts't vkhdh 'l shkhmh vtrd h'ynh vtsh'b v'mr 'lyh hshqyny n'
verses.translation: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

verses.original: וַ/תְּמַהֵ֗ר וַ/תּ֤וֹרֶד כַּדָּ/הּ֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁתֵ֔ה וְ/גַם גְּמַלֶּ֖י/ךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה וָ/אֵ֕שְׁתְּ וְ/גַ֥ם הַ/גְּמַלִּ֖ים הִשְׁקָֽתָה
verses.translit: vtmhr vtvrd khdh m'lyh vt'mr shth vgm gmlykh 'shqh v'sht vgm hgmlym hshqth
verses.translation: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁאַ֣ל אֹתָ֗/הּ וָ/אֹמַר֮ בַּת מִ֣י אַתְּ֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר בַּת בְּתוּאֵל֙ בֶּן נָח֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽלְדָה לּ֖/וֹ מִלְכָּ֑ה וָ/אָשִׂ֤ם הַ/נֶּ֨זֶם֙ עַל אַפָּ֔/הּ וְ/הַ/צְּמִידִ֖ים עַל יָדֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'sh'l 'th v'mr bt my 't vt'mr bt btv'l bn nchvr 'shr yldh lv mlkhh v'shm hnzm 'l 'ph vhtsmydym 'l ydyh
verses.translation: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקֹּ֥ד וָֽ/אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה וָ/אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנְחַ֨/נִי֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אֱמֶ֔ת לָ/קַ֛חַת אֶת בַּת אֲחִ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖/י לִ/בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'qd v'shtchvh lyhvh v'brkh 't yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm 'shr hnchny bdrkh 'mt lqcht 't bt 'chy 'dny lbnv
