verses.translation: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD , and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה אִם יֶשְׁ/כֶ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים חֶ֧סֶד וֶֽ/אֱמֶ֛ת אֶת אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֑/י וְ/אִם לֹ֕א הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔/י וְ/אֶפְנֶ֥ה עַל יָמִ֖ין א֥וֹ עַל שְׂמֹֽאל
verses.translit: v'th 'm yshkhm 'shym chsd v'mt 't 'dny hgydv ly v'm l' hgydv ly v'pnh 'l ymyn 'v 'l shm'l
verses.translation: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן לָבָ֤ן וּ/בְתוּאֵל֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵ/יְהוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א הַ/דָּבָ֑ר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ רַ֥ע אוֹ טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vy'n lbn vbtv'l vy'mrv myhvh yts' hdbr l' nvkhl dbr 'lykh r' 'v tvb
verses.translation: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה רִבְקָ֥ה לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ קַ֣ח וָ/לֵ֑ךְ וּ/תְהִ֤י אִשָּׁה֙ לְ/בֶן אֲדֹנֶ֔י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnh rbqh lpnykh qch vlkh vthy 'shh lbn 'dnykh kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her , and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֛ע עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת דִּבְרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַ֖רְצָ/ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm' 'bd 'brhm 't dbryhm vyshtchv 'rtsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD , bowing himself to the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵ֨א הָ/עֶ֜בֶד כְּלֵי כֶ֨סֶף וּ/כְלֵ֤י זָהָב֙ וּ/בְגָדִ֔ים וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן לְ/רִבְקָ֑ה וּ/מִ֨גְדָּנֹ֔ת נָתַ֥ן לְ/אָחִ֖י/הָ וּ/לְ/אִמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyvts' h'bd khly khsf vkhly zhb vbgdym vytn lrbqh vmgdnt ntn l'chyh vl'mh
verses.translation: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאכְל֣וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֗וּ ה֛וּא וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֖/וֹ וַ/יָּלִ֑ינוּ וַ/יָּק֣וּמוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שַׁלְּחֻ֥/נִי לַֽ/אדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'khlv vyshtv hv' vh'nshym 'shr 'mv vylynv vyqvmv bbqr vy'mr shlchny l'dny
verses.translation: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אָחִ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אִמָּ֔/הּ תֵּשֵׁ֨ב הַ/נַּעֲרָ֥ אִתָּ֛/נוּ יָמִ֖ים א֣וֹ עָשׂ֑וֹר אַחַ֖ר תֵּלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chyh v'mh tshb hn'r 'tnv ymym 'v 'shvr 'chr tlkh
verses.translation: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ אַל תְּאַחֲר֣וּ אֹתִ֔/י וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֑/י שַׁלְּח֕וּ/נִי וְ/אֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽ/אדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm 'l t'chrv 'ty vyhvh htslych drkhy shlchvny v'lkhh l'dny
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ נִקְרָ֣א לַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֑ וְ/נִשְׁאֲלָ֖ה אֶת פִּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv nqr' ln'r vnsh'lh 't pyh
verses.translation: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְא֤וּ לְ/רִבְקָה֙ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/הָ הֲ/תֵלְכִ֖י עִם הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vyqr'v lrbqh vy'mrv 'lyh htlkhy 'm h'ysh hzh vt'mr 'lkh
verses.translation: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת רִבְקָ֥ה אֲחֹתָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת מֵנִקְתָּ֑/הּ וְ/אֶת עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְ/אֶת אֲנָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vyshlchv 't rbqh 'chtm v't mnqth v't 'bd 'brhm v't 'nshyv
verses.translation: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָרֲכ֤וּ אֶת רִבְקָה֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לָ֔/הּ אֲחֹתֵ֕/נוּ אַ֥תְּ הֲיִ֖י לְ/אַלְפֵ֣י רְבָבָ֑ה וְ/יִירַ֣שׁ זַרְעֵ֔/ךְ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר שֹׂנְאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vybrkhv 't rbqh vy'mrv lh 'chtnv 't hyy l'lpy rbbh vyyrsh zr'kh 't sh'r shn'yv
verses.translation: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֨קָם רִבְקָ֜ה וְ/נַעֲרֹתֶ֗י/הָ וַ/תִּרְכַּ֨בְנָה֙ עַל הַ/גְּמַלִּ֔ים וַ/תֵּלַ֖כְנָה אַחֲרֵ֣י הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח הָ/עֶ֛בֶד אֶת רִבְקָ֖ה וַ/יֵּלַֽךְ
verses.translit: vtqm rbqh vn'rtyh vtrkhbnh 'l hgmlym vtlkhnh 'chry h'ysh vyqch h'bd 't rbqh vylkh
verses.translation: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

verses.original: וְ/יִצְחָק֙ בָּ֣א מִ/בּ֔וֹא בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י וְ/ה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/נֶּֽגֶב
verses.translit: vytschq b' mbv' b'r lchy r'y vhv' yvshb b'rts hngb
verses.translation: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק לָ/שׂ֥וּחַ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לִ/פְנ֣וֹת עָ֑רֶב וַ/יִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּ֔רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה גְמַלִּ֖ים בָּאִֽים
verses.translit: vyts' ytschq lshvch bshdh lpnvt 'rb vysh' 'ynyv vyr' vhnh gmlym b'ym
verses.translation: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׂ֤א רִבְקָה֙ אֶת עֵינֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תֵּ֖רֶא אֶת יִצְחָ֑ק וַ/תִּפֹּ֖ל מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/גָּמָֽל
verses.translit: vtsh' rbqh 't 'ynyh vtr' 't ytschq vtpl m'l hgml
verses.translation: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל הָ/עֶ֗בֶד מִֽי הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַלָּזֶה֙ הַ/הֹלֵ֤ךְ בַּ/שָּׂדֶה֙ לִ/קְרָאתֵ֔/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הָ/עֶ֖בֶד ה֣וּא אֲדֹנִ֑/י וַ/תִּקַּ֥ח הַ/צָּעִ֖יף וַ/תִּתְכָּֽס
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l h'bd my h'ysh hlzh hhlkh bshdh lqr'tnv vy'mr h'bd hv' 'dny vtqch hts'yf vttkhs
verses.translation: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפֵּ֥ר הָ/עֶ֖בֶד לְ/יִצְחָ֑ק אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vyspr h'bd lytschq 't khl hdbrym 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִאֶ֣/הָ יִצְחָ֗ק הָ/אֹ֨הֱלָ/ה֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֧ח אֶת רִבְקָ֛ה וַ/תְּהִי ל֥/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֖ה וַ/יֶּאֱהָבֶ֑/הָ וַ/יִּנָּחֵ֥ם יִצְחָ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֥י אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb'h ytschq h'hlh shrh 'mv vyqch 't rbqh vthy lv l'shh vy'hbh vynchm ytschq 'chry 'mv
verses.translation: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧סֶף אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה וּ/שְׁמָ֥/הּ קְטוּרָֽה
verses.translit: vysf 'brhm vyqch 'shh vshmh qtvrh
verses.translation: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד ל֗/וֹ אֶת זִמְרָן֙ וְ/אֶת יָקְשָׁ֔ן וְ/אֶת מְדָ֖ן וְ/אֶת מִדְיָ֑ן וְ/אֶת יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְ/אֶת שֽׁוּחַ
verses.translit: vtld lv 't zmrn v't yqshn v't mdn v't mdyn v't yshbq v't shvch
verses.translation: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

verses.original: וְ/יָקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת שְׁבָ֖א וְ/אֶת דְּדָ֑ן וּ/בְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּ/לְטוּשִׁ֖ים וּ/לְאֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqshn yld 't shb' v't ddn vbny ddn hyv 'shvrm vltvshym vl'mym
verses.translation: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָ/עֵ֨פֶר֙ וַ/חֲנֹ֔ךְ וַ/אֲבִידָ֖ע וְ/אֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה
verses.translit: vbny mdyn 'yph v'pr vchnkh v'byd' v'ld'h khl 'lh bny qtvrh
verses.translation: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ לְ/יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: vytn 'brhm 't khl 'shr lv lytschq
verses.translation: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֤י הַ/פִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן אַבְרָהָ֖ם מַתָּנֹ֑ת וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֞/ם מֵ/עַ֨ל יִצְחָ֤ק בְּנ/וֹ֙ בְּ/עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ חַ֔י קֵ֖דְמָ/ה אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: vlbny hpylgshym 'shr l'brhm ntn 'brhm mtnt vyshlchm m'l ytschq bnv b'vdnv chy qdmh 'l 'rts qdm
verses.translation: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי חַיֵּ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר חָ֑י מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: v'lh ymy shny chyy 'brhm 'shr chy m't shnh vshb'ym shnh vchmsh shnym
verses.translation: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְוַ֨ע וַ/יָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּ/שֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְ/שָׂבֵ֑עַ וַ/יֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vygv' vymt 'brhm bshybh tvbh zqn vshb' vy'sf 'l 'myv
verses.translation: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֜/וֹ יִצְחָ֤ק וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ בָּנָ֔י/ו אֶל מְעָרַ֖ת הַ/מַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֶל שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן צֹ֨חַר֙ הַֽ/חִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא
verses.translit: vyqbrv 'tv ytschq vyshm''l bnyv 'l m'rt hmkhplh 'l shdh 'prn bn tschr hchty 'shr 'l pny mmr'
verses.translation: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

verses.original: הַ/שָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר קָנָ֥ה אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵ/אֵ֣ת בְּנֵי חֵ֑ת שָׁ֛מָּ/ה קֻבַּ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְ/שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hshdh 'shr qnh 'brhm m't bny cht shmh qbr 'brhm vshrh 'shtv
verses.translation: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב יִצְחָ֔ק עִם בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry mvt 'brhm vybrkh 'lhym 't ytschq bnv vyshb ytschq 'm b'r lchy r'y
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֜ה הָגָ֧ר הַ/מִּצְרִ֛ית שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרָ֖ה לְ/אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: v'lh tldt yshm''l bn 'brhm 'shr yldh hgr hmtsryt shpcht shrh l'brhm
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּ/שְׁמֹתָ֖/ם לְ/תוֹלְדֹתָ֑/ם בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָיֹ֔ת וְ/קֵדָ֥ר וְ/אַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּ/מִבְשָֽׂם
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny yshm''l bshmtm ltvldtm bkhr yshm''l nbyt vqdr v'db'l vmbshm
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁמָ֥ע וְ/דוּמָ֖ה וּ/מַשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: vmshm' vdvmh vmsh'
verses.translation: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

verses.original: חֲדַ֣ד וְ/תֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָ/קֵֽדְמָה
verses.translit: chdd vtym' ytvr npysh vqdmh
verses.translation: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/חַצְרֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/טִֽירֹתָ֑/ם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְ/אֻמֹּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'lh hm bny yshm''l v'lh shmtm bchtsryhm vbtyrtm shnym 'shr nshy'm l'mtm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַ/יִּגְוַ֣ע וַ/יָּ֔מָת וַ/יֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'lh shny chyy yshm''l m't shnh vshlshym shnh vshb' shnym vygv' vymt vy'sf 'l 'myv
verses.translation: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽ/חֲוִילָ֜ה עַד שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲ/כָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָ/ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י כָל אֶחָ֖י/ו נָפָֽל
verses.translit: vyshkhnv mchvylh 'd shvr 'shr 'l pny mtsrym b'khh 'shvrh 'l pny khl 'chyv npl
verses.translation: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt ytschq bn 'brhm 'brhm hvlyd 't ytschq
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּ/קַחְתּ֣/וֹ אֶת רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽ/אֲרַמִּ֔י מִ/פַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָ/אֲרַמִּ֖י ל֥/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyhy ytschq bn 'rb'ym shnh bqchtv 't rbqh bt btv'l h'rmy mpdn 'rm 'chvt lbn h'rmy lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לַֽ/יהוָה֙ לְ/נֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַ/יֵּעָ֤תֶר ל/וֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'tr ytschq lyhvh lnkhch 'shtv khy 'qrh hv' vy'tr lv yhvh vthr rbqh 'shtv
verses.translation: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ הַ/בָּנִים֙ בְּ/קִרְבָּ֔/הּ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אִם כֵּ֔ן לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ לִ/דְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytrtstsv hbnym bqrbh vt'mr 'm khn lmh zh 'nkhy vtlkh ldrsh 't yhvh
verses.translation: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗/הּ שְׁנֵ֤י גיים גוֹיִם֙ בְּ/בִטְנֵ֔/ךְ וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִ/מֵּעַ֖יִ/ךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּ/לְאֹם֙ מִ/לְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְ/רַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lh shny gyym gvym bbtnkh vshny l'mym mm'ykh yprdv vl'm ml'm y'mts vrb y'bd ts'yr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖י/הָ לָ/לֶ֑דֶת וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּ/בִטְנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyml'v ymyh lldt vhnh tvmm bbtnh
verses.translation: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א הָ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖/וֹ כְּ/אַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַ/יִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖/וֹ עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: vyts' hr'shvn 'dmvny khlv kh'drt sh'r vyqr'v shmv 'shv
verses.translation: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

verses.original: וְ/אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗י/ו וְ/יָד֤/וֹ אֹחֶ֨זֶת֙ בַּ/עֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/יִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/לֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'chry khn yts' 'chyv vydv 'chzt b'qb 'shv vyqr' shmv y'qb vytschq bn shshym shnh bldt 'tm
verses.translation: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וַ/יְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים
verses.translit: vygdlv hn'rym vyhy 'shv 'ysh yd' tsyd 'ysh shdh vy'qb 'ysh tm yshb 'hlym
verses.translation: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי צַ֣יִד בְּ/פִ֑י/ו וְ/רִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'hb ytschq 't 'shv khy tsyd bpyv vrbqh 'hbt 't y'qb
verses.translation: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַ/יָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וְ/ה֥וּא עָיֵֽף
verses.translit: vyzd y'qb nzyd vyb' 'shv mn hshdh vhv' 'yf
verses.translation: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤/נִי נָא֙ מִן הָ/אָדֹ֤ם הָ/אָדֹם֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא שְׁמ֖/וֹ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv 'l y'qb hl'ytny n' mn h'dm h'dm hzh khy 'yf 'nkhy 'l khn qr' shmv 'dvm
verses.translation: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥/ה כַ/יּ֛וֹם אֶת בְּכֹֽרָתְ/ךָ֖ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb mkhrh khyvm 't bkhrtkh ly
verses.translation: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָ/מ֑וּת וְ/לָ/מָּה זֶּ֥ה לִ֖/י בְּכֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv hnh 'nkhy hvlkh lmvt vlmh zh ly bkhrh
verses.translation: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָ/ה לִּ/י֙ כַּ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת בְּכֹרָת֖/וֹ לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb hshb'h ly khyvm vyshb' lv vymkhr 't bkhrtv ly'qb
verses.translation: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

verses.original: וְ/יַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְ/עֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּ/נְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֣אכַל וַ/יֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַ/יָּ֖קָם וַ/יֵּלַ֑ךְ וַ/יִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת הַ/בְּכֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'qb ntn l'shv lchm vnzyd 'dshym vy'khl vysht vyqm vylkh vybz 'shv 't hbkhrh
verses.translation: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ הָ/רָעָ֣ב הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בִּ/ימֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ יִצְחָ֛ק אֶל אֲבִימֶּ֥לֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים גְּרָֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy r'b b'rts mlbd hr'b hr'shvn 'shr hyh bymy 'brhm vylkh ytschq 'l 'bymlkh mlkh plshtym grrh
verses.translation: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אַל תֵּרֵ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/ה שְׁכֹ֣ן בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv yhvh vy'mr 'l trd mtsrymh shkhn b'rts 'shr 'mr 'lykh
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

verses.original: גּ֚וּר בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמְּ/ךָ֖ וַ/אֲבָרְכֶ֑/ךָּ כִּֽי לְ/ךָ֣ וּֽ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֗ אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת כָּל הָֽ/אֲרָצֹ֣ת הָ/אֵ֔ל וַ/הֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת הַ/שְּׁבֻעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: gvr b'rts hz't v'hyh 'mkh v'brkhkh khy lkh vlzr'kh 'tn 't khl h'rtst h'l vhqmty 't hshb'h 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm 'bykh
verses.translation: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

verses.original: וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֤י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֔ אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/אֲרָצֹ֖ת הָ/אֵ֑ל וְ/הִתְבָּרֲכ֣וּ בְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhrbyty 't zr'kh khkhvkhby hshmym vntty lzr'kh 't khl h'rtst h'l vhtbrkhv bzr'kh khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

verses.original: עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֥ע אַבְרָהָ֖ם בְּ/קֹלִ֑/י וַ/יִּשְׁמֹר֙ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֔/י מִצְוֺתַ֖/י חֻקּוֹתַ֥/י וְ/תוֹרֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'qb 'shr shm' 'brhm bqly vyshmr mshmrty mtsvty chqvty vtvrty
verses.translation: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב יִצְחָ֖ק בִּ/גְרָֽר
verses.translit: vyshb ytschq bgrr
verses.translation: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁאֲל֞וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ לְ/אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲחֹ֣תִ/י הִ֑וא כִּ֤י יָרֵא֙ לֵ/אמֹ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֔/י פֶּן יַֽהַרְגֻ֜/נִי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ עַל רִבְקָ֔ה כִּֽי טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽיא
verses.translit: vysh'lv 'nshy hmqvm l'shtv vy'mr 'chty hv' khy yr' l'mr 'shty pn yhrgny 'nshy hmqvm 'l rbqh khy tvbt mr'h hy'
verses.translation: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ֣י אָֽרְכוּ ל֥/וֹ שָׁם֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וַ/יַּשְׁקֵ֗ף אֲבִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים בְּעַ֖ד הַֽ/חַלּ֑וֹן וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה יִצְחָק֙ מְצַחֵ֔ק אֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khy 'rkhv lv shm hymym vyshqf 'bymlkh mlkh plshtym b'd hchlvn vyr' vhnh ytschq mtschq 't rbqh 'shtv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְ/יִצְחָ֗ק וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַ֣ךְ הִנֵּ֤ה אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֙ הִ֔וא וְ/אֵ֥יךְ אָמַ֖רְתָּ אֲחֹ֣תִ/י הִ֑וא וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ יִצְחָ֔ק כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן אָמ֖וּת עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyqr' 'bymlkh lytschq vy'mr 'kh hnh 'shtkh hv' v'ykh 'mrt 'chty hv' vy'mr 'lyv ytschq khy 'mrty pn 'mvt 'lyh
verses.translation: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ מַה זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֑/נוּ כִּ֠/מְעַט שָׁכַ֞ב אַחַ֤ד הָ/עָם֙ אֶת אִשְׁתֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֥ עָלֵ֖י/נוּ אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh mh z't 'shyt lnv khm't shkhb 'chd h'm 't 'shtkh vhb't 'lynv 'shm
verses.translation: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַ/נֹּגֵ֜עַ בָּ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֛ה וּ/בְ/אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vytsv 'bymlkh 't khl h'm l'mr hng' b'ysh hzh vb'shtv mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְרַ֤ע יִצְחָק֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֔וא וַ/יִּמְצָ֛א בַּ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/הִ֖וא מֵאָ֣ה שְׁעָרִ֑ים וַֽ/יְבָרֲכֵ֖/הוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyzr' ytschq b'rts hhv' vymts' bshnh hhv' m'h sh'rym vybrkhhv yhvh
verses.translation: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְדַּ֖ל הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ וְ/גָדֵ֔ל עַ֥ד כִּֽי גָדַ֖ל מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vygdl h'ysh vylkh hlvkh vgdl 'd khy gdl m'd
verses.translation: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי ל֤/וֹ מִקְנֵה צֹאן֙ וּ/מִקְנֵ֣ה בָקָ֔ר וַ/עֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֑ה וַ/יְקַנְא֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy lv mqnh ts'n vmqnh bqr v'bdh rbh vyqn'v 'tv plshtym
verses.translation: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/בְּאֵרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ו בִּ/ימֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֑י/ו סִתְּמ֣וּ/ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יְמַלְא֖וּ/ם עָפָֽר
verses.translit: vkhl hb'rt 'shr chprv 'bdy 'byv bymy 'brhm 'byv stmvm plshtym vyml'vm 'pr
verses.translation: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל יִצְחָ֑ק לֵ֚ךְ מֵֽ/עִמָּ֔/נוּ כִּֽי עָצַֽמְתָּ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh 'l ytschq lkh m'mnv khy 'tsmt mmnv m'd
verses.translation: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

verses.translit: vylkh mshm ytschq vychn bnchl grr vyshb shm
verses.translation: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב יִצְחָ֜ק וַ/יַּחְפֹּ֣ר אֶת בְּאֵרֹ֣ת הַ/מַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ בִּ/ימֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יְסַתְּמ֣וּ/ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א לָ/הֶן֙ שֵׁמ֔וֹת כַּ/שֵּׁמֹ֕ת אֲשֶׁר קָרָ֥א לָ/הֶ֖ן אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb ytschq vychpr 't b'rt hmym 'shr chprv bymy 'brhm 'byv vystmvm plshtym 'chry mvt 'brhm vyqr' lhn shmvt khshmt 'shr qr' lhn 'byv
verses.translation: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְפְּר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי יִצְחָ֖ק בַּ/נָּ֑חַל וַ/יִּ֨מְצְאוּ שָׁ֔ם בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vychprv 'bdy ytschq bnchl vymts'v shm b'r mym chyym
verses.translation: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

verses.original: וַ/יָּרִ֜יבוּ רֹעֵ֣י גְרָ֗ר עִם רֹעֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק לֵ/אמֹ֖ר לָ֣/נוּ הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א שֵֽׁם הַ/בְּאֵר֙ עֵ֔שֶׂק כִּ֥י הִֽתְעַשְּׂק֖וּ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyrybv r'y grr 'm r'y ytschq l'mr lnv hmym vyqr' shm hb'r 'shq khy ht'shqv 'mv
verses.translation: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּחְפְּרוּ֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וַ/יָּרִ֖יבוּ גַּם עָלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖/הּ שִׂטְנָֽה
verses.translit: vychprv b'r 'chrt vyrybv gm 'lyh vyqr' shmh shtnh
verses.translation: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעְתֵּ֣ק מִ/שָּׁ֗ם וַ/יַּחְפֹּר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וְ/לֹ֥א רָב֖וּ עָלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמָ/הּ֙ רְחֹב֔וֹת וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי עַתָּ֞ה הִרְחִ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה לָ֖/נוּ וּ/פָרִ֥ינוּ בָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'tq mshm vychpr b'r 'chrt vl' rbv 'lyh vyqr' shmh rchbvt vy'mr khy 'th hrchyb yhvh lnv vprynv b'rts
verses.translation: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

verses.translit: vy'l mshm b'r shb'
verses.translation: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֨א אֵלָ֤י/ו יְהוָה֙ בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֔וּא וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֕י אֱלֹהֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֑י/ךָ אַל תִּירָא֙ כִּֽי אִתְּ/ךָ֣ אָנֹ֔כִי וּ/בֵֽרַכְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֔ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv yhvh blylh hhv' vy'mr 'nkhy 'lhy 'brhm 'bykh 'l tyr' khy 'tkh 'nkhy vbrkhtykh vhrbyty 't zr'kh b'bvr 'brhm 'bdy
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֧בֶן שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֶּט שָׁ֖ם אָהֳל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּכְרוּ שָׁ֥ם עַבְדֵי יִצְחָ֖ק בְּאֵֽר
verses.translit: vybn shm mzbch vyqr' bshm yhvh vyt shm 'hlv vykhrv shm 'bdy ytschq b'r
verses.translation: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD , and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ הָלַ֥ךְ אֵלָ֖י/ו מִ/גְּרָ֑ר וַ/אֲחֻזַּת֙ מֵֽרֵעֵ֔/הוּ וּ/פִיכֹ֖ל שַׂר צְבָאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'bymlkh hlkh 'lyv mgrr v'chzt mr'hv vpykhl shr tsb'v
verses.translation: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ יִצְחָ֔ק מַדּ֖וּעַ בָּאתֶ֣ם אֵלָ֑/י וְ/אַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אֹתִ֔/י וַ/תְּשַׁלְּח֖וּ/נִי מֵ/אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm ytschq mdv' b'tm 'ly v'tm shn'tm 'ty vtshlchvny m'tkhm
verses.translation: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ רָא֣וֹ רָאִינוּ֮ כִּֽי הָיָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה עִמָּ/ךְ֒ וַ/נֹּ֗אמֶר תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א אָלָ֛ה בֵּינוֹתֵ֖י/נוּ בֵּינֵ֣י/נוּ וּ/בֵינֶ֑/ךָ וְ/נִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mrv r'v r'ynv khy hyh yhvh 'mkh vn'mr thy n' 'lh bynvtynv bynynv vbynkh vnkhrth bryt 'mkh
verses.translation: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

verses.original: אִם תַּעֲשֵׂ֨ה עִמָּ֜/נוּ רָעָ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א נְגַֽעֲנ֔וּ/ךָ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤ינוּ עִמְּ/ךָ֙ רַק ט֔וֹב וַ/נְּשַׁלֵּֽחֲ/ךָ֖ בְּ/שָׁל֑וֹם אַתָּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה בְּר֥וּךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm t'shh 'mnv r'h kh'shr l' ng'nvkh vkh'shr 'shynv 'mkh rq tvb vnshlchkh bshlvm 'th 'th brvkh yhvh
verses.translation: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ לָ/הֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַ/יֹּאכְל֖וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'sh lhm mshth vy'khlv vyshtv
verses.translation: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/אָחִ֑י/ו וַ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֣/ם יִצְחָ֔ק וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ מֵ/אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshkhymv bbqr vyshb'v 'ysh l'chyv vyshlchm ytschq vylkhv m'tv bshlvm
verses.translation: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ ל֔/וֹ עַל אֹד֥וֹת הַ/בְּאֵ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפָ֑רוּ וַ/יֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖/וֹ מָצָ֥אנוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hhv' vyb'v 'bdy ytschq vygdv lv 'l 'dvt hb'r 'shr chprv vy'mrv lv mts'nv mym
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֹתָ֖/הּ שִׁבְעָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֤ן שֵׁם הָ/עִיר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' 'th shb'h 'l khn shm h'yr b'r shb' 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ אֶת יְהוּדִ֔ית בַּת בְּאֵרִ֖י הַֽ/חִתִּ֑י וְ/אֶת בָּ֣שְׂמַ֔ת בַּת אֵילֹ֖ן הַֽ/חִתִּֽי
verses.translit: vyhy 'shv bn 'rb'ym shnh vyqch 'shh 't yhvdyt bt b'ry hchty v't bshmt bt 'yln hchty
verses.translation: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

verses.original: וַ/תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ מֹ֣רַת ר֑וּחַ לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּ/לְ/רִבְקָֽה
verses.translit: vthyyn mrt rvch lytschq vlrbqh
verses.translation: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כִּֽי זָקֵ֣ן יִצְחָ֔ק וַ/תִּכְהֶ֥יןָ עֵינָ֖י/ו מֵ/רְאֹ֑ת וַ/יִּקְרָ֞א אֶת עֵשָׂ֣ו בְּנ֣/וֹ הַ/גָּדֹ֗ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ בְּנִ֔/י וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו הִנֵּֽנִ/י
verses.translit: vyhy khy zqn ytschq vtkhhyn 'ynyv mr't vyqr' 't 'shv bnv hgdl vy'mr 'lyv bny vy'mr 'lyv hnny
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה נָ֖א זָקַ֑נְתִּי לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי י֥וֹם מוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh n' zqnty l' yd'ty yvm mvty
verses.translation: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ שָׂא נָ֣א כֵלֶ֔י/ךָ תֶּלְיְ/ךָ֖ וְ/קַשְׁתֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/צֵא֙ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וְ/צ֥וּדָ/ה לִּ֖/י צידה צָֽיִד
verses.translit: v'th sh' n' khlykh tlykh vqshtkh vts' hshdh vtsvdh ly tsydh tsyd
verses.translation: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

verses.original: וַ/עֲשֵׂה לִ֨/י מַטְעַמִּ֜ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהַ֛בְתִּי וְ/הָבִ֥יאָ/ה לִּ֖/י וְ/אֹכֵ֑לָה בַּ/עֲב֛וּר תְּבָרֶכְ/ךָ֥ נַפְשִׁ֖/י בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם אָמֽוּת
verses.translit: v'shh ly mt'mym kh'shr 'hbty vhby'h ly v'khlh b'bvr tbrkhkh npshy btrm 'mvt
verses.translation: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

verses.original: וְ/רִבְקָ֣ה שֹׁמַ֔עַת בְּ/דַבֵּ֣ר יִצְחָ֔ק אֶל עֵשָׂ֖ו בְּנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ עֵשָׂו֙ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה לָ/צ֥וּד צַ֖יִד לְ/הָבִֽיא
verses.translit: vrbqh shm't bdbr ytschq 'l 'shv bnv vylkh 'shv hshdh ltsvd tsyd lhby'
verses.translation: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it .

verses.original: וְ/רִבְקָה֙ אָֽמְרָ֔ה אֶל יַעֲקֹ֥ב בְּנָ֖/הּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת אָבִ֔י/ךָ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶל עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִ֖י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vrbqh 'mrh 'l y'qb bnh l'mr hnh shm'ty 't 'bykh mdbr 'l 'shv 'chykh l'mr
verses.translation: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

verses.original: הָבִ֨יאָ/ה לִּ֥/י צַ֛יִד וַ/עֲשֵׂה לִ֥/י מַטְעַמִּ֖ים וְ/אֹכֵ֑לָה וַ/אֲבָרֶכְ/כָ֛ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י מוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hby'h ly tsyd v'shh ly mt'mym v'khlh v'brkhkhh lpny yhvh lpny mvty
verses.translation: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֥ה בְנִ֖/י שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קֹלִ֑/י לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י מְצַוָּ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'th bny shm' bqly l'shr 'ny mtsvh 'tkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

verses.original: לֶךְ נָא֙ אֶל הַ/צֹּ֔אן וְ/קַֽח לִ֣/י מִ/שָּׁ֗ם שְׁנֵ֛י גְּדָיֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים טֹבִ֑ים וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֨ה אֹתָ֧/ם מַטְעַמִּ֛ים לְ/אָבִ֖י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהֵֽב
verses.translit: lkh n' 'l hts'n vqch ly mshm shny gdyy 'zym tbym v''shh 'tm mt'mym l'bykh kh'shr 'hb
verses.translation: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֥ לְ/אָבִ֖י/ךָ וְ/אָכָ֑ל בַּ/עֲבֻ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֖ לִ/פְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhb't l'bykh v'khl b'br 'shr ybrkhkh lpny mvtv
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל רִבְקָ֖ה אִמּ֑/וֹ הֵ֣ן עֵשָׂ֤ו אָחִ/י֙ אִ֣ישׁ שָׂעִ֔ר וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אִ֥ישׁ חָלָֽק
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l rbqh 'mv hn 'shv 'chy 'ysh sh'r v'nkhy 'ysh chlq
verses.translation: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

verses.original: אוּלַ֤י יְמֻשֵּׁ֨/נִי֙ אָבִ֔/י וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי בְ/עֵינָ֖י/ו כִּ/מְתַעְתֵּ֑עַ וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י עָלַ֛/י קְלָלָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א בְרָכָֽה
verses.translit: 'vly ymshny 'by vhyyty b'ynyv khmt't' vhb'ty 'ly qllh vl' brkhh
verses.translation: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ אִמּ֔/וֹ עָלַ֥/י קִלְלָתְ/ךָ֖ בְּנִ֑/י אַ֛ךְ שְׁמַ֥ע בְּ/קֹלִ֖/י וְ/לֵ֥ךְ קַֽח לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'mv 'ly qlltkh bny 'kh shm' bqly vlkh qch ly
verses.translation: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַ/יִּקַּ֔ח וַ/יָּבֵ֖א לְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/תַּ֤עַשׂ אִמּ/וֹ֙ מַטְעַמִּ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָהֵ֥ב אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vylkh vyqch vyb' l'mv vt'sh 'mv mt'mym kh'shr 'hb 'byv
verses.translation: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח רִ֠בְקָה אֶת בִּגְדֵ֨י עֵשָׂ֜ו בְּנָ֤/הּ הַ/גָּדֹל֙ הַ/חֲמֻדֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתָּ֖/הּ בַּ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/תַּלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּנָ֥/הּ הַ/קָּטָֽן
verses.translit: vtqch rbqh 't bgdy 'shv bnh hgdl hchmdt 'shr 'th bbyt vtlbsh 't y'qb bnh hqtn
verses.translation: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗ת עֹרֹת֙ גְּדָיֵ֣י הָֽ/עִזִּ֔ים הִלְבִּ֖ישָׁה עַל יָדָ֑י/ו וְ/עַ֖ל חֶלְקַ֥ת צַוָּארָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't 'rt gdyy h'zym hlbyshh 'l ydyv v'l chlqt tsv'ryv
verses.translation: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת הַ/מַּטְעַמִּ֛ים וְ/אֶת הַ/לֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑תָה בְּ/יַ֖ד יַעֲקֹ֥ב בְּנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vttn 't hmt'mym v't hlchm 'shr 'shth byd y'qb bnh
verses.translation: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֶל אָבִ֖י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הִנֶּ֔נִּ/י מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה בְּנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyb' 'l 'byv vy'mr 'by vy'mr hnny my 'th bny
verses.translation: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל אָבִ֗י/ו אָנֹכִי֙ עֵשָׂ֣ו בְּכֹרֶ֔/ךָ עָשִׂ֕יתִי כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֵלָ֑/י קֽוּם נָ֣א שְׁבָ֗/ה וְ/אָכְלָ/ה֙ מִ/צֵּידִ֔/י בַּ/עֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥/נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l 'byv 'nkhy 'shv bkhrkh 'shyty kh'shr dbrt 'ly qvm n' shbh v'khlh mtsydy b'bvr tbrkhny npshkh
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִצְחָק֙ אֶל בְּנ֔/וֹ מַה זֶּ֛ה מִהַ֥רְתָּ לִ/מְצֹ֖א בְּנִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י הִקְרָ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr ytschq 'l bnv mh zh mhrt lmts' bny vy'mr khy hqrh yhvh 'lhykh lpny
verses.translation: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֔ב גְּשָׁ/ה נָּ֥א וַ/אֲמֻֽשְׁ/ךָ֖ בְּנִ֑/י הַֽ/אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֛ה בְּנִ֥/י עֵשָׂ֖ו אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr ytschq 'l y'qb gshh n' v'mshkh bny h'th zh bny 'shv 'm l'
verses.translation: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֧שׁ יַעֲקֹ֛ב אֶל יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖י/ו וַ/יְמֻשֵּׁ֑/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הַ/קֹּל֙ ק֣וֹל יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/הַ/יָּדַ֖יִם יְדֵ֥י עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: vygsh y'qb 'l ytschq 'byv vymshhv vy'mr hql qvl y'qb vhydym ydy 'shv
verses.translation: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א הִכִּיר֔/וֹ כִּֽי הָי֣וּ יָדָ֗י/ו כִּ/ידֵ֛י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִ֖י/ו שְׂעִרֹ֑ת וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vl' hkhyrv khy hyv ydyv khydy 'shv 'chyv sh'rt vybrkhhv
verses.translation: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣/י עֵשָׂ֑ו וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'th zh bny 'shv vy'mr 'ny
verses.translation: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הַגִּ֤שָׁ/ה לִּ/י֙ וְ/אֹֽכְלָה֙ מִ/צֵּ֣יד בְּנִ֔/י לְמַ֥עַן תְּבָֽרֶכְ/ךָ֖ נַפְשִׁ֑/י וַ/יַּגֶּשׁ ל/וֹ֙ וַ/יֹּאכַ֔ל וַ/יָּ֧בֵא ל֦/וֹ יַ֖יִן וַ/יֵּֽשְׁתְּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hgshh ly v'khlh mtsyd bny lm'n tbrkhkh npshy vygsh lv vy'khl vyb' lv yyn vysht
verses.translation: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֑י/ו גְּשָׁ/ה נָּ֥א וּ/שְׁקָ/ה לִּ֖/י בְּנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv ytschq 'byv gshh n' vshqh ly bny
verses.translation: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּשׁ֙ וַ/יִּשַּׁק ל֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֛רַח אֶת רֵ֥יחַ בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וַֽ/יְבָרֲכֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר רְאֵה֙ רֵ֣יחַ בְּנִ֔/י כְּ/רֵ֣יחַ שָׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּרֲכ֖/וֹ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vygsh vyshq lv vyrch 't rych bgdyv vybrkhhv vy'mr r'h rych bny khrych shdh 'shr brkhv yhvh
verses.translation: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

verses.original: וְ/יִֽתֶּן לְ/ךָ֙ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ/טַּל֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וּ/מִ/שְׁמַנֵּ֖י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/רֹ֥ב דָּגָ֖ן וְ/תִירֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: vytn lkh h'lhym mtl hshmym vmshmny h'rts vrb dgn vtyrsh
verses.translation: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

verses.original: יַֽעַבְד֣וּ/ךָ עַמִּ֗ים ו/ישתחו וְ/יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֤וּ לְ/ךָ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים הֱוֵ֤ה גְבִיר֙ לְ/אַחֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ בְּנֵ֣י אִמֶּ֑/ךָ אֹרְרֶ֣י/ךָ אָר֔וּר וּֽ/מְבָרֲכֶ֖י/ךָ בָּרֽוּךְ
verses.translit: y'bdvkh 'mym vyshtchv vyshtchvv lkh l'mym hvh gbyr l'chykh vyshtchvv lkh bny 'mkh 'rrykh 'rvr vmbrkhykh brvkh
verses.translation: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלָּ֣ה יִצְחָק֮ לְ/בָרֵ֣ךְ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב֒ וַ/יְהִ֗י אַ֣ךְ יָצֹ֤א יָצָא֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב מֵ/אֵ֥ת פְּנֵ֖י יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/עֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֔י/ו בָּ֖א מִ/צֵּידֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr khlh ytschq lbrkh 't y'qb vyhy 'kh yts' yts' y'qb m't pny ytschq 'byv v'shv 'chyv b' mtsydv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ גַּם הוּא֙ מַטְעַמִּ֔ים וַ/יָּבֵ֖א לְ/אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/אָבִ֗י/ו יָקֻ֤ם אָבִ/י֙ וְ/יֹאכַל֙ מִ/צֵּ֣יד בְּנ֔/וֹ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥/נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'sh gm hv' mt'mym vyb' l'byv vy'mr l'byv yqm 'by vy'khl mtsyd bnv b'bvr tbrkhny npshkh
verses.translation: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֛/וֹ יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖י/ו מִי אָ֑תָּה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֲנִ֛י בִּנְ/ךָ֥ בְכֹֽרְ/ךָ֖ עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: vy'mr lv ytschq 'byv my 'th vy'mr 'ny bnkh bkhrkh 'shv
verses.translation: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱרַ֨ד יִצְחָ֣ק חֲרָדָה֮ גְּדֹלָ֣ה עַד מְאֹד֒ וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר מִֽי אֵפ֡וֹא ה֣וּא הַ/צָּֽד צַיִד֩ וַ/יָּ֨בֵא לִ֜/י וָ/אֹכַ֥ל מִ/כֹּ֛ל בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא וָ/אֲבָרֲכֵ֑/הוּ גַּם בָּר֖וּךְ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vychrd ytschq chrdh gdlh 'd m'd vy'mr my 'pv' hv' htsd tsyd vyb' ly v'khl mkhl btrm tbv' v'brkhhv gm brvkh yhyh
verses.translation: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

verses.original: כִּ/שְׁמֹ֤עַ עֵשָׂו֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יִּצְעַ֣ק צְעָקָ֔ה גְּדֹלָ֥ה וּ/מָרָ֖ה עַד מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/אָבִ֔י/ו בָּרֲכֵ֥/נִי גַם אָ֖נִי אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: khshm' 'shv 't dbry 'byv vyts'q ts'qh gdlh vmrh 'd m'd vy'mr l'byv brkhny gm 'ny 'by
verses.translation: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בָּ֥א אָחִ֖י/ךָ בְּ/מִרְמָ֑ה וַ/יִּקַּ֖ח בִּרְכָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr b' 'chykh bmrmh vyqch brkhtkh
verses.translation: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר הֲ/כִי֩ קָרָ֨א שְׁמ֜/וֹ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַֽ/יַּעְקְבֵ֨/נִי֙ זֶ֣ה פַעֲמַ֔יִם אֶת בְּכֹרָתִ֣/י לָקָ֔ח וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה לָקַ֣ח בִּרְכָתִ֑/י וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר הֲ/לֹא אָצַ֥לְתָּ לִּ֖/י בְּרָכָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hkhy qr' shmv y'qb vy'qbny zh p'mym 't bkhrty lqch vhnh 'th lqch brkhty vy'mr hl' 'tslt ly brkhh
verses.translation: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן יִצְחָ֜ק וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/עֵשָׂ֗ו הֵ֣ן גְּבִ֞יר שַׂמְתִּ֥י/ו לָ/ךְ֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֶחָ֗י/ו נָתַ֤תִּי ל/וֹ֙ לַ/עֲבָדִ֔ים וְ/דָגָ֥ן וְ/תִירֹ֖שׁ סְמַכְתִּ֑י/ו וּ/לְ/כָ֣ה אֵפ֔וֹא מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'n ytschq vy'mr l'shv hn gbyr shmtyv lkh v't khl 'chyv ntty lv l'bdym vdgn vtyrsh smkhtyv vlkhh 'pv' mh ''shh bny
verses.translation: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶל אָבִ֗י/ו הַֽ/בְרָכָ֨ה אַחַ֤ת הִֽוא לְ/ךָ֙ אָבִ֔/י בָּרֲכֵ֥/נִי גַם אָ֖נִי אָבִ֑/י וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו קֹל֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּֽבְךְּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv 'l 'byv hbrkhh 'cht hv' lkh 'by brkhny gm 'ny 'by vysh' 'shv qlv vybkh
verses.translation: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַן יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑י/ו הִנֵּ֞ה מִ/שְׁמַנֵּ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה מֽוֹשָׁבֶ֔/ךָ וּ/מִ/טַּ֥ל הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם מֵ/עָֽל
verses.translit: vy'n ytschq 'byv vy'mr 'lyv hnh mshmny h'rts yhyh mvshbkh vmtl hshmym m'l
verses.translation: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

verses.original: וְ/עַל חַרְבְּ/ךָ֣ תִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְ/אֶת אָחִ֖י/ךָ תַּעֲבֹ֑ד וְ/הָיָה֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֔יד וּ/פָרַקְתָּ֥ עֻלּ֖/וֹ מֵ/עַ֥ל צַוָּארֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'l chrbkh tchyh v't 'chykh t'bd vhyh kh'shr tryd vprqt 'lv m'l tsv'rkh
verses.translation: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂטֹ֤ם עֵשָׂו֙ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֔ב עַל הַ֨/בְּרָכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּרֲכ֖/וֹ אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו בְּ/לִבּ֗/וֹ יִקְרְבוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ אֵ֣בֶל אָבִ֔/י וְ/אַֽהַרְגָ֖ה אֶת יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshtm 'shv 't y'qb 'l hbrkhh 'shr brkhv 'byv vy'mr 'shv blbv yqrbv ymy 'bl 'by v'hrgh 't y'qb 'chy
verses.translation: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֣ד לְ/רִבְקָ֔ה אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו בְּנָ֣/הּ הַ/גָּדֹ֑ל וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֞ח וַ/תִּקְרָ֤א לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ בְּנָ֣/הּ הַ/קָּטָ֔ן וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו הִנֵּה֙ עֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֔י/ךָ מִתְנַחֵ֥ם לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/הָרְגֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vygd lrbqh 't dbry 'shv bnh hgdl vtshlch vtqr' ly'qb bnh hqtn vt'mr 'lyv hnh 'shv 'chykh mtnchm lkh lhrgkh
verses.translation: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֥ה בְנִ֖/י שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קֹלִ֑/י וְ/ק֧וּם בְּרַח לְ/ךָ֛ אֶל לָבָ֥ן אָחִ֖/י חָרָֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: v'th bny shm' bqly vqvm brch lkh 'l lbn 'chy chrnh
verses.translation: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֥ עִמּ֖/וֹ יָמִ֣ים אֲחָדִ֑ים עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁ֖וּב חֲמַ֥ת אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshbt 'mv ymym 'chdym 'd 'shr tshvb chmt 'chykh
verses.translation: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;

verses.original: עַד שׁ֨וּב אַף אָחִ֜י/ךָ מִמְּ/ךָ֗ וְ/שָׁכַח֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁלַחְתִּ֖י וּ/לְקַחְתִּ֣י/ךָ מִ/שָּׁ֑ם לָ/מָ֥ה אֶשְׁכַּ֛ל גַּם שְׁנֵי/כֶ֖ם י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'd shvb 'f 'chykh mmkh vshkhch 't 'shr 'shyt lv vshlchty vlqchtykh mshm lmh 'shkhl gm shnykhm yvm 'chd
verses.translation: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר רִבְקָה֙ אֶל יִצְחָ֔ק קַ֣צְתִּי בְ/חַיַּ֔/י מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנ֣וֹת חֵ֑ת אִם לֹקֵ֣חַ יַ֠עֲקֹב אִשָּׁ֨ה מִ/בְּנֽוֹת חֵ֤ת כָּ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ מִ/בְּנ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לָ֥/מָּה לִּ֖/י חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vt'mr rbqh 'l ytschq qtsty bchyy mpny bnvt cht 'm lqch y'qb 'shh mbnvt cht kh'lh mbnvt h'rts lmh ly chyym
verses.translation: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יְצַוֵּ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ לֹֽא תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה מִ/בְּנ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vyqr' ytschq 'l y'qb vybrkh 'tv vytsvhv vy'mr lv l' tqch 'shh mbnvt khn'n
verses.translation: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

verses.original: ק֥וּם לֵךְ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽ/ה אֲרָ֔ם בֵּ֥יתָ/ה בְתוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֣י אִמֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/קַח לְ/ךָ֤ מִ/שָּׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה מִ/בְּנ֥וֹת לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֥י אִמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qvm lkh pdnh 'rm byth btv'l 'by 'mkh vqch lkh mshm 'shh mbnvt lbn 'chy 'mkh
verses.translation: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֹֽתְ/ךָ֔ וְ/יַפְרְ/ךָ֖ וְ/יַרְבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֖יתָ לִ/קְהַ֥ל עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: v'l shdy ybrkh 'tkh vyprkh vyrbkh vhyyt lqhl 'mym
verses.translation: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

verses.original: וְ/יִֽתֶּן לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת בִּרְכַּ֣ת אַבְרָהָ֔ם לְ/ךָ֖ וּ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֣ אִתָּ֑/ךְ לְ/רִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: vytn lkh 't brkht 'brhm lkh vlzr'kh 'tkh lrshtkh 't 'rts mgrykh 'shr ntn 'lhym l'brhm
verses.translation: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽ/ה אֲרָ֑ם אֶל לָבָ֤ן בֶּן בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽ/אֲרַמִּ֔י אֲחִ֣י רִבְקָ֔ה אֵ֥ם יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְ/עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: vyshlch ytschq 't y'qb vylkh pdnh 'rm 'l lbn bn btv'l h'rmy 'chy rbqh 'm y'qb v'shv
verses.translation: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא עֵשָׂ֗ו כִּֽי בֵרַ֣ךְ יִצְחָק֮ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב֒ וְ/שִׁלַּ֤ח אֹת/וֹ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽ/ה אֲרָ֔ם לָ/קַֽחַת ל֥/וֹ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם אִשָּׁ֑ה בְּ/בָרֲכ֣/וֹ אֹת֔/וֹ וַ/יְצַ֤ו עָלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה מִ/בְּנ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vyr' 'shv khy brkh ytschq 't y'qb vshlch 'tv pdnh 'rm lqcht lv mshm 'shh bbrkhv 'tv vytsv 'lyv l'mr l' tqch 'shh mbnvt khn'n
verses.translation: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל אָבִ֖י/ו וְ/אֶל אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֥נָֽ/ה אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vyshm' y'qb 'l 'byv v'l 'mv vylkh pdnh 'rm
verses.translation: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י רָע֖וֹת בְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' 'shv khy r'vt bnvt khn'n b'yny ytschq 'byv
verses.translation: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵ֑אל וַ/יִּקַּ֡ח אֶֽת מָחֲלַ֣ת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֲח֧וֹת נְבָי֛וֹת עַל נָשָׁ֖י/ו ל֥/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vylkh 'shv 'l yshm''l vyqch 't mchlt bt yshm''l bn 'brhm 'chvt nbyvt 'l nshyv lv l'shh
verses.translation: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִ/בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ חָרָֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' y'qb mb'r shb' vylkh chrnh
verses.translation: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְגַּ֨ע בַּ/מָּק֜וֹם וַ/יָּ֤לֶן שָׁם֙ כִּי בָ֣א הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וַ/יִּקַּח֙ מֵ/אַבְנֵ֣י הַ/מָּק֔וֹם וַ/יָּ֖שֶׂם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vypg' bmqvm vyln shm khy b' hshmsh vyqch m'bny hmqvm vyshm mr'shtyv vyshkhb bmqvm hhv'
verses.translation: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּחֲלֹ֗ם וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה סֻלָּם֙ מֻצָּ֣ב אַ֔רְצָ/ה וְ/רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ מַגִּ֣יעַ הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יְמָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֔ים עֹלִ֥ים וְ/יֹרְדִ֖ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychlm vhnh slm mtsb 'rtsh vr'shv mgy' hshmymh vhnh ml'khy 'lhym 'lym vyrdym bv
verses.translation: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב עָלָי/ו֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔י/ךָ וֵ/אלֹהֵ֖י יִצְחָ֑ק הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ שֹׁכֵ֣ב עָלֶ֔י/הָ לְ/ךָ֥ אֶתְּנֶ֖/נָּה וּ/לְ/זַרְעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnh yhvh ntsb 'lyv vy'mr 'ny yhvh 'lhy 'brhm 'bykh v'lhy ytschq h'rts 'shr 'th shkhb 'lyh lkh 'tnnh vlzr'kh
verses.translation: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ כַּ/עֲפַ֣ר הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/פָרַצְתָּ֛ יָ֥מָּ/ה וָ/קֵ֖דְמָ/ה וְ/צָפֹ֣נָ/ה וָ/נֶ֑גְבָּ/ה וְ/נִבְרֲכ֥וּ בְ/ךָ֛ כָּל מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה וּ/בְ/זַרְעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh zr'kh kh'pr h'rts vprtst ymh vqdmh vtspnh vngbh vnbrkhv bkh khl mshpcht h'dmh vbzr'kh
verses.translation: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י עִמָּ֗/ךְ וּ/שְׁמַרְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וַ/הֲשִׁ֣בֹתִ֔י/ךָ אֶל הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את כִּ֚י לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱזָבְ/ךָ֔ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhnh 'nkhy 'mkh vshmrtykh bkhl 'shr tlkh vhshbtykh 'l h'dmh hz't khy l' ''zbkh 'd 'shr 'm 'shyty 't 'shr dbrty lkh
verses.translation: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיקַ֣ץ יַעֲקֹב֮ מִ/שְּׁנָת/וֹ֒ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אָכֵן֙ יֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vyyqts y'qb mshntv vy'mr 'khn ysh yhvh bmqvm hzh v'nkhy l' yd'ty
verses.translation: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּירָא֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר מַה נּוֹרָ֖א הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֗ה כִּ֚י אִם בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/זֶ֖ה שַׁ֥עַר הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyyr' vy'mr mh nvr' hmqvm hzh 'yn zh khy 'm byt 'lhym vzh sh'r hshmym
verses.translation: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת הָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֹתָ֖/הּ מַצֵּבָ֑ה וַ/יִּצֹ֥ק שֶׁ֖מֶן עַל רֹאשָֽׁ/הּ
verses.translit: vyshkhm y'qb bbqr vyqch 't h'bn 'shr shm mr'shtyv vyshm 'th mtsbh vytsq shmn 'l r'shh
verses.translation: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א אֶת שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/אוּלָ֛ם ל֥וּז שֵׁם הָ/עִ֖יר לָ/רִאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' 't shm hmqvm hhv' byt 'l v'vlm lvz shm h'yr lr'shnh
verses.translation: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדַּ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב נֶ֣דֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִם יִהְיֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִמָּדִ֗/י וּ/שְׁמָרַ֨/נִי֙ בַּ/דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י הוֹלֵ֔ךְ וְ/נָֽתַן לִ֥/י לֶ֛חֶם לֶ/אֱכֹ֖ל וּ/בֶ֥גֶד לִ/לְבֹּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vydr y'qb ndr l'mr 'm yhyh 'lhym 'mdy vshmrny bdrkh hzh 'shr 'nkhy hvlkh vntn ly lchm l'khl vbgd llbsh
verses.translation: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתִּ֥י בְ/שָׁל֖וֹם אֶל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑/י וְ/הָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖/י לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vshbty bshlvm 'l byt 'by vhyh yhvh ly l'lhym
verses.translation: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֶ֣בֶן הַ/זֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֨מְתִּי֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֶּן לִ֔/י עַשֵּׂ֖ר אֲעַשְּׂרֶ֥/נּוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vh'bn hz't 'shr shmty mtsbh yhyh byt 'lhym vkhl 'shr ttn ly 'shr ''shrnv lkh
verses.translation: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב רַגְלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ אַ֥רְצָ/ה בְנֵי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: vysh' y'qb rglyv vylkh 'rtsh bny qdm
verses.translation: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֞רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה בְאֵ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁ֞ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶדְרֵי צֹאן֙ רֹבְצִ֣ים עָלֶ֔י/הָ כִּ֚י מִן הַ/בְּאֵ֣ר הַ/הִ֔וא יַשְׁק֖וּ הָ/עֲדָרִ֑ים וְ/הָ/אֶ֥בֶן גְּדֹלָ֖ה עַל פִּ֥י הַ/בְּאֵֽר
verses.translit: vyr' vhnh b'r bshdh vhnh shm shlshh 'dry ts'n rbtsym 'lyh khy mn hb'r hhv' yshqv h'drym vh'bn gdlh 'l py hb'r
verses.translation: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.

verses.original: וְ/נֶאֶסְפוּ שָׁ֣מָּ/ה כָל הָ/עֲדָרִ֗ים וְ/גָלֲל֤וּ אֶת הָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ מֵ/עַל֙ פִּ֣י הַ/בְּאֵ֔ר וְ/הִשְׁק֖וּ אֶת הַ/צֹּ֑אן וְ/הֵשִׁ֧יבוּ אֶת הָ/אֶ֛בֶן עַל פִּ֥י הַ/בְּאֵ֖ר לִ/מְקֹמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vn'spv shmh khl h'drym vgllv 't h'bn m'l py hb'r vhshqv 't hts'n vhshybv 't h'bn 'l py hb'r lmqmh
verses.translation: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב אַחַ֖/י מֵ/אַ֣יִן אַתֶּ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵ/חָרָ֖ן אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm y'qb 'chy m'yn 'tm vy'mrv mchrn 'nchnv
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם הַ/יְדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת לָבָ֣ן בֶּן נָח֑וֹר וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ יָדָֽעְנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm hyd'tm 't lbn bn nchvr vy'mrv yd'nv
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לָ/הֶ֖ם הֲ/שָׁל֣וֹם ל֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וְ/הִנֵּה֙ רָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֔/וֹ בָּאָ֖ה עִם הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm hshlvm lv vy'mrv shlvm vhnh rchl btv b'h 'm hts'n
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֵ֥ן עוֹד֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם גָּד֔וֹל לֹא עֵ֖ת הֵאָסֵ֣ף הַ/מִּקְנֶ֑ה הַשְׁק֥וּ הַ/צֹּ֖אן וּ/לְכ֥וּ רְעֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hn 'vd hyvm gdvl l' 't h'sf hmqnh hshqv hts'n vlkhv r'v
verses.translation: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֮ לֹ֣א נוּכַל֒ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֲדָרִ֔ים וְ/גָֽלֲלוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אֶ֔בֶן מֵ/עַ֖ל פִּ֣י הַ/בְּאֵ֑ר וְ/הִשְׁקִ֖ינוּ הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: vy'mrv l' nvkhl 'd 'shr y'spv khl h'drym vgllv 't h'bn m'l py hb'r vhshqynv hts'n
verses.translation: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֖/נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמָּ֑/ם וְ/רָחֵ֣ל בָּ֗אָה עִם הַ/צֹּאן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אָבִ֔י/הָ כִּ֥י רֹעָ֖ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'vdnv mdbr 'mm vrchl b'h 'm hts'n 'shr l'byh khy r'h hv'
verses.translation: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ רָאָ֨ה יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת רָחֵ֗ל בַּת לָבָן֙ אֲחִ֣י אִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֣י אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּגַּ֣שׁ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַ/יָּ֤גֶל אֶת הָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ מֵ/עַל֙ פִּ֣י הַ/בְּאֵ֔ר וַ/יַּ֕שְׁקְ אֶת צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֥י אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr r'h y'qb 't rchl bt lbn 'chy 'mv v't ts'n lbn 'chy 'mv vygsh y'qb vygl 't h'bn m'l py hb'r vyshq 't ts'n lbn 'chy 'mv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

verses.translit: vyshq y'qb lrchl vysh' 't qlv vybkh
verses.translation: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֨ד יַעֲקֹ֜ב לְ/רָחֵ֗ל כִּ֣י אֲחִ֤י אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ ה֔וּא וְ/כִ֥י בֶן רִבְקָ֖ה ה֑וּא וַ/תָּ֖רָץ וַ/תַּגֵּ֥ד לְ/אָבִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vygd y'qb lrchl khy 'chy 'byh hv' vkhy bn rbqh hv' vtrts vtgd l'byh
verses.translation: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ לָבָ֜ן אֶת שֵׁ֣מַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב בֶּן אֲחֹת֗/וֹ וַ/יָּ֤רָץ לִ/קְרָאת/וֹ֙ וַ/יְחַבֶּק ל/וֹ֙ וַ/יְנַשֶּׁק ל֔/וֹ וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/הוּ אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/יְסַפֵּ֣ר לְ/לָבָ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' lbn 't shm' y'qb bn 'chtv vyrts lqr'tv vychbq lv vynshq lv vyby'hv 'l bytv vyspr llbn 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ לָבָ֔ן אַ֛ךְ עַצְמִ֥/י וּ/בְשָׂרִ֖/י אָ֑תָּה וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב עִמּ֖/וֹ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lv lbn 'kh 'tsmy vbshry 'th vyshb 'mv chdsh ymym
verses.translation: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָבָן֙ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב הֲ/כִי אָחִ֣/י אַ֔תָּה וַ/עֲבַדְתַּ֖/נִי חִנָּ֑ם הַגִּ֥ידָ/ה לִּ֖/י מַה מַּשְׂכֻּרְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn ly'qb hkhy 'chy 'th v'bdtny chnm hgydh ly mh mshkhrtkh
verses.translation: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be ?

verses.original: וּ/לְ/לָבָ֖ן שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֑וֹת שֵׁ֤ם הַ/גְּדֹלָה֙ לֵאָ֔ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/קְּטַנָּ֖ה רָחֵֽל
verses.translit: vllbn shty bnvt shm hgdlh l'h vshm hqtnh rchl
verses.translation: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

verses.original: וְ/עֵינֵ֥י לֵאָ֖ה רַכּ֑וֹת וְ/רָחֵל֙ הָֽיְתָ֔ה יְפַת תֹּ֖אַר וִ/יפַ֥ת מַרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: v'yny l'h rkhvt vrchl hyth ypt t'r vypt mr'h
verses.translation: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֥ב יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת רָחֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֶֽעֱבָדְ/ךָ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים בְּ/רָחֵ֥ל בִּתְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/קְּטַנָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'hb y'qb 't rchl vy'mr ''bdkh shb' shnym brchl btkh hqtnh
verses.translation: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֗ן ט֚וֹב תִּתִּ֣/י אֹתָ֣/הּ לָ֔/ךְ מִ/תִּתִּ֥/י אֹתָ֖/הּ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר שְׁבָ֖/ה עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn tvb tty 'th lkh mtty 'th l'ysh 'chr shbh 'mdy
verses.translation: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֧ד יַעֲקֹ֛ב בְּ/רָחֵ֖ל שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ בְ/עֵינָי/ו֙ כְּ/יָמִ֣ים אֲחָדִ֔ים בְּ/אַהֲבָת֖/וֹ אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'bd y'qb brchl shb' shnym vyhyv b'ynyv khymym 'chdym b'hbtv 'th
verses.translation: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֤ב אֶל לָבָן֙ הָבָ֣/ה אֶת אִשְׁתִּ֔/י כִּ֥י מָלְא֖וּ יָמָ֑/י וְ/אָב֖וֹאָה אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l lbn hbh 't 'shty khy ml'v ymy v'bv'h 'lyh
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֥ף לָבָ֛ן אֶת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/מָּק֖וֹם וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'sf lbn 't khl 'nshy hmqvm vy'sh mshth
verses.translation: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בָ/עֶ֔רֶב וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת לֵאָ֣ה בִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֖/הּ אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyhy b'rb vyqch 't l'h btv vyb' 'th 'lyv vyb' 'lyh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן לָבָן֙ לָ֔/הּ אֶת זִלְפָּ֖ה שִׁפְחָת֑/וֹ לְ/לֵאָ֥ה בִתּ֖/וֹ שִׁפְחָֽה
verses.translit: vytn lbn lh 't zlph shpchtv ll'h btv shpchh
verses.translation: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִנֵּה הִ֖וא לֵאָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל לָבָ֗ן מַה זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לִּ֔/י הֲ/לֹ֤א בְ/רָחֵל֙ עָבַ֣דְתִּי עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/לָ֖/מָּה רִמִּיתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vhnh hv' l'h vy'mr 'l lbn mh z't 'shyt ly hl' brchl 'bdty 'mkh vlmh rmytny
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֔ן לֹא יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן בִּ/מְקוֹמֵ֑/נוּ לָ/תֵ֥ת הַ/צְּעִירָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/בְּכִירָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn l' y'shh khn bmqvmnv ltt hts'yrh lpny hbkhyrh
verses.translation: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

verses.original: מַלֵּ֖א שְׁבֻ֣עַ זֹ֑את וְ/נִתְּנָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ גַּם אֶת זֹ֗את בַּ/עֲבֹדָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֣ד עִמָּדִ֔/י ע֖וֹד שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֥ים אֲחֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: ml' shb' z't vntnh lkh gm 't z't b'bdh 'shr t'bd 'mdy 'vd shb' shnym 'chrvt
verses.translation: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ יַעֲקֹב֙ כֵּ֔ן וַ/יְמַלֵּ֖א שְׁבֻ֣עַ זֹ֑את וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֛/וֹ אֶת רָחֵ֥ל בִּתּ֖/וֹ ל֥/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'sh y'qb khn vyml' shb' z't vytn lv 't rchl btv lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן לָבָן֙ לְ/רָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֔/וֹ אֶת בִּלְהָ֖ה שִׁפְחָת֑/וֹ לָ֖/הּ לְ/שִׁפְחָֽה
verses.translit: vytn lbn lrchl btv 't blhh shpchtv lh lshpchh
verses.translation: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ גַּ֣ם אֶל רָחֵ֔ל וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֥ב גַּֽם אֶת רָחֵ֖ל מִ/לֵּאָ֑ה וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ד עִמּ֔/וֹ ע֖וֹד שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֥ים אֲחֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyb' gm 'l rchl vy'hb gm 't rchl ml'h vy'bd 'mv 'vd shb' shnym 'chrvt
verses.translation: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי שְׂנוּאָ֣ה לֵאָ֔ה וַ/יִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת רַחְמָ֑/הּ וְ/רָחֵ֖ל עֲקָרָֽה
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh khy shnv'h l'h vyptch 't rchmh vrchl 'qrh
verses.translation: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֤הַר לֵאָה֙ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ רְאוּבֵ֑ן כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה כִּֽי רָאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ/עָנְיִ֔/י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה יֶאֱהָבַ֥/נִי אִישִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vthr l'h vtld bn vtqr' shmv r'vbn khy 'mrh khy r'h yhvh b'nyy khy 'th y'hbny 'yshy
verses.translation: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֣הַר עוֹד֮ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּן֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי שָׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי שְׂנוּאָ֣ה אָנֹ֔כִי וַ/יִּתֶּן לִ֖/י גַּם אֶת זֶ֑ה וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ שִׁמְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bn vt'mr khy shm' yhvh khy shnv'h 'nkhy vytn ly gm 't zh vtqr' shmv shm'vn
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֣הַר עוֹד֮ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּן֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר עַתָּ֤ה הַ/פַּ֨עַם֙ יִלָּוֶ֤ה אִישִׁ/י֙ אֵלַ֔/י כִּֽי יָלַ֥דְתִּי ל֖/וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים עַל כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא שְׁמ֖/וֹ לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bn vt'mr 'th hp'm ylvh 'yshy 'ly khy yldty lv shlshh bnym 'l khn qr' shmv lvy
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֨הַר ע֜וֹד וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֗ן וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/פַּ֨עַם֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה אֶת יְהוָ֔ה עַל כֵּ֛ן קָרְאָ֥ה שְׁמ֖/וֹ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖ד מִ/לֶּֽדֶת
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bn vt'mr hp'm 'vdh 't yhvh 'l khn qr'h shmv yhvdh vt'md mldt
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD : therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣רֶא רָחֵ֗ל כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָֽלְדָה֙ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַ/תְּקַנֵּ֥א רָחֵ֖ל בַּ/אֲחֹתָ֑/הּ וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב֙ הָֽבָ/ה לִּ֣/י בָנִ֔ים וְ/אִם אַ֖יִן מֵתָ֥ה אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vtr' rchl khy l' yldh ly'qb vtqn' rchl b'chth vt'mr 'l y'qb hbh ly bnym v'm 'yn mth 'nkhy
verses.translation: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּ/רָחֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֲ/תַ֤חַת אֱלֹהִים֙ אָנֹ֔כִי אֲשֶׁר מָנַ֥ע מִמֵּ֖/ךְ פְּרִי בָֽטֶן
verses.translit: vychr 'f y'qb brchl vy'mr htcht 'lhym 'nkhy 'shr mn' mmkh pry btn
verses.translation: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה אֲמָתִ֥/י בִלְהָ֖ה בֹּ֣א אֵלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/תֵלֵד֙ עַל בִּרְכַּ֔/י וְ/אִבָּנֶ֥ה גַם אָנֹכִ֖י מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vt'mr hnh 'mty blhh b' 'lyh vtld 'l brkhy v'bnh gm 'nkhy mmnh
verses.translation: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֶּן ל֛/וֹ אֶת בִּלְהָ֥ה שִׁפְחָתָ֖/הּ לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖י/הָ יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vttn lv 't blhh shpchth l'shh vyb' 'lyh y'qb
verses.translation: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֣הַר בִּלְהָ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vthr blhh vtld ly'qb bn
verses.translation: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר רָחֵל֙ דָּנַ֣/נִּי אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/גַם֙ שָׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קֹלִ֔/י וַ/יִּתֶּן לִ֖/י בֵּ֑ן עַל כֵּ֛ן קָרְאָ֥ה שְׁמ֖/וֹ דָּֽן
verses.translit: vt'mr rchl dnny 'lhym vgm shm' bqly vytn ly bn 'l khn qr'h shmv dn
verses.translation: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֣הַר ע֔וֹד וַ/תֵּ֕לֶד בִּלְהָ֖ה שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֑ל בֵּ֥ן שֵׁנִ֖י לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld blhh shpcht rchl bn shny ly'qb
verses.translation: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר רָחֵ֗ל נַפְתּוּלֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים נִפְתַּ֛לְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִ֖/י גַּם יָכֹ֑לְתִּי וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ נַפְתָּלִֽי
verses.translit: vt'mr rchl nptvly 'lhym nptlty 'm 'chty gm ykhlty vtqr' shmv nptly
verses.translation: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣רֶא לֵאָ֔ה כִּ֥י עָמְדָ֖ה מִ/לֶּ֑דֶת וַ/תִּקַּח֙ אֶת זִלְפָּ֣ה שִׁפְחָתָ֔/הּ וַ/תִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛/הּ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vtr' l'h khy 'mdh mldt vtqch 't zlph shpchth vttn 'th ly'qb l'shh
verses.translation: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֗לֶד זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה לְ/יַעֲקֹ֥ב בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vtld zlph shpcht l'h ly'qb bn
verses.translation: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר לֵאָ֖ה ב/גד בָּ֣א גָ֑ד וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ גָּֽד
verses.translit: vt'mr l'h bgd b' gd vtqr' 't shmv gd
verses.translation: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֗לֶד זִלְפָּה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת לֵאָ֔ה בֵּ֥ן שֵׁנִ֖י לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vtld zlph shpcht l'h bn shny ly'qb
verses.translation: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאָ֔ה בְּ/אָשְׁרִ֕/י כִּ֥י אִשְּׁר֖וּ/נִי בָּנ֑וֹת וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ אָשֵֽׁר
verses.translit: vt'mr l'h b'shry khy 'shrvny bnvt vtqr' 't shmv 'shr
verses.translation: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֜ן בִּ/ימֵ֣י קְצִיר חִטִּ֗ים וַ/יִּמְצָ֤א דֽוּדָאִים֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וַ/יָּבֵ֣א אֹתָ֔/ם אֶל לֵאָ֖ה אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר רָחֵל֙ אֶל לֵאָ֔ה תְּנִי נָ֣א לִ֔/י מִ/דּוּדָאֵ֖י בְּנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vylkh r'vbn bymy qtsyr chtym vymts' dvd'ym bshdh vyb' 'tm 'l l'h 'mv vt'mr rchl 'l l'h tny n' ly mdvd'y bnkh
verses.translation: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֗/הּ הַ/מְעַט֙ קַחְתֵּ֣/ךְ אֶת אִישִׁ֔/י וְ/לָ/קַ֕חַת גַּ֥ם אֶת דּוּדָאֵ֖י בְּנִ֑/י וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר רָחֵ֗ל לָ/כֵן֙ יִשְׁכַּ֤ב עִמָּ/ךְ֙ הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה תַּ֖חַת דּוּדָאֵ֥י בְנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr lh hm't qchtkh 't 'yshy vlqcht gm 't dvd'y bny vt'mr rchl lkhn yshkhb 'mkh hlylh tcht dvd'y bnkh
verses.translation: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֣ב מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶה֮ בָּ/עֶרֶב֒ וַ/תֵּצֵ֨א לֵאָ֜ה לִ/קְרָאת֗/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵלַ֣/י תָּב֔וֹא כִּ֚י שָׂכֹ֣ר שְׂכַרְתִּ֔י/ךָ בְּ/דוּדָאֵ֖י בְּנִ֑/י וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עִמָּ֖/הּ בַּ/לַּ֥יְלָה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb mn hshdh b'rb vtts' l'h lqr'tv vt'mr 'ly tbv' khy shkhr shkhrtykh bdvd'y bny vyshkhb 'mh blylh hv'
verses.translation: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל לֵאָ֑ה וַ/תַּ֛הַר וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב בֵּ֥ן חֲמִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vyshm' 'lhym 'l l'h vthr vtld ly'qb bn chmyshy
verses.translation: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן אֱלֹהִים֙ שְׂכָרִ֔/י אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי שִׁפְחָתִ֖/י לְ/אִישִׁ֑/י וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ יִשָּׂשכָֽר
verses.translit: vt'mr l'h ntn 'lhym shkhry 'shr ntty shpchty l'yshy vtqr' shmv yshshkhr
verses.translation: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֤הַר עוֹד֙ לֵאָ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד בֵּן שִׁשִּׁ֖י לְּ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vthr 'vd l'h vtld bn shshy ly'qb
verses.translation: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאָ֗ה זְבָדַ֨/נִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֹתִ/י֮ זֵ֣בֶד טוֹב֒ הַ/פַּ֨עַם֙ יִזְבְּלֵ֣/נִי אִישִׁ֔/י כִּֽי יָלַ֥דְתִּי ל֖/וֹ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ זְבֻלֽוּן
verses.translit: vt'mr l'h zbdny 'lhym 'ty zbd tvb hp'm yzblny 'yshy khy yldty lv shshh bnym vtqr' 't shmv zblvn
verses.translation: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֖ר יָ֣לְדָה בַּ֑ת וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמָ֖/הּ דִּינָֽה
verses.translit: v'chr yldh bt vtqr' 't shmh dynh
verses.translation: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת רָחֵ֑ל וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת רַחְמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyzkhr 'lhym 't rchl vyshm' 'lyh 'lhym vyptch 't rchmh
verses.translation: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֖הַר וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר אָסַ֥ף אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vthr vtld bn vt'mr 'sf 'lhym 't chrpty
