verses.translation: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרָ֧א אֶת שְׁמ֛/וֹ יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יֹסֵ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖/י בֵּ֥ן אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vtqr' 't shmv yvsf l'mr ysf yhvh ly bn 'chr
verses.translation: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יָלְדָ֥ה רָחֵ֖ל אֶת יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל לָבָ֔ן שַׁלְּחֵ֨/נִי֙ וְ/אֵ֣לְכָ֔ה אֶל מְקוֹמִ֖/י וּ/לְ/אַרְצִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr yldh rchl 't yvsf vy'mr y'qb 'l lbn shlchny v'lkhh 'l mqvmy vl'rtsy
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

verses.original: תְּנָ֞/ה אֶת נָשַׁ֣/י וְ/אֶת יְלָדַ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבַ֧דְתִּי אֹֽתְ/ךָ֛ בָּ/הֵ֖ן וְ/אֵלֵ֑כָה כִּ֚י אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֶת עֲבֹדָתִ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲבַדְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tnh 't nshy v't yldy 'shr 'bdty 'tkh bhn v'lkhh khy 'th yd't 't 'bdty 'shr 'bdtykh
verses.translation: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ לָבָ֔ן אִם נָ֛א מָצָ֥אתִי חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ נִחַ֕שְׁתִּי וַ/יְבָרֲכֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה בִּ/גְלָלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv lbn 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh nchshty vybrkhny yhvh bgllkh
verses.translation: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר נָקְבָ֧/ה שְׂכָרְ/ךָ֛ עָלַ֖/י וְ/אֶתֵּֽנָה
verses.translit: vy'mr nqbh shkhrkh 'ly v'tnh
verses.translation: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲבַדְתִּ֑י/ךָ וְ/אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה מִקְנְ/ךָ֖ אִתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'th yd't 't 'shr 'bdtykh v't 'shr hyh mqnkh 'ty
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

verses.original: כִּ֡י מְעַט֩ אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֤ לְ/פָנַ/י֙ וַ/יִּפְרֹ֣ץ לָ/רֹ֔ב וַ/יְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֹתְ/ךָ֖ לְ/רַגְלִ֑/י וְ/עַתָּ֗ה מָתַ֛י אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה גַם אָנֹכִ֖י לְ/בֵיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy m't 'shr hyh lkh lpny vyprts lrb vybrkh yhvh 'tkh lrgly v'th mty ''shh gm 'nkhy lbyty
verses.translation: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מָ֣ה אֶתֶּן לָ֑/ךְ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ לֹא תִתֶּן לִ֣/י מְא֔וּמָה אִם תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לִּ/י֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה אָשׁ֛וּבָה אֶרְעֶ֥ה צֹֽאנְ/ךָ֖ אֶשְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr mh 'tn lkh vy'mr y'qb l' ttn ly m'vmh 'm t'shh ly hdbr hzh 'shvbh 'r'h ts'nkh 'shmr
verses.translation: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

verses.original: אֶֽעֱבֹ֨ר בְּ/כָל צֹֽאנְ/ךָ֜ הַ/יּ֗וֹם הָסֵ֨ר מִ/שָּׁ֜ם כָּל שֶׂ֣ה נָקֹ֣ד וְ/טָל֗וּא וְ/כָל שֶׂה חוּם֙ בַּ/כְּשָׂבִ֔ים וְ/טָל֥וּא וְ/נָקֹ֖ד בָּ/עִזִּ֑ים וְ/הָיָ֖ה שְׂכָרִֽ/י
verses.translit: ''br bkhl ts'nkh hyvm hsr mshm khl shh nqd vtlv' vkhl shh chvm bkhshbym vtlv' vnqd b'zym vhyh shkhry
verses.translation: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

verses.original: וְ/עָֽנְתָה בִּ֤/י צִדְקָתִ/י֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם מָחָ֔ר כִּֽי תָב֥וֹא עַל שְׂכָרִ֖/י לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶ/נּוּ֩ נָקֹ֨ד וְ/טָל֜וּא בָּֽ/עִזִּ֗ים וְ/חוּם֙ בַּ/כְּשָׂבִ֔ים גָּנ֥וּב ה֖וּא אִתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'nth by tsdqty byvm mchr khy tbv' 'l shkhry lpnykh khl 'shr 'ynnv nqd vtlv' b'zym vchvm bkhshbym gnvb hv' 'ty
verses.translation: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לָבָ֖ן הֵ֑ן ל֖וּ יְהִ֥י כִ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn hn lv yhy khdbrkh
verses.translation: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣סַר בַּ/יּוֹם֩ הַ/ה֨וּא אֶת הַ/תְּיָשִׁ֜ים הָֽ/עֲקֻדִּ֣ים וְ/הַ/טְּלֻאִ֗ים וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל הָֽ/עִזִּים֙ הַ/נְּקֻדּ֣וֹת וְ/הַ/טְּלֻאֹ֔ת כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר לָבָן֙ בּ֔/וֹ וְ/כָל ח֖וּם בַּ/כְּשָׂבִ֑ים וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן בְּ/יַד בָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vysr byvm hhv' 't htyshym h'qdym vhtl'ym v't khl h'zym hnqdvt vhtl't khl 'shr lbn bv vkhl chvm bkhshbym vytn byd bnyv
verses.translation: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֗שֶׂם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים בֵּינ֖/וֹ וּ/בֵ֣ין יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/יַעֲקֹ֗ב רֹעֶ֛ה אֶת צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן הַ/נּוֹתָרֹֽת
verses.translit: vyshm drkh shlsht ymym bynv vbyn y'qb vy'qb r'h 't ts'n lbn hnvtrt
verses.translation: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל֣/וֹ יַעֲקֹ֗ב מַקַּ֥ל לִבְנֶ֛ה לַ֖ח וְ/ל֣וּז וְ/עֶרְמ֑וֹן וַ/יְפַצֵּ֤ל בָּ/הֵן֙ פְּצָל֣וֹת לְבָנ֔וֹת מַחְשֹׂף֙ הַ/לָּבָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/מַּקְלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqch lv y'qb mql lbnh lch vlvz v'rmvn vyptsl bhn ptslvt lbnvt mchshf hlbn 'shr 'l hmqlvt
verses.translation: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֵּ֗ג אֶת הַ/מַּקְלוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּצֵּ֔ל בָּ/רֳהָטִ֖ים בְּ/שִֽׁקֲת֣וֹת הַ/מָּ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨אןָ הַ/צֹּ֤אן לִ/שְׁתּוֹת֙ לְ/נֹ֣כַח הַ/צֹּ֔אן וַ/יֵּחַ֖מְנָה בְּ/בֹאָ֥/ן לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytsg 't hmqlvt 'shr ptsl brhtym bshqtvt hmym 'shr tb'n hts'n lshtvt lnkhch hts'n vychmnh bb'n lshtvt
verses.translation: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱמ֥וּ הַ/צֹּ֖אן אֶל הַ/מַּקְל֑וֹת וַ/תֵּלַ֣דְןָ הַ/צֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּ/טְלֻאִֽים
verses.translit: vychmv hts'n 'l hmqlvt vtldn hts'n 'qdym nqdym vtl'ym
verses.translation: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כְּשָׂבִים֮ הִפְרִ֣יד יַעֲקֹב֒ וַ֠/יִּתֵּן פְּנֵ֨י הַ/צֹּ֧אן אֶל עָקֹ֛ד וְ/כָל ח֖וּם בְּ/צֹ֣אן לָבָ֑ן וַ/יָּֽשֶׁת ל֤/וֹ עֲדָרִים֙ לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁתָ֖/ם עַל צֹ֥אן לָבָֽן
verses.translit: vhkhshbym hpryd y'qb vytn pny hts'n 'l 'qd vkhl chvm bts'n lbn vysht lv 'drym lbdv vl' shtm 'l ts'n lbn
verses.translation: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/כָל יַחֵם֮ הַ/צֹּ֣אן הַ/מְקֻשָּׁרוֹת֒ וְ/שָׂ֨ם יַעֲקֹ֧ב אֶת הַ/מַּקְל֛וֹת לְ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/צֹּ֖אן בָּ/רֳהָטִ֑ים לְ/יַחְמֵ֖/נָּה בַּ/מַּקְלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhyh bkhl ychm hts'n hmqshrvt vshm y'qb 't hmqlvt l'yny hts'n brhtym lychmnh bmqlvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַעֲטִ֥יף הַ/צֹּ֖אן לֹ֣א יָשִׂ֑ים וְ/הָיָ֤ה הָ/עֲטֻפִים֙ לְ/לָבָ֔ן וְ/הַ/קְּשֻׁרִ֖ים לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vbh'tyf hts'n l' yshym vhyh h'tpym llbn vhqshrym ly'qb
verses.translation: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְרֹ֥ץ הָ/אִ֖ישׁ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַֽ/יְהִי ל/וֹ֙ צֹ֣אן רַבּ֔וֹת וּ/שְׁפָחוֹת֙ וַ/עֲבָדִ֔ים וּ/גְמַלִּ֖ים וַ/חֲמֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vyprts h'ysh m'd m'd vyhy lv ts'n rbvt vshpchvt v'bdym vgmlym vchmrym
verses.translation: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֗ע אֶת דִּבְרֵ֤י בְנֵֽי לָבָן֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לָקַ֣ח יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אָבִ֑י/נוּ וּ/מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אָבִ֔י/נוּ עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/כָּבֹ֖ד הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' 't dbry bny lbn l'mr lqch y'qb 't khl 'shr l'bynv vm'shr l'bynv 'shh 't khl hkhbd hzh
verses.translation: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת פְּנֵ֣י לָבָ֑ן וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אֵינֶ֛/נּוּ עִמּ֖/וֹ כִּ/תְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: vyr' y'qb 't pny lbn vhnh 'ynnv 'mv khtmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֔ב שׁ֛וּב אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ אֲבוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/לְ/מוֹלַדְתֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l y'qb shvb 'l 'rts 'bvtykh vlmvldtkh v'hyh 'mkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א לְ/רָחֵ֣ל וּ/לְ/לֵאָ֑ה הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה אֶל צֹאנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch y'qb vyqr' lrchl vll'h hshdh 'l ts'nv
verses.translation: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ן רֹאֶ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י אֲבִי/כֶ֔ן כִּֽי אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ אֵלַ֖/י כִּ/תְמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם וֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֔/י הָיָ֖ה עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lhn r'h 'nkhy 't pny 'bykhn khy 'ynnv 'ly khtml shlshm v'lhy 'by hyh 'mdy
verses.translation: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֵּ֖נָה יְדַעְתֶּ֑ן כִּ֚י בְּ/כָל כֹּחִ֔/י עָבַ֖דְתִּי אֶת אֲבִי/כֶֽן
verses.translit: v'tnh yd'tn khy bkhl khchy 'bdty 't 'bykhn
verses.translation: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִי/כֶן֙ הֵ֣תֶל בִּ֔/י וְ/הֶחֱלִ֥ף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּ֖/י עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת מֹנִ֑ים וְ/לֹֽא נְתָנ֣/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְ/הָרַ֖ע עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'bykhn htl by vhchlf 't mshkhrty 'shrt mnym vl' ntnv 'lhym lhr' 'mdy
verses.translation: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

verses.original: אִם כֹּ֣ה יֹאמַ֗ר נְקֻדִּים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׂכָרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/יָלְד֥וּ כָל הַ/צֹּ֖אן נְקֻדִּ֑ים וְ/אִם כֹּ֣ה יֹאמַ֗ר עֲקֻדִּים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׂכָרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/יָלְד֥וּ כָל הַ/צֹּ֖אן עֲקֻדִּֽים
verses.translit: 'm khh y'mr nqdym yhyh shkhrkh vyldv khl hts'n nqdym v'm khh y'mr 'qdym yhyh shkhrkh vyldv khl hts'n 'qdym
verses.translation: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֵּ֧ל אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת מִקְנֵ֥ה אֲבִי/כֶ֖ם וַ/יִּתֶּן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vytsl 'lhym 't mqnh 'bykhm vytn ly
verses.translation: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/עֵת֙ יַחֵ֣ם הַ/צֹּ֔אן וָ/אֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֛/י וָ/אֵ֖רֶא בַּ/חֲל֑וֹם וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה הָֽ/עַתֻּדִים֙ הָ/עֹלִ֣ים עַל הַ/צֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּ/בְרֻדִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy b't ychm hts'n v'sh' 'yny v'r' bchlvm vhnh h'tdym h'lym 'l hts'n 'qdym nqdym vbrdym
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜/י מַלְאַ֧ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים בַּ/חֲל֖וֹם יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וָ/אֹמַ֖ר הִנֵּֽנִ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly ml'kh h'lhym bchlvm y'qb v'mr hnny
verses.translation: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying , Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר שָׂא נָ֨א עֵינֶ֤י/ךָ וּ/רְאֵה֙ כָּל הָֽ/עַתֻּדִים֙ הָ/עֹלִ֣ים עַל הַ/צֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּ/בְרֻדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י רָאִ֔יתִי אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבָ֖ן עֹ֥שֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh' n' 'ynykh vr'h khl h'tdym h'lym 'l hts'n 'qdym nqdym vbrdym khy r'yty 't khl 'shr lbn 'shh lkh
verses.translation: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֤י הָ/אֵל֙ בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָשַׁ֤חְתָּ שָּׁם֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֥רְתָּ לִּ֛/י שָׁ֖ם נֶ֑דֶר עַתָּ֗ה ק֥וּם צֵא֙ מִן הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/שׁ֖וּב אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'nkhy h'l byt 'l 'shr mshcht shm mtsbh 'shr ndrt ly shm ndr 'th qvm ts' mn h'rts hz't vshvb 'l 'rts mvldtkh
verses.translation: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֤עַן רָחֵל֙ וְ/לֵאָ֔ה וַ/תֹּאמַ֖רְנָה ל֑/וֹ הַ/ע֥וֹד לָ֛/נוּ חֵ֥לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ/בֵ֥ית אָבִֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vt'n rchl vl'h vt'mrnh lv h'vd lnv chlq vnchlh bbyt 'bynv
verses.translation: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֧וֹא נָכְרִיּ֛וֹת נֶחְשַׁ֥בְנוּ ל֖/וֹ כִּ֣י מְכָרָ֑/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֥אכַל גַּם אָכ֖וֹל אֶת כַּסְפֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hlv' nkhryvt nchshbnv lv khy mkhrnv vy'khl gm 'khvl 't khspnv
verses.translation: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל הָ/עֹ֗שֶׁר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּ֤יל אֱלֹהִים֙ מֵֽ/אָבִ֔י/נוּ לָ֥/נוּ ה֖וּא וּ/לְ/בָנֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ עֲשֵֽׂה
verses.translit: khy khl h'shr 'shr htsyl 'lhym m'bynv lnv hv' vlbnynv v'th khl 'shr 'mr 'lhym 'lykh 'shh
verses.translation: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖קָם יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַ/יִּשָּׂ֛א אֶת בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת נָשָׁ֖י/ו עַל הַ/גְּמַלִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqm y'qb vysh' 't bnyv v't nshyv 'l hgmlym
verses.translation: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

verses.original: וַ/יִּנְהַ֣ג אֶת כָּל מִקְנֵ֗/הוּ וְ/אֶת כָּל רְכֻשׁ/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָכָ֔שׁ מִקְנֵה֙ קִנְיָנ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּ/פַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם לָ/ב֛וֹא אֶל יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖י/ו אַ֥רְצָ/ה כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vynhg 't khl mqnhv v't khl rkhshv 'shr rkhsh mqnh qnynv 'shr rkhsh bpdn 'rm lbv' 'l ytschq 'byv 'rtsh khn'n
verses.translation: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וְ/לָבָ֣ן הָלַ֔ךְ לִ/גְזֹ֖ז אֶת צֹאנ֑/וֹ וַ/תִּגְנֹ֣ב רָחֵ֔ל אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/אָבִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vlbn hlkh lgzz 't ts'nv vtgnb rchl 't htrpym 'shr l'byh
verses.translation: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְנֹ֣ב יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶת לֵ֥ב לָבָ֖ן הָ/אֲרַמִּ֑י עַל בְּלִי֙ הִגִּ֣יד ל֔/וֹ כִּ֥י בֹרֵ֖חַ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vygnb y'qb 't lb lbn h'rmy 'l bly hgyd lv khy brch hv'
verses.translation: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרַ֥ח הוּא֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֖קָם וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר אֶת הַ/נָּהָ֑ר וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת פָּנָ֖י/ו הַ֥ר הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vybrch hv' vkhl 'shr lv vyqm vy'br 't hnhr vyshm 't pnyv hr hgl'd
verses.translation: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֥ד לְ/לָבָ֖ן בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vygd llbn byvm hshlyshy khy brch y'qb
verses.translation: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת אֶחָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֣ף אַחֲרָ֔י/ו דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יַּדְבֵּ֥ק אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/הַ֥ר הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyqch 't 'chyv 'mv vyrdf 'chryv drkh shb't ymym vydbq 'tv bhr hgl'd
verses.translation: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל לָבָ֥ן הָ/אֲרַמִּ֖י בַּ/חֲלֹ֣ם הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לְ/ךָ֛ פֶּן תְּדַבֵּ֥ר עִֽם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִ/טּ֥וֹב עַד רָֽע
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhym 'l lbn h'rmy bchlm hlylh vy'mr lv hshmr lkh pn tdbr 'm y'qb mtvb 'd r'
verses.translation: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשֵּׂ֥ג לָבָ֖ן אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/יַעֲקֹ֗ב תָּקַ֤ע אֶֽת אָהֳל/וֹ֙ בָּ/הָ֔ר וְ/לָבָ֛ן תָּקַ֥ע אֶת אֶחָ֖י/ו בְּ/הַ֥ר הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyshg lbn 't y'qb vy'qb tq' 't 'hlv bhr vlbn tq' 't 'chyv bhr hgl'd
verses.translation: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָבָן֙ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ וַ/תִּגְנֹ֖ב אֶת לְבָבִ֑/י וַ/תְּנַהֵג֙ אֶת בְּנֹתַ֔/י כִּ/שְׁבֻי֖וֹת חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn ly'qb mh 'shyt vtgnb 't lbby vtnhg 't bnty khshbyvt chrb
verses.translation: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

verses.translit: lmh nchb't lbrch vtgnb 'ty vl' hgdt ly v'shlchkh bshmchh vbshrym btf vbkhnvr
verses.translation: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

verses.translit: vl' ntshtny lnshq lbny vlbnty 'th hskhlt 'shv
verses.translation: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

verses.original: יֶשׁ לְ/אֵ֣ל יָדִ֔/י לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם רָ֑ע וֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֨י אֲבִי/כֶ֜ם אֶ֣מֶשׁ אָמַ֧ר אֵלַ֣/י לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לְ/ךָ֛ מִ/דַּבֵּ֥ר עִֽם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִ/טּ֥וֹב עַד רָֽע
verses.translit: ysh l'l ydy l'shvt 'mkhm r' v'lhy 'bykhm 'msh 'mr 'ly l'mr hshmr lkh mdbr 'm y'qb mtvb 'd r'
verses.translation: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הָלֹ֣ךְ הָלַ֔כְתָּ כִּֽי נִכְסֹ֥ף נִכְסַ֖פְתָּה לְ/בֵ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ךָ לָ֥/מָּה גָנַ֖בְתָּ אֶת אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th hlkh hlkht khy nkhsf nkhspth lbyt 'bykh lmh gnbt 't 'lhy
verses.translation: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/לָבָ֑ן כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔אתִי כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן תִּגְזֹ֥ל אֶת בְּנוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'n y'qb vy'mr llbn khy yr'ty khy 'mrty pn tgzl 't bnvtykh m'my
verses.translation: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

verses.original: עִ֠ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּמְצָ֣א אֶת אֱלֹהֶי/ךָ֮ לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶה֒ נֶ֣גֶד אַחֵ֧י/נוּ הַֽכֶּר לְ/ךָ֛ מָ֥ה עִמָּדִ֖/י וְ/קַֽח לָ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י רָחֵ֖ל גְּנָבָֽתַ/ם
verses.translit: 'm 'shr tmts' 't 'lhykh l' ychyh ngd 'chynv hkhr lkh mh 'mdy vqch lkh vl' yd' y'qb khy rchl gnbtm
verses.translation: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א לָבָ֜ן בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל יַעֲקֹ֣ב וּ/בְ/אֹ֣הֶל לֵאָ֗ה וּ/בְ/אֹ֛הֶל שְׁתֵּ֥י הָ/אֲמָהֹ֖ת וְ/לֹ֣א מָצָ֑א וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ מֵ/אֹ֣הֶל לֵאָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל רָחֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb' lbn b'hl y'qb vb'hl l'h vb'hl shty h'mht vl' mts' vyts' m'hl l'h vyb' b'hl rchl
verses.translation: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

verses.original: וְ/רָחֵ֞ל לָקְחָ֣ה אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֗ים וַ/תְּשִׂמֵ֛/ם בְּ/כַ֥ר הַ/גָּמָ֖ל וַ/תֵּ֣שֶׁב עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יְמַשֵּׁ֥שׁ לָבָ֛ן אֶת כָּל הָ/אֹ֖הֶל וְ/לֹ֥א מָצָֽא
verses.translit: vrchl lqchh 't htrpym vtshmm bkhr hgml vtshb 'lyhm vymshsh lbn 't khl h'hl vl' mts'
verses.translation: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל אָבִ֗י/הָ אַל יִ֨חַר֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י כִּ֣י ל֤וֹא אוּכַל֙ לָ/ק֣וּם מִ/פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ כִּי דֶ֥רֶךְ נָשִׁ֖ים לִ֑/י וַ/יְחַפֵּ֕שׂ וְ/לֹ֥א מָצָ֖א אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִֽים
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l 'byh 'l ychr b'yny 'dny khy lv' 'vkhl lqvm mpnykh khy drkh nshym ly vychpsh vl' mts' 't htrpym
verses.translation: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥חַר לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַ/יָּ֣רֶב בְּ/לָבָ֑ן וַ/יַּ֤עַן יַעֲקֹב֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/לָבָ֔ן מַה פִּשְׁעִ/י֙ מַ֣ה חַטָּאתִ֔/י כִּ֥י דָלַ֖קְתָּ אַחֲרָֽ/י
verses.translit: vychr ly'qb vyrb blbn vy'n y'qb vy'mr llbn mh psh'y mh cht'ty khy dlqt 'chry
verses.translation: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

verses.original: כִּֽי מִשַּׁ֣שְׁתָּ אֶת כָּל כֵּלַ֗/י מַה מָּצָ֨אתָ֙ מִ/כֹּ֣ל כְּלֵי בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ שִׂ֣ים כֹּ֔ה נֶ֥גֶד אַחַ֖/י וְ/אַחֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/יוֹכִ֖יחוּ בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khy mshsht 't khl khly mh mts't mkhl khly bytkh shym khh ngd 'chy v'chykh vyvkhychv byn shnynv
verses.translation: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

verses.original: זֶה֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ רְחֵלֶ֥י/ךָ וְ/עִזֶּ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א שִׁכֵּ֑לוּ וְ/אֵילֵ֥י צֹאנְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א אָכָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: zh 'shrym shnh 'nkhy 'mkh rchlykh v'zykh l' shkhlv v'yly ts'nkh l' 'khlty
verses.translation: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

verses.original: טְרֵפָה֙ לֹא הֵבֵ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ אָנֹכִ֣י אֲחַטֶּ֔/נָּה מִ/יָּדִ֖/י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑/נָּה גְּנֻֽבְתִ֣י י֔וֹם וּ/גְנֻֽבְתִ֖י לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: trph l' hb'ty 'lykh 'nkhy 'chtnh mydy tbqshnh gnbty yvm vgnbty lylh
verses.translation: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

verses.original: הָיִ֧יתִי בַ/יּ֛וֹם אֲכָלַ֥/נִי חֹ֖רֶב וְ/קֶ֣רַח בַּ/לָּ֑יְלָה וַ/תִּדַּ֥ד שְׁנָתִ֖/י מֵֽ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: hyyty byvm 'khlny chrb vqrch blylh vtdd shnty m'yny
verses.translation: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

verses.original: זֶה לִּ֞/י עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָה֮ בְּ/בֵיתֶ/ךָ֒ עֲבַדְתִּ֜י/ךָ אַרְבַּֽע עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים בְּ/צֹאנֶ֑/ךָ וַ/תַּחֲלֵ֥ף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּ֖/י עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת מֹנִֽים
verses.translit: zh ly 'shrym shnh bbytkh 'bdtykh 'rb' 'shrh shnh bshty bntykh vshsh shnym bts'nkh vtchlf 't mshkhrty 'shrt mnym
verses.translation: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

verses.original: לוּלֵ֡י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ/י֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וּ/פַ֤חַד יִצְחָק֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔/י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רֵיקָ֣ם שִׁלַּחְתָּ֑/נִי אֶת עָנְיִ֞/י וְ/אֶת יְגִ֧יעַ כַּפַּ֛/י רָאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/יּ֥וֹכַח אָֽמֶשׁ
verses.translit: lvly 'lhy 'by 'lhy 'brhm vpchd ytschq hyh ly khy 'th ryqm shlchtny 't 'nyy v't ygy' khpy r'h 'lhym vyvkhch 'msh
verses.translation: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן לָבָ֜ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַ/בָּנ֨וֹת בְּנֹתַ֜/י וְ/הַ/בָּנִ֤ים בָּנַ/י֙ וְ/הַ/צֹּ֣אן צֹאנִ֔/י וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לִ/י ה֑וּא וְ/לִ/בְנֹתַ֞/י מָֽה אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֤ה לָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם א֥וֹ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלָֽדוּ
verses.translit: vy'n lbn vy'mr 'l y'qb hbnvt bnty vhbnym bny vhts'n ts'ny vkhl 'shr 'th r'h ly hv' vlbnty mh ''shh l'lh hyvm 'v lbnyhn 'shr yldv
verses.translation: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לְכָ֛/ה נִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית אֲנִ֣י וָ/אָ֑תָּה וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/עֵ֖ד בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th lkhh nkhrth bryt 'ny v'th vhyh l'd byny vbynkh
verses.translation: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אָ֑בֶן וַ/יְרִימֶ֖/הָ מַצֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch y'qb 'bn vyrymh mtsbh
verses.translation: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֤ב לְ/אֶחָי/ו֙ לִקְט֣וּ אֲבָנִ֔ים וַ/יִּקְח֥וּ אֲבָנִ֖ים וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ גָ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֥אכְלוּ שָׁ֖ם עַל הַ/גָּֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb l'chyv lqtv 'bnym vyqchv 'bnym vy'shv gl vy'khlv shm 'l hgl
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא ל֣/וֹ לָבָ֔ן יְגַ֖ר שָׂהֲדוּתָ֑א וְ/יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב קָ֥רָא ל֖/וֹ גַּלְעֵֽד
verses.translit: vyqr' lv lbn ygr shhdvt' vy'qb qr' lv gl'd
verses.translation: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֔ן הַ/גַּ֨ל הַ/זֶּ֥ה עֵ֛ד בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינְ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם עַל כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא שְׁמ֖/וֹ גַּלְעֵֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn hgl hzh 'd byny vbynkh hyvm 'l khn qr' shmv gl'd
verses.translation: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מִּצְפָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר יִ֥צֶף יְהוָ֖ה בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֥י נִסָּתֵ֖ר אִ֥ישׁ מֵ/רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vhmtsph 'shr 'mr ytsf yhvh byny vbynkh khy nstr 'ysh mr'hv
verses.translation: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

verses.original: אִם תְּעַנֶּ֣ה אֶת בְּנֹתַ֗/י וְ/אִם תִּקַּ֤ח נָשִׁים֙ עַל בְּנֹתַ֔/י אֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ עִמָּ֑/נוּ רְאֵ֕ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים עֵ֖ד בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm t'nh 't bnty v'm tqch nshym 'l bnty 'yn 'ysh 'mnv r'h 'lhym 'd byny vbynkh
verses.translation: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לָבָ֖ן לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב הִנֵּ֣ה הַ/גַּ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ הַ/מַצֵּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרִ֖יתִי בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn ly'qb hnh hgl hzh vhnh hmtsbh 'shr yryty byny vbynkh
verses.translation: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

verses.original: עֵ֚ד הַ/גַּ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/עֵדָ֖ה הַ/מַּצֵּבָ֑ה אִם אָ֗נִי לֹֽא אֶֽעֱבֹ֤ר אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/גַּ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אִם אַ֠תָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹ֨ר אֵלַ֜/י אֶת הַ/גַּ֥ל הַ/זֶּ֛ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּצֵּבָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'd hgl hzh v'dh hmtsbh 'm 'ny l' ''br 'lykh 't hgl hzh v'm 'th l' t'br 'ly 't hgl hzh v't hmtsbh hz't lr'h
verses.translation: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֤י נָחוֹר֙ יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ בֵינֵ֔י/נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּ/פַ֖חַד אָבִ֥י/ו יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: 'lhy 'brhm v'lhy nchvr yshptv bynynv 'lhy 'byhm vyshb' y'qb bpchd 'byv ytschq
verses.translation: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבַּ֨ח יַעֲקֹ֥ב זֶ֨בַח֙ בָּ/הָ֔ר וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א לְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו לֶ/אֱכָל לָ֑חֶם וַ/יֹּ֣אכְלוּ לֶ֔חֶם וַ/יָּלִ֖ינוּ בָּ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vyzbch y'qb zbch bhr vyqr' l'chyv l'khl lchm vy'khlv lchm vylynv bhr
verses.translation: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם לָבָ֜ן בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַ/יְנַשֵּׁ֧ק לְ/בָנָ֛י/ו וְ/לִ/בְנוֹתָ֖י/ו וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶתְ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב לָבָ֖ן לִ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshkhm lbn bbqr vynshq lbnyv vlbnvtyv vybrkh 'thm vylkh vyshb lbn lmqmv
verses.translation: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

verses.original: וְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב הָלַ֣ךְ לְ/דַרְכּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּפְגְּעוּ ב֖/וֹ מַלְאֲכֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'qb hlkh ldrkhv vypg'v bv ml'khy 'lhym
verses.translation: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאָ֔/ם מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים זֶ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא מַֽחֲנָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb kh'shr r'm mchnh 'lhym zh vyqr' shm hmqvm hhv' mchnym
verses.translation: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח יַעֲקֹ֤ב מַלְאָכִים֙ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו אֶל עֵשָׂ֖ו אָחִ֑י/ו אַ֥רְצָ/ה שֵׂעִ֖יר שְׂדֵ֥ה אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshlch y'qb ml'khym lpnyv 'l 'shv 'chyv 'rtsh sh'yr shdh 'dvm
verses.translation: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו אֹתָ/ם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֣ה תֹאמְר֔וּ/ן לַֽ/אדֹנִ֖/י לְ/עֵשָׂ֑ו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב עִם לָבָ֣ן גַּ֔רְתִּי וָ/אֵחַ֖ר עַד עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vytsv 'tm l'mr khh t'mrvn l'dny l'shv khh 'mr 'bdkh y'qb 'm lbn grty v'chr 'd 'th
verses.translation: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי לִ/י֙ שׁ֣וֹר וַ/חֲמ֔וֹר צֹ֖אן וְ/עֶ֣בֶד וְ/שִׁפְחָ֑ה וָֽ/אֶשְׁלְחָ/ה֙ לְ/הַגִּ֣יד לַֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י לִ/מְצֹא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhy ly shvr vchmvr ts'n v'bd vshpchh v'shlchh lhgyd l'dny lmts' chn b'ynykh
verses.translation: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בָּ֤אנוּ אֶל אָחִ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶל עֵשָׂ֔ו וְ/גַם֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִ/קְרָֽאתְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת אִ֖ישׁ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshbv hml'khym 'l y'qb l'mr b'nv 'l 'chykh 'l 'shv vgm hlkh lqr'tkh v'rb' m'vt 'ysh 'mv
verses.translation: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

verses.original: וַ/יִּירָ֧א יַעֲקֹ֛ב מְאֹ֖ד וַ/יֵּ֣צֶר ל֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֜חַץ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗/וֹ וְ/אֶת הַ/צֹּ֧אן וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּקָ֛ר וְ/הַ/גְּמַלִּ֖ים לִ/שְׁנֵ֥י מַחֲנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyyr' y'qb m'd vytsr lv vychts 't h'm 'shr 'tv v't hts'n v't hbqr vhgmlym lshny mchnvt
verses.translation: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אִם יָב֥וֹא עֵשָׂ֛ו אֶל הַ/מַּחֲנֶ֥ה הָ/אַחַ֖ת וְ/הִכָּ֑/הוּ וְ/הָיָ֛ה הַ/מַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַ/נִּשְׁאָ֖ר לִ/פְלֵיטָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'm ybv' 'shv 'l hmchnh h'cht vhkhhv vhyh hmchnh hnsh'r lplyth
verses.translation: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ יַעֲקֹב֒ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אָבִ֣/י אַבְרָהָ֔ם וֵ/אלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֣/י יִצְחָ֑ק יְהוָ֞ה הָ/אֹמֵ֣ר אֵלַ֗/י שׁ֧וּב לְ/אַרְצְ/ךָ֛ וּ/לְ/מוֹלַדְתְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֵיטִ֥יבָה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'lhy 'by 'brhm v'lhy 'by ytschq yhvh h'mr 'ly shvb l'rtskh vlmvldtkh v'ytybh 'mkh
verses.translation: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

verses.original: קָטֹ֜נְתִּי מִ/כֹּ֤ל הַ/חֲסָדִים֙ וּ/מִ/כָּל הָ֣/אֱמֶ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י בְ/מַקְלִ֗/י עָבַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/עַתָּ֥ה הָיִ֖יתִי לִ/שְׁנֵ֥י מַחֲנֽוֹת
verses.translit: qtnty mkhl hchsdym vmkhl h'mt 'shr 'shyt 't 'bdkh khy bmqly 'brty 't hyrdn hzh v'th hyyty lshny mchnvt
verses.translation: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֥/נִי נָ֛א מִ/יַּ֥ד אָחִ֖/י מִ/יַּ֣ד עֵשָׂ֑ו כִּֽי יָרֵ֤א אָנֹכִי֙ אֹת֔/וֹ פֶּן יָב֣וֹא וְ/הִכַּ֔/נִי אֵ֖ם עַל בָּנִֽים
verses.translit: htsylny n' myd 'chy myd 'shv khy yr' 'nkhy 'tv pn ybv' vhkhny 'm 'l bnym
verses.translation: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ הֵיטֵ֥ב אֵיטִ֖יב עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ כְּ/ח֣וֹל הַ/יָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: v'th 'mrt hytb 'ytyb 'mkh vshmty 't zr'kh khchvl hym 'shr l' yspr mrb
verses.translation: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥לֶן שָׁ֖ם בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח מִן הַ/בָּ֧א בְ/יָד֛/וֹ מִנְחָ֖ה לְ/עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyln shm blylh hhv' vyqch mn hb' bydv mnchh l'shv 'chyv
verses.translation: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

verses.original: עִזִּ֣ים מָאתַ֔יִם וּ/תְיָשִׁ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֑ים רְחֵלִ֥ים מָאתַ֖יִם וְ/אֵילִ֥ים עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: 'zym m'tym vtyshym 'shrym rchlym m'tym v'ylym 'shrym
verses.translation: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

verses.original: גְּמַלִּ֧ים מֵינִיק֛וֹת וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים פָּר֤וֹת אַרְבָּעִים֙ וּ/פָרִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֔ה אֲתֹנֹ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וַ/עְיָרִ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: gmlym mynyqvt vbnyhm shlshym prvt 'rb'ym vprym 'shrh 'tnt 'shrym v'yrm 'shrh
verses.translation: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ בְּ/יַד עֲבָדָ֔י/ו עֵ֥דֶר עֵ֖דֶר לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ וַ֤/יֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדָי/ו֙ עִבְר֣וּ לְ/פָנַ֔/י וְ/רֶ֣וַח תָּשִׂ֔ימוּ בֵּ֥ין עֵ֖דֶר וּ/בֵ֥ין עֵֽדֶר
verses.translit: vytn byd 'bdyv 'dr 'dr lbdv vy'mr 'l 'bdyv 'brv lpny vrvch tshymv byn 'dr vbyn 'dr
verses.translation: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ו אֶת הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כִּ֣י יִֽפְגָּשְׁ/ךָ֞ עֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֗/י וִ/שְׁאֵֽלְ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/מִי אַ֨תָּה֙ וְ/אָ֣נָה תֵלֵ֔ךְ וּ/לְ/מִ֖י אֵ֥לֶּה לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vytsv 't hr'shvn l'mr khy ypgshkh 'shv 'chy vsh'lkh l'mr lmy 'th v'nh tlkh vlmy 'lh lpnykh
verses.translation: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב מִנְחָ֥ה הִוא֙ שְׁלוּחָ֔ה לַֽ/אדֹנִ֖/י לְ/עֵשָׂ֑ו וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה גַם ה֖וּא אַחֲרֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'mrt l'bdkh ly'qb mnchh hv' shlvchh l'dny l'shv vhnh gm hv' 'chrynv
verses.translation: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֞ו גַּ֣ם אֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗י גַּ֚ם אֶת הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י גַּ֚ם אֶת כָּל הַ/הֹ֣לְכִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י הָ/עֲדָרִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כַּ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ תְּדַבְּר֣וּ/ן אֶל עֵשָׂ֔ו בְּ/מֹצַאֲ/כֶ֖ם אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytsv gm 't hshny gm 't hshlyshy gm 't khl hhlkhym 'chry h'drym l'mr khdbr hzh tdbrvn 'l 'shv bmts'khm 'tv
verses.translation: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם גַּ֗ם הִנֵּ֛ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אַחֲרֵ֑י/נוּ כִּֽי אָמַ֞ר אֲכַפְּרָ֣ה פָנָ֗י/ו בַּ/מִּנְחָה֙ הַ/הֹלֶ֣כֶת לְ/פָנָ֔/י וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵן֙ אֶרְאֶ֣ה פָנָ֔י/ו אוּלַ֖י יִשָּׂ֥א פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mrtm gm hnh 'bdkh y'qb 'chrynv khy 'mr 'khprh pnyv bmnchh hhlkht lpny v'chry khn 'r'h pnyv 'vly ysh' pny
verses.translation: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

verses.original: וַ/תַּעֲבֹ֥ר הַ/מִּנְחָ֖ה עַל פָּנָ֑י/ו וְ/ה֛וּא לָ֥ן בַּ/לַּֽיְלָה הַ/ה֖וּא בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vt'br hmnchh 'l pnyv vhv' ln blylh hhv' bmchnh
verses.translation: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה ה֗וּא וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת שְׁתֵּ֤י נָשָׁי/ו֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י שִׁפְחֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת אַחַ֥ד עָשָׂ֖ר יְלָדָ֑י/ו וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֔ר אֵ֖ת מַעֲבַ֥ר יַבֹּֽק
verses.translit: vyqm blylh hv' vyqch 't shty nshyv v't shty shpchtyv v't 'chd 'shr yldyv vy'br 't m'br ybq
verses.translation: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֔/ם וַ/יַּֽעֲבִרֵ֖/ם אֶת הַ/נָּ֑חַל וַֽ/יַּעֲבֵ֖ר אֶת אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqchm vy'brm 't hnchl vy'br 't 'shr lv
verses.translation: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּתֵ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּאָבֵ֥ק אִישׁ֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ עַ֖ד עֲל֥וֹת הַ/שָּֽׁחַר
verses.translit: vyvtr y'qb lbdv vy'bq 'ysh 'mv 'd 'lvt hshchr
verses.translation: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗רְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָכֹל֙ ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּגַּ֖ע בְּ/כַף יְרֵכ֑/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֨קַע֙ כַּף יֶ֣רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּ/הֵֽאָבְק֖/וֹ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' khy l' ykhl lv vyg' bkhf yrkhv vtq' khf yrkh y'qb bh'bqv 'mv
verses.translation: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שַׁלְּחֵ֔/נִי כִּ֥י עָלָ֖ה הַ/שָּׁ֑חַר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֲשַֽׁלֵּחֲ/ךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם בֵּרַכְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr shlchny khy 'lh hshchr vy'mr l' 'shlchkh khy 'm brkhtny
verses.translation: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו מַה שְּׁמֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv mh shmkh vy'mr y'qb
verses.translation: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ שִׁמְ/ךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי שָׂרִ֧יתָ עִם אֱלֹהִ֛ים וְ/עִם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַ/תּוּכָֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr l' y'qb y'mr 'vd shmkh khy 'm yshr'l khy shryt 'm 'lhym v'm 'nshym vtvkhl
verses.translation: And Jacob asked him , and said, Tell me , I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֣א שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֖ה תִּשְׁאַ֣ל לִ/שְׁמִ֑/י וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹת֖/וֹ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vysh'l y'qb vy'mr hgydh n' shmkh vy'mr lmh zh tsh'l lshmy vybrkh 'tv shm
verses.translation: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א יַעֲקֹ֛ב שֵׁ֥ם הַ/מָּק֖וֹם פְּנִיאֵ֑ל כִּֽי רָאִ֤יתִי אֱלֹהִים֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל פָּנִ֔ים וַ/תִּנָּצֵ֖ל נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb shm hmqvm pny'l khy r'yty 'lhym pnym 'l pnym vtntsl npshy
verses.translation: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽזְרַֽח ל֣/וֹ הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבַ֖ר אֶת פְּנוּאֵ֑ל וְ/ה֥וּא צֹלֵ֖עַ עַל יְרֵכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyzrch lv hshmsh kh'shr 'br 't pnv'l vhv' tsl' 'l yrkhv
verses.translation: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּרְא֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה עֵשָׂ֣ו בָּ֔א וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יַּ֣חַץ אֶת הַ/יְלָדִ֗ים עַל לֵאָה֙ וְ/עַל רָחֵ֔ל וְ/עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַ/שְּׁפָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vysh' y'qb 'ynyv vyr' vhnh 'shv b' v'mv 'rb' m'vt 'ysh vychts 't hyldym 'l l'h v'l rchl v'l shty hshpchvt
verses.translation: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת הַ/שְּׁפָח֛וֹת וְ/אֶת יַלְדֵי/הֶ֖ן רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ/אֶת לֵאָ֤ה וִֽ/ילָדֶ֨י/הָ֙ אַחֲרֹנִ֔ים וְ/אֶת רָחֵ֥ל וְ/אֶת יוֹסֵ֖ף אַחֲרֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vyshm 't hshpchvt v't yldyhn r'shnh v't l'h vyldyh 'chrnym v't rchl v't yvsf 'chrnym
verses.translation: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

verses.original: וְ/ה֖וּא עָבַ֣ר לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֤חוּ אַ֨רְצָ/ה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים עַד גִּשְׁתּ֖/וֹ עַד אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhv' 'br lpnyhm vyshtchv 'rtsh shb' p'mym 'd gshtv 'd 'chyv
verses.translation: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

verses.translit: vyrts 'shv lqr'tv vychbqhv vypl 'l tsv'rv vyshqhv vybkhv
verses.translation: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֣א אֶת עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּ֤רְא אֶת הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/יְלָדִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מִי אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑/ךְ וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר הַ/יְלָדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁר חָנַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vysh' 't 'ynyv vyr' 't hnshym v't hyldym vy'mr my 'lh lkh vy'mr hyldym 'shr chnn 'lhym 't 'bdkh
verses.translation: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

verses.original: וַ/תִּגַּ֧שְׁןָ הַ/שְּׁפָח֛וֹת הֵ֥נָּה וְ/יַלְדֵי/הֶ֖ן וַ/תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽיןָ
verses.translit: vtgshn hshpchvt hnh vyldyhn vtshtchvyn
verses.translation: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

verses.original: וַ/תִּגַּ֧שׁ גַּם לֵאָ֛ה וִ/ילָדֶ֖י/הָ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ וְ/אַחַ֗ר נִגַּ֥שׁ יוֹסֵ֛ף וְ/רָחֵ֖ל וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ
verses.translit: vtgsh gm l'h vyldyh vyshtchvv v'chr ngsh yvsf vrchl vyshtchvv
verses.translation: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לְ/ךָ֛ כָּל הַ/מַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּגָ֑שְׁתִּי וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לִ/מְצֹא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr my lkh khl hmchnh hzh 'shr pgshty vy'mr lmts' chn b'yny 'dny
verses.translation: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר עֵשָׂ֖ו יֶשׁ לִ֣/י רָ֑ב אָחִ֕/י יְהִ֥י לְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁר לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv ysh ly rb 'chy yhy lkh 'shr lkh
verses.translation: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב אַל נָא֙ אִם נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ מִנְחָתִ֖/י מִ/יָּדִ֑/י כִּ֣י עַל כֵּ֞ן רָאִ֣יתִי פָנֶ֗י/ךָ כִּ/רְאֹ֛ת פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/תִּרְצֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l n' 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh vlqcht mnchty mydy khy 'l khn r'yty pnykh khr't pny 'lhym vtrtsny
verses.translation: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

verses.original: קַח נָ֤א אֶת בִּרְכָתִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻבָ֣את לָ֔/ךְ כִּֽי חַנַּ֥/נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/כִ֣י יֶשׁ לִ/י כֹ֑ל וַ/יִּפְצַר בּ֖/וֹ וַ/יִּקָּֽח
verses.translit: qch n' 't brkhty 'shr hb't lkh khy chnny 'lhym vkhy ysh ly khl vyptsr bv vyqch
verses.translation: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר נִסְעָ֣ה וְ/נֵלֵ֑כָה וְ/אֵלְכָ֖ה לְ/נֶגְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr ns'h vnlkhh v'lkhh lngdkh
verses.translation: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו אֲדֹנִ֤/י יֹדֵ֨עַ֙ כִּֽי הַ/יְלָדִ֣ים רַכִּ֔ים וְ/הַ/צֹּ֥אן וְ/הַ/בָּקָ֖ר עָל֣וֹת עָלָ֑/י וּ/דְפָקוּ/ם֙ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וָ/מֵ֖תוּ כָּל הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'dny yd' khy hyldym rkhym vhts'n vhbqr 'lvt 'ly vdpqvm yvm 'chd vmtv khl hts'n
verses.translation: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

verses.original: יַעֲבָר נָ֥א אֲדֹנִ֖/י לִ/פְנֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑/וֹ וַ/אֲנִ֞י אֶֽתְנָהֲלָ֣ה לְ/אִטִּ֗/י לְ/רֶ֨גֶל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר לְ/פָנַ/י֙ וּ/לְ/רֶ֣גֶל הַ/יְלָדִ֔ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר אָבֹ֥א אֶל אֲדֹנִ֖/י שֵׂעִֽירָ/ה
verses.translit: y'br n' 'dny lpny 'bdv v'ny 'tnhlh l'ty lrgl hml'khh 'shr lpny vlrgl hyldym 'd 'shr 'b' 'l 'dny sh'yrh
verses.translation: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַצִּֽיגָה נָּ֣א עִמְּ/ךָ֔ מִן הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לָ֣/מָּה זֶּ֔ה אֶמְצָא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv 'tsygh n' 'mkh mn h'm 'shr 'ty vy'mr lmh zh 'mts' chn b'yny 'dny
verses.translation: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֛ו לְ/דַרְכּ֖/וֹ שֵׂעִֽירָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshb byvm hhv' 'shv ldrkhv sh'yrh
verses.translation: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

verses.original: וְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ נָסַ֣ע סֻכֹּ֔תָ/ה וַ/יִּ֥בֶן ל֖/וֹ בָּ֑יִת וּ/לְ/מִקְנֵ֨/הוּ֙ עָשָׂ֣ה סֻכֹּ֔ת עַל כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם הַ/מָּק֖וֹם סֻכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'qb ns' skhth vybn lv byt vlmqnhv 'shh skht 'l khn qr' shm hmqvm skhvt
verses.translation: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֩ יַעֲקֹ֨ב שָׁלֵ֜ם עִ֣יר שְׁכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּ/בֹא֖/וֹ מִ/פַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יִּ֖חַן אֶת פְּנֵ֥י הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb shlm 'yr shkhm 'shr b'rts khn'n bb'v mpdn 'rm vychn 't pny h'yr
verses.translation: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֜קֶן אֶת חֶלְקַ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה שָׁם֙ אָהֳל֔/וֹ מִ/יַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי חֲמ֖וֹר אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם בְּ/מֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה
verses.translit: vyqn 't chlqt hshdh 'shr nth shm 'hlv myd bny chmvr 'by shkhm bm'h qshyth
verses.translation: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֶּב שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַ/יִּ֨קְרָא ל֔/וֹ אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytsb shm mzbch vyqr' lv 'l 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּצֵ֤א דִינָה֙ בַּת לֵאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב לִ/רְא֖וֹת בִּ/בְנ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vtts' dynh bt l'h 'shr yldh ly'qb lr'vt bbnvt h'rts
verses.translation: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨רְא אֹתָ֜/הּ שְׁכֶ֧ם בֶּן חֲמ֛וֹר הַֽ/חִוִּ֖י נְשִׂ֣יא הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛/הּ וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אֹתָ֖/הּ וַ/יְעַנֶּֽ/הָ
verses.translit: vyr' 'th shkhm bn chmvr hchvy nshy' h'rts vyqch 'th vyshkhb 'th vy'nh
verses.translation: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

verses.original: וַ/תִּדְבַּ֣ק נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ בְּ/דִינָ֖ה בַּֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַ/יֶּֽאֱהַב֙ אֶת הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֔ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל לֵ֥ב הַֽ/נַּעֲרָֽ
verses.translit: vtdbq npshv bdynh bt y'qb vy'hb 't hn'r vydbr 'l lb hn'r
verses.translation: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁכֶ֔ם אֶל חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קַֽח לִ֛/י אֶת הַ/יַּלְדָּ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr shkhm 'l chmvr 'byv l'mr qch ly 't hyldh hz't l'shh
verses.translation: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

verses.original: וְ/יַעֲקֹ֣ב שָׁמַ֗ע כִּ֤י טִמֵּא֙ אֶת דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֔/וֹ וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו הָי֥וּ אֶת מִקְנֵ֖/הוּ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וְ/הֶחֱרִ֥שׁ יַעֲקֹ֖ב עַד בֹּאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'qb shm' khy tm' 't dynh btv vbnyv hyv 't mqnhv bshdh vhchrsh y'qb 'd b'm
verses.translation: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֛א חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי שְׁכֶ֖ם אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyts' chmvr 'by shkhm 'l y'qb ldbr 'tv
verses.translation: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֨י יַעֲקֹ֜ב בָּ֤אוּ מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ כְּ/שָׁמְעָ֔/ם וַ/יִּֽתְעַצְּבוּ֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יִּ֥חַר לָ/הֶ֖ם מְאֹ֑ד כִּֽי נְבָלָ֞ה עָשָׂ֣ה בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִ/שְׁכַּב֙ אֶת בַּֽת יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/כֵ֖ן לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vbny y'qb b'v mn hshdh khshm'm vyt'tsbv h'nshym vychr lhm m'd khy nblh 'shh byshr'l lshkhb 't bt y'qb vkhn l' y'shh
verses.translation: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר חֲמ֖וֹר אִתָּ֣/ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנִ֗/י חָֽשְׁקָ֤ה נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ בְּ/בִתְּ/כֶ֔ם תְּנ֨וּ נָ֥א אֹתָ֛/הּ ל֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vydbr chmvr 'tm l'mr shkhm bny chshqh npshv bbtkhm tnv n' 'th lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

verses.original: וְ/הִֽתְחַתְּנ֖וּ אֹתָ֑/נוּ בְּנֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ תִּתְּנוּ לָ֔/נוּ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֵ֖י/נוּ תִּקְח֥וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhtchtnv 'tnv bntykhm ttnv lnv v't bntynv tqchv lkhm
verses.translation: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אִתָּ֖/נוּ תֵּשֵׁ֑בוּ וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם שְׁבוּ֙ וּ/סְחָר֔וּ/הָ וְ/הֵֽאָחֲז֖וּ בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'tnv tshbv vh'rts thyh lpnykhm shbv vschrvh vh'chzv bh
verses.translation: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁכֶם֙ אֶל אָבִ֣י/ה וְ/אֶל אַחֶ֔י/הָ אֶמְצָא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֛וּ אֵלַ֖/י אֶתֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr shkhm 'l 'byh v'l 'chyh 'mts' chn b'ynykhm v'shr t'mrv 'ly 'tn
verses.translation: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

verses.original: הַרְבּ֨וּ עָלַ֤/י מְאֹד֙ מֹ֣הַר וּ/מַתָּ֔ן וְ/אֶ֨תְּנָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑/י וּ/תְנוּ לִ֥/י אֶת הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֖ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: hrbv 'ly m'd mhr vmtn v'tnh kh'shr t'mrv 'ly vtnv ly 't hn'r l'shh
verses.translation: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת שְׁכֶ֨ם וְ/אֶת חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֛י/ו בְּ/מִרְמָ֖ה וַ/יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר טִמֵּ֔א אֵ֖ת דִּינָ֥ה אֲחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'nv bny y'qb 't shkhm v't chmvr 'byv bmrmh vydbrv 'shr tm' 't dynh 'chtm
verses.translation: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם לֹ֤א נוּכַל֙ לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לָ/תֵת֙ אֶת אֲחֹתֵ֔/נוּ לְ/אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר ל֣/וֹ עָרְלָ֑ה כִּֽי חֶרְפָּ֥ה הִ֖וא לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyhm l' nvkhl l'shvt hdbr hzh ltt 't 'chtnv l'ysh 'shr lv 'rlh khy chrph hv' lnv
verses.translation: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

verses.original: אַךְ בְּ/זֹ֖את נֵא֣וֹת לָ/כֶ֑ם אִ֚ם תִּהְי֣וּ כָמֹ֔/נוּ לְ/הִמֹּ֥ל לָ/כֶ֖ם כָּל זָכָֽר
verses.translit: 'kh bz't n'vt lkhm 'm thyv khmnv lhml lkhm khl zkhr
verses.translation: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised;

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֤נּוּ אֶת בְּנֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם נִֽקַּֽח לָ֑/נוּ וְ/יָשַׁ֣בְנוּ אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הָיִ֖ינוּ לְ/עַ֥ם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vntnv 't bntynv lkhm v't bntykhm nqch lnv vyshbnv 'tkhm vhyynv l'm 'chd
verses.translation: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֧א תִשְׁמְע֛וּ אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/הִמּ֑וֹל וְ/לָקַ֥חְנוּ אֶת בִּתֵּ֖/נוּ וְ/הָלָֽכְנוּ
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'v 'lynv lhmvl vlqchnv 't btnv vhlkhnv
verses.translation: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽיטְב֥וּ דִבְרֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י חֲמ֑וֹר וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֖י שְׁכֶ֥ם בֶּן חֲמֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyytbv dbryhm b'yny chmvr vb'yny shkhm bn chmvr
verses.translation: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אֵחַ֤ר הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הַ/דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֥י חָפֵ֖ץ בְּ/בַֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/ה֣וּא נִכְבָּ֔ד מִ/כֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vl' 'chr hn'r l'shvt hdbr khy chpts bbt y'qb vhv' nkhbd mkhl byt 'byv
verses.translation: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א חֲמ֛וֹר וּ/שְׁכֶ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ אֶל שַׁ֣עַר עִירָ֑/ם וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֛וּ אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֥י עִירָ֖/ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyb' chmvr vshkhm bnv 'l sh'r 'yrm vydbrv 'l 'nshy 'yrm l'mr
verses.translation: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

verses.original: הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֨ים הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה שְֽׁלֵמִ֧ים הֵ֣ם אִתָּ֗/נוּ וְ/יֵשְׁב֤וּ בָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וְ/יִסְחֲר֣וּ אֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/הָ/אָ֛רֶץ הִנֵּ֥ה רַֽחֲבַת יָדַ֖יִם לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶת בְּנֹתָ/ם֙ נִקַּֽח לָ֣/נוּ לְ/נָשִׁ֔ים וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֵ֖י/נוּ נִתֵּ֥ן לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: h'nshym h'lh shlmym hm 'tnv vyshbv b'rts vyschrv 'th vh'rts hnh rchbt ydym lpnyhm 't bntm nqch lnv lnshym v't bntynv ntn lhm
verses.translation: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

verses.original: אַךְ בְּ֠/זֹאת יֵאֹ֨תוּ לָ֤/נוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת אִתָּ֔/נוּ לִ/הְי֖וֹת לְ/עַ֣ם אֶחָ֑ד בְּ/הִמּ֥וֹל לָ֨/נוּ֙ כָּל זָכָ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֵ֥ם נִמֹּלִֽים
verses.translit: 'kh bz't y'tv lnv h'nshym lshbt 'tnv lhyvt l'm 'chd bhmvl lnv khl zkhr kh'shr hm nmlym
verses.translation: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

verses.original: מִקְנֵ/הֶ֤ם וְ/קִנְיָנָ/ם֙ וְ/כָל בְּהֶמְתָּ֔/ם הֲ/ל֥וֹא לָ֖/נוּ הֵ֑ם אַ֚ךְ נֵא֣וֹתָה לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/יֵשְׁב֖וּ אִתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: mqnhm vqnynm vkhl bhmtm hlv' lnv hm 'kh n'vth lhm vyshbv 'tnv
verses.translation: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶל חֲמוֹר֙ וְ/אֶל שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔/וֹ כָּל יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר עִיר֑/וֹ וַ/יִּמֹּ֨לוּ֙ כָּל זָכָ֔ר כָּל יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֥עַר עִירֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm'v 'l chmvr v'l shkhm bnv khl yts'y sh'r 'yrv vymlv khl zkhr khl yts'y sh'r 'yrv
verses.translation: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽ/הְיוֹתָ֣/ם כֹּֽאֲבִ֗ים וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי בְנֵי יַ֠עֲקֹב שִׁמְע֨וֹן וְ/לֵוִ֜י אֲחֵ֤י דִינָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ חַרְבּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ עַל הָ/עִ֖יר בֶּ֑טַח וַ/יַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל זָכָֽר
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy bhyvtm kh'bym vyqchv shny bny y'qb shm'vn vlvy 'chy dynh 'ysh chrbv vyb'v 'l h'yr btch vyhrgv khl zkhr
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חֲמוֹר֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔/וֹ הָרְג֖וּ לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וַ/יִּקְח֧וּ אֶת דִּינָ֛ה מִ/בֵּ֥ית שְׁכֶ֖ם וַ/יֵּצֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: v't chmvr v't shkhm bnv hrgv lpy chrb vyqchv 't dynh mbyt shkhm vyts'v
verses.translation: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּ֚אוּ עַל הַ֣/חֲלָלִ֔ים וַ/יָּבֹ֖זּוּ הָ/עִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר טִמְּא֖וּ אֲחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny y'qb b'v 'l hchllym vybzv h'yr 'shr tm'v 'chvtm
verses.translation: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

verses.original: אֶת צֹאנָ֥/ם וְ/אֶת בְּקָרָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת חֲמֹרֵי/הֶּ֑ם וְ/אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר בָּ/עִ֛יר וְ/אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לָקָֽחוּ
verses.translit: 't ts'nm v't bqrm v't chmryhm v't 'shr b'yr v't 'shr bshdh lqchv
verses.translation: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל חֵילָ֤/ם וְ/אֶת כָּל טַפָּ/ם֙ וְ/אֶת נְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם שָׁב֖וּ וַ/יָּבֹ֑זּוּ וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: v't khl chylm v't khl tpm v't nshyhm shbv vybzv v't khl 'shr bbyt
verses.translation: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל שִׁמְע֣וֹן וְ/אֶל לֵוִי֮ עֲכַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ/י֒ לְ/הַבְאִישֵׁ֨/נִי֙ בְּ/יֹשֵׁ֣ב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בַּֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּ/בַ/פְּרִזִּ֑י וַ/אֲנִי֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר וְ/נֶאֶסְפ֤וּ עָלַ/י֙ וְ/הִכּ֔וּ/נִי וְ/נִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י אֲנִ֥י וּ/בֵיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l shm'vn v'l lvy 'khrtm 'ty lhb'yshny byshb h'rts bkhn'ny vbprzy v'ny mty mspr vn'spv 'ly vhkhvny vnshmdty 'ny vbyty
verses.translation: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֑וּ הַ/כְ/זוֹנָ֕ה יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת אֲחוֹתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv hkhzvnh y'shh 't 'chvtnv
verses.translation: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֔ב ק֛וּם עֲלֵ֥ה בֵֽית אֵ֖ל וְ/שֶׁב שָׁ֑ם וַ/עֲשֵׂה שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לָ/אֵל֙ הַ/נִּרְאֶ֣ה אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/בָרְחֲ/ךָ֔ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l y'qb qvm 'lh byt 'l vshb shm v'shh shm mzbch l'l hnr'h 'lykh bbrchkh mpny 'shv 'chykh
verses.translation: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל בֵּית֔/וֹ וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑/וֹ הָסִ֜רוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/נֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/תֹכְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִֽטַּהֲר֔וּ וְ/הַחֲלִ֖יפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l bytv v'l khl 'shr 'mv hsrv 't 'lhy hnkhr 'shr btkhkhm vhthrv vhchlypv shmltykhm
verses.translation: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

verses.original: וְ/נָק֥וּמָה וְ/נַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה שָּׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ לָ/אֵ֞ל הָ/עֹנֶ֤ה אֹתִ/י֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם צָֽרָתִ֔/י וַ/יְהִי֙ עִמָּדִ֔/י בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתִּי
verses.translit: vnqvmh vn'lh byt 'l v''shh shm mzbch l'l h'nh 'ty byvm tsrty vyhy 'mdy bdrkh 'shr hlkhty
verses.translation: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֗ב אֵ֣ת כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/נֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יָדָ֔/ם וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּזָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּטְמֹ֤ן אֹתָ/ם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב תַּ֥חַת הָ/אֵלָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vytnv 'l y'qb 't khl 'lhy hnkhr 'shr bydm v't hnzmym 'shr b'znyhm vytmn 'tm y'qb tcht h'lh 'shr 'm shkhm
verses.translation: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסָּ֑עוּ וַ/יְהִ֣י חִתַּ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל הֶֽ/עָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֣א רָֽדְפ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vys'v vyhy chtt 'lhym 'l h'rym 'shr sbybtyhm vl' rdpv 'chry bny y'qb
verses.translation: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב ל֗וּזָ/ה אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן הִ֖וא בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל ה֖וּא וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb lvzh 'shr b'rts khn'n hv' byt 'l hv' vkhl h'm 'shr 'mv
verses.translation: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is , Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ לַ/מָּק֔וֹם אֵ֖ל בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם נִגְל֤וּ אֵלָי/ו֙ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּ/בָרְח֖/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vybn shm mzbch vyqr' lmqvm 'l byt 'l khy shm nglv 'lyv h'lhym bbrchv mpny 'chyv
verses.translation: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֤מָת דְּבֹרָה֙ מֵינֶ֣קֶת רִבְקָ֔ה וַ/תִּקָּבֵ֛ר מִ/תַּ֥חַת לְ/בֵֽית אֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הָֽ/אַלּ֑וֹן וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ אַלּ֥וֹן בָּכֽוּת
verses.translit: vtmt dbrh mynqt rbqh vtqbr mtcht lbyt 'l tcht h'lvn vyqr' shmv 'lvn bkhvt
verses.translation: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב֙ ע֔וֹד בְּ/בֹא֖/וֹ מִ/פַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 'l y'qb 'vd bb'v mpdn 'rm vybrkh 'tv
verses.translation: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר ל֥/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לֹֽא יִקָּרֵא֩ שִׁמְ/ךָ֨ ע֜וֹד יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּ֤י אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lhym shmkh y'qb l' yqr' shmkh 'vd y'qb khy 'm yshr'l yhyh shmkh vyqr' 't shmv yshr'l
verses.translation: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֲנִ֨י אֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ פְּרֵ֣ה וּ/רְבֵ֔ה גּ֛וֹי וּ/קְהַ֥ל גּוֹיִ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑/ךָּ וּ/מְלָכִ֖ים מֵ/חֲלָצֶ֥י/ךָ יֵצֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lhym 'ny 'l shdy prh vrbh gvy vqhl gvym yhyh mmkh vmlkhym mchltsykh yts'v
verses.translation: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛תִּי לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם וּ/לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק לְ/ךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑/נָּה וּֽ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v't h'rts 'shr ntty l'brhm vlytschq lkh 'tnnh vlzr'kh 'chrykh 'tn 't h'rts
verses.translation: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל מֵ/עָלָ֖י/ו אֱלֹהִ֑ים בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'l m'lyv 'lhym bmqvm 'shr dbr 'tv
verses.translation: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֵּ֨ב יַעֲקֹ֜ב מַצֵּבָ֗ה בַּ/מָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ מַצֶּ֣בֶת אָ֑בֶן וַ/יַּסֵּ֤ךְ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ נֶ֔סֶךְ וַ/יִּצֹ֥ק עָלֶ֖י/הָ שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vytsb y'qb mtsbh bmqvm 'shr dbr 'tv mtsbt 'bn vyskh 'lyh nskh vytsq 'lyh shmn
verses.translation: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת שֵׁ֣ם הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר אִתּ֥/וֹ שָׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb 't shm hmqvm 'shr dbr 'tv shm 'lhym byt 'l
verses.translation: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית אֵ֔ל וַֽ/יְהִי ע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶפְרָ֑תָה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד רָחֵ֖ל וַ/תְּקַ֥שׁ בְּ/לִדְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vys'v mbyt 'l vyhy 'vd khbrt h'rts lbv' 'prth vtld rchl vtqsh bldth
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י בְ/הַקְשֹׁתָ֖/הּ בְּ/לִדְתָּ֑/הּ וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֤/הּ הַ/מְיַלֶּ֨דֶת֙ אַל תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי גַם זֶ֥ה לָ֖/ךְ בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyhy bhqshth bldth vt'mr lh hmyldt 'l tyr'y khy gm zh lkh bn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בְּ/צֵ֤את נַפְשָׁ/הּ֙ כִּ֣י מֵ֔תָה וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ בֶּן אוֹנִ֑י וְ/אָבִ֖י/ו קָֽרָא ל֥/וֹ בִנְיָמִֽין
verses.translit: vyhy bts't npshh khy mth vtqr' shmv bn 'vny v'byv qr' lv bnymyn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֖מָת רָחֵ֑ל וַ/תִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔תָה הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vtmt rchl vtqbr bdrkh 'prth hv' byt lchm
verses.translation: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֵּ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב מַצֵּבָ֖ה עַל קְבֻרָתָ֑/הּ הִ֛וא מַצֶּ֥בֶת קְבֻֽרַת רָחֵ֖ל עַד הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vytsb y'qb mtsbh 'l qbrth hv' mtsbt qbrt rchl 'd hyvm
verses.translation: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֣ט אָֽהֳלֹ֔/ה מֵ/הָ֖לְאָה לְ/מִגְדַּל עֵֽדֶר
verses.translit: vys' yshr'l vyt 'hlh mhl'h lmgdl 'dr
verses.translation: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/שְׁכֹּ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֔וא וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַ/יִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת בִּלְהָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vyhy bshkhn yshr'l b'rts hhv' vylkh r'vbn vyshkhb 't blhh pylgsh 'byv vyshm' yshr'l vyhyv bny y'qb shnym 'shr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֔ה בְּכ֥וֹר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְ/שִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְ/לֵוִ֣י וִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וְ/יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וּ/זְבוּלֻֽן
verses.translit: bny l'h bkhvr y'qb r'vbn vshm'vn vlvy vyhvdh vyshshkhr vzbvln
verses.translation: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל יוֹסֵ֖ף וּ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: bny rchl yvsf vbnymn
verses.translation: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֤י בִלְהָה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֔ל דָּ֖ן וְ/נַפְתָּלִֽי
verses.translit: vbny blhh shpcht rchl dn vnptly
verses.translation: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה גָּ֣ד וְ/אָשֵׁ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּד ל֖/וֹ בְּ/פַדַּ֥ן אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vbny zlph shpcht l'h gd v'shr 'lh bny y'qb 'shr yld lv bpdn 'rm
verses.translation: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֔י/ו מַמְרֵ֖א קִרְיַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבַּ֑ע הִ֣וא חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּֽר שָׁ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְ/יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb 'l ytschq 'byv mmr' qryt h'rb' hv' chbrvn 'shr gr shm 'brhm vytschq
verses.translation: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֖וּ יְמֵ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhyv ymy ytschq m't shnh vshmnym shnh
verses.translation: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְוַ֨ע יִצְחָ֤ק וַ/יָּ֨מָת֙ וַ/יֵּאָ֣סֶף אֶל עַמָּ֔י/ו זָקֵ֖ן וּ/שְׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ עֵשָׂ֥ו וְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב בָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vygv' ytschq vymt vy'sf 'l 'myv zqn vshb' ymym vyqbrv 'tv 'shv vy'qb bnyv
verses.translation: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'lh tldvt 'shv hv' 'dvm
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת נָשָׁ֖י/ו מִ/בְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת עָדָ֗ה בַּת אֵילוֹן֙ הַֽ/חִתִּ֔י וְ/אֶת אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת עֲנָ֔ה בַּת צִבְע֖וֹן הַֽ/חִוִּֽי
verses.translit: 'shv lqch 't nshyv mbnvt khn'n 't 'dh bt 'ylvn hchty v't 'hlybmh bt 'nh bt tsb'vn hchvy
verses.translation: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲח֥וֹת נְבָיֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't bshmt bt yshm''l 'chvt nbyvt
verses.translation: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְ/עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּ/בָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת רְעוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vtld 'dh l'shv 't 'lypz vbshmt yldh 't r'v'l
verses.translation: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

verses.original: וְ/אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת יעיש יְע֥וּשׁ וְ/אֶת יַעְלָ֖ם וְ/אֶת קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ ל֖/וֹ בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: v'hlybmh yldh 't y'ysh y'vsh v't y'lm v't qrch 'lh bny 'shv 'shr yldv lv b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת נָ֠שָׁי/ו וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתָי/ו֮ וְ/אֶת כָּל נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּית/וֹ֒ וְ/אֶת מִקְנֵ֣/הוּ וְ/אֶת כָּל בְּהֶמְתּ֗/וֹ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל קִנְיָנ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל אֶ֔רֶץ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqch 'shv 't nshyv v't bnyv v't bntyv v't khl npshvt bytv v't mqnhv v't khl bhmtv v't khl qnynv 'shr rkhsh b'rts khn'n vylkh 'l 'rts mpny y'qb 'chyv
verses.translation: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛/ם רָ֖ב מִ/שֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְ/לֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵי/הֶם֙ לָ/שֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔/ם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy hyh rkhvshm rb mshbt ychdv vl' ykhlh 'rts mgvryhm lsh't 'tm mpny mqnyhm
verses.translation: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshb 'shv bhr sh'yr 'shv hv' 'dvm
verses.translation: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּ/הַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר
verses.translit: v'lh tldvt 'shv 'by 'dvm bhr sh'yr
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt bny 'shv 'lypz bn 'dh 'sht 'shv r'v'l bn bshmt 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אוֹמָ֔ר צְפ֥וֹ וְ/גַעְתָּ֖ם וּ/קְנַֽז
verses.translit: vyhyv bny 'lypz tymn 'vmr tspv vg'tm vqnz
verses.translation: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.original: וְ/תִמְנַ֣ע הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽ/אֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן עֵשָׂ֔ו וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד לֶ/אֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: vtmn' hyth pylgsh l'lypz bn 'shv vtld l'lypz 't 'mlq 'lh bny 'dh 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָ/זֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּ/מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּ֣ה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: v'lh bny r'v'l ncht vzrch shmh vmzh 'lh hyv bny bshmt 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אָהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת עֲנָ֛ה בַּת צִבְע֖וֹן אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד לְ/עֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת יעיש יְע֥וּשׁ וְ/אֶת יַעְלָ֖ם וְ/אֶת קֹֽרַח
verses.translit: v'lh hyv bny 'hlybmh bt 'nh bt tsb'vn 'sht 'shv vtld l'shv 't y'ysh y'vsh v't y'lm v't qrch
verses.translation: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכ֣וֹר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אוֹמָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז
verses.translit: 'lh 'lvpy bny 'shv bny 'lypz bkhvr 'shv 'lvf tymn 'lvf 'vmr 'lvf tspv 'lvf qnz
verses.translation: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

verses.original: אַלּֽוּף קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה
verses.translit: 'lvf qrch 'lvf g'tm 'lvf 'mlq 'lh 'lvpy 'lypz b'rts 'dvm 'lh bny 'dh
verses.translation: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֨חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: v'lh bny r'v'l bn 'shv 'lvf ncht 'lvf zrch 'lvf shmh 'lvf mzh 'lh 'lvpy r'v'l b'rts 'dvm 'lh bny bshmt 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'hlybmh 'sht 'shv 'lvf y'vsh 'lvf y'lm 'lvf qrch 'lh 'lvpy 'hlybmh bt 'nh 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

verses.original: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי עֵשָׂ֛ו וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵי/הֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'lh bny 'shv v'lh 'lvpyhm hv' 'dvm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי שֵׂעִיר֙ הַ/חֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לוֹטָ֥ן וְ/שׁוֹבָ֖ל וְ/צִבְע֥וֹן וַ/עֲנָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh bny sh'yr hchry yshby h'rts lvtn vshvbl vtsb'vn v'nh
verses.translation: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

verses.original: וְ/דִשׁ֥וֹן וְ/אֵ֖צֶר וְ/דִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַ/חֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vdshvn v'tsr vdyshn 'lh 'lvpy hchry bny sh'yr b'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְ/הֵימָ֑ם וַ/אֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע
verses.translit: vyhyv bny lvtn chry vhymm v'chvt lvtn tmn'
verses.translation: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּ/מָנַ֖חַת וְ/עֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפ֖וֹ וְ/אוֹנָֽם
verses.translit: v'lh bny shvbl 'lvn vmncht v'ybl shpv v'vnm
verses.translation: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
