verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי צִבְע֖וֹן וְ/אַיָּ֣ה וַ/עֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת הַ/יֵּמִם֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּ/רְעֹת֥/וֹ אֶת הַ/חֲמֹרִ֖ים לְ/צִבְע֥וֹן אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'lh bny tsb'vn v'yh v'nh hv' 'nh 'shr mts' 't hymm bmdbr br'tv 't hchmrym ltsb'vn 'byv
verses.translation: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְ/אָהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת עֲנָֽה
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'nh dshn v'hlybmh bt 'nh
verses.translation: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְ/אֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְ/יִתְרָ֥ן וּ/כְרָֽן
verses.translit: v'lh bny dyshn chmdn v'shbn vytrn vkhrn
verses.translation: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְ/זַעֲוָ֖ן וַ/עֲקָֽן
verses.translit: 'lh bny 'tsr blhn vz'vn v'qn
verses.translation: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַ/אֲרָֽן
verses.translit: 'lh bny dyshn 'vts v'rn
verses.translation: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַ/חֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לוֹטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שׁוֹבָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְע֖וֹן אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh 'lvpy hchry 'lvf lvtn 'lvf shvbl 'lvf tsb'vn 'lvf 'nh
verses.translation: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַ/חֹרִ֛י לְ/אַלֻּפֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר
verses.translit: 'lvf dshn 'lvf 'tsr 'lvf dyshn 'lh 'lvpy hchry l'lpyhm b'rts sh'yr
verses.translation: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַ/מְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם לִ/פְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh hmlkhym 'shr mlkhv b'rts 'dvm lpny mlkh mlkh lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּ/אֱד֔וֹם בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן בְּע֑וֹר וְ/שֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖/וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה
verses.translit: vymlkh b'dvm bl' bn b'vr vshm 'yrv dnhbh
verses.translation: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן זֶ֖רַח מִ/בָּצְרָֽה
verses.translit: vymt bl' vymlkh tchtyv yvbb bn zrch mbtsrh
verses.translation: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/תֵּימָנִֽי
verses.translit: vymt yvbb vymlkh tchtyv chshm m'rts htymny
verses.translation: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַ/יִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜י/ו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן בְּדַ֗ד הַ/מַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת מִדְיָן֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/שֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖/וֹ עֲוִֽית
verses.translit: vymt chshm vymlkh tchtyv hdd bn bdd hmkhh 't mdyn bshdh mv'b vshm 'yrv 'vyt
verses.translation: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִ/מַּשְׂרֵקָֽה
verses.translit: vymt hdd vymlkh tchtyv shmlh mmshrqh
verses.translation: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו שָׁא֖וּל מֵ/רְחֹב֥וֹת הַ/נָּהָֽר
verses.translit: vymt shmlh vymlkh tchtyv sh'vl mrchbvt hnhr
verses.translation: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן עַכְבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vymlkh tchtyv b'l chnn bn 'khbvr
verses.translation: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּמָת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר֒ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּי/ו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְ/שֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖/וֹ פָּ֑עוּ וְ/שֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤/וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vymt b'l chnn bn 'khbvr vymlkh tchtyv hdr vshm 'yrv p'v vshm 'shtv mhytb'l bt mtrd bt my zhb
verses.translation: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

verses.original: וְ֠/אֵלֶּה שְׁמ֞וֹת אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔/ם לִ/מְקֹמֹתָ֖/ם בִּ/שְׁמֹתָ֑/ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt 'lvpy 'shv lmshpchtm lmqmtm bshmtm 'lvf tmn' 'lvf 'lvh 'lvf ytt
verses.translation: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

verses.original: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן
verses.translit: 'lvf 'hlybmh 'lvf 'lh 'lvf pynn
verses.translation: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר
verses.translit: 'lvf qnz 'lvf tymn 'lvf mbtsr
verses.translation: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֗וֹם לְ/מֹֽשְׁבֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔/ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'lvf mgdy'l 'lvf 'yrm 'lh 'lvpy 'dvm lmshbtm b'rts 'chztm hv' 'shv 'by 'dvm
verses.translation: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ מְגוּרֵ֣י אָבִ֑י/ו בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vyshb y'qb b'rts mgvry 'byv b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה תֹּלְד֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֗ב יוֹסֵ֞ף בֶּן שְׁבַֽע עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֨ה רֹעֶ֤ה אֶת אֶחָי/ו֙ בַּ/צֹּ֔אן וְ/ה֣וּא נַ֗עַר אֶת בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָ֛ה וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֖ה נְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת דִּבָּתָ֥/ם רָעָ֖ה אֶל אֲבִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'lh tldvt y'qb yvsf bn shb' 'shrh shnh hyh r'h 't 'chyv bts'n vhv' n'r 't bny blhh v't bny zlph nshy 'byv vyb' yvsf 't dbtm r'h 'l 'byhm
verses.translation: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָהַ֤ב אֶת יוֹסֵף֙ מִ/כָּל בָּנָ֔י/ו כִּֽי בֶן זְקֻנִ֥ים ה֖וּא ל֑/וֹ וְ/עָ֥שָׂה ל֖/וֹ כְּתֹ֥נֶת פַּסִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshr'l 'hb 't yvsf mkhl bnyv khy bn zqnym hv' lv v'shh lv khtnt psym
verses.translation: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֣וּ אֶחָ֗י/ו כִּֽי אֹת֞/וֹ אָהַ֤ב אֲבִי/הֶם֙ מִ/כָּל אֶחָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּשְׂנְא֖וּ אֹת֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ דַּבְּר֥/וֹ לְ/שָׁלֹֽם
verses.translit: vyr'v 'chyv khy 'tv 'hb 'byhm mkhl 'chyv vyshn'v 'tv vl' ykhlv dbrv lshlm
verses.translation: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲלֹ֤ם יוֹסֵף֙ חֲל֔וֹם וַ/יַּגֵּ֖ד לְ/אֶחָ֑י/ו וַ/יּוֹסִ֥פוּ ע֖וֹד שְׂנֹ֥א אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychlm yvsf chlvm vygd l'chyv vyvspv 'vd shn' 'tv
verses.translation: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם שִׁמְעוּ נָ֕א הַ/חֲל֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָלָֽמְתִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm shm'v n' hchlvm hzh 'shr chlmty
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

verses.original: וְ֠/הִנֵּה אֲנַ֜חְנוּ מְאַלְּמִ֤ים אֲלֻמִּים֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה קָ֥מָה אֲלֻמָּתִ֖/י וְ/גַם נִצָּ֑בָה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה תְסֻבֶּ֨ינָה֙ אֲלֻמֹּ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וַ/תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖יןָ לַ/אֲלֻמָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhnh 'nchnv m'lmym 'lmym btvkh hshdh vhnh qmh 'lmty vgm ntsbh vhnh tsbynh 'lmtykhm vtshtchvyn l'lmty
verses.translation: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ אֶחָ֔י/ו הֲ/מָלֹ֤ךְ תִּמְלֹךְ֙ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ אִם מָשׁ֥וֹל תִּמְשֹׁ֖ל בָּ֑/נוּ וַ/יּוֹסִ֤פוּ עוֹד֙ שְׂנֹ֣א אֹת֔/וֹ עַל חֲלֹמֹתָ֖י/ו וְ/עַל דְּבָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'chyv hmlkh tmlkh 'lynv 'm mshvl tmshl bnv vyvspv 'vd shn' 'tv 'l chlmtyv v'l dbryv
verses.translation: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲלֹ֥ם עוֹד֙ חֲל֣וֹם אַחֵ֔ר וַ/יְסַפֵּ֥ר אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/אֶחָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֨ה חָלַ֤מְתִּֽי חֲלוֹם֙ ע֔וֹד וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה הַ/שֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ וְ/הַ/יָּרֵ֗חַ וְ/אַחַ֤ד עָשָׂר֙ כּֽוֹכָבִ֔ים מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֖ים לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vychlm 'vd chlvm 'chr vyspr 'tv l'chyv vy'mr hnh chlmty chlvm 'vd vhnh hshmsh vhyrch v'chd 'shr khvkhbym mshtchvym ly
verses.translation: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפֵּ֣ר אֶל אָבִי/ו֮ וְ/אֶל אֶחָי/ו֒ וַ/יִּגְעַר בּ֣/וֹ אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ מָ֛ה הַ/חֲל֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָלָ֑מְתָּ הֲ/ב֣וֹא נָב֗וֹא אֲנִי֙ וְ/אִמְּ/ךָ֣ וְ/אַחֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֥ת לְ/ךָ֖ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyspr 'l 'byv v'l 'chyv vyg'r bv 'byv vy'mr lv mh hchlvm hzh 'shr chlmt hbv' nbv' 'ny v'mkh v'chykh lhshtchvt lkh 'rtsh
verses.translation: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

verses.original: וַ/יְקַנְאוּ ב֖/וֹ אֶחָ֑י/ו וְ/אָבִ֖י/ו שָׁמַ֥ר אֶת הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyqn'v bv 'chyv v'byv shmr 't hdbr
verses.translation: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אֶחָ֑י/ו לִ/רְע֛וֹת אֶׄתׄ צֹ֥אן אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם בִּ/שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vylkhv 'chyv lr'vt 't ts'n 'byhm bshkhm
verses.translation: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל יוֹסֵ֗ף הֲ/ל֤וֹא אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ רֹעִ֣ים בִּ/שְׁכֶ֔ם לְכָ֖/ה וְ/אֶשְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ הִנֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l 'l yvsf hlv' 'chykh r'ym bshkhm lkhh v'shlchkh 'lyhm vy'mr lv hnny
verses.translation: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ לֶךְ נָ֨א רְאֵ֜ה אֶת שְׁל֤וֹם אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁל֣וֹם הַ/צֹּ֔אן וַ/הֲשִׁבֵ֖/נִי דָּבָ֑ר וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֵ֨/הוּ֙ מֵ/עֵ֣מֶק חֶבְר֔וֹן וַ/יָּבֹ֖א שְׁכֶֽמָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr lv lkh n' r'h 't shlvm 'chykh v't shlvm hts'n vhshbny dbr vyshlchhv m'mq chbrvn vyb' shkhmh
verses.translation: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְצָאֵ֣/הוּ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה תֹעֶ֖ה בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁאָלֵ֧/הוּ הָ/אִ֛ישׁ לֵ/אמֹ֖ר מַה תְּבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vymts'hv 'ysh vhnh t'h bshdh vysh'lhv h'ysh l'mr mh tbqsh
verses.translation: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת אַחַ֖/י אָנֹכִ֣י מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֣א לִ֔/י אֵיפֹ֖ה הֵ֥ם רֹעִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 't 'chy 'nkhy mbqsh hgydh n' ly 'yph hm r'ym
verses.translation: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הָ/אִישׁ֙ נָסְע֣וּ מִ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים נֵלְכָ֖ה דֹּתָ֑יְנָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ יוֹסֵף֙ אַחַ֣ר אֶחָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּמְצָאֵ֖/ם בְּ/דֹתָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr h'ysh ns'v mzh khy shm'ty 'mrym nlkhh dtynh vylkh yvsf 'chr 'chyv vymts'm bdtn
verses.translation: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ מֵ/רָחֹ֑ק וּ/בְ/טֶ֨רֶם֙ יִקְרַ֣ב אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּֽתְנַכְּל֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ לַ/הֲמִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr'v 'tv mrchq vbtrm yqrb 'lyhm vytnkhlv 'tv lhmytv
verses.translation: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑י/ו הִנֵּ֗ה בַּ֛עַל הַ/חֲלֹמ֥וֹת הַלָּזֶ֖ה בָּֽא
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l 'chyv hnh b'l hchlmvt hlzh b'
verses.translation: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה לְכ֣וּ וְ/נַֽהַרְגֵ֗/הוּ וְ/נַשְׁלִכֵ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/אַחַ֣ד הַ/בֹּר֔וֹת וְ/אָמַ֕רְנוּ חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֖ה אֲכָלָ֑תְ/הוּ וְ/נִרְאֶ֕ה מַה יִּהְי֖וּ חֲלֹמֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'th lkhv vnhrghv vnshlkhhv b'chd hbrvt v'mrnv chyh r'h 'khlthv vnr'h mh yhyv chlmtyv
verses.translation: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַ/יַּצִּלֵ֖/הוּ מִ/יָּדָ֑/ם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א נַכֶּ֖/נּוּ נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: vyshm' r'vbn vytslhv mydm vy'mr l' nkhnv npsh
verses.translation: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֣ם רְאוּבֵן֮ אַל תִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם֒ הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֗/וֹ אֶל הַ/בּ֤וֹר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וְ/יָ֖ד אַל תִּשְׁלְחוּ ב֑/וֹ לְמַ֗עַן הַצִּ֤יל אֹת/וֹ֙ מִ/יָּדָ֔/ם לַ/הֲשִׁיב֖/וֹ אֶל אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm r'vbn 'l tshpkhv dm hshlykhv 'tv 'l hbvr hzh 'shr bmdbr vyd 'l tshlchv bv lm'n htsyl 'tv mydm lhshybv 'l 'byv
verses.translation: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֕י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶל אֶחָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף֙ אֶת כֻּתָּנְתּ֔/וֹ אֶת כְּתֹ֥נֶת הַ/פַּסִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr b' yvsf 'l 'chyv vypshytv 't yvsf 't khtntv 't khtnt hpsym 'shr 'lyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨קָּחֻ֔/הוּ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖/וֹ הַ/בֹּ֑רָ/ה וְ/הַ/בּ֣וֹר רֵ֔ק אֵ֥ין בּ֖/וֹ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqchhv vyshlkhv 'tv hbrh vhbvr rq 'yn bv mym
verses.translation: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁבוּ֮ לֶֽ/אֱכָל לֶחֶם֒ וַ/יִּשְׂא֤וּ עֵֽינֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יִּרְא֔וּ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ אֹרְחַ֣ת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים בָּאָ֖ה מִ/גִּלְעָ֑ד וּ/גְמַלֵּי/הֶ֣ם נֹֽשְׂאִ֗ים נְכֹאת֙ וּ/צְרִ֣י וָ/לֹ֔ט הוֹלְכִ֖ים לְ/הוֹרִ֥יד מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshbv l'khl lchm vysh'v 'ynyhm vyr'v vhnh 'rcht yshm''lym b'h mgl'd vgmlyhm nsh'ym nkh't vtsry vlt hvlkhym lhvryd mtsrymh
verses.translation: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶל אֶחָ֑י/ו מַה בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י נַהֲרֹג֙ אֶת אָחִ֔י/נוּ וְ/כִסִּ֖ינוּ אֶת דָּמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh 'l 'chyv mh bts' khy nhrg 't 'chynv vkhsynv 't dmv
verses.translation: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

verses.original: לְכ֞וּ וְ/נִמְכְּרֶ֣/נּוּ לַ/יִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֗ים וְ/יָדֵ֨/נוּ֙ אַל תְּהִי ב֔/וֹ כִּֽי אָחִ֥י/נוּ בְשָׂרֵ֖/נוּ ה֑וּא וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֖וּ אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lkhv vnmkhrnv lyshm''lym vydnv 'l thy bv khy 'chynv bshrnv hv' vyshm'v 'chyv
verses.translation: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַבְרוּ֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים מִדְיָנִ֜ים סֹֽחֲרִ֗ים וַֽ/יִּמְשְׁכוּ֙ וַ/יַּֽעֲל֤וּ אֶת יוֹסֵף֙ מִן הַ/בּ֔וֹר וַ/יִּמְכְּר֧וּ אֶת יוֹסֵ֛ף לַ/יִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֖ים בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים כָּ֑סֶף וַ/יָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת יוֹסֵ֖ף מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'brv 'nshym mdynym schrym vymshkhv vy'lv 't yvsf mn hbvr vymkhrv 't yvsf lyshm''lym b'shrym khsf vyby'v 't yvsf mtsrymh
verses.translation: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב רְאוּבֵן֙ אֶל הַ/בּ֔וֹר וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אֵין יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּ/בּ֑וֹר וַ/יִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb r'vbn 'l hbvr vhnh 'yn yvsf bbvr vyqr' 't bgdyv
verses.translation: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב אֶל אֶחָ֖י/ו וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַ/יֶּ֣לֶד אֵינֶ֔/נּוּ וַ/אֲנִ֖י אָ֥נָה אֲנִי בָֽא
verses.translit: vyshb 'l 'chyv vy'mr hyld 'ynnv v'ny 'nh 'ny b'
verses.translation: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֖וּ אֶת כְּתֹ֣נֶת יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲטוּ֙ שְׂעִ֣יר עִזִּ֔ים וַ/יִּטְבְּל֥וּ אֶת הַ/כֻּתֹּ֖נֶת בַּ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: vyqchv 't khtnt yvsf vyshchtv sh'yr 'zym vytblv 't hkhtnt bdm
verses.translation: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

verses.original: וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּח֞וּ אֶת כְּתֹ֣נֶת הַ/פַּסִּ֗ים וַ/יָּבִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶל אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ זֹ֣את מָצָ֑אנוּ הַכֶּר נָ֗א הַ/כְּתֹ֧נֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֛ הִ֖וא אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: vyshlchv 't khtnt hpsym vyby'v 'l 'byhm vy'mrv z't mts'nv hkhr n' hkhtnt bnkh hv' 'm l'
verses.translation: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכִּירָ֤/הּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כְּתֹ֣נֶת בְּנִ֔/י חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֖ה אֲכָלָ֑תְ/הוּ טָרֹ֥ף טֹרַ֖ף יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vykhyrh vy'mr khtnt bny chyh r'h 'khlthv trf trf yvsf
verses.translation: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרַ֤ע יַעֲקֹב֙ שִׂמְלֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם שַׂ֖ק בְּ/מָתְנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְאַבֵּ֥ל עַל בְּנ֖/וֹ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb shmltyv vyshm shq bmtnyv vyt'bl 'l bnv ymym rbym
verses.translation: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻמוּ֩ כָל בָּנָ֨י/ו וְ/כָל בְּנֹתָ֜י/ו לְ/נַחֲמ֗/וֹ וַ/יְמָאֵן֙ לְ/הִתְנַחֵ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כִּֽי אֵרֵ֧ד אֶל בְּנִ֛/י אָבֵ֖ל שְׁאֹ֑לָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ אֹת֖/וֹ אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqmv khl bnyv vkhl bntyv lnchmv vym'n lhtnchm vy'mr khy 'rd 'l bny 'bl sh'lh vybkh 'tv 'byv
verses.translation: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/מְּדָנִ֔ים מָכְר֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ אֶל מִצְרָ֑יִם לְ/פֽוֹטִיפַר֙ סְרִ֣יס פַּרְעֹ֔ה שַׂ֖ר הַ/טַּבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: vhmdnym mkhrv 'tv 'l mtsrym lpvtypr srys pr'h shr htbchym
verses.translation: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔וא וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֣ת אֶחָ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּ֛ט עַד אִ֥ישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִ֖י וּ/שְׁמ֥/וֹ חִירָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy b't hhv' vyrd yhvdh m't 'chyv vyt 'd 'ysh 'dlmy vshmv chyrh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא שָׁ֧ם יְהוּדָ֛ה בַּת אִ֥ישׁ כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ שׁ֑וּעַ וַ/יִּקָּחֶ֖/הָ וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyr' shm yhvdh bt 'ysh khn'ny vshmv shv' vyqchh vyb' 'lyh
verses.translation: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֖הַר וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ עֵֽר
verses.translit: vthr vtld bn vyqr' 't shmv 'r
verses.translation: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֥הַר ע֖וֹד וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ אוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bn vtqr' 't shmv 'vnn
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤סֶף עוֹד֙ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ שֵׁלָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה בִ/כְזִ֖יב בְּ/לִדְתָּ֥/הּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtsf 'vd vtld bn vtqr' 't shmv shlh vhyh bkhzyb bldth 'tv
verses.translation: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֧ח יְהוּדָ֛ה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְ/עֵ֣ר בְּכוֹר֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁמָ֖/הּ תָּמָֽר
verses.translit: vyqch yhvdh 'shh l'r bkhvrv vshmh tmr
verses.translation: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י עֵ֚ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֔ה רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְמִתֵ֖/הוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'r bkhvr yhvdh r' b'yny yhvh vymthv yhvh
verses.translation: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD ; and the LORD slew him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ לְ/אוֹנָ֔ן בֹּ֛א אֶל אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖י/ךָ וְ/יַבֵּ֣ם אֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/הָקֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע לְ/אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh l'vnn b' 'l 'sht 'chykh vybm 'th vhqm zr' l'chykh
verses.translation: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣דַע אוֹנָ֔ן כִּ֛י לֹּ֥א ל֖/וֹ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַ/זָּ֑רַע וְ/הָיָ֞ה אִם בָּ֨א אֶל אֵ֤שֶׁת אָחִי/ו֙ וְ/שִׁחֵ֣ת אַ֔רְצָ/ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י נְתָן זֶ֖רַע לְ/אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyd' 'vnn khy l' lv yhyh hzr' vhyh 'm b' 'l 'sht 'chyv vshcht 'rtsh lblty ntn zr' l'chyv
verses.translation: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֛רַע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַ/יָּ֖מֶת גַּם אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' b'yny yhvh 'shr 'shh vymt gm 'tv
verses.translation: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD : wherefore he slew him also.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְ/תָמָ֨ר כַּלָּת֜/וֹ שְׁבִ֧י אַלְמָנָ֣ה בֵית אָבִ֗י/ךְ עַד יִגְדַּל֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֔/י כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן יָמ֥וּת גַּם ה֖וּא כְּ/אֶחָ֑י/ו וַ/תֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֔ר וַ/תֵּ֖שֶׁב בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh ltmr khltv shby 'lmnh byt 'bykh 'd ygdl shlh bny khy 'mr pn ymvt gm hv' kh'chyv vtlkh tmr vtshb byt 'byh
verses.translation: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְבּוּ֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וַ/תָּ֖מָת בַּת שׁ֣וּעַ אֵֽשֶׁת יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יַּ֜עַל עַל גֹּֽזֲזֵ֤י צֹאנ/וֹ֙ ה֗וּא וְ/חִירָ֛ה רֵעֵ֥/הוּ הָ/עֲדֻלָּמִ֖י תִּמְנָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyrbv hymym vtmt bt shv' 'sht yhvdh vynchm yhvdh vy'l 'l gzzy ts'nv hv' vchyrh r'hv h'dlmy tmnth
verses.translation: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֥ד לְ/תָמָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֥ה חָמִ֛י/ךְ עֹלֶ֥ה תִמְנָ֖תָ/ה לָ/גֹ֥ז צֹאנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vygd ltmr l'mr hnh chmykh 'lh tmnth lgz ts'nv
verses.translation: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

verses.original: וַ/תָּסַר֩ בִּגְדֵ֨י אַלְמְנוּתָ֜/הּ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֗י/הָ וַ/תְּכַ֤ס בַּ/צָּעִיף֙ וַ/תִּתְעַלָּ֔ף וַ/תֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּ/פֶ֣תַח עֵינַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל דֶּ֣רֶךְ תִּמְנָ֑תָ/ה כִּ֤י רָאֲתָה֙ כִּֽי גָדַ֣ל שֵׁלָ֔ה וְ/הִ֕וא לֹֽא נִתְּנָ֥ה ל֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vtsr bgdy 'lmnvth m'lyh vtkhs bts'yf vtt'lf vtshb bptch 'ynym 'shr 'l drkh tmnth khy r'th khy gdl shlh vhv' l' ntnh lv l'shh
verses.translation: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאֶ֣/הָ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽ/יַּחְשְׁבֶ֖/הָ לְ/זוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֥י כִסְּתָ֖ה פָּנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyr'h yhvdh vychshbh lzvnh khy khsth pnyh
verses.translation: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨ט אֵלֶ֜י/הָ אֶל הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽבָ/ה נָּא֙ אָב֣וֹא אֵלַ֔יִ/ךְ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כַלָּת֖/וֹ הִ֑וא וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מַה תִּתֶּן לִּ֔/י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyt 'lyh 'l hdrkh vy'mr hbh n' 'bv' 'lykh khy l' yd' khy khltv hv' vt'mr mh ttn ly khy tbv' 'ly
verses.translation: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֛י אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח גְּדִֽי עִזִּ֖ים מִן הַ/צֹּ֑אן וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר אִם תִּתֵּ֥ן עֵרָב֖וֹן עַ֥ד שָׁלְחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'nkhy 'shlch gdy 'zym mn hts'n vt'mr 'm ttn 'rbvn 'd shlchkh
verses.translation: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֣ה הָֽ/עֵרָבוֹן֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶתֶּן לָּ/ךְ֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר חֹתָֽמְ/ךָ֙ וּ/פְתִילֶ֔/ךָ וּ/מַטְּ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יִּתֶּן לָּ֛/הּ וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖י/הָ וַ/תַּ֥הַר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr mh h'rbvn 'shr 'tn lkh vt'mr chtmkh vptylkh vmtkh 'shr bydkh vytn lh vyb' 'lyh vthr lv
verses.translation: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֣קָם וַ/תֵּ֔לֶךְ וַ/תָּ֥סַר צְעִיפָ֖/הּ מֵ/עָלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/תִּלְבַּ֖שׁ בִּגְדֵ֥י אַלְמְנוּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtqm vtlkh vtsr ts'yph m'lyh vtlbsh bgdy 'lmnvth
verses.translation: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶת גְּדִ֣י הָֽ/עִזִּ֗ים בְּ/יַד֙ רֵעֵ֣/הוּ הָֽ/עֲדֻלָּמִ֔י לָ/קַ֥חַת הָ/עֵרָב֖וֹן מִ/יַּ֣ד הָ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וְ/לֹ֖א מְצָאָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvdh 't gdy h'zym byd r'hv h'dlmy lqcht h'rbvn myd h'shh vl' mts'h
verses.translation: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֤י מְקֹמָ/הּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַיֵּ֧ה הַ/קְּדֵשָׁ֛ה הִ֥וא בָ/עֵינַ֖יִם עַל הַ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹא הָיְתָ֥ה בָ/זֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vysh'l 't 'nshy mqmh l'mr 'yh hqdshh hv' b'ynym 'l hdrkh vy'mrv l' hyth bzh qdshh
verses.translation: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ אֶל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֑י/הָ וְ/גַ֨ם אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹא הָיְתָ֥ה בָ/זֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vyshb 'l yhvdh vy'mr l' mts'tyh vgm 'nshy hmqvm 'mrv l' hyth bzh qdshh
verses.translation: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ תִּֽקַּֽח לָ֔/הּ פֶּ֖ן נִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/ב֑וּז הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי֙ הַ/גְּדִ֣י הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א מְצָאתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh tqch lh pn nhyh lbvz hnh shlchty hgdy hzh v'th l' mts'th
verses.translation: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/מִ/שְׁלֹ֣שׁ חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַ/יֻּגַּ֨ד לִֽ/יהוּדָ֤ה לֵֽ/אמֹר֙ זָֽנְתָה֙ תָּמָ֣ר כַּלָּתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/גַ֛ם הִנֵּ֥ה הָרָ֖ה לִ/זְנוּנִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֔ה הוֹצִיא֖וּ/הָ וְ/תִשָּׂרֵֽף
verses.translit: vyhy khmshlsh chdshym vygd lyhvdh l'mr znth tmr khltkh vgm hnh hrh lznvnym vy'mr yhvdh hvtsy'vh vtshrf
verses.translation: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

verses.original: הִ֣וא מוּצֵ֗את וְ/הִ֨יא שָׁלְחָ֤ה אֶל חָמִ֨י/הָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר אֵ֣לֶּה לּ֔/וֹ אָנֹכִ֖י הָרָ֑ה וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַכֶּר נָ֔א לְ/מִ֞י הַ/חֹתֶ֧מֶת וְ/הַ/פְּתִילִ֛ים וְ/הַ/מַּטֶּ֖ה הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: hv' mvts't vhy' shlchh 'l chmyh l'mr l'ysh 'shr 'lh lv 'nkhy hrh vt'mr hkhr n' lmy hchtmt vhptylym vhmth h'lh
verses.translation: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ צָֽדְקָ֣ה מִמֶּ֔/נִּי כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֥ן לֹא נְתַתִּ֖י/הָ לְ/שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא יָסַ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְ/דַעְתָּֽ/ה
verses.translit: vykhr yhvdh vy'mr tsdqh mmny khy 'l khn l' nttyh lshlh bny vl' ysf 'vd ld'th
verses.translation: And Judah acknowledged them , and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י בְּ/עֵ֣ת לִדְתָּ֑/הּ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה תְאוֹמִ֖ים בְּ/בִטְנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhy b't ldth vhnh t'vmym bbtnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י בְ/לִדְתָּ֖/הּ וַ/יִּתֶּן יָ֑ד וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח הַ/מְיַלֶּ֗דֶת וַ/תִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עַל יָד֤/וֹ שָׁנִי֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר זֶ֖ה יָצָ֥א רִאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bldth vytn yd vtqch hmyldt vtqshr 'l ydv shny l'mr zh yts' r'shnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/מֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔י/ו וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר מַה פָּרַ֖צְתָּ עָלֶ֣י/ךָ פָּ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ פָּֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy khmshyb ydv vhnh yts' 'chyv vt'mr mh prtst 'lykh prts vyqr' shmv prts
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַר֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל יָד֖/וֹ הַ/שָּׁנִ֑י וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ זָֽרַח
verses.translit: v'chr yts' 'chyv 'shr 'l ydv hshny vyqr' shmv zrch
verses.translation: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹסֵ֖ף הוּרַ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/ה וַ/יִּקְנֵ֡/הוּ פּוֹטִיפַר֩ סְרִ֨יס פַּרְעֹ֜ה שַׂ֤ר הַ/טַּבָּחִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מִ/יַּד֙ הַ/יִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹרִדֻ֖/הוּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyvsf hvrd mtsrymh vyqnhv pvtypr srys pr'h shr htbchym 'ysh mtsry myd hyshm''lym 'shr hvrdhv shmh
verses.translation: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶת יוֹסֵ֔ף וַ/יְהִ֖י אִ֣ישׁ מַצְלִ֑יחַ וַ/יְהִ֕י בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֲדֹנָ֖י/ו הַ/מִּצְרִֽי
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 't yvsf vyhy 'ysh mtslych vyhy bbyt 'dnyv hmtsry
verses.translation: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑/וֹ וְ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֔ה יְהוָ֖ה מַצְלִ֥יחַ בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' 'dnyv khy yhvh 'tv vkhl 'shr hv' 'shh yhvh mtslych bydv
verses.translation: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְצָ֨א יוֹסֵ֥ף חֵ֛ן בְּ/עֵינָ֖י/ו וַ/יְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יַּפְקִדֵ֨/הוּ֙ עַל בֵּית֔/וֹ וְ/כָל יֶשׁ ל֖/וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vymts' yvsf chn b'ynyv vyshrt 'tv vypqdhv 'l bytv vkhl ysh lv ntn bydv
verses.translation: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י מֵ/אָז֩ הִפְקִ֨יד אֹת֜/וֹ בְּ/בֵית֗/וֹ וְ/עַל֙ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ ל֔/וֹ וַ/יְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית הַ/מִּצְרִ֖י בִּ/גְלַ֣ל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יְהִ֞י בִּרְכַּ֤ת יְהוָה֙ בְּ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ ל֔/וֹ בַּ/בַּ֖יִת וּ/בַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy m'z hpqyd 'tv bbytv v'l khl 'shr ysh lv vybrkh yhvh 't byt hmtsry bgll yvsf vyhy brkht yhvh bkhl 'shr ysh lv bbyt vbshdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֣ב כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֮ בְּ/יַד יוֹסֵף֒ וְ/לֹא יָדַ֤ע אִתּ/וֹ֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם הַ/לֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא אוֹכֵ֑ל וַ/יְהִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף יְפֵה תֹ֖אַר וִ/יפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'zb khl 'shr lv byd yvsf vl' yd' 'tv m'vmh khy 'm hlchm 'shr hv' 'vkhl vyhy yvsf yph t'r vyph mr'h
verses.translation: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/תִּשָּׂ֧א אֵֽשֶׁת אֲדֹנָ֛י/ו אֶת עֵינֶ֖י/הָ אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁכְבָ֥/ה עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh vtsh' 'sht 'dnyv 't 'ynyh 'l yvsf vt'mr shkhbh 'my
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֵ֓ן וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֵ֣שֶׁת אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנִ֔/י לֹא יָדַ֥ע אִתִּ֖/י מַה בַּ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ ל֖/וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּ/יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vym'n vy'mr 'l 'sht 'dnyv hn 'dny l' yd' 'ty mh bbyt vkhl 'shr ysh lv ntn bydy
verses.translation: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

verses.original: אֵינֶ֨/נּוּ גָד֜וֹל בַּ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/זֶּה֮ מִמֶּ/נִּי֒ וְ/לֹֽא חָשַׂ֤ךְ מִמֶּ֨/נִּי֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם אוֹתָ֖/ךְ בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתְּ אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֨יךְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֜ה הָ/רָעָ֤ה הַ/גְּדֹלָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/חָטָ֖אתִי לֵֽ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'ynnv gdvl bbyt hzh mmny vl' chshkh mmny m'vmh khy 'm 'vtkh b'shr 't 'shtv v'ykh ''shh hr'h hgdlh hz't vcht'ty l'lhym
verses.translation: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כְּ/דַבְּרָ֥/הּ אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף י֣וֹם י֑וֹם וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע אֵלֶ֛י/הָ לִ/שְׁכַּ֥ב אֶצְלָ֖/הּ לִ/הְי֥וֹת עִמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhy khdbrh 'l yvsf yvm yvm vl' shm' 'lyh lshkhb 'tslh lhyvt 'mh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֥א הַ/בַּ֖יְתָ/ה לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת מְלַאכְתּ֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֨ין אִ֜ישׁ מֵ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/בַּ֛יִת שָׁ֖ם בַּ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyhy khhyvm hzh vyb' hbyth l'shvt ml'khtv v'yn 'ysh m'nshy hbyt shm bbyt
verses.translation: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

verses.translit: vttpshhv bbgdv l'mr shkhbh 'my vy'zb bgdv bydh vyns vyts' hchvtsh
verses.translation: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/רְאוֹתָ֔/הּ כִּֽי עָזַ֥ב בִּגְד֖/וֹ בְּ/יָדָ֑/הּ וַ/יָּ֖נָס הַ/חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vth khy 'zb bgdv bydh vyns hchvtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרָ֞א לְ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵיתָ֗/הּ וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר רְא֗וּ הֵ֥בִיא לָ֛/נוּ אִ֥ישׁ עִבְרִ֖י לְ/צַ֣חֶק בָּ֑/נוּ בָּ֤א אֵלַ/י֙ לִ/שְׁכַּ֣ב עִמִּ֔/י וָ/אֶקְרָ֖א בְּ/ק֥וֹל גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vtqr' l'nshy byth vt'mr lhm l'mr r'v hby' lnv 'ysh 'bry ltschq bnv b' 'ly lshkhb 'my v'qr' bqvl gdvl
verses.translation: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְ/שָׁמְע֔/וֹ כִּֽי הֲרִימֹ֥תִי קוֹלִ֖/י וָ/אֶקְרָ֑א וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְד/וֹ֙ אֶצְלִ֔/י וַ/יָּ֖נָס וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הַ/חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'v khy hrymty qvly v'qr' vy'zb bgdv 'tsly vyns vyts' hchvtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

verses.original: וַ/תַּנַּ֥ח בִּגְד֖/וֹ אֶצְלָ֑/הּ עַד בּ֥וֹא אֲדֹנָ֖י/ו אֶל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtnch bgdv 'tslh 'd bv' 'dnyv 'l bytv
verses.translation: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

verses.original: וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו כַּ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בָּֽא אֵלַ֞/י הָ/עֶ֧בֶד הָֽ/עִבְרִ֛י אֲשֶׁר הֵבֵ֥אתָ לָּ֖/נוּ לְ/צַ֥חֶק בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vtdbr 'lyv khdbrym h'lh l'mr b' 'ly h'bd h'bry 'shr hb't lnv ltschq by
verses.translation: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/הֲרִימִ֥/י קוֹלִ֖/י וָ/אֶקְרָ֑א וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֥ב בִּגְד֛/וֹ אֶצְלִ֖/י וַ/יָּ֥נָס הַ/חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy khhrymy qvly v'qr' vy'zb bgdv 'tsly vyns hchvtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹנָ֜י/ו אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּרָ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כַּ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה עָ֥שָׂהּ לִ֖/י עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יִּ֖חַר אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'dnyv 't dbry 'shtv 'shr dbrh 'lyv l'mr khdbrym h'lh 'shh ly 'bdkh vychr 'pv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ אֲדֹנֵ֨י יוֹסֵ֜ף אֹת֗/וֹ וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/סֹּ֔הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר אסורי אֲסִירֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲסוּרִ֑ים וַֽ/יְהִי שָׁ֖ם בְּ/בֵ֥ית הַ/סֹּֽהַר
verses.translit: vyqch 'dny yvsf 'tv vytnhv 'l byt hshr mqvm 'shr 'svry 'syry hmlkh 'svrym vyhy shm bbyt hshr
verses.translation: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶת יוֹסֵ֔ף וַ/יֵּ֥ט אֵלָ֖י/ו חָ֑סֶד וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן חִנּ֔/וֹ בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר בֵּית הַ/סֹּֽהַר
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 't yvsf vyt 'lyv chsd vytn chnv b'yny shr byt hshr
verses.translation: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤ר בֵּית הַ/סֹּ֨הַר֙ בְּ/יַד יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣/אֲסִירִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/סֹּ֑הַר וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ שָׁ֔ם ה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vytn shr byt hshr byd yvsf 't khl h'syrm 'shr bbyt hshr v't khl 'shr 'shym shm hv' hyh 'shh
verses.translation: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it .

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שַׂ֣ר בֵּית הַ/סֹּ֗הַר רֹאֶ֤ה אֶֽת כָּל מְא֨וּמָה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑/וֹ וַֽ/אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה מַצְלִֽיחַ
verses.translit: 'yn shr byt hshr r'h 't khl m'vmh bydv b'shr yhvh 'tv v'shr hv' 'shh yhvh mtslych
verses.translation: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה חָֽטְא֛וּ מַשְׁקֵ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/הָ/אֹפֶ֑ה לַ/אֲדֹנֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh cht'v mshqh mlkh mtsrym vh'ph l'dnyhm lmlkh mtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְצֹ֣ף פַּרְעֹ֔ה עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י סָרִיסָ֑י/ו עַ֚ל שַׂ֣ר הַ/מַּשְׁקִ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ל שַׂ֥ר הָ/אוֹפִֽים
verses.translit: vyqtsf pr'h 'l shny srysyv 'l shr hmshqym v'l shr h'vpym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜/ם בְּ/מִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֛ית שַׂ֥ר הַ/טַבָּחִ֖ים אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/סֹּ֑הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אָס֥וּר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vytn 'tm bmshmr byt shr htbchym 'l byt hshr mqvm 'shr yvsf 'svr shm
verses.translation: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּפְקֹד שַׂ֣ר הַ/טַּבָּחִ֧ים אֶת יוֹסֵ֛ף אִתָּ֖/ם וַ/יְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ יָמִ֖ים בְּ/מִשְׁמָֽר
verses.translit: vypqd shr htbchym 't yvsf 'tm vyshrt 'tm vyhyv ymym bmshmr
verses.translation: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽחַלְמוּ֩ חֲל֨וֹם שְׁנֵי/הֶ֜ם אִ֤ישׁ חֲלֹמ/וֹ֙ בְּ/לַ֣יְלָה אֶחָ֔ד אִ֖ישׁ כְּ/פִתְר֣וֹן חֲלֹמ֑/וֹ הַ/מַּשְׁקֶ֣ה וְ/הָ/אֹפֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲסוּרִ֖ים בְּ/בֵ֥ית הַ/סֹּֽהַר
verses.translit: vychlmv chlvm shnyhm 'ysh chlmv blylh 'chd 'ysh khptrvn chlmv hmshqh vh'ph 'shr lmlkh mtsrym 'shr 'svrym bbyt hshr
verses.translation: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֧א אֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/יַּ֣רְא אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/הִנָּ֖/ם זֹעֲפִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyhm yvsf bbqr vyr' 'tm vhnm z'pym
verses.translation: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת סְרִיסֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִתּ֧/וֹ בְ/מִשְׁמַ֛ר בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנָ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מַדּ֛וּעַ פְּנֵי/כֶ֥ם רָעִ֖ים הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vysh'l 't srysy pr'h 'shr 'tv bmshmr byt 'dnyv l'mr mdv' pnykhm r'ym hyvm
verses.translation: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְנוּ וּ/פֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם יוֹסֵ֗ף הֲ/ל֤וֹא לֵֽ/אלֹהִים֙ פִּתְרֹנִ֔ים סַפְּרוּ נָ֖א לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv chlvm chlmnv vptr 'yn 'tv vy'mr 'lhm yvsf hlv' l'lhym ptrnym sprv n' ly
verses.translation: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them , I pray you.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפֵּ֧ר שַֽׂר הַ/מַּשְׁקִ֛ים אֶת חֲלֹמ֖/וֹ לְ/יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ בַּ/חֲלוֹמִ֕/י וְ/הִנֵּה גֶ֖פֶן לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyspr shr hmshqym 't chlmv lyvsf vy'mr lv bchlvmy vhnh gpn lpny
verses.translation: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

verses.original: וּ/בַ/גֶּ֖פֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה שָׂרִיגִ֑ם וְ/הִ֤יא כְ/פֹרַ֨חַת֙ עָלְתָ֣ה נִצָּ֔/הּ הִבְשִׁ֥ילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶ֖י/הָ עֲנָבִֽים
verses.translit: vbgpn shlshh shrygm vhy' khprcht 'lth ntsh hbshylv 'shkhltyh 'nbym
verses.translation: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

verses.original: וְ/כ֥וֹס פַּרְעֹ֖ה בְּ/יָדִ֑/י וָ/אֶקַּ֣ח אֶת הָֽ/עֲנָבִ֗ים וָֽ/אֶשְׂחַ֤ט אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל כּ֣וֹס פַּרְעֹ֔ה וָ/אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת הַ/כּ֖וֹס עַל כַּ֥ף פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vkhvs pr'h bydy v'qch 't h'nbym v'shcht 'tm 'l khvs pr'h v'tn 't hkhvs 'l khf pr'h
verses.translation: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף זֶ֖ה פִּתְרֹנ֑/וֹ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙ הַ/שָּׂ֣רִגִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים הֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yvsf zh ptrnv shlsht hshrgym shlsht ymym hm
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

verses.original: בְּ/ע֣וֹד שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים יִשָּׂ֤א פַרְעֹה֙ אֶת רֹאשֶׁ֔/ךָ וַ/הֲשִֽׁיבְ/ךָ֖ עַל כַּנֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ כוֹס פַּרְעֹה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּט֙ הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֖יתָ מַשְׁקֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: b'vd shlsht ymym ysh' pr'h 't r'shkh vhshybkh 'l khnkh vntt khvs pr'h bydv khmshpt hr'shvn 'shr hyyt mshqhv
verses.translation: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

verses.original: כִּ֧י אִם זְכַרְתַּ֣/נִי אִתְּ/ךָ֗ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔/ךְ וְ/עָשִֽׂיתָ נָּ֥א עִמָּדִ֖/י חָ֑סֶד וְ/הִזְכַּרְתַּ֨/נִי֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/הוֹצֵאתַ֖/נִי מִן הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm zkhrtny 'tkh kh'shr yytb lkh v'shyt n' 'mdy chsd vhzkhrtny 'l pr'h vhvts'tny mn hbyt hzh
verses.translation: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

verses.original: כִּֽי גֻנֹּ֣ב גֻּנַּ֔בְתִּי מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ הָ/עִבְרִ֑ים וְ/גַם פֹּה֙ לֹא עָשִׂ֣יתִֽי מְא֔וּמָה כִּֽי שָׂמ֥וּ אֹתִ֖/י בַּ/בּֽוֹר
verses.translit: khy gnb gnbty m'rts h'brym vgm ph l' 'shyty m'vmh khy shmv 'ty bbvr
verses.translation: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא שַׂר הָ/אֹפִ֖ים כִּ֣י ט֣וֹב פָּתָ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אַף אֲנִי֙ בַּ/חֲלוֹמִ֔/י וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֛ה סַלֵּ֥י חֹרִ֖י עַל רֹאשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vyr' shr h'pym khy tvb ptr vy'mr 'l yvsf 'f 'ny bchlvmy vhnh shlshh sly chry 'l r'shy
verses.translation: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

verses.original: וּ/בַ/סַּ֣ל הָֽ/עֶלְי֔וֹן מִ/כֹּ֛ל מַאֲכַ֥ל פַּרְעֹ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹפֶ֑ה וְ/הָ/ע֗וֹף אֹכֵ֥ל אֹתָ֛/ם מִן הַ/סַּ֖ל מֵ/עַ֥ל רֹאשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vbsl h'lyvn mkhl m'khl pr'h m'shh 'ph vh'vf 'khl 'tm mn hsl m'l r'shy
verses.translation: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן יוֹסֵף֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר זֶ֖ה פִּתְרֹנ֑/וֹ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙ הַ/סַּלִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים הֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'n yvsf vy'mr zh ptrnv shlsht hslym shlsht ymym hm
verses.translation: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

verses.original: בְּ/ע֣וֹד שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים יִשָּׂ֨א פַרְעֹ֤ה אֶת רֹֽאשְׁ/ךָ֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/תָלָ֥ה אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ עַל עֵ֑ץ וְ/אָכַ֥ל הָ/ע֛וֹף אֶת בְּשָׂרְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: b'vd shlsht ymym ysh' pr'h 't r'shkh m'lykh vtlh 'vtkh 'l 'ts v'khl h'vf 't bshrkh m'lykh
verses.translation: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗י י֚וֹם הֻלֶּ֣דֶת אֶת פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה לְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשָּׂ֞א אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ שַׂ֣ר הַ/מַּשְׁקִ֗ים וְ/אֶת רֹ֛אשׁ שַׂ֥ר הָ/אֹפִ֖ים בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy yvm hldt 't pr'h vy'sh mshth lkhl 'bdyv vysh' 't r'sh shr hmshqym v't r'sh shr h'pym btvkh 'bdyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛שֶׁב אֶת שַׂ֥ר הַ/מַּשְׁקִ֖ים עַל מַשְׁקֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן הַ/כּ֖וֹס עַל כַּ֥ף פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshb 't shr hmshqym 'l mshqhv vytn hkhvs 'l khf pr'h
verses.translation: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛ת שַׂ֥ר הָ/אֹפִ֖ים תָּלָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּתַ֛ר לָ/הֶ֖ם יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: v't shr h'pym tlh kh'shr ptr lhm yvsf
verses.translation: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא זָכַ֧ר שַֽׂר הַ/מַּשְׁקִ֛ים אֶת יוֹסֵ֖ף וַ/יִּשְׁכָּחֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vl' zkhr shr hmshqym 't yvsf vyshkhchhv
verses.translation: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קֵּ֖ץ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים וּ/פַרְעֹ֣ה חֹלֵ֔ם וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy mqts shntym ymym vpr'h chlm vhnh 'md 'l hy'r
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה מִן הַ/יְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת יְפ֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וּ/בְרִיאֹ֣ת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַ/תִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּ/אָֽחוּ
verses.translit: vhnh mn hy'r 'lt shb' prvt ypvt mr'h vbry't bshr vtr'ynh b'chv
verses.translation: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֞ה שֶׁ֧בַע פָּר֣וֹת אֲחֵר֗וֹת עֹל֤וֹת אַחֲרֵי/הֶן֙ מִן הַ/יְאֹ֔ר רָע֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וְ/דַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה אֵ֥צֶל הַ/פָּר֖וֹת עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vhnh shb' prvt 'chrvt 'lvt 'chryhn mn hy'r r'vt mr'h vdqvt bshr vt'mdnh 'tsl hprvt 'l shpt hy'r
verses.translation: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאכַ֣לְנָה הַ/פָּר֗וֹת רָע֤וֹת הַ/מַּרְאֶה֙ וְ/דַקֹּ֣ת הַ/בָּשָׂ֔ר אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַ/פָּר֔וֹת יְפֹ֥ת הַ/מַּרְאֶ֖ה וְ/הַ/בְּרִיאֹ֑ת וַ/יִּיקַ֖ץ פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vt'khlnh hprvt r'vt hmr'h vdqt hbshr 't shb' hprvt ypt hmr'h vhbry't vyyqts pr'h
verses.translation: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

verses.original: וַ/יִּישָׁ֕ן וַֽ/יַּחֲלֹ֖ם שֵׁנִ֑ית וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹל֛וֹת בְּ/קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד בְּרִיא֥וֹת וְ/טֹבֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyyshn vychlm shnyt vhnh shb' shblym 'lvt bqnh 'chd bry'vt vtbvt
verses.translation: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים דַּקּ֖וֹת וּ/שְׁדוּפֹ֣ת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vhnh shb' shblym dqvt vshdvpt qdym tsmchvt 'chryhn
verses.translation: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְלַ֨עְנָה֙ הַ/שִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַ/דַּקּ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַֽ/שִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים הַ/בְּרִיא֖וֹת וְ/הַ/מְּלֵא֑וֹת וַ/יִּיקַ֥ץ פַּרְעֹ֖ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה חֲלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vtbl'nh hshblym hdqvt 't shb' hshblym hbry'vt vhml'vt vyyqts pr'h vhnh chlvm
verses.translation: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַ/תִּפָּ֣עֶם רוּח֔/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א אֶת כָּל חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת כָּל חֲכָמֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יְסַפֵּ֨ר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ אֶת חֲלֹמ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵין פּוֹתֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vtp'm rvchv vyshlch vyqr' 't khl chrtmy mtsrym v't khl chkhmyh vyspr pr'h lhm 't chlmv v'yn pvtr 'vtm lpr'h
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/מַּשְׁקִ֔ים אֶת פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֶת חֲטָאַ֕/י אֲנִ֖י מַזְכִּ֥יר הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vydbr shr hmshqym 't pr'h l'mr 't cht'y 'ny mzkhyr hyvm
verses.translation: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה קָצַ֣ף עַל עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתִ֜/י בְּ/מִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֚ית שַׂ֣ר הַ/טַּבָּחִ֔ים אֹתִ֕/י וְ/אֵ֖ת שַׂ֥ר הָ/אֹפִֽים
verses.translit: pr'h qtsf 'l 'bdyv vytn 'ty bmshmr byt shr htbchym 'ty v't shr h'pym
verses.translation: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:

verses.original: וַ/נַּֽחַלְמָ֥/ה חֲל֛וֹם בְּ/לַ֥יְלָה אֶחָ֖ד אֲנִ֣י וָ/ה֑וּא אִ֛ישׁ כְּ/פִתְר֥וֹן חֲלֹמ֖/וֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ
verses.translit: vnchlmh chlvm blylh 'chd 'ny vhv' 'ysh khptrvn chlmv chlmnv
verses.translation: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨ם אִתָּ֜/נוּ נַ֣עַר עִבְרִ֗י עֶ֚בֶד לְ/שַׂ֣ר הַ/טַּבָּחִ֔ים וַ/נְּ֨סַפֶּר ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּפְתָּר לָ֖/נוּ אֶת חֲלֹמֹתֵ֑י/נוּ אִ֥ישׁ כַּ/חֲלֹמ֖/וֹ פָּתָֽר
verses.translit: vshm 'tnv n'r 'bry 'bd lshr htbchym vnspr lv vyptr lnv 't chlmtynv 'ysh khchlmv ptr
verses.translation: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּֽתַר לָ֖/נוּ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֑ה אֹתִ֛/י הֵשִׁ֥יב עַל כַּנִּ֖/י וְ/אֹת֥/וֹ תָלָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr ptr lnv khn hyh 'ty hshyb 'l khny v'tv tlh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח פַּרְעֹה֙ וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א אֶת יוֹסֵ֔ף וַ/יְרִיצֻ֖/הוּ מִן הַ/בּ֑וֹר וַ/יְגַלַּח֙ וַ/יְחַלֵּ֣ף שִׂמְלֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֶל פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch pr'h vyqr' 't yvsf vyrytshv mn hbvr vyglch vychlf shmltyv vyb' 'l pr'h
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְתִּי וּ/פֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/אֲנִ֗י שָׁמַ֤עְתִּי עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר תִּשְׁמַ֥ע חֲל֖וֹם לִ/פְתֹּ֥ר אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l yvsf chlvm chlmty vptr 'yn 'tv v'ny shm'ty 'lykh l'mr tshm' chlvm lptr 'tv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶת פַּרְעֹ֛ה לֵ/אמֹ֖ר בִּלְעָדָ֑/י אֱלֹהִ֕ים יַעֲנֶ֖ה אֶת שְׁל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'n yvsf 't pr'h l'mr bl'dy 'lhym y'nh 't shlvm pr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף בַּ/חֲלֹמִ֕/י הִנְ/נִ֥י עֹמֵ֖ד עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr pr'h 'l yvsf bchlmy hnny 'md 'l shpt hy'r
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה מִן הַ/יְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת בְּרִיא֥וֹת בָּשָׂ֖ר וִ/יפֹ֣ת תֹּ֑אַר וַ/תִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּ/אָֽחוּ
verses.translit: vhnh mn hy'r 'lt shb' prvt bry'vt bshr vypt t'r vtr'ynh b'chv
verses.translation: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֞ה שֶֽׁבַע פָּר֤וֹת אֲחֵרוֹת֙ עֹל֣וֹת אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ן דַּלּ֨וֹת וְ/רָע֥וֹת תֹּ֛אַר מְאֹ֖ד וְ/רַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר לֹֽא רָאִ֧יתִי כָ/הֵ֛נָּה בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָ/רֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vhnh shb' prvt 'chrvt 'lvt 'chryhn dlvt vr'vt t'r m'd vrqvt bshr l' r'yty khhnh bkhl 'rts mtsrym lr'
verses.translation: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאכַ֨לְנָה֙ הַ/פָּר֔וֹת הָ/רַקּ֖וֹת וְ/הָ/רָע֑וֹת אֵ֣ת שֶׁ֧בַע הַ/פָּר֛וֹת הָ/רִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הַ/בְּרִיאֹֽת
verses.translit: vt'khlnh hprvt hrqvt vhr'vt 't shb' hprvt hr'shnvt hbry't
verses.translation: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֣אנָה אֶל קִרְבֶּ֗/נָה וְ/לֹ֤א נוֹדַע֙ כִּי בָ֣אוּ אֶל קִרְבֶּ֔/נָה וּ/מַרְאֵי/הֶ֣ן רַ֔ע כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּ/תְּחִלָּ֑ה וָ/אִיקָֽץ
verses.translit: vtb'nh 'l qrbnh vl' nvd' khy b'v 'l qrbnh vmr'yhn r' kh'shr btchlh v'yqts
verses.translation: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֖רֶא בַּ/חֲלֹמִ֑/י וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹלֹ֛ת בְּ/קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְ/טֹבֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'r' bchlmy vhnh shb' shblym 'lt bqnh 'chd ml't vtbvt
verses.translation: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צְנֻמ֥וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת שְׁדֻפ֣וֹת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhnh shb' shblym tsnmvt dqvt shdpvt qdym tsmchvt 'chryhm
verses.translation: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְלַ֨עְןָ֙ הָ/שִׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַ/דַּקֹּ֔ת אֵ֛ת שֶׁ֥בַע הַֽ/שִׁבֳּלִ֖ים הַ/טֹּב֑וֹת וָֽ/אֹמַר֙ אֶל הַֽ/חַרְטֻמִּ֔ים וְ/אֵ֥ין מַגִּ֖יד לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtbl'n hshblym hdqt 't shb' hshblym htbvt v'mr 'l hchrtmym v'yn mgyd ly
verses.translation: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה חֲל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶחָ֣ד ה֑וּא אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הִגִּ֥יד לְ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l pr'h chlvm pr'h 'chd hv' 't 'shr h'lhym 'shh hgyd lpr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.original: שֶׁ֧בַע פָּרֹ֣ת הַ/טֹּבֹ֗ת שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְ/שֶׁ֤בַע הַֽ/שִּׁבֳּלִים֙ הַ/טֹּבֹ֔ת שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים הֵ֑נָּה חֲל֖וֹם אֶחָ֥ד הֽוּא
verses.translit: shb' prt htbt shb' shnym hnh vshb' hshblym htbt shb' shnym hnh chlvm 'chd hv'
verses.translation: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

verses.original: וְ/שֶׁ֣בַע הַ֠/פָּרוֹת הָֽ/רַקּ֨וֹת וְ/הָ/רָעֹ֜ת הָ/עֹלֹ֣ת אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְ/שֶׁ֤בַע הַֽ/שִׁבֳּלִים֙ הָ/רֵק֔וֹת שְׁדֻפ֖וֹת הַ/קָּדִ֑ים יִהְי֕וּ שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י רָעָֽב
verses.translit: vshb' hprvt hrqvt vhr't h'lt 'chryhn shb' shnym hnh vshb' hshblym hrqvt shdpvt hqdym yhyv shb' shny r'b
verses.translation: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

verses.original: ה֣וּא הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֶת פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: hv' hdbr 'shr dbrty 'l pr'h 'shr h'lhym 'shh hr'h 't pr'h
verses.translation: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים בָּא֑וֹת שָׂבָ֥ע גָּד֖וֹל בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: hnh shb' shnym b'vt shb' gdvl bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

verses.original: וְ֠/קָמוּ שֶׁ֜בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ן וְ/נִשְׁכַּ֥ח כָּל הַ/שָּׂבָ֖ע בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/כִלָּ֥ה הָ/רָעָ֖ב אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vqmv shb' shny r'b 'chryhn vnshkhch khl hshb' b'rts mtsrym vkhlh hr'b 't h'rts
verses.translation: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִוָּדַ֤ע הַ/שָּׂבָע֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ מִ/פְּנֵ֛י הָ/רָעָ֥ב הַ/ה֖וּא אַחֲרֵי כֵ֑ן כִּֽי כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vl' yvd' hshb' b'rts mpny hr'b hhv' 'chry khn khy khbd hv' m'd
verses.translation: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַ/חֲל֛וֹם אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה פַּעֲמָ֑יִם כִּֽי נָכ֤וֹן הַ/דָּבָר֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/מְמַהֵ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַ/עֲשֹׂתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l hshnvt hchlvm 'l pr'h p'mym khy nkhvn hdbr m'm h'lhym vmmhr h'lhym l'shtv
verses.translation: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יֵרֶ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ נָב֣וֹן וְ/חָכָ֑ם וִ/ישִׁיתֵ֖/הוּ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'th yr' pr'h 'ysh nbvn vchkhm vyshythv 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

verses.original: יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְ/יַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/חִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂבָֽע
verses.translit: y'shh pr'h vypqd pqdym 'l h'rts vchmsh 't 'rts mtsrym bshb' shny hshb'
verses.translation: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

verses.original: וְ/יִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת כָּל אֹ֨כֶל֙ הַ/שָּׁנִ֣ים הַ/טֹּבֹ֔ת הַ/בָּאֹ֖ת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/יִצְבְּרוּ בָ֞ר תַּ֧חַת יַד פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֹ֥כֶל בֶּ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/שָׁמָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyqbtsv 't khl 'khl hshnym htbt hb't h'lh vytsbrv br tcht yd pr'h 'khl b'rym vshmrv
verses.translation: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה הָ/אֹ֤כֶל לְ/פִקָּדוֹן֙ לָ/אָ֔רֶץ לְ/שֶׁ֨בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָ/רָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לֹֽא תִכָּרֵ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּ/רָעָֽב
verses.translit: vhyh h'khl lpqdvn l'rts lshb' shny hr'b 'shr thyyn b'rts mtsrym vl' tkhrt h'rts br'b
verses.translation: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיטַ֥ב הַ/דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyytb hdbr b'yny pr'h vb'yny khl 'bdyv
verses.translation: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל עֲבָדָ֑י/ו הֲ/נִמְצָ֣א כָ/זֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l 'bdyv hnmts' khzh 'ysh 'shr rvch 'lhym bv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ אֶת כָּל זֹ֑את אֵין נָב֥וֹן וְ/חָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l yvsf 'chry hvdy' 'lhym 'vtkh 't khl z't 'yn nbvn vchkhm khmvkh
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

verses.original: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל בֵּיתִ֔/י וְ/עַל פִּ֖י/ךָ יִשַּׁ֣ק כָּל עַמִּ֑/י רַ֥ק הַ/כִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'th thyh 'l byty v'l pykh yshq khl 'my rq hkhs' 'gdl mmkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְ/ךָ֔ עַ֖ל כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l yvsf r'h ntty 'tkh 'l khl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨סַר פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת טַבַּעְתּ/וֹ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖/הּ עַל יַ֣ד יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹת/וֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁ֔שׁ וַ/יָּ֛שֶׂם רְבִ֥ד הַ/זָּהָ֖ב עַל צַוָּארֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysr pr'h 't tb'tv m'l ydv vytn 'th 'l yd yvsf vylbsh 'tv bgdy shsh vyshm rbd hzhb 'l tsv'rv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗/וֹ בְּ/מִרְכֶּ֤בֶת הַ/מִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרְא֥וּ לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְ/נָת֣וֹן אֹת֔/וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyrkhb 'tv bmrkhbt hmshnh 'shr lv vyqr'v lpnyv 'brkh vntvn 'tv 'l khl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּ/בִלְעָדֶ֗י/ךָ לֹֽא יָרִ֨ים אִ֧ישׁ אֶת יָד֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת רַגְל֖/וֹ בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l yvsf 'ny pr'h vbl'dykh l' yrym 'ysh 't ydv v't rglv bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֣/וֹ אֶת אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h shm yvsf tspnt p'nch vytn lv 't 'snt bt pvty pr' khhn 'n l'shh vyts' yvsf 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹסֵף֙ בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּ/עָמְד֕/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַֽ/יַּעְבֹ֖ר בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyvsf bn shlshym shnh b'mdv lpny pr'h mlkh mtsrym vyts' yvsf mlpny pr'h vy'br bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֣עַשׂ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בְּ/שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂבָ֑ע לִ/קְמָצִֽים
verses.translit: vt'sh h'rts bshb' shny hshb' lqmtsym
verses.translation: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת כָּל אֹ֣כֶל שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּתֶּן אֹ֖כֶל בֶּ/עָרִ֑ים אֹ֧כֶל שְׂדֵה הָ/עִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתֶ֖י/הָ נָתַ֥ן בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyqbts 't khl 'khl shb' shnym 'shr hyv b'rts mtsrym vytn 'khl b'rym 'khl shdh h'yr 'shr sbybtyh ntn btvkhh
verses.translation: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּ/ח֥וֹל הַ/יָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי חָדַ֥ל לִ/סְפֹּ֖ר כִּי אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: vytsbr yvsf br khchvl hym hrbh m'd 'd khy chdl lspr khy 'yn mspr
verses.translation: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/יוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָ/רָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה לּ/וֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן
verses.translit: vlyvsf yld shny bnym btrm tbv' shnt hr'b 'shr yldh lv 'snt bt pvty pr' khhn 'vn
verses.translation: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת שֵׁ֥ם הַ/בְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי נַשַּׁ֤/נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת כָּל עֲמָלִ֔/י וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyqr' yvsf 't shm hbkhvr mnshh khy nshny 'lhym 't khl 'mly v't khl byt 'by
verses.translation: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he , hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛ת שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי הִפְרַ֥/נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ עָנְיִֽ/י
verses.translit: v't shm hshny qr' 'prym khy hprny 'lhym b'rts 'nyy
verses.translation: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכְלֶ֕ינָה שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtkhlynh shb' shny hshb' 'shr hyh b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

verses.original: וַ/תְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָ/רָעָב֙ לָ/ב֔וֹא כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּ/כָל הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת וּ/בְ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vtchlynh shb' shny hr'b lbv' kh'shr 'mr yvsf vyhy r'b bkhl h'rtsvt vbkhl 'rts mtsrym hyh lchm
verses.translation: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.original: וַ/תִּרְעַב֙ כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּצְעַ֥ק הָ/עָ֛ם אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַ/לָּ֑חֶם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לְ/כָל מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַ֥ר לָ/כֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vtr'b khl 'rts mtsrym vyts'q h'm 'l pr'h llchm vy'mr pr'h lkhl mtsrym lkhv 'l yvsf 'shr y'mr lkhm t'shv
verses.translation: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּפְתַּ֨ח יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּ/הֶם֙ וַ/יִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָֽ/רָעָ֖ב בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhr'b hyh 'l khl pny h'rts vyptch yvsf 't khl 'shr bhm vyshbr lmtsrym vychzq hr'b b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה לִ/שְׁבֹּ֖ר אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּֽי חָזַ֥ק הָ/רָעָ֖ב בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkhl h'rts b'v mtsrymh lshbr 'l yvsf khy chzq hr'b bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ לְ/בָנָ֔י/ו לָ֖/מָּה תִּתְרָאֽוּ
verses.translit: vyr' y'qb khy ysh shbr bmtsrym vy'mr y'qb lbnyv lmh ttr'v
verses.translation: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י יֶשׁ שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם רְדוּ שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ וְ/שִׁבְרוּ לָ֣/נוּ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וְ/נִחְיֶ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א נָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh shm'ty khy ysh shbr bmtsrym rdv shmh vshbrv lnv mshm vnchyh vl' nmvt
verses.translation: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֥וּ אֲחֵֽי יוֹסֵ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לִ/שְׁבֹּ֥ר בָּ֖ר מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyrdv 'chy yvsf 'shrh lshbr br mmtsrym
verses.translation: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בִּנְיָמִין֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹא שָׁלַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת אֶחָ֑י/ו כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן יִקְרָאֶ֖/נּוּ אָסֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't bnymyn 'chy yvsf l' shlch y'qb 't 'chyv khy 'mr pn yqr'nv 'svn
verses.translation: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/שְׁבֹּ֖ר בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/בָּאִ֑ים כִּֽי הָיָ֥ה הָ/רָעָ֖ב בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vyb'v bny yshr'l lshbr btvkh hb'ym khy hyh hr'b b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹסֵ֗ף ה֚וּא הַ/שַּׁלִּ֣יט עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ ה֥וּא הַ/מַּשְׁבִּ֖יר לְ/כָל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֲחֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף וַ/יִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ ל֥/וֹ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyvsf hv' hshlyt 'l h'rts hv' hmshbyr lkhl 'm h'rts vyb'v 'chy yvsf vyshtchvv lv 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת אֶחָ֖י/ו וַ/יַּכִּרֵ֑/ם וַ/יִּתְנַכֵּ֨ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר אִתָּ֣/ם קָשׁ֗וֹת וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ מֵ/אַ֣יִן בָּאתֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִ/שְׁבָּר אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: vyr' yvsf 't 'chyv vykhrm vytnkhr 'lyhm vydbr 'tm qshvt vy'mr 'lhm m'yn b'tm vy'mrv m'rts khn'n lshbr 'khl
verses.translation: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶת אֶחָ֑י/ו וְ/הֵ֖ם לֹ֥א הִכִּרֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vykhr yvsf 't 'chyv vhm l' hkhrhv
verses.translation: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֣ר יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת הַ/חֲלֹמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָלַ֖ם לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ מְרַגְּלִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לִ/רְא֛וֹת אֶת עֶרְוַ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּאתֶֽם
verses.translit: vyzkhr yvsf 't hchlmvt 'shr chlm lhm vy'mr 'lhm mrglym 'tm lr'vt 't 'rvt h'rts b'tm
verses.translation: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו לֹ֣א אֲדֹנִ֑/י וַ/עֲבָדֶ֥י/ךָ בָּ֖אוּ לִ/שְׁבָּר אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv l' 'dny v'bdykh b'v lshbr 'khl
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֕/נוּ בְּנֵ֥י אִישׁ אֶחָ֖ד נָ֑חְנוּ כֵּנִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ לֹא הָי֥וּ עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ מְרַגְּלִֽים
verses.translit: khlnv bny 'ysh 'chd nchnv khnym 'nchnv l' hyv 'bdykh mrglym
verses.translation: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men , thy servants are no spies.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם לֹ֕א כִּֽי עֶרְוַ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּאתֶ֥ם לִ/רְאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm l' khy 'rvt h'rts b'tm lr'vt
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂר֩ עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ אַחִ֧ים אֲנַ֛חְנוּ בְּנֵ֥י אִישׁ אֶחָ֖ד בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הַ/קָּטֹ֤ן אֶת אָבִ֨י/נוּ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/הָ/אֶחָ֖ד אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv shnym 'shr 'bdykh 'chym 'nchnv bny 'ysh 'chd b'rts khn'n vhnh hqtn 't 'bynv hyvm vh'chd 'ynnv
verses.translation: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם יוֹסֵ֑ף ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֲלֵ/כֶ֛ם לֵ/אמֹ֖ר מְרַגְּלִ֥ים אַתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm yvsf hv' 'shr dbrty 'lkhm l'mr mrglym 'tm
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

verses.original: בְּ/זֹ֖את תִּבָּחֵ֑נוּ חֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ אִם תֵּצְא֣וּ מִ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֧י אִם בְּ/ב֛וֹא אֲחִי/כֶ֥ם הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: bz't tbchnv chy pr'h 'm tts'v mzh khy 'm bbv' 'chykhm hqtn hnh
verses.translation: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

verses.original: שִׁלְח֨וּ מִ/כֶּ֣ם אֶחָד֮ וְ/יִקַּ֣ח אֶת אֲחִי/כֶם֒ וְ/אַתֶּם֙ הֵאָ֣סְר֔וּ וְ/יִבָּֽחֲנוּ֙ דִּבְרֵי/כֶ֔ם הַֽ/אֱמֶ֖ת אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אִם לֹ֕א חֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה כִּ֥י מְרַגְּלִ֖ים אַתֶּֽם
verses.translit: shlchv mkhm 'chd vyqch 't 'chykhm v'tm h'srv vybchnv dbrykhm h'mt 'tkhm v'm l' chy pr'h khy mrglym 'tm
verses.translation: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛/ם אֶל מִשְׁמָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sf 'tm 'l mshmr shlsht ymym
verses.translation: And he put them all together into ward three days.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֤ם יוֹסֵף֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י זֹ֥את עֲשׂ֖וּ וִֽ/חְי֑וּ אֶת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יָרֵֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm yvsf byvm hshlyshy z't 'shv vchyv 't h'lhym 'ny yr'
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

verses.original: אִם כֵּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם אֲחִי/כֶ֣ם אֶחָ֔ד יֵאָסֵ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֣ית מִשְׁמַרְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אַתֶּם֙ לְכ֣וּ הָבִ֔יאוּ שֶׁ֖בֶר רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm khnym 'tm 'chykhm 'chd y'sr bbyt mshmrkhm v'tm lkhv hby'v shbr r'bvn btykhm
verses.translation: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אֲחִי/כֶ֤ם הַ/קָּטֹן֙ תָּבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/יֵאָמְנ֥וּ דִבְרֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ וַ/יַּעֲשׂוּ כֵֽן
verses.translit: v't 'chykhm hqtn tby'v 'ly vy'mnv dbrykhm vl' tmvtv vy'shv khn
verses.translation: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֗י/ו אֲבָל֮ אֲשֵׁמִ֣ים אֲנַחְנוּ֮ עַל אָחִי/נוּ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָאִ֜ינוּ צָרַ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ בְּ/הִתְחַֽנְנ֥/וֹ אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֑עְנוּ עַל כֵּן֙ בָּ֣אָה אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ הַ/צָּרָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l 'chyv 'bl 'shmym 'nchnv 'l 'chynv 'shr r'ynv tsrt npshv bhtchnnv 'lynv vl' shm'nv 'l khn b'h 'lynv htsrh hz't
verses.translation: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ רְאוּבֵ֨ן אֹתָ֜/ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הֲ/לוֹא֩ אָמַ֨רְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶ֧ם לֵ/אמֹ֛ר אַל תֶּחֶטְא֥וּ בַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְ/גַם דָּמ֖/וֹ הִנֵּ֥ה נִדְרָֽשׁ
