verses.translit: vy'n r'vbn 'tm l'mr hlv' 'mrty 'lykhm l'mr 'l tcht'v byld vl' shm'tm vgm dmv hnh ndrsh
verses.translation: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

verses.original: וְ/הֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּ֥י הַ/מֵּלִ֖יץ בֵּינֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhm l' yd'v khy shm' yvsf khy hmlyts byntm
verses.translation: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסֹּ֥ב מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וַ/יֵּ֑בְךְּ וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽ/אִתָּ/ם֙ אֶת שִׁמְע֔וֹן וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֥ר אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vysb m'lyhm vybkh vyshb 'lhm vydbr 'lhm vyqch m'tm 't shm'vn vy'sr 'tv l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו יוֹסֵ֗ף וַ/יְמַלְא֣וּ אֶת כְּלֵי/הֶם֮ בָּר֒ וּ/לְ/הָשִׁ֤יב כַּסְפֵּי/הֶם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל שַׂקּ֔/וֹ וְ/לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶ֛ם צֵדָ֖ה לַ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ לָ/הֶ֖ם כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vytsv yvsf vyml'v 't khlyhm br vlhshyb khspyhm 'ysh 'l shqv vltt lhm tsdh ldrkh vy'sh lhm khn
verses.translation: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת שִׁבְרָ֖/ם עַל חֲמֹרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vysh'v 't shbrm 'l chmryhm vylkhv mshm
verses.translation: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְתַּ֨ח הָ/אֶחָ֜ד אֶת שַׂקּ֗/וֹ לָ/תֵ֥ת מִסְפּ֛וֹא לַ/חֲמֹר֖/וֹ בַּ/מָּל֑וֹן וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת כַּסְפּ֔/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּה ה֖וּא בְּ/פִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyptch h'chd 't shqv ltt mspv' lchmrv bmlvn vyr' 't khspv vhnh hv' bpy 'mtchtv
verses.translation: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל אֶחָי/ו֙ הוּשַׁ֣ב כַּסְפִּ֔/י וְ/גַ֖ם הִנֵּ֣ה בְ/אַמְתַּחְתִּ֑/י וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א לִבָּ֗/ם וַ/יֶּֽחֶרְד֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל אָחִי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מַה זֹּ֛את עָשָׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l 'chyv hvshb khspy vgm hnh b'mtchty vyts' lbm vychrdv 'ysh 'l 'chyv l'mr mh z't 'shh 'lhym lnv
verses.translation: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them , and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֛אוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹ֥ב אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם אַ֣רְצָ/ה כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔/וֹ אֵ֛ת כָּל הַ/קֹּרֹ֥ת אֹתָ֖/ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l y'qb 'byhm 'rtsh khn'n vygydv lv 't khl hqrt 'tm l'mr
verses.translation: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

verses.original: דִּ֠בֶּר הָ/אִ֨ישׁ אֲדֹנֵ֥י הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אִתָּ֖/נוּ קָשׁ֑וֹת וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֹתָ֔/נוּ כִּֽ/מְרַגְּלִ֖ים אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: dbr h'ysh 'dny h'rts 'tnv qshvt vytn 'tnv khmrglym 't h'rts
verses.translation: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

verses.original: וַ/נֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו כֵּנִ֣ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ לֹ֥א הָיִ֖ינוּ מְרַגְּלִֽים
verses.translit: vn'mr 'lyv khnym 'nchnv l' hyynv mrglym
verses.translation: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

verses.original: שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֲנַ֛חְנוּ אַחִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אָבִ֑י/נוּ הָ/אֶחָ֣ד אֵינֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/הַ/קָּטֹ֥ן הַ/יּ֛וֹם אֶת אָבִ֖י/נוּ בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: shnym 'shr 'nchnv 'chym bny 'bynv h'chd 'ynnv vhqtn hyvm 't 'bynv b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֵ֗י/נוּ הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲדֹנֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בְּ/זֹ֣את אֵדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כֵנִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אֲחִי/כֶ֤ם הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ הַנִּ֣יחוּ אִתִּ֔/י וְ/אֶת רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּי/כֶ֖ם קְח֥וּ וָ/לֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lynv h'ysh 'dny h'rts bz't 'd' khy khnym 'tm 'chykhm h'chd hnychv 'ty v't r'bvn btykhm qchv vlkhv
verses.translation: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

verses.original: וְ֠/הָבִיאוּ אֶת אֲחִי/כֶ֣ם הַ/קָּטֹן֮ אֵלַ/י֒ וְ/אֵֽדְעָ֗ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א מְרַגְּלִים֙ אַתֶּ֔ם כִּ֥י כֵנִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אֶת אֲחִי/כֶם֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תִּסְחָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vhby'v 't 'chykhm hqtn 'ly v'd'h khy l' mrglym 'tm khy khnym 'tm 't 'chykhm 'tn lkhm v't h'rts tschrv
verses.translation: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י הֵ֚ם מְרִיקִ֣ים שַׂקֵּי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הִנֵּה אִ֥ישׁ צְרוֹר כַּסְפּ֖/וֹ בְּ/שַׂקּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּרְא֞וּ אֶת צְרֹר֧וֹת כַּסְפֵּי/הֶ֛ם הֵ֥מָּה וַ/אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם וַ/יִּירָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vyhy hm mryqym shqyhm vhnh 'ysh tsrvr khspv bshqv vyr'v 't tsrrvt khspyhm hmh v'byhm vyyr'v
verses.translation: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם אֹתִ֖/י שִׁכַּלְתֶּ֑ם יוֹסֵ֤ף אֵינֶ֨/נּוּ֙ וְ/שִׁמְע֣וֹן אֵינֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/אֶת בִּנְיָמִ֣ן תִּקָּ֔חוּ עָלַ֖/י הָי֥וּ כֻלָּֽ/נָה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm y'qb 'byhm 'ty shkhltm yvsf 'ynnv vshm'vn 'ynnv v't bnymn tqchv 'ly hyv khlnh
verses.translation: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר רְאוּבֵן֙ אֶל אָבִ֣י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֶת שְׁנֵ֤י בָנַ/י֙ תָּמִ֔ית אִם לֹ֥א אֲבִיאֶ֖/נּוּ אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ תְּנָ֤/ה אֹת/וֹ֙ עַל יָדִ֔/י וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֲשִׁיבֶ֥/נּוּ אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr r'vbn 'l 'byv l'mr 't shny bny tmyt 'm l' 'by'nv 'lykh tnh 'tv 'l ydy v'ny 'shybnv 'lykh
verses.translation: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא יֵרֵ֥ד בְּנִ֖/י עִמָּ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי אָחִ֨י/ו מֵ֜ת וְ/ה֧וּא לְ/בַדּ֣/וֹ נִשְׁאָ֗ר וּ/קְרָאָ֤/הוּ אָסוֹן֙ בַּ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ בָ֔/הּ וְ/הוֹרַדְתֶּ֧ם אֶת שֵׂיבָתִ֛/י בְּ/יָג֖וֹן שְׁאֽוֹלָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr l' yrd bny 'mkhm khy 'chyv mt vhv' lbdv nsh'r vqr'hv 'svn bdrkh 'shr tlkhv bh vhvrdtm 't shybty bygvn sh'vlh
verses.translation: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רָעָ֖ב כָּבֵ֥ד בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhr'b khbd b'rts
verses.translation: And the famine was sore in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר כִּלּוּ֙ לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל אֶת הַ/שֶּׁ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָ֥/נוּ מְעַט אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr khlv l'khl 't hshbr 'shr hby'v mmtsrym vy'mr 'lyhm 'byhm shbv shbrv lnv m't 'khl
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלָ֛י/ו יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָעֵ֣ד הֵעִד֩ בָּ֨/נוּ הָ/אִ֤ישׁ לֵ/אמֹר֙ לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔/י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִי/כֶ֥ם אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv yhvdh l'mr h'd h'd bnv h'ysh l'mr l' tr'v pny blty 'chykhm 'tkhm
verses.translation: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

verses.original: אִם יֶשְׁ/ךָ֛ מְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ אֶת אָחִ֖י/נוּ אִתָּ֑/נוּ נֵרְדָ֕ה וְ/נִשְׁבְּרָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: 'm yshkh mshlch 't 'chynv 'tnv nrdh vnshbrh lkh 'khl
verses.translation: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֵינְ/ךָ֥ מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ לֹ֣א נֵרֵ֑ד כִּֽי הָ/אִ֞ישׁ אָמַ֤ר אֵלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔/י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִי/כֶ֥ם אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm 'ynkh mshlch l' nrd khy h'ysh 'mr 'lynv l' tr'v pny blty 'chykhm 'tkhm
verses.translation: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ/מָ֥ה הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם לִ֑/י לְ/הַגִּ֣יד לָ/אִ֔ישׁ הַ/ע֥וֹד לָ/כֶ֖ם אָֽח
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l lmh hr'tm ly lhgyd l'ysh h'vd lkhm 'ch
verses.translation: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֡וּ שָׁא֣וֹל שָֽׁאַל הָ֠/אִישׁ לָ֣/נוּ וּ/לְ/מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֜/נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הַ/ע֨וֹד אֲבִי/כֶ֥ם חַי֙ הֲ/יֵ֣שׁ לָ/כֶ֣ם אָ֔ח וַ/נַ֨גֶּד ל֔/וֹ עַל פִּ֖י הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה הֲ/יָד֣וֹעַ נֵדַ֔ע כִּ֣י יֹאמַ֔ר הוֹרִ֖ידוּ אֶת אֲחִי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv sh'vl sh'l h'ysh lnv vlmvldtnv l'mr h'vd 'bykhm chy hysh lkhm 'ch vngd lv 'l py hdbrym h'lh hydv' nd' khy y'mr hvrydv 't 'chykhm
verses.translation: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֗י/ו שִׁלְחָ֥/ה הַ/נַּ֛עַר אִתִּ֖/י וְ/נָק֣וּמָה וְ/נֵלֵ֑כָה וְ/נִֽחְיֶה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת גַּם אֲנַ֥חְנוּ גַם אַתָּ֖ה גַּם טַפֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh 'l yshr'l 'byv shlchh hn'r 'ty vnqvmh vnlkhh vnchyh vl' nmvt gm 'nchnv gm 'th gm tpnv
verses.translation: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶֽעֶרְבֶ֔/נּוּ מִ/יָּדִ֖/י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑/נּוּ אִם לֹ֨א הֲבִיאֹתִ֤י/ו אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/הִצַּגְתִּ֣י/ו לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/חָטָ֥אתִֽי לְ/ךָ֖ כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: 'nkhy ''rbnv mydy tbqshnv 'm l' hby'tyv 'lykh vhtsgtyv lpnykh vcht'ty lkh khl hymym
verses.translation: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

verses.original: כִּ֖י לוּלֵ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְנוּ כִּֽי עַתָּ֥ה שַׁ֖בְנוּ זֶ֥ה פַעֲמָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy lvl' htmhmhnv khy 'th shbnv zh p'mym
verses.translation: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֲבִי/הֶ֗ם אִם כֵּ֣ן אֵפוֹא֮ זֹ֣את עֲשׂוּ֒ קְח֞וּ מִ/זִּמְרַ֤ת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ בִּ/כְלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הוֹרִ֥ידוּ לָ/אִ֖ישׁ מִנְחָ֑ה מְעַ֤ט צֳרִי֙ וּ/מְעַ֣ט דְּבַ֔שׁ נְכֹ֣את וָ/לֹ֔ט בָּטְנִ֖ים וּ/שְׁקֵדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm yshr'l 'byhm 'm khn 'pv' z't 'shv qchv mzmrt h'rts bkhlykhm vhvrydv l'ysh mnchh m't tsry vm't dbsh nkh't vlt btnym vshqdym
verses.translation: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

verses.original: וְ/כֶ֥סֶף מִשְׁנֶ֖ה קְח֣וּ בְ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אֶת הַ/כֶּ֜סֶף הַ/מּוּשָׁ֨ב בְּ/פִ֤י אַמְתְּחֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ תָּשִׁ֣יבוּ בְ/יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם אוּלַ֥י מִשְׁגֶּ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vkhsf mshnh qchv bydkhm v't hkhsf hmvshb bpy 'mtchtykhm tshybv bydkhm 'vly mshgh hv'
verses.translation: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אֲחִי/כֶ֖ם קָ֑חוּ וְ/ק֖וּמוּ שׁ֥וּבוּ אֶל הָ/אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: v't 'chykhm qchv vqvmv shvbv 'l h'ysh
verses.translation: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֗י יִתֵּ֨ן לָ/כֶ֤ם רַחֲמִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/אִ֔ישׁ וְ/שִׁלַּ֥ח לָ/כֶ֛ם אֶת אֲחִי/כֶ֥ם אַחֵ֖ר וְ/אֶת בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וַ/אֲנִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכֹ֖לְתִּי שָׁכָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: v'l shdy ytn lkhm rchmym lpny h'ysh vshlch lkhm 't 'chykhm 'chr v't bnymyn v'ny kh'shr shkhlty shkhlty
verses.translation: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֤וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את וּ/מִשְׁנֶה כֶּ֛סֶף לָקְח֥וּ בְ/יָדָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַ/יָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ וַ/יֵּרְד֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vyqchv h'nshym 't hmnchh hz't vmshnh khsf lqchv bydm v't bnymn vyqmv vyrdv mtsrym vy'mdv lpny yvsf
verses.translation: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨רְא יוֹסֵ֣ף אִתָּ/ם֮ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לַֽ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל בֵּית֔/וֹ הָבֵ֥א אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַ/בָּ֑יְתָ/ה וּ/טְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֨בַח֙ וְ/הָכֵ֔ן כִּ֥י אִתִּ֛/י יֹאכְל֥וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים בַּֽ/צָּהֳרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyr' yvsf 'tm 't bnymyn vy'mr l'shr 'l bytv hb' 't h'nshym hbyth vtbch tbch vhkhn khy 'ty y'khlv h'nshym btshrym
verses.translation: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ הָ/אִ֔ישׁ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יָּבֵ֥א הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֥יתָ/ה יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vy'sh h'ysh kh'shr 'mr yvsf vyb' h'ysh 't h'nshym byth yvsf
verses.translation: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְא֣וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּ֣י הֽוּבְאוּ֮ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵף֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ עַל דְּבַ֤ר הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַ/שָּׁ֤ב בְּ/אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ בַּ/תְּחִלָּ֔ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מֽוּבָאִ֑ים לְ/הִתְגֹּלֵ֤ל עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ/לְ/הִתְנַפֵּ֣ל עָלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/לָ/קַ֧חַת אֹתָ֛/נוּ לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים וְ/אֶת חֲמֹרֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyyr'v h'nshym khy hvb'v byt yvsf vy'mrv 'l dbr hkhsf hshb b'mtchtynv btchlh 'nchnv mvb'ym lhtgll 'lynv vlhtnpl 'lynv vlqcht 'tnv l'bdym v't chmrynv
verses.translation: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּגְּשׁוּ֙ אֶל הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו פֶּ֥תַח הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vygshv 'l h'ysh 'shr 'l byt yvsf vydbrv 'lyv ptch hbyt
verses.translation: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֑/י יָרֹ֥ד יָרַ֛דְנוּ בַּ/תְּחִלָּ֖ה לִ/שְׁבָּר אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: vy'mrv by 'dny yrd yrdnv btchlh lshbr 'khl
verses.translation: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֞י כִּי בָ֣אנוּ אֶל הַ/מָּל֗וֹן וַֽ/נִּפְתְּחָ/ה֙ אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה כֶֽסֶף אִישׁ֙ בְּ/פִ֣י אַמְתַּחְתּ֔/וֹ כַּסְפֵּ֖/נוּ בְּ/מִשְׁקָל֑/וֹ וַ/נָּ֥שֶׁב אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/יָדֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vyhy khy b'nv 'l hmlvn vnptchh 't 'mtchtynv vhnh khsf 'ysh bpy 'mtchtv khspnv bmshqlv vnshb 'tv bydnv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

verses.original: וְ/כֶ֧סֶף אַחֵ֛ר הוֹרַ֥דְנוּ בְ/יָדֵ֖/נוּ לִ/שְׁבָּר אֹ֑כֶל לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְנוּ מִי שָׂ֥ם כַּסְפֵּ֖/נוּ בְּ/אַמְתְּחֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vkhsf 'chr hvrdnv bydnv lshbr 'khl l' yd'nv my shm khspnv b'mtchtynv
verses.translation: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ שָׁל֨וֹם לָ/כֶ֜ם אַל תִּירָ֗אוּ אֱלֹ֨הֵי/כֶ֜ם וֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֤י אֲבִי/כֶם֙ נָתַ֨ן לָ/כֶ֤ם מַטְמוֹן֙ בְּ/אַמְתְּחֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם כַּסְפְּ/כֶ֖ם בָּ֣א אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יּוֹצֵ֥א אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם אֶת שִׁמְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr shlvm lkhm 'l tyr'v 'lhykhm v'lhy 'bykhm ntn lkhm mtmvn b'mtchtykhm khspkhm b' 'ly vyvts' 'lhm 't shm'vn
verses.translation: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֥א הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֣יתָ/ה יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יִּתֶּן מַ֨יִם֙ וַ/יִּרְחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן מִסְפּ֖וֹא לַ/חֲמֹֽרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb' h'ysh 't h'nshym byth yvsf vytn mym vyrchtsv rglyhm vytn mspv' lchmryhm
verses.translation: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

verses.original: וַ/יָּכִ֨ינוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה עַד בּ֥וֹא יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּֽ/צָּהֳרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּי שָׁ֖ם יֹ֥אכְלוּ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vykhynv 't hmnchh 'd bv' yvsf btshrym khy shm'v khy shm y'khlv lchm
verses.translation: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ הַ/בַּ֔יְתָ/ה וַ/יָּבִ֥יאּוּ ל֛/וֹ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בְּ/יָדָ֖/ם הַ/בָּ֑יְתָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֖/וֹ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb' yvsf hbyth vyby'v lv 't hmnchh 'shr bydm hbyth vyshtchvv lv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֤ל לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/שָׁל֔וֹם וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֲ/שָׁל֛וֹם אֲבִי/כֶ֥ם הַ/זָּקֵ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הַ/עוֹדֶ֖/נּוּ חָֽי
verses.translit: vysh'l lhm lshlvm vy'mr hshlvm 'bykhm hzqn 'shr 'mrtm h'vdnv chy
verses.translation: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ שָׁל֛וֹם לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ לְ/אָבִ֖י/נוּ עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ חָ֑י וַֽ/יִּקְּד֖וּ ו/ישתחו וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv shlvm l'bdkh l'bynv 'vdnv chy vyqdv vyshtchv vyshtchvv
verses.translation: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֣א עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּ֞רְא אֶת בִּנְיָמִ֣ין אָחִי/ו֮ בֶּן אִמּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֲ/זֶה֙ אֲחִי/כֶ֣ם הַ/קָּטֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים יָחְנְ/ךָ֖ בְּנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vysh' 'ynyv vyr' 't bnymyn 'chyv bn 'mv vy'mr hzh 'chykhm hqtn 'shr 'mrtm 'ly vy'mr 'lhym ychnkh bny
verses.translation: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֣ר יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּֽי נִכְמְר֤וּ רַחֲמָי/ו֙ אֶל אָחִ֔י/ו וַ/יְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לִ/בְכּ֑וֹת וַ/יָּבֹ֥א הַ/חַ֖דְרָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vymhr yvsf khy nkhmrv rchmyv 'l 'chyv vybqsh lbkhvt vyb' hchdrh vybkh shmh
verses.translation: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְחַ֥ץ פָּנָ֖י/ו וַ/יֵּצֵ֑א וַ/יִּ֨תְאַפַּ֔ק וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שִׂ֥ימוּ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyrchts pnyv vyts' vyt'pq vy'mr shymv lchm
verses.translation: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ ל֛/וֹ לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ וְ/לָ/הֶ֣ם לְ/בַדָּ֑/ם וְ/לַ/מִּצְרִ֞ים הָ/אֹכְלִ֤ים אִתּ/וֹ֙ לְ/בַדָּ֔/ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוּכְל֜וּ/ן הַ/מִּצְרִ֗ים לֶ/אֱכֹ֤ל אֶת הָֽ/עִבְרִים֙ לֶ֔חֶם כִּי תוֹעֵבָ֥ה הִ֖וא לְ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshymv lv lbdv vlhm lbdm vlmtsrym h'khlym 'tv lbdm khy l' yvkhlvn hmtsrym l'khl 't h'brym lchm khy tv'bh hv' lmtsrym
verses.translation: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו הַ/בְּכֹר֙ כִּ/בְכֹ֣רָת֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/צָּעִ֖יר כִּ/צְעִרָת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּתְמְה֥וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyshbv lpnyv hbkhr khbkhrtv vhts'yr khts'rtv vytmhv h'nshym 'ysh 'l r'hv
verses.translation: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א מַשְׂאֹ֜ת מֵ/אֵ֣ת פָּנָי/ו֮ אֲלֵ/הֶם֒ וַ/תֵּ֜רֶב מַשְׂאַ֧ת בִּנְיָמִ֛ן מִ/מַּשְׂאֹ֥ת כֻּלָּ֖/ם חָמֵ֣שׁ יָד֑וֹת וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֥וּ וַֽ/יִּשְׁכְּר֖וּ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysh' msh't m't pnyv 'lhm vtrb msh't bnymn mmsh't khlm chmsh ydvt vyshtv vyshkhrv 'mv
verses.translation: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֞ו אֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל בֵּית/וֹ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ מַלֵּ֞א אֶת אַמְתְּחֹ֤ת הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ אֹ֔כֶל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּכְל֖וּ/ן שְׂאֵ֑ת וְ/שִׂ֥ים כֶּֽסֶף אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/פִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytsv 't 'shr 'l bytv l'mr ml' 't 'mtcht h'nshym 'khl kh'shr yvkhlvn sh't vshym khsf 'ysh bpy 'mtchtv
verses.translation: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת גְּבִיעִ֞/י גְּבִ֣יעַ הַ/כֶּ֗סֶף תָּשִׂים֙ בְּ/פִי֙ אַמְתַּ֣חַת הַ/קָּטֹ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף שִׁבְר֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: v't gby'y gby' hkhsf tshym bpy 'mtcht hqtn v't khsf shbrv vy'sh khdbr yvsf 'shr dbr
verses.translation: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

verses.original: הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר א֑וֹר וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים שֻׁלְּח֔וּ הֵ֖מָּה וַ/חֲמֹרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hbqr 'vr vh'nshym shlchv hmh vchmryhm
verses.translation: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

verses.original: הֵ֠ם יָֽצְא֣וּ אֶת הָ/עִיר֮ לֹ֣א הִרְחִיקוּ֒ וְ/יוֹסֵ֤ף אָמַר֙ לַֽ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל בֵּית֔/וֹ ק֥וּם רְדֹ֖ף אַחֲרֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְ/הִשַּׂגְתָּ/ם֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם לָ֛/מָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּ֥ם רָעָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: hm yts'v 't h'yr l' hrchyqv vyvsf 'mr l'shr 'l bytv qvm rdf 'chry h'nshym vhshgtm v'mrt 'lhm lmh shlmtm r'h tcht tvbh
verses.translation: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא זֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁתֶּ֤ה אֲדֹנִ/י֙ בּ֔/וֹ וְ/ה֕וּא נַחֵ֥שׁ יְנַחֵ֖שׁ בּ֑/וֹ הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
verses.translit: hlv' zh 'shr yshth 'dny bv vhv' nchsh ynchsh bv hr'tm 'shr 'shytm
verses.translation: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּשִּׂגֵ֑/ם וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyshgm vydbr 'lhm 't hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו לָ֚/מָּה יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔/י כַּ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה חָלִ֨ילָ/ה֙ לַ/עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ מֵ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv lmh ydbr 'dny khdbrym h'lh chlylh l'bdykh m'shvt khdbr hzh
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

verses.original: הֵ֣ן כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָצָ֨אנוּ֙ בְּ/פִ֣י אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔י/נוּ הֱשִׁיבֹ֥נוּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/אֵ֗יךְ נִגְנֹב֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית אֲדֹנֶ֔י/ךָ כֶּ֖סֶף א֥וֹ זָהָֽב
verses.translit: hn khsf 'shr mts'nv bpy 'mtchtynv hshybnv 'lykh m'rts khn'n v'ykh ngnb mbyt 'dnykh khsf 'v zhb
verses.translation: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֥א אִתּ֛/וֹ מֵ/עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ וָ/מֵ֑ת וְ/גַם אֲנַ֕חְנוּ נִֽהְיֶ֥ה לַֽ/אדֹנִ֖/י לַ/עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: 'shr ymts' 'tv m'bdykh vmt vgm 'nchnv nhyh l'dny l'bdym
verses.translation: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם עַתָּ֥ה כְ/דִבְרֵי/כֶ֖ם כֶּן ה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א אִתּ/וֹ֙ יִהְיֶה לִּ֣/י עָ֔בֶד וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְי֥וּ נְקִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr gm 'th khdbrykhm khn hv' 'shr ymts' 'tv yhyh ly 'bd v'tm thyv nqym
verses.translation: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְמַהֲר֗וּ וַ/יּוֹרִ֛דוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת אַמְתַּחְתּ֖/וֹ אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַֽ/יִּפְתְּח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vymhrv vyvrdv 'ysh 't 'mtchtv 'rtsh vyptchv 'ysh 'mtchtv
verses.translation: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַפֵּ֕שׂ בַּ/גָּד֣וֹל הֵחֵ֔ל וּ/בַ/קָּטֹ֖ן כִּלָּ֑ה וַ/יִּמָּצֵא֙ הַ/גָּבִ֔יעַ בְּ/אַמְתַּ֖חַת בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vychpsh bgdvl hchl vbqtn khlh vymts' hgby' b'mtcht bnymn
verses.translation: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְע֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָ֑/ם וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹס֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל חֲמֹר֔/וֹ וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הָ/עִֽירָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqr'v shmltm vy'ms 'ysh 'l chmrv vyshbv h'yrh
verses.translation: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יְהוּדָ֤ה וְ/אֶחָי/ו֙ בֵּ֣יתָ/ה יוֹסֵ֔ף וְ/ה֖וּא עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ שָׁ֑ם וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb' yhvdh v'chyv byth yvsf vhv' 'vdnv shm vyplv lpnyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף מָֽה הַ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם הֲ/ל֣וֹא יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּֽי נַחֵ֧שׁ יְנַחֵ֛שׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּמֹֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm yvsf mh hm'shh hzh 'shr 'shytm hlv' yd'tm khy nchsh ynchsh 'ysh 'shr khmny
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה מַה נֹּאמַר֙ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י מַה נְּדַבֵּ֖ר וּ/מַה נִּצְטַדָּ֑ק הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָצָא֙ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ הִנֶּ/נּ֤וּ עֲבָדִים֙ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י גַּם אֲנַ֕חְנוּ גַּ֛ם אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָ֥א הַ/גָּבִ֖יעַ בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh mh n'mr l'dny mh ndbr vmh ntstdq h'lhym mts' 't 'vn 'bdykh hnnv 'bdym l'dny gm 'nchnv gm 'shr nmts' hgby' bydv
verses.translation: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָ/ה לִּ֔/י מֵ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת זֹ֑את הָ/אִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א הַ/גָּבִ֜יעַ בְּ/יָד֗/וֹ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶה לִּ֣/י עָ֔בֶד וְ/אַתֶּ֕ם עֲל֥וּ לְ/שָׁל֖וֹם אֶל אֲבִי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr chlylh ly m'shvt z't h'ysh 'shr nmts' hgby' bydv hv' yhyh ly 'bd v'tm 'lv lshlvm 'l 'bykhm
verses.translation: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלָ֜י/ו יְהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ/י֒ יְדַבֶּר נָ֨א עַבְדְּ/ךָ֤ דָבָר֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י וְ/אַל יִ֥חַר אַפְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֥י כָמ֖וֹ/ךָ כְּ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vygsh 'lyv yhvdh vy'mr by 'dny ydbr n' 'bdkh dbr b'zny 'dny v'l ychr 'pkh b'bdkh khy khmvkh khpr'h
verses.translation: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֣/י שָׁאַ֔ל אֶת עֲבָדָ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֲ/יֵשׁ לָ/כֶ֥ם אָ֖ב אוֹ אָֽח
verses.translit: 'dny sh'l 't 'bdyv l'mr hysh lkhm 'b 'v 'ch
verses.translation: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

verses.original: וַ/נֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֔/י יֶשׁ לָ֨/נוּ֙ אָ֣ב זָקֵ֔ן וְ/יֶ֥לֶד זְקֻנִ֖ים קָטָ֑ן וְ/אָחִ֨י/ו מֵ֜ת וַ/יִּוָּתֵ֨ר ה֧וּא לְ/בַדּ֛/וֹ לְ/אִמּ֖/וֹ וְ/אָבִ֥י/ו אֲהֵבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vn'mr 'l 'dny ysh lnv 'b zqn vyld zqnym qtn v'chyv mt vyvtr hv' lbdv l'mv v'byv 'hbv
verses.translation: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ הוֹרִדֻ֖/הוּ אֵלָ֑/י וְ/אָשִׂ֥ימָה עֵינִ֖/י עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l 'bdykh hvrdhv 'ly v'shymh 'yny 'lyv
verses.translation: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

verses.original: וַ/נֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֔/י לֹא יוּכַ֥ל הַ/נַּ֖עַר לַ/עֲזֹ֣ב אֶת אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/עָזַ֥ב אֶת אָבִ֖י/ו וָ/מֵֽת
verses.translit: vn'mr 'l 'dny l' yvkhl hn'r l'zb 't 'byv v'zb 't 'byv vmt
verses.translation: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ אִם לֹ֥א יֵרֵ֛ד אֲחִי/כֶ֥ם הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תֹסִפ֖וּ/ן לִ/רְא֥וֹת פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l 'bdykh 'm l' yrd 'chykhm hqtn 'tkhm l' tspvn lr'vt pny
verses.translation: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כִּ֣י עָלִ֔ינוּ אֶֽל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ אָבִ֑/י וַ/נַּ֨גֶּד ל֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy khy 'lynv 'l 'bdkh 'by vngd lv 't dbry 'dny
verses.translation: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אָבִ֑י/נוּ שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָ֥/נוּ מְעַט אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bynv shbv shbrv lnv m't 'khl
verses.translation: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

verses.original: וַ/נֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לָ/רֶ֑דֶת אִם יֵשׁ֩ אָחִ֨י/נוּ הַ/קָּטֹ֤ן אִתָּ֨/נוּ֙ וְ/יָרַ֔דְנוּ כִּי לֹ֣א נוּכַ֗ל לִ/רְאוֹת֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אִ֔ישׁ וְ/אָחִ֥י/נוּ הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ אִתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vn'mr l' nvkhl lrdt 'm ysh 'chynv hqtn 'tnv vyrdnv khy l' nvkhl lr'vt pny h'ysh v'chynv hqtn 'ynnv 'tnv
verses.translation: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ אָבִ֖/י אֵלֵ֑י/נוּ אַתֶּ֣ם יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּ֥י שְׁנַ֖יִם יָֽלְדָה לִּ֥/י אִשְׁתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bdkh 'by 'lynv 'tm yd'tm khy shnym yldh ly 'shty
verses.translation: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ מֵֽ/אִתִּ֔/י וָ/אֹמַ֕ר אַ֖ךְ טָרֹ֣ף טֹרָ֑ף וְ/לֹ֥א רְאִיתִ֖י/ו עַד הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vyts' h'chd m'ty v'mr 'kh trf trf vl' r'ytyv 'd hnh
verses.translation: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

verses.original: וּ/לְקַחְתֶּ֧ם גַּם אֶת זֶ֛ה מֵ/עִ֥ם פָּנַ֖/י וְ/קָרָ֣/הוּ אָס֑וֹן וְ/הֽוֹרַדְתֶּ֧ם אֶת שֵׂיבָתִ֛/י בְּ/רָעָ֖ה שְׁאֹֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vlqchtm gm 't zh m'm pny vqrhv 'svn vhvrdtm 't shybty br'h sh'lh
verses.translation: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כְּ/בֹאִ/י֙ אֶל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ אָבִ֔/י וְ/הַ/נַּ֖עַר אֵינֶ֣/נּוּ אִתָּ֑/נוּ וְ/נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ קְשׁוּרָ֥ה בְ/נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th khb'y 'l 'bdkh 'by vhn'r 'ynnv 'tnv vnpshv qshvrh bnpshv
verses.translation: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּ/רְאוֹת֛/וֹ כִּי אֵ֥ין הַ/נַּ֖עַר וָ/מֵ֑ת וְ/הוֹרִ֨ידוּ עֲבָדֶ֜י/ךָ אֶת שֵׂיבַ֨ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ אָבִ֛י/נוּ בְּ/יָג֖וֹן שְׁאֹֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vhyh khr'vtv khy 'yn hn'r vmt vhvrydv 'bdykh 't shybt 'bdkh 'bynv bygvn sh'lh
verses.translation: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ עָרַ֣ב אֶת הַ/נַּ֔עַר מֵ/עִ֥ם אָבִ֖/י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִם לֹ֤א אֲבִיאֶ֨/נּוּ֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/חָטָ֥אתִי לְ/אָבִ֖/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'bdkh 'rb 't hn'r m'm 'by l'mr 'm l' 'by'nv 'lykh vcht'ty l'by khl hymym
verses.translation: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה יֵֽשֶׁב נָ֤א עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/נַּ֔עַר עֶ֖בֶד לַֽ/אדֹנִ֑/י וְ/הַ/נַּ֖עַר יַ֥עַל עִם אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'th yshb n' 'bdkh tcht hn'r 'bd l'dny vhn'r y'l 'm 'chyv
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

verses.original: כִּי אֵיךְ֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל אָבִ֔/י וְ/הַ/נַּ֖עַר אֵינֶ֣/נּוּ אִתִּ֑/י פֶּ֚ן אֶרְאֶ֣ה בָ/רָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִמְצָ֖א אֶת אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'ykh ''lh 'l 'by vhn'r 'ynnv 'ty pn 'r'h br' 'shr ymts' 't 'by
verses.translation: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יָכֹ֨ל יוֹסֵ֜ף לְ/הִתְאַפֵּ֗ק לְ/כֹ֤ל הַ/נִּצָּבִים֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְרָ֕א הוֹצִ֥יאוּ כָל אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/עָלָ֑/י וְ/לֹא עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ בְּ/הִתְוַדַּ֥ע יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶל אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vl' ykhl yvsf lht'pq lkhl hntsbym 'lyv vyqr' hvtsy'v khl 'ysh m'ly vl' 'md 'ysh 'tv bhtvd' yvsf 'l 'chyv
verses.translation: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אֶת קֹל֖/וֹ בִּ/בְכִ֑י וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vytn 't qlv bbkhy vyshm'v mtsrym vyshm' byt pr'h
verses.translation: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶל אֶחָי/ו֙ אֲנִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף הַ/ע֥וֹד אָבִ֖/י חָ֑י וְ/לֹֽא יָכְל֤וּ אֶחָי/ו֙ לַ/עֲנ֣וֹת אֹת֔/וֹ כִּ֥י נִבְהֲל֖וּ מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l 'chyv 'ny yvsf h'vd 'by chy vl' ykhlv 'chyv l'nvt 'tv khy nbhlv mpnyv
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶל אֶחָ֛י/ו גְּשׁוּ נָ֥א אֵלַ֖/י וַ/יִּגָּ֑שׁוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֲנִי֙ יוֹסֵ֣ף אֲחִי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖/י מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l 'chyv gshv n' 'ly vygshv vy'mr 'ny yvsf 'chykhm 'shr mkhrtm 'ty mtsrymh
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אַל תֵּעָ֣צְב֗וּ וְ/אַל יִ֨חַר֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖/י הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֣י לְ/מִֽחְיָ֔ה שְׁלָחַ֥/נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th 'l t'tsbv v'l ychr b'ynykhm khy mkhrtm 'ty hnh khy lmchyh shlchny 'lhym lpnykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

verses.original: כִּי זֶ֛ה שְׁנָתַ֥יִם הָ/רָעָ֖ב בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/עוֹד֙ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין חָרִ֖ישׁ וְ/קָצִּֽיר
verses.translit: khy zh shntym hr'b bqrb h'rts v'vd chmsh shnym 'shr 'yn chrysh vqtsyr
verses.translation: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֵ֤/נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם לָ/שׂ֥וּם לָ/כֶ֛ם שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/לְ/הַחֲי֣וֹת לָ/כֶ֔ם לִ/פְלֵיטָ֖ה גְּדֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlchny 'lhym lpnykhm lshvm lkhm sh'ryt b'rts vlhchyvt lkhm lplyth gdlh
verses.translation: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לֹֽא אַתֶּ֞ם שְׁלַחְתֶּ֤ם אֹתִ/י֙ הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֖י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יְשִׂימֵ֨/נִֽי לְ/אָ֜ב לְ/פַרְעֹ֗ה וּ/לְ/אָדוֹן֙ לְ/כָל בֵּית֔/וֹ וּ/מֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'th l' 'tm shlchtm 'ty hnh khy h'lhym vyshymny l'b lpr'h vl'dvn lkhl bytv vmshl bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: מַהֲרוּ֮ וַ/עֲל֣וּ אֶל אָבִ/י֒ וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ בִּנְ/ךָ֣ יוֹסֵ֔ף שָׂמַ֧/נִי אֱלֹהִ֛ים לְ/אָד֖וֹן לְ/כָל מִצְרָ֑יִם רְדָ֥/ה אֵלַ֖/י אַֽל תַּעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: mhrv v'lv 'l 'by v'mrtm 'lyv khh 'mr bnkh yvsf shmny 'lhym l'dvn lkhl mtsrym rdh 'ly 'l t'md
verses.translation: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֣ בְ/אֶֽרֶץ גֹּ֗שֶׁן וְ/הָיִ֤יתָ קָרוֹב֙ אֵלַ֔/י אַתָּ֕ה וּ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/בְנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/צֹאנְ/ךָ֥ וּ/בְקָרְ/ךָ֖ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyshbt b'rts gshn vhyyt qrvb 'ly 'th vbnykh vbny bnykh vts'nkh vbqrkh vkhl 'shr lkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

verses.original: וְ/כִלְכַּלְתִּ֤י אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם כִּי ע֛וֹד חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים רָעָ֑ב פֶּן תִּוָּרֵ֛שׁ אַתָּ֥ה וּ/בֵֽיתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhlkhlty 'tkh shm khy 'vd chmsh shnym r'b pn tvrsh 'th vbytkh vkhl 'shr lkh
verses.translation: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ רֹא֔וֹת וְ/עֵינֵ֖י אָחִ֣/י בִנְיָמִ֑ין כִּי פִ֖/י הַֽ/מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhnh 'ynykhm r'vt v'yny 'chy bnymyn khy py hmdbr 'lykhm
verses.translation: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

verses.original: וְ/הִגַּדְתֶּ֣ם לְ/אָבִ֗/י אֶת כָּל כְּבוֹדִ/י֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֑ם וּ/מִֽהַרְתֶּ֛ם וְ/הוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת אָבִ֖/י הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vhgdtm l'by 't khl khbvdy bmtsrym v't khl 'shr r'ytm vmhrtm vhvrdtm 't 'by hnh
verses.translation: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֛ל עַל צַוְּארֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן אָחִ֖י/ו וַ/יֵּ֑בְךְּ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּכָ֖ה עַל צַוָּארָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vypl 'l tsv'ry bnymn 'chyv vybkh vbnymn bkhh 'l tsv'ryv
verses.translation: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַשֵּׁ֥ק לְ/כָל אֶחָ֖י/ו וַ/יֵּ֣בְךְּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן דִּבְּר֥וּ אֶחָ֖י/ו אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vynshq lkhl 'chyv vybkh 'lyhm v'chry khn dbrv 'chyv 'tv
verses.translation: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/קֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמַ֗ע בֵּ֤ית פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּ֖אוּ אֲחֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יִּיטַב֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhql nshm' byt pr'h l'mr b'v 'chy yvsf vyytb b'yny pr'h vb'yny 'bdyv
verses.translation: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל אַחֶ֖י/ךָ זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ טַֽעֲנוּ֙ אֶת בְּעִ֣ירְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/לְכוּ בֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָ/ה כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l yvsf 'mr 'l 'chykh z't 'shv t'nv 't b'yrkhm vlkhv b'v 'rtsh khn'n
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

verses.original: וּ/קְח֧וּ אֶת אֲבִי/כֶ֛ם וְ/אֶת בָּתֵּי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בֹ֣אוּ אֵלָ֑/י וְ/אֶתְּנָ֣ה לָ/כֶ֗ם אֶת טוּב֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/אִכְל֖וּ אֶת חֵ֥לֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vqchv 't 'bykhm v't btykhm vb'v 'ly v'tnh lkhm 't tvb 'rts mtsrym v'khlv 't chlb h'rts
verses.translation: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֥ה צֻוֵּ֖יתָה זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ לָ/כֶם֩ מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם עֲגָל֗וֹת לְ/טַפְּ/כֶם֙ וְ/לִ/נְשֵׁי/כֶ֔ם וּ/נְשָׂאתֶ֥ם אֶת אֲבִי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בָאתֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th tsvyth z't 'shv qchv lkhm m'rts mtsrym 'glvt ltpkhm vlnshykhm vnsh'tm 't 'bykhm vb'tm
verses.translation: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.original: וְ/עֵ֣ינְ/כֶ֔ם אַל תָּחֹ֖ס עַל כְּלֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּי ט֛וּב כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָ/כֶ֥ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'ynkhm 'l tchs 'l khlykhm khy tvb khl 'rts mtsrym lkhm hv'
verses.translation: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֥ם יוֹסֵ֛ף עֲגָל֖וֹת עַל פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן לָ/הֶ֛ם צֵדָ֖ה לַ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'shv khn bny yshr'l vytn lhm yvsf 'glvt 'l py pr'h vytn lhm tsdh ldrkh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

verses.original: לְ/כֻלָּ֥/ם נָתַ֛ן לָ/אִ֖ישׁ חֲלִפ֣וֹת שְׂמָלֹ֑ת וּ/לְ/בִנְיָמִ֤ן נָתַן֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/חָמֵ֖שׁ חֲלִפֹ֥ת שְׂמָלֹֽת
verses.translit: lkhlm ntn l'ysh chlpvt shmlt vlbnymn ntn shlsh m'vt khsf vchmsh chlpt shmlt
verses.translation: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אָבִ֞י/ו שָׁלַ֤ח כְּ/זֹאת֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֲמֹרִ֔ים נֹשְׂאִ֖ים מִ/טּ֣וּב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/עֶ֣שֶׂר אֲתֹנֹ֡ת נֹֽ֠שְׂאֹת בָּ֣ר וָ/לֶ֧חֶם וּ/מָז֛וֹן לְ/אָבִ֖י/ו לַ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vl'byv shlch khz't 'shrh chmrym nsh'ym mtvb mtsrym v'shr 'tnt nsh't br vlchm vmzvn l'byv ldrkh
verses.translation: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת אֶחָ֖י/ו וַ/יֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אַֽל תִּרְגְּז֖וּ בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshlch 't 'chyv vylkhv vy'mr 'lhm 'l trgzv bdrkh
verses.translation: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲבִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'lv mmtsrym vyb'v 'rts khn'n 'l y'qb 'byhm
verses.translation: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֨דוּ ל֜/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר ע֚וֹד יוֹסֵ֣ף חַ֔י וְ/כִֽי ה֥וּא מֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יָּ֣פָג לִבּ֔/וֹ כִּ֥י לֹא הֶאֱמִ֖ין לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vygdv lv l'mr 'vd yvsf chy vkhy hv' mshl bkhl 'rts mtsrym vypg lbv khy l' h'myn lhm
verses.translation: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו אֵ֣ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת הָ֣/עֲגָל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח יוֹסֵ֖ף לָ/שֵׂ֣את אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/תְּחִ֕י ר֖וּחַ יַעֲקֹ֥ב אֲבִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vydbrv 'lyv 't khl dbry yvsf 'shr dbr 'lhm vyr' 't h'glvt 'shr shlch yvsf lsh't 'tv vtchy rvch y'qb 'byhm
verses.translation: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רַ֛ב עוֹד יוֹסֵ֥ף בְּנִ֖/י חָ֑י אֵֽלְכָ֥ה וְ/אֶרְאֶ֖/נּוּ בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם אָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l rb 'vd yvsf bny chy 'lkhh v'r'nv btrm 'mvt
verses.translation: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֖א בְּאֵ֣רָ/ה שָּׁ֑בַע וַ/יִּזְבַּ֣ח זְבָחִ֔ים לֵ/אלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֥י/ו יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: vys' yshr'l vkhl 'shr lv vyb' b'rh shb' vyzbch zbchym l'lhy 'byv ytschq
verses.translation: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֤ים לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/מַרְאֹ֣ת הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֣ב יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym lyshr'l bmr't hlylh vy'mr y'qb y'qb vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י הָ/אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑י/ךָ אַל תִּירָא֙ מֵ/רְדָ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה כִּֽי לְ/ג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִֽׂימְ/ךָ֥ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'nkhy h'l 'lhy 'bykh 'l tyr' mrdh mtsrymh khy lgvy gdvl 'shymkh shm
verses.translation: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֗י אֵרֵ֤ד עִמְּ/ךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אַֽעַלְ/ךָ֣ גַם עָלֹ֑ה וְ/יוֹסֵ֕ף יָשִׁ֥ית יָד֖/וֹ עַל עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'rd 'mkh mtsrymh v'nkhy ''lkh gm 'lh vyvsf yshyt ydv 'l 'ynykh
verses.translation: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קָם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִ/בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַ/יִּשְׂא֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִי/הֶ֗ם וְ/אֶת טַפָּ/ם֙ וְ/אֶת נְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם בָּ/עֲגָל֕וֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח פַּרְעֹ֖ה לָ/שֵׂ֥את אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqm y'qb mb'r shb' vysh'v bny yshr'l 't y'qb 'byhm v't tpm v't nshyhm b'glvt 'shr shlch pr'h lsh't 'tv
verses.translation: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ אֶת מִקְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/אֶת רְכוּשָׁ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽכְשׁוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/ה יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְ/כָל זַרְע֥/וֹ אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqchv 't mqnyhm v't rkhvshm 'shr rkhshv b'rts khn'n vyb'v mtsrymh y'qb vkhl zr'v 'tv
verses.translation: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

verses.original: בָּנָ֞י/ו וּ/בְנֵ֤י בָנָי/ו֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ בְּנֹתָ֛י/ו וּ/בְנ֥וֹת בָּנָ֖י/ו וְ/כָל זַרְע֑/וֹ הֵבִ֥יא אִתּ֖/וֹ מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: bnyv vbny bnyv 'tv bntyv vbnvt bnyv vkhl zr'v hby' 'tv mtsrymh
verses.translation: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֧וֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַ/בָּאִ֥ים מִצְרַ֖יְמָ/ה יַעֲקֹ֣ב וּ/בָנָ֑י/ו בְּכֹ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵֽן
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny yshr'l hb'ym mtsrymh y'qb vbnyv bkhr y'qb r'vbn
verses.translation: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י רְאוּבֵ֑ן חֲנ֥וֹךְ וּ/פַלּ֖וּא וְ/חֶצְר֥וֹן וְ/כַרְמִֽי
verses.translit: vbny r'vbn chnvkh vplv' vchtsrvn vkhrmy
verses.translation: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֧ל וְ/יָמִ֛ין וְ/אֹ֖הַד וְ/יָכִ֣ין וְ/צֹ֑חַר וְ/שָׁא֖וּל בֶּן הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִֽית
verses.translit: vbny shm'vn ymv'l vymyn v'hd vykhyn vtschr vsh'vl bn hkhn'nyt
verses.translation: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן קְהָ֖ת וּ/מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: vbny lvy grshvn qht vmrry
verses.translation: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֧ר וְ/אוֹנָ֛ן וְ/שֵׁלָ֖ה וָ/פֶ֣רֶץ וָ/זָ֑רַח וַ/יָּ֨מָת עֵ֤ר וְ/אוֹנָן֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְ/חָמֽוּל
verses.translit: vbny yhvdh 'r v'vnn vshlh vprts vzrch vymt 'r v'vnn b'rts khn'n vyhyv bny prts chtsrvn vchmvl
verses.translation: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר תּוֹלָ֥ע וּ/פֻוָּ֖ה וְ/י֥וֹב וְ/שִׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vbny yshshkhr tvl' vpvh vyvb vshmrvn
verses.translation: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י זְבוּלֻ֑ן סֶ֥רֶד וְ/אֵל֖וֹן וְ/יַחְלְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbny zbvln srd v'lvn vychl'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָֽלְדָ֤ה לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ בְּ/פַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֑/וֹ כָּל נֶ֧פֶשׁ בָּנָ֛י/ו וּ/בְנוֹתָ֖י/ו שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/שָׁלֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'lh bny l'h 'shr yldh ly'qb bpdn 'rm v't dynh btv khl npsh bnyv vbnvtyv shlshym vshlsh
verses.translation: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד צִפְי֥וֹן וְ/חַגִּ֖י שׁוּנִ֣י וְ/אֶצְבֹּ֑ן עֵרִ֥י וַֽ/אֲרוֹדִ֖י וְ/אַרְאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: vbny gd tspyvn vchgy shvny v'tsbn 'ry v'rvdy v'r'ly
verses.translation: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְ/יִשְׁוָ֛ה וְ/יִשְׁוִ֥י וּ/בְרִיעָ֖ה וְ/שֶׂ֣רַח אֲחֹתָ֑/ם וּ/בְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּ/מַלְכִּיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbny 'shr ymnh vyshvh vyshvy vbry'h vshrch 'chtm vbny bry'h chbr vmlkhy'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י זִלְפָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְ/לֵאָ֣ה בִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֤לֶד אֶת אֵ֨לֶּה֙ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: 'lh bny zlph 'shr ntn lbn ll'h btv vtld 't 'lh ly'qb shsh 'shrh npsh
verses.translation: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י רָחֵל֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יוֹסֵ֖ף וּ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: bny rchl 'sht y'qb yvsf vbnymn
verses.translation: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְ/יוֹסֵף֮ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה לּ/וֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֣ן אֹ֑ן אֶת מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְ/אֶת אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyvld lyvsf b'rts mtsrym 'shr yldh lv 'snt bt pvty pr' khhn 'n 't mnshh v't 'prym
verses.translation: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֤לַע וָ/בֶ֨כֶר֙ וְ/אַשְׁבֵּ֔ל גֵּרָ֥א וְ/נַעֲמָ֖ן אֵחִ֣י וָ/רֹ֑אשׁ מֻפִּ֥ים וְ/חֻפִּ֖ים וָ/אָֽרְדְּ
verses.translit: vbny bnymn bl' vbkhr v'shbl gr' vn'mn 'chy vr'sh mpym vchpym v'rd
verses.translation: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖ד לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל נֶ֖פֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: 'lh bny rchl 'shr yld ly'qb khl npsh 'rb'h 'shr
verses.translation: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי דָ֖ן חֻשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vbny dn chshym
verses.translation: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י נַפְתָּלִ֑י יַחְצְאֵ֥ל וְ/גוּנִ֖י וְ/יֵ֥צֶר וְ/שִׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: vbny nptly ychts'l vgvny vytsr vshlm
verses.translation: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְ/רָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֑/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֧לֶד אֶת אֵ֛לֶּה לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב כָּל נֶ֥פֶשׁ שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh bny blhh 'shr ntn lbn lrchl btv vtld 't 'lh ly'qb khl npsh shb'h
verses.translation: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

verses.original: כָּל הַ֠/נֶּפֶשׁ הַ/בָּאָ֨ה לְ/יַעֲקֹ֤ב מִצְרַ֨יְמָ/ה֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י יְרֵכ֔/וֹ מִ/לְּ/בַ֖ד נְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵי יַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל נֶ֖פֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָ/שֵֽׁשׁ
verses.translit: khl hnpsh hb'h ly'qb mtsrymh yts'y yrkhv mlbd nshy bny y'qb khl npsh shshym vshsh
verses.translation: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֛ף אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד ל֥/וֹ בְ/מִצְרַ֖יִם נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׁנָ֑יִם כָּל הַ/נֶּ֧פֶשׁ לְ/בֵֽית יַעֲקֹ֛ב הַ/בָּ֥אָה מִצְרַ֖יְמָ/ה שִׁבְעִֽים
verses.translit: vbny yvsf 'shr yld lv bmtsrym npsh shnym khl hnpsh lbyt y'qb hb'h mtsrymh shb'ym
verses.translation: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת יְהוּדָ֞ה שָׁלַ֤ח לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף לְ/הוֹרֹ֥ת לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו גֹּ֑שְׁנָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָ/ה גֹּֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: v't yhvdh shlch lpnyv 'l yvsf lhvrt lpnyv gshnh vyb'v 'rtsh gshn
verses.translation: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאְסֹ֤ר יוֹסֵף֙ מֶרְכַּבְתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּ֛עַל לִ/קְרַֽאת יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אָבִ֖י/ו גֹּ֑שְׁנָ/ה וַ/יֵּרָ֣א אֵלָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּפֹּל֙ עַל צַוָּארָ֔י/ו וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל צַוָּארָ֖י/ו עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vy'sr yvsf mrkhbtv vy'l lqr't yshr'l 'byv gshnh vyr' 'lyv vypl 'l tsv'ryv vybkh 'l tsv'ryv 'vd
verses.translation: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף אָמ֣וּתָה הַ/פָּ֑עַם אַחֲרֵי֙ רְאוֹתִ֣/י אֶת פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֥י עוֹדְ/ךָ֖ חָֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l 'l yvsf 'mvth hp'm 'chry r'vty 't pnykh khy 'vdkh chy
verses.translation: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶל אֶחָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/ו אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וְ/אַגִּ֣ידָה לְ/פַרְעֹ֑ה וְ/אֹֽמְרָ֣ה אֵלָ֔י/ו אַחַ֧/י וּ/בֵית אָבִ֛/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן בָּ֥אוּ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l 'chyv v'l byt 'byv ''lh v'gydh lpr'h v'mrh 'lyv 'chy vbyt 'by 'shr b'rts khn'n b'v 'ly
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ רֹ֣עֵי צֹ֔אן כִּֽי אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הָי֑וּ וְ/צֹאנָ֧/ם וּ/בְקָרָ֛/ם וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָ/הֶ֖ם הֵבִֽיאוּ
verses.translit: vh'nshym r'y ts'n khy 'nshy mqnh hyv vts'nm vbqrm vkhl 'shr lhm hby'v
verses.translation: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֕ה כִּֽי יִקְרָ֥א לָ/כֶ֖ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/אָמַ֖ר מַה מַּעֲשֵׂי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khy yqr' lkhm pr'h v'mr mh m'shykhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִקְנֶ֜ה הָי֤וּ עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/נְּעוּרֵ֣י/נוּ וְ/עַד עַ֔תָּה גַּם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ גַּם אֲבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ בַּ/עֲב֗וּר תֵּשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן כִּֽי תוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם כָּל רֹ֥עֵה צֹֽאן
verses.translit: v'mrtm 'nshy mqnh hyv 'bdykh mn'vrynv v'd 'th gm 'nchnv gm 'btynv b'bvr tshbv b'rts gshn khy tv'bt mtsrym khl r'h ts'n
verses.translation: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א יוֹסֵף֮ וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/פַרְעֹה֒ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אָבִ֨/י וְ/אַחַ֜/י וְ/צֹאנָ֤/ם וּ/בְקָרָ/ם֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/הֶ֔ם בָּ֖אוּ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/הִנָּ֖/ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vyb' yvsf vygd lpr'h vy'mr 'by v'chy vts'nm vbqrm vkhl 'shr lhm b'v m'rts khn'n vhnm b'rts gshn
verses.translation: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/קְצֵ֣ה אֶחָ֔י/ו לָקַ֖ח חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יַּצִּגֵ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vmqtsh 'chyv lqch chmshh 'nshym vytsgm lpny pr'h
verses.translation: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל אֶחָ֖י/ו מַה מַּעֲשֵׂי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֗ה רֹעֵ֥ה צֹאן֙ עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ גַּם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ גַּם אֲבוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l 'chyv mh m'shykhm vy'mrv 'l pr'h r'h ts'n 'bdykh gm 'nchnv gm 'bvtynv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֗ה לָ/ג֣וּר בָּ/אָרֶץ֮ בָּאנוּ֒ כִּי אֵ֣ין מִרְעֶ֗ה לַ/צֹּאן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי כָבֵ֥ד הָ/רָעָ֖ב בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/עַתָּ֛ה יֵֽשְׁבוּ נָ֥א עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l pr'h lgvr b'rts b'nv khy 'yn mr'h lts'n 'shr l'bdykh khy khbd hr'b b'rts khn'n v'th yshbv n' 'bdykh b'rts gshn
verses.translation: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אָבִ֥י/ךָ וְ/אַחֶ֖י/ךָ בָּ֥אוּ אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l yvsf l'mr 'bykh v'chykh b'v 'lykh
verses.translation: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ הִ֔וא בְּ/מֵיטַ֣ב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הוֹשֵׁ֥ב אֶת אָבִ֖י/ךָ וְ/אֶת אַחֶ֑י/ךָ יֵשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן וְ/אִם יָדַ֗עְתָּ וְ/יֶשׁ בָּ/ם֙ אַנְשֵׁי חַ֔יִל וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֛/ם שָׂרֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה עַל אֲשֶׁר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'rts mtsrym lpnykh hv' bmytb h'rts hvshb 't 'bykh v't 'chykh yshbv b'rts gshn v'm yd't vysh bm 'nshy chyl vshmtm shry mqnh 'l 'shr ly
verses.translation: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ אֶת יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יַּֽעֲמִדֵ֖/הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyb' yvsf 't y'qb 'byv vy'mdhv lpny pr'h vybrkh y'qb 't pr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֑ב כַּ/מָּ֕ה יְמֵ֖י שְׁנֵ֥י חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l y'qb khmh ymy shny chyykh
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵ֣י מְגוּרַ֔/י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה מְעַ֣ט וְ/רָעִ֗ים הָיוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיַּ֔/י וְ/לֹ֣א הִשִּׂ֗יגוּ אֶת יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י אֲבֹתַ֔/י בִּ/ימֵ֖י מְגוּרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l pr'h ymy shny mgvry shlshym vm't shnh m't vr'ym hyv ymy shny chyy vl' hshygv 't ymy shny chyy 'bty bymy mgvryhm
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vybrkh y'qb 't pr'h vyts' mlpny pr'h
verses.translation: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֣ב יוֹסֵף֮ אֶת אָבִ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת אֶחָי/ו֒ וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֤ם אֲחֻזָּה֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/מֵיטַ֥ב הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ רַעְמְסֵ֑ס כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyvshb yvsf 't 'byv v't 'chyv vytn lhm 'chzh b'rts mtsrym bmytb h'rts b'rts r'mss kh'shr tsvh pr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַלְכֵּ֤ל יוֹסֵף֙ אֶת אָבִ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת אֶחָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ו לֶ֖חֶם לְ/פִ֥י הַ/טָּֽף
verses.translit: vykhlkhl yvsf 't 'byv v't 'chyv v't khl byt 'byv lchm lpy htf
verses.translation: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

verses.original: וְ/לֶ֤חֶם אֵין֙ בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי כָבֵ֥ד הָ/רָעָ֖ב מְאֹ֑ד וַ/תֵּ֜לַהּ אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וְ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן מִ/פְּנֵ֖י הָ/רָעָֽב
verses.translit: vlchm 'yn bkhl h'rts khy khbd hr'b m'd vtlh 'rts mtsrym v'rts khn'n mpny hr'b
verses.translation: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

verses.original: וַ/יְלַקֵּ֣ט יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת כָּל הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַ/נִּמְצָ֤א בְ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וּ/בְ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בַּ/שֶּׁ֖בֶר אֲשֶׁר הֵ֣ם שֹׁבְרִ֑ים וַ/יָּבֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף בֵּ֥יתָ/ה פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vylqt yvsf 't khl hkhsf hnmts' b'rts mtsrym vb'rts khn'n bshbr 'shr hm shbrym vyb' yvsf 't hkhsf byth pr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֹּ֣ם הַ/כֶּ֗סֶף מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֮ וּ/מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַעַן֒ וַ/יָּבֹאוּ֩ כָל מִצְרַ֨יִם אֶל יוֹסֵ֤ף לֵ/אמֹר֙ הָֽבָ/ה לָּ֣/נוּ לֶ֔חֶם וְ/לָ֥/מָּה נָמ֖וּת נֶגְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֥י אָפֵ֖ס כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vytm hkhsf m'rts mtsrym vm'rts khn'n vyb'v khl mtsrym 'l yvsf l'mr hbh lnv lchm vlmh nmvt ngdkh khy 'ps khsf
verses.translation: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ הָב֣וּ מִקְנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶתְּנָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/מִקְנֵי/כֶ֑ם אִם אָפֵ֖ס כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf hbv mqnykhm v'tnh lkhm bmqnykhm 'm 'ps khsf
verses.translation: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֣יאוּ אֶת מִקְנֵי/הֶם֮ אֶל יוֹסֵף֒ וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶם֩ יוֹסֵ֨ף לֶ֜חֶם בַּ/סּוּסִ֗ים וּ/בְ/מִקְנֵ֥ה הַ/צֹּ֛אן וּ/בְ/מִקְנֵ֥ה הַ/בָּקָ֖ר וּ/בַ/חֲמֹרִ֑ים וַ/יְנַהֲלֵ֤/ם בַּ/לֶּ֨חֶם֙ בְּ/כָל מִקְנֵ/הֶ֔ם בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הַ/הִֽוא
verses.translit: vyby'v 't mqnyhm 'l yvsf vytn lhm yvsf lchm bsvsym vbmqnh hts'n vbmqnh hbqr vbchmrym vynhlm blchm bkhl mqnhm bshnh hhv'
verses.translation: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֹּם֮ הַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/הִוא֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ אֵלָ֜י/ו בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗ית וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֹֽא נְכַחֵ֣ד מֵֽ/אֲדֹנִ֔/י כִּ֚י אִם תַּ֣ם הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/מִקְנֵ֥ה הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֶל אֲדֹנִ֑/י לֹ֤א נִשְׁאַר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י בִּלְתִּ֥י אִם גְּוִיָּתֵ֖/נוּ וְ/אַדְמָתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vttm hshnh hhv' vyb'v 'lyv bshnh hshnyt vy'mrv lv l' nkhchd m'dny khy 'm tm hkhsf vmqnh hbhmh 'l 'dny l' nsh'r lpny 'dny blty 'm gvytnv v'dmtnv
verses.translation: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

verses.original: לָ֧/מָּה נָמ֣וּת לְ/עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ גַּם אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ גַּ֣ם אַדְמָתֵ֔/נוּ קְנֵֽה אֹתָ֥/נוּ וְ/אֶת אַדְמָתֵ֖/נוּ בַּ/לָּ֑חֶם וְ/נִֽהְיֶ֞ה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ וְ/אַדְמָתֵ֨/נוּ֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ/פַרְעֹ֔ה וְ/תֶן זֶ֗רַע וְ/נִֽחְיֶה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת וְ/הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵשָֽׁם
verses.translit: lmh nmvt l'ynykh gm 'nchnv gm 'dmtnv qnh 'tnv v't 'dmtnv blchm vnhyh 'nchnv v'dmtnv 'bdym lpr'h vtn zr' vnchyh vl' nmvt vh'dmh l' tshm
verses.translation: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨קֶן יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶת כָּל אַדְמַ֤ת מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְ/פַרְעֹ֔ה כִּֽי מָכְר֤וּ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֔/הוּ כִּֽי חָזַ֥ק עֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם הָ/רָעָ֑ב וַ/תְּהִ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyqn yvsf 't khl 'dmt mtsrym lpr'h khy mkhrv mtsrym 'ysh shdhv khy chzq 'lhm hr'b vthy h'rts lpr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨ת הָ/עָ֔ם הֶעֱבִ֥יר אֹת֖/וֹ לֶ/עָרִ֑ים מִ/קְצֵ֥ה גְבוּל מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/עַד קָצֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: v't h'm h'byr 'tv l'rym mqtsh gbvl mtsrym v'd qtshv
verses.translation: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

verses.original: רַ֛ק אַדְמַ֥ת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֹ֣א קָנָ֑ה כִּי֩ חֹ֨ק לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵ/אֵ֣ת פַּרְעֹ֗ה וְ/אָֽכְל֤וּ אֶת חֻקָּ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ פַּרְעֹ֔ה עַל כֵּ֕ן לֹ֥א מָכְר֖וּ אֶת אַדְמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: rq 'dmt hkhhnym l' qnh khy chq lkhhnym m't pr'h v'khlv 't chqm 'shr ntn lhm pr'h 'l khn l' mkhrv 't 'dmtm
verses.translation: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם הֵן֩ קָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֥ם הַ/יּ֛וֹם וְ/אֶת אַדְמַתְ/כֶ֖ם לְ/פַרְעֹ֑ה הֵֽא לָ/כֶ֣ם זֶ֔רַע וּ/זְרַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l h'm hn qnyty 'tkhm hyvm v't 'dmtkhm lpr'h h' lkhm zr' vzr'tm 't h'dmh
verses.translation: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/תְּבוּאֹ֔ת וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם חֲמִישִׁ֖ית לְ/פַרְעֹ֑ה וְ/אַרְבַּ֣ע הַ/יָּדֹ֡ת יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶם֩ לְ/זֶ֨רַע הַ/שָּׂדֶ֧ה וּֽ/לְ/אָכְלְ/כֶ֛ם וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/בָתֵּי/כֶ֖ם וְ/לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל לְ/טַפְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh btbv't vnttm chmyshyt lpr'h v'rb' hydt yhyh lkhm lzr' hshdh vl'khlkhm vl'shr bbtykhm vl'khl ltpkhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ הֶחֱיִתָ֑/נוּ נִמְצָא חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י וְ/הָיִ֥ינוּ עֲבָדִ֖ים לְ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv hchytnv nmts' chn b'yny 'dny vhyynv 'bdym lpr'h
verses.translation: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֣/הּ יוֹסֵ֡ף לְ/חֹק֩ עַד הַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֜ה עַל אַדְמַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְ/פַרְעֹ֖ה לַ/חֹ֑מֶשׁ רַ֞ק אַדְמַ֤ת הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְ/בַדָּ֔/ם לֹ֥א הָיְתָ֖ה לְ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshm 'th yvsf lchq 'd hyvm hzh 'l 'dmt mtsrym lpr'h lchmsh rq 'dmt hkhhnym lbdm l' hyth lpr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֑שֶׁן וַ/יֵּאָחֲז֣וּ בָ֔/הּ וַ/יִּפְר֥וּ וַ/יִּרְבּ֖וּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyshb yshr'l b'rts mtsrym b'rts gshn vy'chzv bh vyprv vyrbv m'd
verses.translation: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֤י יַעֲקֹב֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֤י יְמֵֽי יַעֲקֹב֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיָּ֔י/ו שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vychy y'qb b'rts mtsrym shb' 'shrh shnh vyhy ymy y'qb shny chyyv shb' shnym v'rb'ym vm't shnh
verses.translation: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְב֣וּ יְמֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לָ/מוּת֒ וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א לִ/בְנ֣/וֹ לְ/יוֹסֵ֗ף וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ אִם נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ שִֽׂים נָ֥א יָדְ/ךָ֖ תַּ֣חַת יְרֵכִ֑/י וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ עִמָּדִ/י֙ חֶ֣סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶ֔ת אַל נָ֥א תִקְבְּרֵ֖/נִי בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqrbv ymy yshr'l lmvt vyqr' lbnv lyvsf vy'mr lv 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh shym n' ydkh tcht yrkhy v'shyt 'mdy chsd v'mt 'l n' tqbrny bmtsrym
verses.translation: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁכַבְתִּי֙ עִם אֲבֹתַ֔/י וּ/נְשָׂאתַ֨/נִי֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וּ/קְבַרְתַּ֖/נִי בִּ/קְבֻרָתָ֑/ם וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה כִ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vshkhbty 'm 'bty vnsh'tny mmtsrym vqbrtny bqbrtm vy'mr 'nkhy ''shh khdbrkh
verses.translation: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִשָּֽׁבְעָ/ה֙ לִ֔/י וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/מִּטָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hshb'h ly vyshb' lv vyshtchv yshr'l 'l r'sh hmth
verses.translation: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/יוֹסֵ֔ף הִנֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖י/ךָ חֹלֶ֑ה וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת שְׁנֵ֤י בָנָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ אֶת מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְ/אֶת אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry hdbrym h'lh vy'mr lyvsf hnh 'bykh chlh vyqch 't shny bnyv 'mv 't mnshh v't 'prym
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה בִּנְ/ךָ֥ יוֹסֵ֖ף בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּק֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל הַ/מִּטָּֽה
verses.translit: vygd ly'qb vy'mr hnh bnkh yvsf b' 'lykh vytchzq yshr'l vyshb 'l hmth
verses.translation: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֥ל שַׁדַּ֛י נִרְאָֽה אֵלַ֥/י בְּ/ל֖וּז בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/יְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'l yvsf 'l shdy nr'h 'ly blvz b'rts khn'n vybrkh 'ty
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י הִנְ/נִ֤י מַפְרְ/ךָ֙ וְ/הִרְבִּיתִ֔/ךָ וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ לִ/קְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְ/נָ֨תַתִּ֜י אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֛את לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hnny mprkh vhrbytkh vnttykh lqhl 'mym vntty 't h'rts hz't lzr'kh 'chrykh 'chzt 'vlm
verses.translation: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה שְׁנֵֽי בָנֶי/ךָ֩ הַ/נּוֹלָדִ֨ים לְ/ךָ֜ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד בֹּאִ֥/י אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ מִצְרַ֖יְמָ/ה לִ/י הֵ֑ם אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּ/רְאוּבֵ֥ן וְ/שִׁמְע֖וֹן יִֽהְיוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th shny bnykh hnvldym lkh b'rts mtsrym 'd b'y 'lykh mtsrymh ly hm 'prym vmnshh khr'vbn vshm'vn yhyv ly
verses.translation: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹלַדְתְּ/ךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלַ֥דְתָּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/ךָ֣ יִהְי֑וּ עַ֣ל שֵׁ֧ם אֲחֵי/הֶ֛ם יִקָּרְא֖וּ בְּ/נַחֲלָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vmvldtkh 'shr hvldt 'chryhm lkh yhyv 'l shm 'chyhm yqr'v bnchltm
verses.translation: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י בְּ/בֹאִ֣/י מִ/פַּדָּ֗ן מֵ֩תָה֩ עָלַ֨/י רָחֵ֜ל בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֨עַן֙ בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּ/ע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת אֶ֖רֶץ לָ/בֹ֣א אֶפְרָ֑תָה וָ/אֶקְבְּרֶ֤/הָ שָּׁם֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔ת הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: v'ny bb'y mpdn mth 'ly rchl b'rts khn'n bdrkh b'vd khbrt 'rts lb' 'prth v'qbrh shm bdrkh 'prt hv' byt lchm
verses.translation: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מִי אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyr' yshr'l 't bny yvsf vy'mr my 'lh
verses.translation: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל אָבִ֔י/ו בָּנַ֣/י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר נָֽתַן לִ֥/י אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּ/זֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר קָֽחֶ/ם נָ֥א אֵלַ֖/י וַ/אֲבָרֲכֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l 'byv bny hm 'shr ntn ly 'lhym bzh vy'mr qchm n' 'ly v'brkhm
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place . And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

verses.original: וְ/עֵינֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כָּבְד֣וּ מִ/זֹּ֔קֶן לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִ/רְא֑וֹת וַ/יַּגֵּ֤שׁ אֹתָ/ם֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּשַּׁ֥ק לָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/יְחַבֵּ֥ק לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'yny yshr'l khbdv mzqn l' yvkhl lr'vt vygsh 'tm 'lyv vyshq lhm vychbq lhm
verses.translation: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף רְאֹ֥ה פָנֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א פִלָּ֑לְתִּי וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛/י אֱלֹהִ֖ים גַּ֥ם אֶת זַרְעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l 'l yvsf r'h pnykh l' pllty vhnh hr'h 'ty 'lhym gm 't zr'kh
verses.translation: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/עִ֣ם בִּרְכָּ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לְ/אַפָּ֖י/ו אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyvts' yvsf 'tm m'm brkhyv vyshtchv l'pyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח יוֹסֵף֮ אֶת שְׁנֵי/הֶם֒ אֶת אֶפְרַ֤יִם בִּֽ/ימִינ/וֹ֙ מִ/שְּׂמֹ֣אל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בִ/שְׂמֹאל֖/וֹ מִ/ימִ֣ין יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּגֵּ֖שׁ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqch yvsf 't shnyhm 't 'prym bymynv mshm'l yshr'l v't mnshh bshm'lv mymyn yshr'l vygsh 'lyv
verses.translation: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת יְמִינ֜/וֹ וַ/יָּ֨שֶׁת עַל רֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ וְ/ה֣וּא הַ/צָּעִ֔יר וְ/אֶת שְׂמֹאל֖/וֹ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שִׂכֵּל֙ אֶת יָדָ֔י/ו כִּ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה הַ/בְּכֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyshlch yshr'l 't ymynv vysht 'l r'sh 'prym vhv' hts'yr v't shm'lv 'l r'sh mnshh shkhl 't ydyv khy mnshh hbkhvr
verses.translation: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת יוֹסֵ֖ף וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ אֲבֹתַ֤/י לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם וְ/יִצְחָ֔ק הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ הָ/רֹעֶ֣ה אֹתִ֔/י מֵ/עוֹדִ֖/י עַד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vybrkh 't yvsf vy'mr h'lhym 'shr hthlkhv 'bty lpnyv 'brhm vytschq h'lhym hr'h 'ty m'vdy 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

verses.original: הַ/מַּלְאָךְ֩ הַ/גֹּאֵ֨ל אֹתִ֜/י מִ/כָּל רָ֗ע יְבָרֵךְ֮ אֶת הַ/נְּעָרִים֒ וְ/יִקָּרֵ֤א בָ/הֶם֙ שְׁמִ֔/י וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אֲבֹתַ֖/י אַבְרָהָ֣ם וְ/יִצְחָ֑ק וְ/יִדְגּ֥וּ לָ/רֹ֖ב בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hml'kh hg'l 'ty mkhl r' ybrkh 't hn'rym vyqr' bhm shmy vshm 'bty 'brhm vytschq vydgv lrb bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּי יָשִׁ֨ית אָבִ֧י/ו יַד יְמִינ֛/וֹ עַל רֹ֥אשׁ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וַ/יֵּ֣רַע בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְמֹ֣ךְ יַד אָבִ֗י/ו לְ/הָסִ֥יר אֹתָ֛/הּ מֵ/עַ֥ל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַ֖יִם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyr' yvsf khy yshyt 'byv yd ymynv 'l r'sh 'prym vyr' b'ynyv vytmkh yd 'byv lhsyr 'th m'l r'sh 'prym 'l r'sh mnshh
verses.translation: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶל אָבִ֖י/ו לֹא כֵ֣ן אָבִ֑/י כִּי זֶ֣ה הַ/בְּכֹ֔ר שִׂ֥ים יְמִינְ/ךָ֖ עַל רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l 'byv l' khn 'by khy zh hbkhr shym ymynkh 'l r'shv
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֵ֣ן אָבִ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יָדַ֤עְתִּֽי בְנִ/י֙ יָדַ֔עְתִּי גַּם ה֥וּא יִֽהְיֶה לְּ/עָ֖ם וְ/גַם ה֣וּא יִגְדָּ֑ל וְ/אוּלָ֗ם אָחִ֤י/ו הַ/קָּטֹן֙ יִגְדַּ֣ל מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/זַרְע֖/וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מְלֹֽא הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
