verses.translit: vym'n 'byv vy'mr yd'ty bny yd'ty gm hv' yhyh l'm vgm hv' ygdl v'vlm 'chyv hqtn ygdl mmnv vzr'v yhyh ml' hgvym
verses.translation: And his father refused, and said, I know it , my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֨רֲכֵ֜/ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/הוּא֮ לֵ/אמוֹר֒ בְּ/ךָ֗ יְבָרֵ֤ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְשִֽׂמְ/ךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים כְּ/אֶפְרַ֖יִם וְ/כִ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת אֶפְרַ֖יִם לִ/פְנֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vybrkhm byvm hhv' l'mvr bkh ybrkh yshr'l l'mr yshmkh 'lhym kh'prym vkhmnshh vyshm 't 'prym lpny mnshh
verses.translation: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל יוֹסֵ֔ף הִנֵּ֥ה אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ֑ת וְ/הָיָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הֵשִׁ֣יב אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l 'l yvsf hnh 'nkhy mt vhyh 'lhym 'mkhm vhshyb 'tkhm 'l 'rts 'btykhm
verses.translation: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֞י נָתַ֧תִּֽי לְ/ךָ֛ שְׁכֶ֥ם אַחַ֖ד עַל אַחֶ֑י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י בְּ/חַרְבִּ֖/י וּ/בְ/קַשְׁתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny ntty lkh shkhm 'chd 'l 'chykh 'shr lqchty myd h'mry bchrby vbqshty
verses.translation: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶל בָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְ/אַגִּ֣ידָה לָ/כֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb 'l bnyv vy'mr h'spv v'gydh lkhm 't 'shr yqr' 'tkhm b'chryt hymym
verses.translation: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וְ/שִׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/שִׁמְע֖וּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֲבִי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hqbtsv vshm'v bny y'qb vshm'v 'l yshr'l 'bykhm
verses.translation: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

verses.original: רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣רִ/י אַ֔תָּה כֹּחִ֖/י וְ/רֵאשִׁ֣ית אוֹנִ֑/י יֶ֥תֶר שְׂאֵ֖ת וְ/יֶ֥תֶר עָֽז
verses.translit: r'vbn bkhry 'th khchy vr'shyt 'vny ytr sh't vytr 'z
verses.translation: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

verses.original: פַּ֤חַז כַּ/מַּ֨יִם֙ אַל תּוֹתַ֔ר כִּ֥י עָלִ֖יתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אָבִ֑י/ךָ אָ֥ז חִלַּ֖לְתָּ יְצוּעִ֥/י עָלָֽה
verses.translit: pchz khmym 'l tvtr khy 'lyt mshkhby 'bykh 'z chllt ytsv'y 'lh
verses.translation: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וֹן וְ/לֵוִ֖י אַחִ֑ים כְּלֵ֥י חָמָ֖ס מְכֵרֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'vn vlvy 'chym khly chms mkhrtyhm
verses.translation: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

verses.original: בְּ/סֹדָ/ם֙ אַל תָּבֹ֣א נַפְשִׁ֔/י בִּ/קְהָלָ֖/ם אַל תֵּחַ֣ד כְּבֹדִ֑/י כִּ֤י בְ/אַפָּ/ם֙ הָ֣רְגוּ אִ֔ישׁ וּ/בִ/רְצֹנָ֖/ם עִקְּרוּ שֽׁוֹר
verses.translit: bsdm 'l tb' npshy bqhlm 'l tchd khbdy khy b'pm hrgv 'ysh vbrtsnm 'qrv shvr
verses.translation: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

verses.original: אָר֤וּר אַפָּ/ם֙ כִּ֣י עָ֔ז וְ/עֶבְרָתָ֖/ם כִּ֣י קָשָׁ֑תָה אֲחַלְּקֵ֣/ם בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַ/אֲפִיצֵ֖/ם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'rvr 'pm khy 'z v'brtm khy qshth 'chlqm by'qb v'pytsm byshr'l
verses.translation: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

verses.original: יְהוּדָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ יוֹד֣וּ/ךָ אַחֶ֔י/ךָ יָדְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/עֹ֣רֶף אֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ בְּנֵ֥י אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvdh 'th yvdvkh 'chykh ydkh b'rf 'ybykh yshtchvv lkh bny 'bykh
verses.translation: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

verses.original: גּ֤וּר אַרְיֵה֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ/טֶּ֖רֶף בְּנִ֣/י עָלִ֑יתָ כָּרַ֨ע רָבַ֧ץ כְּ/אַרְיֵ֛ה וּ/כְ/לָבִ֖יא מִ֥י יְקִימֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: gvr 'ryh yhvdh mtrf bny 'lyt khr' rbts kh'ryh vkhlby' my yqymnv
verses.translation: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

verses.original: לֹֽא יָס֥וּר שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ מִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וּ/מְחֹקֵ֖ק מִ/בֵּ֣ין רַגְלָ֑י/ו עַ֚ד כִּֽי יָבֹ֣א שילה שִׁיל֔וֹ וְ/ל֖/וֹ יִקְּהַ֥ת עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: l' ysvr shbt myhvdh vmchqq mbyn rglyv 'd khy yb' shylh shylv vlv yqht 'mym
verses.translation: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be .

verses.original: אֹסְרִ֤י לַ/גֶּ֨פֶן֙ עיר/ה עִיר֔/וֹ וְ/לַ/שֹּׂרֵקָ֖ה בְּנִ֣י אֲתֹנ֑/וֹ כִּבֵּ֤ס בַּ/יַּ֨יִן֙ לְבֻשׁ֔/וֹ וּ/בְ/דַם עֲנָבִ֖ים סות/ה סוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'sry lgpn 'yrh 'yrv vlshrqh bny 'tnv khbs byyn lbshv vbdm 'nbym svth svtv
verses.translation: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

verses.original: חַכְלִילִ֥י עֵינַ֖יִם מִ/יָּ֑יִן וּ/לְבֶן שִׁנַּ֖יִם מֵ/חָלָֽב
verses.translit: chkhlyly 'ynym myyn vlbn shnym mchlb
verses.translation: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

verses.original: זְבוּלֻ֕ן לְ/ח֥וֹף יַמִּ֖ים יִשְׁכֹּ֑ן וְ/הוּא֙ לְ/ח֣וֹף אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְ/יַרְכָת֖/וֹ עַל צִידֹֽן
verses.translit: zbvln lchvf ymym yshkhn vhv' lchvf 'nyvt vyrkhtv 'l tsydn
verses.translation: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

verses.original: יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר חֲמֹ֣ר גָּ֑רֶם רֹבֵ֖ץ בֵּ֥ין הַֽ/מִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם
verses.translit: yshshkhr chmr grm rbts byn hmshptym
verses.translation: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא מְנֻחָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ כִּ֣י נָעֵ֑מָה וַ/יֵּ֤ט שִׁכְמ/וֹ֙ לִ/סְבֹּ֔ל וַ/יְהִ֖י לְ/מַס עֹבֵֽד
verses.translit: vyr' mnchh khy tvb v't h'rts khy n'mh vyt shkhmv lsbl vyhy lms 'bd
verses.translation: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

verses.original: דָּ֖ן יָדִ֣ין עַמּ֑/וֹ כְּ/אַחַ֖ד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: dn ydyn 'mv kh'chd shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: יְהִי דָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ עֲלֵי דֶ֔רֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹ֖ן עֲלֵי אֹ֑רַח הַ/נֹּשֵׁךְ֙ עִקְּבֵי ס֔וּס וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל רֹכְב֖/וֹ אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: yhy dn nchsh 'ly drkh shpypn 'ly 'rch hnshkh 'qby svs vypl rkhbv 'chvr
verses.translation: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

verses.original: לִֽ/ישׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֖ קִוִּ֥יתִי יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lyshv'tkh qvyty yhvh
verses.translation: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD .

verses.original: גָּ֖ד גְּד֣וּד יְגוּדֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/ה֖וּא יָגֻ֥ד עָקֵֽב
verses.translit: gd gdvd ygvdnv vhv' ygd 'qb
verses.translation: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

verses.original: מֵ/אָשֵׁ֖ר שְׁמֵנָ֣ה לַחְמ֑/וֹ וְ/ה֥וּא יִתֵּ֖ן מַֽעֲדַנֵּי מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: m'shr shmnh lchmv vhv' ytn m'dny mlkh
verses.translation: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

verses.original: נַפְתָּלִ֖י אַיָּלָ֣ה שְׁלֻחָ֑ה הַ/נֹּתֵ֖ן אִמְרֵי שָֽׁפֶר
verses.translit: nptly 'ylh shlchh hntn 'mry shpr
verses.translation: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

verses.original: בֵּ֤ן פֹּרָת֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף בֵּ֥ן פֹּרָ֖ת עֲלֵי עָ֑יִן בָּנ֕וֹת צָעֲדָ֖ה עֲלֵי שֽׁוּר
verses.translit: bn prt yvsf bn prt 'ly 'yn bnvt ts'dh 'ly shvr
verses.translation: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְמָרֲרֻ֖/הוּ וָ/רֹ֑בּוּ וַֽ/יִּשְׂטְמֻ֖/הוּ בַּעֲלֵ֥י חִצִּֽים
verses.translit: vymrrhv vrbv vyshtmhv b'ly chtsym
verses.translation: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him , and hated him:

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤שֶׁב בְּ/אֵיתָן֙ קַשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּפֹ֖זּוּ זְרֹעֵ֣י יָדָ֑י/ו מִ/ידֵי֙ אֲבִ֣יר יַעֲקֹ֔ב מִ/שָּׁ֥ם רֹעֶ֖ה אֶ֥בֶן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vtshb b'ytn qshtv vypzv zr'y ydyv mydy 'byr y'qb mshm r'h 'bn yshr'l
verses.translation: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

verses.original: מֵ/אֵ֨ל אָבִ֜י/ךָ וְ/יַעְזְרֶ֗/ךָּ וְ/אֵ֤ת שַׁדַּי֙ וִ/יבָ֣רְכֶ֔/ךָּ בִּרְכֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מֵ/עָ֔ל בִּרְכֹ֥ת תְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֣צֶת תָּ֑חַת בִּרְכֹ֥ת שָׁדַ֖יִם וָ/רָֽחַם
verses.translit: m'l 'bykh vy'zrkh v't shdy vybrkhkh brkht shmym m'l brkht thvm rbtst tcht brkht shdym vrchm
verses.translation: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

verses.original: בִּרְכֹ֣ת אָבִ֗י/ךָ גָּֽבְרוּ֙ עַל בִּרְכֹ֣ת הוֹרַ֔/י עַֽד תַּאֲוַ֖ת גִּבְעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֨ין֙ לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּ/לְ/קָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: brkht 'bykh gbrv 'l brkht hvry 'd t'vt gb't 'vlm thyyn lr'sh yvsf vlqdqd nzyr 'chyv
verses.translation: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִין֙ זְאֵ֣ב יִטְרָ֔ף בַּ/בֹּ֖קֶר יֹ֣אכַל עַ֑ד וְ/לָ/עֶ֖רֶב יְחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל
verses.translit: bnymyn z'b ytrf bbqr y'khl 'd vl'rb ychlq shll
verses.translation: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֛לֶּה שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר וְ֠/זֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֨ר לָ/הֶ֤ם אֲבִי/הֶם֙ וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אוֹתָ֔/ם אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּ/בִרְכָת֖/וֹ בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khl 'lh shbty yshr'l shnym 'shr vz't 'shr dbr lhm 'byhm vybrkh 'vtm 'ysh 'shr khbrkhtv brkh 'tm
verses.translation: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו אוֹתָ֗/ם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ אֲנִי֙ נֶאֱסָ֣ף אֶל עַמִּ֔/י קִבְר֥וּ אֹתִ֖/י אֶל אֲבֹתָ֑/י אֶל הַ֨/מְּעָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/שְׂדֵ֖ה עֶפְר֥וֹן הַֽ/חִתִּֽי
verses.translit: vytsv 'vtm vy'mr 'lhm 'ny n'sf 'l 'my qbrv 'ty 'l 'bty 'l hm'rh 'shr bshdh 'prvn hchty
verses.translation: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.original: בַּ/מְּעָרָ֞ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּ/שְׂדֵ֧ה הַ/מַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵ֖א בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ קָנָ֨ה אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה מֵ/אֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַ/חִתִּ֖י לַ/אֲחֻזַּת קָֽבֶר
verses.translit: bm'rh 'shr bshdh hmkhplh 'shr 'l pny mmr' b'rts khn'n 'shr qnh 'brhm 't hshdh m't 'prn hchty l'chzt qbr
verses.translation: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּ/ה קָֽבְר֞וּ אֶת אַבְרָהָ֗ם וְ/אֵת֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ שָׁ֚מָּ/ה קָבְר֣וּ אֶת יִצְחָ֔ק וְ/אֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁ֥מָּ/ה קָבַ֖רְתִּי אֶת לֵאָֽה
verses.translit: shmh qbrv 't 'brhm v't shrh 'shtv shmh qbrv 't ytschq v't rbqh 'shtv vshmh qbrty 't l'h
verses.translation: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

verses.original: מִקְנֵ֧ה הַ/שָּׂדֶ֛ה וְ/הַ/מְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בּ֖/וֹ מֵ/אֵ֥ת בְּנֵי חֵֽת
verses.translit: mqnh hshdh vhm'rh 'shr bv m't bny cht
verses.translation: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֤ל יַעֲקֹב֙ לְ/צַוֺּ֣ת אֶת בָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֥ף רַגְלָ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/מִּטָּ֑ה וַ/יִּגְוַ֖ע וַ/יֵּאָ֥סֶף אֶל עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vykhl y'qb ltsvt 't bnyv vy'sf rglyv 'l hmth vygv' vy'sf 'l 'myv
verses.translation: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל פְּנֵ֣י אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ עָלָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּשַּׁק לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vypl yvsf 'l pny 'byv vybkh 'lyv vyshq lv
verses.translation: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֨ו יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶת עֲבָדָי/ו֙ אֶת הָ/רֹ֣פְאִ֔ים לַ/חֲנֹ֖ט אֶת אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יַּחַנְט֥וּ הָ/רֹפְאִ֖ים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytsv yvsf 't 'bdyv 't hrp'ym lchnt 't 'byv vychntv hrp'ym 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלְאוּ ל/וֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יִמְלְא֖וּ יְמֵ֣י הַ/חֲנֻטִ֑ים וַ/יִּבְכּ֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ מִצְרַ֖יִם שִׁבְעִ֥ים יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyml'v lv 'rb'ym yvm khy khn yml'v ymy hchntym vybkhv 'tv mtsrym shb'ym yvm
verses.translation: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַבְרוּ֙ יְמֵ֣י בְכִית֔/וֹ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶל בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִם נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם דַּבְּרוּ נָ֕א בְּ/אָזְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'brv ymy bkhytv vydbr yvsf 'l byt pr'h l'mr 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykhm dbrv n' b'zny pr'h l'mr
verses.translation: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

verses.original: אָבִ֞/י הִשְׁבִּיעַ֣/נִי לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ מֵת֒ בְּ/קִבְרִ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרִ֤יתִי לִ/י֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן שָׁ֖מָּ/ה תִּקְבְּרֵ֑/נִי וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אֶֽעֱלֶה נָּ֛א וְ/אֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת אָבִ֖/י וְ/אָשֽׁוּבָה
verses.translit: 'by hshby'ny l'mr hnh 'nkhy mt bqbry 'shr khryty ly b'rts khn'n shmh tqbrny v'th ''lh n' v'qbrh 't 'by v'shvbh
verses.translation: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֑ה עֲלֵ֛ה וּ/קְבֹ֥ר אֶת אָבִ֖י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבִּיעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'lh vqbr 't 'bykh kh'shr hshby'kh
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל יוֹסֵ֖ף לִ/קְבֹּ֣ר אֶת אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יַּֽעֲל֨וּ אִתּ֜/וֹ כָּל עַבְדֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בֵית֔/וֹ וְ/כֹ֖ל זִקְנֵ֥י אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'l yvsf lqbr 't 'byv vy'lv 'tv khl 'bdy pr'h zqny bytv vkhl zqny 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו וּ/בֵ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ו רַ֗ק טַפָּ/ם֙ וְ/צֹאנָ֣/ם וּ/בְקָרָ֔/ם עָזְב֖וּ בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vkhl byt yvsf v'chyv vbyt 'byv rq tpm vts'nm vbqrm 'zbv b'rts gshn
verses.translation: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל עִמּ֔/וֹ גַּם רֶ֖כֶב גַּם פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֥י הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'l 'mv gm rkhb gm prshym vyhy hmchnh khbd m'd
verses.translation: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד גֹּ֣רֶן הָאָטָ֗ד אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַ/יִּ֨סְפְּדוּ שָׁ֔ם מִסְפֵּ֛ד גָּד֥וֹל וְ/כָבֵ֖ד מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ לְ/אָבִ֛י/ו אֵ֖בֶל שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v 'd grn h'td 'shr b'br hyrdn vyspdv shm mspd gdvl vkhbd m'd vy'sh l'byv 'bl shb't ymym
verses.translation: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֡רְא יוֹשֵׁב֩ הָ/אָ֨רֶץ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֜י אֶת הָ/אֵ֗בֶל בְּ/גֹ֨רֶן֙ הָֽאָטָ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵֽבֶל כָּבֵ֥ד זֶ֖ה לְ/מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָ/הּ֙ אָבֵ֣ל מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyr' yvshb h'rts hkhn'ny 't h'bl bgrn h'td vy'mrv 'bl khbd zh lmtsrym 'l khn qr' shmh 'bl mtsrym 'shr b'br hyrdn
verses.translation: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ בָנָ֖י/ו ל֑/וֹ כֵּ֖ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'shv bnyv lv khn kh'shr tsvm
verses.translation: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֨וּ אֹת֤/וֹ בָנָי/ו֙ אַ֣רְצָ/ה כְּנַ֔עַן וַ/יִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ בִּ/מְעָרַ֖ת שְׂדֵ֣ה הַ/מַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָנָה֩ אַבְרָהָ֨ם אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֜ה לַ/אֲחֻזַּת קֶ֗בֶר מֵ/אֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַ/חִתִּ֖י עַל פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא
verses.translit: vysh'v 'tv bnyv 'rtsh khn'n vyqbrv 'tv bm'rt shdh hmkhplh 'shr qnh 'brhm 't hshdh l'chzt qbr m't 'prn hchty 'l pny mmr'
verses.translation: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב יוֹסֵ֤ף מִצְרַ֨יְמָ/ה֙ ה֣וּא וְ/אֶחָ֔י/ו וְ/כָל הָ/עֹלִ֥ים אִתּ֖/וֹ לִ/קְבֹּ֣ר אֶת אָבִ֑י/ו אַחֲרֵ֖י קָבְר֥/וֹ אֶת אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb yvsf mtsrymh hv' v'chyv vkhl h'lym 'tv lqbr 't 'byv 'chry qbrv 't 'byv
verses.translation: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ אֲחֵֽי יוֹסֵף֙ כִּי מֵ֣ת אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ ל֥וּ יִשְׂטְמֵ֖/נוּ יוֹסֵ֑ף וְ/הָשֵׁ֤ב יָשִׁיב֙ לָ֔/נוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּמַ֖לְנוּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr'v 'chy yvsf khy mt 'byhm vy'mrv lv yshtmnv yvsf vhshb yshyb lnv 't khl hr'h 'shr gmlnv 'tv
verses.translation: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוּ֕וּ אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אָבִ֣י/ךָ צִוָּ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י מוֹת֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsvv 'l yvsf l'mr 'bykh tsvh lpny mvtv l'mr
verses.translation: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה תֹאמְר֣וּ לְ/יוֹסֵ֗ף אָ֣נָּ֡א שָׂ֣א נָ֠א פֶּ֣שַׁע אַחֶ֤י/ךָ וְ/חַטָּאתָ/ם֙ כִּי רָעָ֣ה גְמָל֔וּ/ךָ וְ/עַתָּה֙ שָׂ֣א נָ֔א לְ/פֶ֥שַׁע עַבְדֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ יוֹסֵ֖ף בְּ/דַבְּרָ֥/ם אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khh t'mrv lyvsf 'n' sh' n' psh' 'chykh vcht'tm khy r'h gmlvkh v'th sh' n' lpsh' 'bdy 'lhy 'bykh vybkh yvsf bdbrm 'lyv
verses.translation: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֙ גַּם אֶחָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֶּ֥/נּֽוּ לְ/ךָ֖ לַ/עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: vylkhv gm 'chyv vyplv lpnyv vy'mrv hnnv lkh l'bdym
verses.translation: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֛ם יוֹסֵ֖ף אַל תִּירָ֑אוּ כִּ֛י הֲ/תַ֥חַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm yvsf 'l tyr'v khy htcht 'lhym 'ny
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֕ם חֲשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖/י רָעָ֑ה אֱלֹהִים֙ חֲשָׁבָ֣/הּ לְ/טֹבָ֔ה לְמַ֗עַן עֲשֹׂ֛ה כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לְ/הַחֲיֹ֥ת עַם רָֽב
verses.translit: v'tm chshbtm 'ly r'h 'lhym chshbh ltbh lm'n 'shh khyvm hzh lhchyt 'm rb
verses.translation: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ אַל תִּירָ֔אוּ אָנֹכִ֛י אֲכַלְכֵּ֥ל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֶֽת טַפְּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יְנַחֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/יְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל לִבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th 'l tyr'v 'nkhy 'khlkhl 'tkhm v't tpkhm vynchm 'vtm vydbr 'l lbm
verses.translation: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב יוֹסֵף֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם ה֖וּא וּ/בֵ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יְחִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף מֵאָ֥ה וָ/עֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyshb yvsf bmtsrym hv' vbyt 'byv vychy yvsf m'h v'shr shnym
verses.translation: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא יוֹסֵף֙ לְ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּנֵ֖י שִׁלֵּשִׁ֑ים גַּ֗ם בְּנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יֻלְּד֖וּ עַל בִּרְכֵּ֥י יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vyr' yvsf l'prym bny shlshym gm bny mkhyr bn mnshh yldv 'l brkhy yvsf
verses.translation: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל אֶחָ֔י/ו אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ֑ת וֵֽ/אלֹהִ֞ים פָּקֹ֧ד יִפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם וְ/הֶעֱלָ֤ה אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִן הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛ע לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'l 'chyv 'nkhy mt v'lhym pqd ypqd 'tkhm vh'lh 'tkhm mn h'rts hz't 'l h'rts 'shr nshb' l'brhm lytschq vly'qb
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁבַּ֣ע יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַעֲלִתֶ֥ם אֶת עַצְמֹתַ֖/י מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshb' yvsf 't bny yshr'l l'mr pqd ypqd 'lhym 'tkhm vh'ltm 't 'tsmty mzh
verses.translation: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת יוֹסֵ֔ף בֶּן מֵאָ֥ה וָ/עֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִ֑ים וַ/יַּחַנְט֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ וַ/יִּ֥ישֶׂם בָּ/אָר֖וֹן בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vymt yvsf bn m'h v'shr shnym vychntv 'tv vyyshm b'rvn bmtsrym
verses.translation: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/בָּאִ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/ה אֵ֣ת יַעֲקֹ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ וּ/בֵית֖/וֹ בָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny yshr'l hb'ym mtsrymh 't y'qb 'ysh vbytv b'v
verses.translation: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

verses.original: רְאוּבֵ֣ן שִׁמְע֔וֹן לֵוִ֖י וִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: r'vbn shm'vn lvy vyhvdh
verses.translation: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

verses.original: יִשָּׂשכָ֥ר זְבוּלֻ֖ן וּ/בְנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: yshshkhr zbvln vbnymn
verses.translation: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

verses.original: דָּ֥ן וְ/נַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְ/אָשֵֽׁר
verses.translit: dn vnptly gd v'shr
verses.translation: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֗י כָּל נֶ֛פֶשׁ יֹצְאֵ֥י יֶֽרֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֖ב שִׁבְעִ֣ים נָ֑פֶשׁ וְ/יוֹסֵ֖ף הָיָ֥ה בְ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khl npsh yts'y yrkh y'qb shb'ym npsh vyvsf hyh bmtsrym
verses.translation: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤מָת יוֹסֵף֙ וְ/כָל אֶחָ֔י/ו וְ/כֹ֖ל הַ/דּ֥וֹר הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vymt yvsf vkhl 'chyv vkhl hdvr hhv'
verses.translation: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּר֧וּ וַֽ/יִּשְׁרְצ֛וּ וַ/יִּרְבּ֥וּ וַ/יַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ בִּ/מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֥א הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l prv vyshrtsv vyrbv vy'tsmv bm'd m'd vtml' h'rts 'tm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קָם מֶֽלֶךְ חָדָ֖שׁ עַל מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יָדַ֖ע אֶת יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vyqm mlkh chdsh 'l mtsrym 'shr l' yd' 't yvsf
verses.translation: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל עַמּ֑/וֹ הִנֵּ֗ה עַ֚ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רַ֥ב וְ/עָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l 'mv hnh 'm bny yshr'l rb v'tsvm mmnv
verses.translation: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

verses.original: הָ֥בָ/ה נִֽתְחַכְּמָ֖ה ל֑/וֹ פֶּן יִרְבֶּ֗ה וְ/הָיָ֞ה כִּֽי תִקְרֶ֤אנָה מִלְחָמָה֙ וְ/נוֹסַ֤ף גַּם הוּא֙ עַל שֹׂ֣נְאֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/נִלְחַם בָּ֖/נוּ וְ/עָלָ֥ה מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hbh ntchkhmh lv pn yrbh vhyh khy tqr'nh mlchmh vnvsf gm hv' 'l shn'ynv vnlchm bnv v'lh mn h'rts
verses.translation: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֤ימוּ עָלָי/ו֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מִסִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן עַנֹּת֖/וֹ בְּ/סִבְלֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּ֜בֶן עָרֵ֤י מִסְכְּנוֹת֙ לְ/פַרְעֹ֔ה אֶת פִּתֹ֖ם וְ/אֶת רַעַמְסֵֽס
verses.translit: vyshymv 'lyv shry msym lm'n 'ntv bsbltm vybn 'ry mskhnvt lpr'h 't ptm v't r'mss
verses.translation: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

verses.original: וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁר֙ יְעַנּ֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ כֵּ֥ן יִרְבֶּ֖ה וְ/כֵ֣ן יִפְרֹ֑ץ וַ/יָּקֻ֕צוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vkh'shr y'nv 'tv khn yrbh vkhn yprts vyqtsv mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבִ֧דוּ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/פָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'bdv mtsrym 't bny yshr'l bprkh
verses.translation: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

verses.original: וַ/יְמָרְר֨וּ אֶת חַיֵּי/הֶ֜ם בַּ/עֲבֹדָ֣ה קָשָׁ֗ה בְּ/חֹ֨מֶר֙ וּ/בִ/לְבֵנִ֔ים וּ/בְ/כָל עֲבֹדָ֖ה בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁר עָבְד֥וּ בָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/פָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vymrrv 't chyyhm b'bdh qshh bchmr vblbnym vbkhl 'bdh bshdh 't khl 'bdtm 'shr 'bdv bhm bprkh
verses.translation: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לַֽ/מְיַלְּדֹ֖ת הָֽ/עִבְרִיֹּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם הָֽ/אַחַת֙ שִׁפְרָ֔ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית פּוּעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh mtsrym lmyldt h'bryt 'shr shm h'cht shprh vshm hshnyt pv'h
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בְּ/יַלֶּדְ/כֶן֙ אֶת הָֽ/עִבְרִיּ֔וֹת וּ/רְאִיתֶ֖ן עַל הָ/אָבְנָ֑יִם אִם בֵּ֥ן הוּא֙ וַ/הֲמִתֶּ֣ן אֹת֔/וֹ וְ/אִם בַּ֥ת הִ֖יא וָ/חָֽיָה
verses.translit: vy'mr byldkhn 't h'bryvt vr'ytn 'l h'bnym 'm bn hv' vhmtn 'tv v'm bt hy' vchyh
verses.translation: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

verses.original: וַ/תִּירֶ֤אןָ הַֽ/מְיַלְּדֹת֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֣א עָשׂ֔וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/תְּחַיֶּ֖יןָ אֶת הַ/יְלָדִֽים
verses.translit: vtyr'n hmyldt 't h'lhym vl' 'shv kh'shr dbr 'lyhn mlkh mtsrym vtchyyn 't hyldym
verses.translation: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לַֽ/מְיַלְּדֹ֔ת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ן מַדּ֥וּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ן הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/תְּחַיֶּ֖יןָ אֶת הַ/יְלָדִֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' mlkh mtsrym lmyldt vy'mr lhn mdv' 'shytn hdbr hzh vtchyyn 't hyldym
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמַ֤רְןָ הַֽ/מְיַלְּדֹת֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֧א כַ/נָּשִׁ֛ים הַ/מִּצְרִיֹּ֖ת הָֽ/עִבְרִיֹּ֑ת כִּֽי חָי֣וֹת הֵ֔נָּה בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם תָּב֧וֹא אֲלֵ/הֶ֛ן הַ/מְיַלֶּ֖דֶת וְ/יָלָֽדוּ
verses.translit: vt'mrn hmyldt 'l pr'h khy l' khnshym hmtsryt h'bryt khy chyvt hnh btrm tbv' 'lhn hmyldt vyldv
verses.translation: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥יטֶב אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַֽ/מְיַלְּדֹ֑ת וַ/יִּ֧רֶב הָ/עָ֛ם וַ/יַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyytb 'lhym lmyldt vyrb h'm vy'tsmv m'd
verses.translation: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כִּֽי יָֽרְא֥וּ הַֽ/מְיַלְּדֹ֖ת אֶת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ לָ/הֶ֖ם בָּתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khy yr'v hmyldt 't h'lhym vy'sh lhm btym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו פַּרְעֹ֔ה לְ/כָל עַמּ֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כָּל הַ/בֵּ֣ן הַ/יִּלּ֗וֹד הַ/יְאֹ֨רָ/ה֙ תַּשְׁלִיכֻ֔/הוּ וְ/כָל הַ/בַּ֖ת תְּחַיּֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vytsv pr'h lkhl 'mv l'mr khl hbn hylvd hy'rh tshlykhhv vkhl hbt tchyvn
verses.translation: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אִ֖ישׁ מִ/בֵּ֣ית לֵוִ֑י וַ/יִּקַּ֖ח אֶת בַּת לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: vylkh 'ysh mbyt lvy vyqch 't bt lvy
verses.translation: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֥הַר הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַ/תֵּ֤רֶא אֹת/וֹ֙ כִּי ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַֽ/תִּצְפְּנֵ֖/הוּ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יְרָחִֽים
verses.translit: vthr h'shh vtld bn vtr' 'tv khy tvb hv' vttspnhv shlshh yrchym
verses.translation: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָכְלָ֣ה עוֹד֮ הַצְּפִינ/וֹ֒ וַ/תִּֽקַּֽח ל/וֹ֙ תֵּ֣בַת גֹּ֔מֶא וַ/תַּחְמְרָ֥/ה בַ/חֵמָ֖ר וּ/בַ/זָּ֑פֶת וַ/תָּ֤שֶׂם בָּ/הּ֙ אֶת הַ/יֶּ֔לֶד וַ/תָּ֥שֶׂם בַּ/סּ֖וּף עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vl' ykhlh 'vd htspynv vtqch lv tbt gm' vtchmrh bchmr vbzpt vtshm bh 't hyld vtshm bsvf 'l shpt hy'r
verses.translation: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּתַצַּ֥ב אֲחֹת֖/וֹ מֵ/רָחֹ֑ק לְ/דֵעָ֕ה מַה יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtttsb 'chtv mrchq ld'h mh y'shh lv
verses.translation: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤רֶד בַּת פַּרְעֹה֙ לִ/רְחֹ֣ץ עַל הַ/יְאֹ֔ר וְ/נַעֲרֹתֶ֥י/הָ הֹלְכֹ֖ת עַל יַ֣ד הַ/יְאֹ֑ר וַ/תֵּ֤רֶא אֶת הַ/תֵּבָה֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/סּ֔וּף וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֶת אֲמָתָ֖/הּ וַ/תִּקָּחֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: vtrd bt pr'h lrchts 'l hy'r vn'rtyh hlkht 'l yd hy'r vtr' 't htbh btvkh hsvf vtshlch 't 'mth vtqchh
verses.translation: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

verses.original: וַ/תִּפְתַּח֙ וַ/תִּרְאֵ֣/הוּ אֶת הַ/יֶּ֔לֶד וְ/הִנֵּה נַ֖עַר בֹּכֶ֑ה וַ/תַּחְמֹ֣ל עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר מִ/יַּלְדֵ֥י הָֽ/עִבְרִ֖ים זֶֽה
verses.translit: vtptch vtr'hv 't hyld vhnh n'r bkhh vtchml 'lyv vt'mr myldy h'brym zh
verses.translation: And when she had opened it , she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֲחֹת/וֹ֮ אֶל בַּת פַּרְעֹה֒ הַ/אֵלֵ֗ךְ וְ/קָרָ֤אתִי לָ/ךְ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה מֵינֶ֔קֶת מִ֖ן הָ/עִבְרִיֹּ֑ת וְ/תֵינִ֥ק לָ֖/ךְ אֶת הַ/יָּֽלֶד
verses.translit: vt'mr 'chtv 'l bt pr'h h'lkh vqr'ty lkh 'shh mynqt mn h'bryt vtynq lkh 't hyld
verses.translation: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּֽאמֶר לָ֥/הּ בַּת פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵ֑כִי וַ/תֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ הָֽ/עַלְמָ֔ה וַ/תִּקְרָ֖א אֶת אֵ֥ם הַ/יָּֽלֶד
verses.translit: vt'mr lh bt pr'h lkhy vtlkh h'lmh vtqr' 't 'm hyld
verses.translation: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר לָ֣/הּ בַּת פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֵילִ֜יכִי אֶת הַ/יֶּ֤לֶד הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/הֵינִקִ֣/הוּ לִ֔/י וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת שְׂכָרֵ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּקַּ֧ח הָ/אִשָּׁ֛ה הַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וַ/תְּנִיקֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vt'mr lh bt pr'h hylykhy 't hyld hzh vhynqhv ly v'ny 'tn 't shkhrkh vtqch h'shh hyld vtnyqhv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

verses.original: וַ/יִגְדַּ֣ל הַ/יֶּ֗לֶד וַ/תְּבִאֵ֨/הוּ֙ לְ/בַת פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַֽ/יְהִי לָ֖/הּ לְ/בֵ֑ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמ/וֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י מִן הַ/מַּ֖יִם מְשִׁיתִֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vygdl hyld vtb'hv lbt pr'h vyhy lh lbn vtqr' shmv mshh vt'mr khy mn hmym mshythv
verses.translation: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֗ם וַ/יִּגְדַּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א אֶל אֶחָ֔י/ו וַ/יַּ֖רְא בְּ/סִבְלֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יַּרְא֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מַכֶּ֥ה אִישׁ עִבְרִ֖י מֵ/אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy bymym hhm vygdl mshh vyts' 'l 'chyv vyr' bsbltm vyr' 'ysh mtsry mkhh 'ysh 'bry m'chyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤פֶן כֹּה֙ וָ/כֹ֔ה וַ/יַּ֖רְא כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּצְרִ֔י וַֽ/יִּטְמְנֵ֖/הוּ בַּ/חֽוֹל
verses.translit: vypn khh vkhh vyr' khy 'yn 'ysh vykh 't hmtsry vytmnhv bchvl
verses.translation: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנֵֽי אֲנָשִׁ֥ים עִבְרִ֖ים נִצִּ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לָֽ/רָשָׁ֔ע לָ֥/מָּה תַכֶּ֖ה רֵעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyts' byvm hshny vhnh shny 'nshym 'brym ntsym vy'mr lrsh' lmh tkhh r'kh
verses.translation: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר מִ֣י שָֽׂמְ/ךָ֞ לְ/אִ֨ישׁ שַׂ֤ר וְ/שֹׁפֵט֙ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ הַ/לְ/הָרְגֵ֨/נִי֙ אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרַ֖גְתָּ אֶת הַ/מִּצְרִ֑י וַ/יִּירָ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר אָכֵ֖ן נוֹדַ֥ע הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr my shmkh l'ysh shr vshpt 'lynv hlhrgny 'th 'mr kh'shr hrgt 't hmtsry vyyr' mshh vy'mr 'khn nvd' hdbr
verses.translation: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לַ/הֲרֹ֣ג אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יִּבְרַ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ מִדְיָ֖ן וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב עַֽל הַ/בְּאֵֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' pr'h 't hdbr hzh vybqsh lhrg 't mshh vybrch mshh mpny pr'h vyshb b'rts mdyn vyshb 'l hb'r
verses.translation: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/כֹהֵ֥ן מִדְיָ֖ן שֶׁ֣בַע בָּנ֑וֹת וַ/תָּבֹ֣אנָה וַ/תִּדְלֶ֗נָה וַ/תְּמַלֶּ֨אנָה֙ אֶת הָ֣/רְהָטִ֔ים לְ/הַשְׁק֖וֹת צֹ֥אן אֲבִי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vlkhhn mdyn shb' bnvt vtb'nh vtdlnh vtml'nh 't hrhtym lhshqvt ts'n 'byhn
verses.translation: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ הָ/רֹעִ֖ים וַ/יְגָרְשׁ֑וּ/ם וַ/יָּ֤קָם מֹשֶׁה֙ וַ/יּ֣וֹשִׁעָ֔/ן וַ/יַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת צֹאנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyb'v hr'ym vygrshvm vyqm mshh vyvsh'n vyshq 't ts'nm
verses.translation: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֕אנָה אֶל רְעוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִי/הֶ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֛וּעַ מִהַרְתֶּ֥ן בֹּ֖א הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vtb'nh 'l r'v'l 'byhn vy'mr mdv' mhrtn b' hyvm
verses.translation: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמַ֕רְןָ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י הִצִּילָ֖/נוּ מִ/יַּ֣ד הָ/רֹעִ֑ים וְ/גַם דָּלֹ֤ה דָלָה֙ לָ֔/נוּ וַ/יַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: vt'mrn 'ysh mtsry htsylnv myd hr'ym vgm dlh dlh lnv vyshq 't hts'n
verses.translation: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל בְּנֹתָ֖י/ו וְ/אַיּ֑/וֹ לָ֤/מָּה זֶּה֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ן אֶת הָ/אִ֔ישׁ קִרְאֶ֥ן ל֖/וֹ וְ/יֹ֥אכַל לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l bntyv v'yv lmh zh 'zbtn 't h'ysh qr'n lv vy'khl lchm
verses.translation: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹאֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יִּתֵּ֛ן אֶת צִפֹּרָ֥ה בִתּ֖/וֹ לְ/מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyv'l mshh lshbt 't h'ysh vytn 't tsprh btv lmshh
verses.translation: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ גֵּרְשֹׁ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vtld bn vyqr' 't shmv grshm khy 'mr gr hyyty b'rts nkhryh
verses.translation: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בַ/יָּמִ֨ים הָֽ/רַבִּ֜ים הָ/הֵ֗ם וַ/יָּ֨מָת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יֵּאָנְח֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִן הָ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה וַ/יִּזְעָ֑קוּ וַ/תַּ֧עַל שַׁוְעָתָ֛/ם אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן הָ/עֲבֹדָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bymym hrbym hhm vymt mlkh mtsrym vy'nchv bny yshr'l mn h'bdh vyz'qv vt'l shv'tm 'l h'lhym mn h'bdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת נַאֲקָתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת בְּרִית֔/וֹ אֶת אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת יִצְחָ֥ק וְ/אֶֽת יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vyshm' 'lhym 't n'qtm vyzkhr 'lhym 't brytv 't 'brhm 't ytschq v't y'qb
verses.translation: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֖דַע אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 't bny yshr'l vyd' 'lhym
verses.translation: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them .

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁ֗ה הָיָ֥ה רֹעֶ֛ה אֶת צֹ֛אן יִתְר֥וֹ חֹתְנ֖/וֹ כֹּהֵ֣ן מִדְיָ֑ן וַ/יִּנְהַ֤ג אֶת הַ/צֹּאן֙ אַחַ֣ר הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וַ/יָּבֹ֛א אֶל הַ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים חֹרֵֽבָ/ה
verses.translit: vmshh hyh r'h 't ts'n ytrv chtnv khhn mdyn vynhg 't hts'n 'chr hmdbr vyb' 'l hr h'lhym chrbh
verses.translation: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

verses.original: וַ֠/יֵּרָא מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֵלָ֛י/ו בְּ/לַבַּת אֵ֖שׁ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/סְּנֶ֑ה וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/סְּנֶה֙ בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/הַ/סְּנֶ֖ה אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ אֻכָּֽל
verses.translit: vyr' ml'kh yhvh 'lyv blbt 'sh mtvkh hsnh vyr' vhnh hsnh b'r b'sh vhsnh 'ynnv 'khl
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אָסֻֽרָה נָּ֣א וְ/אֶרְאֶ֔ה אֶת הַ/מַּרְאֶ֥ה הַ/גָּדֹ֖ל הַ/זֶּ֑ה מַדּ֖וּעַ לֹא יִבְעַ֥ר הַ/סְּנֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'srh n' v'r'h 't hmr'h hgdl hzh mdv' l' yb'r hsnh
verses.translation: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י סָ֣ר לִ/רְא֑וֹת וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ אֵלָ֨י/ו אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/סְּנֶ֗ה וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh khy sr lr'vt vyqr' 'lyv 'lhym mtvkh hsnh vy'mr mshh mshh vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אַל תִּקְרַ֣ב הֲלֹ֑ם שַׁל נְעָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֣י הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עוֹמֵ֣ד עָלָ֔י/ו אַדְמַת קֹ֖דֶשׁ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l tqrb hlm shl n'lykh m'l rglykh khy hmqvm 'shr 'th 'vmd 'lyv 'dmt qdsh hv'
verses.translation: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ךָ אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֖ק וֵ/אלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַ/יַּסְתֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנָ֔י/ו כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א מֵ/הַבִּ֖יט אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'nkhy 'lhy 'bykh 'lhy 'brhm 'lhy ytschq v'lhy y'qb vystr mshh pnyv khy yr' mhbyt 'l h'lhym
verses.translation: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה רָאֹ֥ה רָאִ֛יתִי אֶת עֳנִ֥י עַמִּ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת צַעֲקָתָ֤/ם שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י נֹֽגְשָׂ֔י/ו כִּ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי אֶת מַכְאֹבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh r'h r'yty 't 'ny 'my 'shr bmtsrym v't ts'qtm shm'ty mpny ngshyv khy yd'ty 't mkh'byv
verses.translation: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

verses.original: וָ/אֵרֵ֞ד לְ/הַצִּיל֣/וֹ מִ/יַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֗יִם וּֽ/לְ/הַעֲלֹת/וֹ֮ מִן הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִוא֒ אֶל אֶ֤רֶץ טוֹבָה֙ וּ/רְחָבָ֔ה אֶל אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָ֑שׁ אֶל מְק֤וֹם הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְ/הַ֣/חִתִּ֔י וְ/הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י וְ/הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: v'rd lhtsylv myd mtsrym vlh'ltv mn h'rts hhv' 'l 'rts tvbh vrchbh 'l 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh 'l mqvm hkhn'ny vhchty vh'mry vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy
verses.translation: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֛ה צַעֲקַ֥ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣אָה אֵלָ֑/י וְ/גַם רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת הַ/לַּ֔חַץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹחֲצִ֥ים אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th hnh ts'qt bny yshr'l b'h 'ly vgm r'yty 't hlchts 'shr mtsrym lchtsym 'tm
verses.translation: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה לְכָ֔/ה וְ/אֶֽשְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֖ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/הוֹצֵ֛א אֶת עַמִּ֥/י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'th lkhh v'shlchkh 'l pr'h vhvts' 't 'my bny yshr'l mmtsrym
verses.translation: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ֣י אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אֵלֵ֖ךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/כִ֥י אוֹצִ֛יא אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l h'lhym my 'nkhy khy 'lkh 'l pr'h vkhy 'vtsy' 't bny yshr'l mmtsrym
verses.translation: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כִּֽי אֶֽהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/זֶה לְּ/ךָ֣ הָ/א֔וֹת כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י שְׁלַחְתִּ֑י/ךָ בְּ/הוֹצִֽיאֲ/ךָ֤ אֶת הָ/עָם֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם תַּֽעַבְדוּ/ן֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָ/הָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr khy 'hyh 'mkh vzh lkh h'vt khy 'nkhy shlchtykh bhvtsy'kh 't h'm mmtsrym t'bdvn 't h'lhym 'l hhr hzh
verses.translation: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֣י בָא֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְ/אָמַרְתִּ֣י לָ/הֶ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/אָֽמְרוּ לִ֣/י מַה שְּׁמ֔/וֹ מָ֥ה אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l h'lhym hnh 'nkhy b' 'l bny yshr'l v'mrty lhm 'lhy 'bvtykhm shlchny 'lykhm v'mrv ly mh shmv mh 'mr 'lhm
verses.translation: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽהְיֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה שְׁלָחַ֥/נִי אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l mshh 'hyh 'shr 'hyh vy'mr khh t'mr lbny yshr'l 'hyh shlchny 'lykhm
verses.translation: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ ע֨וֹד אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֹּֽה תֹאמַר֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק וֵ/אלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם זֶה שְּׁמִ֣/י לְ/עֹלָ֔ם וְ/זֶ֥ה זִכְרִ֖/י לְ/דֹ֥ר דֹּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'vd 'lhym 'l mshh khh t'mr 'l bny yshr'l yhvh 'lhy 'btykhm 'lhy 'brhm 'lhy ytschq v'lhy y'qb shlchny 'lykhm zh shmy l'lm vzh zkhry ldr dr
verses.translation: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ וְ/אָֽסַפְתָּ֞ אֶת זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ נִרְאָ֣ה אֵלַ֔/י אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם יִצְחָ֥ק וְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֵ/אמֹ֑ר פָּקֹ֤ד פָּקַ֨דְתִּי֙ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת הֶ/עָשׂ֥וּי לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: lkh v'spt 't zqny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm yhvh 'lhy 'btykhm nr'h 'ly 'lhy 'brhm ytschq vy'qb l'mr pqd pqdty 'tkhm v't h'shvy lkhm bmtsrym
verses.translation: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶם֮ מֵ/עֳנִ֣י מִצְרַיִם֒ אֶל אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְ/הַ֣/חִתִּ֔י וְ/הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י וְ/הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֑י אֶל אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'mr ''lh 'tkhm m'ny mtsrym 'l 'rts hkhn'ny vhchty vh'mry vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy 'l 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְע֖וּ לְ/קֹלֶ֑/ךָ וּ/בָאתָ֡ אַתָּה֩ וְ/זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֗יִם וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽ/עִבְרִיִּים֙ נִקְרָ֣ה עָלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה נֵֽלֲכָה נָּ֞א דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וְ/נִזְבְּחָ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vshm'v lqlkh vb't 'th vzqny yshr'l 'l mlkh mtsrym v'mrtm 'lyv yhvh 'lhy h'bryym nqrh 'lynv v'th nlkhh n' drkh shlsht ymym bmdbr vnzbchh lyhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֠י לֹֽא יִתֵּ֥ן אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם לַ/הֲלֹ֑ךְ וְ/לֹ֖א בְּ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה
verses.translit: v'ny yd'ty khy l' ytn 'tkhm mlkh mtsrym lhlkh vl' byd chzqh
verses.translation: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁלַחְתִּ֤י אֶת יָדִ/י֙ וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֣י אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/כֹל֙ נִפְלְאֹתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּ/קִרְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshlchty 't ydy vhkhyty 't mtsrym bkhl npl'ty 'shr ''shh bqrbv v'chry khn yshlch 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֛י אֶת חֵ֥ן הָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֵֽלֵכ֔וּ/ן לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: vntty 't chn h'm hzh b'yny mtsrym vhyh khy tlkhvn l' tlkhv ryqm
verses.translation: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁאֲלָ֨ה אִשָּׁ֤ה מִ/שְּׁכֶנְתָּ/הּ֙ וּ/מִ/גָּרַ֣ת בֵּיתָ֔/הּ כְּלֵי כֶ֛סֶף וּ/כְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּ/שְׂמָלֹ֑ת וְ/שַׂמְתֶּ֗ם עַל בְּנֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/עַל בְּנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֶת מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vsh'lh 'shh mshkhnth vmgrt byth khly khsf vkhly zhb vshmlt vshmtm 'l bnykhm v'l bntykhm vntsltm 't mtsrym
verses.translation: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן מֹשֶׁה֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר וְ/הֵן֙ לֹֽא יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לִ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ בְּ/קֹלִ֑/י כִּ֣י יֹֽאמְר֔וּ לֹֽא נִרְאָ֥ה אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n mshh vy'mr vhn l' y'mynv ly vl' yshm'v bqly khy y'mrv l' nr'h 'lykh yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלָ֛י/ו יְהוָ֖ה מ/זה מַה זֶּ֣ה בְ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מַטֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv yhvh mzh mh zh bydkh vy'mr mth
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַשְׁלִיכֵ֣/הוּ אַ֔רְצָ/ה וַ/יַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥/הוּ אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/יְהִ֣י לְ/נָחָ֑שׁ וַ/יָּ֥נָס מֹשֶׁ֖ה מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr hshlykhhv 'rtsh vyshlykhhv 'rtsh vyhy lnchsh vyns mshh mpnyv
verses.translation: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה שְׁלַח֙ יָֽדְ/ךָ֔ וֶ/אֱחֹ֖ז בִּ/זְנָב֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָד/וֹ֙ וַ/יַּ֣חֲזֶק בּ֔/וֹ וַ/יְהִ֥י לְ/מַטֶּ֖ה בְּ/כַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh shlch ydkh v'chz bznbv vyshlch ydv vychzq bv vyhy lmth bkhpv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יַאֲמִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי נִרְאָ֥ה אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתָ֑/ם אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֖ק וֵ/אלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: lm'n y'mynv khy nr'h 'lykh yhvh 'lhy 'btm 'lhy 'brhm 'lhy ytschq v'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֜/וֹ ע֗וֹד הָֽבֵא נָ֤א יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יָּבֵ֥א יָד֖/וֹ בְּ/חֵיק֑/וֹ וַ/יּ֣וֹצִאָ֔/הּ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה יָד֖/וֹ מְצֹרַ֥עַת כַּ/שָּֽׁלֶג
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lv 'vd hb' n' ydkh bchyqkh vyb' ydv bchyqv vyvts'h vhnh ydv mtsr't khshlg
verses.translation: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הָשֵׁ֤ב יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ אֶל חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב יָד֖/וֹ אֶל חֵיק֑/וֹ וַ/יּֽוֹצִאָ/הּ֙ מֵֽ/חֵיק֔/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁ֖בָה כִּ/בְשָׂרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr hshb ydkh 'l chyqkh vyshb ydv 'l chyqv vyvts'h mchyqv vhnh shbh khbshrv
verses.translation: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ אִם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לָ֔/ךְ וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ לְ/קֹ֖ל הָ/אֹ֣ת הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן וְ/הֶֽאֱמִ֔ינוּ לְ/קֹ֖ל הָ/אֹ֥ת הָ/אַחֲרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhyh 'm l' y'mynv lkh vl' yshm'v lql h't hr'shvn vh'mynv lql h't h'chrvn
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה אִם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֡ינוּ גַּם֩ לִ/שְׁנֵ֨י הָ/אֹת֜וֹת הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וְ/לֹ֤א יִשְׁמְעוּ/ן֙ לְ/קֹלֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֙ מִ/מֵּימֵ֣י הַ/יְאֹ֔ר וְ/שָׁפַכְתָּ֖ הַ/יַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְ/הָי֤וּ הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקַּ֣ח מִן הַ/יְאֹ֔ר וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/דָ֖ם בַּ/יַּבָּֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vhyh 'm l' y'mynv gm lshny h'tvt h'lh vl' yshm'vn lqlkh vlqcht mmymy hy'r vshpkht hybshh vhyv hmym 'shr tqch mn hy'r vhyv ldm bybsht
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל יְהוָה֮ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנָ/י֒ לֹא֩ אִ֨ישׁ דְּבָרִ֜ים אָנֹ֗כִי גַּ֤ם מִ/תְּמוֹל֙ גַּ֣ם מִ/שִּׁלְשֹׁ֔ם גַּ֛ם מֵ/אָ֥ז דַּבֶּרְ/ךָ אֶל עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֧י כְבַד פֶּ֛ה וּ/כְבַ֥ד לָשׁ֖וֹן אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l yhvh by 'dny l' 'ysh dbrym 'nkhy gm mtmvl gm mshlshm gm m'z dbrkh 'l 'bdkh khy khbd ph vkhbd lshvn 'nkhy
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD , O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו מִ֣י שָׂ֣ם פֶּה֮ לָֽ/אָדָם֒ א֚וֹ מִֽי יָשׂ֣וּם אִלֵּ֔ם א֣וֹ חֵרֵ֔שׁ א֥וֹ פִקֵּ֖חַ א֣וֹ עִוֵּ֑ר הֲ/לֹ֥א אָנֹכִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv my shm ph l'dm 'v my yshvm 'lm 'v chrsh 'v pqch 'v 'vr hl' 'nkhy yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD ?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה לֵ֑ךְ וְ/אָנֹכִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶ֣ה עִם פִּ֔י/ךָ וְ/הוֹרֵיתִ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: v'th lkh v'nkhy 'hyh 'm pykh vhvrytykh 'shr tdbr
verses.translation: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר בִּ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑/י שְֽׁלַֽח נָ֖א בְּ/יַד תִּשְׁלָֽח
verses.translit: vy'mr by 'dny shlch n' byd tshlch
verses.translation: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֨ף יְהוָ֜ה בְּ/מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הֲ/לֹ֨א אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/לֵּוִ֔י יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי דַבֵּ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר ה֑וּא וְ/גַ֤ם הִנֵּה הוּא֙ יֹצֵ֣א לִ/קְרָאתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/רָאֲ/ךָ֖ וְ/שָׂמַ֥ח בְּ/לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh bmshh vy'mr hl' 'hrn 'chykh hlvy yd'ty khy dbr ydbr hv' vgm hnh hv' yts' lqr'tkh vr'kh vshmch blbv
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

verses.original: וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים בְּ/פִ֑י/ו וְ/אָנֹכִ֗י אֶֽהְיֶ֤ה עִם פִּ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/עִם פִּ֔י/הוּ וְ/הוֹרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּ/ן
verses.translit: vdbrt 'lyv vshmt 't hdbrym bpyv v'nkhy 'hyh 'm pykh v'm pyhv vhvryty 'tkhm 't 'shr t'shvn
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

verses.original: וְ/דִבֶּר ה֥וּא לְ/ךָ֖ אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/הָ֤יָה הוּא֙ יִֽהְיֶה לְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/פֶ֔ה וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶה לּ֥/וֹ לֵֽ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vdbr hv' lkh 'l h'm vhyh hv' yhyh lkh lph v'th thyh lv l'lhym
verses.translation: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּטֶּ֥ה הַ/זֶּ֖ה תִּקַּ֣ח בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂה בּ֖/וֹ אֶת הָ/אֹתֹֽת
verses.translit: v't hmth hzh tqch bydkh 'shr t'shh bv 't h'tt
verses.translation: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב אֶל יֶ֣תֶר חֹֽתְנ֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ אֵ֣לֲכָה נָּ֗א וְ/אָשׁ֨וּבָה֙ אֶל אַחַ֣/י אֲשֶׁר בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/אֶרְאֶ֖ה הַ/עוֹדָ֣/ם חַיִּ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יִתְר֛וֹ לְ/מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵ֥ךְ לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vylkh mshh vyshb 'l ytr chtnv vy'mr lv 'lkhh n' v'shvbh 'l 'chy 'shr bmtsrym v'r'h h'vdm chyym vy'mr ytrv lmshh lkh lshlvm
verses.translation: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ בְּ/מִדְיָ֔ן לֵ֖ךְ שֻׁ֣ב מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּי מֵ֨תוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַֽ/מְבַקְשִׁ֖ים אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh bmdyn lkh shb mtsrym khy mtv khl h'nshym hmbqshym 't npshkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת אִשְׁתּ֣/וֹ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּרְכִּבֵ/ם֙ עַֽל הַ/חֲמֹ֔ר וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב אַ֣רְצָ/ה מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת מַטֵּ֥ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't 'shtv v't bnyv vyrkhbm 'l hchmr vyshb 'rtsh mtsrym vyqch mshh 't mth h'lhym bydv
verses.translation: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ בְּ/לֶכְתְּ/ךָ֙ לָ/שׁ֣וּב מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה רְאֵ֗ה כָּל הַ/מֹּֽפְתִים֙ אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֣מְתִּי בְ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ וַ/עֲשִׂיתָ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַ/אֲנִי֙ אֲחַזֵּ֣ק אֶת לִבּ֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh blkhtkh lshvb mtsrymh r'h khl hmptym 'shr shmty bydkh v'shytm lpny pr'h v'ny 'chzq 't lbv vl' yshlch 't h'm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּנִ֥/י בְכֹרִ֖/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'mrt 'l pr'h khh 'mr yhvh bny bkhry yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD , Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ שַׁלַּ֤ח אֶת בְּנִ/י֙ וְ/יַֽעַבְדֵ֔/נִי וַ/תְּמָאֵ֖ן לְ/שַׁלְּח֑/וֹ הִנֵּה֙ אָנֹכִ֣י הֹרֵ֔ג אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֖ בְּכֹרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'mr 'lykh shlch 't bny vy'bdny vtm'n lshlchv hnh 'nkhy hrg 't bnkh bkhrkh
verses.translation: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י בַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ בַּ/מָּל֑וֹן וַ/יִּפְגְּשֵׁ֣/הוּ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יְבַקֵּ֖שׁ הֲמִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy bdrkh bmlvn vypgshhv yhvh vybqsh hmytv
verses.translation: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֨ח צִפֹּרָ֜ה צֹ֗ר וַ/תִּכְרֹת֙ אֶת עָרְלַ֣ת בְּנָ֔/הּ וַ/תַּגַּ֖ע לְ/רַגְלָ֑י/ו וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֧י חֲתַן דָּמִ֛ים אַתָּ֖ה לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtqch tsprh tsr vtkhrt 't 'rlt bnh vtg' lrglyv vt'mr khy chtn dmym 'th ly
verses.translation: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֖רֶף מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אָ֚ז אָֽמְרָ֔ה חֲתַ֥ן דָּמִ֖ים לַ/מּוּלֹֽת
verses.translit: vyrf mmnv 'z 'mrh chtn dmym lmvlt
verses.translation: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן לֵ֛ךְ לִ/קְרַ֥את מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַ/מִּדְבָּ֑רָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ וַֽ/יִּפְגְּשֵׁ֛/הוּ בְּ/הַ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/יִּשַּׁק לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l 'hrn lkh lqr't mshh hmdbrh vylkh vypgshhv bhr h'lhym vyshq lv
verses.translation: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ לְ/אַֽהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֛ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלָח֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/אֹתֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vygd mshh l'hrn 't khl dbry yhvh 'shr shlchv v't khl h'tt 'shr tsvhv
verses.translation: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַ/יַּ֣אַסְפ֔וּ אֶת כָּל זִקְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vylkh mshh v'hrn vy'spv 't khl zqny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/אֹתֹ֖ת לְ/עֵינֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vydbr 'hrn 't khl hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'l mshh vy'sh h'tt l'yny h'm
verses.translation: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּאֲמֵ֖ן הָ/עָ֑ם וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֡וּ כִּֽי פָקַ֨ד יְהוָ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/כִ֤י רָאָה֙ אֶת עָנְיָ֔/ם וַֽ/יִּקְּד֖וּ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mn h'm vyshm'v khy pqd yhvh 't bny yshr'l vkhy r'h 't 'nym vyqdv vyshtchvv
verses.translation: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֗ר בָּ֚אוּ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י וְ/יָחֹ֥גּוּ לִ֖/י בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v'chr b'v mshh v'hrn vy'mrv 'l pr'h khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l shlch 't 'my vychgv ly bmdbr
verses.translation: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה מִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶשְׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קֹל֔/וֹ לְ/שַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֲשַׁלֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h my yhvh 'shr 'shm' bqlv lshlch 't yshr'l l' yd'ty 't yhvh vgm 't yshr'l l' 'shlch
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD , that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD , neither will I let Israel go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/עִבְרִ֖ים נִקְרָ֣א עָלֵ֑י/נוּ נֵ֣לֲכָה נָּ֡א דֶּרֶךְ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֜ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר וְ/נִזְבְּחָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ פֶּ֨ן יִפְגָּעֵ֔/נוּ בַּ/דֶּ֖בֶר א֥וֹ בֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lhy h'brym nqr' 'lynv nlkhh n' drkh shlsht ymym bmdbr vnzbchh lyhvh 'lhynv pn ypg'nv bdbr 'v bchrb
verses.translation: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָ֚/מָּה מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן תַּפְרִ֥יעוּ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם מִ/מַּֽעֲשָׂ֑י/ו לְכ֖וּ לְ/סִבְלֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm mlkh mtsrym lmh mshh v'hrn tpry'v 't h'm mm'shyv lkhv lsbltykhm
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה הֵן רַבִּ֥ים עַתָּ֖ה עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הִשְׁבַּתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖/ם מִ/סִּבְלֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h hn rbym 'th 'm h'rts vhshbtm 'tm msbltm
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ו פַּרְעֹ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא אֶת הַ/נֹּגְשִׂ֣ים בָּ/עָ֔ם וְ/אֶת שֹׁטְרָ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv pr'h byvm hhv' 't hngshym b'm v't shtryv l'mr
verses.translation: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאסִפ֞וּ/ן לָ/תֵ֨ת תֶּ֧בֶן לָ/עָ֛ם לִ/לְבֹּ֥ן הַ/לְּבֵנִ֖ים כִּ/תְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם הֵ֚ם יֵֽלְכ֔וּ וְ/קֹשְׁשׁ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן
verses.translit: l' t'spvn ltt tbn l'm llbn hlbnym khtmvl shlshm hm ylkhv vqshshv lhm tbn
verses.translation: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מַתְכֹּ֨נֶת הַ/לְּבֵנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים תְּמ֤וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם֙ תָּשִׂ֣ימוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ כִּֽי נִרְפִּ֣ים הֵ֔ם עַל כֵּ֗ן הֵ֤ם צֹֽעֲקִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לֵ/אלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v't mtkhnt hlbnym 'shr hm 'shym tmvl shlshm tshymv 'lyhm l' tgr'v mmnv khy nrpym hm 'l khn hm ts'qym l'mr nlkhh nzbchh l'lhynv
verses.translation: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

verses.original: תִּכְבַּ֧ד הָ/עֲבֹדָ֛ה עַל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְ/יַעֲשׂוּ בָ֑/הּ וְ/אַל יִשְׁע֖וּ בְּ/דִבְרֵי שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: tkhbd h'bdh 'l h'nshym vy'shv bh v'l ysh'v bdbry shqr
verses.translation: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨צְא֜וּ נֹגְשֵׂ֤י הָ/עָם֙ וְ/שֹׁ֣טְרָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֶל הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֵינֶ֛/נִּי נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן
verses.translit: vyts'v ngshy h'm vshtryv vy'mrv 'l h'm l'mr khh 'mr pr'h 'ynny ntn lkhm tbn
verses.translation: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

verses.original: אַתֶּ֗ם לְכ֨וּ קְח֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ תֶּ֔בֶן מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר תִּמְצָ֑אוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נִגְרָ֛ע מֵ/עֲבֹדַתְ/כֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: 'tm lkhv qchv lkhm tbn m'shr tmts'v khy 'yn ngr' m'bdtkhm dbr
verses.translation: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥פֶץ הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְ/קֹשֵׁ֥שׁ קַ֖שׁ לַ/תֶּֽבֶן
verses.translit: vypts h'm bkhl 'rts mtsrym lqshsh qsh ltbn
verses.translation: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נֹּגְשִׂ֖ים אָצִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כַּלּ֤וּ מַעֲשֵׂי/כֶם֙ דְּבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/הְי֥וֹת הַ/תֶּֽבֶן
verses.translit: vhngshym 'tsym l'mr khlv m'shykhm dbr yvm byvmv kh'shr bhyvt htbn
verses.translation: And the taskmasters hasted them , saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּכּ֗וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣מוּ עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם נֹגְשֵׂ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מַדּ֡וּעַ לֹא֩ כִלִּיתֶ֨ם חָקְ/כֶ֤ם לִ/לְבֹּן֙ כִּ/תְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם גַּם תְּמ֖וֹל גַּם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vykhv shtry bny yshr'l 'shr shmv 'lhm ngshy pr'h l'mr mdv' l' khlytm chqkhm llbn khtmvl shlshm gm tmvl gm hyvm
verses.translation: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּצְעֲק֥וּ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לָ֧/מָּה תַעֲשֶׂ֦ה כֹ֖ה לַ/עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyb'v shtry bny yshr'l vyts'qv 'l pr'h l'mr lmh t'shh khh l'bdykh
verses.translation: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

verses.original: תֶּ֗בֶן אֵ֤ין נִתָּן֙ לַ/עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/לְבֵנִ֛ים אֹמְרִ֥ים לָ֖/נוּ עֲשׂ֑וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדֶ֛י/ךָ מֻכִּ֖ים וְ/חָטָ֥את עַמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: tbn 'yn ntn l'bdykh vlbnym 'mrym lnv 'shv vhnh 'bdykh mkhym vcht't 'mkh
verses.translation: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר נִרְפִּ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם נִרְפִּ֑ים עַל כֵּן֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr nrpym 'tm nrpym 'l khn 'tm 'mrym nlkhh nzbchh lyhvh
verses.translation: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ לְכ֣וּ עִבְד֔וּ וְ/תֶ֖בֶן לֹא יִנָּתֵ֣ן לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/תֹ֥כֶן לְבֵנִ֖ים תִּתֵּֽנּוּ
verses.translit: v'th lkhv 'bdv vtbn l' yntn lkhm vtkhn lbnym ttnv
verses.translation: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֞וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵ֧י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/רָ֣ע לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹא תִגְרְע֥וּ מִ/לִּבְנֵי/כֶ֖ם דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr'v shtry bny yshr'l 'tm br' l'mr l' tgr'v mlbnykhm dbr yvm byvmv
verses.translation: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּפְגְּעוּ֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֔ן נִצָּבִ֖ים לִ/קְרָאתָ֑/ם בְּ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֵ֥ת פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vypg'v 't mshh v't 'hrn ntsbym lqr'tm bts'tm m't pr'h
verses.translation: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם יֵ֧רֶא יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/יִשְׁפֹּ֑ט אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת רֵיחֵ֗/נוּ בְּ/עֵינֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֣י עֲבָדָ֔י/ו לָֽ/תֶת חֶ֥רֶב בְּ/יָדָ֖/ם לְ/הָרְגֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lhm yr' yhvh 'lykhm vyshpt 'shr hb'shtm 't rychnv b'yny pr'h vb'yny 'bdyv ltt chrb bydm lhrgnv
verses.translation: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗/י לָ/מָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֨תָה֙ לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֖ה שְׁלַחְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyshb mshh 'l yhvh vy'mr 'dny lmh hr'th l'm hzh lmh zh shlchtny
verses.translation: And Moses returned unto the LORD , and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/אָ֞ז בָּ֤אתִי אֶל פַּרְעֹה֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר בִּ/שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ הֵרַ֖ע לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/הַצֵּ֥ל לֹא הִצַּ֖לְתָּ אֶת עַמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vm'z b'ty 'l pr'h ldbr bshmkh hr' l'm hzh vhtsl l' htslt 't 'mkh
verses.translation: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה תִרְאֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְ/פַרְעֹ֑ה כִּ֣י בְ/יָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ יְשַׁלְּחֵ֔/ם וּ/בְ/יָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה יְגָרְשֵׁ֖/ם מֵ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'th tr'h 'shr ''shh lpr'h khy byd chzqh yshlchm vbyd chzqh ygrshm m'rtsv
verses.translation: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhym 'l mshh vy'mr 'lyv 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD : : or, JEHOVAH

verses.original: וָ/אֵרָ֗א אֶל אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל יִצְחָ֥ק וְ/אֶֽל יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּ/אֵ֣ל שַׁדָּ֑י וּ/שְׁמִ֣/י יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖עְתִּי לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'r' 'l 'brhm 'l ytschq v'l y'qb b'l shdy vshmy yhvh l' nvd'ty lhm
verses.translation: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם הֲקִמֹ֤תִי אֶת בְּרִיתִ/י֙ אִתָּ֔/ם לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶ֖ם אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֵ֛ת אֶ֥רֶץ מְגֻרֵי/הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר גָּ֥רוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vgm hqmty 't bryty 'tm ltt lhm 't 'rts khn'n 't 'rts mgryhm 'shr grv bh
verses.translation: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֲנִ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶֽת נַאֲקַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם מַעֲבִדִ֣ים אֹתָ֑/ם וָ/אֶזְכֹּ֖ר אֶת בְּרִיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vgm 'ny shm'ty 't n'qt bny yshr'l 'shr mtsrym m'bdym 'tm v'zkhr 't bryty
verses.translation: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֥ר לִ/בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם מִ/תַּ֨חַת֙ סִבְלֹ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/עֲבֹדָתָ֑/ם וְ/גָאַלְתִּ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בִּ/זְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּ/בִ/שְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr lbny yshr'l 'ny yhvh vhvts'ty 'tkhm mtcht sblt mtsrym vhtslty 'tkhm m'bdtm vg'lty 'tkhm bzrv' ntvyh vbshptym gdlym
verses.translation: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְ/כֶ֥ם לִ/י֙ לְ/עָ֔ם וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֑ים וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/מּוֹצִ֣יא אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִ/תַּ֖חַת סִבְל֥וֹת מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vlqchty 'tkhm ly l'm vhyyty lkhm l'lhym vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm hmvtsy' 'tkhm mtcht sblvt mtsrym
verses.translation: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔/י לָ/תֵ֣ת אֹתָ֔/הּ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י אֹתָ֥/הּ לָ/כֶ֛ם מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'tkhm 'l h'rts 'shr nsh'ty 't ydy ltt 'th l'brhm lytschq vly'qb vntty 'th lkhm mvrshh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה כֵּ֖ן אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִ/קֹּ֣צֶר ר֔וּחַ וּ/מֵ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה קָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vydbr mshh khn 'l bny yshr'l vl' shm'v 'l mshh mqtsr rvch vm'bdh qshh
verses.translation: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: בֹּ֣א דַבֵּ֔ר אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וִֽ/ישַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b' dbr 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym vyshlch 't bny yshr'l m'rtsv
verses.translation: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֵ֤ן בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹֽא שָׁמְע֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/אֵיךְ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣/נִי פַרְעֹ֔ה וַ/אֲנִ֖י עֲרַ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vydbr mshh lpny yhvh l'mr hn bny yshr'l l' shm'v 'ly v'ykh yshm'ny pr'h v'ny 'rl shptym
verses.translation: And Moses spake before the LORD , saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֒ וַ/יְצַוֵּ/ם֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶל פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn vytsvm 'l bny yshr'l v'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym lhvtsy' 't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֲנ֤וֹךְ וּ/פַלּוּא֙ חֶצְר֣וֹן וְ/כַרְמִ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת רְאוּבֵֽן
verses.translit: 'lh r'shy byt 'btm bny r'vbn bkhr yshr'l chnvkh vplv' chtsrvn vkhrmy 'lh mshpcht r'vbn
verses.translation: These be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֨ל וְ/יָמִ֤ין וְ/אֹ֨הַד֙ וְ/יָכִ֣ין וְ/צֹ֔חַר וְ/שָׁא֖וּל בֶּן הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֑ית אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת שִׁמְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vbny shm'vn ymv'l vymyn v'hd vykhyn vtschr vsh'vl bn hkhn'nyt 'lh mshpcht shm'vn
verses.translation: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי לֵוִי֙ לְ/תֹ֣לְדֹתָ֔/ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּ/קְהָ֖ת וּ/מְרָרִ֑י וּ/שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י לֵוִ֔י שֶׁ֧בַע וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה
