verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny lvy ltldtm grshvn vqht vmrry vshny chyy lvy shb' vshlshym vm't shnh
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֛וֹן לִבְנִ֥י וְ/שִׁמְעִ֖י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny grshvn lbny vshm'y lmshpchtm
verses.translation: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְ/יִצְהָ֔ר וְ/חֶבְר֖וֹן וְ/עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל וּ/שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י קְהָ֔ת שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vbny qht 'mrm vytshr vchbrvn v'zy'l vshny chyy qht shlsh vshlshym vm't shnh
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּ/מוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַ/לֵּוִ֖י לְ/תֹלְדֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbny mrry mchly vmvshy 'lh mshpcht hlvy ltldtm
verses.translation: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח עַמְרָ֜ם אֶת יוֹכֶ֤בֶד דֹּֽדָת/וֹ֙ ל֣/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד ל֔/וֹ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וּ/שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י עַמְרָ֔ם שֶׁ֧בַע וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch 'mrm 't yvkhbd ddtv lv l'shh vtld lv 't 'hrn v't mshh vshny chyy 'mrm shb' vshlshym vm't shnh
verses.translation: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י יִצְהָ֑ר קֹ֥רַח וָ/נֶ֖פֶג וְ/זִכְרִֽי
verses.translit: vbny ytshr qrch vnpg vzkhry
verses.translation: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִֽישָׁאֵ֥ל וְ/אֶלְצָפָ֖ן וְ/סִתְרִֽי
verses.translit: vbny 'zy'l mysh'l v'ltspn vstry
verses.translation: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת אֱלִישֶׁ֧בַע בַּת עַמִּינָדָ֛ב אֲח֥וֹת נַחְשׁ֖וֹן ל֣/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד ל֗/וֹ אֶת נָדָב֙ וְ/אֶת אֲבִיה֔וּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְ/אֶת אִֽיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: vyqch 'hrn 't 'lyshb' bt 'myndb 'chvt nchshvn lv l'shh vtld lv 't ndb v't 'byhv' 't 'l'zr v't 'ytmr
verses.translation: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י קֹ֔רַח אַסִּ֥יר וְ/אֶלְקָנָ֖ה וַ/אֲבִיאָסָ֑ף אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַ/קָּרְחִֽי
verses.translit: vbny qrch 'syr v'lqnh v'by'sf 'lh mshpcht hqrchy
verses.translation: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֜ן לָקַֽח ל֨/וֹ מִ/בְּנ֤וֹת פּֽוּטִיאֵל֙ ל֣/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖/וֹ אֶת פִּֽינְחָ֑ס אֵ֗לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'l'zr bn 'hrn lqch lv mbnvt pvty'l lv l'shh vtld lv 't pynchs 'lh r'shy 'bvt hlvym lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

verses.original: ה֥וּא אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֜יאוּ אֶת בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל צִבְאֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hv' 'hrn vmshh 'shr 'mr yhvh lhm hvtsy'v 't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym 'l tsb'tm
verses.translation: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

verses.original: הֵ֗ם הַֽ/מְדַבְּרִים֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם ה֥וּא מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: hm hmdbrym 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym lhvtsy' 't bny yshr'l mmtsrym hv' mshh v'hrn
verses.translation: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/י֨וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy byvm dbr yhvh 'l mshh b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דַּבֵּ֗ר אֶל פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr 'ny yhvh dbr 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym 't khl 'shr 'ny dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ עֲרַ֣ל שְׂפָתַ֔יִם וְ/אֵ֕יךְ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵלַ֖/י פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lpny yhvh hn 'ny 'rl shptym v'ykh yshm' 'ly pr'h
verses.translation: And Moses said before the LORD , Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה רְאֵ֛ה נְתַתִּ֥י/ךָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/פַרְעֹ֑ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֖י/ךָ יִהְיֶ֥ה נְבִיאֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh r'h nttykh 'lhym lpr'h v'hrn 'chykh yhyh nby'kh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תְדַבֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֑/ךָּ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֨י/ךָ֙ יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'th tdbr 't khl 'shr 'tsvkh v'hrn 'chykh ydbr 'l pr'h vshlch 't bny yshr'l m'rtsv
verses.translation: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֥י אַקְשֶׁ֖ה אֶת לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֧י אֶת אֹתֹתַ֛/י וְ/אֶת מוֹפְתַ֖/י בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'ny 'qshh 't lb pr'h vhrbyty 't 'tty v't mvpty b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֲלֵ/כֶם֙ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת יָדִ֖/י בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֨י אֶת צִבְאֹתַ֜/י אֶת עַמִּ֤/י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בִּ/שְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים
verses.translit: vl' yshm' 'lkhm pr'h vntty 't ydy bmtsrym vhvts'ty 't tsb'ty 't 'my bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym bshptym gdlym
verses.translation: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֤וּ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/נְטֹתִ֥/י אֶת יָדִ֖/י עַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֥י אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/תּוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyd'v mtsrym khy 'ny yhvh bntty 't ydy 'l mtsrym vhvts'ty 't bny yshr'l mtvkhm
verses.translation: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹתָ֖/ם כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh v'hrn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tm khn 'shv
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁה֙ בֶּן שְׁמֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/אַֽהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן שָׁלֹ֥שׁ וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/דַבְּרָ֖/ם אֶל פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vmshh bn shmnym shnh v'hrn bn shlsh vshmnym shnh bdbrm 'l pr'h
verses.translation: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵ/כֶ֤ם פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר תְּנ֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם מוֹפֵ֑ת וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֧ח אֶֽת מַטְּ/ךָ֛ וְ/הַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ לִ/פְנֵֽי פַרְעֹ֖ה יְהִ֥י לְ/תַנִּֽין
verses.translit: khy ydbr 'lkhm pr'h l'mr tnv lkhm mvpt v'mrt 'l 'hrn qch 't mtkh vhshlkh lpny pr'h yhy ltnyn
verses.translation: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂוּ כֵ֔ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת מַטֵּ֗/הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֛ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יְהִ֥י לְ/תַנִּֽין
verses.translit: vyb' mshh v'hrn 'l pr'h vy'shv khn kh'shr tsvh yhvh vyshlkh 'hrn 't mthv lpny pr'h vlpny 'bdyv vyhy ltnyn
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ גַּם פַּרְעֹ֔ה לַֽ/חֲכָמִ֖ים וְ/לַֽ/מְכַשְּׁפִ֑ים וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֨וּ גַם הֵ֜ם חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּ/לַהֲטֵי/הֶ֖ם כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyqr' gm pr'h lchkhmym vlmkhshpym vy'shv gm hm chrtmy mtsrym blhtyhm khn
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֨יכוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מַטֵּ֔/הוּ וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ לְ/תַנִּינִ֑ם וַ/יִּבְלַ֥ע מַטֵּֽה אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶת מַטֹּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshlykhv 'ysh mthv vyhyv ltnynm vybl' mth 'hrn 't mttm
verses.translation: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱזַק֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vychzq lb pr'h vl' shm' 'lhm kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כָּבֵ֖ד לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה מֵאֵ֖ן לְ/שַׁלַּ֥ח הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh khbd lb pr'h m'n lshlch h'm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֞ה בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר הִנֵּה֙ יֹצֵ֣א הַ/מַּ֔יְמָ/ה וְ/נִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ/קְרָאת֖/וֹ עַל שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְאֹ֑ר וְ/הַ/מַּטֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְ/נָחָ֖שׁ תִּקַּ֥ח בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lkh 'l pr'h bbqr hnh yts' hmymh vntsbt lqr'tv 'l shpt hy'r vhmth 'shr nhpkh lnchsh tqch bydkh
verses.translation: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗י/ו יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָ/עִבְרִים֙ שְׁלָחַ֤/נִי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י וְ/יַֽעַבְדֻ֖/נִי בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה לֹא שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַד כֹּֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyv yhvh 'lhy h'brym shlchny 'lykh l'mr shlch 't 'my vy'bdny bmdbr vhnh l' shm't 'd khh
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/זֹ֣את תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַכֶּ֣ה בַּ/מַּטֶּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר בְּ/יָדִ֗/י עַל הַ/מַּ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/יְאֹ֖ר וְ/נֶהֶפְכ֥וּ לְ/דָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh bz't td' khy 'ny yhvh hnh 'nkhy mkhh bmth 'shr bydy 'l hmym 'shr by'r vnhpkhv ldm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD : behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/דָּגָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר בַּ/יְאֹ֛ר תָּמ֖וּת וּ/בָאַ֣שׁ הַ/יְאֹ֑ר וְ/נִלְא֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִ/שְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם מִן הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vhdgh 'shr by'r tmvt vb'sh hy'r vnl'v mtsrym lshtvt mym mn hy'r
verses.translation: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֡ן קַ֣ח מַטְּ/ךָ֣ וּ/נְטֵֽה יָדְ/ךָ֩ עַל מֵימֵ֨י מִצְרַ֜יִם עַֽל נַהֲרֹתָ֣/ם עַל יְאֹרֵי/הֶ֣ם וְ/עַל אַגְמֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/עַ֛ל כָּל מִקְוֵ֥ה מֵימֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/יִֽהְיוּ דָ֑ם וְ/הָ֤יָה דָם֙ בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/בָ/עֵצִ֖ים וּ/בָ/אֲבָנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'mr 'l 'hrn qch mtkh vnth ydkh 'l mymy mtsrym 'l nhrtm 'l y'ryhm v'l 'gmyhm v'l khl mqvh mymyhm vyhyv dm vhyh dm bkhl 'rts mtsrym vb'tsym vb'bnym
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֜ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יָּ֤רֶם בַּ/מַּטֶּה֙ וַ/יַּ֤ךְ אֶת הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/יְאֹ֔ר לְ/עֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּ/לְ/עֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּהָֽפְכ֛וּ כָּל הַ/מַּ֥יִם אֲשֶׁר בַּ/יְאֹ֖ר לְ/דָֽם
verses.translit: vy'shv khn mshh v'hrn kh'shr tsvh yhvh vyrm bmth vykh 't hmym 'shr by'r l'yny pr'h vl'yny 'bdyv vyhpkhv khl hmym 'shr by'r ldm
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/דָּגָ֨ה אֲשֶׁר בַּ/יְאֹ֥ר מֵ֨תָה֙ וַ/יִּבְאַ֣שׁ הַ/יְאֹ֔ר וְ/לֹא יָכְל֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִ/שְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם מִן הַ/יְאֹ֑ר וַ/יְהִ֥י הַ/דָּ֖ם בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhdgh 'shr by'r mth vyb'sh hy'r vl' ykhlv mtsrym lshtvt mym mn hy'r vyhy hdm bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵ֛ן חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּ/לָטֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֤ק לֵב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'shv khn chrtmy mtsrym bltyhm vychzq lb pr'h vl' shm' 'lhm kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣פֶן פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וְ/לֹא שָׁ֥ת לִבּ֖/וֹ גַּם לָ/זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vypn pr'h vyb' 'l bytv vl' sht lbv gm lz't
verses.translation: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְפְּר֧וּ כָל מִצְרַ֛יִם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הַ/יְאֹ֖ר מַ֣יִם לִ/שְׁתּ֑וֹת כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לִ/שְׁתֹּ֔ת מִ/מֵּימֵ֖י הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vychprv khl mtsrym sbybt hy'r mym lshtvt khy l' ykhlv lshtt mmymy hy'r
verses.translation: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים אַחֲרֵ֥י הַכּוֹת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הַ/יְאֹֽר
verses.translit: vyml' shb't ymym 'chry hkhvt yhvh 't hy'r
verses.translation: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן נְטֵ֤ה אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/מַטֶּ֔/ךָ עַל הַ֨/נְּהָרֹ֔ת עַל הַ/יְאֹרִ֖ים וְ/עַל הָ/אֲגַמִּ֑ים וְ/הַ֥עַל אֶת הַֽ/צְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'mr 'l 'hrn nth 't ydkh bmtkh 'l hnhrt 'l hy'rym v'l h'gmym vh'l 't htsprd'ym 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤ט אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ עַ֖ל מֵימֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/תַּ֨עַל֙ הַ/צְּפַרְדֵּ֔עַ וַ/תְּכַ֖ס אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyt 'hrn 't ydv 'l mymy mtsrym vt'l htsprd' vtkhs 't 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵ֥ן הַֽ/חֲרְטֻמִּ֖ים בְּ/לָטֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ אֶת הַֽ/צְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'shv khn hchrtmym bltyhm vy'lv 't htsprd'ym 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֜ה לְ/מֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽ/לְ/אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַעְתִּ֣ירוּ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יָסֵר֙ הַֽ/צְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמֶּ֖/נִּי וּ/מֵֽ/עַמִּ֑/י וַ/אֲשַׁלְּחָה֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/יִזְבְּח֖וּ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h lmshh vl'hrn vy'mr h'tyrv 'l yhvh vysr htsprd'ym mmny vm'my v'shlchh 't h'm vyzbchv lyhvh
verses.translation: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה לְ/פַרְעֹה֮ הִתְפָּאֵ֣ר עָלַ/י֒ לְ/מָתַ֣י אַעְתִּ֣יר לְ/ךָ֗ וְ/לַ/עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּֽ/לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/הַכְרִית֙ הַֽ/צֲפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמְּ/ךָ֖ וּ/מִ/בָּתֶּ֑י/ךָ רַ֥ק בַּ/יְאֹ֖ר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lpr'h htp'r 'ly lmty ''tyr lkh vl'bdykh vl'mkh lhkhryt htsprd'ym mmkh vmbtykh rq by'r tsh'rnh
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לְ/מָחָ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כִּ/דְבָ֣רְ/ךָ֔ לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּי אֵ֖ין כַּ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lmchr vy'mr khdbrkh lm'n td' khy 'yn khyhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

verses.translit: vsrv htsprd'ym mmkh vmbtykh vm'bdykh vm'mkh rq by'r tsh'rnh
verses.translation: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵ/עִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יִּצְעַ֤ק מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה עַל דְּבַ֥ר הַֽ/צְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֥ם לְ/פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vyts' mshh v'hrn m'm pr'h vyts'q mshh 'l yhvh 'l dbr htsprd'ym 'shr shm lpr'h
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD , that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה כִּ/דְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יָּמֻ֨תוּ֙ הַֽ/צְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִן הַ/בָּתִּ֥ים מִן הַ/חֲצֵרֹ֖ת וּ/מִן הַ/שָּׂדֹֽת
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh khdbr mshh vymtv htsprd'ym mn hbtym mn hchtsrt vmn hshdt
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְבְּר֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם חֳמָרִ֣ם חֳמָרִ֑ם וַ/תִּבְאַ֖שׁ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vytsbrv 'tm chmrm chmrm vtb'sh h'rts
verses.translation: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא פַּרְעֹ֗ה כִּ֤י הָֽיְתָה֙ הָֽ/רְוָחָ֔ה וְ/הַכְבֵּד֙ אֶת לִבּ֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyr' pr'h khy hyth hrvchh vhkhbd 't lbv vl' shm' 'lhm kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ אֱמֹר֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן נְטֵ֣ה אֶֽת מַטְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/הַ֖ךְ אֶת עֲפַ֣ר הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/כִנִּ֖ם בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'mr 'l 'hrn nth 't mtkh vhkh 't 'pr h'rts vhyh lkhnm bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵ֗ן וַ/יֵּט֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת יָד֤/וֹ בְ/מַטֵּ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת עֲפַ֣ר הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/תְּהִי֙ הַ/כִּנָּ֔ם בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה כָּל עֲפַ֥ר הָ/אָ֛רֶץ הָיָ֥ה כִנִּ֖ים בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'shv khn vyt 'hrn 't ydv bmthv vykh 't 'pr h'rts vthy hkhnm b'dm vbbhmh khl 'pr h'rts hyh khnym bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂוּ כֵ֨ן הַ/חַרְטֻמִּ֧ים בְּ/לָטֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא אֶת הַ/כִּנִּ֖ים וְ/לֹ֣א יָכֹ֑לוּ וַ/תְּהִי֙ הַ/כִּנָּ֔ם בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'shv khn hchrtmym bltyhm lhvtsy' 't hkhnym vl' ykhlv vthy hkhnm b'dm vbbhmh
verses.translation: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ הַֽ/חַרְטֻמִּים֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִ֑וא וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֤ק לֵב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv hchrtmym 'l pr'h 'tsb' 'lhym hv' vychzq lb pr'h vl' shm' 'lhm kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם בַּ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ וְ/הִתְיַצֵּב֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה יוֹצֵ֣א הַ/מָּ֑יְמָ/ה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖/י וְ/יַֽעַבְדֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hshkhm bbqr vhtytsb lpny pr'h hnh yvts' hmymh v'mrt 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh shlch 'my vy'bdny
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם אֵינְ/ךָ֮ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ אֶת עַמִּ/י֒ הִנְ/נִי֩ מַשְׁלִ֨יחַ בְּ/ךָ֜ וּ/בַ/עֲבָדֶ֧י/ךָ וּֽ/בְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֛ וּ/בְ/בָתֶּ֖י/ךָ אֶת הֶ/עָרֹ֑ב וּ/מָ֨לְא֜וּ בָּתֵּ֤י מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶת הֶ֣/עָרֹ֔ב וְ/גַ֥ם הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥ם עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy 'm 'ynkh mshlch 't 'my hnny mshlych bkh vb'bdykh vb'mkh vbbtykh 't h'rb vml'v bty mtsrym 't h'rb vgm h'dmh 'shr hm 'lyh
verses.translation: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הִפְלֵיתִי֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַמִּ/י֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔י/הָ לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י הֱיֽוֹת שָׁ֖ם עָרֹ֑ב לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhplyty byvm hhv' 't 'rts gshn 'shr 'my 'md 'lyh lblty hyvt shm 'rb lm'n td' khy 'ny yhvh bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י פְדֻ֔ת בֵּ֥ין עַמִּ֖/י וּ/בֵ֣ין עַמֶּ֑/ךָ לְ/מָחָ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה הָ/אֹ֥ת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vshmty pdt byn 'my vbyn 'mkh lmchr yhyh h't hzh
verses.translation: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ כֵּ֔ן וַ/יָּבֹא֙ עָרֹ֣ב כָּבֵ֔ד בֵּ֥יתָ/ה פַרְעֹ֖ה וּ/בֵ֣ית עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וּ/בְ/כָל אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם תִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י הֶ/עָרֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh khn vyb' 'rb khbd byth pr'h vbyt 'bdyv vbkhl 'rts mtsrym tshcht h'rts mpny h'rb
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וּֽ/לְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לְכ֛וּ זִבְח֥וּ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h 'l mshh vl'hrn vy'mr lkhv zbchv l'lhykhm b'rts
verses.translation: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground whereon they are .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לֹ֤א נָכוֹן֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן כִּ֚י תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם נִזְבַּ֖ח לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ הֵ֣ן נִזְבַּ֞ח אֶת תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א יִסְקְלֻֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh l' nkhvn l'shvt khn khy tv'bt mtsrym nzbch lyhvh 'lhynv hn nzbch 't tv'bt mtsrym l'ynyhm vl' ysqlnv
verses.translation: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.

verses.original: דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים נֵלֵ֖ךְ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/זָבַ֨חְנוּ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר יֹאמַ֥ר אֵלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: drkh shlsht ymym nlkh bmdbr vzbchnv lyhvh 'lhynv kh'shr y'mr 'lynv
verses.translation: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֗ה אָנֹכִ֞י אֲשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶתְ/כֶם֙ וּ/זְבַחְתֶּ֞ם לַ/יהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר רַ֛ק הַרְחֵ֥ק לֹא תַרְחִ֖יקוּ לָ/לֶ֑כֶת הַעְתִּ֖ירוּ בַּעֲדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'nkhy 'shlch 'tkhm vzbchtm lyhvh 'lhykhm bmdbr rq hrchq l' trchyqv llkht h'tyrv b'dy
verses.translation: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י יוֹצֵ֤א מֵֽ/עִמָּ/ךְ֙ וְ/הַעְתַּרְתִּ֣י אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/סָ֣ר הֶ/עָרֹ֗ב מִ/פַּרְעֹ֛ה מֵ/עֲבָדָ֥י/ו וּ/מֵ/עַמּ֖/וֹ מָחָ֑ר רַ֗ק אַל יֹסֵ֤ף פַּרְעֹה֙ הָתֵ֔ל לְ/בִלְתִּי֙ שַׁלַּ֣ח אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם לִ/זְבֹּ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh hnh 'nkhy yvts' m'mkh vh'trty 'l yhvh vsr h'rb mpr'h m'bdyv vm'mv mchr rq 'l ysf pr'h htl lblty shlch 't h'm lzbch lyhvh
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א מֹשֶׁ֖ה מֵ/עִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יֶּעְתַּ֖ר אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' mshh m'm pr'h vy'tr 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יָּ֨סַר֙ הֶ/עָרֹ֔ב מִ/פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֵ/עֲבָדָ֣י/ו וּ/מֵ/עַמּ֑/וֹ לֹ֥א נִשְׁאַ֖ר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh khdbr mshh vysr h'rb mpr'h m'bdyv vm'mv l' nsh'r 'chd
verses.translation: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכְבֵּ֤ד פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת לִבּ֔/וֹ גַּ֖ם בַּ/פַּ֣עַם הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/לֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vykhbd pr'h 't lbv gm bp'm hz't vl' shlch 't h'm
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.

And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD .
And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD .
And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֹּ֖א אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽ/עִבְרִ֔ים שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת עַמִּ֖/י וְ/יַֽעַבְדֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh b' 'l pr'h vdbrt 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy h'brym shlch 't 'my vy'bdny
verses.translation: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לְ/שַׁלֵּ֑חַ וְ/עוֹדְ/ךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֥יק בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy 'm m'n 'th lshlch v'vdkh mchzyq bm
verses.translation: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יַד יְהוָ֜ה הוֹיָ֗ה בְּ/מִקְנְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּ/סּוּסִ֤ים בַּֽ/חֲמֹרִים֙ בַּ/גְּמַלִּ֔ים בַּ/בָּקָ֖ר וּ/בַ/צֹּ֑אן דֶּ֖בֶר כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: hnh yd yhvh hvyh bmqnkh 'shr bshdh bsvsym bchmrym bgmlym bbqr vbts'n dbr khbd m'd
verses.translation: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

verses.original: וְ/הִפְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין מִקְנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/בֵ֖ין מִקְנֵ֣ה מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת מִ/כָּל לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vhplh yhvh byn mqnh yshr'l vbyn mqnh mtsrym vl' ymvt mkhl lbny yshr'l dbr
verses.translation: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children’s of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם יְהוָ֖ה מוֹעֵ֣ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyshm yhvh mv'd l'mr mchr y'shh yhvh hdbr hzh b'rts
verses.translation: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יָּ֕מָת כֹּ֖ל מִקְנֵ֣ה מִצְרָ֑יִם וּ/מִ/מִּקְנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא מֵ֥ת אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh 't hdbr hzh mmchrt vymt khl mqnh mtsrym vmmqnh bny yshr'l l' mt 'chd
verses.translation: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה לֹא מֵ֛ת מִ/מִּקְנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יִּכְבַּד֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch pr'h vhnh l' mt mmqnh yshr'l 'd 'chd vykhbd lb pr'h vl' shlch 't h'm
verses.translation: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֒ קְח֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ מְלֹ֣א חָפְנֵי/כֶ֔ם פִּ֖יחַ כִּבְשָׁ֑ן וּ/זְרָק֥/וֹ מֹשֶׁ֛ה הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יְמָ/ה לְ/עֵינֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn qchv lkhm ml' chpnykhm pych khbshn vzrqv mshh hshmymh l'yny pr'h
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה לְ/אָבָ֔ק עַ֖ל כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הָיָ֨ה עַל הָ/אָדָ֜ם וְ/עַל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֗ה לִ/שְׁחִ֥ין פֹּרֵ֛חַ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹ֖ת בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh l'bq 'l khl 'rts mtsrym vhyh 'l h'dm v'l hbhmh lshchyn prch 'b'b't bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ אֶת פִּ֣יחַ הַ/כִּבְשָׁ֗ן וַ/יַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יִּזְרֹ֥ק אֹת֛/וֹ מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יְמָ/ה וַ/יְהִ֗י שְׁחִין֙ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹ֔ת פֹּרֵ֕חַ בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vyqchv 't pych hkhbshn vy'mdv lpny pr'h vyzrq 'tv mshh hshmymh vyhy shchyn 'b'b't prch b'dm vbbhmh
verses.translation: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יָכְל֣וּ הַֽ/חַרְטֻמִּ֗ים לַ/עֲמֹ֛ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁחִ֑ין כִּֽי הָיָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁחִ֔ין בַּֽ/חֲרְטֻמִּ֖ם וּ/בְ/כָל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv hchrtmym l'md lpny mshh mpny hshchyn khy hyh hshchyn bchrtmm vbkhl mtsrym
verses.translation: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֤ק יְהוָה֙ אֶת לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vychzq yhvh 't lb pr'h vl' shm' 'lhm kh'shr dbr yhvh 'l mshh
verses.translation: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִתְיַצֵּ֖ב לִ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽ/עִבְרִ֔ים שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת עַמִּ֖/י וְ/יַֽעַבְדֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hshkhm bbqr vhtytsb lpny pr'h v'mrt 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy h'brym shlch 't 'my vy'bdny
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בַּ/פַּ֣עַם הַ/זֹּ֗את אֲנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ אֶת כָּל מַגֵּפֹתַ/י֙ אֶֽל לִבְּ/ךָ֔ וּ/בַ/עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/בְ/עַמֶּ֑/ךָ בַּ/עֲב֣וּר תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין כָּמֹ֖/נִי בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy bp'm hz't 'ny shlch 't khl mgpty 'l lbkh vb'bdykh vb'mkh b'bvr td' khy 'yn khmny bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֶת יָדִ֔/י וָ/אַ֥ךְ אוֹתְ/ךָ֛ וְ/אֶֽת עַמְּ/ךָ֖ בַּ/דָּ֑בֶר וַ/תִּכָּחֵ֖ד מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy 'th shlchty 't ydy v'kh 'vtkh v't 'mkh bdbr vtkhchd mn h'rts
verses.translation: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

verses.original: וְ/אוּלָ֗ם בַּ/עֲב֥וּר זֹאת֙ הֶעֱמַדְתִּ֔י/ךָ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר הַרְאֹתְ/ךָ֣ אֶת כֹּחִ֑/י וּ/לְמַ֛עַן סַפֵּ֥ר שְׁמִ֖/י בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'vlm b'bvr z't h'mdtykh b'bvr hr'tkh 't khchy vlm'n spr shmy bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

verses.original: עוֹדְ/ךָ֖ מִסְתּוֹלֵ֣ל בְּ/עַמִּ֑/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י שַׁלְּחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'vdkh mstvll b'my lblty shlchm
verses.translation: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֤י מַמְטִיר֙ כָּ/עֵ֣ת מָחָ֔ר בָּרָ֖ד כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא הָיָ֤ה כָמֹ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/מִן הַ/יּ֥וֹם הִוָּסְדָ֖/ה וְ/עַד עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: hnny mmtyr kh't mchr brd khbd m'd 'shr l' hyh khmhv bmtsrym lmn hyvm hvsdh v'd 'th
verses.translation: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שְׁלַ֤ח הָעֵז֙ אֶֽת מִקְנְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/ךָ֖ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה כָּל הָ/אָדָ֨ם וְ/הַ/בְּהֵמָ֜ה אֲשֶֽׁר יִמָּצֵ֣א בַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְ/לֹ֤א יֵֽאָסֵף֙ הַ/בַּ֔יְתָ/ה וְ/יָרַ֧ד עֲלֵ/הֶ֛ם הַ/בָּרָ֖ד וָ/מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: v'th shlch h'z 't mqnkh v't khl 'shr lkh bshdh khl h'dm vhbhmh 'shr ymts' bshdh vl' y'sf hbyth vyrd 'lhm hbrd vmtv
verses.translation: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

verses.original: הַ/יָּרֵא֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מֵֽ/עַבְדֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֑ה הֵנִ֛יס אֶת עֲבָדָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת מִקְנֵ֖/הוּ אֶל הַ/בָּתִּֽים
verses.translit: hyr' 't dbr yhvh m'bdy pr'h hnys 't 'bdyv v't mqnhv 'l hbtym
verses.translation: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא שָׂ֛ם לִבּ֖/וֹ אֶל דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת עֲבָדָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת מִקְנֵ֖/הוּ בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: v'shr l' shm lbv 'l dbr yhvh vy'zb 't 'bdyv v't mqnhv bshdh
verses.translation: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵ֤ה אֶת יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ עַל הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וִ/יהִ֥י בָרָ֖ד בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל הָ/אָדָ֣ם וְ/עַל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ/עַ֛ל כָּל עֵ֥שֶׂב הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh nth 't ydkh 'l hshmym vyhy brd bkhl 'rts mtsrym 'l h'dm v'l hbhmh v'l khl 'shb hshdh b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת מַטֵּ/הוּ֮ עַל הַ/שָּׁמַיִם֒ וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קֹלֹת֙ וּ/בָרָ֔ד וַ/תִּ֥הֲלַךְ אֵ֖שׁ אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/יַּמְטֵ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בָּרָ֖ד עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyt mshh 't mthv 'l hshmym vyhvh ntn qlt vbrd vthlkh 'sh 'rtsh vymtr yhvh brd 'l 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בָרָ֔ד וְ/אֵ֕שׁ מִתְלַקַּ֖חַת בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/בָּרָ֑ד כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא הָיָ֤ה כָמֹ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ/אָ֖ז הָיְתָ֥ה לְ/גֽוֹי
verses.translit: vyhy brd v'sh mtlqcht btvkh hbrd khbd m'd 'shr l' hyh khmhv bkhl 'rts mtsrym m'z hyth lgvy
verses.translation: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨ךְ הַ/בָּרָ֜ד בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם אֵ֚ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵ/אָדָ֖ם וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל עֵ֤שֶׂב הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ הִכָּ֣ה הַ/בָּרָ֔ד וְ/אֶת כָּל עֵ֥ץ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה שִׁבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vykh hbrd bkhl 'rts mtsrym 't khl 'shr bshdh m'dm v'd bhmh v't khl 'shb hshdh hkhh hbrd v't khl 'ts hshdh shbr
verses.translation: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

verses.original: רַ֚ק בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֥א הָיָ֖ה בָּרָֽד
verses.translit: rq b'rts gshn 'shr shm bny yshr'l l' hyh brd
verses.translation: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were , was there no hail.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח פַּרְעֹ֗ה וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ לְ/מֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽ/לְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם חָטָ֣אתִי הַ/פָּ֑עַם יְהוָה֙ הַ/צַּדִּ֔יק וַ/אֲנִ֥י וְ/עַמִּ֖/י הָ/רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch pr'h vyqr' lmshh vl'hrn vy'mr 'lhm cht'ty hp'm yhvh htsdyq v'ny v'my hrsh'ym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

verses.original: הַעְתִּ֨ירוּ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/רַ֕ב מִֽ/הְיֹ֛ת קֹלֹ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּ/בָרָ֑ד וַ/אֲשַׁלְּחָ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א תֹסִפ֖וּ/ן לַ/עֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: h'tyrv 'l yhvh vrb mhyt qlt 'lhym vbrd v'shlchh 'tkhm vl' tspvn l'md
verses.translation: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּ/צֵאתִ/י֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר אֶפְרֹ֥שׂ אֶת כַּפַּ֖/י אֶל יְהוָ֑ה הַ/קֹּל֣וֹת יֶחְדָּל֗וּ/ן וְ/הַ/בָּרָד֙ לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה ע֔וֹד לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֥י לַ/יהוָ֖ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv mshh khts'ty 't h'yr 'prsh 't khpy 'l yhvh hqlvt ychdlvn vhbrd l' yhyh 'vd lm'n td' khy lyhvh h'rts
verses.translation: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD ; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD’s .

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֖ה וַ/עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּ֚י טֶ֣רֶם תִּֽירְא֔וּ/ן מִ/פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'th v'bdykh yd'ty khy trm tyr'vn mpny yhvh 'lhym
verses.translation: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.

verses.translit: vhpshth vhsh'rh nkhth khy hsh'rh 'byb vhpshth gb'l
verses.translation: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חִטָּ֥ה וְ/הַ/כֻּסֶּ֖מֶת לֹ֣א נֻכּ֑וּ כִּ֥י אֲפִילֹ֖ת הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vhchth vhkhsmt l' nkhv khy 'pylt hnh
verses.translation: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵ/עִ֤ם פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖י/ו אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחְדְּל֤וּ הַ/קֹּלוֹת֙ וְ/הַ/בָּרָ֔ד וּ/מָטָ֖ר לֹא נִתַּ֥ךְ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' mshh m'm pr'h 't h'yr vyprsh khpyv 'l yhvh vychdlv hqlvt vhbrd vmtr l' ntkh 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD : and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא פַּרְעֹ֗ה כִּֽי חָדַ֨ל הַ/מָּטָ֧ר וְ/הַ/בָּרָ֛ד וְ/הַ/קֹּלֹ֖ת וַ/יֹּ֣סֶף לַ/חֲטֹ֑א וַ/יַּכְבֵּ֥ד לִבּ֖/וֹ ה֥וּא וַ/עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' pr'h khy chdl hmtr vhbrd vhqlt vysf lcht' vykhbd lbv hv' v'bdyv
verses.translation: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

verses.original: וַֽ/יֶּחֱזַק֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vychzq lb pr'h vl' shlch 't bny yshr'l kh'shr dbr yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֹּ֖א אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה כִּֽי אֲנִ֞י הִכְבַּ֤דְתִּי אֶת לִבּ/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת לֵ֣ב עֲבָדָ֔י/ו לְמַ֗עַן שִׁתִ֛/י אֹתֹתַ֥/י אֵ֖לֶּה בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh b' 'l pr'h khy 'ny hkhbdty 't lbv v't lb 'bdyv lm'n shty 'tty 'lh bqrbv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

verses.original: וּ/לְמַ֡עַן תְּסַפֵּר֩ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֨י בִנְ/ךָ֜ וּ/בֶן בִּנְ/ךָ֗ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִתְעַלַּ֨לְתִּי֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/אֶת אֹתֹתַ֖/י אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֣מְתִּי בָ֑/ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlm'n tspr b'zny bnkh vbn bnkh 't 'shr ht'llty bmtsrym v't 'tty 'shr shmty bm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son’s son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אַהֲרֹן֮ אֶל פַּרְעֹה֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽ/עִבְרִ֔ים עַד מָתַ֣י מֵאַ֔נְתָּ לֵ/עָנֹ֖ת מִ/פָּנָ֑/י שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖/י וְ/יַֽעַבְדֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyb' mshh v'hrn 'l pr'h vy'mrv 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy h'brym 'd mty m'nt l'nt mpny shlch 'my vy'bdny
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לְ/שַׁלֵּ֣חַ אֶת עַמִּ֑/י הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא מָחָ֛ר אַרְבֶּ֖ה בִּ/גְבֻלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'm m'n 'th lshlch 't 'my hnny mby' mchr 'rbh bgblkh
verses.translation: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

verses.original: וְ/כִסָּה֙ אֶת עֵ֣ין הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִ/רְאֹ֣ת אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אָכַ֣ל אֶת יֶ֣תֶר הַ/פְּלֵטָ֗ה הַ/נִּשְׁאֶ֤רֶת לָ/כֶם֙ מִן הַ/בָּרָ֔ד וְ/אָכַל֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/עֵ֔ץ הַ/צֹּמֵ֥חַ לָ/כֶ֖ם מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhsh 't 'yn h'rts vl' yvkhl lr't 't h'rts v'khl 't ytr hplth hnsh'rt lkhm mn hbrd v'khl 't khl h'ts htsmch lkhm mn hshdh
verses.translation: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

verses.original: וּ/מָלְא֨וּ בָתֶּ֜י/ךָ וּ/בָתֵּ֣י כָל עֲבָדֶי/ךָ֮ וּ/בָתֵּ֣י כָל מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא רָא֤וּ אֲבֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וַ/אֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ מִ/יּ֗וֹם הֱיוֹתָ/ם֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יִּ֥פֶן וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א מֵ/עִ֥ם פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vml'v btykh vbty khl 'bdykh vbty khl mtsrym 'shr l' r'v 'btykh v'bvt 'btykh myvm hyvtm 'l h'dmh 'd hyvm hzh vypn vyts' m'm pr'h
verses.translation: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י פַרְעֹ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו עַד מָתַי֙ יִהְיֶ֨ה זֶ֥ה לָ֨/נוּ֙ לְ/מוֹקֵ֔שׁ שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְ/יַֽעַבְד֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם הֲ/טֶ֣רֶם תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֥י אָבְדָ֖ה מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdy pr'h 'lyv 'd mty yhyh zh lnv lmvqsh shlch 't h'nshym vy'bdv 't yhvh 'lhyhm htrm td' khy 'bdh mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh’s servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

verses.original: וַ/יּוּשַׁ֞ב אֶת מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם לְכ֥וּ עִבְד֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם מִ֥י וָ/מִ֖י הַ/הֹלְכִֽים
verses.translit: vyvshb 't mshh v't 'hrn 'l pr'h vy'mr 'lhm lkhv 'bdv 't yhvh 'lhykhm my vmy hhlkhym
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: but who are they that shall go?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה בִּ/נְעָרֵ֥י/נוּ וּ/בִ/זְקֵנֵ֖י/נוּ נֵלֵ֑ךְ בְּ/בָנֵ֨י/נוּ וּ/בִ/בְנוֹתֵ֜/נוּ בְּ/צֹאנֵ֤/נוּ וּ/בִ/בְקָרֵ֨/נוּ֙ נֵלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֥י חַג יְהוָ֖ה לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh bn'rynv vbzqnynv nlkh bbnynv vbbnvtnv bts'nnv vbbqrnv nlkh khy chg yhvh lnv
verses.translation: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם יְהִ֨י כֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֶֽת טַפְּ/כֶ֑ם רְא֕וּ כִּ֥י רָעָ֖ה נֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm yhy khn yhvh 'mkhm kh'shr 'shlch 'tkhm v't tpkhm r'v khy r'h ngd pnykhm
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

verses.original: לֹ֣א כֵ֗ן לְכֽוּ נָ֤א הַ/גְּבָרִים֙ וְ/עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֹתָ֖/הּ אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֑ים וַ/יְגָ֣רֶשׁ אֹתָ֔/ם מֵ/אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: l' khn lkhv n' hgbrym v'bdv 't yhvh khy 'th 'tm mbqshym vygrsh 'tm m't pny pr'h
verses.translation: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD ; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה נְטֵ֨ה יָדְ/ךָ֜ עַל אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בָּֽ/אַרְבֶּ֔ה וְ/יַ֖עַל עַל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/יֹאכַל֙ אֶת כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁאִ֖יר הַ/בָּרָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh nth ydkh 'l 'rts mtsrym b'rbh vy'l 'l 'rts mtsrym vy'khl 't khl 'shb h'rts 't khl 'shr hsh'yr hbrd
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת מַטֵּ/הוּ֮ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה נִהַ֤ג ר֥וּחַ קָדִים֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ כָּל הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וְ/כָל הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה הַ/בֹּ֣קֶר הָיָ֔ה וְ/ר֨וּחַ֙ הַ/קָּדִ֔ים נָשָׂ֖א אֶת הָ/אַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyt mshh 't mthv 'l 'rts mtsrym vyhvh nhg rvch qdym b'rts khl hyvm hhv' vkhl hlylh hbqr hyh vrvch hqdym nsh' 't h'rbh
verses.translation: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל הָֽ/אַרְבֶּ֗ה עַ֚ל כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יָּ֕נַח בְּ/כֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל מִצְרָ֑יִם כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד לְ֠/פָנָי/ו לֹא הָ֨יָה כֵ֤ן אַרְבֶּה֙ כָּמֹ֔/הוּ וְ/אַחֲרָ֖י/ו לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'l h'rbh 'l khl 'rts mtsrym vynch bkhl gbvl mtsrym khbd m'd lpnyv l' hyh khn 'rbh khmhv v'chryv l' yhyh khn
verses.translation: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֞ס אֶת עֵ֣ין כָּל הָ/אָרֶץ֮ וַ/תֶּחְשַׁ֣ךְ הָ/אָרֶץ֒ וַ/יֹּ֜אכַל אֶת כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל פְּרִ֣י הָ/עֵ֔ץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹתִ֖יר הַ/בָּרָ֑ד וְ/לֹא נוֹתַ֨ר כָּל יֶ֧רֶק בָּ/עֵ֛ץ וּ/בְ/עֵ֥שֶׂב הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vykhs 't 'yn khl h'rts vtchshkh h'rts vy'khl 't khl 'shb h'rts v't khl pry h'ts 'shr hvtyr hbrd vl' nvtr khl yrq b'ts vb'shb hshdh bkhl 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֣ר פַּרְעֹ֔ה לִ/קְרֹ֖א לְ/מֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽ/לְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר חָטָ֛אתִי לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vymhr pr'h lqr' lmshh vl'hrn vy'mr cht'ty lyhvh 'lhykhm vlkhm
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שָׂ֣א נָ֤א חַטָּאתִ/י֙ אַ֣ךְ הַ/פַּ֔עַם וְ/הַעְתִּ֖ירוּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/יָסֵר֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י רַ֖ק אֶת הַ/מָּ֥וֶת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'th sh' n' cht'ty 'kh hp'm vh'tyrv lyhvh 'lhykhm vysr m'ly rq 't hmvt hzh
verses.translation: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א מֵ/עִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יֶּעְתַּ֖ר אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' m'm pr'h vy'tr 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּהֲפֹ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה רֽוּחַ יָם֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד וַ/יִּשָּׂא֙ אֶת הָ֣/אַרְבֶּ֔ה וַ/יִּתְקָעֵ֖/הוּ יָ֣מָּ/ה סּ֑וּף לֹ֤א נִשְׁאַר֙ אַרְבֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד בְּ/כֹ֖ל גְּב֥וּל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhpkh yhvh rvch ym chzq m'd vysh' 't h'rbh vytq'hv ymh svf l' nsh'r 'rbh 'chd bkhl gbvl mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה אֶת לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vychzq yhvh 't lb pr'h vl' shlch 't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה נְטֵ֤ה יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ עַל הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וִ֥/יהִי חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/יָמֵ֖שׁ חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh nth ydkh 'l hshmym vyhy chshkh 'l 'rts mtsrym vymsh chshkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥ט מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת יָד֖/וֹ עַל הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/יְהִ֧י חֹֽשֶׁךְ אֲפֵלָ֛ה בְּ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyt mshh 't ydv 'l hshmym vyhy chshkh 'plh bkhl 'rts mtsrym shlsht ymym
verses.translation: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

verses.original: לֹֽא רָא֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אָחִ֗י/ו וְ/לֹא קָ֛מוּ אִ֥ישׁ מִ/תַּחְתָּ֖י/ו שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וּֽ/לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָ֥יָה א֖וֹר בְּ/מוֹשְׁבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: l' r'v 'ysh 't 'chyv vl' qmv 'ysh mtchtyv shlsht ymym vlkhl bny yshr'l hyh 'vr bmvshbtm
verses.translation: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְכוּ֙ עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה רַ֛ק צֹאנְ/כֶ֥ם וּ/בְקַרְ/כֶ֖ם יֻצָּ֑ג גַּֽם טַפְּ/כֶ֖ם יֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h 'l mshh vy'mr lkhv 'bdv 't yhvh rq ts'nkhm vbqrkhm ytsg gm tpkhm ylkh 'mkhm
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD ; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה גַּם אַתָּ֛ה תִּתֵּ֥ן בְּ/יָדֵ֖/נוּ זְבָחִ֣ים וְ/עֹל֑וֹת וְ/עָשִׂ֖ינוּ לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh gm 'th ttn bydnv zbchym v'lvt v'shynv lyhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.

verses.original: וְ/גַם מִקְנֵ֜/נוּ יֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗/נוּ לֹ֤א תִשָּׁאֵר֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה כִּ֚י מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ נִקַּ֔ח לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ לֹֽא נֵדַ֗ע מַֽה נַּעֲבֹד֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה עַד בֹּאֵ֖/נוּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vgm mqnnv ylkh 'mnv l' tsh'r prsh khy mmnv nqch l'bd 't yhvh 'lhynv v'nchnv l' nd' mh n'bd 't yhvh 'd b'nv shmh
verses.translation: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD , until we come thither.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה אֶת לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לְ/שַׁלְּחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vychzq yhvh 't lb pr'h vl' 'bh lshlchm
verses.translation: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר ל֥/וֹ פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ מֵ/עָלָ֑/י הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֗ אֶל תֹּ֨סֶף֙ רְא֣וֹת פָּנַ֔/י כִּ֗י בְּ/י֛וֹם רְאֹתְ/ךָ֥ פָנַ֖/י תָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr lv pr'h lkh m'ly hshmr lkh 'l tsf r'vt pny khy byvm r'tkh pny tmvt
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֣ן דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ לֹא אֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד רְא֥וֹת פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh khn dbrt l' 'sf 'vd r'vt pnykh
verses.translation: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה ע֣וֹד נֶ֤גַע אֶחָד֙ אָבִ֤יא עַל פַּרְעֹה֙ וְ/עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֕ן יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/זֶּ֑ה כְּ/שַׁ֨לְּח֔/וֹ כָּלָ֕ה גָּרֵ֛שׁ יְגָרֵ֥שׁ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'vd ng' 'chd 'by' 'l pr'h v'l mtsrym 'chry khn yshlch 'tkhm mzh khshlchv khlh grsh ygrsh 'tkhm mzh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

verses.original: דַּבֶּר נָ֖א בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/יִשְׁאֲל֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ מֵ/אֵ֣ת רֵעֵ֗/הוּ וְ/אִשָּׁה֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת רְעוּתָ֔/הּ כְּלֵי כֶ֖סֶף וּ/כְלֵ֥י זָהָֽב
verses.translit: dbr n' b'zny h'm vysh'lv 'ysh m't r'hv v'shh m't r'vth khly khsf vkhly zhb
verses.translation: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת חֵ֥ן הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם גַּ֣ם הָ/אִ֣ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֗ה גָּד֤וֹל מְאֹד֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י עַבְדֵֽי פַרְעֹ֖ה וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 't chn h'm b'yny mtsrym gm h'ysh mshh gdvl m'd b'rts mtsrym b'yny 'bdy pr'h vb'yny h'm
verses.translation: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/חֲצֹ֣ת הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה אֲנִ֥י יוֹצֵ֖א בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh khh 'mr yhvh khchtst hlylh 'ny yvts' btvkh mtsrym
verses.translation: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD , About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

verses.original: וּ/מֵ֣ת כָּל בְּכוֹר֮ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ מִ/בְּכ֤וֹר פַּרְעֹה֙ הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְא֔/וֹ עַ֚ד בְּכ֣וֹר הַ/שִּׁפְחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַחַ֣ר הָ/רֵחָ֑יִם וְ/כֹ֖ל בְּכ֥וֹר בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vmt khl bkhvr b'rts mtsrym mbkhvr pr'h hyshb 'l khs'v 'd bkhvr hshpchh 'shr 'chr hrchym vkhl bkhvr bhmh
verses.translation: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽיְתָ֛ה צְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּמֹ֨/הוּ֙ לֹ֣א נִהְיָ֔תָה וְ/כָמֹ֖/הוּ לֹ֥א תֹסִֽף
verses.translit: vhyth ts'qh gdlh bkhl 'rts mtsrym 'shr khmhv l' nhyth vkhmhv l' tsf
verses.translation: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א יֶֽחֱרַץ כֶּ֨לֶב֙ לְשֹׁנ֔/וֹ לְ/מֵ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ/ן אֲשֶׁר֙ יַפְלֶ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/בֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlkhl bny yshr'l l' ychrts khlb lshnv lm'ysh v'd bhmh lm'n td'vn 'shr yplh yhvh byn mtsrym vbyn yshr'l
verses.translation: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

verses.original: וְ/יָרְד֣וּ כָל עֲבָדֶי/ךָ֩ אֵ֨לֶּה אֵלַ֜/י וְ/הִשְׁתַּֽחֲוּוּ לִ֣/י לֵ/אמֹ֗ר צֵ֤א אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר בְּ/רַגְלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן אֵצֵ֑א וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א מֵֽ/עִם פַּרְעֹ֖ה בָּ/חֳרִי אָֽף
verses.translit: vyrdv khl 'bdykh 'lh 'ly vhshtchvv ly l'mr ts' 'th vkhl h'm 'shr brglykh v'chry khn 'ts' vyts' m'm pr'h bchry 'f
verses.translation: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה לֹא יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן רְב֥וֹת מוֹפְתַ֖/י בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh l' yshm' 'lykhm pr'h lm'n rbvt mvpty b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֗ן עָשׂ֛וּ אֶת כָּל הַ/מֹּפְתִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לִ/פְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יְחַזֵּ֤ק יְהוָה֙ אֶת לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmshh v'hrn 'shv 't khl hmptym h'lh lpny pr'h vychzq yhvh 't lb pr'h vl' shlch 't bny yshr'l m'rtsv
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn b'rts mtsrym l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.original: הַ/חֹ֧דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם רֹ֣אשׁ חֳדָשִׁ֑ים רִאשׁ֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם לְ/חָדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/שָּׁנָֽה
verses.translit: hchdsh hzh lkhm r'sh chdshym r'shvn hv' lkhm lchdshy hshnh
verses.translation: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.

verses.original: דַּבְּר֗וּ אֶֽל כָּל עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בֶּ/עָשֹׂ֖ר לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/יִקְח֣וּ לָ/הֶ֗ם אִ֛ישׁ שֶׂ֥ה לְ/בֵית אָבֹ֖ת שֶׂ֥ה לַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: dbrv 'l khl 'dt yshr'l l'mr b'shr lchdsh hzh vyqchv lhm 'ysh shh lbyt 'bt shh lbyt
verses.translation: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:

verses.original: וְ/אִם יִמְעַ֣ט הַ/בַּיִת֮ מִ/הְיֹ֣ת מִ/שֶּׂה֒ וְ/לָקַ֣ח ה֗וּא וּ/שְׁכֵנ֛/וֹ הַ/קָּרֹ֥ב אֶל בֵּית֖/וֹ בְּ/מִכְסַ֣ת נְפָשֹׁ֑ת אִ֚ישׁ לְ/פִ֣י אָכְל֔/וֹ תָּכֹ֖סּוּ עַל הַ/שֶּֽׂה
verses.translit: v'm ym't hbyt mhyt mshh vlqch hv' vshkhnv hqrb 'l bytv bmkhst npsht 'ysh lpy 'khlv tkhsv 'l hshh
verses.translation: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.

verses.original: שֶׂ֥ה תָמִ֛ים זָכָ֥ר בֶּן שָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם מִן הַ/כְּבָשִׂ֥ים וּ/מִן הָ/עִזִּ֖ים תִּקָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: shh tmym zkhr bn shnh yhyh lkhm mn hkhbshym vmn h'zym tqchv
verses.translation: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת עַ֣ד אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/שָׁחֲט֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ כֹּ֛ל קְהַ֥ל עֲדַֽת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֥ין הָ/עַרְבָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh lkhm lmshmrt 'd 'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh hzh vshchtv 'tv khl qhl 'dt yshr'l byn h'rbym
verses.translation: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

verses.original: וְ/לָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן הַ/דָּ֔ם וְ/נָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַ/מְּזוּזֹ֖ת וְ/עַל הַ/מַּשְׁק֑וֹף עַ֚ל הַ/בָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יֹאכְל֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vlqchv mn hdm vntnv 'l shty hmzvzt v'l hmshqvf 'l hbtym 'shr y'khlv 'tv bhm
verses.translation: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

verses.original: וְ/אָכְל֥וּ אֶת הַ/בָּשָׂ֖ר בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/זֶּ֑ה צְלִי אֵ֣שׁ וּ/מַצּ֔וֹת עַל מְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: v'khlv 't hbshr blylh hzh tsly 'sh vmtsvt 'l mrrym y'khlhv
verses.translation: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

verses.original: אַל תֹּאכְל֤וּ מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ נָ֔א וּ/בָשֵׁ֥ל מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל בַּ/מָּ֑יִם כִּ֣י אִם צְלִי אֵ֔שׁ רֹאשׁ֥/וֹ עַל כְּרָעָ֖י/ו וְ/עַל קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l t'khlv mmnv n' vbshl mbshl bmym khy 'm tsly 'sh r'shv 'l khr'yv v'l qrbv
verses.translation: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עַד בֹּ֑קֶר וְ/הַ/נֹּתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ עַד בֹּ֖קֶר בָּ/אֵ֥שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ
verses.translit: vl' tvtyrv mmnv 'd bqr vhntr mmnv 'd bqr b'sh tshrpv
verses.translation: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

verses.original: וְ/כָכָה֮ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹת/וֹ֒ מָתְנֵי/כֶ֣ם חֲגֻרִ֔ים נַֽעֲלֵי/כֶם֙ בְּ/רַגְלֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/מַקֶּלְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹת/וֹ֙ בְּ/חִפָּז֔וֹן פֶּ֥סַח ה֖וּא לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhkhh t'khlv 'tv mtnykhm chgrym n'lykhm brglykhm vmqlkhm bydkhm v'khltm 'tv bchpzvn psch hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’s passover.

verses.original: וְ/עָבַרְתִּ֣י בְ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַיִם֮ בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/זֶּה֒ וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֤י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ/אָדָ֖ם וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה וּ/בְ/כָל אֱלֹהֵ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה שְׁפָטִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'brty b'rts mtsrym blylh hzh vhkhyty khl bkhvr b'rts mtsrym m'dm v'd bhmh vbkhl 'lhy mtsrym ''shh shptym 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ הַ/דָּ֨ם לָ/כֶ֜ם לְ/אֹ֗ת עַ֤ל הַ/בָּתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם וְ/רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם וּ/פָסַחְתִּ֖י עֲלֵ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בָ/כֶ֥ם נֶ֨גֶף֙ לְ/מַשְׁחִ֔ית בְּ/הַכֹּתִ֖/י בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh hdm lkhm l't 'l hbtym 'shr 'tm shm vr'yty 't hdm vpschty 'lkhm vl' yhyh bkhm ngf lmshchyt bhkhty b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ הַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/זִכָּר֔וֹן וְ/חַגֹּתֶ֥ם אֹת֖/וֹ חַ֣ג לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תְּחָגֻּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vhyh hyvm hzh lkhm lzkhrvn vchgtm 'tv chg lyhvh ldrtykhm chqt 'vlm tchghv
verses.translation: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מַצּ֣וֹת תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אַ֚ךְ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן תַּשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ שְּׂאֹ֖ר מִ/בָּתֵּי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֣י כָּל אֹכֵ֣ל חָמֵ֗ץ וְ/נִכְרְתָ֞ה הַ/נֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַ/הִוא֙ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/יּ֥וֹם הָ/רִאשֹׁ֖ן עַד י֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִעִֽי
verses.translit: shb't ymym mtsvt t'khlv 'kh byvm hr'shvn tshbytv sh'r mbtykhm khy khl 'khl chmts vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' myshr'l myvm hr'shn 'd yvm hshb'y
verses.translation: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֤וֹם הָ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ מִקְרָא קֹ֔דֶשׁ וּ/בַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם כָּל מְלָאכָה֙ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה בָ/הֶ֔ם אַ֚ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֣ל לְ/כָל נֶ֔פֶשׁ ה֥וּא לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hr'shvn mqr' qdsh vbyvm hshby'y mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'khh l' y'shh bhm 'kh 'shr y'khl lkhl npsh hv' lbdv y'shh lkhm
verses.translation: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת הַ/מַּצּוֹת֒ כִּ֗י בְּ/עֶ֨צֶם֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶת צִבְאוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֞ם אֶת הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't hmtsvt khy b'tsm hyvm hzh hvts'ty 't tsb'vtykhm m'rts mtsrym vshmrtm 't hyvm hzh ldrtykhm chqt 'vlm
verses.translation: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

verses.original: בָּ/רִאשֹׁ֡ן בְּ/אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בָּ/עֶ֔רֶב תֹּאכְל֖וּ מַצֹּ֑ת עַ֠ד י֣וֹם הָ/אֶחָ֧ד וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים לַ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ בָּ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: br'shn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh b'rb t'khlv mtst 'd yvm h'chd v'shrym lchdsh b'rb
verses.translation: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים שְׂאֹ֕ר לֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א בְּ/בָתֵּי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֣י כָּל אֹכֵ֣ל מַחְמֶ֗צֶת וְ/נִכְרְתָ֞ה הַ/נֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַ/הִוא֙ מֵ/עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּ/גֵּ֖ר וּ/בְ/אֶזְרַ֥ח הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: shb't ymym sh'r l' ymts' bbtykhm khy khl 'khl mchmtst vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'dt yshr'l bgr vb'zrch h'rts
verses.translation: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

verses.original: כָּל מַחְמֶ֖צֶת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ בְּ/כֹל֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם תֹּאכְל֖וּ מַצּֽוֹת
verses.translit: khl mchmtst l' t'khlv bkhl mvshbtykhm t'khlv mtsvt
verses.translation: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְ/כָל זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם מִֽשְׁכ֗וּ וּ/קְח֨וּ לָ/כֶ֥ם צֹ֛אן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/שַׁחֲט֥וּ הַ/פָּֽסַח
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh lkhl zqny yshr'l vy'mr 'lhm mshkhv vqchv lkhm ts'n lmshpchtykhm vshchtv hpsch
verses.translation: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

verses.original: וּ/לְקַחְתֶּ֞ם אֲגֻדַּ֣ת אֵז֗וֹב וּ/טְבַלְתֶּם֮ בַּ/דָּ֣ם אֲשֶׁר בַּ/סַּף֒ וְ/הִגַּעְתֶּ֤ם אֶל הַ/מַּשְׁקוֹף֙ וְ/אֶל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/מְּזוּזֹ֔ת מִן הַ/דָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/סָּ֑ף וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם לֹ֥א תֵצְא֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ מִ/פֶּֽתַח בֵּית֖/וֹ עַד בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vlqchtm 'gdt 'zvb vtbltm bdm 'shr bsf vhg'tm 'l hmshqvf v'l shty hmzvzt mn hdm 'shr bsf v'tm l' tts'v 'ysh mptch bytv 'd bqr
verses.translation: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִ/נְגֹּ֣ף אֶת מִצְרַיִם֒ וְ/רָאָ֤ה אֶת הַ/דָּם֙ עַל הַ/מַּשְׁק֔וֹף וְ/עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/מְּזוּזֹ֑ת וּ/פָסַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ עַל הַ/פֶּ֔תַח וְ/לֹ֤א יִתֵּן֙ הַ/מַּשְׁחִ֔ית לָ/בֹ֥א אֶל בָּתֵּי/כֶ֖ם לִ/נְגֹּֽף
verses.translit: v'br yhvh lngf 't mtsrym vr'h 't hdm 'l hmshqvf v'l shty hmzvzt vpsch yhvh 'l hptch vl' ytn hmshchyt lb' 'l btykhm lngf
verses.translation: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you .

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה לְ/חָק לְ/ךָ֥ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't hdbr hzh lchq lkh vlbnykh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כִּֽי תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת הָ/עֲבֹדָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vhyh khy tb'v 'l h'rts 'shr ytn yhvh lkhm kh'shr dbr vshmrtm 't h'bdh hz't
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֕ה כִּֽי יֹאמְר֥וּ אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם מָ֛ה הָ/עֲבֹדָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khy y'mrv 'lykhm bnykhm mh h'bdh hz't lkhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֡ם זֶֽבַח פֶּ֨סַח ה֜וּא לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּ֠סַח עַל בָּתֵּ֤י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/נָגְפּ֥/וֹ אֶת מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת בָּתֵּ֣י/נוּ הִצִּ֑יל וַ/יִּקֹּ֥ד הָ/עָ֖ם וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ
verses.translit: v'mrtm zbch psch hv' lyhvh 'shr psch 'l bty bny yshr'l bmtsrym bngpv 't mtsrym v't btynv htsyl vyqd h'm vyshtchvv
verses.translation: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD’s passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vylkhv vy'shv bny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh v'hrn khn 'shv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה וַֽ/יהוָה֮ הִכָּ֣ה כָל בְּכוֹר֮ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ מִ/בְּכֹ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְא֔/וֹ עַ֚ד בְּכ֣וֹר הַ/שְּׁבִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/בּ֑וֹר וְ/כֹ֖ל בְּכ֥וֹר בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bchtsy hlylh vyhvh hkhh khl bkhvr b'rts mtsrym mbkhr pr'h hyshb 'l khs'v 'd bkhvr hshby 'shr bbyt hbvr vkhl bkhvr bhmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם פַּרְעֹ֜ה לַ֗יְלָה ה֤וּא וְ/כָל עֲבָדָי/ו֙ וְ/כָל מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/תְּהִ֛י צְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי אֵ֣ין בַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין שָׁ֖ם מֵֽת
verses.translit: vyqm pr'h lylh hv' vkhl 'bdyv vkhl mtsrym vthy ts'qh gdlh bmtsrym khy 'yn byt 'shr 'yn shm mt
verses.translation: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ לְ/מֹשֶׁ֨ה וּֽ/לְ/אַהֲרֹ֜ן לַ֗יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֔/י גַּם אַתֶּ֖ם גַּם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/לְכ֛וּ עִבְד֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/דַבֶּרְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqr' lmshh vl'hrn lylh vy'mr qvmv ts'v mtvkh 'my gm 'tm gm bny yshr'l vlkhv 'bdv 't yhvh khdbrkhm
verses.translation: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD , as ye have said.

verses.original: גַּם צֹאנְ/כֶ֨ם גַּם בְּקַרְ/כֶ֥ם קְח֛וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם וָ/לֵ֑כוּ וּ/בֵֽרַכְתֶּ֖ם גַּם אֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: gm ts'nkhm gm bqrkhm qchv kh'shr dbrtm vlkhv vbrkhtm gm 'ty
verses.translation: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

verses.original: וַ/תֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ עַל הָ/עָ֔ם לְ/מַהֵ֖ר לְ/שַׁלְּחָ֣/ם מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ כֻּלָּ֥/נוּ מֵתִֽים
verses.translit: vtchzq mtsrym 'l h'm lmhr lshlchm mn h'rts khy 'mrv khlnv mtym
verses.translation: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א הָ/עָ֛ם אֶת בְּצֵק֖/וֹ טֶ֣רֶם יֶחְמָ֑ץ מִשְׁאֲרֹתָ֛/ם צְרֻרֹ֥ת בְּ/שִׂמְלֹתָ֖/ם עַל שִׁכְמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vysh' h'm 't btsqv trm ychmts msh'rtm tsrrt bshmltm 'l shkhmm
verses.translation: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עָשׂ֖וּ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽ/יִּשְׁאֲלוּ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם כְּלֵי כֶ֛סֶף וּ/כְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּ/שְׂמָלֹֽת
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l 'shv khdbr mshh vysh'lv mmtsrym khly khsf vkhly zhb vshmlt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֞ה נָתַ֨ן אֶת חֵ֥ן הָ/עָ֛ם בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וַ/יַּשְׁאִל֑וּ/ם וַֽ/יְנַצְּל֖וּ אֶת מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhvh ntn 't chn h'm b'yny mtsrym vysh'lvm vyntslv 't mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵ/רַעְמְסֵ֖ס סֻכֹּ֑תָ/ה כְּ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֧לֶף רַגְלִ֛י הַ/גְּבָרִ֖ים לְ/בַ֥ד מִ/טָּֽף
verses.translit: vys'v bny yshr'l mr'mss skhth khshsh m'vt 'lf rgly hgbrym lbd mtf
verses.translation: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

verses.original: וְ/גַם עֵ֥רֶב רַ֖ב עָלָ֣ה אִתָּ֑/ם וְ/צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֔ר מִקְנֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vgm 'rb rb 'lh 'tm vts'n vbqr mqnh khbd m'd
verses.translation: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאפ֨וּ אֶת הַ/בָּצֵ֜ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֧יאוּ מִ/מִּצְרַ֛יִם עֻגֹ֥ת מַצּ֖וֹת כִּ֣י לֹ֣א חָמֵ֑ץ כִּֽי גֹרְשׁ֣וּ מִ/מִּצְרַ֗יִם וְ/לֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לְ/הִתְמַהְמֵ֔הַּ וְ/גַם צֵדָ֖ה לֹא עָשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'pv 't hbtsq 'shr hvtsy'v mmtsrym 'gt mtsvt khy l' chmts khy grshv mmtsrym vl' ykhlv lhtmhmh vgm tsdh l' 'shv lhm
verses.translation: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹשַׁב֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vmvshb bny yshr'l 'shr yshbv bmtsrym shlshym shnh v'rb' m'vt shnh
verses.translation: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִ/קֵּץ֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/עֶ֨צֶם֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה יָֽצְא֛וּ כָּל צִבְא֥וֹת יְהוָ֖ה מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy mqts shlshym shnh v'rb' m'vt shnh vyhy b'tsm hyvm hzh yts'v khl tsb'vt yhvh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

verses.original: לֵ֣יל שִׁמֻּרִ֥ים הוּא֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לְ/הוֹצִיאָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הֽוּא הַ/לַּ֤יְלָה הַ/זֶּה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה שִׁמֻּרִ֛ים לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/דֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lyl shmrym hv' lyhvh lhvtsy'm m'rts mtsrym hv' hlylh hzh lyhvh shmrym lkhl bny yshr'l ldrtm
verses.translation: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן זֹ֖את חֻקַּ֣ת הַ/פָּ֑סַח כָּל בֶּן נֵכָ֖ר לֹא יֹ֥אכַל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'hrn z't chqt hpsch khl bn nkhr l' y'khl bv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

verses.original: וְ/כָל עֶ֥בֶד אִ֖ישׁ מִקְנַת כָּ֑סֶף וּ/מַלְתָּ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ אָ֖ז יֹ֥אכַל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl 'bd 'ysh mqnt khsf vmlth 'tv 'z y'khl bv
verses.translation: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

verses.original: תּוֹשָׁ֥ב וְ/שָׂכִ֖יר לֹא יֹ֥אכַל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tvshb vshkhyr l' y'khl bv
verses.translation: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

verses.original: בְּ/בַ֤יִת אֶחָד֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹא תוֹצִ֧יא מִן הַ/בַּ֛יִת מִן הַ/בָּשָׂ֖ר ח֑וּצָ/ה וְ/עֶ֖צֶם לֹ֥א תִשְׁבְּרוּ בֽ/וֹ
