verses.translit: bbyt 'chd y'khl l' tvtsy' mn hbyt mn hbshr chvtsh v'tsm l' tshbrv bv
verses.translation: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

verses.original: כָּל עֲדַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl 'dt yshr'l y'shv 'tv
verses.translation: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָג֨וּר אִתְּ/ךָ֜ גֵּ֗ר וְ/עָ֣שָׂה פֶסַח֮ לַ/יהוָה֒ הִמּ֧וֹל ל֣/וֹ כָל זָכָ֗ר וְ/אָז֙ יִקְרַ֣ב לַ/עֲשֹׂת֔/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֖ה כְּ/אֶזְרַ֣ח הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כָל עָרֵ֖ל לֹֽא יֹ֥אכַל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhy ygvr 'tkh gr v'shh psch lyhvh hmvl lv khl zkhr v'z yqrb l'shtv vhyh kh'zrch h'rts vkhl 'rl l' y'khl bv
verses.translation: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD , let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה לָֽ/אֶזְרָ֑ח וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: tvrh 'cht yhyh l'zrch vlgr hgr btvkhkhm
verses.translation: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֖ן כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vy'shv khl bny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh v't 'hrn khn 'shv
verses.translation: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י בְּ/עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה הוֹצִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל צִבְאֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy b'tsm hyvm hzh hvtsy' yhvh 't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym 'l tsb'tm
verses.translation: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: קַדֶּשׁ לִ֨/י כָל בְּכ֜וֹר פֶּ֤טֶר כָּל רֶ֨חֶם֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֖/י הֽוּא
verses.translit: qdsh ly khl bkhvr ptr khl rchm bbny yshr'l b'dm vbbhmh ly hv'
verses.translation: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל הָ/עָ֗ם זָכ֞וֹר אֶת הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצָאתֶ֤ם מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים כִּ֚י בְּ/חֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד הוֹצִ֧יא יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל חָמֵֽץ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l h'm zkhvr 't hyvm hzh 'shr yts'tm mmtsrym mbyt 'bdym khy bchzq yd hvtsy' yhvh 'tkhm mzh vl' y'khl chmts
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

verses.original: הַ/יּ֖וֹם אַתֶּ֣ם יֹצְאִ֑ים בְּ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ הָ/אָבִֽיב
verses.translit: hyvm 'tm yts'ym bchdsh h'byb
verses.translation: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה כִֽי יְבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֡ה אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ֠/כְּנַעֲנִי וְ/הַ/חִתִּ֨י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִ֜י וְ/הַ/חִוִּ֣י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ֣/תֶת לָ֔/ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָ֑שׁ וְ/עָבַדְתָּ֛ אֶת הָ/עֲבֹדָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhyh khy yby'kh yhvh 'l 'rts hkhn'ny vhchty vh'mry vhchvy vhybvsy 'shr nshb' l'btykh ltt lkh 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh v'bdt 't h'bdh hz't bchdsh hzh
verses.translation: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצֹּ֑ת וּ/בַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י חַ֖ג לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: shb't ymym t'khl mtst vbyvm hshby'y chg lyhvh
verses.translation: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD .

verses.original: מַצּוֹת֙ יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וְ/לֹֽא יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ חָמֵ֗ץ וְ/לֹֽא יֵרָאֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ שְׂאֹ֖ר בְּ/כָל גְּבֻלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mtsvt y'khl 't shb't hymym vl' yr'h lkh chmts vl' yr'h lkh sh'r bkhl gblkh
verses.translation: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

verses.original: וְ/הִגַּדְתָּ֣ לְ/בִנְ/ךָ֔ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בַּ/עֲב֣וּר זֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִ֔/י בְּ/צֵאתִ֖/י מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhgdt lbnkh byvm hhv' l'mr b'bvr zh 'shh yhvh ly bts'ty mmtsrym
verses.translation: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ לְ/ךָ֨ לְ/א֜וֹת עַל יָדְ/ךָ֗ וּ/לְ/זִכָּרוֹן֙ בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ לְמַ֗עַן תִּהְיֶ֛ה תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/פִ֑י/ךָ כִּ֚י בְּ/יָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה הוֹצִֽאֲ/ךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh lkh l'vt 'l ydkh vlzkhrvn byn 'ynykh lm'n thyh tvrt yhvh bpykh khy byd chzqh hvts'kh yhvh mmtsrym
verses.translation: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD’s law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֛ אֶת הַ/חֻקָּ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/מוֹעֲדָ֑/הּ מִ/יָּמִ֖ים יָמִֽימָ/ה
verses.translit: vshmrt 't hchqh hz't lmv'dh mymym ymymh
verses.translation: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כִּֽי יְבִֽאֲ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ/ךָ֖ וְ/לַֽ/אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/נְתָנָ֖/הּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh khy yb'kh yhvh 'l 'rts hkhn'ny kh'shr nshb' lkh vl'btykh vntnh lkh
verses.translation: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

verses.original: וְ/הַעֲבַרְתָּ֥ כָל פֶּֽטֶר רֶ֖חֶם לַֽ/יהֹוָ֑ה וְ/כָל פֶּ֣טֶר שֶׁ֣גֶר בְּהֵמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ הַ/זְּכָרִ֖ים לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vh'brt khl ptr rchm lyhvh vkhl ptr shgr bhmh 'shr yhyh lkh hzkhrym lyhvh
verses.translation: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD’s .

verses.original: וְ/כָל פֶּ֤טֶר חֲמֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְ/שֶׂ֔ה וְ/אִם לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַ/עֲרַפְתּ֑/וֹ וְ/כֹ֨ל בְּכ֥וֹר אָדָ֛ם בְּ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ תִּפְדֶּֽה
verses.translit: vkhl ptr chmr tpdh bshh v'm l' tpdh v'rptv vkhl bkhvr 'dm bbnykh tpdh
verses.translation: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כִּֽי יִשְׁאָלְ/ךָ֥ בִנְ/ךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֣ר מַה זֹּ֑את וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔י/ו בְּ/חֹ֣זֶק יָ֗ד הוֹצִיאָ֧/נוּ יְהוָ֛ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: vhyh khy ysh'lkh bnkh mchr l'mr mh z't v'mrt 'lyv bchzq yd hvtsy'nv yhvh mmtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּֽי הִקְשָׁ֣ה פַרְעֹה֮ לְ/שַׁלְּחֵ/נוּ֒ וַ/יַּהֲרֹ֨ג יְהֹוָ֤ה כָּל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִ/בְּכֹ֥ר אָדָ֖ם וְ/עַד בְּכ֣וֹר בְּהֵמָ֑ה עַל כֵּן֩ אֲנִ֨י זֹבֵ֜חַ לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה כָּל פֶּ֤טֶר רֶ֨חֶם֙ הַ/זְּכָרִ֔ים וְ/כָל בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנַ֖/י אֶפְדֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khy hqshh pr'h lshlchnv vyhrg yhvh khl bkhvr b'rts mtsrym mbkhr 'dm v'd bkhvr bhmh 'l khn 'ny zbch lyhvh khl ptr rchm hzkhrym vkhl bkhvr bny 'pdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה לְ/אוֹת֙ עַל יָ֣דְ/כָ֔ה וּ/לְ/טוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֚י בְּ/חֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד הוֹצִיאָ֥/נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh l'vt 'l ydkhh vltvtpt byn 'ynykh khy bchzq yd hvtsy'nv yhvh mmtsrym
verses.translation: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/שַׁלַּ֣ח פַּרְעֹה֮ אֶת הָ/עָם֒ וְ/לֹא נָחָ֣/ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים דֶּ֚רֶךְ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כִּ֥י קָר֖וֹב ה֑וּא כִּ֣י אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים פֶּֽן יִנָּחֵ֥ם הָ/עָ֛ם בִּ/רְאֹתָ֥/ם מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְ/שָׁ֥בוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy bshlch pr'h 't h'm vl' nchm 'lhym drkh 'rts plshtym khy qrvb hv' khy 'mr 'lhym pn ynchm h'm br'tm mlchmh vshbv mtsrymh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

verses.original: וַ/יַּסֵּ֨ב אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶת הָ/עָ֛ם דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר יַם ס֑וּף וַ/חֲמֻשִׁ֛ים עָל֥וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vysb 'lhym 't h'm drkh hmdbr ym svf vchmshym 'lv bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹסֵ֖ף עִמּ֑/וֹ כִּי֩ הַשְׁבֵּ֨עַ הִשְׁבִּ֜יעַ אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַעֲלִיתֶ֧ם אֶת עַצְמֹתַ֛/י מִ/זֶּ֖ה אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't 'tsmvt yvsf 'mv khy hshb' hshby' 't bny yshr'l l'mr pqd ypqd 'lhym 'tkhm vh'lytm 't 'tsmty mzh 'tkhm
verses.translation: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/סֻּכֹּ֑ת וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ בְ/אֵתָ֔ם בִּ/קְצֵ֖ה הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vys'v mskht vychnv b'tm bqtsh hmdbr
verses.translation: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֡ה הֹלֵךְ֩ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֨ם יוֹמָ֜ם בְּ/עַמּ֤וּד עָנָן֙ לַ/נְחֹתָ֣/ם הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/לַ֛יְלָה בְּ/עַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לְ/הָאִ֣יר לָ/הֶ֑ם לָ/לֶ֖כֶת יוֹמָ֥ם וָ/לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyhvh hlkh lpnyhm yvmm b'mvd 'nn lnchtm hdrkh vlylh b'mvd 'sh lh'yr lhm llkht yvmm vlylh
verses.translation: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

verses.original: לֹֽא יָמִ֞ישׁ עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְ/עַמּ֥וּד הָ/אֵ֖שׁ לָ֑יְלָה לִ/פְנֵ֖י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: l' ymysh 'mvd h'nn yvmm v'mvd h'sh lylh lpny h'm
verses.translation: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְ/יָשֻׁ֗בוּ וְ/יַחֲנוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת בֵּ֥ין מִגְדֹּ֖ל וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/יָּ֑ם לִ/פְנֵי֙ בַּ֣עַל צְפֹ֔ן נִכְח֥/וֹ תַחֲנ֖וּ עַל הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l vyshbv vychnv lpny py hchyrt byn mgdl vbyn hym lpny b'l tspn nkhchv tchnv 'l hym
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְבֻכִ֥ים הֵ֖ם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ סָגַ֥ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v'mr pr'h lbny yshr'l nbkhym hm b'rts sgr 'lyhm hmdbr
verses.translation: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

verses.original: וְ/חִזַּקְתִּ֣י אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה֮ וְ/רָדַ֣ף אַחֲרֵי/הֶם֒ וְ/אִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּ/פַרְעֹה֙ וּ/בְ/כָל חֵיל֔/וֹ וְ/יָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵֽן
verses.translit: vchzqty 't lb pr'h vrdf 'chryhm v'khbdh bpr'h vbkhl chylv vyd'v mtsrym khy 'ny yhvh vy'shv khn
verses.translation: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD . And they did so.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּד֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח הָ/עָ֑ם וַ֠/יֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַ֨ב פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַ/עֲבָדָי/ו֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יֹּֽאמרוּ֙ מַה זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֔ינוּ כִּֽי שִׁלַּ֥חְנוּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/עָבְדֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vygd lmlkh mtsrym khy brch h'm vyhpkh lbb pr'h v'bdyv 'l h'm vy'mrv mh z't 'shynv khy shlchnv 't yshr'l m'bdnv
verses.translation: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאְסֹ֖ר אֶת רִכְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/אֶת עַמּ֖/וֹ לָקַ֥ח עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sr 't rkhbv v't 'mv lqch 'mv
verses.translation: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֗ח שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת רֶ֨כֶב֙ בָּח֔וּר וְ/כֹ֖ל רֶ֣כֶב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/שָׁלִשִׁ֖ם עַל כֻּלּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch shsh m'vt rkhb bchvr vkhl rkhb mtsrym vshlshm 'l khlv
verses.translation: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֣ק יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת לֵ֤ב פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֹצְאִ֖ים בְּ/יָ֥ד רָמָֽה
verses.translit: vychzq yhvh 't lb pr'h mlkh mtsrym vyrdf 'chry bny yshr'l vbny yshr'l yts'ym byd rmh
verses.translation: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יַּשִּׂ֤יגוּ אוֹתָ/ם֙ חֹנִ֣ים עַל הַ/יָּ֔ם כָּל סוּס֙ רֶ֣כֶב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וּ/פָרָשָׁ֖י/ו וְ/חֵיל֑/וֹ עַל פִּי֙ הַֽחִירֹ֔ת לִ/פְנֵ֖י בַּ֥עַל צְפֹֽן
verses.translit: vyrdpv mtsrym 'chryhm vyshygv 'vtm chnym 'l hym khl svs rkhb pr'h vprshyv vchylv 'l py hchyrt lpny b'l tspn
verses.translation: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

verses.original: וּ/פַרְעֹ֖ה הִקְרִ֑יב וַ/יִּשְׂאוּ֩ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת עֵינֵי/הֶ֜ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה מִצְרַ֣יִם נֹסֵ֣עַ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יִּֽירְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַ/יִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vpr'h hqryb vysh'v bny yshr'l 't 'ynyhm vhnh mtsrym ns' 'chryhm vyyr'v m'd vyts'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ הַֽ/מִ/בְּלִ֤י אֵין קְבָרִים֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם לְקַחְתָּ֖/נוּ לָ/מ֣וּת בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר מַה זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔/נוּ לְ/הוֹצִיאָ֖/נוּ מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l mshh hmbly 'yn qbrym bmtsrym lqchtnv lmvt bmdbr mh z't 'shyt lnv lhvtsy'nv mmtsrym
verses.translation: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבַּ֨רְנוּ אֵלֶ֤י/ךָ בְ/מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר חֲדַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ וְ/נַֽעַבְדָ֣ה אֶת מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לָ֨/נוּ֙ עֲבֹ֣ד אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם מִ/מֻּתֵ֖/נוּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: hl' zh hdbr 'shr dbrnv 'lykh bmtsrym l'mr chdl mmnv vn'bdh 't mtsrym khy tvb lnv 'bd 't mtsrym mmtnv bmdbr
verses.translation: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל הָ/עָם֮ אַל תִּירָאוּ֒ הִֽתְיַצְב֗וּ וּ/רְאוּ֙ אֶת יְשׁוּעַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם כִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר רְאִיתֶ֤ם אֶת מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם לֹ֥א תֹסִ֛יפוּ לִ/רְאֹתָ֥/ם ע֖וֹד עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l h'm 'l tyr'v htytsbv vr'v 't yshv't yhvh 'shr y'shh lkhm hyvm khy 'shr r'ytm 't mtsrym hyvm l' tsypv lr'tm 'vd 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD , which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם תַּחֲרִישֽׁוּ/ן
verses.translit: yhvh ylchm lkhm v'tm tchryshvn
verses.translation: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מַה תִּצְעַ֖ק אֵלָ֑/י דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh mh tts'q 'ly dbr 'l bny yshr'l vys'v
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה הָרֵ֣ם אֶֽת מַטְּ/ךָ֗ וּ/נְטֵ֧ה אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֛ עַל הַ/יָּ֖ם וּ/בְקָעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/יָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יָּ֖ם בַּ/יַּבָּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: v'th hrm 't mtkh vnth 't ydkh 'l hym vbq'hv vyb'v bny yshr'l btvkh hym bybshh
verses.translation: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י הִנְ/נִ֤י מְחַזֵּק֙ אֶת לֵ֣ב מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/יָבֹ֖אוּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּ/פַרְעֹה֙ וּ/בְ/כָל חֵיל֔/וֹ בְּ/רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וּ/בְ/פָרָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: v'ny hnny mchzq 't lb mtsrym vyb'v 'chryhm v'khbdh bpr'h vbkhl chylv brkhbv vbprshyv
verses.translation: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/הִכָּבְדִ֣/י בְּ/פַרְעֹ֔ה בְּ/רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וּ/בְ/פָרָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vyd'v mtsrym khy 'ny yhvh bhkhbdy bpr'h brkhbv vbprshyv
verses.translation: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֞ע מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים הַ/הֹלֵךְ֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ מֵ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּסַּ֞ע עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּֽעֲמֹ֖ד מֵ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vys' ml'kh h'lhym hhlkh lpny mchnh yshr'l vylkh m'chryhm vys' 'mvd h'nn mpnyhm vy'md m'chryhm
verses.translation: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א בֵּ֣ין מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֗יִם וּ/בֵין֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יְהִ֤י הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ וְ/הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וַ/יָּ֖אֶר אֶת הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וְ/לֹא קָרַ֥ב זֶ֛ה אֶל זֶ֖ה כָּל הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyb' byn mchnh mtsrym vbyn mchnh yshr'l vyhy h'nn vhchshkh vy'r 't hlylh vl' qrb zh 'l zh khl hlylh
verses.translation: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת יָד/וֹ֮ עַל הַ/יָּם֒ וַ/יּ֣וֹלֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה אֶת הַ֠/יָּם בְּ/ר֨וּחַ קָדִ֤ים עַזָּה֙ כָּל הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם לֶ/חָרָבָ֑ה וַ/יִּבָּקְע֖וּ הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyt mshh 't ydv 'l hym vyvlkh yhvh 't hym brvch qdym 'zh khl hlylh vyshm 't hym lchrbh vybq'v hmym
verses.translation: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land , and the waters were divided.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יָּ֖ם בַּ/יַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְ/הַ/מַּ֤יִם לָ/הֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽ/ימִינָ֖/ם וּ/מִ/שְּׂמֹאלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyb'v bny yshr'l btvkh hym bybshh vhmym lhm chmh mymynm vmshm'lm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֤וּ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֚ל ס֣וּס פַּרְעֹ֔ה רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וּ/פָרָשָׁ֑י/ו אֶל תּ֖וֹךְ הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vyrdpv mtsrym vyb'v 'chryhm khl svs pr'h rkhbv vprshyv 'l tvkh hym
verses.translation: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בְּ/אַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יַּשְׁקֵ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/עַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ וְ/עָנָ֑ן וַ/יָּ֕הָם אֵ֖ת מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy b'shmrt hbqr vyshqf yhvh 'l mchnh mtsrym b'mvd 'sh v'nn vyhm 't mchnh mtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֗סַר אֵ֚ת אֹפַ֣ן מַרְכְּבֹתָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יְנַהֲגֵ֖/הוּ בִּ/כְבֵדֻ֑ת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מִצְרַ֗יִם אָנ֨וּסָה֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֥ם לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vysr 't 'pn mrkhbtyv vynhghv bkhbdt vy'mr mtsrym 'nvsh mpny yshr'l khy yhvh nlchm lhm bmtsrym
verses.translation: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה נְטֵ֥ה אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֖ עַל הַ/יָּ֑ם וְ/יָשֻׁ֤בוּ הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם עַל רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וְ/עַל פָּרָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh nth 't ydkh 'l hym vyshbv hmym 'l mtsrym 'l rkhbv v'l prshyv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת יָד֜/וֹ עַל הַ/יָּ֗ם וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב הַ/יָּ֜ם לִ/פְנ֥וֹת בֹּ֨קֶר֙ לְ/אֵ֣יתָנ֔/וֹ וּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם נָסִ֣ים לִ/קְרָאת֑/וֹ וַ/יְנַעֵ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vyt mshh 't ydv 'l hym vyshb hym lpnvt bqr l'ytnv vmtsrym nsym lqr'tv vyn'r yhvh 't mtsrym btvkh hym
verses.translation: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ הַ/מַּ֗יִם וַ/יְכַסּ֤וּ אֶת הָ/רֶ֨כֶב֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/פָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים לְ/כֹל֙ חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֔ה הַ/בָּאִ֥ים אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּ/יָּ֑ם לֹֽא נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּ/הֶ֖ם עַד אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyshbv hmym vykhsv 't hrkhb v't hprshym lkhl chyl pr'h hb'ym 'chryhm bym l' nsh'r bhm 'd 'chd
verses.translation: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַ/יַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/יָּ֑ם וְ/הַ/מַּ֤יִם לָ/הֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽ/ימִינָ֖/ם וּ/מִ/שְּׂמֹאלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l hlkhv bybshh btvkh hym vhmym lhm chmh mymynm vmshm'lm
verses.translation: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֨וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֜ה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֛וּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/יַּ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יַּ֤רְא יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ֖ת עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vyvsh' yhvh byvm hhv' 't yshr'l myd mtsrym vyr' yshr'l 't mtsrym mt 'l shpt hym
verses.translation: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת הַ/יָּ֣ד הַ/גְּדֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּֽירְא֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּֽאֲמִ֨ינוּ֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/בְ/מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַבְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' yshr'l 't hyd hgdlh 'shr 'shh yhvh bmtsrym vyyr'v h'm 't yhvh vy'mynv byhvh vbmshh 'bdv
verses.translation: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD , and believed the LORD , and his servant Moses.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר מֹשֶׁה֩ וּ/בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת הַ/שִּׁירָ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ כִּֽי גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְ/רֹכְב֖/וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: 'z yshyr mshh vbny yshr'l 't hshyrh hz't lyhvh vy'mrv l'mr 'shyrh lyhvh khy g'h g'h svs vrkhbv rmh bym
verses.translation: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD , and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD , for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

verses.original: עָזִּ֤/י וְ/זִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽ/יְהִי לִ֖/י לִֽ/ישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִ/י֙ וְ/אַנְוֵ֔/הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖/י וַ/אֲרֹמְמֶֽ/נְהוּ
verses.translit: 'zy vzmrt yh vyhy ly lyshv'h zh 'ly v'nvhv 'lhy 'by v'rmmnhv
verses.translation: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhvh 'ysh mlchmh yhvh shmv
verses.translation: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.

verses.original: מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְ/חֵיל֖/וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַ/יָּ֑ם וּ/מִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖י/ו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְ/יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: mrkhbt pr'h vchylv yrh bym vmbchr shlshyv tb'v bym svf
verses.translation: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

verses.original: תְּהֹמֹ֖ת יְכַסְיֻ֑/מוּ יָרְד֥וּ בִ/מְצוֹלֹ֖ת כְּמוֹ אָֽבֶן
verses.translit: thmt ykhsymv yrdv bmtsvlt khmv 'bn
verses.translation: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

verses.original: יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּ/כֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: ymynkh yhvh n'dry bkhch ymynkh yhvh tr'ts 'vyb
verses.translation: Thy right hand, O LORD , is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD , hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/רֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְ/ךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑י/ךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְ/ךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖/מוֹ כַּ/קַּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vbrb g'vnkh thrs qmykh tshlch chrnkh y'khlmv khqsh
verses.translation: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/ר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמוֹ נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּ/לֶב יָֽם
verses.translit: vbrvch 'pykh n'rmv mym ntsbv khmv nd nzlym qp'v thmt blb ym
verses.translation: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

verses.original: אָמַ֥ר אוֹיֵ֛ב אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣/מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔/י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔/י תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖/מוֹ יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'mr 'vyb 'rdf 'shyg 'chlq shll tml'mv npshy 'ryq chrby tvryshmv ydy
verses.translation: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

verses.original: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְ/רוּחֲ/ךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣/מוֹ יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽ/עוֹפֶ֔רֶת בְּ/מַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים
verses.translit: nshpt brvchkh khsmv ym tsllv kh'vprt bmym 'dyrym
verses.translation: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

verses.original: מִֽי כָמֹ֤/כָה בָּֽ/אֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖/כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא
verses.translit: my khmkhh b'lm yhvh my khmkhh n'dr bqdsh nvr' thlt 'shh pl'
verses.translation: Who is like unto thee, O LORD , among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

verses.original: נָטִ֨יתָ֙ יְמִ֣ינְ/ךָ֔ תִּבְלָעֵ֖/מוֹ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ntyt ymynkh tbl'mv 'rts
verses.translation: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

verses.original: נָחִ֥יתָ בְ/חַסְדְּ/ךָ֖ עַם ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְ/עָזְּ/ךָ֖ אֶל נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: nchyt bchsdkh 'm zv g'lt nhlt b'zkh 'l nvh qdshkh
verses.translation: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

verses.original: שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּ/ן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: shm'v 'mym yrgzvn chyl 'chz yshby plsht
verses.translation: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

verses.original: אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖/מוֹ רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן
verses.translit: 'z nbhlv 'lvpy 'dvm 'yly mv'b y'chzmv r'd nmgv khl yshby khn'n
verses.translation: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

verses.original: תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵי/הֶ֤ם אֵימָ֨תָ/ה֙ וָ/פַ֔חַד בִּ/גְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲ/ךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּ/אָ֑בֶן עַד יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ
verses.translit: tpl 'lyhm 'ymth vpchd bgdl zrv'kh ydmv kh'bn 'd y'br 'mkh yhvh 'd y'br 'm zv qnyt
verses.translation: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD , till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

verses.original: תְּבִאֵ֗/מוֹ וְ/תִטָּעֵ֨/מוֹ֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְ/ךָ֔ מָכ֧וֹן לְ/שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֛ פָּעַ֖לְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖/י כּוֹנְנ֥וּ יָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tb'mv vtt'mv bhr nchltkh mkhvn lshbtkh p'lt yhvh mqdsh 'dny khvnnv ydykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְ/עֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: yhvh ymlkh l'lm v'd
verses.translation: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בָא֩ ס֨וּס פַּרְעֹ֜ה בְּ/רִכְבּ֤/וֹ וּ/בְ/פָרָשָׁי/ו֙ בַּ/יָּ֔ם וַ/יָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם אֶת מֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֑ם וּ/בְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַ/יַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: khy b' svs pr'h brkhbv vbprshyv bym vyshb yhvh 'lhm 't my hym vbny yshr'l hlkhv bybshh btvkh hym
verses.translation: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּח֩ מִרְיָ֨ם הַ/נְּבִיאָ֜ה אֲח֧וֹת אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת הַ/תֹּ֖ף בְּ/יָדָ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּצֶ֤אןָ כָֽל הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ אַחֲרֶ֔י/הָ בְּ/תֻפִּ֖ים וּ/בִ/מְחֹלֹֽת
verses.translit: vtqch mrym hnby'h 'chvt 'hrn 't htf bydh vtts'n khl hnshym 'chryh btpym vbmchlt
verses.translation: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֥עַן לָ/הֶ֖ם מִרְיָ֑ם שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ כִּֽי גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְ/רֹכְב֖/וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vt'n lhm mrym shyrv lyhvh khy g'h g'h svs vrkhbv rmh bym
verses.translation: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD , for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסַּ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/יַּם ס֔וּף וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ אֶל מִדְבַּר שׁ֑וּר וַ/יֵּלְכ֧וּ שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת יָמִ֛ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר וְ/לֹא מָ֥צְאוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vys' mshh 't yshr'l mym svf vyts'v 'l mdbr shvr vylkhv shlsht ymym bmdbr vl' mts'v mym
verses.translation: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ מָרָ֔תָ/ה וְ/לֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לִ/שְׁתֹּ֥ת מַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מָּרָ֔ה כִּ֥י מָרִ֖ים הֵ֑ם עַל כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא שְׁמָ֖/הּ מָרָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v mrth vl' ykhlv lshtt mym mmrh khy mrym hm 'l khn qr' shmh mrh
verses.translation: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלֹּ֧נוּ הָ/עָ֛ם עַל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹ֖ר מַה נִּשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: vylnv h'm 'l mshh l'mr mh nshth
verses.translation: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יּוֹרֵ֤/הוּ יְהוָה֙ עֵ֔ץ וַ/יַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל הַ/מַּ֔יִם וַֽ/יִּמְתְּק֖וּ הַ/מָּ֑יִם שָׁ֣ם שָׂ֥ם ל֛/וֹ חֹ֥ק וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְ/שָׁ֥ם נִסָּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyts'q 'l yhvh vyvrhv yhvh 'ts vyshlkh 'l hmym vymtqv hmym shm shm lv chq vmshpt vshm nshv
verses.translation: And he cried unto the LORD ; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אִם שָׁמ֨וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/הַ/יָּשָׁ֤ר בְּ/עֵינָי/ו֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/הַֽאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְ/מִצְוֺתָ֔י/ו וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל חֻקָּ֑י/ו כָּֽל הַ/מַּֽחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֤מְתִּי בְ/מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹא אָשִׂ֣ים עָלֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֹפְאֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'm shmv' tshm' lqvl yhvh 'lhykh vhyshr b'ynyv t'shh vh'znt lmtsvtyv vshmrt khl chqyv khl hmchlh 'shr shmty bmtsrym l' 'shym 'lykh khy 'ny yhvh rp'kh
verses.translation: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵילִ֔מָ/ה וְ/שָׁ֗ם שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֖יִם וְ/שִׁבְעִ֣ים תְּמָרִ֑ים וַ/יַּחֲנוּ שָׁ֖ם עַל הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'ylmh vshm shtym 'shrh 'ynt mym vshb'ym tmrym vychnv shm 'l hmym
verses.translation: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽ/אֵילִ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ כָּל עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל מִדְבַּר סִ֔ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּין אֵילִ֖ם וּ/בֵ֣ין סִינָ֑י בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י לְ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vys'v m'ylm vyb'v khl 'dt bny yshr'l 'l mdbr syn 'shr byn 'ylm vbyn syny bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshny lts'tm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: ו/ילינו וַ/יִּלּ֜וֹנוּ כָּל עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vylynv vylvnv khl 'dt bny yshr'l 'l mshh v'l 'hrn bmdbr
verses.translation: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִֽי יִתֵּ֨ן מוּתֵ֤/נוּ בְ/יַד יְהוָה֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/שִׁבְתֵּ֨/נוּ֙ עַל סִ֣יר הַ/בָּשָׂ֔ר בְּ/אָכְלֵ֥/נוּ לֶ֖חֶם לָ/שֹׂ֑בַע כִּֽי הוֹצֵאתֶ֤ם אֹתָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לְ/הָמִ֛ית אֶת כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֥ל הַ/זֶּ֖ה בָּ/רָעָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lhm bny yshr'l my ytn mvtnv byd yhvh b'rts mtsrym bshbtnv 'l syr hbshr b'khlnv lchm lshb' khy hvts'tm 'tnv 'l hmdbr hzh lhmyt 't khl hqhl hzh br'b
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י מַמְטִ֥יר לָ/כֶ֛ם לֶ֖חֶם מִן הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/יָצָ֨א הָ/עָ֤ם וְ/לָֽקְטוּ֙ דְּבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֔/וֹ לְמַ֧עַן אֲנַסֶּ֛/נּוּ הֲ/יֵלֵ֥ךְ בְּ/תוֹרָתִ֖/י אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hnny mmtyr lkhm lchm mn hshmym vyts' h'm vlqtv dbr yvm byvmv lm'n 'nsnv hylkh btvrty 'm l'
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔י וְ/הֵכִ֖ינוּ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר יָבִ֑יאוּ וְ/הָיָ֣ה מִשְׁנֶ֔ה עַ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר יִלְקְט֖וּ י֥וֹם יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hshshy vhkhynv 't 'shr yby'v vhyh mshnh 'l 'shr ylqtv yvm yvm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֶ֕רֶב וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י יְהוָ֛ה הוֹצִ֥יא אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh v'hrn 'l khl bny yshr'l 'rb vyd'tm khy yhvh hvtsy' 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

verses.original: וּ/בֹ֗קֶר וּ/רְאִיתֶם֙ אֶת כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/שָׁמְע֥/וֹ אֶת תְּלֻנֹּתֵי/כֶ֖ם עַל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/נַ֣חְנוּ מָ֔ה כִּ֥י תלונו תַלִּ֖ינוּ עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vbqr vr'ytm 't khbvd yhvh bshm'v 't tlntykhm 'l yhvh vnchnv mh khy tlvnv tlynv 'lynv
verses.translation: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD ; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD : and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּ/תֵ֣ת יְהוָה֩ לָ/כֶ֨ם בָּ/עֶ֜רֶב בָּשָׂ֣ר לֶ/אֱכֹ֗ל וְ/לֶ֤חֶם בַּ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ לִ/שְׂבֹּ֔עַ בִּ/שְׁמֹ֤עַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת תְּלֻנֹּ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם מַלִּינִ֖ם עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נַ֣חְנוּ מָ֔ה לֹא עָלֵ֥י/נוּ תְלֻנֹּתֵי/כֶ֖ם כִּ֥י עַל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh btt yhvh lkhm b'rb bshr l'khl vlchm bbqr lshb' bshm' yhvh 't tlntykhm 'shr 'tm mlynm 'lyv vnchnv mh l' 'lynv tlntykhm khy 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses said, This shall be , when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֱמֹ֗ר אֶֽל כָּל עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל קִרְב֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע אֵ֖ת תְּלֻנֹּתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn 'mr 'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l qrbv lpny yhvh khy shm' 't tlntykhm
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD : for he hath heard your murmurings.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/דַבֵּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל כָּל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּפְנ֖וּ אֶל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/הִנֵּה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה נִרְאָ֖ה בֶּ/עָנָֽן
verses.translit: vyhy khdbr 'hrn 'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l vypnv 'l hmdbr vhnh khbvd yhvh nr'h b'nn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶת תְּלוּנֹּת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ דַּבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר בֵּ֤ין הָֽ/עַרְבַּ֨יִם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ בָשָׂ֔ר וּ/בַ/בֹּ֖קֶר תִּשְׂבְּעוּ לָ֑חֶם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'ty 't tlvnt bny yshr'l dbr 'lhm l'mr byn h'rbym t'khlv bshr vbbqr tshb'v lchm vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בָ/עֶ֔רֶב וַ/תַּ֣עַל הַ/שְּׂלָ֔ו וַ/תְּכַ֖ס אֶת הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּ/בַ/בֹּ֗קֶר הָֽיְתָה֙ שִׁכְבַ֣ת הַ/טַּ֔ל סָבִ֖יב לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy b'rb vt'l hshlv vtkhs 't hmchnh vbbqr hyth shkhbt htl sbyb lmchnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֖עַל שִׁכְבַ֣ת הַ/טָּ֑ל וְ/הִנֵּ֞ה עַל פְּנֵ֤י הַ/מִּדְבָּר֙ דַּ֣ק מְחֻסְפָּ֔ס דַּ֥ק כַּ/כְּפֹ֖ר עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vt'l shkhbt htl vhnh 'l pny hmdbr dq mchsps dq khkhpr 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל אָחִי/ו֙ מָ֣ן ה֔וּא כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ מַה ה֑וּא וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם ה֣וּא הַ/לֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: vyr'v bny yshr'l vy'mrv 'ysh 'l 'chyv mn hv' khy l' yd'v mh hv' vy'mr mshh 'lhm hv' hlchm 'shr ntn yhvh lkhm l'khlh
verses.translation: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לִקְט֣וּ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ אִ֖ישׁ לְ/פִ֣י אָכְל֑/וֹ עֹ֣מֶר לַ/גֻּלְגֹּ֗לֶת מִסְפַּר֙ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/אָהֳל֖/וֹ תִּקָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh lqtv mmnv 'ysh lpy 'khlv 'mr lglglt mspr npshtykhm 'ysh l'shr b'hlv tqchv
verses.translation: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂוּ כֵ֖ן בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יִּלְקְט֔וּ הַ/מַּרְבֶּ֖ה וְ/הַ/מַּמְעִֽיט
verses.translit: vy'shv khn bny yshr'l vylqtv hmrbh vhmm'yt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

verses.original: וַ/יָּמֹ֣דּוּ בָ/עֹ֔מֶר וְ/לֹ֤א הֶעְדִּיף֙ הַ/מַּרְבֶּ֔ה וְ/הַ/מַּמְעִ֖יט לֹ֣א הֶחְסִ֑יר אִ֥ישׁ לְ/פִֽי אָכְל֖/וֹ לָקָֽטוּ
verses.translit: vymdv b'mr vl' h'dyf hmrbh vhmm'yt l' hchsyr 'ysh lpy 'khlv lqtv
verses.translation: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אִ֕ישׁ אַל יוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עַד בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'lhm 'ysh 'l yvtr mmnv 'd bqr
verses.translation: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא שָׁמְע֣וּ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יּוֹתִ֨רוּ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ עַד בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יָּ֥רֻם תּוֹלָעִ֖ים וַ/יִּבְאַ֑שׁ וַ/יִּקְצֹ֥ף עֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vl' shm'v 'l mshh vyvtrv 'nshym mmnv 'd bqr vyrm tvl'ym vyb'sh vyqtsf 'lhm mshh
verses.translation: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְקְט֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר אִ֖ישׁ כְּ/פִ֣י אָכְל֑/וֹ וְ/חַ֥ם הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְ/נָמָֽס
verses.translit: vylqtv 'tv bbqr bbqr 'ysh khpy 'khlv vchm hshmsh vnms
verses.translation: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֗י לָֽקְט֥וּ לֶ֨חֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה שְׁנֵ֥י הָ/עֹ֖מֶר לָ/אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ כָּל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה וַ/יַּגִּ֖ידוּ לְ/מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshshy lqtv lchm mshnh shny h'mr l'chd vyb'v khl nshy'y h'dh vygydv lmshh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם ה֚וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁבָּת֧וֹן שַׁבַּת קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה מָחָ֑ר אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר תֹּאפ֞וּ אֵפ֗וּ וְ/אֵ֤ת אֲשֶֽׁר תְּבַשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּשֵּׁ֔לוּ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֹדֵ֔ף הַנִּ֧יחוּ לָ/כֶ֛ם לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת עַד הַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm hv' 'shr dbr yhvh shbtvn shbt qdsh lyhvh mchr 't 'shr t'pv 'pv v't 'shr tbshlv bshlv v't khl h'df hnychv lkhm lmshmrt 'd hbqr
verses.translation: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD : bake that which ye will bake to day , and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנִּ֤יחוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ עַד הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְ/לֹ֣א הִבְאִ֔ישׁ וְ/רִמָּ֖ה לֹא הָ֥יְתָה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vynychv 'tv 'd hbqr kh'shr tsvh mshh vl' hb'ysh vrmh l' hyth bv
verses.translation: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אִכְלֻ֣/הוּ הַ/יּ֔וֹם כִּֽי שַׁבָּ֥ת הַ/יּ֖וֹם לַ/יהוָ֑ה הַ/יּ֕וֹם לֹ֥א תִמְצָאֻ֖/הוּ בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'khlhv hyvm khy shbt hyvm lyhvh hyvm l' tmts'hv bshdh
verses.translation: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD : to day ye shall not find it in the field.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תִּלְקְטֻ֑/הוּ וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֛י שַׁבָּ֖ת לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shsht ymym tlqthv vbyvm hshby'y shbt l' yhyh bv
verses.translation: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י יָצְא֥וּ מִן הָ/עָ֖ם לִ/לְקֹ֑ט וְ/לֹ֖א מָצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshby'y yts'v mn h'm llqt vl' mts'v
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה עַד אָ֨נָה֙ מֵֽאַנְתֶּ֔ם לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתַ֖/י וְ/תוֹרֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'd 'nh m'ntm lshmr mtsvty vtvrty
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

verses.original: רְא֗וּ כִּֽי יְהוָה֮ נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֣ם הַ/שַּׁבָּת֒ עַל כֵּ֠ן ה֣וּא נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֖י לֶ֣חֶם יוֹמָ֑יִם שְׁב֣וּ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֗י/ו אַל יֵ֥צֵא אִ֛ישׁ מִ/מְּקֹמ֖/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: r'v khy yhvh ntn lkhm hshbt 'l khn hv' ntn lkhm byvm hshshy lchm yvmym shbv 'ysh tchtyv 'l yts' 'ysh mmqmv byvm hshby'y
verses.translation: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

verses.translit: vyshbtv h'm byvm hshb'y
verses.translation: So the people rested on the seventh day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְא֧וּ בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ מָ֑ן וְ/ה֗וּא כְּ/זֶ֤רַע גַּד֙ לָבָ֔ן וְ/טַעְמ֖/וֹ כְּ/צַפִּיחִ֥ת בִּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyqr'v byt yshr'l 't shmv mn vhv' khzr' gd lbn vt'mv khtspycht bdbsh
verses.translation: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה זֶ֤ה הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה מְלֹ֤א הָ/עֹ֨מֶר֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן יִרְא֣וּ אֶת הַ/לֶּ֗חֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱכַ֤לְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּ/הוֹצִיאִ֥/י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh ml' h'mr mmnv lmshmrt ldrtykhm lm'n yr'v 't hlchm 'shr h'khlty 'tkhm bmdbr bhvtsy'y 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֚ח צִנְצֶ֣נֶת אַחַ֔ת וְ/תֶן שָׁ֥מָּ/ה מְלֹֽא הָ/עֹ֖מֶר מָ֑ן וְ/הַנַּ֤ח אֹת/וֹ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn qch tsntsnt 'cht vtn shmh ml' h'mr mn vhnch 'tv lpny yhvh lmshmrt ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD , to be kept for your generations.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יַּנִּיחֵ֧/הוּ אַהֲרֹ֛ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עֵדֻ֖ת לְ/מִשְׁמָֽרֶת
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'l mshh vynychhv 'hrn lpny h'dt lmshmrt
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָֽכְל֤וּ אֶת הַ/מָּן֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה עַד בֹּאָ֖/ם אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ נוֹשָׁ֑בֶת אֶת הַ/מָּן֙ אָֽכְל֔וּ עַד בֹּאָ֕/ם אֶל קְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l 'khlv 't hmn 'rb'ym shnh 'd b'm 'l 'rts nvshbt 't hmn 'khlv 'd b'm 'l qtsh 'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עֹ֕מֶר עֲשִׂרִ֥ית הָ/אֵיפָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vh'mr 'shryt h'yph hv'
verses.translation: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּסְעוּ כָּל עֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל מִ/מִּדְבַּר סִ֛ין לְ/מַסְעֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּ/רְפִידִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם לִ/שְׁתֹּ֥ת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vys'v khl 'dt bny yshr'l mmdbr syn lms'yhm 'l py yhvh vychnv brpydym v'yn mym lshtt h'm
verses.translation: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD , and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤רֶב הָ/עָם֙ עִם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ תְּנוּ לָ֥/נוּ מַ֖יִם וְ/נִשְׁתֶּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מַה תְּרִיבוּ/ן֙ עִמָּדִ֔/י מַה תְּנַסּ֖וּ/ן אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyrb h'm 'm mshh vy'mrv tnv lnv mym vnshth vy'mr lhm mshh mh trybvn 'mdy mh tnsvn 't yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְמָ֨א שָׁ֤ם הָ/עָם֙ לַ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/יָּ֥לֶן הָ/עָ֖ם עַל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לָ֤/מָּה זֶּה֙ הֶעֱלִיתָ֣/נוּ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם לְ/הָמִ֥ית אֹתִ֛/י וְ/אֶת בָּנַ֥/י וְ/אֶת מִקְנַ֖/י בַּ/צָּמָֽא
verses.translit: vytsm' shm h'm lmym vyln h'm 'l mshh vy'mr lmh zh h'lytnv mmtsrym lhmyt 'ty v't bny v't mqny btsm'
verses.translation: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעַ֤ק מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה ע֥וֹד מְעַ֖ט וּ/סְקָלֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyts'q mshh 'l yhvh l'mr mh ''shh l'm hzh 'vd m't vsqlny
verses.translation: And Moses cried unto the LORD , saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲבֹר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/קַ֥ח אִתְּ/ךָ֖ מִ/זִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/מַטְּ/ךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכִּ֤יתָ בּ/וֹ֙ אֶת הַ/יְאֹ֔ר קַ֥ח בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ וְ/הָלָֽכְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'br lpny h'm vqch 'tkh mzqny yshr'l vmtkh 'shr hkhyt bv 't hy'r qch bydkh vhlkht
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֣י עֹמֵד֩ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ שָּׁ֥ם עַֽל הַ/צּוּר֮ בְּ/חֹרֵב֒ וְ/הִכִּ֣יתָ בַ/צּ֗וּר וְ/יָצְא֥וּ מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ מַ֖יִם וְ/שָׁתָ֣ה הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hnny 'md lpnykh shm 'l htsvr bchrb vhkhyt btsvr vyts'v mmnv mym vshth h'm vy'sh khn mshh l'yny zqny yshr'l
verses.translation: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הַ/מָּק֔וֹם מַסָּ֖ה וּ/מְרִיבָ֑ה עַל רִ֣יב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/עַ֨ל נַסֹּתָ֤/ם אֶת יְהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֲ/יֵ֧שׁ יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֖/נוּ אִם אָֽיִן
verses.translit: vyqr' shm hmqvm msh vmrybh 'l ryb bny yshr'l v'l nstm 't yhvh l'mr hysh yhvh bqrbnv 'm 'yn
verses.translation: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD , saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֖א עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַ/יִּלָּ֥חֶם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּ/רְפִידִֽם
verses.translit: vyb' 'mlq vylchm 'm yshr'l brpydm
verses.translation: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בְּחַר לָ֣/נוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְ/צֵ֖א הִלָּחֵ֣ם בַּ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק מָחָ֗ר אָנֹכִ֤י נִצָּב֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/גִּבְעָ֔ה וּ/מַטֵּ֥ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l yhvsh' bchr lnv 'nshym vts' hlchm b'mlq mchr 'nkhy ntsb 'l r'sh hgb'h vmth h'lhym bydy
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמַר ל/וֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם בַּ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק וּ/מֹשֶׁה֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְ/ח֔וּר עָל֖וּ רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/גִּבְעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvsh' kh'shr 'mr lv mshh lhlchm b'mlq vmshh 'hrn vchvr 'lv r'sh hgb'h
verses.translation: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ים מֹשֶׁ֛ה יָד֖/וֹ וְ/גָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנִ֛יחַ יָד֖/וֹ וְ/גָבַ֥ר עֲמָלֵֽק
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr yrym mshh ydv vgbr yshr'l vkh'shr ynych ydv vgbr 'mlq
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

verses.original: וִ/ידֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ כְּבֵדִ֔ים וַ/יִּקְחוּ אֶ֛בֶן וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ תַחְתָּ֖י/ו וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב עָלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְ/ח֜וּר תָּֽמְכ֣וּ בְ/יָדָ֗י/ו מִ/זֶּ֤ה אֶחָד֙ וּ/מִ/זֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וַ/יְהִ֥י יָדָ֛י/ו אֱמוּנָ֖ה עַד בֹּ֥א הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vydy mshh khbdym vyqchv 'bn vyshymv tchtyv vyshb 'lyh v'hrn vchvr tmkhv bydyv mzh 'chd vmzh 'chd vyhy ydyv 'mvnh 'd b' hshmsh
verses.translation: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲלֹ֧שׁ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת עֲמָלֵ֥ק וְ/אֶת עַמּ֖/וֹ לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vychlsh yhvsh' 't 'mlq v't 'mv lpy chrb
verses.translation: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּתֹ֨ב זֹ֤את זִכָּרוֹן֙ בַּ/סֵּ֔פֶר וְ/שִׂ֖ים בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כִּֽי מָחֹ֤ה אֶמְחֶה֙ אֶת זֵ֣כֶר עֲמָלֵ֔ק מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh khtb z't zkhrvn bspr vshym b'zny yhvsh' khy mchh 'mchh 't zkhr 'mlq mtcht hshmym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥בֶן מֹשֶׁ֖ה מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה נִסִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vybn mshh mzbch vyqr' shmv yhvh nsy
verses.translation: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi: my banner

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי יָד֙ עַל כֵּ֣ס יָ֔הּ מִלְחָמָ֥ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה בַּֽ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק מִ/דֹּ֖ר דֹּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr khy yd 'l khs yh mlchmh lyhvh b'mlq mdr dr
verses.translation: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation. , therefore, etc hath…: Heb. the hand upon the throne of the LORD

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֞ע יִתְר֨וֹ כֹהֵ֤ן מִדְיָן֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/מֹשֶׁ֔ה וּ/לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshm' ytrv khhn mdyn chtn mshh 't khl 'shr 'shh 'lhym lmshh vlyshr'l 'mv khy hvtsy' yhvh 't yshr'l mmtsrym
verses.translation: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֗ח יִתְרוֹ֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת צִפֹּרָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת מֹשֶׁ֑ה אַחַ֖ר שִׁלּוּחֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyqch ytrv chtn mshh 't tsprh 'sht mshh 'chr shlvchyh
verses.translation: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: v't shny bnyh 'shr shm h'chd grshm khy 'mr gr hyyty b'rts nkhryh
verses.translation: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הָ/אֶחָ֖ד אֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר כִּֽי אֱלֹהֵ֤י אָבִ/י֙ בְּ/עֶזְרִ֔/י וַ/יַּצִּלֵ֖/נִי מֵ/חֶ֥רֶב פַּרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vshm h'chd 'ly'zr khy 'lhy 'by b'zry vytslny mchrb pr'h
verses.translation: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה וּ/בָנָ֥י/ו וְ/אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֶל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר אֲשֶׁר ה֛וּא חֹנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם הַ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' ytrv chtn mshh vbnyv v'shtv 'l mshh 'l hmdbr 'shr hv' chnh shm hr h'lhym
verses.translation: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲנִ֛י חֹתֶנְ/ךָ֥ יִתְר֖וֹ בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/אִ֨שְׁתְּ/ךָ֔ וּ/שְׁנֵ֥י בָנֶ֖י/הָ עִמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l mshh 'ny chtnkh ytrv b' 'lykh v'shtkh vshny bnyh 'mh
verses.translation: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִ/קְרַ֣את חֹֽתְנ֗/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ וַ/יִּשַּׁק ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ אִישׁ לְ/רֵעֵ֖/הוּ לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ הָ/אֹֽהֱלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' mshh lqr't chtnv vyshtchv vyshq lv vysh'lv 'ysh lr'hv lshlvm vyb'v h'hlh
verses.translation: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ לְ/חֹ֣תְנ֔/וֹ אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/פַרְעֹ֣ה וּ/לְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/תְּלָאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְצָאָ֣תַ/ם בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וַ/יַּצִּלֵ֖/ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyspr mshh lchtnv 't khl 'shr 'shh yhvh lpr'h vlmtsrym 'l 'vdt yshr'l 't khl htl'h 'shr mts'tm bdrkh vytslm yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣חַדְּ יִתְר֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצִּיל֖/וֹ מִ/יַּ֥ד מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vychd ytrv 'l khl htvbh 'shr 'shh yhvh lyshr'l 'shr htsylv myd mtsrym
verses.translation: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ יִתְרוֹ֒ בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּ֥יל אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִ/יַּ֥ד מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/מִ/יַּ֣ד פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִצִּיל֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם מִ/תַּ֖חַת יַד מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr ytrv brvkh yhvh 'shr htsyl 'tkhm myd mtsrym vmyd pr'h 'shr htsyl 't h'm mtcht yd mtsrym
verses.translation: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי גָד֥וֹל יְהוָ֖ה מִ/כָּל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י בַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָד֖וּ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'th yd'ty khy gdvl yhvh mkhl h'lhym khy bdbr 'shr zdv 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה עֹלָ֥ה וּ/זְבָחִ֖ים לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יָּבֹ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/כֹ֣ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֶ/אֱכָל לֶ֛חֶם עִם חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyqch ytrv chtn mshh 'lh vzbchym l'lhym vyb' 'hrn vkhl zqny yshr'l l'khl lchm 'm chtn mshh lpny h'lhym
verses.translation: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִ/שְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֤ד הָ/עָם֙ עַל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyshb mshh lshpt 't h'm vy'md h'm 'l mshh mn hbqr 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה לָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹשֶׂה֙ לָ/עָ֔ם מַדּ֗וּעַ אַתָּ֤ה יוֹשֵׁב֙ לְ/בַדֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֛ם נִצָּ֥ב עָלֶ֖י/ךָ מִן בֹּ֥קֶר עַד עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyr' chtn mshh 't khl 'shr hv' 'shh l'm vy'mr mh hdbr hzh 'shr 'th 'shh l'm mdv' 'th yvshb lbdkh vkhl h'm ntsb 'lykh mn bqr 'd 'rb
verses.translation: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְ/חֹתְנ֑/וֹ כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א אֵלַ֛/י הָ/עָ֖ם לִ/דְרֹ֥שׁ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lchtnv khy yb' 'ly h'm ldrsh 'lhym
verses.translation: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

verses.original: כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֨ה לָ/הֶ֤ם דָּבָר֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔/י וְ/שָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּ/בֵ֣ין רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/הוֹדַעְתִּ֛י אֶת חֻקֵּ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/אֶת תּוֹרֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy yhyh lhm dbr b' 'ly vshptty byn 'ysh vbyn r'hv vhvd'ty 't chqy h'lhym v't tvrtyv
verses.translation: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֵלָ֑י/ו לֹא טוֹב֙ הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'mr chtn mshh 'lyv l' tvb hdbr 'shr 'th 'shh
verses.translation: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

verses.original: נָבֹ֣ל תִּבֹּ֔ל גַּם אַתָּ֕ה גַּם הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּ֑/ךְ כִּֽי כָבֵ֤ד מִמְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/דָּבָ֔ר לֹא תוּכַ֥ל עֲשֹׂ֖/הוּ לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: nbl tbl gm 'th gm h'm hzh 'shr 'mkh khy khbd mmkh hdbr l' tvkhl 'shhv lbdkh
verses.translation: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

verses.original: עַתָּ֞ה שְׁמַ֤ע בְּ/קֹלִ/י֙ אִיעָ֣צְ/ךָ֔ וִ/יהִ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּ֑/ךְ הֱיֵ֧ה אַתָּ֣ה לָ/עָ֗ם מ֚וּל הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֥ אַתָּ֛ה אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'th shm' bqly 'y'tskh vyhy 'lhym 'mkh hyh 'th l'm mvl h'lhym vhb't 'th 't hdbrym 'l h'lhym
verses.translation: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

verses.original: וְ/הִזְהַרְתָּ֣ה אֶתְ/הֶ֔ם אֶת הַ/חֻקִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/תּוֹרֹ֑ת וְ/הוֹדַעְתָּ֣ לָ/הֶ֗ם אֶת הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔/הּ וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֽׂוּ/ן
verses.translit: vhzhrth 'thm 't hchqym v't htvrt vhvd't lhm 't hdrkh ylkhv bh v't hm'shh 'shr y'shvn
verses.translation: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תֶחֱזֶ֣ה מִ/כָּל הָ֠/עָם אַנְשֵׁי חַ֜יִל יִרְאֵ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י אֱמֶ֖ת שֹׂ֣נְאֵי בָ֑צַע וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֣ עֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת
verses.translit: v'th tchzh mkhl h'm 'nshy chyl yr'y 'lhym 'nshy 'mt shn'y bts' vshmt 'lhm shry 'lpym shry m'vt shry chmshym vshry 'shrt
verses.translation: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפְט֣וּ אֶת הָ/עָם֮ בְּ/כָל עֵת֒ וְ/הָיָ֞ה כָּל הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/גָּדֹל֙ יָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/כָל הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפְּטוּ הֵ֑ם וְ/הָקֵל֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/נָשְׂא֖וּ אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vshptv 't h'm bkhl 't vhyh khl hdbr hgdl yby'v 'lykh vkhl hdbr hqtn yshptv hm vhql m'lykh vnsh'v 'tkh
verses.translation: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

verses.original: אִ֣ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/צִוְּ/ךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/יָֽכָלְתָּ֖ עֲמֹ֑ד וְ/גַם֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה עַל מְקֹמ֖/וֹ יָבֹ֥א בְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'm 't hdbr hzh t'shh vtsvkh 'lhym vykhlt 'md vgm khl h'm hzh 'l mqmv yb' bshlvm
verses.translation: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְ/ק֣וֹל חֹתְנ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמָֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' mshh lqvl chtnv vy'sh khl 'shr 'mr
verses.translation: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְחַ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֤ה אַנְשֵׁי חַ֨יִל֙ מִ/כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛/ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עַל הָ/עָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת
verses.translit: vybchr mshh 'nshy chyl mkhl yshr'l vytn 'tm r'shym 'l h'm shry 'lpym shry m'vt shry chmshym vshry 'shrt
verses.translation: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/כָל עֵ֑ת אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/קָּשֶׁה֙ יְבִיא֣וּ/ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/כָל הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפּוּט֥וּ הֵֽם
verses.translit: vshptv 't h'm bkhl 't 't hdbr hqshh yby'vn 'l mshh vkhl hdbr hqtn yshpvtv hm
verses.translation: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת חֹתְנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ ל֖/וֹ אֶל אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch mshh 't chtnv vylkh lv 'l 'rtsv
verses.translation: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לְ/צֵ֥את בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: bchdsh hshlyshy lts't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym byvm hzh b'v mdbr syny
verses.translation: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֣וּ מֵ/רְפִידִ֗ים וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ/יִּֽחַן שָׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נֶ֥גֶד הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vys'v mrpydym vyb'v mdbr syny vychnv bmdbr vychn shm yshr'l ngd hhr
verses.translation: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁ֥ה עָלָ֖ה אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֤י/ו יְהוָה֙ מִן הָ/הָ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/תַגֵּ֖יד לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vmshh 'lh 'l h'lhym vyqr' 'lyv yhvh mn hhr l'mr khh t'mr lbyt y'qb vtgyd lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

verses.original: אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וָ/אֶשָּׂ֤א אֶתְ/כֶם֙ עַל כַּנְפֵ֣י נְשָׁרִ֔ים וָ/אָבִ֥א אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'tm r'ytm 'shr 'shyty lmtsrym v'sh' 'tkhm 'l khnpy nshrym v'b' 'tkhm 'ly
verses.translation: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אִם שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּ/קֹלִ֔/י וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת בְּרִיתִ֑/י וִ/הְיִ֨יתֶם לִ֤/י סְגֻלָּה֙ מִ/כָּל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים כִּי לִ֖/י כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'th 'm shmv' tshm'v bqly vshmrtm 't bryty vhyytm ly sglh mkhl h'mym khy ly khl h'rts
verses.translation: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֧ם תִּהְיוּ לִ֛/י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/ג֣וֹי קָד֑וֹשׁ אֵ֚לֶּה הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'tm thyv ly mmlkht khhnym vgvy qdvsh 'lh hdbrym 'shr tdbr 'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א לְ/זִקְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖/הוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' mshh vyqr' lzqny h'm vyshm lpnyhm 't khl hdbrym h'lh 'shr tsvhv yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנ֨וּ כָל הָ/עָ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַ/יָּ֧שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'nv khl h'm ychdv vy'mrv khl 'shr dbr yhvh n'shh vyshb mshh 't dbry h'm 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י בָּ֣א אֵלֶי/ךָ֮ בְּ/עַ֣ב הֶֽ/עָנָן֒ בַּ/עֲב֞וּר יִשְׁמַ֤ע הָ/עָם֙ בְּ/דַבְּרִ֣/י עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/גַם בְּ/ךָ֖ יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/יַּגֵּ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hnh 'nkhy b' 'lykh b'b h'nn b'bvr yshm' h'm bdbry 'mkh vgm bkh y'mynv l'vlm vygd mshh 't dbry h'm 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֥/ם הַ/יּ֖וֹם וּ/מָחָ֑ר וְ/כִבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh lkh 'l h'm vqdshtm hyvm vmchr vkhbsv shmltm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

verses.original: וְ/הָי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗י יֵרֵ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה לְ/עֵינֵ֥י כָל הָ/עָ֖ם עַל הַ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: vhyv nkhnym lyvm hshlyshy khy byvm hshlyshy yrd yhvh l'yny khl h'm 'l hr syny
verses.translation: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

verses.original: וְ/הִגְבַּלְתָּ֤ אֶת הָ/עָם֙ סָבִ֣יב לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁמְר֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם עֲל֥וֹת בָּ/הָ֖ר וּ/נְגֹ֣עַ בְּ/קָצֵ֑/הוּ כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ/הָ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vhgblt 't h'm sbyb l'mr hshmrv lkhm 'lvt bhr vng' bqtshv khl hng' bhr mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

verses.original: לֹא תִגַּ֨ע בּ֜/וֹ יָ֗ד כִּֽי סָק֤וֹל יִסָּקֵל֙ אוֹ יָרֹ֣ה יִיָּרֶ֔ה אִם בְּהֵמָ֥ה אִם אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יִחְיֶ֑ה בִּ/מְשֹׁךְ֙ הַ/יֹּבֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה יַעֲל֥וּ בָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: l' tg' bv yd khy sqvl ysql 'v yrh yyrh 'm bhmh 'm 'ysh l' ychyh bmshkh hybl hmh y'lv bhr
verses.translation: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִן הָ/הָ֖ר אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יְכַבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyrd mshh mn hhr 'l h'm vyqdsh 't h'm vykhbsv shmltm
verses.translation: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם הֱי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לִ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים אַֽל תִּגְּשׁ֖וּ אֶל אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l h'm hyv nkhnym lshlsht ymym 'l tgshv 'l 'shh
verses.translation: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽ/הְיֹ֣ת הַ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַ/יְהִי֩ קֹלֹ֨ת וּ/בְרָקִ֜ים וְ/עָנָ֤ן כָּבֵד֙ עַל הָ/הָ֔ר וְ/קֹ֥ל שֹׁפָ֖ר חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy bhyt hbqr vyhy qlt vbrqym v'nn khbd 'l hhr vql shpr chzq m'd vychrd khl h'm 'shr bmchnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת הָ/עָ֛ם לִ/קְרַ֥את הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַ/יִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּ/תַחְתִּ֥ית הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vyvts' mshh 't h'm lqr't h'lhym mn hmchnh vytytsbv btchtyt hhr
verses.translation: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֤ר סִינַי֙ עָשַׁ֣ן כֻּלּ֔/וֹ מִ֠/פְּנֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרַ֥ד עָלָ֛י/ו יְהוָ֖ה בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וַ/יַּ֤עַל עֲשָׁנ/וֹ֙ כְּ/עֶ֣שֶׁן הַ/כִּבְשָׁ֔ן וַ/יֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל הָ/הָ֖ר מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vhr syny 'shn khlv mpny 'shr yrd 'lyv yhvh b'sh vy'l 'shnv kh'shn hkhbshn vychrd khl hhr m'd
verses.translation: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ ק֣וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר הוֹלֵ֖ךְ וְ/חָזֵ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְ/הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים יַעֲנֶ֥/נּוּ בְ/קֽוֹל
verses.translit: vyhy qvl hshvpr hvlkh vchzq m'd mshh ydbr vh'lhym y'nnv bqvl
verses.translation: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧רֶד יְהוָ֛ה עַל הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י אֶל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֑ר וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א יְהוָ֧ה לְ/מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/הָ֖ר וַ/יַּ֥עַל מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh 'l hr syny 'l r'sh hhr vyqr' yhvh lmshh 'l r'sh hhr vy'l mshh
verses.translation: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּ/עָ֑ם פֶּן יֶהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל יְהוָה֙ לִ/רְא֔וֹת וְ/נָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ רָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh rd h'd b'm pn yhrsv 'l yhvh lr'vt vnpl mmnv rb
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֧ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים הַ/נִּגָּשִׁ֥ים אֶל יְהוָ֖ה יִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ פֶּן יִפְרֹ֥ץ בָּ/הֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm hkhhnym hngshym 'l yhvh ytqdshv pn yprts bhm yhvh
verses.translation: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD , sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה לֹא יוּכַ֣ל הָ/עָ֔ם לַ/עֲלֹ֖ת אֶל הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י כִּֽי אַתָּ֞ה הַעֵדֹ֤תָה בָּ֨/נוּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַגְבֵּ֥ל אֶת הָ/הָ֖ר וְ/קִדַּשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l yhvh l' yvkhl h'm l'lt 'l hr syny khy 'th h'dth bnv l'mr hgbl 't hhr vqdshtv
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤י/ו יְהוָה֙ לֶךְ רֵ֔ד וְ/עָלִ֥יתָ אַתָּ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הָ/עָ֗ם אַל יֶֽהֶרְס֛וּ לַ/עֲלֹ֥ת אֶל יְהוָ֖ה פֶּן יִפְרָץ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv yhvh lkh rd v'lyt 'th v'hrn 'mkh vhkhhnym vh'm 'l yhrsv l'lt 'l yhvh pn yprts bm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD , lest he break forth upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyrd mshh 'l h'm vy'mr 'lhm
verses.translation: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֵ֛ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhym 't khl hdbrym h'lh l'mr
verses.translation: And God spake all these words, saying,

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛י/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh 'shr hvts'tykh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

verses.original: לֹֽ֣א יִהְיֶֽה לְ/ךָ֛ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עַל פָּנָֽ/יַ
verses.translit: l' yhyh lkh 'lhym 'chrym 'l pny
verses.translation: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

verses.original: לֹֽ֣א תַֽעֲשֶׂ֨ה לְ/ךָ֥ פֶ֨סֶל֙ וְ/כָל תְּמוּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּ֔עַל וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/תָּ֑חַת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/מַּ֖יִם מִ/תַּ֥חַת לָ/אָֽרֶץ
