verses.translit: l' t'shh lkh psl vkhl tmvnh 'shr bshmym mm'l v'shr b'rts mtcht v'shr bmym mtcht l'rts
verses.translation: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

verses.original: לֹֽא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑/ם כִּ֣י אָֽנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָבֹ֧ת עַל בָּנִ֛ים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְ/עַל רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְ/שֹׂנְאָֽ/י
verses.translit: l' tshtchvh lhm vl' t'bdm khy 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh 'l qn' pqd 'vn 'bt 'l bnym 'l shlshym v'l rb'ym lshn'y
verses.translation: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

verses.original: וְ/עֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֖סֶד לַ/אֲלָפִ֑ים לְ/אֹהֲבַ֖/י וּ/לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'shh chsd l'lpym l'hby vlshmry mtsvty
verses.translation: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת שֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לַ/שָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ לַ/שָּֽׁוְא
verses.translit: l' tsh' 't shm yhvh 'lhykh lshv' khy l' ynqh yhvh 't 'shr ysh' 't shmv lshv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

verses.original: זָכ֛וֹר אֶת י֥וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֖ת לְ/קַדְּשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: zkhvr 't yvm hshbt lqdshv
verses.translation: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ כָּל מְלַאכְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'bd v'shyt khl ml'khtkh
verses.translation: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

verses.original: וְ/י֨וֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י שַׁבָּ֖ת לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹֽ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֨ה כָל מְלָאכָ֜ה אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בִנְ/ךָֽ֣ וּ/בִתֶּ֗/ךָ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֤ וַ/אֲמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ וּ/בְהֶמְתֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/גֵרְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyvm hshby'y shbt lyhvh 'lhykh l' t'shh khl ml'khh 'th vbnkh vbtkh 'bdkh v'mtkh vbhmtkh vgrkh 'shr bsh'rykh
verses.translation: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

verses.original: כִּ֣י שֵֽׁשֶׁת יָמִים֩ עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֶת הַ/יָּם֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֔/ם וַ/יָּ֖נַח בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֑י עַל כֵּ֗ן בֵּרַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת י֥וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֖ת וַֽ/יְקַדְּשֵֽׁ/הוּ
verses.translit: khy shsht ymym 'shh yhvh 't hshmym v't h'rts 't hym v't khl 'shr bm vynch byvm hshby'y 'l khn brkh yhvh 't yvm hshbt vyqdshhv
verses.translation: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֥ד אֶת אָבִ֖י/ךָ וְ/אֶת אִמֶּ֑/ךָ לְמַ֨עַן֙ יַאֲרִכ֣וּ/ן יָמֶ֔י/ךָ עַ֚ל הָ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khbd 't 'bykh v't 'mkh lm'n y'rkhvn ymykh 'l h'dmh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּרְצָֽח
verses.translit: l' trtsch
verses.translation: Thou shalt not kill.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּנְאָֽף
verses.translit: l' tn'f
verses.translation: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹֽב
verses.translit: l' tgnb
verses.translation: Thou shalt not steal.

verses.original: לֹֽא תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְ/רֵעֲ/ךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: l' t'nh br'kh 'd shqr
verses.translation: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑/ךָ לֹֽא תַחְמֹ֞ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֗/ךָ וְ/עַבְדּ֤/וֹ וַ/אֲמָת/וֹ֙ וְ/שׁוֹר֣/וֹ וַ/חֲמֹר֔/וֹ וְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/רֵעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' tchmd byt r'kh l' tchmd 'sht r'kh v'bdv v'mtv vshvrv vchmrv vkhl 'shr lr'kh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֩ רֹאִ֨ים אֶת הַ/קּוֹלֹ֜ת וְ/אֶת הַ/לַּפִּידִ֗ם וְ/אֵת֙ ק֣וֹל הַ/שֹּׁפָ֔ר וְ/אֶת הָ/הָ֖ר עָשֵׁ֑ן וַ/יַּ֤רְא הָ/עָם֙ וַ/יָּנֻ֔עוּ וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֖וּ מֵֽ/רָחֹֽק
verses.translit: vkhl h'm r'ym 't hqvlt v't hlpydm v't qvl hshpr v't hhr 'shn vyr' h'm vyn'v vy'mdv mrchq
verses.translation: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it , they removed, and stood afar off.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה דַּבֵּר אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּ֖/נוּ וְ/נִשְׁמָ֑עָה וְ/אַל יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּ֛/נוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים פֶּן נָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l mshh dbr 'th 'mnv vnshm'h v'l ydbr 'mnv 'lhym pn nmvt
verses.translation: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל הָ/עָם֮ אַל תִּירָאוּ֒ כִּ֗י לְ/בַֽ/עֲבוּר֙ נַסּ֣וֹת אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם בָּ֖א הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ/בַ/עֲב֗וּר תִּהְיֶ֧ה יִרְאָת֛/וֹ עַל פְּנֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י תֶחֱטָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l h'm 'l tyr'v khy lb'bvr nsvt 'tkhm b' h'lhym vb'bvr thyh yr'tv 'l pnykhm lblty tcht'v
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד הָ/עָ֖ם מֵ/רָחֹ֑ק וּ/מֹשֶׁה֙ נִגַּ֣שׁ אֶל הָֽ/עֲרָפֶ֔ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'md h'm mrchq vmshh ngsh 'l h'rpl 'shr shm h'lhym
verses.translation: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם כִּ֚י מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh khh t'mr 'l bny yshr'l 'tm r'ytm khy mn hshmym dbrty 'mkhm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ/ן אִתִּ֑/י אֱלֹ֤הֵי כֶ֨סֶף֙ וֵ/אלֹהֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' t'shvn 'ty 'lhy khsf v'lhy zhb l' t'shv lkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

verses.original: מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲדָמָה֮ תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּ/י֒ וְ/זָבַחְתָּ֣ עָלָ֗י/ו אֶת עֹלֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁלָמֶ֔י/ךָ אֶת צֹֽאנְ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶת בְּקָרֶ֑/ךָ בְּ/כָל הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַזְכִּ֣יר אֶת שְׁמִ֔/י אָב֥וֹא אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/בֵרַכְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mzbch 'dmh t'shh ly vzbcht 'lyv 't 'ltykh v't shlmykh 't ts'nkh v't bqrkh bkhl hmqvm 'shr 'zkhyr 't shmy 'bv' 'lykh vbrkhtykh
verses.translation: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מִזְבַּ֤ח אֲבָנִים֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לִּ֔/י לֹֽא תִבְנֶ֥ה אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן גָּזִ֑ית כִּ֧י חַרְבְּ/ךָ֛ הֵנַ֥פְתָּ עָלֶ֖י/הָ וַ/תְּחַֽלְלֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: v'm mzbch 'bnym t'shh ly l' tbnh 'thn gzyt khy chrbkh hnpt 'lyh vtchllh
verses.translation: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תַעֲלֶ֥ה בְ/מַעֲלֹ֖ת עַֽל מִזְבְּחִ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא תִגָּלֶ֥ה עֶרְוָתְ/ךָ֖ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vl' t'lh bm'lt 'l mzbchy 'shr l' tglh 'rvtkh 'lyv
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּשִׂ֖ים לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'lh hmshptym 'shr tshym lpnyhm
verses.translation: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תִקְנֶה֙ עֶ֣בֶד עִבְרִ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑ד וּ/בַ֨/שְּׁבִעִ֔ת יֵצֵ֥א לַֽ/חָפְשִׁ֖י חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: khy tqnh 'bd 'bry shsh shnym y'bd vbshb't yts' lchpshy chnm
verses.translation: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

verses.original: אִם בְּ/גַפּ֥/וֹ יָבֹ֖א בְּ/גַפּ֣/וֹ יֵצֵ֑א אִם בַּ֤עַל אִשָּׁה֙ ה֔וּא וְ/יָצְאָ֥ה אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm bgpv yb' bgpv yts' 'm b'l 'shh hv' vyts'h 'shtv 'mv
verses.translation: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

verses.original: אִם אֲדֹנָי/ו֙ יִתֶּן ל֣/וֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/יָלְדָה ל֥/וֹ בָנִ֖ים א֣וֹ בָנ֑וֹת הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה וִ/ילָדֶ֗י/הָ תִּהְיֶה֙ לַֽ/אדֹנֶ֔י/הָ וְ/ה֖וּא יֵצֵ֥א בְ/גַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm 'dnyv ytn lv 'shh vyldh lv bnym 'v bnvt h'shh vyldyh thyh l'dnyh vhv' yts' bgpv
verses.translation: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אָמֹ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ הָ/עֶ֔בֶד אָהַ֨בְתִּי֙ אֶת אֲדֹנִ֔/י אֶת אִשְׁתִּ֖/י וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֑/י לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א חָפְשִֽׁי
verses.translit: v'm 'mr y'mr h'bd 'hbty 't 'dny 't 'shty v't bny l' 'ts' chpshy
verses.translation: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

verses.original: וְ/הִגִּישׁ֤/וֹ אֲדֹנָי/ו֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/הִגִּישׁ/וֹ֙ אֶל הַ/דֶּ֔לֶת א֖וֹ אֶל הַ/מְּזוּזָ֑ה וְ/רָצַ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤י/ו אֶת אָזְנ/וֹ֙ בַּ/מַּרְצֵ֔עַ וַ/עֲבָד֖/וֹ לְ/עֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhgyshv 'dnyv 'l h'lhym vhgyshv 'l hdlt 'v 'l hmzvzh vrts' 'dnyv 't 'znv bmrts' v'bdv l'lm
verses.translation: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִמְכֹּ֥ר אִ֛ישׁ אֶת בִּתּ֖/וֹ לְ/אָמָ֑ה לֹ֥א תֵצֵ֖א כְּ/צֵ֥את הָ/עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: vkhy ymkhr 'ysh 't btv l'mh l' tts' khts't h'bdym
verses.translation: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

verses.original: אִם רָעָ֞ה בְּ/עֵינֵ֧י אֲדֹנֶ֛י/הָ אֲשֶׁר לא ל֥/וֹ יְעָדָ֖/הּ וְ/הֶפְדָּ֑/הּ לְ/עַ֥ם נָכְרִ֛י לֹא יִמְשֹׁ֥ל לְ/מָכְרָ֖/הּ בְּ/בִגְד/וֹ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'm r'h b'yny 'dnyh 'shr l' lv y'dh vhpdh l'm nkhry l' ymshl lmkhrh bbgdv bh
verses.translation: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לִ/בְנ֖/וֹ יִֽיעָדֶ֑/נָּה כְּ/מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַ/בָּנ֖וֹת יַעֲשֶׂה לָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm lbnv yy'dnh khmshpt hbnvt y'shh lh
verses.translation: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

verses.original: אִם אַחֶ֖רֶת יִֽקַּֽח ל֑/וֹ שְׁאֵרָ֛/הּ כְּסוּתָ֥/הּ וְ/עֹנָתָ֖/הּ לֹ֥א יִגְרָֽע
verses.translit: 'm 'chrt yqch lv sh'rh khsvth v'nth l' ygr'
verses.translation: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

verses.original: וְ/אִם שְׁלָ֨שׁ אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לָ֑/הּ וְ/יָצְאָ֥ה חִנָּ֖ם אֵ֥ין כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'm shlsh 'lh l' y'shh lh vyts'h chnm 'yn khsf
verses.translation: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

verses.original: מַכֵּ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ וָ/מֵ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: mkhh 'ysh vmt mvt yvmt
verses.translation: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צָדָ֔ה וְ/הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אִנָּ֣ה לְ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י לְ/ךָ֙ מָק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: v'shr l' tsdh vh'lhym 'nh lydv vshmty lkh mqvm 'shr ynvs shmh
verses.translation: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָזִ֥ד אִ֛ישׁ עַל רֵעֵ֖/הוּ לְ/הָרְג֣/וֹ בְ/עָרְמָ֑ה מֵ/עִ֣ם מִזְבְּחִ֔/י תִּקָּחֶ֖/נּוּ לָ/מֽוּת
verses.translit: vkhy yzd 'ysh 'l r'hv lhrgv b'rmh m'm mzbchy tqchnv lmvt
verses.translation: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

verses.original: וּ/מַכֵּ֥ה אָבִ֛י/ו וְ/אִמּ֖/וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vmkhh 'byv v'mv mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

verses.original: וְ/גֹנֵ֨ב אִ֧ישׁ וּ/מְכָר֛/וֹ וְ/נִמְצָ֥א בְ/יָד֖/וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vgnb 'ysh vmkhrv vnmts' bydv mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וּ/מְקַלֵּ֥ל אָבִ֛י/ו וְ/אִמּ֖/וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vmqll 'byv v'mv mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יְרִיבֻ֣/ן אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְ/הִכָּה אִישׁ֙ אֶת רֵעֵ֔/הוּ בְּ/אֶ֖בֶן א֣וֹ בְ/אֶגְרֹ֑ף וְ/לֹ֥א יָמ֖וּת וְ/נָפַ֥ל לְ/מִשְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: vkhy yrybn 'nshym vhkhh 'ysh 't r'hv b'bn 'v b'grf vl' ymvt vnpl lmshkhb
verses.translation: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

verses.original: אִם יָק֞וּם וְ/הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּ/ח֛וּץ עַל מִשְׁעַנְתּ֖/וֹ וְ/נִקָּ֣ה הַ/מַּכֶּ֑ה רַ֥ק שִׁבְתּ֛/וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן וְ/רַפֹּ֥א יְרַפֵּֽא
verses.translit: 'm yqvm vhthlkh bchvts 'l msh'ntv vnqh hmkhh rq shbtv ytn vrp' yrp'
verses.translation: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יַכֶּה֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶת עַבְדּ֜/וֹ א֤וֹ אֶת אֲמָת/וֹ֙ בַּ/שֵּׁ֔בֶט וּ/מֵ֖ת תַּ֣חַת יָד֑/וֹ נָקֹ֖ם יִנָּקֵֽם
verses.translit: vkhy ykhh 'ysh 't 'bdv 'v 't 'mtv bshbt vmt tcht ydv nqm ynqm
verses.translation: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אִם י֛וֹם א֥וֹ יוֹמַ֖יִם יַעֲמֹ֑ד לֹ֣א יֻקַּ֔ם כִּ֥י כַסְפּ֖/וֹ הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'kh 'm yvm 'v yvmym y'md l' yqm khy khspv hv'
verses.translation: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִנָּצ֣וּ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וְ/נָ֨גְפ֜וּ אִשָּׁ֤ה הָרָה֙ וְ/יָצְא֣וּ יְלָדֶ֔י/הָ וְ/לֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה אָס֑וֹן עָנ֣וֹשׁ יֵעָנֵ֗שׁ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׁ֤ית עָלָי/ו֙ בַּ֣עַל הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/נָתַ֖ן בִּ/פְלִלִֽים
verses.translit: vkhy yntsv 'nshym vngpv 'shh hrh vyts'v yldyh vl' yhyh 'svn 'nvsh y'nsh kh'shr yshyt 'lyv b'l h'shh vntn bpllym
verses.translation: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine .

verses.original: וְ/אִם אָס֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֑ה וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'm 'svn yhyh vntth npsh tcht npsh
verses.translation: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

verses.original: עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן יָ֚ד תַּ֣חַת יָ֔ד רֶ֖גֶל תַּ֥חַת רָֽגֶל
verses.translit: 'yn tcht 'yn shn tcht shn yd tcht yd rgl tcht rgl
verses.translation: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.original: כְּוִיָּה֙ תַּ֣חַת כְּוִיָּ֔ה פֶּ֖צַע תַּ֣חַת פָּ֑צַע חַבּוּרָ֕ה תַּ֖חַת חַבּוּרָֽה
verses.translit: khvyh tcht khvyh pts' tcht pts' chbvrh tcht chbvrh
verses.translation: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יַכֶּ֨ה אִ֜ישׁ אֶת עֵ֥ין עַבְדּ֛/וֹ אֽוֹ אֶת עֵ֥ין אֲמָת֖/וֹ וְ/שִֽׁחֲתָ֑/הּ לַֽ/חָפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖/נּוּ תַּ֥חַת עֵינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhy ykhh 'ysh 't 'yn 'bdv 'v 't 'yn 'mtv vshchth lchpshy yshlchnv tcht 'ynv
verses.translation: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

verses.original: וְ/אִם שֵׁ֥ן עַבְדּ֛/וֹ אֽוֹ שֵׁ֥ן אֲמָת֖/וֹ יַפִּ֑יל לַֽ/חָפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖/נּוּ תַּ֥חַת שִׁנּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm shn 'bdv 'v shn 'mtv ypyl lchpshy yshlchnv tcht shnv
verses.translation: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִגַּ֨ח שׁ֥וֹר אֶת אִ֛ישׁ א֥וֹ אֶת אִשָּׁ֖ה וָ/מֵ֑ת סָק֨וֹל יִסָּקֵ֜ל הַ/שּׁ֗וֹר וְ/לֹ֤א יֵאָכֵל֙ אֶת בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ וּ/בַ֥עַל הַ/שּׁ֖וֹר נָקִֽי
verses.translit: vkhy ygch shvr 't 'ysh 'v 't 'shh vmt sqvl ysql hshvr vl' y'khl 't bshrv vb'l hshvr nqy
verses.translation: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֡ם שׁוֹר֩ נַגָּ֨ח ה֜וּא מִ/תְּמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֗ם וְ/הוּעַ֤ד בִּ/בְעָלָי/ו֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְרֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/הֵמִ֥ית אִ֖ישׁ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה הַ/שּׁוֹר֙ יִסָּקֵ֔ל וְ/גַם בְּעָלָ֖י/ו יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: v'm shvr ngch hv' mtml shlshm vhv'd bb'lyv vl' yshmrnv vhmyt 'ysh 'v 'shh hshvr ysql vgm b'lyv yvmt
verses.translation: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

verses.original: אִם כֹּ֖פֶר יוּשַׁ֣ת עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נָתַן֙ פִּדְיֹ֣ן נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יוּשַׁ֖ת עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'm khpr yvsht 'lyv vntn pdyn npshv khkhl 'shr yvsht 'lyv
verses.translation: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

verses.original: אוֹ בֵ֥ן יִגָּ֖ח אוֹ בַ֣ת יִגָּ֑ח כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַ/זֶּ֖ה יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'v bn ygch 'v bt ygch khmshpt hzh y'shh lv
verses.translation: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

verses.original: אִם עֶ֛בֶד יִגַּ֥ח הַ/שּׁ֖וֹר א֣וֹ אָמָ֑ה כֶּ֣סֶף שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים יִתֵּן֙ לַֽ/אדֹנָ֔י/ו וְ/הַ/שּׁ֖וֹר יִסָּקֵֽל
verses.translit: 'm 'bd ygch hshvr 'v 'mh khsf shlshym shqlym ytn l'dnyv vhshvr ysql
verses.translation: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִפְתַּ֨ח אִ֜ישׁ בּ֗וֹר א֠וֹ כִּֽי יִכְרֶ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ בֹּ֖ר וְ/לֹ֣א יְכַסֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/נָֽפַל שָׁ֥מָּ/ה שּׁ֖וֹר א֥וֹ חֲמֽוֹר
verses.translit: vkhy yptch 'ysh bvr 'v khy ykhrh 'ysh br vl' ykhsnv vnpl shmh shvr 'v chmvr
verses.translation: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

verses.original: בַּ֤עַל הַ/בּוֹר֙ יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם כֶּ֖סֶף יָשִׁ֣יב לִ/בְעָלָ֑י/ו וְ/הַ/מֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b'l hbvr yshlm khsf yshyb lb'lyv vhmt yhyh lv
verses.translation: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִגֹּ֧ף שֽׁוֹר אִ֛ישׁ אֶת שׁ֥וֹר רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וָ/מֵ֑ת וּ/מָ֨כְר֜וּ אֶת הַ/שּׁ֤וֹר הַ/חַי֙ וְ/חָצ֣וּ אֶת כַּסְפּ֔/וֹ וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת הַ/מֵּ֖ת יֶֽחֱצֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vkhy ygf shvr 'ysh 't shvr r'hv vmt vmkhrv 't hshvr hchy vchtsv 't khspv vgm 't hmt ychtsvn
verses.translation: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

verses.original: א֣וֹ נוֹדַ֗ע כִּ֠י שׁ֣וֹר נַגָּ֥ח הוּא֙ מִ/תְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א יִשְׁמְרֶ֖/נּוּ בְּעָלָ֑י/ו שַׁלֵּ֨ם יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שׁוֹר֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/שּׁ֔וֹר וְ/הַ/מֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'v nvd' khy shvr ngch hv' mtmvl shlshm vl' yshmrnv b'lyv shlm yshlm shvr tcht hshvr vhmt yhyh lv
verses.translation: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

verses.original: אִם בַּ/מַּחְתֶּ֛רֶת יִמָּצֵ֥א הַ/גַּנָּ֖ב וְ/הֻכָּ֣ה וָ/מֵ֑ת אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ דָּמִֽים
verses.translit: 'm bmchtrt ymts' hgnb vhkhh vmt 'yn lv dmym
verses.translation: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

verses.original: אִם זָרְחָ֥ה הַ/שֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ עָלָ֖י/ו דָּמִ֣ים ל֑/וֹ שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם אִם אֵ֣ין ל֔/וֹ וְ/נִמְכַּ֖ר בִּ/גְנֵבָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm zrchh hshmsh 'lyv dmym lv shlm yshlm 'm 'yn lv vnmkhr bgnbtv
verses.translation: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

verses.original: אִֽם הִמָּצֵא֩ תִמָּצֵ֨א בְ/יָד֜/וֹ הַ/גְּנֵבָ֗ה מִ/שּׁ֧וֹר עַד חֲמ֛וֹר עַד שֶׂ֖ה חַיִּ֑ים שְׁנַ֖יִם יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: 'm hmts' tmts' bydv hgnbh mshvr 'd chmvr 'd shh chyym shnym yshlm
verses.translation: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יַבְעֶר אִישׁ֙ שָׂדֶ֣ה אוֹ כֶ֔רֶם וְ/שִׁלַּח֙ אֶת בעיר/ה בְּעִיר֔/וֹ וּ/בִעֵ֖ר בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר מֵיטַ֥ב שָׂדֵ֛/הוּ וּ/מֵיטַ֥ב כַּרְמ֖/וֹ יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: khy yb'r 'ysh shdh 'v khrm vshlch 't b'yrh b'yrv vb'r bshdh 'chr mytb shdhv vmytb khrmv yshlm
verses.translation: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

verses.original: כִּֽי תֵצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ וּ/מָצְאָ֤ה קֹצִים֙ וְ/נֶאֱכַ֣ל גָּדִ֔ישׁ א֥וֹ הַ/קָּמָ֖ה א֣וֹ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם הַ/מַּבְעִ֖ר אֶת הַ/בְּעֵרָֽה
verses.translit: khy tts' 'sh vmts'h qtsym vn'khl gdysh 'v hqmh 'v hshdh shlm yshlm hmb'r 't hb'rh
verses.translation: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֜/הוּ כֶּ֤סֶף אֽוֹ כֵלִים֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֔ר וְ/גֻנַּ֖ב מִ/בֵּ֣ית הָ/אִ֑ישׁ אִם יִמָּצֵ֥א הַ/גַּנָּ֖ב יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy ytn 'ysh 'l r'hv khsf 'v khlym lshmr vgnb mbyt h'ysh 'm ymts' hgnb yshlm shnym
verses.translation: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֤א יִמָּצֵא֙ הַ/גַּנָּ֔ב וְ/נִקְרַ֥ב בַּֽעַל הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֶל הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים אִם לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖/וֹ בִּ/מְלֶ֥אכֶת רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'm l' ymts' hgnb vnqrb b'l hbyt 'l h'lhym 'm l' shlch ydv bml'kht r'hv
verses.translation: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

verses.original: עַֽל כָּל דְּבַר פֶּ֡שַׁע עַל שׁ֡וֹר עַל חֲ֠מוֹר עַל שֶׂ֨ה עַל שַׂלְמָ֜ה עַל כָּל אֲבֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ כִּי ה֣וּא זֶ֔ה עַ֚ד הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים יָבֹ֖א דְּבַר שְׁנֵי/הֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַרְשִׁיעֻ/ן֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם לְ/רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'l khl dbr psh' 'l shvr 'l chmvr 'l shh 'l shlmh 'l khl 'bdh 'shr y'mr khy hv' zh 'd h'lhym yb' dbr shnyhm 'shr yrshy'n 'lhym yshlm shnym lr'hv
verses.translation: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֜/הוּ חֲמ֨וֹר אוֹ שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ שֶׂ֛ה וְ/כָל בְּהֵמָ֖ה לִ/שְׁמֹ֑ר וּ/מֵ֛ת אוֹ נִשְׁבַּ֥ר אוֹ נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אֵ֥ין רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: khy ytn 'ysh 'l r'hv chmvr 'v shvr 'v shh vkhl bhmh lshmr vmt 'v nshbr 'v nshbh 'yn r'h
verses.translation: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

verses.original: שְׁבֻעַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה תִּהְיֶה֙ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם אִם לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖/וֹ בִּ/מְלֶ֣אכֶת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/לָקַ֥ח בְּעָלָ֖י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: shb't yhvh thyh byn shnyhm 'm l' shlch ydv bml'kht r'hv vlqch b'lyv vl' yshlm
verses.translation: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

verses.original: וְ/אִם גָּנֹ֥ב יִגָּנֵ֖ב מֵ/עִמּ֑/וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לִ/בְעָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'm gnb ygnb m'mv yshlm lb'lyv
verses.translation: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof , and he shall not make it good.

verses.original: אִם טָרֹ֥ף יִטָּרֵ֖ף יְבִאֵ֣/הוּ עֵ֑ד הַ/טְּרֵפָ֖ה לֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: 'm trf ytrf yb'hv 'd htrph l' yshlm
verses.translation: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִשְׁאַ֥ל אִ֛ישׁ מֵ/עִ֥ם רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וְ/נִשְׁבַּ֣ר אוֹ מֵ֑ת בְּעָלָ֥י/ו אֵין עִמּ֖/וֹ שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: vkhy ysh'l 'ysh m'm r'hv vnshbr 'v mt b'lyv 'yn 'mv shlm yshlm
verses.translation: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

verses.original: אִם בְּעָלָ֥י/ו עִמּ֖/וֹ לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם אִם שָׂכִ֣יר ה֔וּא בָּ֖א בִּ/שְׂכָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm b'lyv 'mv l' yshlm 'm shkhyr hv' b' bshkhrv
verses.translation: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יְפַתֶּ֣ה אִ֗ישׁ בְּתוּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא אֹרָ֖שָׂה וְ/שָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑/הּ מָהֹ֛ר יִמְהָרֶ֥/נָּה לּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vkhy ypth 'ysh btvlh 'shr l' 'rshh vshkhb 'mh mhr ymhrnh lv l'shh
verses.translation: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing , it came for his hire.

verses.original: אִם מָאֵ֧ן יְמָאֵ֛ן אָבִ֖י/הָ לְ/תִתָּ֣/הּ ל֑/וֹ כֶּ֣סֶף יִשְׁקֹ֔ל כְּ/מֹ֖הַר הַ/בְּתוּלֹֽת
verses.translit: 'm m'n ym'n 'byh ltth lv khsf yshql khmhr hbtvlt
verses.translation: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

verses.original: מְכַשֵּׁפָ֖ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּֽה
verses.translit: mkhshph l' tchyh
verses.translation: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

verses.original: כָּל שֹׁכֵ֥ב עִם בְּהֵמָ֖ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: khl shkhb 'm bhmh mvt yvmt
verses.translation: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

verses.original: זֹבֵ֥חַ לָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים יָֽחֳרָ֑ם בִּלְתִּ֥י לַ/יהוָ֖ה לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zbch l'lhym ychrm blty lyhvh lbdv
verses.translation: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/גֵ֥ר לֹא תוֹנֶ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א תִלְחָצֶ֑/נּוּ כִּֽי גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vgr l' tvnh vl' tlchtsnv khy grym hyytm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

verses.original: כָּל אַלְמָנָ֥ה וְ/יָת֖וֹם לֹ֥א תְעַנּֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: khl 'lmnh vytvm l' t'nvn
verses.translation: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: אִם עַנֵּ֥ה תְעַנֶּ֖ה אֹת֑/וֹ כִּ֣י אִם צָעֹ֤ק יִצְעַק֙ אֵלַ֔/י שָׁמֹ֥עַ אֶשְׁמַ֖ע צַעֲקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm 'nh t'nh 'tv khy 'm ts'q yts'q 'ly shm' 'shm' ts'qtv
verses.translation: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

verses.original: וְ/חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔/י וְ/הָרַגְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב וְ/הָי֤וּ נְשֵׁי/כֶם֙ אַלְמָנ֔וֹת וּ/בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם יְתֹמִֽים
verses.translit: vchrh 'py vhrgty 'tkhm bchrb vhyv nshykhm 'lmnvt vbnykhm ytmym
verses.translation: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

verses.original: אִם כֶּ֣סֶף תַּלְוֶ֣ה אֶת עַמִּ֗/י אֶת הֶֽ/עָנִי֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ לֹא תִהְיֶ֥ה ל֖/וֹ כְּ/נֹשֶׁ֑ה לֹֽא תְשִׂימ֥וּ/ן עָלָ֖י/ו נֶֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: 'm khsf tlvh 't 'my 't h'ny 'mkh l' thyh lv khnshh l' tshymvn 'lyv nshkh
verses.translation: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

verses.original: אִם חָבֹ֥ל תַּחְבֹּ֖ל שַׂלְמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֑/ךָ עַד בֹּ֥א הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶ֥/נּוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm chbl tchbl shlmt r'kh 'd b' hshmsh tshybnv lv
verses.translation: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִ֤וא כסות/ה כְסוּת/וֹ֙ לְ/בַדָּ֔/הּ הִ֥וא שִׂמְלָת֖/וֹ לְ/עֹר֑/וֹ בַּ/מֶּ֣ה יִשְׁכָּ֔ב וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּֽי יִצְעַ֣ק אֵלַ֔/י וְ/שָׁמַעְתִּ֖י כִּֽי חַנּ֥וּן אָֽנִי
verses.translit: khy hv' khsvth khsvtv lbdh hv' shmltv l'rv bmh yshkhb vhyh khy yts'q 'ly vshm'ty khy chnvn 'ny
verses.translation: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א תְקַלֵּ֑ל וְ/נָשִׂ֥יא בְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א תָאֹֽר
verses.translit: 'lhym l' tqll vnshy' b'mkh l' t'r
verses.translation: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

verses.original: מְלֵאָתְ/ךָ֥ וְ/דִמְעֲ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנֶ֖י/ךָ תִּתֶּן לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: ml'tkh vdm'kh l' t'chr bkhvr bnykh ttn ly
verses.translation: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

verses.original: כֵּֽן תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְ/שֹׁרְ/ךָ֖ לְ/צֹאנֶ֑/ךָ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עִם אִמּ֔/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֖י תִּתְּנ/וֹ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khn t'shh lshrkh lts'nkh shb't ymym yhyh 'm 'mv byvm hshmyny ttnv ly
verses.translation: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

verses.original: וְ/אַנְשֵׁי קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְי֣וּ/ן לִ֑/י וּ/בָשָׂ֨ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֤ה טְרֵפָה֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ לַ/כֶּ֖לֶב תַּשְׁלִכ֥וּ/ן אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'nshy qdsh thyvn ly vbshr bshdh trph l' t'khlv lkhlb tshlkhvn 'tv
verses.translation: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֖א שֵׁ֣מַע שָׁ֑וְא אַל תָּ֤שֶׁת יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ עִם רָשָׁ֔ע לִ/הְיֹ֖ת עֵ֥ד חָמָֽס
verses.translit: l' tsh' shm' shv' 'l tsht ydkh 'm rsh' lhyt 'd chms
verses.translation: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

verses.original: לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרֵֽי רַבִּ֖ים לְ/רָעֹ֑ת וְ/לֹא תַעֲנֶ֣ה עַל רִ֗ב לִ/נְטֹ֛ת אַחֲרֵ֥י רַבִּ֖ים לְ/הַטֹּֽת
verses.translit: l' thyh 'chry rbym lr't vl' t'nh 'l rb lntt 'chry rbym lhtt
verses.translation: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

verses.original: וְ/דָ֕ל לֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר בְּ/רִיבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vdl l' thdr brybv
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִפְגַּ֞ע שׁ֧וֹר אֹֽיִבְ/ךָ֛ א֥וֹ חֲמֹר֖/וֹ תֹּעֶ֑ה הָשֵׁ֥ב תְּשִׁיבֶ֖/נּוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tpg' shvr 'ybkh 'v chmrv t'h hshb tshybnv lv
verses.translation: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

verses.original: כִּֽי תִרְאֶ֞ה חֲמ֣וֹר שֹׂנַאֲ/ךָ֗ רֹבֵץ֙ תַּ֣חַת מַשָּׂא֔/וֹ וְ/חָדַלְתָּ֖ מֵ/עֲזֹ֣ב ל֑/וֹ עָזֹ֥ב תַּעֲזֹ֖ב עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tr'h chmvr shn'kh rbts tcht msh'v vchdlt m'zb lv 'zb t'zb 'mv
verses.translation: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיֹנְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/רִיבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' tth mshpt 'bynkh brybv
verses.translation: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

verses.original: מִ/דְּבַר שֶׁ֖קֶר תִּרְחָ֑ק וְ/נָקִ֤י וְ/צַדִּיק֙ אַֽל תַּהֲרֹ֔ג כִּ֥י לֹא אַצְדִּ֖יק רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: mdbr shqr trchq vnqy vtsdyq 'l thrg khy l' 'tsdyq rsh'
verses.translation: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

verses.original: וְ/שֹׁ֖חַד לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח כִּ֤י הַ/שֹּׁ֨חַד֙ יְעַוֵּ֣ר פִּקְחִ֔ים וִֽ/יסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽים
verses.translit: vshchd l' tqch khy hshchd y'vr pqchym vyslf dbry tsdyqym
verses.translation: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

verses.original: וְ/גֵ֖ר לֹ֣א תִלְחָ֑ץ וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם יְדַעְתֶּם֙ אֶת נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַ/גֵּ֔ר כִּֽי גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vgr l' tlchts v'tm yd'tm 't npsh hgr khy grym hyytm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vshsh shnym tzr' 't 'rtskh v'spt 't tbv'th
verses.translation: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֞ת תִּשְׁמְטֶ֣/נָּה וּ/נְטַשְׁתָּ֗/הּ וְ/אָֽכְלוּ֙ אֶבְיֹנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/יִתְרָ֕/ם תֹּאכַ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה כֵּֽן תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְ/כַרְמְ/ךָ֖ לְ/זֵיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhshby't tshmtnh vntshth v'khlv 'byny 'mkh vytrm t'khl chyt hshdh khn t'shh lkhrmkh lzytkh
verses.translation: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔י/ךָ וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת לְמַ֣עַן יָנ֗וּחַ שֽׁוֹרְ/ךָ֙ וַ/חֲמֹרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/יִנָּפֵ֥שׁ בֶּן אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/הַ/גֵּֽר
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'shh m'shykh vbyvm hshby'y tshbt lm'n ynvch shvrkh vchmrkh vynpsh bn 'mtkh vhgr
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּשָּׁמֵ֑רוּ וְ/שֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לֹ֣א תַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עַל פִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vbkhl 'shr 'mrty 'lykhm tshmrv vshm 'lhym 'chrym l' tzkhyrv l' yshm' 'l pykh
verses.translation: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֔ים תָּחֹ֥ג לִ֖/י בַּ/שָּׁנָֽה
verses.translit: shlsh rglym tchg ly bshnh
verses.translation: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

verses.original: אֶת חַ֣ג הַ/מַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִים֩ תֹּאכַ֨ל מַצּ֜וֹת כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֗/ךָ לְ/מוֹעֵד֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/אָבִ֔יב כִּי ב֖/וֹ יָצָ֣אתָ מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לֹא יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖/י רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: 't chg hmtsvt tshmr shb't ymym t'khl mtsvt kh'shr tsvytkh lmv'd chdsh h'byb khy bv yts't mmtsrym vl' yr'v pny ryqm
verses.translation: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

verses.original: וְ/חַ֤ג הַ/קָּצִיר֙ בִּכּוּרֵ֣י מַעֲשֶׂ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּזְרַ֖ע בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וְ/חַ֤ג הָֽ/אָסִף֙ בְּ/צֵ֣את הַ/שָּׁנָ֔ה בְּ/אָסְפְּ/ךָ֥ אֶֽת מַעֲשֶׂ֖י/ךָ מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vchg hqtsyr bkhvry m'shykh 'shr tzr' bshdh vchg h'sf bts't hshnh b'spkh 't m'shykh mn hshdh
verses.translation: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל זְכ֣וּרְ/ךָ֔ אֶל פְּנֵ֖י הָ/אָדֹ֥ן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shlsh p'mym bshnh yr'h khl zkhvrkh 'l pny h'dn yhvh
verses.translation: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD .

verses.original: לֹֽא תִזְבַּ֥ח עַל חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם זִבְחִ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא יָלִ֥ין חֵֽלֶב חַגִּ֖/י עַד בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: l' tzbch 'l chmts dm zbchy vl' ylyn chlb chgy 'd bqr
verses.translation: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹֽא תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּ/חֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: r'shyt bkhvry 'dmtkh tby' byt yhvh 'lhykh l' tbshl gdy bchlb 'mv
verses.translation: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ מַלְאָךְ֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמָרְ/ךָ֖ בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ/לַ/הֲבִ֣יאֲ/ךָ֔ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲכִנֹֽתִי
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy shlch ml'kh lpnykh lshmrkh bdrkh vlhby'kh 'l hmqvm 'shr hkhnty
verses.translation: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

verses.translit: hshmr mpnyv vshm' bqlv 'l tmr bv khy l' ysh' lpsh'khm khy shmy bqrbv
verses.translation: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּ/קֹל֔/וֹ וְ/עָשִׂ֕יתָ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְ/אָֽיַבְתִּי֙ אֶת אֹ֣יְבֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/צַרְתִּ֖י אֶת צֹרְרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'm shm' tshm' bqlv v'shyt khl 'shr 'dbr v'ybty 't 'ybykh vtsrty 't tsrrykh
verses.translation: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

verses.original: כִּֽי יֵלֵ֣ךְ מַלְאָכִ/י֮ לְ/פָנֶי/ךָ֒ וֶ/הֱבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֗ אֶל הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ וְ/הַ֣/חִתִּ֔י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּי֙ וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֑י וְ/הִכְחַדְתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy ylkh ml'khy lpnykh vhby'kh 'l h'mry vhchty vhprzy vhkhn'ny hchvy vhybvsy vhkhchdtyv
verses.translation: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

verses.original: לֹֽא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֤ה לֵ/אלֹֽהֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תָֽעָבְדֵ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כְּ/מַֽעֲשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֤י הָרֵס֙ תְּהָ֣רְסֵ֔/ם וְ/שַׁבֵּ֥ר תְּשַׁבֵּ֖ר מַצֵּבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: l' tshtchvh l'lhyhm vl' t'bdm vl' t'shh khm'shyhm khy hrs thrsm vshbr tshbr mtsbtyhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

verses.original: וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֵרַ֥ךְ אֶֽת לַחְמְ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶת מֵימֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/הֲסִרֹתִ֥י מַחֲלָ֖ה מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'bdtm 't yhvh 'lhykhm vbrkh 't lchmkh v't mymykh vhsrty mchlh mqrbkh
verses.translation: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֛ה מְשַׁכֵּלָ֥ה וַ/עֲקָרָ֖ה בְּ/אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ אֶת מִסְפַּ֥ר יָמֶ֖י/ךָ אֲמַלֵּֽא
verses.translit: l' thyh mshkhlh v'qrh b'rtskh 't mspr ymykh 'ml'
verses.translation: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

verses.original: אֶת אֵֽימָתִ/י֙ אֲשַׁלַּ֣ח לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הַמֹּתִי֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖א בָּ/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֧י אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶ֛י/ךָ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ עֹֽרֶף
verses.translit: 't 'ymty 'shlch lpnykh vhmty 't khl h'm 'shr tb' bhm vntty 't khl 'ybykh 'lykh 'rf
verses.translation: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁלַחְתִּ֥י אֶת הַ/צִּרְעָ֖ה לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/גֵרְשָׁ֗ה אֶת הַ/חִוִּ֧י אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֛י וְ/אֶת הַ/חִתִּ֖י מִ/לְּ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vshlchty 't htsr'h lpnykh vgrshh 't hchvy 't hkhn'ny v't hchty mlpnykh
verses.translation: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

verses.original: לֹ֧א אֲגָרְשֶׁ֛/נּוּ מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/שָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת פֶּן תִּהְיֶ֤ה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְ/רַבָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/ךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: l' 'grshnv mpnykh bshnh 'cht pn thyh h'rts shmmh vrbh 'lykh chyt hshdh
verses.translation: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

verses.original: מְעַ֥ט מְעַ֛ט אֲגָרְשֶׁ֖/נּוּ מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְרֶ֔ה וְ/נָחַלְתָּ֖ אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: m't m't 'grshnv mpnykh 'd 'shr tprh vnchlt 't h'rts
verses.translation: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁתִּ֣י אֶת גְּבֻלְ/ךָ֗ מִ/יַּם סוּף֙ וְ/עַד יָ֣ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/מִ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר עַד הַ/נָּהָ֑ר כִּ֣י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/גֵרַשְׁתָּ֖/מוֹ מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vshty 't gblkh mym svf v'd ym plshtym vmmdbr 'd hnhr khy 'tn bydkhm 't yshby h'rts vgrshtmv mpnykh
verses.translation: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

verses.original: לֹֽא תִכְרֹ֥ת לָ/הֶ֛ם וְ/לֵ/אלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: l' tkhrt lhm vl'lhyhm bryt
verses.translation: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יֵשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ פֶּן יַחֲטִ֥יאוּ אֹתְ/ךָ֖ לִ֑/י כִּ֤י תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/מוֹקֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: l' yshbv b'rtskh pn ychty'v 'tkh ly khy t'bd 't 'lhyhm khy yhyh lkh lmvqsh
verses.translation: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מֹשֶׁ֨ה אָמַ֜ר עֲלֵ֣ה אֶל יְהוָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְ/אַהֲרֹן֙ נָדָ֣ב וַ/אֲבִיה֔וּא וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים מִ/זִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם מֵ/רָחֹֽק
verses.translit: v'l mshh 'mr 'lh 'l yhvh 'th v'hrn ndb v'byhv' vshb'ym mzqny yshr'l vhshtchvytm mrchq
verses.translation: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD , thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

verses.original: וְ/נִגַּ֨שׁ מֹשֶׁ֤ה לְ/בַדּ/וֹ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הֵ֖ם לֹ֣א יִגָּ֑שׁוּ וְ/הָ/עָ֕ם לֹ֥א יַעֲל֖וּ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vngsh mshh lbdv 'l yhvh vhm l' ygshv vh'm l' y'lv 'mv
verses.translation: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD : but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יְסַפֵּ֤ר לָ/עָם֙ אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֨עַן כָּל הָ/עָ֜ם ק֤וֹל אֶחָד֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyb' mshh vyspr l'm 't khl dbry yhvh v't khl hmshptym vy'n khl h'm qvl 'chd vy'mrv khl hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh n'shh
verses.translation: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD , and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ תַּ֣חַת הָ/הָ֑ר וּ/שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה לִ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 't khl dbry yhvh vyshkhm bbqr vybn mzbch tcht hhr vshtym 'shrh mtsbh lshnym 'shr shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD , and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶֽת נַעֲרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּֽעֲל֖וּ עֹלֹ֑ת וַֽ/יִּזְבְּח֞וּ זְבָחִ֧ים שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַ/יהוָ֖ה פָּרִֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch 't n'ry bny yshr'l vy'lv 'lt vyzbchv zbchym shlmym lyhvh prym
verses.translation: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ חֲצִ֣י הַ/דָּ֔ם וַ/יָּ֖שֶׂם בָּ/אַגָּנֹ֑ת וַ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/דָּ֔ם זָרַ֖ק עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqch mshh chtsy hdm vyshm b'gnt vchtsy hdm zrq 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַ/בְּרִ֔ית וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְ/נִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: vyqch spr hbryt vyqr' b'zny h'm vy'mrv khl 'shr dbr yhvh n'shh vnshm'
verses.translation: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם וַ/יִּזְרֹ֖ק עַל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה דַֽם הַ/בְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם עַ֥ל כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't hdm vyzrq 'l h'm vy'mr hnh dm hbryt 'shr khrt yhvh 'mkhm 'l khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן נָדָב֙ וַ/אֲבִיה֔וּא וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים מִ/זִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'l mshh v'hrn ndb v'byhv' vshb'ym mzqny yshr'l
verses.translation: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֕וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/תַ֣חַת רַגְלָ֗י/ו כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂה֙ לִבְנַ֣ת הַ/סַּפִּ֔יר וּ/כְ/עֶ֥צֶם הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם לָ/טֹֽהַר
verses.translit: vyr'v 't 'lhy yshr'l vtcht rglyv khm'shh lbnt hspyr vkh'tsm hshmym lthr
verses.translation: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל אֲצִילֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֖ח יָד֑/וֹ וַֽ/יֶּחֱזוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יֹּאכְל֖וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: v'l 'tsyly bny yshr'l l' shlch ydv vychzv 't h'lhym vy'khlv vyshtv
verses.translation: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֛/י הָ/הָ֖רָ/ה וֶ/הְיֵה שָׁ֑ם וְ/אֶתְּנָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ אֶת לֻחֹ֣ת הָ/אֶ֗בֶן וְ/הַ/תּוֹרָה֙ וְ/הַ/מִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתַ֖בְתִּי לְ/הוֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'lh 'ly hhrh vhyh shm v'tnh lkh 't lcht h'bn vhtvrh vhmtsvh 'shr khtbty lhvrtm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ מְשָׁרְת֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הַ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyqm mshh vyhvsh' mshrtv vy'l mshh 'l hr h'lhym
verses.translation: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הַ/זְּקֵנִ֤ים אָמַר֙ שְׁבוּ לָ֣/נוּ בָ/זֶ֔ה עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר נָשׁ֖וּב אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְ/חוּר֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם מִי בַ֥עַל דְּבָרִ֖ים יִגַּ֥שׁ אֲלֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l hzqnym 'mr shbv lnv bzh 'd 'shr nshvb 'lykhm vhnh 'hrn vchvr 'mkhm my b'l dbrym ygsh 'lhm
verses.translation: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הָ/הָ֑ר וַ/יְכַ֥ס הֶ/עָנָ֖ן אֶת הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vy'l mshh 'l hhr vykhs h'nn 't hhr
verses.translation: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן כְּבוֹד יְהוָה֙ עַל הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַ/יְכַסֵּ֥/הוּ הֶ/עָנָ֖ן שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א אֶל מֹשֶׁ֛ה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הֶ/עָנָֽן
verses.translit: vyshkhn khbvd yhvh 'l hr syny vykhshv h'nn shsht ymym vyqr' 'l mshh byvm hshby'y mtvkh h'nn
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

verses.original: וּ/מַרְאֵה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה כְּ/אֵ֥שׁ אֹכֶ֖לֶת בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֑ר לְ/עֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vmr'h khbvd yhvh kh'sh 'khlt br'sh hhr l'yny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הֶ/עָנָ֖ן וַ/יַּ֣עַל אֶל הָ/הָ֑ר וַ/יְהִ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ בָּ/הָ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyb' mshh btvkh h'nn vy'l 'l hhr vyhy mshh bhr 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh
verses.translation: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/יִקְחוּ לִ֖/י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵ/אֵ֤ת כָּל אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣/נּוּ לִבּ֔/וֹ תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת תְּרוּמָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l vyqchv ly trvmh m't khl 'ysh 'shr ydbnv lbv tqchv 't trvmty
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

verses.original: וְ/זֹאת֙ הַ/תְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵ/אִתָּ֑/ם זָהָ֥ב וָ/כֶ֖סֶף וּ/נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vz't htrvmh 'shr tqchv m'tm zhb vkhsf vnchsht
verses.translation: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

verses.original: וּ/תְכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ וְ/עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh v'zym
verses.translation: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair ,

verses.original: וְ/עֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְ/עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַ/עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים
verses.translit: v'rt 'ylm m'dmym v'rt tchshym v'tsy shtym
verses.translation: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

verses.original: שֶׁ֖מֶן לַ/מָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְ/שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/לִ/קְטֹ֖רֶת הַ/סַּמִּֽים
verses.translit: shmn lm'r bshmym lshmn hmshchh vlqtrt hsmym
verses.translation: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

verses.original: אַבְנֵי שֹׁ֕הַם וְ/אַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָ/אֵפֹ֖ד וְ/לַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: 'bny shhm v'bny ml'ym l'pd vlchshn
verses.translation: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

verses.original: וְ/עָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖/י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְ/שָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shv ly mqdsh vshkhnty btvkhm
verses.translation: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

verses.original: כְּ/כֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו וְ/כֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: khkhl 'shr 'ny mr'h 'vtkh 't tbnyt hmshkhn v't tbnyt khl khlyv vkhn t'shv
verses.translation: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it .

verses.original: וְ/עָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָ/חֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֤ה וָ/חֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֥ה וָ/חֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shv 'rvn 'tsy shtym 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhv v'mh vchtsy rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

verses.original: וְ/צִפִּיתָ֤ אֹת/וֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִ/בַּ֥יִת וּ/מִ/ח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/עָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛י/ו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vtspyt 'tv zhb thvr mbyt vmchvts ttspnv v'shyt 'lyv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

verses.original: וְ/יָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗/וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְ/נָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑י/ו וּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל צַלְע/וֹ֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת וּ/שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל צַלְע֖/וֹ הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vytsqt lv 'rb' tb't zhb vntth 'l 'rb' p'mtyv vshty tb't 'l tsl'v h'cht vshty tb't 'l tsl'v hshnyt
verses.translation: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v'shyt bdy 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.original: וְ/הֵֽבֵאתָ֤ אֶת הַ/בַּדִּים֙ בַּ/טַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָ/אָרֹ֑ן לָ/שֵׂ֥את אֶת הָ/אָרֹ֖ן בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhb't 't hbdym btb't 'l tsl't h'rn lsh't 't h'rn bhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

verses.original: בְּ/טַבְּעֹת֙ הָ/אָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַ/בַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: btb't h'rn yhyv hbdym l' ysrv mmnv
verses.translation: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֖ אֶל הָ/אָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָ/עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vntt 'l h'rn 't h'dt 'shr 'tn 'lykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָ/חֵ֨צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔/הּ וְ/אַמָּ֥ה וָ/חֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'shyt khprt zhb thvr 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhh v'mh vchtsy rchbh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔/ם מִ/שְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַ/כַּפֹּֽרֶת
verses.translit: v'shyt shnym khrbym zhb mqshh t'shh 'tm mshny qtsvt hkhprt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.original: וַ֠/עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִ/קָּצָה֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וּ/כְרוּב אֶחָ֥ד מִ/קָּצָ֖ה מִ/זֶּ֑ה מִן הַ/כַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת הַ/כְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'shh khrvb 'chd mqtsh mzh vkhrvb 'chd mqtsh mzh mn hkhprt t'shv 't hkhrbym 'l shny qtsvtyv
verses.translation: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֣וּ הַ/כְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְ/מַ֗עְלָ/ה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּ/כַנְפֵי/הֶם֙ עַל הַ/כַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑י/ו אֶל הַ/כַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַ/כְּרֻבִֽים
verses.translit: vhyv hkhrbym prshy khnpym lm'lh skhkhym bkhnpyhm 'l hkhprt vpnyhm 'ysh 'l 'chyv 'l hkhprt yhyv pny hkhrbym
verses.translation: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֧ אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל הָ/אָרֹ֖ן מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/אֶל הָ֣/אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הָ֣/עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vntt 't hkhprt 'l h'rn mlm'lh v'l h'rn ttn 't h'dt 'shr 'tn 'lykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

verses.original: וְ/נוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְ/ךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְ/דִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּ/ךָ֜ מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/כַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִ/בֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל אֲרֹ֣ן הָ/עֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vnv'dty lkh shm vdbrty 'tkh m'l hkhprt mbyn shny hkhrbym 'shr 'l 'rn h'dt 't khl 'shr 'tsvh 'vtkh 'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּ/וֹ֙ וְ/אַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֥ה וָ/חֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shyt shlchn 'tsy shtym 'mtym 'rkhv v'mh rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

verses.original: וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖/וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛/וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vtspyt 'tv zhb thvr v'shyt lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥/וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְ/עָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר זָהָ֛ב לְ/מִסְגַּרְתּ֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: v'shyt lv msgrt tpch sbyb v'shyt zr zhb lmsgrtv sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔/וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְ/נָתַתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַ/פֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'shyt lv 'rb' tb't zhb vntt 't htb't 'l 'rb' hp't 'shr l'rb' rglyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

verses.original: לְ/עֻמַּת֙ הַ/מִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְ/בָתִּ֣ים לְ/בַדִּ֔ים לָ/שֵׂ֖את אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָֽן
verses.translit: l'mt hmsgrt thyyn htb't lbtym lbdym lsh't 't hshlchn
verses.translation: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת הַ/בַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָ֑ב וְ/נִשָּׂא בָ֖/ם אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָֽן
verses.translit: v'shyt 't hbdym 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb vnsh' bm 't hshlchn
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜י/ו וְ/כַפֹּתָ֗י/ו וּ/קְשׂוֹתָי/ו֙ וּ/מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּ/הֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shyt q'rtyv vkhptyv vqshvtyv vmnqytyv 'shr yskh bhn zhb thvr t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְ/פָנַ֥/י תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vntt 'l hshlchn lchm pnym lpny tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַ/מְּנוֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣/הּ וְ/קָנָ֔/הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛י/הָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥י/הָ וּ/פְרָחֶ֖י/הָ מִמֶּ֥/נָּה יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: v'shyt mnrt zhb thvr mqshh t'shh hmnvrh yrkhh vqnh gby'yh khptryh vprchyh mmnh yhyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִ/צִּדֶּ֑י/הָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִ/צִּדָּ/הּ֙ הָ/אֶחָ֔ד וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִ/צִּדָּ֖/הּ הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vshshh qnym yts'ym mtsdyh shlshh qny mnrh mtsdh h'chd vshlshh qny mnrh mtsdh hshny
verses.translation: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּ/קָּנֶ֣ה הָ/אֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָ/פֶרַח֒ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּ/קָּנֶ֥ה הָ/אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָ/פָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְ/שֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַ/קָּנִ֔ים הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן הַ/מְּנֹרָֽה
verses.translit: shlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh h'chd khptr vprch vshlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh h'chd khptr vprch khn lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mn hmnrh
verses.translation: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/מְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖י/הָ וּ/פְרָחֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbmnrh 'rb'h gb'ym mshqdym khptryh vprchyh
verses.translation: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

verses.original: וְ/כַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַ/קָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗/נָּה וְ/כַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַ/קָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔/נָּה וְ/כַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/קָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑/נָּה לְ/שֵׁ֨שֶׁת֙ הַ/קָּנִ֔ים הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן הַ/מְּנֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mn hmnrh
verses.translation: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

verses.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵי/הֶ֥ם וּ/קְנֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּ֣/נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛/הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: khptryhm vqntm mmnh yhyv khlh mqshh 'cht zhb thvr
verses.translation: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֖י/הָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְ/הֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/הֵאִ֖יר עַל עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'shyt 't nrtyh shb'h vh'lh 't nrtyh vh'yr 'l 'br pnyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְקָחֶ֥י/הָ וּ/מַחְתֹּתֶ֖י/הָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vmlqchyh vmchttyh zhb thvr
verses.translation: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

verses.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑/הּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: khkhr zhb thvr y'shh 'th 't khl hkhlym h'lh
verses.translation: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

verses.original: וּ/רְאֵ֖ה וַ/עֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּ/תַ֨בְנִיתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה מָרְאֶ֖ה בָּ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vr'h v'shh btbnytm 'shr 'th mr'h bhr
verses.translation: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּ/תְכֵ֤לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָן֙ וְ/תֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v't hmshkhn t'shh 'shr yry't shsh mshzr vtkhlt v'rgmn vtl't shny khrbym m'shh chshb t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽ/אַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּ/אַמָּ֔ה הַ/יְרִיעָ֖ה הָ/אֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְ/כָל הַ/יְרִיעֹֽת
verses.translit: 'rkh hyry'h h'cht shmnh v'shrym b'mh vrchb 'rb' b'mh hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht lkhl hyry't
verses.translation: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

verses.original: חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַ/יְרִיעֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶ֨יןָ֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: chmsh hyry't thyyn chbrt 'shh 'l 'chth vchmsh yry't chbrt 'shh 'l 'chth
verses.translation: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַ/יְרִיעָה֙ הָ/אֶחָ֔ת מִ/קָּצָ֖ה בַּ/חֹבָ֑רֶת וְ/כֵ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּ/שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה הַ/קִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּ/מַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: v'shyt ll't tkhlt 'l shpt hyry'h h'cht mqtsh bchbrt vkhn t'shh bshpt hyry'h hqytsvnh bmchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ בַּ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָ/אֶחָת֒ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּ/מַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַ/לֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: chmshym ll't t'shh byry'h h'cht vchmshym ll't t'shh bqtsh hyry'h 'shr bmchbrt hshnyt mqbylt hll't 'shh 'l 'chth
verses.translation: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֕יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וְ/חִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶת הַ/יְרִיעֹ֜ת אִשָּׁ֤ה אֶל אֲחֹתָ/הּ֙ בַּ/קְּרָסִ֔ים וְ/הָיָ֥ה הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'shyt chmshym qrsy zhb vchbrt 't hyry't 'shh 'l 'chth bqrsym vhyh hmshkhn 'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְ/אֹ֖הֶל עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shyt yry't 'zym l'hl 'l hmshkhn 'shty 'shrh yry't t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽ/אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּ/אַמָּ֔ה הַ/יְרִיעָ֖ה הָ/אֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְ/עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת
verses.translit: 'rkh hyry'h h'cht shlshym b'mh vrchb 'rb' b'mh hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht l'shty 'shrh yry't
verses.translation: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

verses.original: וְ/חִבַּרְתָּ֞ אֶת חֲמֵ֤שׁ הַ/יְרִיעֹת֙ לְ/בָ֔ד וְ/אֶת שֵׁ֥שׁ הַ/יְרִיעֹ֖ת לְ/בָ֑ד וְ/כָפַלְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔ית אֶל מ֖וּל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vchbrt 't chmsh hyry't lbd v't shsh hyry't lbd vkhplt 't hyry'h hshshyt 'l mvl pny h'hl
verses.translation: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַ/יְרִיעָה֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת הַ/קִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּ/חֹבָ֑רֶת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה הַ/חֹבֶ֖רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: v'shyt chmshym ll't 'l shpt hyry'h h'cht hqytsnh bchbrt vchmshym ll't 'l shpt hyry'h hchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֛יתָ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת הַ/קְּרָסִים֙ בַּ/לֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת וְ/חִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֶת הָ/אֹ֖הֶל וְ/הָיָ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'shyt qrsy nchsht chmshym vhb't 't hqrsym bll't vchbrt 't h'hl vhyh 'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

verses.original: וְ/סֶ֨רַח֙ הָ/עֹדֵ֔ף בִּ/ירִיעֹ֖ת הָ/אֹ֑הֶל חֲצִ֤י הַ/יְרִיעָה֙ הָ/עֹדֶ֔פֶת תִּסְרַ֕ח עַ֖ל אֲחֹרֵ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vsrch h'df byry't h'hl chtsy hyry'h h'dpt tsrch 'l 'chry hmshkhn
verses.translation: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אַמָּ֨ה מִ/זֶּ֜ה וְ/הָ/אַמָּ֤ה מִ/זֶּה֙ בָּ/עֹדֵ֔ף בְּ/אֹ֖רֶךְ יְרִיעֹ֣ת הָ/אֹ֑הֶל יִהְיֶ֨ה סָר֜וּחַ עַל צִדֵּ֧י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן מִ/זֶּ֥ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֖ה לְ/כַסֹּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vh'mh mzh vh'mh mzh b'df b'rkh yry't h'hl yhyh srvch 'l tsdy hmshkhn mzh vmzh lkhstv
verses.translation: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ מִכְסֶה֙ לָ/אֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּ/מִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: v'shyt mkhsh l'hl 'rt 'ylm m'dmym vmkhsh 'rt tchshym mlm'lh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים
verses.translit: v'shyt 't hqrshym lmshkhn 'tsy shtym 'mdym
verses.translation: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

verses.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּ֑רֶשׁ וְ/אַמָּה֙ וַ/חֲצִ֣י הָֽ/אַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'shr 'mvt 'rkh hqrsh v'mh vchtsy h'mh rchb hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָד֗וֹת לַ/קֶּ֨רֶשׁ֙ הָ/אֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָ֑/הּ כֵּ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: shty ydvt lqrsh h'chd mshlbt 'shh 'l 'chth khn t'shh lkhl qrshy hmshkhn
verses.translation: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קֶ֔רֶשׁ לִ/פְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גְבָּ/ה תֵימָֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: v'shyt 't hqrshym lmshkhn 'shrym qrsh lp't ngbh tymnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי כֶ֔סֶף תַּעֲשֶׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַ/קָּ֑רֶשׁ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת הַ/קֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָד֙ לִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔י/ו וּ/שְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָ֖ד לִ/שְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dny khsf t'shh tcht 'shrym hqrsh shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/צֶ֧לַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית לִ/פְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ
verses.translit: vltsl' hmshkhn hshnyt lp't tspvn 'shrym qrsh
verses.translation: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַ/קֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dnyhm khsf shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.translit: vlyrkhty hmshkhn ymh t'shh shshh qrshym
verses.translation: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִ/מְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּ/יַּרְכָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vshny qrshym t'shh lmqts't hmshkhn byrkhtym
verses.translation: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִים֮ מִ/לְּ/מַטָּה֒ וְ/יַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ אֶל הַ/טַּבַּ֖עַת הָ/אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִ/שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם לִ/שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/מִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vyhyv t'mym mlmth vychdv yhyv tmym 'l r'shv 'l htb't h'cht khn yhyh lshnyhm lshny hmqts't yhyv
verses.translation: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

verses.original: וְ/הָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַ/קֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָ֔ד וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhyv shmnh qrshym v'dnyhm khsf shshh 'shr 'dnym shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְ/קַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'shyt brychm 'tsy shtym chmshh lqrshy tsl' hmshkhn h'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.original: וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְ/קַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑ית וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְ/קַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַ/יַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vchmshh brychm lqrshy tsl' hmshkhn hshnyt vchmshh brychm lqrshy tsl' hmshkhn lyrkhtym ymh
verses.translation: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בְּרִ֥יחַ הַ/תִּיכֹ֖ן בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן הַ/קָּצֶ֖ה אֶל הַ/קָּצֶֽה
verses.translit: vhbrych htykhn btvkh hqrshym mbrch mn hqtsh 'l hqtsh
verses.translation: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְ/אֶת טַבְּעֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַ/בְּרִיחִ֑ם וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת הַ/בְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v't hqrshym ttsph zhb v't tb'tyhm t'shh zhb btym lbrychm vtspyt 't hbrychm zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּ/מִ֨שְׁפָּט֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vhqmt 't hmshkhn khmshptv 'shr hr'yt bhr
verses.translation: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖/הּ כְּרֻבִֽים
verses.translit: v'shyt prkht tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh chshb y'shh 'th khrbym
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗/הּ עַל אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵי/הֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי כָֽסֶף
verses.translit: vntth 'th 'l 'rb'h 'mvdy shtym mtspym zhb vvyhm zhb 'l 'rb'h 'dny khsf
verses.translation: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת הַ/פָּרֹכֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַ/קְּרָסִים֒ וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית לַ/פָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָ/עֵד֑וּת וְ/הִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַ/פָּרֹ֨כֶת֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּ/בֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vntth 't hprkht tcht hqrsym vhb't shmh mbyt lprkht 't 'rvn h'dvt vhbdylh hprkht lkhm byn hqdsh vbyn qdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָ/עֵדֻ֑ת בְּ/קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vntt 't hkhprt 'l 'rvn h'dt bqdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place .

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִ/ח֣וּץ לַ/פָּרֹ֔כֶת וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָ/ה וְ/הַ֨/שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vshmt 't hshlchn mchvts lprkht v't hmnrh nkhch hshlchn 'l tsl' hmshkhn tymnh vhshlchn ttn 'l tsl' tspvn
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְ/פֶ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם
verses.translit: v'shyt mskh lptch h'hl tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh rqm
verses.translation: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ לַ/מָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְ/צִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָ/ם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵי/הֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְ/יָצַקְתָּ֣ לָ/הֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: v'shyt lmskh chmshh 'mvdy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb vvyhm zhb vytsqt lhm chmshh 'dny nchsht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְ/חָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/שָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shyt 't hmzbch 'tsy shtym chmsh 'mvt 'rkh vchmsh 'mvt rchb rbv' yhyh hmzbch vshlsh 'mvt qmtv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗י/ו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔י/ו מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖/וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: v'shyt qrntyv 'l 'rb' pntyv mmnv thyyn qrntyv vtspyt 'tv nchsht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָי/ו֙ לְ/דַשְּׁנ֔/וֹ וְ/יָעָי/ו֙ וּ/מִזְרְקֹתָ֔י/ו וּ/מִזְלְגֹתָ֖י/ו וּ/מַחְתֹּתָ֑י/ו לְ/כָל כֵּלָ֖י/ו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: v'shyt syrtyv ldshnv vy'yv vmzrqtyv vmzlgtyv vmchttyv lkhl khlyv t'shh nchsht
