verses.translation: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ לּ/וֹ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל הָ/רֶ֗שֶׁת אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥ע קְצוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'shyt lv mkhbr m'shh rsht nchsht v'shyt 'l hrsht 'rb' tb't nchsht 'l 'rb' qtsvtyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗/הּ תַּ֛חַת כַּרְכֹּ֥ב הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ מִ/לְּ/מָ֑טָּה וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה הָ/רֶ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ד חֲצִ֥י הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vntth 'th tcht khrkhb hmzbch mlmth vhyth hrsht 'd chtsy hmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ בַדִּים֙ לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: v'shyt bdym lmzbch bdy 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm nchsht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

verses.original: וְ/הוּבָ֥א אֶת בַּדָּ֖י/ו בַּ/טַּבָּעֹ֑ת וְ/הָי֣וּ הַ/בַּדִּ֗ים עַל שְׁתֵּ֛י צַלְעֹ֥ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בִּ/שְׂאֵ֥ת אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhvb' 't bdyv btb't vhyv hbdym 'l shty tsl't hmzbch bsh't 'tv
verses.translation: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

verses.original: נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתְ/ךָ֛ בָּ/הָ֖ר כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: nbvb lcht t'shh 'tv kh'shr hr'h 'tkh bhr khn y'shv
verses.translation: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it .

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֖ת חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן לִ/פְאַ֣ת נֶֽגֶב תֵּ֠ימָנָ/ה קְלָעִ֨ים לֶ/חָצֵ֜ר שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר מֵאָ֤ה בָֽ/אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ לַ/פֵּאָ֖ה הָ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: v'shyt 't chtsr hmshkhn lp't ngb tymnh ql'ym lchtsr shsh mshzr m'h b'mh 'rkh lp'h h'cht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

verses.original: וְ/עַמֻּדָ֣י/ו עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָ/עַמֻּדִ֛ים וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'mdyv 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

verses.original: וְ/כֵ֨ן לִ/פְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ בָּ/אֹ֔רֶךְ קְלָעִ֖ים מֵ֣אָה אֹ֑רֶךְ ו/עמד/ו וְ/עַמּוּדָ֣י/ו עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֤ם עֶשְׂרִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽ/עַמֻּדִ֛ים וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vkhn lp't tspvn b'rkh ql'ym m'h 'rkh v'mdv v'mvdyv 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.original: וְ/רֹ֤חַב הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ לִ/פְאַת יָ֔ם קְלָעִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵי/הֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: vrchb hchtsr lp't ym ql'ym chmshym 'mh 'mdyhm 'shrh v'dnyhm 'shrh
verses.translation: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

verses.original: וְ/רֹ֣חַב הֶֽ/חָצֵ֗ר לִ/פְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָ/ה מִזְרָ֖חָ/ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vrchb hchtsr lp't qdmh mzrchh chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

verses.original: וַ/חֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֛ה קְלָעִ֖ים לַ/כָּתֵ֑ף עַמֻּדֵי/הֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vchmsh 'shrh 'mh ql'ym lkhtf 'mdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.original: וְ/לַ/כָּתֵף֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔ית חְמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה קְלָעִ֑ים עַמֻּדֵי/הֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vlkhtf hshnyt chmsh 'shrh ql'ym 'mdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שַׁ֨עַר הֶֽ/חָצֵ֜ר מָסָ֣ךְ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְ/תוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם עַמֻּֽדֵי/הֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: vlsh'r hchtsr mskh 'shrym 'mh tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh rqm 'mdyhm 'rb'h v'dnyhm 'rb'h
verses.translation: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

verses.original: כָּל עַמּוּדֵ֨י הֶֽ/חָצֵ֤ר סָבִיב֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וָוֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: khl 'mvdy hchtsr sbyb mchshqym khsf vvyhm khsf v'dnyhm nchsht
verses.translation: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הֶֽ/חָצֵר֩ מֵאָ֨ה בָֽ/אַמָּ֜ה וְ/רֹ֣חַב חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בַּ/חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וְ/קֹמָ֛ה חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: 'rkh hchtsr m'h b'mh vrchb chmshym bchmshym vqmh chmsh 'mvt shsh mshzr v'dnyhm nchsht
verses.translation: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

verses.original: לְ/כֹל֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּ/כֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָת֑/וֹ וְ/כָל יְתֵדֹתָ֛י/ו וְ/כָל יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: lkhl khly hmshkhn bkhl 'bdtv vkhl ytdtyv vkhl ytdt hchtsr nchsht
verses.translation: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/יִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַ/מָּא֑וֹר לְ/הַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: v'th ttsvh 't bny yshr'l vyqchv 'lykh shmn zyt zkh khtyt lm'vr lh'lt nr tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

verses.original: בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִ/ח֨וּץ לַ/פָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָ/עֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨/וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו מֵ/עֶ֥רֶב עַד בֹּ֖קֶר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹ֣רֹתָ֔/ם מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: b'hl mv'd mchvts lprkht 'shr 'l h'dt y'rkh 'tv 'hrn vbnyv m'rb 'd bqr lpny yhvh chqt 'vlm ldrtm m't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD : it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֡ה הַקְרֵ֣ב אֵלֶי/ךָ֩ אֶת אַהֲרֹ֨ן אָחִ֜י/ךָ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֣י/ו אִתּ֔/וֹ מִ/תּ֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/כַהֲנ/וֹ לִ֑/י אַהֲרֹ֕ן נָדָ֧ב וַ/אֲבִיה֛וּא אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְ/אִיתָמָ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: v'th hqrb 'lykh 't 'hrn 'chykh v't bnyv 'tv mtvkh bny yshr'l lkhhnv ly 'hrn ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr bny 'hrn
verses.translation: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ בִגְדֵי קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֑י/ךָ לְ/כָב֖וֹד וּ/לְ/תִפְאָֽרֶת
verses.translit: v'shyt bgdy qdsh l'hrn 'chykh lkhbvd vltp'rt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה תְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶל כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּאתִ֖י/ו ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/עָשׂ֞וּ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן לְ/קַדְּשׁ֖/וֹ לְ/כַהֲנ/וֹ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th tdbr 'l khl chkhmy lb 'shr ml'tyv rvch chkhmh v'shv 't bgdy 'hrn lqdshv lkhhnv ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה הַ/בְּגָדִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשׂ֗וּ חֹ֤שֶׁן וְ/אֵפוֹד֙ וּ/מְעִ֔יל וּ/כְתֹ֥נֶת תַּשְׁבֵּ֖ץ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת וְ/אַבְנֵ֑ט וְ/עָשׂ֨וּ בִגְדֵי קֹ֜דֶשׁ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֛י/ךָ וּ/לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו לְ/כַהֲנ/וֹ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'lh hbgdym 'shr y'shv chshn v'pvd vm'yl vkhtnt tshbts mtsnpt v'bnt v'shv bgdy qdsh l'hrn 'chykh vlbnyv lkhhnv ly
verses.translation: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וְ/הֵם֙ יִקְח֣וּ אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֔ב וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּכֵ֖לֶת וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֑ן וְ/אֶת תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/שֵּֽׁשׁ
verses.translit: vhm yqchv 't hzhb v't htkhlt v't h'rgmn v't tvl't hshny v't hshsh
verses.translation: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.original: וְ/עָשׂ֖וּ אֶת הָ/אֵפֹ֑ד זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֜ן תּוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: v'shv 't h'pd zhb tkhlt v'rgmn tvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh chshb
verses.translation: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֧י כְתֵפֹ֣ת חֹֽבְרֹ֗ת יִֽהְיֶה לּ֛/וֹ אֶל שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָ֖י/ו וְ/חֻבָּֽר
verses.translit: shty khtpt chbrt yhyh lv 'l shny qtsvtyv vchbr
verses.translation: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

verses.original: וְ/חֵ֤שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔י/ו כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֖/הוּ מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ יִהְיֶ֑ה זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר
verses.translit: vchshb 'pdtv 'shr 'lyv khm'shhv mmnv yhyh zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr
verses.translation: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.original: וְ/לָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֶת שְׁתֵּ֖י אַבְנֵי שֹׁ֑הַם וּ/פִתַּחְתָּ֣ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlqcht 't shty 'bny shhm vptcht 'lyhm shmvt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

verses.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ מִ/שְּׁמֹתָ֔/ם עַ֖ל הָ/אֶ֣בֶן הָ/אֶחָ֑ת וְ/אֶת שְׁמ֞וֹת הַ/שִּׁשָּׁ֧ה הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל הָ/אֶ֥בֶן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית כְּ/תוֹלְדֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shshh mshmtm 'l h'bn h'cht v't shmvt hshshh hnvtrym 'l h'bn hshnyt khtvldtm
verses.translation: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חָרַשׁ֮ אֶבֶן֒ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֗ם תְּפַתַּח֙ אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י הָ/אֲבָנִ֔ים עַל שְׁמֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֻסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: m'shh chrsh 'bn ptvchy chtm tptch 't shty h'bnym 'l shmt bny yshr'l msbt mshbtsvt zhb t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֞ אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י הָ/אֲבָנִ֗ים עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָֽ/אֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּרֹ֖ן לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/נָשָׂא֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת שְׁמוֹתָ֜/ם לִ/פְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה עַל שְׁתֵּ֥י כְתֵפָ֖י/ו לְ/זִכָּרֹֽן
verses.translit: vshmt 't shty h'bnym 'l khtpt h'pd 'bny zkhrn lbny yshr'l vnsh' 'hrn 't shmvtm lpny yhvh 'l shty khtpyv lzkhrn
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֖ת זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v'shyt mshbtst zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֤י שַׁרְשְׁרֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִגְבָּלֹ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖/ם מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת וְ/נָתַתָּ֛ה אֶת שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת הָ/עֲבֹתֹ֖ת עַל הַֽ/מִּשְׁבְּצֹֽת
verses.translit: vshty shrshrt zhb thvr mgblt t'shh 'tm m'shh 'bt vntth 't shrshrt h'btt 'l hmshbtst
verses.translation: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתָ חֹ֤שֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חֹשֵׁ֔ב כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֵפֹ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֑/נּוּ זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְ/תוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shyt chshn mshpt m'shh chshb khm'shh 'pd t'shnv zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr t'shh 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

verses.original: רָב֥וּעַ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה כָּפ֑וּל זֶ֥רֶת אָרְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/זֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: rbv' yhyh khpvl zrt 'rkhv vzrt rchbv
verses.translation: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

verses.original: וּ/מִלֵּאתָ֥ ב/וֹ֙ מִלֻּ֣אַת אֶ֔בֶן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה טוּרִ֣ים אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּ/בָרֶ֔קֶת הַ/טּ֖וּר הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vml't bv ml't 'bn 'rb'h tvrym 'bn tvr 'dm ptdh vbrqt htvr h'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/טּ֖וּר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְ/יָהֲלֹֽם
verses.translit: vhtvr hshny npkh spyr vyhlm
verses.translation: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/טּ֖וּר הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְ/אַחְלָֽמָה
verses.translit: vhtvr hshlyshy lshm shbv v'chlmh
verses.translation: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/טּוּר֙ הָ/רְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ וְ/שֹׁ֖הַם וְ/יָשְׁפֵ֑ה מְשֻׁבָּצִ֥ים זָהָ֛ב יִהְי֖וּ בְּ/מִלּוּאֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhtvr hrby'y trshysh vshhm vyshph mshbtsym zhb yhyv bmlv'tm
verses.translation: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָ/אֲבָנִים תִּֽהְיֶ֜יןָ עַל שְׁמֹ֧ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל שְׁמֹתָ֑/ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חוֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל שְׁמ֔/וֹ תִּֽהְיֶ֕יןָ לִ/שְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: vh'bnym thyyn 'l shmt bny yshr'l shtym 'shrh 'l shmtm ptvchy chvtm 'ysh 'l shmv thyyn lshny 'shr shbt
verses.translation: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֧יתָ עַל הַ/חֹ֛שֶׁן שַֽׁרְשֹׁ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: v'shyt 'l hchshn shrsht gblt m'shh 'bt zhb thvr
verses.translation: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ עַל הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁן שְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֑ב וְ/נָתַתָּ֗ אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ הַ/טַּבָּע֔וֹת עַל שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: v'shyt 'l hchshn shty tb'vt zhb vntt 't shty htb'vt 'l shny qtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֗ה אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ עֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַ/זָּהָ֔ב עַל שְׁתֵּ֖י הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֑ת אֶל קְצ֖וֹת הַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vntth 't shty 'btt hzhb 'l shty htb't 'l qtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָ/עֲבֹתֹ֔ת תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽ/מִּשְׁבְּצ֑וֹת וְ/נָתַתָּ֛ה עַל כִּתְפ֥וֹת הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד אֶל מ֥וּל פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't shty qtsvt shty h'btt ttn 'l shty hmshbtsvt vntth 'l khtpvt h'pd 'l mvl pnyv
verses.translation: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֗יתָ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֔ב וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔/ם עַל שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַ/חֹ֑שֶׁן עַל שְׂפָת֕/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל עֵ֥בֶר הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: v'shyt shty tb'vt zhb vshmt 'tm 'l shny qtsvt hchshn 'l shptv 'shr 'l 'br h'pd byth
verses.translation: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂיתָ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָב֒ וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֡/ם עַל שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפ֨וֹת הָ/אֵפ֤וֹד מִ/לְּ/מַ֨טָּה֙ מִ/מּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔י/ו לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑/וֹ מִ/מַּ֕עַל לְ/חֵ֖שֶׁב הָ/אֵפֽוֹד
verses.translit: v'shyt shty tb'vt zhb vntth 'tm 'l shty khtpvt h'pvd mlmth mmvl pnyv l'mt mchbrtv mm'l lchshb h'pvd
verses.translation: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

verses.original: וְ/יִרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת הַ֠/חֹשֶׁן מ/טבעת/ו מִֽ/טַּבְּעֹתָ֞י/ו אֶל טַבְּעֹ֤ת הָ/אֵפֹד֙ בִּ/פְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לִֽ/הְי֖וֹת עַל חֵ֣שֶׁב הָ/אֵפ֑וֹד וְ/לֹֽא יִזַּ֣ח הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁן מֵ/עַ֖ל הָ/אֵפֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyrkhsv 't hchshn mtb'tv mtb'tyv 'l tb't h'pd bptyl tkhlt lhyvt 'l chshb h'pvd vl' yzch hchshn m'l h'pvd
verses.translation: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

verses.original: וְ/נָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמ֨וֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בְּ/חֹ֧שֶׁן הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֛ט עַל לִבּ֖/וֹ בְּ/בֹא֣/וֹ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְ/זִכָּרֹ֥ן לִ/פְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vnsh' 'hrn 't shmvt bny yshr'l bchshn hmshpt 'l lbv bb'v 'l hqdsh lzkhrn lpny yhvh tmyd
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place , for a memorial before the LORD continually.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֞ אֶל חֹ֣שֶׁן הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֗ט אֶת הָ/אוּרִים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/תֻּמִּ֔ים וְ/הָיוּ֙ עַל לֵ֣ב אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּ/בֹא֖/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/נָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֨ט בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל עַל לִבּ֛/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vntt 'l chshn hmshpt 't h'vrym v't htmym vhyv 'l lb 'hrn bb'v lpny yhvh vnsh' 'hrn 't mshpt bny yshr'l 'l lbv lpny yhvh tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the LORD : and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֛יתָ אֶת מְעִ֥יל הָ/אֵפ֖וֹד כְּלִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת
verses.translit: v'shyt 't m'yl h'pvd khlyl tkhlt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה פִֽי רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ בְּ/תוֹכ֑/וֹ שָׂפָ֡ה יִֽהְיֶה֩ לְ/פִ֨י/ו סָבִ֜יב מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֗ג כְּ/פִ֥י תַחְרָ֛א יִֽהְיֶה לּ֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vhyh py r'shv btvkhv shph yhyh lpyv sbyb m'shh 'rg khpy tchr' yhyh lv l' yqr'
verses.translation: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל שׁוּלָ֗י/ו רִמֹּנֵי֙ תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָן֙ וְ/תוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י עַל שׁוּלָ֖י/ו סָבִ֑יב וּ/פַעֲמֹנֵ֥י זָהָ֛ב בְּ/תוֹכָ֖/ם סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: v'shyt 'l shvlyv rmny tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny 'l shvlyv sbyb vp'mny zhb btvkhm sbyb
verses.translation: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

verses.original: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן זָהָב֙ וְ/רִמּ֔וֹן פַּֽעֲמֹ֥ן זָהָ֖ב וְ/רִמּ֑וֹן עַל שׁוּלֵ֥י הַ/מְּעִ֖יל סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: p'mn zhb vrmvn p'mn zhb vrmvn 'l shvly hm'yl sbyb
verses.translation: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְ/שָׁרֵ֑ת וְ/נִשְׁמַ֣ע ק֠וֹל/וֹ בְּ/בֹא֨/וֹ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ לִ/פְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וּ/בְ/צֵאת֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vhyh 'l 'hrn lshrt vnshm' qvlv bb'v 'l hqdsh lpny yhvh vbts'tv vl' ymvt
verses.translation: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD , and when he cometh out, that he die not.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ צִּ֖יץ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וּ/פִתַּחְתָּ֤ עָלָי/ו֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'shyt tsyts zhb thvr vptcht 'lyv ptvchy chtm qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֤ אֹת/וֹ֙ עַל פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְ/הָיָ֖ה עַל הַ/מִּצְנָ֑פֶת אֶל מ֥וּל פְּנֵֽי הַ/מִּצְנֶ֖פֶת יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vshmt 'tv 'l ptyl tkhlt vhyh 'l hmtsnpt 'l mvl pny hmtsnpt yhyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֮ עַל מֵ֣צַח אַהֲרֹן֒ וְ/נָשָׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַקְדִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/כָֽל מַתְּנֹ֖ת קָדְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָיָ֤ה עַל מִצְח/וֹ֙ תָּמִ֔יד לְ/רָצ֥וֹן לָ/הֶ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh 'l mtsch 'hrn vnsh' 'hrn 't 'vn hqdshym 'shr yqdyshv bny yshr'l lkhl mtnt qdshyhm vhyh 'l mtschv tmyd lrtsvn lhm lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבַּצְתָּ֙ הַ/כְּתֹ֣נֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְ/אַבְנֵ֥ט תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה רֹקֵֽם
verses.translit: vshbtst hkhtnt shsh v'shyt mtsnpt shsh v'bnt t'shh m'shh rqm
verses.translation: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֻתֳּנֹ֔ת וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם אַבְנֵטִ֑ים וּ/מִגְבָּעוֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לָ/הֶ֔ם לְ/כָב֖וֹד וּ/לְ/תִפְאָֽרֶת
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn t'shh khtnt v'shyt lhm 'bntym vmgb'vt t'shh lhm lkhbvd vltp'rt
verses.translation: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

verses.original: וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶת אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֖י/ו אִתּ֑/וֹ וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֨ אֹתָ֜/ם וּ/מִלֵּאתָ֧ אֶת יָדָ֛/ם וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם וְ/כִהֲנ֥וּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhlbsht 'tm 't 'hrn 'chykh v't bnyv 'tv vmshcht 'tm vml't 't ydm vqdsht 'tm vkhhnv ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשֵׂ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ מִכְנְסֵי בָ֔ד לְ/כַסּ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֣ר עֶרְוָ֑ה מִ/מָּתְנַ֥יִם וְ/עַד יְרֵכַ֖יִם יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: v'shh lhm mkhnsy bd lkhsvt bshr 'rvh mmtnym v'd yrkhym yhyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:

verses.original: וְ/הָיוּ֩ עַל אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְ/עַל בָּנָ֜י/ו בְּ/בֹאָ֣/ם אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְ/גִשְׁתָּ֤/ם אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לְ/שָׁרֵ֣ת בַּ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְ/לֹא יִשְׂא֥וּ עָוֺ֖ן וָ/מֵ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ל֖/וֹ וּ/לְ/זַרְע֥/וֹ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhyv 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv bb'm 'l 'hl mv'd 'v bgshtm 'l hmzbch lshrt bqdsh vl' ysh'v 'vn vmtv chqt 'vlm lv vlzr'v 'chryv
verses.translation: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֨ה הַ/דָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָ/הֶ֛ם לְ/קַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖/ם לְ/כַהֵ֣ן לִ֑/י לְ֠קַח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר וְ/אֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shr t'shh lhm lqdsh 'tm lkhhn ly lqch pr 'chd bn bqr v'ylm shnym tmymm
verses.translation: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

verses.original: וְ/לֶ֣חֶם מַצּ֗וֹת וְ/חַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וּ/רְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּ/שָּׁ֑מֶן סֹ֥לֶת חִטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vlchm mtsvt vchlt mtst blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn slt chtym t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ אוֹתָ/ם֙ עַל סַ֣ל אֶחָ֔ד וְ/הִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/סָּ֑ל וְ/אֶ֨ת הַ/פָּ֔ר וְ/אֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֥י הָ/אֵילִֽם
verses.translit: vntt 'vtm 'l sl 'chd vhqrbt 'tm bsl v't hpr v't shny h'ylm
verses.translation: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְ/אֶת בָּנָי/ו֙ תַּקְרִ֔יב אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/רָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: v't 'hrn v't bnyv tqryb 'l ptch 'hl mv'd vrchtst 'tm bmym
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת הַ/בְּגָדִ֗ים וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת הַ/כֻּתֹּ֔נֶת וְ/אֵת֙ מְעִ֣יל הָ/אֵפֹ֔ד וְ/אֶת הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד וְ/אֶת הַ/חֹ֑שֶׁן וְ/אָפַדְתָּ֣ ל֔/וֹ בְּ/חֵ֖שֶׁב הָ/אֵפֹֽד
verses.translit: vlqcht 't hbgdym vhlbsht 't 'hrn 't hkhtnt v't m'yl h'pd v't h'pd v't hchshn v'pdt lv bchshb h'pd
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֥ הַ/מִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/נָתַתָּ֛ אֶת נֵ֥זֶר הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַל הַ/מִּצְנָֽפֶת
verses.translit: vshmt hmtsnpt 'l r'shv vntt 't nzr hqdsh 'l hmtsnpt
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

verses.original: וְ/לָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/יָצַקְתָּ֖ עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֖ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlqcht 't shmn hmshchh vytsqt 'l r'shv vmshcht 'tv
verses.translation: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֖י/ו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖/ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת
verses.translit: v't bnyv tqryb vhlbshtm khtnt
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

verses.original: וְ/חָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨/ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/בָנָ֗י/ו וְ/חָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָ/הֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֛ם כְּהֻנָּ֖ה לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּ/מִלֵּאתָ֥ יַֽד אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/יַד בָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vchgrt 'tm 'bnt 'hrn vbnyv vchbsht lhm mgb't vhyth lhm khhnh lchqt 'vlm vml't yd 'hrn vyd bnyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/פָּ֔ר לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/סָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/פָּֽר
verses.translit: vhqrbt 't hpr lpny 'hl mv'd vsmkh 'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh hpr
verses.translation: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַטְתָּ֥ אֶת הַ/פָּ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vshchtt 't hpr lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/לָֽקַחְתָּ֙ מִ/דַּ֣ם הַ/פָּ֔ר וְ/נָתַתָּ֛ה עַל קַרְנֹ֥ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּ/אֶצְבָּעֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/דָּ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vlqcht mdm hpr vntth 'l qrnt hmzbch b'tsb'kh v't khl hdm tshpkh 'l ysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

verses.original: וְ/לָֽקַחְתָּ֗ אֶֽת כָּל הַ/חֵלֶב֮ הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/קֶּרֶב֒ וְ/אֵ֗ת הַ/יֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֖לֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ן וְ/הִקְטַרְתָּ֖ הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vlqcht 't khl hchlb hmkhsh 't hqrb v't hytrt 'l hkhbd v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lyhn vhqtrt hmzbchh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּשַׂ֤ר הַ/פָּר֙ וְ/אֶת עֹר֣/וֹ וְ/אֶת פִּרְשׁ֔/וֹ תִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא
verses.translit: v't bshr hpr v't 'rv v't prshv tshrf b'sh mchvts lmchnh cht't hv'
verses.translation: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אַ֥יִל הָ/אֶחָ֖ד תִּקָּ֑ח וְ/סָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/אָֽיִל
verses.translit: v't h'yl h'chd tqch vsmkhv 'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh h'yl
verses.translation: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַטְתָּ֖ אֶת הָ/אָ֑יִל וְ/לָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת דָּמ֔/וֹ וְ/זָרַקְתָּ֥ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vshchtt 't h'yl vlqcht 't dmv vzrqt 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨ת הָ/אַ֔יִל תְּנַתֵּ֖חַ לִ/נְתָחָ֑י/ו וְ/רָחַצְתָּ֤ קִרְבּ/וֹ֙ וּ/כְרָעָ֔י/ו וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ עַל נְתָחָ֖י/ו וְ/עַל רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't h'yl tntch lntchyv vrchtst qrbv vkhr'yv vntt 'l ntchyv v'l r'shv
verses.translation: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת כָּל הָ/אַ֨יִל֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיח֔וֹחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhqtrt 't khl h'yl hmzbchh 'lh hv' lyhvh rych nychvch 'shh lyhvh hv'
verses.translation: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD : it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָ/אַ֣יִל הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י וְ/סָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/אָֽיִל
verses.translit: vlqcht 't h'yl hshny vsmkh 'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh h'yl
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת הָ/אַ֗יִל וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֤ מִ/דָּמ/וֹ֙ וְ/נָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/עַל תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָי/ו֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָ/ם֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖/ם הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית וְ/זָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת הַ/דָּ֛ם עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vshchtt 't h'yl vlqcht mdmv vntth 'l tnvkh 'zn 'hrn v'l tnvkh 'zn bnyv hymnyt v'l bhn ydm hymnyt v'l bhn rglm hymnyt vzrqt 't hdm 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן הַ/דָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל הַ/מִּזְבֵּחַ֮ וּ/מִ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָה֒ וְ/הִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/עַל בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/עַל בָּנָ֛י/ו וְ/עַל בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו אִתּ֑/וֹ וְ/קָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּ/בְגָדָ֔י/ו וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו וּ/בִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlqcht mn hdm 'shr 'l hmzbch vmshmn hmshchh vhzyt 'l 'hrn v'l bgdyv v'l bnyv v'l bgdy bnyv 'tv vqdsh hv' vbgdyv vbnyv vbgdy bnyv 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן הָ֠/אַיִל הַ/חֵ֨לֶב וְ/הָֽ/אַלְיָ֜ה וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֣לֶב הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/קֶּ֗רֶב וְ/אֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַ/כָּבֵד֙ וְ/אֵ֣ת שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֗ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ת שׁ֣וֹק הַ/יָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא
verses.translit: vlqcht mn h'yl hchlb vh'lyh v't hchlb hmkhsh 't hqrb v't ytrt hkhbd v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lhn v't shvq hymyn khy 'yl ml'ym hv'
verses.translation: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

verses.original: וְ/כִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וַֽ/חַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְ/רָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִ/סַּל֙ הַ/מַּצּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhkhr lchm 'cht vchlt lchm shmn 'cht vrqyq 'chd msl hmtsvt 'shr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֣ הַ/כֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/עַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑י/ו וְ/הֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛/ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmt hkhl 'l khpy 'hrn v'l khpy bnyv vhnpt 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/יָּדָ֔/ם וְ/הִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חָ/ה עַל הָ/עֹלָ֑ה לְ/רֵ֤יחַ נִיח֨וֹחַ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tm mydm vhqtrt hmzbchh 'l h'lh lrych nychvch lpny yhvh 'shh hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD : it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת הֶֽ/חָזֶ֗ה מֵ/אֵ֤יל הַ/מִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/הֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹת֛/וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/מָנָֽה
verses.translit: vlqcht 't hchzh m'yl hml'ym 'shr l'hrn vhnpt 'tv tnvph lpny yhvh vhyh lkh lmnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD : and it shall be thy part.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת חֲזֵ֣ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֗ה וְ/אֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַ/תְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵ/אֵיל֙ הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/בָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vqdsht 't chzh htnvph v't shvq htrvmh 'shr hvnf v'shr hvrm m'yl hml'ym m'shr l'hrn vm'shr lbnyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֜י/ו לְ/חָק עוֹלָ֗ם מֵ/אֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּ/תְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵ/אֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/זִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵי/הֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖/ם לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh l'hrn vlbnyv lchq 'vlm m't bny yshr'l khy trvmh hv' vtrvmh yhyh m't bny yshr'l mzbchy shlmyhm trvmtm lyhvh
verses.translation: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בִגְדֵ֤י הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן יִהְי֥וּ לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו אַחֲרָ֑י/ו לְ/מָשְׁחָ֣ה בָ/הֶ֔ם וּ/לְ/מַלֵּא בָ֖/ם אֶת יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbgdy hqdsh 'shr l'hrn yhyv lbnyv 'chryv lmshchh bhm vlml' bm 't ydm
verses.translation: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧/ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖י/ו מִ/בָּנָ֑י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לְ/שָׁרֵ֥ת בַּ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: shb't ymym ylbshm hkhhn tchtyv mbnyv 'shr yb' 'l 'hl mv'd lshrt bqdsh
verses.translation: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place .

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛ת אֵ֥יל הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֖ים תִּקָּ֑ח וּ/בִשַּׁלְתָּ֥ אֶת בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ בְּ/מָקֹ֥ם קָדֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: v't 'yl hml'ym tqch vbshlt 't bshrv bmqm qdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

verses.original: וְ/אָכַ֨ל אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּ/בָנָי/ו֙ אֶת בְּשַׂ֣ר הָ/אַ֔יִל וְ/אֶת הַ/לֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/סָּ֑ל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: v'khl 'hrn vbnyv 't bshr h'yl v't hlchm 'shr bsl ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/אָכְל֤וּ אֹתָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֻּפַּ֣ר בָּ/הֶ֔ם לְ/מַלֵּ֥א אֶת יָדָ֖/ם לְ/קַדֵּ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/זָ֥ר לֹא יֹאכַ֖ל כִּי קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֵֽם
verses.translit: v'khlv 'tm 'shr khpr bhm lml' 't ydm lqdsh 'tm vzr l' y'khl khy qdsh hm
verses.translation: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy.

verses.original: וְֽ/אִם יִוָּתֵ֞ר מִ/בְּשַׂ֧ר הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֛ים וּ/מִן הַ/לֶּ֖חֶם עַד הַ/בֹּ֑קֶר וְ/שָׂרַפְתָּ֤ אֶת הַ/נּוֹתָר֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל כִּי קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'm yvtr mbshr hml'ym vmn hlchm 'd hbqr vshrpt 't hnvtr b'sh l' y'khl khy qdsh hv'
verses.translation: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתָ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּ/לְ/בָנָי/ו֙ כָּ֔כָה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֹתָ֑/כָה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תְּמַלֵּ֥א יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shyt l'hrn vlbnyv khkhh khkhl 'shr tsvyty 'tkhh shb't ymym tml' ydm
verses.translation: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

verses.original: וּ/פַ֨ר חַטָּ֜את תַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה לַ/יּוֹם֙ עַל הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֔ים וְ/חִטֵּאתָ֙ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּ/כַפֶּרְ/ךָ֖ עָלָ֑י/ו וּ/מָֽשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/קַדְּשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vpr cht't t'shh lyvm 'l hkhprym vcht't 'l hmzbch bkhprkh 'lyv vmshcht 'tv lqdshv
verses.translation: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹת֑/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֤ה הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בַּ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: shb't ymym tkhpr 'l hmzbch vqdsht 'tv vhyh hmzbch qdsh qdshym khl hng' bmzbch yqdsh
verses.translation: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם לַ/יּ֖וֹם תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vzh 'shr t'shh 'l hmzbch khbshym bny shnh shnym lyvm tmyd
verses.translation: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

verses.original: אֶת הַ/כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַ/בֹּ֑קֶר וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָ/עַרְבָּֽיִם
verses.translit: 't hkhbsh h'chd t'shh bbqr v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym
verses.translation: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

verses.original: וְ/עִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּ/שֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַ/הִ֔ין וְ/נֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִעִ֥ית הַ/הִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'shrn slt blvl bshmn khtyt rb' hhyn vnskh rb'yt hhyn yyn lkhbsh h'chd
verses.translation: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָ/עַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּ/מִנְחַ֨ת הַ/בֹּ֤קֶר וּ/כְ/נִסְכָּ/הּ֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לָּ֔/הּ לְ/רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym khmncht hbqr vkhnskhh t'shh lh lrych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִוָּעֵ֤ד לָ/כֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: 'lt tmyd ldrtykhm ptch 'hl mv'd lpny yhvh 'shr 'v'd lkhm shmh ldbr 'lykh shm
verses.translation: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD : where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/נֹעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/נִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּ/כְבֹדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vn'dty shmh lbny yshr'l vnqdsh bkhbdy
verses.translation: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/אֶת אַהֲרֹ֧ן וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֛י/ו אֲקַדֵּ֖שׁ לְ/כַהֵ֥ן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vqdshty 't 'hl mv'd v't hmzbch v't 'hrn v't bnyv 'qdsh lkhhn ly
verses.translation: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vshkhnty btvkh bny yshr'l vhyyty lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְ/שָׁכְנִ֣/י בְ/תוֹכָ֑/ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tm m'rts mtsrym lshkhny btvkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shyt mzbch mqtr qtrt 'tsy shtym t'shh 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

verses.original: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכּ֜/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֤ה רָחְבּ/וֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְ/אַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑/וֹ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'mh 'rkhv v'mh rchbv rbv' yhyh v'mtym qmtv mmnv qrntyv
verses.translation: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

verses.original: וְ/צִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜/וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת גַּגּ֧/וֹ וְ/אֶת קִירֹתָ֛י/ו סָבִ֖יב וְ/אֶת קַרְנֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛/וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vtspyt 'tv zhb thvr 't ggv v't qyrtyv sbyb v't qrntyv v'shyt lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לּ֣/וֹ מִ/תַּ֣חַת לְ/זֵר֗/וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔י/ו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑י/ו וְ/הָיָה֙ לְ/בָתִּ֣ים לְ/בַדִּ֔ים לָ/שֵׂ֥את אֹת֖/וֹ בָּ/הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vshty tb't zhb t'shh lv mtcht lzrv 'l shty tsl'tyv t'shh 'l shny tsdyv vhyh lbtym lbdym lsh't 'tv bhmh
verses.translation: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַ/בַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְ/צִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v'shyt 't hbdym 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה אֹת/וֹ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/פָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל אֲרֹ֣ן הָ/עֵדֻ֑ת לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/כַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל הָ֣/עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְ/ךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vntth 'tv lpny hprkht 'shr 'l 'rn h'dt lpny hkhprt 'shr 'l h'dt 'shr 'v'd lkh shmh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛י/ו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר בְּ/הֵיטִיב֛/וֹ אֶת הַ/נֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vhqtyr 'lyv 'hrn qtrt smym bbqr bbqr bhytybv 't hnrt yqtyrnh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת הַ/נֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָ/עֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑/נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbh'lt 'hrn 't hnrt byn h'rbym yqtyrnh qtrt tmyd lpny yhvh ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

verses.original: לֹא תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛י/ו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְ/עֹלָ֣ה וּ/מִנְחָ֑ה וְ/נֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' t'lv 'lyv qtrt zrh v'lh vmnchh vnskh l' tskhv 'lyv
verses.translation: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל קַרְנֹתָ֔י/ו אַחַ֖ת בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה מִ/דַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָי/ו֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhpr 'hrn 'l qrntyv 'cht bshnh mdm cht't hkhprym 'cht bshnh ykhpr 'lyv ldrtykhm qdsh qdshym hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶם֒ וְ/נָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ לַ/יהוָ֖ה בִּ/פְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה בָ/הֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּ/פְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy tsh' 't r'sh bny yshr'l lpqdyhm vntnv 'ysh khpr npshv lyhvh bpqd 'tm vl' yhyh bhm ngf bpqd 'tm
verses.translation: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD , when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה יִתְּנ֗וּ כָּל הָ/עֹבֵר֙ עַל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַ/שֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַ/שֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: zh ytnv khl h'br 'l hpqdym mchtsyt hshql bshql hqdsh 'shrym grh hshql mchtsyt hshql trvmh lyhvh
verses.translation: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֗ל הָ/עֹבֵר֙ עַל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֔ים מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl h'br 'l hpqdym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh ytn trvmt yhvh
verses.translation: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: הֶֽ/עָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְ/הַ/דַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽ/מַּחֲצִ֖ית הַ/שָּׁ֑קֶל לָ/תֵת֙ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: h'shyr l' yrbh vhdl l' ym'yt mmchtsyt hshql ltt 't trvmt yhvh lkhpr 'l npshtykhm
verses.translation: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD , to make an atonement for your souls.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת כֶּ֣סֶף הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵ/אֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֔/וֹ עַל עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/הָיָה֩ לִ/בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְ/זִכָּרוֹן֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vlqcht 't khsf hkhprym m't bny yshr'l vntt 'tv 'l 'bdt 'hl mv'd vhyh lbny yshr'l lzkhrvn lpny yhvh lkhpr 'l npshtykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD , to make an atonement for your souls.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיּ֥וֹר נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְ/כַנּ֥/וֹ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְ/רָחְצָ֑ה וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֗/וֹ בֵּֽין אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּ/ה מָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'shyt khyvr nchsht vkhnv nchsht lrchtsh vntt 'tv byn 'hl mv'd vbyn hmzbch vntt shmh mym
verses.translation: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

verses.original: וְ/רָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת רַגְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vrchtsv 'hrn vbnyv mmnv 't ydyhm v't rglyhm
verses.translation: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

verses.original: בְּ/בֹאָ֞/ם אֶל אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ מַ֖יִם וְ/לֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ א֣וֹ בְ/גִשְׁתָּ֤/ם אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לְ/שָׁרֵ֔ת לְ/הַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: bb'm 'l 'hl mv'd yrchtsv mym vl' ymtv 'v bgshtm 'l hmzbch lshrt lhqtyr 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/רָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵי/הֶ֥ם וְ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְ/הָיְתָ֨ה לָ/הֶ֧ם חָק עוֹלָ֛ם ל֥/וֹ וּ/לְ/זַרְע֖/וֹ לְ/דֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vrchtsv ydyhm vrglyhm vl' ymtv vhyth lhm chq 'vlm lv vlzr'v ldrtm
verses.translation: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה קַח לְ/ךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר דְּרוֹר֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְ/קִנְּמָן בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִית֖/וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מָאתָ֑יִם וּ/קְנֵה בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'th qch lkh bshmym r'sh mr drvr chmsh m'vt vqnmn bshm mchtsytv chmshym vm'tym vqnh bshm chmshym vm'tym
verses.translation: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels , and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels , and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels ,

verses.original: וְ/קִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְ/שֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין
verses.translit: vqdh chmsh m'vt bshql hqdsh vshmn zyt hyn
verses.translation: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹת֗/וֹ שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'shyt 'tv shmn mshcht qdsh rqch mrqcht m'shh rqch shmn mshcht qdsh yhyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֥ ב֖/וֹ אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/אֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָ/עֵדֻֽת
verses.translit: vmshcht bv 't 'hl mv'd v't 'rvn h'dt
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָ֖ה וְ/אֶת כֵּלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/קְּטֹֽרֶת
verses.translit: v't hshlchn v't khl khlyv v't hmnrh v't khlyh v't mzbch hqtrt
verses.translation: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֖ר וְ/אֶת כַּנּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't mzbch h'lh v't khl khlyv v't hkhyr v't khnv
verses.translation: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/הָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֑ים כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ/הֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vqdsht 'tm vhyv qdsh qdshym khl hng' bhm yqdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֖י/ו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם לְ/כַהֵ֥ן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v't 'hrn v't bnyv tmshch vqdsht 'tm lkhhn ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖/י לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l bny yshr'l tdbr l'mr shmn mshcht qdsh yhyh zh ly ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

verses.original: עַל בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּ/בְ/מַ֨תְכֻּנְתּ֔/וֹ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑/הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l bshr 'dm l' yyskh vbmtkhntv l' t'shv khmhv qdsh hv' qdsh yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

verses.original: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔/הוּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עַל זָ֑ר וְ/נִכְרַ֖ת מֵ/עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'ysh 'shr yrqch khmhv v'shr ytn mmnv 'l zr vnkhrt m'myv
verses.translation: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח לְ/ךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף וּ/שְׁחֵ֨לֶת֙ וְ/חֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּ/לְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּ/בַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh qch lkh smym ntf vshchlt vchlbnh smym vlbnh zkhh bd bbd yhyh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָ/הּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רוֹקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָה֥וֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'shyt 'th qtrt rqch m'shh rvqch mmlch thvr qdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּ/נָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְ/נָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜/נָּה לִ/פְנֵ֤י הָ/עֵדֻת֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְ/ךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּ/ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshchqt mmnh hdq vntth mmnh lpny h'dt b'hl mv'd 'shr 'v'd lkh shmh qdsh qdshym thyh lkhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/קְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּ/מַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔/הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָ/כֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqtrt 'shr t'shh bmtkhnth l' t'shv lkhm qdsh thyh lkh lyhvh
verses.translation: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD .

verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹ/הָ לְ/הָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑/הּ וְ/נִכְרַ֖ת מֵ/עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'ysh 'shr y'shh khmvh lhrych bh vnkhrt m'myv
verses.translation: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: רְאֵ֖ה קָרָ֣אתִֽי בְ/שֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אוּרִ֥י בֶן ח֖וּר לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: r'h qr'ty bshm btsl'l bn 'vry bn chvr lmth yhvdh
verses.translation: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

verses.original: וָ/אֲמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖/וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ/חָכְמָ֛ה וּ/בִ/תְבוּנָ֥ה וּ/בְ/דַ֖עַת וּ/בְ/כָל מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: v'ml' 'tv rvch 'lhym bchkhmh vbtbvnh vbd't vbkhl ml'khh
verses.translation: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

verses.original: לַ/חְשֹׁ֖ב מַחֲשָׁבֹ֑ת לַ/עֲשׂ֛וֹת בַּ/זָּהָ֥ב וּ/בַ/כֶּ֖סֶף וּ/בַ/נְּחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: lchshb mchshbt l'shvt bzhb vbkhsf vbnchsht
verses.translation: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְ/מַלֹּ֖את וּ/בַ/חֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּ/כָל מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vbchrsht 'bn lml't vbchrsht 'ts l'shvt bkhl ml'khh
verses.translation: And in cutting of stones, to set them , and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נָתַ֣תִּי אִתּ֗/וֹ אֵ֣ת אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן אֲחִֽיסָמָךְ֙ לְ/מַטֵּה דָ֔ן וּ/בְ/לֵ֥ב כָּל חֲכַם לֵ֖ב נָתַ֣תִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/עָשׂ֕וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny hnh ntty 'tv 't 'hly'b bn 'chysmkh lmth dn vblb khl chkhm lb ntty chkhmh v'shv 't khl 'shr tsvytkh
verses.translation: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

verses.original: אֵ֣ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אָרֹן֙ לָֽ/עֵדֻ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּ֖רֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל כְּלֵ֥י הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: 't 'hl mv'd v't h'rn l'dt v't hkhprt 'shr 'lyv v't khl khly h'hl
verses.translation: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְ/אֶת כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָ֥ה הַ/טְּהֹרָ֖ה וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/קְּטֹֽרֶת
verses.translit: v't hshlchn v't khlyv v't hmnrh hthrh v't khl khlyh v't mzbch hqtrt
verses.translation: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/כִּיּ֖וֹר וְ/אֶת כַּנּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't mzbch h'lh v't khl khlyv v't hkhyvr v't khnv
verses.translation: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַ/שְּׂרָ֑ד וְ/אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו לְ/כַהֵֽן
verses.translit: v't bgdy hshrd v't bgdy hqdsh l'hrn hkhhn v't bgdy bnyv lkhhn
verses.translation: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת שֶׁ֧מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֛ה וְ/אֶת קְטֹ֥רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֖ים לַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִ֖/ךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: v't shmn hmshchh v't qtrt hsmym lqdsh khkhl 'shr tsvytkh y'shv
verses.translation: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַ֥ךְ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖/י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כִּי֩ א֨וֹת הִ֜וא בֵּינִ֤/י וּ/בֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם לָ/דַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr 'kh 't shbtty tshmrv khy 'vt hv' byny vbynykhm ldrtykhm ld't khy 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִ֖וא לָ/כֶ֑ם מְחַֽלְלֶ֨י/הָ֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כִּ֗י כָּל הָ/עֹשֶׂ֥ה בָ/הּ֙ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't hshbt khy qdsh hv' lkhm mchllyh mvt yvmt khy khl h'shh bh ml'khh vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' mqrb 'myh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֧ת שַׁבָּת֛וֹן קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַ/יהוָ֑ה כָּל הָ/עֹשֶׂ֧ה מְלָאכָ֛ה בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: shsht ymym y'shh ml'khh vbyvm hshby'y shbt shbtvn qdsh lyhvh khl h'shh ml'khh byvm hshbt mvt yvmt
verses.translation: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD : whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת לַ/עֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת הַ/שַּׁבָּ֛ת לְ/דֹרֹתָ֖/ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vshmrv bny yshr'l 't hshbt l'shvt 't hshbt ldrtm bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

verses.original: בֵּינִ֗/י וּ/בֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְ/עֹלָ֑ם כִּי שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/בַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַ/יִּנָּפַֽשׁ
verses.translit: byny vbyn bny yshr'l 'vt hv' l'lm khy shsht ymym 'shh yhvh 't hshmym v't h'rts vbyvm hshby'y shbt vynpsh
verses.translation: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּ/כַלֹּת/וֹ֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֤ר אִתּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֣ת הָ/עֵדֻ֑ת לֻחֹ֣ת אֶ֔בֶן כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּ/אֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vytn 'l mshh khkhltv ldbr 'tv bhr syny shny lcht h'dt lcht 'bn khtbym b'tsb' 'lhym
verses.translation: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא הָ/עָ֔ם כִּֽי בֹשֵׁ֥שׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָ/רֶ֣דֶת מִן הָ/הָ֑ר וַ/יִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָ/עָ֜ם עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָי/ו֙ ק֣וּם עֲשֵׂה לָ֣/נוּ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵֽלְכוּ֙ לְ/פָנֵ֔י/נוּ כִּי זֶ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֨/נוּ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה הָ֥יָה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' h'm khy bshsh mshh lrdt mn hhr vyqhl h'm 'l 'hrn vy'mrv 'lyv qvm 'shh lnv 'lhym 'shr ylkhv lpnynv khy zh mshh h'ysh 'shr h'lnv m'rts mtsrym l' yd'nv mh hyh lv
verses.translation: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן פָּֽרְקוּ֙ נִזְמֵ֣י הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י נְשֵׁי/כֶ֔ם בְּנֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בְנֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָבִ֖יאוּ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm 'hrn prqv nzmy hzhb 'shr b'zny nshykhm bnykhm vbntykhm vhby'v 'ly
verses.translation: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם אֶת נִזְמֵ֥י הַ/זָּהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: vytprqv khl h'm 't nzmy hzhb 'shr b'znyhm vyby'v 'l 'hrn
verses.translation: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח מִ/יָּדָ֗/ם וַ/יָּ֤צַר אֹת/וֹ֙ בַּ/חֶ֔רֶט וַֽ/יַּעֲשֵׂ֖/הוּ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּ/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqch mydm vytsr 'tv bchrt vy'shhv 'gl mskhh vy'mrv 'lh 'lhykh yshr'l 'shr h'lvkh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַ/יִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אַֽהֲרֹן֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר חַ֥ג לַ/יהוָ֖ה מָחָֽר
verses.translit: vyr' 'hrn vybn mzbch lpnyv vyqr' 'hrn vy'mr chg lyhvh mchr
verses.translation: And when Aaron saw it , he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֨ימוּ֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ עֹלֹ֔ת וַ/יַּגִּ֖שׁוּ שְׁלָמִ֑ים וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב הָ/עָם֙ לֶֽ/אֱכֹ֣ל וְ/שָׁת֔וֹ וַ/יָּקֻ֖מוּ לְ/צַחֵֽק
verses.translit: vyshkhymv mmchrt vy'lv 'lt vygshv shlmym vyshb h'm l'khl vshtv vyqmv ltschq
verses.translation: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה לֶךְ רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh lkh rd khy shcht 'mkh 'shr h'lyt m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

verses.original: סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔/ם עָשׂ֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ ל/וֹ֙ וַ/יִּזְבְּחוּ ל֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱל֖וּ/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: srv mhr mn hdrkh 'shr tsvytm 'shv lhm 'gl mskhh vyshtchvv lv vyzbchv lv vy'mrv 'lh 'lhykh yshr'l 'shr h'lvkh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh r'yty 't h'm hzh vhnh 'm qshh 'rf hv'
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הַנִּ֣יחָ/ה לִּ֔/י וְ/יִֽחַר אַפִּ֥/י בָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/אֲכַלֵּ֑/ם וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתְ/ךָ֖ לְ/ג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: v'th hnychh ly vychr 'py bhm v'khlm v''shh 'vtkh lgvy gdvl
verses.translation: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לָ/מָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יֶחֱרֶ֤ה אַפְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/עַמֶּ֔/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֨אתָ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/כֹ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל וּ/בְ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה
verses.translit: vychl mshh 't pny yhvh 'lhyv vy'mr lmh yhvh ychrh 'pkh b'mkh 'shr hvts't m'rts mtsrym bkhch gdvl vbyd chzqh
verses.translation: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand? : Heb. the face of the LORD

verses.original: לָ/מָּה֩ יֹאמְר֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר בְּ/רָעָ֤ה הֽוֹצִיאָ/ם֙ לַ/הֲרֹ֤ג אֹתָ/ם֙ בֶּֽ/הָרִ֔ים וּ֨/לְ/כַלֹּתָ֔/ם מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֑ה שׁ֚וּב מֵ/חֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/הִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל הָ/רָעָ֖ה לְ/עַמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lmh y'mrv mtsrym l'mr br'h hvtsy'm lhrg 'tm bhrym vlkhltm m'l pny h'dmh shvb mchrvn 'pkh vhnchm 'l hr'h l'mkh
verses.translation: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

verses.original: זְכֹ֡ר לְ/אַבְרָהָם֩ לְ/יִצְחָ֨ק וּ/לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עֲבָדֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתָּ לָ/הֶם֮ בָּ/ךְ֒ וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/כֶ֔ם כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֖י הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶתֵּן֙ לְ/זַרְעֲ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נָחֲל֖וּ לְ/עֹלָֽם
verses.translit: zkhr l'brhm lytschq vlyshr'l 'bdykh 'shr nshb't lhm bkh vtdbr 'lhm 'rbh 't zr'khm khkhvkhby hshmym vkhl h'rts hz't 'shr 'mrty 'tn lzr'khm vnchlv l'lm
verses.translation: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּ֖חֶם יְהוָ֑ה עַל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לְ/עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vynchm yhvh 'l hr'h 'shr dbr l'shvt l'mv
verses.translation: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֜פֶן וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד מֹשֶׁה֙ מִן הָ/הָ֔ר וּ/שְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָ/עֵדֻ֖ת בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ לֻחֹ֗ת כְּתֻבִים֙ מִ/שְּׁנֵ֣י עֶבְרֵי/הֶ֔ם מִ/זֶּ֥ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֖ה הֵ֥ם כְּתֻבִֽים
verses.translit: vypn vyrd mshh mn hhr vshny lcht h'dt bydv lcht khtbym mshny 'bryhm mzh vmzh hm khtbym
verses.translation: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/לֻּחֹ֔ת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה וְ/הַ/מִּכְתָּ֗ב מִכְתַּ֤ב אֱלֹהִים֙ ה֔וּא חָר֖וּת עַל הַ/לֻּחֹֽת
verses.translit: vhlcht m'shh 'lhym hmh vhmkhtb mkhtb 'lhym hv' chrvt 'l hlcht
verses.translation: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֧ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת ק֥וֹל הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/רֵעֹ֑/ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶה
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvsh' 't qvl h'm br'h vy'mr 'l mshh qvl mlchmh bmchnh
verses.translation: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֥ין קוֹל֙ עֲנ֣וֹת גְּבוּרָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל עֲנ֣וֹת חֲלוּשָׁ֑ה ק֣וֹל עַנּ֔וֹת אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'yn qvl 'nvt gbvrh v'yn qvl 'nvt chlvshh qvl 'nvt 'nkhy shm'
verses.translation: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרַב֙ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֶת הָ/עֵ֖גֶל וּ/מְחֹלֹ֑ת וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ מ/יד/ו מִ/יָּדָי/ו֙ אֶת הַ/לֻּחֹ֔ת וַ/יְשַׁבֵּ֥ר אֹתָ֖/ם תַּ֥חַת הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr qrb 'l hmchnh vyr' 't h'gl vmchlt vychr 'f mshh vyshlkh mydv mydyv 't hlcht vyshbr 'tm tcht hhr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת הָ/עֵ֨גֶל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יִּטְחַ֖ן עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר דָּ֑ק וַ/יִּ֨זֶר֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/יַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqch 't h'gl 'shr 'shv vyshrf b'sh vytchn 'd 'shr dq vyzr 'l pny hmym vyshq 't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן מֶֽה עָשָׂ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּֽי הֵבֵ֥אתָ עָלָ֖י/ו חֲטָאָ֥ה גְדֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn mh 'shh lkh h'm hzh khy hb't 'lyv cht'h gdlh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַל יִ֥חַר אַ֖ף אֲדֹנִ֑/י אַתָּה֙ יָדַ֣עְתָּ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם כִּ֥י בְ/רָ֖ע הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'hrn 'l ychr 'f 'dny 'th yd't 't h'm khy br' hv'
verses.translation: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔/י עֲשֵׂה לָ֣/נוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵלְכ֖וּ לְ/פָנֵ֑י/נוּ כִּי זֶ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֨/נוּ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה הָ֥יָה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mrv ly 'shh lnv 'lhym 'shr ylkhv lpnynv khy zh mshh h'ysh 'shr h'lnv m'rts mtsrym l' yd'nv mh hyh lv
verses.translation: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֤ר לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/מִ֣י זָהָ֔ב הִתְפָּרָ֖קוּ וַ/יִּתְּנוּ לִ֑/י וָ/אַשְׁלִכֵ֣/הוּ בָ/אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א הָ/עֵ֥גֶל הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'mr lhm lmy zhb htprqv vytnv ly v'shlkhhv b'sh vyts' h'gl hzh
verses.translation: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם כִּ֥י פָרֻ֖עַ ה֑וּא כִּֽי פְרָעֹ֣/ה אַהֲרֹ֔ן לְ/שִׁמְצָ֖ה בְּ/קָמֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyr' mshh 't h'm khy pr' hv' khy pr'h 'hrn lshmtsh bqmyhm
verses.translation: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו כָּל בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: vy'md mshh bsh'r hmchnh vy'mr my lyhvh 'ly vy'spv 'lyv khl bny lvy
verses.translation: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׂ֥ימוּ אִישׁ חַרְבּ֖/וֹ עַל יְרֵכ֑/וֹ עִבְר֨וּ וָ/שׁ֜וּבוּ מִ/שַּׁ֤עַר לָ/שַׁ֨עַר֙ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/הִרְג֧וּ אִֽישׁ אֶת אָחִ֛י/ו וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶת קְרֹבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l shymv 'ysh chrbv 'l yrkhv 'brv vshvbv msh'r lsh'r bmchnh vhrgv 'ysh 't 'chyv v'ysh 't r'hv v'ysh 't qrbv
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵֽי לֵוִ֖י כִּ/דְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יִּפֹּ֤ל מִן הָ/עָם֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא כִּ/שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֖י אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vy'shv bny lvy khdbr mshh vypl mn h'm byvm hhv' khshlsht 'lpy 'ysh
verses.translation: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה מִלְא֨וּ יֶדְ/כֶ֤ם הַ/יּוֹם֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בִּ/בְנ֖/וֹ וּ/בְ/אָחִ֑י/ו וְ/לָ/תֵ֧ת עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם הַ/יּ֖וֹם בְּרָכָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh ml'v ydkhm hyvm lyhvh khy 'ysh bbnv vb'chyv vltt 'lykhm hyvm brkhh
verses.translation: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD , even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day. , because every man hath been against his brother, etc

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם אַתֶּ֥ם חֲטָאתֶ֖ם חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה וְ/עַתָּה֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל יְהוָ֔ה אוּלַ֥י אֲכַפְּרָ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד חַטַּאתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vy'mr mshh 'l h'm 'tm cht'tm cht'h gdlh v'th ''lh 'l yhvh 'vly 'khprh b'd cht'tkhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אָ֣נָּ֗א חָטָ֞א הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vyshb mshh 'l yhvh vy'mr 'n' cht' h'm hzh cht'h gdlh vy'shv lhm 'lhy zhb
verses.translation: And Moses returned unto the LORD , and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה אִם תִּשָּׂ֣א חַטָּאתָ֑/ם וְ/אִם אַ֕יִן מְחֵ֣/נִי נָ֔א מִֽ/סִּפְרְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתָֽבְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th 'm tsh' cht'tm v'm 'yn mchny n' msprkh 'shr khtbt
verses.translation: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִ֚י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטָא לִ֔/י אֶמְחֶ֖/נּוּ מִ/סִּפְרִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh my 'shr cht' ly 'mchnv mspry
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
