verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה לֵ֣ךְ נְחֵ֣ה אֶת הָ/עָ֗ם אֶ֤ל אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ לָ֔/ךְ הִנֵּ֥ה מַלְאָכִ֖/י יֵלֵ֣ךְ לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/בְ/י֣וֹם פָּקְדִ֔/י וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֥י עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם חַטָּאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th lkh nchh 't h'm 'l 'shr dbrty lkh hnh ml'khy ylkh lpnykh vbyvm pqdy vpqdty 'lyhm cht'tm
verses.translation: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגֹּ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת הָ/עֵ֔גֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: vygf yhvh 't h'm 'l 'shr 'shv 't h'gl 'shr 'shh 'hrn
verses.translation: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ עֲלֵ֣ה מִ/זֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֣ה וְ/הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱלִ֖יתָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְ/אַבְרָהָ֨ם לְ/יִצְחָ֤ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh lkh 'lh mzh 'th vh'm 'shr h'lyt m'rts mtsrym 'l h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm lytschq vly'qb l'mr lzr'kh 'tnnh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁלַחְתִּ֥י לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ מַלְאָ֑ךְ וְ/גֵֽרַשְׁתִּ֗י אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י וְ/הַֽ/חִתִּי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vshlchty lpnykh ml'kh vgrshty 't hkhn'ny h'mry vhchty vhprzy hchvy vhybvsy
verses.translation: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

verses.original: אֶל אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֶֽעֱלֶ֜ה בְּ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֗ כִּ֤י עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֨רֶף֙ אַ֔תָּה פֶּן אֲכֶלְ/ךָ֖ בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: 'l 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh khy l' ''lh bqrbkh khy 'm qshh 'rf 'th pn 'khlkh bdrkh
verses.translation: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע הָ/עָ֗ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הָ/רָ֛ע הַ/זֶּ֖ה וַ/יִּתְאַבָּ֑לוּ וְ/לֹא שָׁ֛תוּ אִ֥ישׁ עֶדְי֖/וֹ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshm' h'm 't hdbr hr' hzh vyt'blv vl' shtv 'ysh 'dyv 'lyv
verses.translation: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַתֶּ֣ם עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֔רֶף רֶ֧גַע אֶחָ֛ד אֶֽעֱלֶ֥ה בְ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/כִלִּיתִ֑י/ךָ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הוֹרֵ֤ד עֶדְיְ/ךָ֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֵדְעָ֖ה מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'mr 'l bny yshr'l 'tm 'm qshh 'rf rg' 'chd ''lh bqrbkh vkhlytykh v'th hvrd 'dykh m'lykh v'd'h mh ''shh lkh
verses.translation: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְנַצְּל֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת עֶדְיָ֖/ם מֵ/הַ֥ר חוֹרֵֽב
verses.translit: vytntslv bny yshr'l 't 'dym mhr chvrb
verses.translation: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁה֩ יִקַּ֨ח אֶת הָ/אֹ֜הֶל וְ/נָֽטָה ל֣/וֹ מִ/ח֣וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֗ה הַרְחֵק֙ מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/קָ֥רָא ל֖/וֹ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/הָיָה֙ כָּל מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה יֵצֵא֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vmshh yqch 't h'hl vnth lv mchvts lmchnh hrchq mn hmchnh vqr' lv 'hl mv'd vhyh khl mbqsh yhvh yts' 'l 'hl mv'd 'shr mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כְּ/צֵ֤את מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל הָ/אֹ֔הֶל יָק֨וּמוּ֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/נִ֨צְּב֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֣תַח אָהֳל֑/וֹ וְ/הִבִּ֨יטוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד בֹּא֖/וֹ הָ/אֹֽהֱלָ/ה
verses.translit: vhyh khts't mshh 'l h'hl yqvmv khl h'm vntsbv 'ysh ptch 'hlv vhbytv 'chry mshh 'd b'v h'hlh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כְּ/בֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ הָ/אֹ֔הֱלָ/ה יֵרֵד֙ עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽ/עָנָ֔ן וְ/עָמַ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֑הֶל וְ/דִבֶּ֖ר עִם מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vhyh khb' mshh h'hlh yrd 'mvd h'nn v'md ptch h'hl vdbr 'm mshh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֤ה כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֶת עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽ/עָנָ֔ן עֹמֵ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֑הֶל וְ/קָ֤ם כָּל הָ/עָם֙ וְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֥תַח אָהֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vr'h khl h'm 't 'mvd h'nn 'md ptch h'hl vqm khl h'm vhshtchvv 'ysh ptch 'hlv
verses.translation: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

verses.original: וְ/דִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל פָּנִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/שָׁב֙ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וּ/מְשָׁ֨רְת֜/וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ נַ֔עַר לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vdbr yhvh 'l mshh pnym 'l pnym kh'shr ydbr 'ysh 'l r'hv vshb 'l hmchnh vmshrtv yhvsh' bn nvn n'r l' ymysh mtvkh h'hl
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל יְהוָ֗ה רְ֠אֵה אַתָּ֞ה אֹמֵ֤ר אֵלַ/י֙ הַ֚עַל אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֔/נִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלַ֖ח עִמִּ֑/י וְ/אַתָּ֤ה אָמַ֨רְתָּ֙ יְדַעְתִּ֣י/ךָֽ בְ/שֵׁ֔ם וְ/גַם מָצָ֥אתָ חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l yhvh r'h 'th 'mr 'ly h'l 't h'm hzh v'th l' hvd'tny 't 'shr tshlch 'my v'th 'mrt yd'tykh bshm vgm mts't chn b'yny
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD , See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה אִם נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ הוֹדִעֵ֤/נִי נָא֙ אֶת דְּרָכֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אֵדָ֣עֲ/ךָ֔ לְמַ֥עַן אֶמְצָא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/רְאֵ֕ה כִּ֥י עַמְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/גּ֥וֹי הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'th 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh hvd'ny n' 't drkhkh v'd'kh lm'n 'mts' chn b'ynykh vr'h khy 'mkh hgvy hzh
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר פָּנַ֥/י יֵלֵ֖כוּ וַ/הֲנִחֹ֥תִי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr pny ylkhv vhnchty lkh
verses.translation: And he said, My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י/ו אִם אֵ֤ין פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הֹלְכִ֔ים אַֽל תַּעֲלֵ֖/נוּ מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'm 'yn pnykh hlkhym 'l t'lnv mzh
verses.translation: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/מֶּ֣ה יִוָּדַ֣ע אֵפ֗וֹא כִּֽי מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְ/עַמֶּ֔/ךָ הֲ/ל֖וֹא בְּ/לֶכְתְּ/ךָ֣ עִמָּ֑/נוּ וְ/נִפְלֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֔ מִ/כָּ֨ל הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vbmh yvd' 'pv' khy mts'ty chn b'ynykh 'ny v'mkh hlv' blkhtkh 'mnv vnplynv 'ny v'mkh mkhl h'm 'shr 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה גַּ֣ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה כִּֽי מָצָ֤אתָ חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י וָ/אֵדָעֲ/ךָ֖ בְּ/שֵֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh gm 't hdbr hzh 'shr dbrt ''shh khy mts't chn b'yny v'd'kh bshm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַרְאֵ֥/נִי נָ֖א אֶת כְּבֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr hr'ny n' 't khbdkh
verses.translation: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֲנִ֨י אַעֲבִ֤יר כָּל טוּבִ/י֙ עַל פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/קָרָ֧אתִֽי בְ/שֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֖ה לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/חַנֹּתִי֙ אֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָחֹ֔ן וְ/רִחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲרַחֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ny ''byr khl tvby 'l pnykh vqr'ty bshm yhvh lpnykh vchnty 't 'shr 'chn vrchmty 't 'shr 'rchm
verses.translation: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִ/רְאֹ֣ת אֶת פָּנָ֑/י כִּ֛י לֹֽא יִרְאַ֥/נִי הָ/אָדָ֖ם וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr l' tvkhl lr't 't pny khy l' yr'ny h'dm vchy
verses.translation: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה מָק֖וֹם אִתִּ֑/י וְ/נִצַּבְתָּ֖ עַל הַ/צּֽוּר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh hnh mqvm 'ty vntsbt 'l htsvr
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/עֲבֹ֣ר כְּבֹדִ֔/י וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֖י/ךָ בְּ/נִקְרַ֣ת הַ/צּ֑וּר וְ/שַׂכֹּתִ֥י כַפִּ֛/י עָלֶ֖י/ךָ עַד עָבְרִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyh b'br khbdy vshmtykh bnqrt htsvr vshkhty khpy 'lykh 'd 'bry
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

verses.original: וַ/הֲסִרֹתִי֙ אֶת כַּפִּ֔/י וְ/רָאִ֖יתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָ֑/י וּ/פָנַ֖/י לֹ֥א יֵרָאֽוּ
verses.translit: vhsrty 't khpy vr'yt 't 'chry vpny l' yr'v
verses.translation: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה פְּסָל לְ/ךָ֛ שְׁנֵֽי לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּ/רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְ/כָתַבְתִּי֙ עַל הַ/לֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל הַ/לֻּחֹ֥ת הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh psl lkh shny lcht 'bnym khr'shnym vkhtbty 'l hlcht 't hdbrym 'shr hyv 'l hlcht hr'shnym 'shr shbrt
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

verses.original: וֶ/הְיֵ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לַ/בֹּ֑קֶר וְ/עָלִ֤יתָ בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ אֶל הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וְ/נִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ֛/י שָׁ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vhyh nkhvn lbqr v'lyt bbqr 'l hr syny vntsbt ly shm 'l r'sh hhr
verses.translation: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/גַם אִ֥ישׁ אַל יֵרָ֖א בְּ/כָל הָ/הָ֑ר גַּם הַ/צֹּ֤אן וְ/הַ/בָּקָר֙ אַל יִרְע֔וּ אֶל מ֖וּל הָ/הָ֥ר הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'ysh l' y'lh 'mkh vgm 'ysh 'l yr' bkhl hhr gm hts'n vhbqr 'l yr'v 'l mvl hhr hhv'
verses.translation: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְסֹ֡ל שְׁנֵֽי לֻחֹ֨ת אֲבָנִ֜ים כָּ/רִאשֹׁנִ֗ים וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם מֹשֶׁ֤ה בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ אֶל הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִֽים
verses.translit: vypsl shny lcht 'bnym khr'shnym vyshkhm mshh bbqr vy'l 'l hr syny kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv vyqch bydv shny lcht 'bnym
verses.translation: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בֶּֽ/עָנָ֔ן וַ/יִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖/וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א בְ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh b'nn vytytsb 'mv shm vyqr' bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה עַל פָּנָי/ו֮ וַ/יִּקְרָא֒ יְהוָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְ/חַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְ/רַב חֶ֥סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: vy'br yhvh 'l pnyv vyqr' yhvh yhvh 'l rchvm vchnvn 'rkh 'pym vrb chsd v'mt
verses.translation: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD , The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

verses.original: נֹצֵ֥ר חֶ֨סֶד֙ לָ/אֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָ/פֶ֖שַׁע וְ/חַטָּאָ֑ה וְ/נַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֣ד עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֗וֹת עַל בָּנִים֙ וְ/עַל בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְ/עַל רִבֵּעִֽים
verses.translit: ntsr chsd l'lpym nsh' 'vn vpsh' vcht'h vnqh l' ynqh pqd 'vn 'bvt 'l bnym v'l bny bnym 'l shlshym v'l rb'ym
verses.translation: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation .

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֖ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vymhr mshh vyqd 'rtsh vyshtchv
verses.translation: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר אִם נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֔/י יֵֽלֶךְ נָ֥א אֲדֹנָ֖/י בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֑/נוּ כִּ֤י עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֨רֶף֙ ה֔וּא וְ/סָלַחְתָּ֛ לַ/עֲוֺנֵ֥/נוּ וּ/לְ/חַטָּאתֵ֖/נוּ וּ/נְחַלְתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh 'dny ylkh n' 'dny bqrbnv khy 'm qshh 'rf hv' vslcht l'vnnv vlcht'tnv vnchltnv
verses.translation: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ כֹּרֵ֣ת בְּרִית֒ נֶ֤גֶד כָּֽל עַמְּ/ךָ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא נִבְרְא֥וּ בְ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וּ/בְ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/רָאָ֣ה כָל הָ֠/עָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֨ה בְ/קִרְבּ֜/וֹ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי נוֹרָ֣א ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh 'nkhy khrt bryt ngd khl 'mkh ''shh npl't 'shr l' nbr'v bkhl h'rts vbkhl hgvym vr'h khl h'm 'shr 'th bqrbv 't m'shh yhvh khy nvr' hv' 'shr 'ny 'shh 'mkh
verses.translation: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

verses.original: שְׁמָ֨ר לְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֣ הַ/יּ֑וֹם הִנְ/נִ֧י גֹרֵ֣שׁ מִ/פָּנֶ֗י/ךָ אֶת הָ/אֱמֹרִי֙ וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְ/הַ/חִתִּי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י וְ/הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: shmr lkh 't 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm hnny grsh mpnykh 't h'mry vhkhn'ny vhchty vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy
verses.translation: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֗ פֶּן תִּכְרֹ֤ת בְּרִית֙ לְ/יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ֣א עָלֶ֑י/הָ פֶּן יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/מוֹקֵ֖שׁ בְּ/קִרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn tkhrt bryt lyvshb h'rts 'shr 'th b' 'lyh pn yhyh lmvqsh bqrbkh
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָ/ם֙ תִּתֹּצ֔וּ/ן וְ/אֶת מַצֵּבֹתָ֖/ם תְּשַׁבֵּר֑וּ/ן וְ/אֶת אֲשֵׁרָ֖י/ו תִּכְרֹתֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: khy 't mzbchtm tttsvn v't mtsbtm tshbrvn v't 'shryv tkhrtvn
verses.translation: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לְ/אֵ֣ל אַחֵ֑ר כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ קַנָּ֣א שְׁמ֔/וֹ אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֖א הֽוּא
verses.translit: khy l' tshtchvh l'l 'chr khy yhvh qn' shmv 'l qn' hv'
verses.translation: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

verses.original: פֶּן תִּכְרֹ֥ת בְּרִ֖ית לְ/יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/זָנ֣וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/זָבְחוּ֙ לֵ/אלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/קָרָ֣א לְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֖ מִ/זִּבְחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: pn tkhrt bryt lyvshb h'rts vznv 'chry 'lhyhm vzbchv l'lhyhm vqr' lkh v'khlt mzbchv
verses.translation: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ מִ/בְּנֹתָ֖י/ו לְ/בָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/זָנ֣וּ בְנֹתָ֗י/ו אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ן וְ/הִזְנוּ֙ אֶת בָּנֶ֔י/ךָ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vlqcht mbntyv lbnykh vznv bntyv 'chry 'lhyhn vhznv 't bnykh 'chry 'lhyhn
verses.translation: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֥י מַסֵּכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'lhy mskhh l' t'shh lkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

verses.original: אֶת חַ֣ג הַ/מַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֜ים תֹּאכַ֤ל מַצּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔/ךָ לְ/מוֹעֵ֖ד חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/אָבִ֑יב כִּ֚י בְּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/אָבִ֔יב יָצָ֖אתָ מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: 't chg hmtsvt tshmr shb't ymym t'khl mtsvt 'shr tsvytkh lmv'd chdsh h'byb khy bchdsh h'byb yts't mmtsrym
verses.translation: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

verses.original: כָּל פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם לִ֑/י וְ/כָֽל מִקְנְ/ךָ֙ תִּזָּכָ֔ר פֶּ֖טֶר שׁ֥וֹר וָ/שֶֽׂה
verses.translit: khl ptr rchm ly vkhl mqnkh tzkhr ptr shvr vshh
verses.translation: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male .

verses.original: וּ/פֶ֤טֶר חֲמוֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְ/שֶׂ֔ה וְ/אִם לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַ/עֲרַפְתּ֑/וֹ כֹּ֣ל בְּכ֤וֹר בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖/י רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: vptr chmvr tpdh bshh v'm l' tpdh v'rptv khl bkhvr bnykh tpdh vl' yr'v pny ryqm
verses.translation: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲבֹ֔ד וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת בֶּ/חָרִ֥ישׁ וּ/בַ/קָּצִ֖יר תִּשְׁבֹּֽת
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'bd vbyvm hshby'y tshbt bchrysh vbqtsyr tshbt
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

verses.original: וְ/חַ֤ג שָׁבֻעֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לְ/ךָ֔ בִּכּוּרֵ֖י קְצִ֣יר חִטִּ֑ים וְ/חַג֙ הָֽ/אָסִ֔יף תְּקוּפַ֖ת הַ/שָּׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vchg shb't t'shh lkh bkhvry qtsyr chtym vchg h'syf tqvpt hshnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל זְכ֣וּרְ/ךָ֔ אֶת פְּנֵ֛י הָֽ/אָדֹ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shlsh p'mym bshnh yr'h khl zkhvrkh 't pny h'dn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD , the God of Israel.

verses.original: כִּֽי אוֹרִ֤ישׁ גּוֹיִם֙ מִ/פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הִרְחַבְתִּ֖י אֶת גְּבוּלֶ֑/ךָ וְ/לֹא יַחְמֹ֥ד אִישׁ֙ אֶֽת אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ בַּ/עֲלֹֽתְ/ךָ֗ לֵ/רָאוֹת֙ אֶת פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁנָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'vrysh gvym mpnykh vhrchbty 't gbvlkh vl' ychmd 'ysh 't 'rtskh b'ltkh lr'vt 't pny yhvh 'lhykh shlsh p'mym bshnh
verses.translation: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.

verses.original: לֹֽא תִשְׁחַ֥ט עַל חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם זִבְחִ֑/י וְ/לֹא יָלִ֣ין לַ/בֹּ֔קֶר זֶ֖בַח חַ֥ג הַ/פָּֽסַח
verses.translit: l' tshcht 'l chmts dm zbchy vl' ylyn lbqr zbch chg hpsch
verses.translation: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּ/חֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: r'shyt bkhvry 'dmtkh tby' byt yhvh 'lhykh l' tbshl gdy bchlb 'mv
verses.translation: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּתָב לְ/ךָ֖ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֞י עַל פִּ֣י הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה כָּרַ֧תִּי אִתְּ/ךָ֛ בְּרִ֖ית וְ/אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh khtb lkh 't hdbrym h'lh khy 'l py hdbrym h'lh khrty 'tkh bryt v't yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי שָׁ֣ם עִם יְהוָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔ל וּ/מַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתָ֑ה וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב עַל הַ/לֻּחֹ֗ת אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/בְּרִ֔ית עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַ/דְּבָרִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy shm 'm yhvh 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh lchm l' 'khl vmym l' shth vykhtb 'l hlcht 't dbry hbryt 'shrt hdbrym
verses.translation: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/רֶ֤דֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ מֵ/הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּ/שְׁנֵ֨י לֻחֹ֤ת הָֽ/עֵדֻת֙ בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּ/רִדְתּ֖/וֹ מִן הָ/הָ֑ר וּ/מֹשֶׁ֣ה לֹֽא יָדַ֗ע כִּ֥י קָרַ֛ן ע֥וֹר פָּנָ֖י/ו בְּ/דַבְּר֥/וֹ אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy brdt mshh mhr syny vshny lcht h'dt byd mshh brdtv mn hhr vmshh l' yd' khy qrn 'vr pnyv bdbrv 'tv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨רְא אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/כָל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה קָרַ֖ן ע֣וֹר פָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּֽירְא֖וּ מִ/גֶּ֥שֶׁת אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' 'hrn vkhl bny yshr'l 't mshh vhnh qrn 'vr pnyv vyyr'v mgsht 'lyv
verses.translation: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יָּשֻׁ֧בוּ אֵלָ֛י/ו אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְ/כָל הַ/נְּשִׂאִ֖ים בָּ/עֵדָ֑ה וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhm mshh vyshbv 'lyv 'hrn vkhl hnsh'ym b'dh vydbr mshh 'lhm
verses.translation: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֥ן נִגְּשׁ֖וּ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יְצַוֵּ֕/ם אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/הַ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: v'chry khn ngshv khl bny yshr'l vytsvm 't khl 'shr dbr yhvh 'tv bhr syny
verses.translation: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִ/דַּבֵּ֖ר אִתָּ֑/ם וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן עַל פָּנָ֖י/ו מַסְוֶֽה
verses.translit: vykhl mshh mdbr 'tm vytn 'l pnyv msvh
verses.translation: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/בֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ יָסִ֥יר אֶת הַ/מַּסְוֶ֖ה עַד צֵאת֑/וֹ וְ/יָצָ֗א וְ/דִבֶּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצֻוֶּֽה
verses.translit: vbb' mshh lpny yhvh ldbr 'tv ysyr 't hmsvh 'd ts'tv vyts' vdbr 'l bny yshr'l 't 'shr ytsvh
verses.translation: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

verses.original: וְ/רָא֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה כִּ֣י קָרַ֔ן ע֖וֹר פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְ/הֵשִׁ֨יב מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת הַ/מַּסְוֶה֙ עַל פָּנָ֔י/ו עַד בֹּא֖/וֹ לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vr'v bny yshr'l 't pny mshh khy qrn 'vr pny mshh vhshyb mshh 't hmsvh 'l pnyv 'd b'v ldbr 'tv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְהֵ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אֵ֚לֶּה הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqhl mshh 't khl 'dt bny yshr'l vy'mr 'lhm 'lh hdbrym 'shr tsvh yhvh l'sht 'tm
verses.translation: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י יִהְיֶ֨ה לָ/כֶ֥ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן לַ/יהוָ֑ה כָּל הָ/עֹשֶׂ֥ה ב֛/וֹ מְלָאכָ֖ה יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'shh ml'khh vbyvm hshby'y yhyh lkhm qdsh shbt shbtvn lyhvh khl h'shh bv ml'khh yvmt
verses.translation: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

verses.original: לֹא תְבַעֲר֣וּ אֵ֔שׁ בְּ/כֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם בְּ/י֖וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: l' tb'rv 'sh bkhl mshbtykhm byvm hshbt
verses.translation: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל כָּל עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l l'mr zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

verses.original: קְח֨וּ מֵֽ/אִתְּ/כֶ֤ם תְּרוּמָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כֹּ֚ל נְדִ֣יב לִבּ֔/וֹ יְבִיאֶ֕/הָ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה זָהָ֥ב וָ/כֶ֖סֶף וּ/נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: qchv m'tkhm trvmh lyhvh khl ndyb lbv yby'h 't trvmt yhvh zhb vkhsf vnchsht
verses.translation: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD : whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD ; gold, and silver, and brass,

verses.original: וּ/תְכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ וְ/עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh v'zym
verses.translation: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair ,

verses.original: וְ/עֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְ/עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַ/עֲצֵ֥י שִׂטִּֽים
verses.translit: v'rt 'ylm m'dmym v'rt tchshym v'tsy shtym
verses.translation: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

verses.original: וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן לַ/מָּא֑וֹר וּ/בְשָׂמִים֙ לְ/שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/לִ/קְטֹ֖רֶת הַ/סַּמִּֽים
verses.translit: vshmn lm'vr vbshmym lshmn hmshchh vlqtrt hsmym
verses.translation: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

verses.original: וְ/אַ֨בְנֵי שֹׁ֔הַם וְ/אַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָ/אֵפ֖וֹד וְ/לַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: v'bny shhm v'bny ml'ym l'pvd vlchshn
verses.translation: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

verses.original: וְ/כָל חֲכַם לֵ֖ב בָּ/כֶ֑ם יָבֹ֣אוּ וְ/יַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl chkhm lb bkhm yb'v vy'shv 't khl 'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;

verses.original: אֶת הַ֨/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן אֶֽת אָהֳל֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת מִכְסֵ֑/הוּ אֶת קְרָסָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶת קְרָשָׁ֔י/ו אֶת בְּרִיחָ֕/ו אֶת עַמֻּדָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת אֲדָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 't hmshkhn 't 'hlv v't mkhshv 't qrsyv v't qrshyv 't brychv 't 'mdyv v't 'dnyv
verses.translation: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

verses.original: אֶת הָ/אָרֹ֥ן וְ/אֶת בַּדָּ֖י/ו אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּ֑רֶת וְ/אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַ/מָּסָֽךְ
verses.translit: 't h'rn v't bdyv 't hkhprt v't prkht hmskh
verses.translation: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,

verses.original: אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֥ן וְ/אֶת בַּדָּ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַ/פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: 't hshlchn v't bdyv v't khl khlyv v't lchm hpnym
verses.translation: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מְנֹרַ֧ת הַ/מָּא֛וֹר וְ/אֶת כֵּלֶ֖י/הָ וְ/אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַ/מָּאֽוֹר
verses.translit: v't mnrt hm'vr v't khlyh v't nrtyh v't shmn hm'vr
verses.translation: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/קְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ וְ/אֶת בַּדָּ֔י/ו וְ/אֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֑ים וְ/אֶת מָסַ֥ךְ הַ/פֶּ֖תַח לְ/פֶ֥תַח הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: v't mzbch hqtrt v't bdyv v't shmn hmshchh v't qtrt hsmym v't mskh hptch lptch hmshkhn
verses.translation: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

verses.original: אֵ֣ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֗ה וְ/אֶת מִכְבַּ֤ר הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ אֶת בַּדָּ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֖ר וְ/אֶת כַּנּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't mzbch h'lh v't mkhbr hnchsht 'shr lv 't bdyv v't khl khlyv 't hkhyr v't khnv
verses.translation: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

verses.original: אֵ֚ת קַלְעֵ֣י הֶ/חָצֵ֔ר אֶת עַמֻּדָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת אֲדָנֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶ/חָצֵֽר
verses.translit: 't ql'y hchtsr 't 'mdyv v't 'dnyh v't mskh sh'r hchtsr
verses.translation: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

verses.original: אֶת יִתְדֹ֧ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְ/אֶת יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר וְ/אֶת מֵיתְרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 't ytdt hmshkhn v't ytdt hchtsr v't mytryhm
verses.translation: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

verses.original: אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י הַ/שְּׂרָ֖ד לְ/שָׁרֵ֣ת בַּ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו לְ/כַהֵֽן
verses.translit: 't bgdy hshrd lshrt bqdsh 't bgdy hqdsh l'hrn hkhhn v't bgdy bnyv lkhhn
verses.translation: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽצְא֛וּ כָּל עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyts'v khl 'dt bny yshr'l mlpny mshh
verses.translation: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ כָּל אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂא֣/וֹ לִבּ֑/וֹ וְ/כֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָדְבָ֨ה רוּח֜/וֹ אֹת֗/וֹ הֵ֠בִיאוּ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לִ/מְלֶ֨אכֶת אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּ/לְ/כָל עֲבֹ֣דָת֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/בִגְדֵ֖י הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vyb'v khl 'ysh 'shr nsh'v lbv vkhl 'shr ndbh rvchv 'tv hby'v 't trvmt yhvh lml'kht 'hl mv'd vlkhl 'bdtv vlbgdy hqdsh
verses.translation: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים עַל הַ/נָּשִׁ֑ים כֹּ֣ל נְדִ֣יב לֵ֗ב הֵ֠בִיאוּ חָ֣ח וָ/נֶ֜זֶם וְ/טַבַּ֤עַת וְ/כוּמָז֙ כָּל כְּלִ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְ/כָל אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵנִ֛יף תְּנוּפַ֥ת זָהָ֖ב לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v h'nshym 'l hnshym khl ndyb lb hby'v chch vnzm vtb't vkhvmz khl khly zhb vkhl 'ysh 'shr hnyf tnvpt zhb lyhvh
verses.translation: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כָל אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָ֣א אִתּ֗/וֹ תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ וְ/עִזִּ֑ים וְ/עֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְ/עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים הֵבִֽיאוּ
verses.translit: vkhl 'ysh 'shr nmts' 'tv tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh v'zym v'rt 'ylm m'dmym v'rt tchshym hby'v
verses.translation: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair , and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought them .

verses.original: כָּל מֵרִ֗ים תְּר֤וּמַת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ וּ/נְחֹ֔שֶׁת הֵבִ֕יאוּ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א אִתּ֜/וֹ עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֛ים לְ/כָל מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה הֵבִֽיאוּ
verses.translit: khl mrym trvmt khsf vnchsht hby'v 't trvmt yhvh vkhl 'shr nmts' 'tv 'tsy shtym lkhl ml'kht h'bdh hby'v
verses.translation: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’s offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it .

verses.original: וְ/כָל אִשָּׁ֥ה חַכְמַת לֵ֖ב בְּ/יָדֶ֣י/הָ טָו֑וּ וַ/יָּבִ֣יאוּ מַטְוֶ֗ה אֶֽת הַ/תְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֔ן אֶת תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/שֵּֽׁשׁ
verses.translit: vkhl 'shh chkhmt lb bydyh tvv vyby'v mtvh 't htkhlt v't h'rgmn 't tvl't hshny v't hshsh
verses.translation: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ֨/נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָשָׂ֥א לִבָּ֛/ן אֹתָ֖/נָה בְּ/חָכְמָ֑ה טָו֖וּ אֶת הָ/עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: vkhl hnshym 'shr nsh' lbn 'tnh bchkhmh tvv 't h'zym
verses.translation: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נְּשִׂאִ֣ם הֵבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֚ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַ/שֹּׁ֔הַם וְ/אֵ֖ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֑ים לָ/אֵפ֖וֹד וְ/לַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vhnsh'm hby'v 't 'bny hshhm v't 'bny hml'ym l'pvd vlchshn
verses.translation: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/בֹּ֖שֶׂם וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן לְ/מָא֕וֹר וּ/לְ/שֶׁ֨מֶן֙ הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/לִ/קְטֹ֖רֶת הַ/סַּמִּֽים
verses.translit: v't hbshm v't hshmn lm'vr vlshmn hmshchh vlqtrt hsmym
verses.translation: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

verses.original: כָּל אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֣ב לִבָּ/ם֮ אֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/הָבִיא֙ לְ/כָל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֑ה הֵבִ֧יאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל נְדָבָ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl 'ysh v'shh 'shr ndb lbm 'tm lhby' lkhl hml'khh 'shr tsvh yhvh l'shvt byd mshh hby'v bny yshr'l ndbh lyhvh
verses.translation: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD , every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רְא֛וּ קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/שֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אוּרִ֥י בֶן ח֖וּר לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l bny yshr'l r'v qr' yhvh bshm btsl'l bn 'vry bn chvr lmth yhvdh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

verses.original: וַ/יְמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖/וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ/חָכְמָ֛ה בִּ/תְבוּנָ֥ה וּ/בְ/דַ֖עַת וּ/בְ/כָל מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vyml' 'tv rvch 'lhym bchkhmh btbvnh vbd't vbkhl ml'khh
verses.translation: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

verses.translit: vlchshb mchshbt l'sht bzhb vbkhsf vbnchsht
verses.translation: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְ/מַלֹּ֖את וּ/בַ/חֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּ/כָל מְלֶ֥אכֶת מַחֲשָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: vbchrsht 'bn lml't vbchrsht 'ts l'shvt bkhl ml'kht mchshbt
verses.translation: And in the cutting of stones, to set them , and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הוֹרֹ֖ת נָתַ֣ן בְּ/לִבּ֑/וֹ ה֕וּא וְ/אָֽהֳלִיאָ֥ב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָ֖ךְ לְ/מַטֵּה דָֽן
verses.translit: vlhvrt ntn blbv hv' v'hly'b bn 'chysmkh lmth dn
verses.translation: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.original: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜/ם חָכְמַת לֵ֗ב לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ וְ/חֹשֵׁב֒ וְ/רֹקֵ֞ם בַּ/תְּכֵ֣לֶת וּ/בָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּ/תוֹלַ֧עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֛י וּ/בַ/שֵּׁ֖שׁ וְ/אֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל מְלָאכָ֔ה וְ/חֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת
verses.translit: ml' 'tm chkhmt lb l'shvt khl ml'kht chrsh vchshb vrqm btkhlt vb'rgmn btvl't hshny vbshsh v'rg 'shy khl ml'khh vchshby mchshbt
verses.translation: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְ/אָהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְ/כֹ֣ל אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּ/תְבוּנָה֙ בָּ/הֵ֔מָּה לָ/דַ֣עַת לַ/עֲשֹׂ֔ת אֶֽת כָּל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'shh btsl'l v'hly'b vkhl 'ysh chkhm lb 'shr ntn yhvh chkhmh vtbvnh bhmh ld't l'sht 't khl ml'kht 'bdt hqdsh lkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל בְּצַלְאֵ֘ל וְ/אֶל אָֽהֳלִיאָב֒ וְ/אֶל֙ כָּל אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה חָכְמָ֖ה בְּ/לִבּ֑/וֹ כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נְשָׂא֣/וֹ לִבּ֔/וֹ לְ/קָרְבָ֥ה אֶל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'l btsl'l v'l 'hly'b v'l khl 'ysh chkhm lb 'shr ntn yhvh chkhmh blbv khl 'shr nsh'v lbv lqrbh 'l hml'khh l'sht 'th
verses.translation: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/תְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִ/מְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַ/עֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑/הּ וְ֠/הֵם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥י/ו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּ/בֹּ֥קֶר בַּ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vyqchv mlpny mshh 't khl htrvmh 'shr hby'v bny yshr'l lml'kht 'bdt hqdsh l'sht 'th vhm hby'v 'lyv 'vd ndbh bbqr bbqr
verses.translation: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal . And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ כָּל הַ֣/חֲכָמִ֔ים הָ/עֹשִׂ֕ים אֵ֖ת כָּל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ אִֽישׁ אִ֥ישׁ מִ/מְּלַאכְתּ֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: vyb'v khl hchkhmym h'shym 't khl ml'kht hqdsh 'ysh 'ysh mml'khtv 'shr hmh 'shym
verses.translation: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה לֵּ/אמֹ֔ר מַרְבִּ֥ים הָ/עָ֖ם לְ/הָבִ֑יא מִ/דֵּ֤י הָֽ/עֲבֹדָה֙ לַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l mshh l'mr mrbym h'm lhby' mdy h'bdh lml'khh 'shr tsvh yhvh l'sht 'th
verses.translation: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֗ה אַל יַעֲשׂוּ ע֛וֹד מְלָאכָ֖ה לִ/תְרוּמַ֣ת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַ/יִּכָּלֵ֥א הָ/עָ֖ם מֵ/הָבִֽיא
verses.translit: vytsv mshh vy'byrv qvl bmchnh l'mr 'ysh v'shh 'l y'shv 'vd ml'khh ltrvmt hqdsh vykhl' h'm mhby'
verses.translation: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מְּלָאכָ֗ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַיָּ֛/ם לְ/כָל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת אֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/הוֹתֵֽר
verses.translit: vhml'khh hyth dym lkhl hml'khh l'shvt 'th vhvtr
verses.translation: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֨וּ כָל חֲכַם לֵ֜ב בְּ/עֹשֵׂ֧י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֛ה אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּ/תְכֵ֤לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָן֙ וְ/תוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'shv khl chkhm lb b'shy hml'khh 't hmshkhn 'shr yry't shsh mshzr vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny khrbym m'shh chshb 'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

verses.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽ/אַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה הַ/יְרִיעָ֖ה הָ/אֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְ/כָל הַ/יְרִיעֹֽת
verses.translit: 'rkh hyry'h h'cht shmnh v'shrym b'mh vrchb 'rb' b'mh hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht lkhl hyry't
verses.translation: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַבֵּר֙ אֶת חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַ/יְרִיעֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל אֶחָ֑ת וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חִבַּ֔ר אַחַ֖ת אֶל אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vychbr 't chmsh hyry't 'cht 'l 'cht vchmsh yry't chbr 'cht 'l 'cht
verses.translation: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַ/יְרִיעָה֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת מִ/קָּצָ֖ה בַּ/מַּחְבָּ֑רֶת כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בִּ/שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה הַ/קִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּ/מַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vy'sh ll't tkhlt 'l shpt hyry'h h'cht mqtsh bmchbrt khn 'shh bshpt hyry'h hqytsvnh bmchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֮ בַּ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָ/אֶחָת֒ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּ/מַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַ/לֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: chmshym ll't 'shh byry'h h'cht vchmshym ll't 'shh bqtsh hyry'h 'shr bmchbrt hshnyt mqbylt hll't 'cht 'l 'cht
verses.translation: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַ/יְחַבֵּ֨ר אֶת הַ/יְרִעֹ֜ת אַחַ֤ת אֶל אַחַת֙ בַּ/קְּרָסִ֔ים וַֽ/יְהִ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh chmshym qrsy zhb vychbr 't hyr't 'cht 'l 'cht bqrsym vyhy hmshkhn 'chd
verses.translation: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְ/אֹ֖הֶל עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'sh yry't 'zym l'hl 'l hmshkhn 'shty 'shrh yry't 'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

verses.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָ/אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וְ/אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת רֹ֖חַב הַ/יְרִיעָ֣ה הָ/אֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְ/עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת
verses.translit: 'rkh hyry'h h'cht shlshym b'mh v'rb' 'mvt rchb hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht l'shty 'shrh yry't
verses.translation: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַבֵּ֛ר אֶת חֲמֵ֥שׁ הַ/יְרִיעֹ֖ת לְ/בָ֑ד וְ/אֶת שֵׁ֥שׁ הַ/יְרִיעֹ֖ת לְ/בָֽד
verses.translit: vychbr 't chmsh hyry't lbd v't shsh hyry't lbd
verses.translation: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה הַ/קִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּ/מַּחְבָּ֑רֶת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ עַל שְׂפַ֣ת הַ/יְרִיעָ֔ה הַ/חֹבֶ֖רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vy'sh ll't chmshym 'l shpt hyry'h hqytsnh bmchbrt vchmshym ll't 'shh 'l shpt hyry'h hchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים לְ/חַבֵּ֥ר אֶת הָ/אֹ֖הֶל לִֽ/הְיֹ֥ת אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh qrsy nchsht chmshym lchbr 't h'hl lhyt 'chd
verses.translation: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ מִכְסֶה֙ לָ/אֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵלִ֖ים מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּ/מִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'sh mkhsh l'hl 'rt 'lym m'dmym vmkhsh 'rt tchshym mlm'lh
verses.translation: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hqrshym lmshkhn 'tsy shtym 'mdym
verses.translation: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

verses.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמֹּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַ/קָּ֑רֶשׁ וְ/אַמָּה֙ וַ/חֲצִ֣י הָֽ/אַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'shr 'mt 'rkh hqrsh v'mh vchtsy h'mh rchb hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדֹ֗ת לַ/קֶּ֨רֶשׁ֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: shty ydt lqrsh h'chd mshlbt 'cht 'l 'cht khn 'shh lkhl qrshy hmshkhn
verses.translation: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קְרָשִׁ֔ים לִ/פְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גֶב תֵּימָֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hqrshym lmshkhn 'shrym qrshym lp't ngb tymnh
verses.translation: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי כֶ֔סֶף עָשָׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת הַ/קֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָד֙ לִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔י/ו וּ/שְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָ֖ד לִ/שְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dny khsf 'shh tcht 'shrym hqrshym shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv
verses.translation: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/צֶ֧לַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית לִ/פְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עָשָׂ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים קְרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vltsl' hmshkhn hshnyt lp't tspvn 'shh 'shrym qrshym
verses.translation: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַ/קֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָ֔ד וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dnyhm khsf shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.translit: vlyrkhty hmshkhn ymh 'shh shshh qrshym
verses.translation: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה לִ/מְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּ/יַּרְכָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vshny qrshym 'shh lmqts't hmshkhn byrkhtym
verses.translation: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֣וּ תוֹאֲמִם֮ מִ/לְּ/מַטָּה֒ וְ/יַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ אֶל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ אֶל הַ/טַּבַּ֖עַת הָ/אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן עָשָׂ֣ה לִ/שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם לִ/שְׁנֵ֖י הַ/מִּקְצֹעֹֽת
verses.translit: vhyv tv'mm mlmth vychdv yhyv tmym 'l r'shv 'l htb't h'cht khn 'shh lshnyhm lshny hmqts't
verses.translation: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

verses.original: וְ/הָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֤י אֲדָנִים֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhyv shmnh qrshym v'dnyhm khsf shshh 'shr 'dnym shny 'dnym shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ בְּרִיחֵ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְ/קַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vy'sh brychy 'tsy shtym chmshh lqrshy tsl' hmshkhn h'cht
verses.translation: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.original: וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְ/קַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑ית וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה בְרִיחִם֙ לְ/קַרְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַ/יַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vchmshh brychm lqrshy tsl' hmshkhn hshnyt vchmshh brychm lqrshy hmshkhn lyrkhtym ymh
verses.translation: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת הַ/בְּרִ֣יחַ הַ/תִּיכֹ֑ן לִ/בְרֹ֨חַ֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֔ים מִן הַ/קָּצֶ֖ה אֶל הַ/קָּצֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hbrych htykhn lbrch btvkh hqrshym mn hqtsh 'l hqtsh
verses.translation: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת הַ/קְּרָשִׁ֞ים צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְ/אֶת טַבְּעֹתָ/ם֙ עָשָׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַ/בְּרִיחִ֑ם וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֶת הַ/בְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v't hqrshym tsph zhb v't tb'tm 'shh zhb btym lbrychm vytsf 't hbrychm zhb
verses.translation: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת הַ/פָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖/הּ כְּרֻבִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hprkht tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh chshb 'shh 'th khrbym
verses.translation: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֗/הּ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַ/יְצַפֵּ֣/ם זָהָ֔ב וָוֵי/הֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וַ/יִּצֹ֣ק לָ/הֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי כָֽסֶף
verses.translit: vy'sh lh 'rb'h 'mvdy shtym vytspm zhb vvyhm zhb vytsq lhm 'rb'h 'dny khsf
verses.translation: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ מָסָךְ֙ לְ/פֶ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'sh mskh lptch h'hl tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh rqm
verses.translation: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַמּוּדָ֤י/ו חֲמִשָּׁה֙ וְ/אֶת וָ֣וֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/צִפָּ֧ה רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֛ם וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: v't 'mvdyv chmshh v't vvyhm vtsph r'shyhm vchshqyhm zhb v'dnyhm chmshh nchsht
verses.translation: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל אֶת הָ/אָרֹ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָ/חֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֤ה וָ/חֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֥ה וָ/חֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh btsl'l 't h'rn 'tsy shtym 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhv v'mh vchtsy rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

verses.original: וַ/יְצַפֵּ֛/הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר מִ/בַּ֣יִת וּ/מִ/ח֑וּץ וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛/וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vytsphv zhb thvr mbyt vmchvts vy'sh lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצֹ֣ק ל֗/וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑י/ו וּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל צַלְע/וֹ֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת וּ/שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּע֔וֹת עַל צַלְע֖/וֹ הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vytsq lv 'rb' tb't zhb 'l 'rb' p'mtyv vshty tb't 'l tsl'v h'cht vshty tb'vt 'l tsl'v hshnyt
verses.translation: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vy'sh bdy 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֤א אֶת הַ/בַּדִּים֙ בַּ/טַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָ/אָרֹ֑ן לָ/שֵׂ֖את אֶת הָ/אָרֹֽן
verses.translit: vyb' 't hbdym btb't 'l tsl't h'rn lsh't 't h'rn
verses.translation: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ כַּפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָ/חֵ֨צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔/הּ וְ/אַמָּ֥ה וָ/חֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'sh khprt zhb thvr 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhh v'mh vchtsy rchbh
verses.translation: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֥י כְרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔/ם מִ/שְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַ/כַּפֹּֽרֶת
verses.translit: vy'sh shny khrbym zhb mqshh 'shh 'tm mshny qtsvt hkhprt
verses.translation: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

verses.original: כְּרוּב אֶחָ֤ד מִ/קָּצָה֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וּ/כְרוּב אֶחָ֥ד מִ/קָּצָ֖ה מִ/זֶּ֑ה מִן הַ/כַּפֹּ֛רֶת עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת הַ/כְּרֻבִ֖ים מִ/שְּׁנֵ֥י קצוות/ו קְצוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khrvb 'chd mqtsh mzh vkhrvb 'chd mqtsh mzh mn hkhprt 'shh 't hkhrbym mshny qtsvvtv qtsvtyv
verses.translation: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ הַ/כְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְ/מַ֗עְלָ/ה סֹֽכְכִ֤ים בְּ/כַנְפֵי/הֶם֙ עַל הַ/כַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑י/ו אֶל הַ/כַּפֹּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַ/כְּרֻבִֽים
verses.translit: vyhyv hkhrbym prshy khnpym lm'lh skhkhym bkhnpyhm 'l hkhprt vpnyhm 'ysh 'l 'chyv 'l hkhprt hyv pny hkhrbym
verses.translation: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּ/וֹ֙ וְ/אַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔/וֹ וְ/אַמָּ֥ה וָ/חֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hshlchn 'tsy shtym 'mtym 'rkhv v'mh rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֹת֖/וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛/וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vytsf 'tv zhb thvr vy'sh lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ ל֥/וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ זֵר זָהָ֛ב לְ/מִסְגַּרְתּ֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vy'sh lv msgrt tpch sbyb vy'sh zr zhb lmsgrtv sbyb
verses.translation: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצֹ֣ק ל֔/וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַ/פֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytsq lv 'rb' tb't zhb vytn 't htb't 'l 'rb' hp't 'shr l'rb' rglyv
verses.translation: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

verses.original: לְ/עֻמַּת֙ הַ/מִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֑ת בָּתִּים֙ לַ/בַּדִּ֔ים לָ/שֵׂ֖את אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָֽן
verses.translit: l'mt hmsgrt hyv htb't btym lbdym lsh't 't hshlchn
verses.translation: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ אֶת הַ/בַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָ֑ב לָ/שֵׂ֖את אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָֽן
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hbdym 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm zhb lsh't 't hshlchn
verses.translation: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת הַ/כֵּלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֶת קְעָרֹתָ֤י/ו וְ/אֶת כַּפֹּתָי/ו֙ וְ/אֵת֙ מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/קְּשָׂוֺ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּ/הֵ֑ן זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hkhlym 'shr 'l hshlchn 't q'rtyv v't khptyv v't mnqytyv v't hqshvt 'shr yskh bhn zhb thvr
verses.translation: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָ֖ה זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣/הּ וְ/קָנָ֔/הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛י/הָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥י/הָ וּ/פְרָחֶ֖י/הָ מִמֶּ֥/נָּה הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hmnrh zhb thvr mqshh 'shh 't hmnrh yrkhh vqnh gby'yh khptryh vprchyh mmnh hyv
verses.translation: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִ/צִּדֶּ֑י/הָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִ/צִּדָּ/הּ֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִ/צִּדָּ֖/הּ הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vshshh qnym yts'ym mtsdyh shlshh qny mnrh mtsdh h'chd vshlshh qny mnrh mtsdh hshny
verses.translation: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּ/קָּנֶ֣ה הָ/אֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָ/פֶרַח֒ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בְּ/קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָ/פָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְ/שֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַ/קָּנִ֔ים הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן הַ/מְּנֹרָֽה
verses.translit: shlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh h'chd khptr vprch vshlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh 'chd khptr vprch khn lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mn hmnrh
verses.translation: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/מְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁ֨קָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖י/הָ וּ/פְרָחֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbmnrh 'rb'h gb'ym mshqdym khptryh vprchyh
verses.translation: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

verses.original: וְ/כַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַ/קָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗/נָּה וְ/כַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַ/קָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔/נָּה וְ/כַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּֽחַת שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/קָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑/נָּה לְ/שֵׁ֨שֶׁת֙ הַ/קָּנִ֔ים הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mmnh
verses.translation: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

verses.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵי/הֶ֥ם וּ/קְנֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּ֣/נָּה הָי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛/הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: khptryhm vqntm mmnh hyv khlh mqshh 'cht zhb thvr
verses.translation: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֖י/הָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וּ/מַלְקָחֶ֥י/הָ וּ/מַחְתֹּתֶ֖י/הָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'sh 't nrtyh shb'h vmlqchyh vmchttyh zhb thvr
verses.translation: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

verses.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל כֵּלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khkhr zhb thvr 'shh 'th v't khl khlyh
verses.translation: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/קְּטֹ֖רֶת עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּ֣ה אָרְכּ/וֹ֩ וְ/אַמָּ֨ה רָחְבּ֜/וֹ רָב֗וּעַ וְ/אַמָּתַ֨יִם֙ קֹֽמָת֔/וֹ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ הָי֥וּ קַרְנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh 't mzbch hqtrt 'tsy shtym 'mh 'rkhv v'mh rchbv rbv' v'mtym qmtv mmnv hyv qrntyv
verses.translation: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֨ף אֹת֜/וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת גַּגּ֧/וֹ וְ/אֶת קִירֹתָ֛י/ו סָבִ֖יב וְ/אֶת קַרְנֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛/וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vytsf 'tv zhb thvr 't ggv v't qyrtyv sbyb v't qrntyv vy'sh lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב עָֽשָׂה ל֣/וֹ מִ/תַּ֣חַת לְ/זֵר֗/וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔י/ו עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑י/ו לְ/בָתִּ֣ים לְ/בַדִּ֔ים לָ/שֵׂ֥את אֹת֖/וֹ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vshty tb't zhb 'shh lv mtcht lzrv 'l shty tsl'tyv 'l shny tsdyv lbtym lbdym lsh't 'tv bhm
verses.translation: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/בַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hbdym 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ אֶת שֶׁ֤מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָה֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְ/אֶת קְטֹ֥רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֖ים טָה֑וֹר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'sh 't shmn hmshchh qdsh v't qtrt hsmym thvr m'shh rqch
verses.translation: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָ֖ה עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אָרְכּ֜/וֹ וְ/חָֽמֵשׁ אַמּ֤וֹת רָחְבּ/וֹ֙ רָב֔וּעַ וְ/שָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh 't mzbch h'lh 'tsy shtym chmsh 'mvt 'rkhv vchmsh 'mvt rchbv rbv' vshlsh 'mvt qmtv
verses.translation: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ קַרְנֹתָ֗י/ו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔י/ו מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ הָי֣וּ קַרְנֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֹת֖/וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vy'sh qrntyv 'l 'rb' pntyv mmnv hyv qrntyv vytsf 'tv nchsht
verses.translation: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֣י הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶת הַ/סִּירֹ֤ת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָקֹ֔ת אֶת הַ/מִּזְלָגֹ֖ת וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּחְתֹּ֑ת כָּל כֵּלָ֖י/ו עָשָׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vy'sh 't khl khly hmzbch 't hsyrt v't hy'ym v't hmzrqt 't hmzlgt v't hmchtt khl khlyv 'shh nchsht
verses.translation: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת תַּ֧חַת כַּרְכֻּבּ֛/וֹ מִ/לְּ/מַ֖טָּה עַד חֶצְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh lmzbch mkhbr m'shh rsht nchsht tcht khrkhbv mlmth 'd chtsyv
verses.translation: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצֹ֞ק אַרְבַּ֧ע טַבָּעֹ֛ת בְּ/אַרְבַּ֥ע הַ/קְּצָוֺ֖ת לְ/מִכְבַּ֣ר הַ/נְּחֹ֑שֶׁת בָּתִּ֖ים לַ/בַּדִּֽים
verses.translit: vytsq 'rb' tb't b'rb' hqtsvt lmkhbr hnchsht btym lbdym
verses.translation: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/בַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖/ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hbdym 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm nchsht
verses.translation: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֨א אֶת הַ/בַּדִּ֜ים בַּ/טַּבָּעֹ֗ת עַ֚ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לָ/שֵׂ֥את אֹת֖/וֹ בָּ/הֶ֑ם נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' 't hbdym btb't 'l tsl't hmzbch lsh't 'tv bhm nbvb lcht 'shh 'tv
verses.translation: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַשׂ אֵ֚ת הַ/כִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְ/אֵ֖ת כַּנּ֣/וֹ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת בְּ/מַרְאֹת֙ הַ/צֹּ֣בְאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽבְא֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hkhyvr nchsht v't khnv nchsht bmr't htsb't 'shr tsb'v ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת הֶ/חָצֵ֑ר לִ/פְאַ֣ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֗נָ/ה קַלְעֵ֤י הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֔ר מֵאָ֖ה בָּ/אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hchtsr lp't ngb tymnh ql'y hchtsr shsh mshzr m'h b'mh
verses.translation: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

verses.original: עַמּוּדֵי/הֶ֣ם עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָ/עַמֻּדִ֛ים וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: 'mvdyhm 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ מֵאָ֣ה בָֽ/אַמָּ֔ה עַמּוּדֵי/הֶ֣ם עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽ/עַמּוּדִ֛ים וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vlp't tspvn m'h b'mh 'mvdyhm 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mvdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְאַת יָ֗ם קְלָעִים֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה עַמּוּדֵי/הֶ֥ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וָוֵ֧י הָ/עַמֻּדִ֛ים וַ/חֲשׁוּקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vlp't ym ql'ym chmshym b'mh 'mvdyhm 'shrh v'dnyhm 'shrh vvy h'mdym vchshvqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָ/ה מִזְרָ֖חָ/ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vlp't qdmh mzrchh chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

verses.original: קְלָעִ֛ים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה אֶל הַ/כָּתֵ֑ף עַמּוּדֵי/הֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: ql'ym chmsh 'shrh 'mh 'l hkhtf 'mvdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.original: וְ/לַ/כָּתֵ֣ף הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗ית מִ/זֶּ֤ה וּ/מִ/זֶּה֙ לְ/שַׁ֣עַר הֶֽ/חָצֵ֔ר קְלָעִ֕ים חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵי/הֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vlkhtf hshnyt mzh vmzh lsh'r hchtsr ql'ym chmsh 'shrh 'mh 'mdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.original: כָּל קַלְעֵ֧י הֶ/חָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר
verses.translit: khl ql'y hchtsr sbyb shsh mshzr
verses.translation: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲדָנִ֣ים לָֽ/עַמֻּדִים֮ נְחֹשֶׁת֒ וָוֵ֨י הָֽ/עַמּוּדִ֜ים וַ/חֲשׁוּקֵי/הֶם֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/צִפּ֥וּי רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְ/הֵם֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף כֹּ֖ל עַמֻּדֵ֥י הֶ/חָצֵֽר
verses.translit: vh'dnym l'mdym nchsht vvy h'mvdym vchshvqyhm khsf vtspvy r'shyhm khsf vhm mchshqym khsf khl 'mdy hchtsr
verses.translation: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

verses.original: וּ/מָסַ֞ךְ שַׁ֤עַר הֶ/חָצֵר֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֔ם תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְ/קוֹמָ֤ה בְ/רֹ֨חַב֙ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת קַלְעֵ֥י הֶ/חָצֵֽר
verses.translit: vmskh sh'r hchtsr m'shh rqm tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr v'shrym 'mh 'rkh vqvmh brchb chmsh 'mvt l'mt ql'y hchtsr
verses.translation: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

verses.original: וְ/עַמֻּֽדֵי/הֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֥ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵי/הֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/צִפּ֧וּי רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֛ם וַ/חֲשֻׁקֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'mdyhm 'rb'h v'dnyhm 'rb'h nchsht vvyhm khsf vtspvy r'shyhm vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

verses.original: וְֽ/כָל הַ/יְתֵדֹ֞ת לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֧ן וְ/לֶ/חָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vkhl hytdt lmshkhn vlchtsr sbyb nchsht
verses.translation: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֤י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָ/עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֻּקַּ֖ד עַל פִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה עֲבֹדַת֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם בְּ/יַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy hmshkhn mshkhn h'dt 'shr pqd 'l py mshh 'bdt hlvym byd 'ytmr bn 'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

verses.original: וּ/בְצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אוּרִ֥י בֶן ח֖וּר לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vbtsl'l bn 'vry bn chvr lmth yhvdh 'shh 't khl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וְ/אִתּ֗/וֹ אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָ֛ךְ לְ/מַטֵּה דָ֖ן חָרָ֣שׁ וְ/חֹשֵׁ֑ב וְ/רֹקֵ֗ם בַּ/תְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּ/בָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּ/בְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֖י וּ/בַ/שֵּֽׁשׁ
verses.translit: v'tv 'hly'b bn 'chysmkh lmth dn chrsh vchshb vrqm btkhlt vb'rgmn vbtvl't hshny vbshsh
verses.translation: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/זָּהָ֗ב הֶֽ/עָשׂוּי֙ לַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה בְּ/כֹ֖ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַ/יְהִ֣י זְהַ֣ב הַ/תְּנוּפָ֗ה תֵּ֤שַׁע וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ כִּכָּ֔ר וּ/שְׁבַ֨ע מֵא֧וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּ/שֶׁ֥קֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: khl hzhb h'shvy lml'khh bkhl ml'kht hqdsh vyhy zhb htnvph tsh' v'shrym khkhr vshb' m'vt vshlshym shql bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place , even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.original: וְ/כֶ֛סֶף פְּקוּדֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה מְאַ֣ת כִּכָּ֑ר וְ/אֶלֶף֩ וּ/שְׁבַ֨ע מֵא֜וֹת וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֛ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּ/שֶׁ֥קֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vkhsf pqvdy h'dh m't khkhr v'lf vshb' m'vt vchmshh vshb'ym shql bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.original: בֶּ֚קַע לַ/גֻּלְגֹּ֔לֶת מַחֲצִ֥ית הַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְ/כֹ֨ל הָ/עֹבֵ֜ר עַל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֗ים מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה לְ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: bq' lglglt mchtsyt hshql bshql hqdsh lkhl h'br 'l hpqdym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lshsh m'vt 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: A bekah for every man, that is , half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מְאַת֙ כִּכַּ֣ר הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף לָ/צֶ֗קֶת אֵ֚ת אַדְנֵ֣י הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְ/אֵ֖ת אַדְנֵ֣י הַ/פָּרֹ֑כֶת מְאַ֧ת אֲדָנִ֛ים לִ/מְאַ֥ת הַ/כִּכָּ֖ר כִּכָּ֥ר לָ/אָֽדֶן
verses.translit: vyhy m't khkhr hkhsf ltsqt 't 'dny hqdsh v't 'dny hprkht m't 'dnym lm't hkhkhr khkhr l'dn
verses.translation: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אֶ֜לֶף וּ/שְׁבַ֤ע הַ/מֵּאוֹת֙ וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֔ים עָשָׂ֥ה וָוִ֖ים לָ/עַמּוּדִ֑ים וְ/צִפָּ֥ה רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם וְ/חִשַּׁ֥ק אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v't h'lf vshb' hm'vt vchmshh vshb'ym 'shh vvym l'mvdym vtsph r'shyhm vchshq 'tm
verses.translation: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

verses.original: וּ/נְחֹ֥שֶׁת הַ/תְּנוּפָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֣ים כִּכָּ֑ר וְ/אַלְפַּ֥יִם וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵא֖וֹת שָֽׁקֶל
verses.translit: vnchsht htnvph shb'ym khkhr v'lpym v'rb' m'vt shql
verses.translation: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ בָּ֗/הּ אֶת אַדְנֵי֙ פֶּ֚תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/אֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/נְּחֹ֔שֶׁת וְ/אֶת מִכְבַּ֥ר הַ/נְּחֹ֖שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל כְּלֵ֥י הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'sh bh 't 'dny ptch 'hl mv'd v't mzbch hnchsht v't mkhbr hnchsht 'shr lv v't khl khly hmzbch
verses.translation: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אַדְנֵ֤י הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ סָבִ֔יב וְ/אֶת אַדְנֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר הֶ/חָצֵ֑ר וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל יִתְדֹ֧ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְ/אֶת כָּל יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: v't 'dny hchtsr sbyb v't 'dny sh'r hchtsr v't khl ytdt hmshkhn v't khl ytdt hchtsr sbyb
verses.translation: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְ/הָֽ/אַרְגָּמָן֙ וְ/תוֹלַ֣עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי שְׂרָ֖ד לְ/שָׁרֵ֣ת בַּ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vmn htkhlt vh'rgmn vtvl't hshny 'shv bgdy shrd lshrt bqdsh vy'shv 't bgdy hqdsh 'shr l'hrn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת הָ/אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר
verses.translit: vy'sh 't h'pd zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr
verses.translation: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת פַּחֵ֣י הַ/זָּהָב֮ וְ/קִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּ/ת֤וֹךְ הַ/תְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּ/בְ/ת֣וֹךְ הָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּ/בְ/ת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֖י וּ/בְ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/שֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vyrq'v 't pchy hzhb vqtsts ptylm l'shvt btvkh htkhlt vbtvkh h'rgmn vbtvkh tvl't hshny vbtvkh hshsh m'shh chshb
verses.translation: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

verses.original: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ ל֖/וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל שְׁנֵ֥י קצוות/ו קְצוֹתָ֖י/ו חֻבָּֽר
verses.translit: khtpt 'shv lv chbrt 'l shny qtsvvtv qtsvtyv chbr
verses.translation: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

verses.original: וְ/חֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗י/ו מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ/הוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vchshb 'pdtv 'shr 'lyv mmnv hv' khm'shhv zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת אַבְנֵ֣י הַ/שֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'shv 't 'bny hshhm msbt mshbtst zhb mptcht ptvchy chvtm 'l shmvt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗/ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָ/אֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyshm 'tm 'l khtpt h'pd 'bny zkhrvn lbny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
