verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת הַ/חֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hchshn m'shh chshb khm'shh 'pd zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr
verses.translation: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.original: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת הַ/חֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכּ֛/וֹ וְ/זֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּ֖/וֹ כָּפֽוּל
verses.translit: rbv' hyh khpvl 'shv 't hchshn zrt 'rkhv vzrt rchbv khpvl
verses.translation: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַלְאוּ ב֔/וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּ/בָרֶ֔קֶת הַ/טּ֖וּר הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyml'v bv 'rb'h tvry 'bn tvr 'dm ptdh vbrqt htvr h'chd
verses.translation: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/טּ֖וּר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְ/יָהֲלֹֽם
verses.translit: vhtvr hshny npkh spyr vyhlm
verses.translation: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/טּ֖וּר הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְ/אַחְלָֽמָה
verses.translit: vhtvr hshlyshy lshm shbv v'chlmh
verses.translation: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/טּוּר֙ הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְ/יָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב בְּ/מִלֻּאֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhtvr hrby'y trshysh shhm vyshph mvsbt mshbtsvt zhb bml'tm
verses.translation: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָ/אֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל שְׁמֹתָ֑/ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל שְׁמ֔/וֹ לִ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: vh'bnym 'l shmt bny yshr'l hnh shtym 'shrh 'l shmtm ptvchy chtm 'ysh 'l shmv lshnym 'shr shbt
verses.translation: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל הַ/חֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'shv 'l hchshn shrshrt gblt m'shh 'bt zhb thvr
verses.translation: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּ/שְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vy'shv shty mshbtst zhb vshty tb't zhb vytnv 't shty htb't 'l shny qtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָ/עֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַ/זָּהָ֔ב עַל שְׁתֵּ֖י הַ/טַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל קְצ֖וֹת הַ/חֹֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vytnv shty h'btt hzhb 'l shty htb't 'l qtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽ/עֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽ/מִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽ/יִּתְּנֻ֛/ם עַל כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד אֶל מ֥וּל פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't shty qtsvt shty h'btt ntnv 'l shty hmshbtst vytnm 'l khtpt h'pd 'l mvl pnyv
verses.translation: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַ/יָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַ/חֹ֑שֶׁן עַל שְׂפָת֕/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל עֵ֥בֶר הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'shv shty tb't zhb vyshymv 'l shny qtsvt hchshn 'l shptv 'shr 'l 'br h'pd byth
verses.translation: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽ/יִּתְּנֻ֡/ם עַל שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָ/אֵפֹ֤ד מִ/לְ/מַ֨טָּה֙ מִ/מּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔י/ו לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑/וֹ מִ/מַּ֕עַל לְ/חֵ֖שֶׁב הָ/אֵפֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'shv shty tb't zhb vytnm 'l shty khtpt h'pd mlmth mmvl pnyv l'mt mchbrtv mm'l lchshb h'pd
verses.translation: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת הַ/חֹ֡שֶׁן מִ/טַּבְּעֹתָי/ו֩ אֶל טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָ/אֵפֹ֜ד בִּ/פְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽ/הְיֹת֙ עַל חֵ֣שֶׁב הָ/אֵפֹ֔ד וְ/לֹֽא יִזַּ֣ח הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁן מֵ/עַ֖ל הָ/אֵפֹ֑ד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyrkhsv 't hchshn mtb'tyv 'l tb't h'pd bptyl tkhlt lhyt 'l chshb h'pd vl' yzch hchshn m'l h'pd kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת מְעִ֥יל הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת
verses.translit: vy'sh 't m'yl h'pd m'shh 'rg khlyl tkhlt
verses.translation: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

verses.original: וּ/פִֽי הַ/מְּעִ֥יל בְּ/תוֹכ֖/וֹ כְּ/פִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְ/פִ֛י/ו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vpy hm'yl btvkhv khpy tchr' shph lpyv sbyb l' yqr'
verses.translation: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל שׁוּלֵ֣י הַ/מְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְ/תוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר
verses.translit: vy'shv 'l shvly hm'yl rmvny tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny mshzr
verses.translation: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת הַ/פַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/רִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל שׁוּלֵ֤י הַ/מְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ הָ/רִמֹּנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'shv p'mny zhb thvr vytnv 't hp'mnym btvkh hrmnym 'l shvly hm'yl sbyb btvkh hrmnym
verses.translation: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

verses.original: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְ/רִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְ/רִמֹּ֔ן עַל שׁוּלֵ֥י הַ/מְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְ/שָׁרֵ֕ת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: p'mn vrmn p'mn vrmn 'l shvly hm'yl sbyb lshrt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת הַ/כָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'shv 't hkhtnt shsh m'shh 'rg l'hrn vlbnyv
verses.translation: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/מִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְ/אֶת פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַ/מִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְ/אֶת מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַ/בָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר
verses.translit: v't hmtsnpt shsh v't p'ry hmgb't shsh v't mkhnsy hbd shsh mshzr
verses.translation: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת הָ/אַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּ/תְכֵ֧לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְ/תוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v't h'bnt shsh mshzr vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny m'shh rqm kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַ/יִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗י/ו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'shv 't tsyts nzr hqdsh zhb thvr vykhtbv 'lyv mkhtb ptvchy chvtm qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָי/ו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָ/תֵ֥ת עַל הַ/מִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vytnv 'lyv ptyl tkhlt ltt 'l hmtsnpt mlm'lh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֕כֶל כָּל עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vtkhl khl 'bdt mshkhn 'hl mv'd vy'shv bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn 'shv
verses.translation: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת הָ/אֹ֖הֶל וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו קְרָסָ֣י/ו קְרָשָׁ֔י/ו בריח/ו בְּרִיחָ֖י/ו וְ/עַמֻּדָ֥י/ו וַ/אֲדָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyby'v 't hmshkhn 'l mshh 't h'hl v't khl khlyv qrsyv qrshyv brychv brychyv v'mdyv v'dnyv
verses.translation: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מִכְסֵ֞ה עוֹרֹ֤ת הָֽ/אֵילִם֙ הַ/מְאָדָּמִ֔ים וְ/אֶת מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַ/תְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְ/אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַ/מָּסָֽךְ
verses.translit: v't mkhsh 'vrt h'ylm hm'dmym v't mkhsh 'rt htchshym v't prkht hmskh
verses.translation: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

verses.original: אֶת אֲרֹ֥ן הָ/עֵדֻ֖ת וְ/אֶת בַּדָּ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת הַ/כַּפֹּֽרֶת
verses.translit: 't 'rn h'dt v't bdyv v't hkhprt
verses.translation: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

verses.original: אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַ/פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: 't hshlchn 't khl khlyv v't lchm hpnym
verses.translation: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

verses.original: אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָ֨ה הַ/טְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֗י/הָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַ/מַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַ/מָּאֽוֹר
verses.translit: 't hmnrh hthrh 't nrtyh nrt hm'rkhh v't khl khlyh v't shmn hm'vr
verses.translation: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/זָּהָ֔ב וְ/אֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֑ים וְ/אֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: v't mzbch hzhb v't shmn hmshchh v't qtrt hsmym v't mskh ptch h'hl
verses.translation: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

verses.original: אֵ֣ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/נְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְ/אֶת מִכְבַּ֤ר הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ אֶת בַּדָּ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֖ר וְ/אֶת כַּנּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't mzbch hnchsht v't mkhbr hnchsht 'shr lv 't bdyv v't khl khlyv 't hkhyr v't khnv
verses.translation: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

verses.original: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶ/חָצֵ֜ר אֶת עַמֻּדֶ֣י/הָ וְ/אֶת אֲדָנֶ֗י/הָ וְ/אֶת הַ/מָּסָךְ֙ לְ/שַׁ֣עַר הֶֽ/חָצֵ֔ר אֶת מֵיתָרָ֖י/ו וִ/יתֵדֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵ֗ת כָּל כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: 't ql'y hchtsr 't 'mdyh v't 'dnyh v't hmskh lsh'r hchtsr 't mytryv vytdtyh v't khl khly 'bdt hmshkhn l'hl mv'd
verses.translation: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

verses.original: אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י הַ/שְּׂרָ֖ד לְ/שָׁרֵ֣ת בַּ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו לְ/כַהֵֽן
verses.translit: 't bgdy hshrd lshrt bqdsh 't bgdy hqdsh l'hrn hkhhn v't bgdy bnyv lkhhn
verses.translation: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

verses.original: כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל הָ/עֲבֹדָֽה
verses.translit: khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l 't khl h'bdh
verses.translation: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת כָּל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖/ם מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyr' mshh 't khl hml'khh vhnh 'shv 'th kh'shr tsvh yhvh khn 'shv vybrkh 'tm mshh
verses.translation: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: בְּ/יוֹם הַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: byvm hchdsh hr'shvn b'chd lchdsh tqym 't mshkhn 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָ/עֵד֑וּת וְ/סַכֹּתָ֥ עַל הָ/אָרֹ֖ן אֶת הַ/פָּרֹֽכֶת
verses.translit: vshmt shm 't 'rvn h'dvt vskht 'l h'rn 't hprkht
verses.translation: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְ/עָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת עֶרְכּ֑/וֹ וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָ֔ה וְ/הַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת נֵרֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhb't 't hshlchn v'rkht 't 'rkhv vhb't 't hmnrh vh'lyt 't nrtyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/זָּהָב֙ לִ/קְטֹ֔רֶת לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָ/עֵדֻ֑ת וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת מָסַ֥ךְ הַ/פֶּ֖תַח לַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vntth 't mzbch hzhb lqtrt lpny 'rvn h'dt vshmt 't mskh hptch lmshkhn
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/נָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֑ה לִ/פְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vntth 't mzbch h'lh lpny ptch mshkhn 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/נָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vntt 't hkhyr byn 'hl mv'd vbyn hmzbch vntt shm mym
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת הֶ/חָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְ/נָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶ/חָצֵֽר
verses.translit: vshmt 't hchtsr sbyb vntt 't mskh sh'r hchtsr
verses.translation: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑/וֹ וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֖י/ו וְ/הָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vlqcht 't shmn hmshchh vmshcht 't hmshkhn v't khl 'shr bv vqdsht 'tv v't khl khlyv vhyh qdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/הָיָ֥ה הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vmshcht 't mzbch h'lh v't khl khlyv vqdsht 't hmzbch vhyh hmzbch qdsh qdshym
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

verses.translit: vmshcht 't hkhyr v't khnv vqdsht 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֔י/ו אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/רָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vhqrbt 't 'hrn v't bnyv 'l ptch 'hl mv'd vrchtst 'tm bmym
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

verses.original: וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/קִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖/וֹ וְ/כִהֵ֥ן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhlbsht 't 'hrn 't bgdy hqdsh vmshcht 'tv vqdsht 'tv vkhhn ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֖י/ו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת
verses.translit: v't bnyv tqryb vhlbsht 'tm khtnt
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֨חְתָּ֙ אֶת אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם וְ/כִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑/י וְ֠/הָיְתָה לִ/הְיֹ֨ת לָ/הֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛/ם לִ/כְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vmshcht 'tm kh'shr mshcht 't 'byhm vkhhnv ly vhyth lhyt lhm mshchtm lkhhnt 'vlm ldrtm
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖/וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv khn 'shh
verses.translation: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בַּ/חֹ֧דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vyhy bchdsh hr'shvn bshnh hshnyt b'chd lchdsh hvqm hmshkhn
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת אֲדָנָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת קְרָשָׁ֔י/ו וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת בְּרִיחָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֖קֶם אֶת עַמּוּדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm mshh 't hmshkhn vytn 't 'dnyv vyshm 't qrshyv vytn 't brychyv vyqm 't 'mvdyv
verses.translation: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת הָ/אֹ֨הֶל֙ עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַ/יָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵ֥ה הָ/אֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖י/ו מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyprsh 't h'hl 'l hmshkhn vyshm 't mkhsh h'hl 'lyv mlm'lh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת הָ/עֵדֻת֙ אֶל הָ֣/אָרֹ֔ן וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הַ/בַּדִּ֖ים עַל הָ/אָרֹ֑ן וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל הָ/אָרֹ֖ן מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqch vytn 't h'dt 'l h'rn vyshm 't hbdym 'l h'rn vytn 't hkhprt 'l h'rn mlm'lh
verses.translation: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֣א אֶת הָ/אָרֹן֮ אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַ/יָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַ/מָּסָ֔ךְ וַ/יָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָ/עֵד֑וּת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyb' 't h'rn 'l hmshkhn vyshm 't prkht hmskh vyskh 'l 'rvn h'dvt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָ/ה מִ/ח֖וּץ לַ/פָּרֹֽכֶת
verses.translit: vytn 't hshlchn b'hl mv'd 'l yrkh hmshkhn tspnh mchvts lprkht
verses.translation: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛י/ו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'rkh 'lyv 'rkh lchm lpny yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD ; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָה֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyshm 't hmnrh b'hl mv'd nkhch hshlchn 'l yrkh hmshkhn ngbh
verses.translation: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל הַ/נֵּרֹ֖ת לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'l hnrt lpny yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/זָּהָ֖ב בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִ/פְנֵ֖י הַ/פָּרֹֽכֶת
verses.translit: vyshm 't mzbch hzhb b'hl mv'd lpny hprkht
verses.translation: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖י/ו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyqtr 'lyv qtrt smym kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת מָסַ֥ךְ הַ/פֶּ֖תַח לַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vyshm 't mskh hptch lmshkhn
verses.translation: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗י/ו אֶת הָ/עֹלָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v't mzbch h'lh shm ptch mshkhn 'hl mv'd vy'l 'lyv 't h'lh v't hmnchh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּ/ה מַ֖יִם לְ/רָחְצָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm 't hkhyr byn 'hl mv'd vbyn hmzbch vytn shmh mym lrchtsh
verses.translation: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal .

verses.original: וְ/רָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/בָנָ֑י/ו אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת רַגְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vrchtsv mmnv mshh v'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm v't rglyhm
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

verses.original: בְּ/בֹאָ֞/ם אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּ/בְ/קָרְבָתָ֛/ם אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: bb'm 'l 'hl mv'd vbqrbtm 'l hmzbch yrchtsv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קֶם אֶת הֶ/חָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְ/לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַ/יִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶ/חָצֵ֑ר וַ/יְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת הַ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vyqm 't hchtsr sbyb lmshkhn vlmzbch vytn 't mskh sh'r hchtsr vykhl mshh 't hml'khh
verses.translation: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֥ס הֶ/עָנָ֖ן אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּ/כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vykhs h'nn 't 'hl mv'd vkhbvd yhvh ml' 't hmshkhn
verses.translation: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָ/בוֹא֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖י/ו הֶ/עָנָ֑ן וּ/כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vl' ykhl mshh lbv' 'l 'hl mv'd khy shkhn 'lyv h'nn vkhbvd yhvh ml' 't hmshkhn
verses.translation: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/כֹ֖ל מַסְעֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbh'lvt h'nn m'l hmshkhn ys'v bny yshr'l bkhl ms'yhm
verses.translation: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶ/עָנָ֑ן וְ/לֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm l' y'lh h'nn vl' ys'v 'd yvm h'ltv
verses.translation: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

verses.original: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְ/אֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵ֥י כָל בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/כָל מַסְעֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'nn yhvh 'l hmshkhn yvmm v'sh thyh lylh bv l'yny khl byt yshr'l bkhl ms'yhm
verses.translation: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו מֵ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyqr' 'l mshh vydbr yhvh 'lyv m'hl mv'd l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי יַקְרִ֥יב מִ/כֶּ֛ם קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָ֗ה מִן הַ/בָּקָר֙ וּ/מִן הַ/צֹּ֔אן תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ אֶת קָרְבַּנְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'dm khy yqryb mkhm qrbn lyhvh mn hbhmh mn hbqr vmn hts'n tqrybv 't qrbnkhm
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD , ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

verses.original: אִם עֹלָ֤ה קָרְבָּנ/וֹ֙ מִן הַ/בָּקָ֔ר זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶ֑/נּוּ אֶל פֶּ֝תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ יַקְרִ֣יב אֹת֔/וֹ לִ/רְצֹנ֖/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm 'lh qrbnv mn hbqr zkhr tmym yqrybnv 'l ptch 'hl mv'd yqryb 'tv lrtsnv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/סָמַ֣ךְ יָד֔/וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וְ/נִרְצָ֥ה ל֖/וֹ לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vsmkh ydv 'l r'sh h'lh vnrtsh lv lkhpr 'lyv
verses.translation: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַ֛ט אֶת בֶּ֥ן הַ/בָּקָ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠/הִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן הַֽ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם וְ/זָרְק֨וּ אֶת הַ/דָּ֤ם עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vshcht 't bn hbqr lpny yhvh vhqrybv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 't hdm vzrqv 't hdm 'l hmzbch sbyb 'shr ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD : and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/הִפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וְ/נִתַּ֥ח אֹתָ֖/הּ לִ/נְתָחֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhpshyt 't h'lh vntch 'th lntchyh
verses.translation: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

verses.original: וְ֠/נָתְנוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֵ֖שׁ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/עָרְכ֥וּ עֵצִ֖ים עַל הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vntnv bny 'hrn hkhhn 'sh 'l hmzbch v'rkhv 'tsym 'l h'sh
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

verses.original: וְ/עָרְכ֗וּ בְּנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֵ֚ת הַ/נְּתָחִ֔ים אֶת הָ/רֹ֖אשׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/פָּ֑דֶר עַל הָ/עֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָ/אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: v'rkhv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 't hntchym 't hr'sh v't hpdr 'l h'tsym 'shr 'l h'sh 'shr 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

verses.original: וְ/קִרְבּ֥/וֹ וּ/כְרָעָ֖י/ו יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/הִקְטִ֨יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת הַ/כֹּל֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עֹלָ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיח֖וֹחַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vqrbv vkhr'yv yrchts bmym vhqtyr hkhhn 't hkhl hmzbchh 'lh 'shh rych nychvch lyhvh
verses.translation: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם מִן הַ/צֹּ֨אן קָרְבָּנ֧/וֹ מִן הַ/כְּשָׂבִ֛ים א֥וֹ מִן הָ/עִזִּ֖ים לְ/עֹלָ֑ה זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: v'm mn hts'n qrbnv mn hkhshbym 'v mn h'zym l'lh zkhr tmym yqrybnv
verses.translation: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely , of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַ֨ט אֹת֜/וֹ עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֛חַ צָפֹ֖נָ/ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/זָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת דָּמ֛/וֹ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vshcht 'tv 'l yrkh hmzbch tspnh lpny yhvh vzrqv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 't dmv 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD : and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/נִתַּ֤ח אֹת/וֹ֙ לִ/נְתָחָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת פִּדְר֑/וֹ וְ/עָרַ֤ךְ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔/ם עַל הָֽ/עֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָ/אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vntch 'tv lntchyv v't r'shv v't pdrv v'rkh hkhhn 'tm 'l h'tsym 'shr 'l h'sh 'shr 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/קֶּ֥רֶב וְ/הַ/כְּרָעַ֖יִם יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/הִקְרִ֨יב הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת הַ/כֹּל֙ וְ/הִקְטִ֣יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqrb vhkhr'ym yrchts bmym vhqryb hkhhn 't hkhl vhqtyr hmzbchh 'lh hv' 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִ֧ם מִן הָ/ע֛וֹף עֹלָ֥ה קָרְבָּנ֖/וֹ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הִקְרִ֣יב מִן הַ/תֹּרִ֗ים א֛וֹ מִן בְּנֵ֥י הַ/יּוֹנָ֖ה אֶת קָרְבָּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm mn h'vf 'lh qrbnv lyhvh vhqryb mn htrym 'v mn bny hyvnh 't qrbnv
verses.translation: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִיב֤/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּ/מָלַק֙ אֶת רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/הִקְטִ֖יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה וְ/נִמְצָ֣ה דָמ֔/וֹ עַ֖ל קִ֥יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vhqrybv hkhhn 'l hmzbch vmlq 't r'shv vhqtyr hmzbchh vnmtsh dmv 'l qyr hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

verses.original: וְ/הֵסִ֥יר אֶת מֻרְאָת֖/וֹ בְּ/נֹצָתָ֑/הּ וְ/הִשְׁלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜/הּ אֵ֤צֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ קֵ֔דְמָ/ה אֶל מְק֖וֹם הַ/דָּֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: vhsyr 't mr'tv bntsth vhshlykh 'th 'tsl hmzbch qdmh 'l mqvm hdshn
verses.translation: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁסַּ֨ע אֹת֣/וֹ בִ/כְנָפָי/ו֮ לֹ֣א יַבְדִּיל֒ וְ/הִקְטִ֨יר אֹת֤/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עַל הָ/עֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָ/אֵ֑שׁ עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshs' 'tv bkhnpyv l' ybdyl vhqtyr 'tv hkhhn hmzbchh 'l h'tsym 'shr 'l h'sh 'lh hv' 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/נֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קָרְבָּנ֑/וֹ וְ/יָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְ/נָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖י/הָ לְבֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vnpsh khy tqryb qrbn mnchh lyhvh slt yhyh qrbnv vytsq 'lyh shmn vntn 'lyh lbnh
verses.translation: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD , his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

verses.original: וֶֽ/הֱבִיאָ֗/הּ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֒ וְ/קָמַ֨ץ מִ/שָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗/וֹ מִ/סָּלְתָּ/הּ֙ וּ/מִ/שַּׁמְנָ֔/הּ עַ֖ל כָּל לְבֹנָתָ֑/הּ וְ/הִקְטִ֨יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָ/הּ֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhby'h 'l bny 'hrn hkhhnym vqmts mshm ml' qmtsv mslth vmshmnh 'l khl lbnth vhqtyr hkhhn 't 'zkhrth hmzbchh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֑י/ו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnvtrt mn hmnchh l'hrn vlbnyv qdsh qdshym m'shy yhvh
verses.translation: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וּ/רְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vkhy tqrb qrbn mnchh m'ph tnvr slt chlvt mtst blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn
verses.translation: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מִנְחָ֥ה עַל הַֽ/מַּחֲבַ֖ת קָרְבָּנֶ֑/ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'm mnchh 'l hmchbt qrbnkh slt blvlh bshmn mtsh thyh
verses.translation: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

verses.original: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָ/הּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְ/יָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖י/הָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: ptvt 'th ptym vytsqt 'lyh shmn mnchh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶ֑/ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: v'm mncht mrchsht qrbnkh slt bshmn t'shh
verses.translation: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵ/אֵ֖לֶּה לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הִקְרִיבָ/הּ֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִגִּישָׁ֖/הּ אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vhb't 't hmnchh 'shr y'shh m'lh lyhvh vhqrybh 'l hkhhn vhgyshh 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD : and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

verses.original: וְ/הֵרִ֨ים הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן מִן הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ אֶת אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔/הּ וְ/הִקְטִ֖יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhrym hkhhn mn hmnchh 't 'zkhrth vhqtyr hmzbchh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֑י/ו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnvtrt mn hmnchh l'hrn vlbnyv qdsh qdshym m'shy yhvh
verses.translation: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/מִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כָל שְׂאֹר֙ וְ/כָל דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl hmnchh 'shr tqrybv lyhvh l' t'shh chmts khy khl sh'r vkhl dbsh l' tqtyrv mmnv 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD , shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

verses.original: קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖/ם לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא יַעֲל֖וּ לְ/רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ
verses.translit: qrbn r'shyt tqrybv 'tm lyhvh v'l hmzbch l' y'lv lrych nychch
verses.translation: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD : but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

verses.original: וְ/כָל קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְ/ךָ֮ בַּ/מֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְ/לֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ מֵ/עַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑/ךָ עַ֥ל כָּל קָרְבָּנְ/ךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח
verses.translit: vkhl qrbn mnchtkh bmlch tmlch vl' tshbyt mlch bryt 'lhykh m'l mnchtkh 'l khl qrbnkh tqryb mlch
verses.translation: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

verses.original: וְ/אִם תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַ/יהוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּ/אֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'm tqryb mncht bkhvrym lyhvh 'byb qlvy b'sh grsh khrml tqryb 't mncht bkhvrykh
verses.translation: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD , thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖י/הָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: vntt 'lyh shmn vshmt 'lyh lbnh mnchh hv'
verses.translation: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִ֨יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָ֗/הּ מִ/גִּרְשָׂ/הּ֙ וּ/מִ/שַּׁמְנָ֔/הּ עַ֖ל כָּל לְבֹנָתָ֑/הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqtyr hkhhn 't 'zkhrth mgrshh vmshmnh 'l khl lbnth 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים קָרְבָּנ֑/וֹ אִ֤ם מִן הַ/בָּקָר֙ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֔יב אִם זָכָר֙ אִם נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֥ים יַקְרִיבֶ֖/נּוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm zbch shlmym qrbnv 'm mn hbqr hv' mqryb 'm zkhr 'm nqbh tmym yqrybnv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/סָמַ֤ךְ יָד/וֹ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ קָרְבָּנ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁחָט֕/וֹ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/זָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת הַ/דָּ֛ם עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vsmkh ydv 'l r'sh qrbnv vshchtv ptch 'hl mv'd vzrqv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 't hdm 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִיב֙ מִ/זֶּ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֔ים אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/קֶּ֔רֶב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/חֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/קֶּֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhqryb mzbch hshlmym 'shh lyhvh 't hchlb hmkhsh 't hqrb v't khl hchlb 'shr 'l hqrb
verses.translation: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/כְּסָלִ֑ים וְ/אֶת הַ/יֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַ/כְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lhn 'shr 'l hkhslym v't hytrt 'l hkhbd 'l hkhlyvt ysyrnh
verses.translation: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִ֨ירוּ אֹת֤/וֹ בְנֵֽי אַהֲרֹן֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עַל הָ֣/עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָ/עֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָ/אֵ֑שׁ אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqtyrv 'tv bny 'hrn hmzbchh 'l h'lh 'shr 'l h'tsym 'shr 'l h'sh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם מִן הַ/צֹּ֧אן קָרְבָּנ֛/וֹ לְ/זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַ/יהוָ֑ה זָכָר֙ א֣וֹ נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: v'm mn hts'n qrbnv lzbch shlmym lyhvh zkhr 'v nqbh tmym yqrybnv
verses.translation: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

verses.original: אִם כֶּ֥שֶׂב הֽוּא מַקְרִ֖יב אֶת קָרְבָּנ֑/וֹ וְ/הִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֖/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm khshb hv' mqryb 't qrbnv vhqryb 'tv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/סָמַ֤ךְ אֶת יָד/וֹ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ קָרְבָּנ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ֠/זָרְקוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת דָּמ֛/וֹ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vsmkh 't ydv 'l r'sh qrbnv vshcht 'tv lpny 'hl mv'd vzrqv bny 'hrn 't dmv 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֨יב מִ/זֶּ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִים֮ אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַ/יהוָה֒ חֶלְבּ/וֹ֙ הָ/אַלְיָ֣ה תְמִימָ֔ה לְ/עֻמַּ֥ת הֶ/עָצֶ֖ה יְסִירֶ֑/נָּה וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/קֶּ֔רֶב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/חֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/קֶּֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhqryb mzbch hshlmym 'shh lyhvh chlbv h'lyh tmymh l'mt h'tsh ysyrnh v't hchlb hmkhsh 't hqrb v't khl hchlb 'shr 'l hqrb
verses.translation: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/כְּסָלִ֑ים וְ/אֶת הַ/יֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַ/כְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lhn 'shr 'l hkhslym v't hytrt 'l hkhbd 'l hkhlyt ysyrnh
verses.translation: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִיר֥/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה לֶ֥חֶם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqtyrv hkhhn hmzbchh lchm 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִ֥ם עֵ֖ז קָרְבָּנ֑/וֹ וְ/הִקְרִיב֖/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm 'z qrbnv vhqrybv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/סָמַ֤ךְ אֶת יָד/וֹ֙ עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ֠/זָרְקוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת דָּמ֛/וֹ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vsmkh 't ydv 'l r'shv vshcht 'tv lpny 'hl mv'd vzrqv bny 'hrn 't dmv 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֤יב מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ קָרְבָּנ֔/וֹ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/קֶּ֔רֶב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/חֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/קֶּֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhqryb mmnv qrbnv 'shh lyhvh 't hchlb hmkhsh 't hqrb v't khl hchlb 'shr 'l hqrb
verses.translation: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/כְּסָלִ֑ים וְ/אֶת הַ/יֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַ/כְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lhn 'shr 'l hkhslym v't hytrt 'l hkhbd 'l hkhlyt ysyrnh
verses.translation: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִירָ֥/ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה לֶ֤חֶם אִשֶּׁה֙ לְ/רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ כָּל חֵ֖לֶב לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqtyrm hkhhn hmzbchh lchm 'shh lrych nychch khl chlb lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD’s .

verses.original: חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם כָּל חֵ֥לֶב וְ/כָל דָּ֖ם לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bkhl mvshbtykhm khl chlb vkhl dm l' t'khlv
verses.translation: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
